items.desc: ETANDEX est une entreprise française de travaux spéciaux. Nous réalisons plus de 1 500 chantiers par an, pour un chiffre d’affaires d’environ 180 M€ (2025). Nos équipes travaux mettent en œuvre des revêtements composites (résines, mortiers, fibres) pour des fonctions d’étanchéité, de renforcement et de protection des bétons, sur des ouvrages à forts enjeux techniques. L’équipe Innovation Procédés a pour mission de concevoir, tester, qualifier et déployer des procédés et systèmes de revêtements, puis d’en sécuriser la mise en œuvre sur chantier (documentation, règles d’exécution, assistance terrain). Nous recrutons un profil capable de relier expérimentation matériaux et exploitation de données, pour accélérer la mise au point des procédés, fiabiliser les performances et mieux maîtriser la variabilité terrain. Missions Concevoir et piloter des programmes d’essais matériaux/procédés (plans d’expérience, protocoles, traçabilité, analyse) Structurer et exploiter des jeux de données issus d’essais labo et de chantiers (résultats, conditions d’ambiance, paramètres d’application, non-conformités, REX) Développer des modèles et outils d’analyse pour comprendre, prédire et optimiser les performances (statistiques, ML, optimisation, incertitudes) Construire des workflows simples et robustes pour le traitement des données (collecte, nettoyage, versioning, reporting, reproductibilité) Définir et améliorer des méthodes d’essai et des critères d’acceptation, en cohérence avec les normes et les risques associés Transposer les innovations du laboratoire au chantier (modes opératoires, fiches techniques, supports de formation, accompagnement des équipes travaux) Travailler en interface avec les équipes mécanisation/robotisation et digitalisation, pour instrumenter les procédés, exploiter les données capteurs, et industrialiser les outils d’analyse Contribuer, selon les projets, à l’adaptation à des référentiels et normes étrangers (support technique, qualification, documentation) Exemples de sujets Modèles “propriétés – formulation – conditions d’application” pour réduire les itérations d’essais Détection de dérives et causes racines à partir des données d’essais et des retours terrain Optimisation multi-critères (performance, robustesse, contraintes d’exécution, environnement) Exploitation de données issues d’instrumentation et de machines de mise en œuvre Profil recherché Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat, avec un socle scientifique solide (matériaux, chimie, génie civil, mécanique) et une vraie pratique data (ou l’inverse, avec forte appétence matériaux/procédés) Très bonne maîtrise de Python et des outils data usuels (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn ; PyTorch/TensorFlow apprécié) Bon niveau en statistiques appliquées et en plan d’expérience (DoE), analyse d’incertitudes, validation Capacité à documenter proprement (protocoles, code, rapports) et à rendre les résultats actionnables Goût pour le terrain et capacité à dialoguer avec des équipes chantier, et accompagner l'innovation du laboratoire jusqu'au chantier Anglais opérationnel apprécié Conditions CDI, temps plein Poste basé aux Ulis (91), déplacements ponctuels sur chantiers et chez partenaires Rémunération indicative : à partir de 43 k€ annuels pour un profil débutant, ajustable selon parcours et expérience Voiture de service Parcours d’intégration et accompagnement par un ingénieur expérimenté, avec montée en compétence progressive Point d’attention Le poste n’est pas un poste “data” générique. Le cœur du travail reste la R&D matériaux/procédés, avec une responsabilité forte sur la mise en œuvre concrète et la maîtrise des risques techniques.

items.desc: 10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that. With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time. Founded in 2022, and with 800+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034. An interest in understanding the business and working closely with Product teams to improve how things work. Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure. What you can expect: Work close to the decisions that shape Aira's customer journey, where your insights can translate directly into changes to our products and processes.  At a glance 
 Early Careers at Sanofi aren’t just about landing a role – they’re about starting a journey that stretches you from day one. You’ll dive into projects that matter, surrounded by people who challenge, mentor, and inspire you to explore more every step of the way.
Here, you can navigate paths across science, digital, manufacturing, and business – following your curiosity, growing your expertise, and building skills for tomorrow. With AI-powered tools, world-class learning, and a culture rooted in collaboration, we give you the opportunity to develop your expertise and transform our future.
 Back to nav 
 Location: Waterford, Ireland
 Start Date: 1 September 2027
 Duration: 23 months | Two 8-month rotations, and 7-month
 Working Model: Fully on-site
 Working Hours: Full-time
 Salary: €41,600 gross per annum
 Assessment Centre: January 2027 | In person, Waterford
 Your opportunity at Sanofi 
 Ready to turn your academic knowledge into real-world experience?
 Join Sanofi, a global biopharmaceutical company, through our 23-month Graduate Programme in Waterford . Explore three different functions, gain hands-on industry experience and develop the skills to shape your future career.
 As a Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) Graduate , you'll discover how science and innovative technologies help bring life-changing medicines to patients. From introducing new products and improving manufacturing processes to developing analytical methods, you'll gain hands-on experience across three specialist areas that play a vital role in biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
 One programme. Three rotations. A world of experience. 
 Why explore just one area when you could experience three?
 Our structured Graduate Programme takes you through three rotations (two 8-month rotations, and 7-month), providing exposure to different functions, meaningful projects and opportunities to learn from experienced professionals.
 Your rotation journey 
 Rotation 1: Manufacturing Sciences | Months 1–8 
 Start your journey in the state-of-the-art MSAT laboratory, working alongside the Manufacturing Sciences team and supporting the Lyophilisation Centre of Excellence for the Sanofi network. You'll explore the science behind biopharmaceutical products and learn how laboratory technologies support manufacturing processes.
 Support new product introductions and technology transfers to Sanofi Waterford and the wider Sanofi network.
 Gain hands-on experience with small-scale lyophilisers, protein characterisation and solid-state characterisation techniques.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support manufacturing investigations and deviations.
 Rotation 2: Manufacturing Technologies & Industrialisation | Months 9–16 
 Build on your laboratory experience by exploring how scientific knowledge and technologies are transferred into commercial manufacturing. You'll learn how complex manufacturing processes are introduced, maintained and continuously improved.
 Support technology transfer projects and the introduction of new products to commercial manufacturing operations.
 Learn how changes to validated manufacturing processes are managed to improve efficiency and support product lifecycle management.
 Contribute to manufacturing investigations, deviation resolution and process improvement activities.
 Rotation 3: Analytical Sciences | Months 17–23 
 Complete your graduate journey in the MSAT Analytical Sciences team, working in a state-of-the-art analytical laboratory. You'll develop an understanding of the methods and technologies used to analyse biopharmaceutical products and support their quality.
 Gain experience in the development, qualification and validation of analytical methods for biopharmaceutical testing.
 Support analytical method transfers, new technology introduction and cross-functional projects.
 Contribute to analytical investigations, troubleshooting, method optimisation/automation and innovation initiatives.
 Your development focus 
 Throughout the programme, you'll build the scientific knowledge, technical capabilities and transferable skills needed to develop your career in Manufacturing Science and Technology.
 Scientific and technical expertise: Develop practical knowledge of lyophilisation, protein characterisation, analytical testing and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
 Problem-solving and analytical thinking: Strengthen your ability to interpret scientific data, investigate technical challenges and contribute to process improvements.
 Collaboration and communication: Build confidence in presenting scientific findings, working with …

items.desc: At Product Madness , we create mobile games that bring entertainment to players around the world. Data plays an important role in understanding player needs, improving gaming experiences, and making informed business decisions. Join our collaborative team, where your ideas and expertise will help us explore new opportunities, solve meaningful challenges, and shape the future of mobile gaming. The Role As a Data Scientist at Product Madness, you will use data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modelling to better understand player behaviour, solve business challenges, and improve gaming experiences. You will contribute to projects dedicated to player involvement, retention, and revenue. You will also help develop analytical tools and machine learning solutions that support informed decisions and create more personalised experiences for our players. Working with a variety of datasets, you will take ownership of clearly defined analytical and modelling tasks while learning from experienced data scientists on more complex projects. You will collaborate with game developers, data analysts, product managers, and game operations teams to translate data into meaningful insights and practical improvements. What You'll Do Explore business challenges, develop hypotheses, choose suitable analytical methods, and deliver data-driven solutions with support from experienced colleagues when needed. Develop, test, and improve predictive algorithms and artificial intelligence techniques to improve player experiences, engagement, retention, and revenue. Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, predictive modelling, and simulation to understand player behaviour and business performance. Support A/B testing and experiments by selecting relevant metrics, analysing results, and sharing findings that guide business decisions. Create analytical models, simulations, and tools that help teams make informed decisions and find opportunities for improvement. Prepare, validate, and explore large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that support business goals. Work with senior data scientists, Data Engineering, and MLOps teams to develop and integrate analytical models and machine learning solutions into business processes. Share findings with collaborators, explain key insights and limitations, and offer practical recommendations. Contribute to a supportive team environment by documenting your work, participating in peer reviews, sharing knowledge, and developing your technical skills. What We're Looking For MSc or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or possessing equivalent experience. 1+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or quantitative analytics, with practical experience delivering analytical or modelling projects. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, descriptive analysis, and statistical inference. Practical experience in exploratory data analysis, data preparation, and working with large datasets. Experience developing and evaluating predictive or machine learning models, including regression, classification, or clustering. Understanding of statistical modelling, forecasting, and simulation techniques. Familiarity with hypothesis testing, split testing, and experimental analysis. Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and modelling, including common libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Ability to write SQL queries to extract, join, transform, and aggregate data. Basic understanding of software development practices, including version control, testing, and documentation. items.desc: Job Description As Applied ML/AI Engineer at Databricks, you will define and create the Agentic Machine Learning revolution. You will help world’s largest companies build and deploy massive classical machine learning solutions (such as personalized recommendations, fraud detection, dynamic pricing, forecasting) fully using Databricks’ agents and harnesses. After 30 years of painfully slow progress, expensive knowledge acquisition and tedious processes in classical ML, the agentic era has ushered innovation, scale and visibility for all: from the most junior data scientists and machine learning engineers to the world class experts. You will work on Databricks’ Genie Code, an agent and an ML “exoskeleton” that is authoring ML, training and deploying models, monitoring and self-healing production ML, all at the top-expert level. Additionally, you will develop ML solutions that under the hood address the most pressing questions non-technical business people have today: predictive and what-if questions. Your work is a top priority for Databricks and you will report to a Principal Software Engineer (a Director level position). The impact you will have Build agentic end-to-end systems in a small, highly international team of experienced engineers in a flat and agile organization. Build solutions for people like you: software engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists and MLOps engineers. Own our applied ML investment by engaging with engineering and product teams across the company. Drive the development and deployment of state-of-the-art ML/AI models and systems that directly impact the capabilities and performance of Databricks’ products, infrastructure, and services. Architect and implement robust, scalable ML infrastructure, including model training and serving components to support seamless integration of AI/ML models into production environments. Work on novel forecasting techniques. Possibilities to contribute to the broader AI community by presenting at conferences and actively participating in open source projects, enhancing Databricks’ reputation as an industry leader. What we look for 2-8 years of engineering experience in high-velocity, high-growth companies. Infrastructure and system engineers with no ML background and willingness to excel in personal growth are welcome to apply. Strong software engineering skills, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing and deployment. Experience developing AI/ML systems at scale in production and a strong track record of ML modeling that goes beyond using standard libraries is a plus. Nice to have: experience deploying, scaling, and monitoring models in production; understanding of the unique infrastructure challenges posed by training and serving predictions in Tier 0 environments. Why Join Us? At Databricks, we are building state-of-the-art AI solutions that redefine how users interact with data and our products. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven products at Databricks, work with cutting-edge models, and collaborate with a world-class team of AI and ML experts. If you're excited about pushing the boundaries of AI in real-world applications, we’d love to hear from you! About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. items.desc: About The Role Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, automation, and digital transformation? Do you want to gain hands-on experience applying cutting-edge AI technologies in a global pharmaceutical manufacturing environment? At Novartis Schweizerhalle, we are accelerating our digitalisation journey across IT, Operational Technology (OT), manufacturing, quality, and business functions. As an AI Agent Development Intern / Working Student, you will work directly with IT/OT experts and business stakeholders to design, build, test, and improve AI agents using Microsoft Copilot and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. This is a unique opportunity to gain practical experience with enterprise AI technologies while contributing to real-world solutions that improve productivity, knowledge access, and operational excellence. Your work will help shape how AI is adopted across a highly regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The role structure and employer branding elements align with current Novartis job posting guidance and templates. Part-time role - 24 hours/week Key Responsibilities As part of the local IT/OT and Digitalisation team, you will: Design, configure, and test AI agents using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and related Microsoft 365 technologies. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI agents can improve processes, knowledge management, and decision-making. Support the development of prompt libraries, workflows, and automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform technologies. Analyze business processes and translate user requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions. Assist in validating AI agent performance, usability, and reliability through structured testing and user feedback. Support data analysis activities to identify trends, opportunities, and improvement areas. Create user documentation, training materials, and demonstrations to promote AI adoption across the site. Work closely with IT, OT, Quality, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to ensure solutions align with business requirements and compliance expectations. Stay informed about emerging AI, Copilot, and automation capabilities and contribute ideas for future digital innovation initiatives. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, and responsible AI adoption. Essential Requirements Currently enrolled in the final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, Digital Transformation, or a related field. Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and digital technologies. Basic understanding of Microsoft 365 technologies and cloud-based solutions. Knowledge of data analysis, process mapping, or automation concepts. Experience with programming, scripting, or low-code/no-code tools through academic projects, internships, or personal initiatives. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Fluency in English. Desirable Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Microsoft Azure services. Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI agent design, or chatbot development. Understanding of manufacturing, pharmaceutical, engineering, or regulated industry environments. Experience working with structured and unstructured data sources. Knowledge of responsible AI principles and human-centered design approaches. German language skills are considered an advantage. What You Will Learn During this assignment, you will have the opportunity to: Work with some of the most advanced enterprise AI technologies available today. Gain practical experience building AI agents that deliver measurable business value. Collaborate with experienced IT/OT professionals, engineers, and business leaders. Develop skills in AI solution design, automation, data analysis, and stakeholder management. Understand how digital transformation and AI are implemented within a global pharmaceutical manufacturing organization. Build a professional network within Novartis and gain exposure to real-world innovation projects.

items.desc: Únete a Aristocrat como Growth Data Scientist y ayúdanos a crear experiencias de juegos móviles de primera clase. Este puesto ofrece una excelente oportunidad para estar a la vanguardia en la implementación de estrategias de adquisición de jugadores utilizando técnicas innovadoras de ciencia de datos. En Aristocrat, fomentamos una cultura inclusiva y colaborativa, donde la innovación y la excelencia son celebradas. Jugarás un papel crucial asesorando a nuestro equipo de Growth sobre la asignación de presupuestos y la eficiencia de los canales, moldeando el futuro de nuestros juegos exitosos. Lo que harás Asesorarás al equipo de UA en la planificación del presupuesto y tácticas de canales basándote en análisis de datos completos y modelado. Aplicarás análisis estadísticos, inferencia causal, aprendizaje automático y modelado de series temporales para entender el comportamiento de los usuarios y evaluar la eficiencia de los canales de marketing. Identificarás proactivamente áreas de mejora; construirás y ejecutarás análisis y modelos que conduzcan a recomendaciones accionables. Construirás y mantendrás modelos de previsión para apoyar la planificación y toma de decisiones de UA. Traducirás hallazgos analíticos complejos en ideas claras y convincentes para colaboradores técnicos y no técnicos. Colaborarás con los equipos de Análisis de Datos e Ingeniería para asegurar una base de datos fiable y disponibilidad de características. Aprenderás y compartirás ideas con un equipo diverso y distribuido globalmente de científicos de datos. Lo que buscamos Grado en Matemáticas, Estadística, Economía, Informática o un campo cuantitativo similar, o experiencia equivalente. Más de 2 años de experiencia profesional en ciencia de datos, con un historial demostrado de entrega de proyectos de datos o ML de principio a fin. Experiencia práctica aplicando ciencia de datos para resolver desafíos empresariales reales, idealmente en un entorno de marketing, crecimiento o digital. Experiencia en juegos o entretenimiento digital es una ventaja importante. Dominio de Python y SQL. Experiencia construyendo modelos de previsión y de series temporales. Familiaridad con métodos de inferencia causal (por ejemplo, diff-in-diff, discontinuidad de regresión, modelado de uplift). Conocimiento de análisis estadístico y experimentación (pruebas A/B, pruebas de significancia). Experiencia con herramientas de visualización de datos y presentación clara de resultados analíticos. Enfoque pragmático para la resolución de problemas, favoreciendo soluciones prácticas. Comodidad trabajando con ambigüedad y cambiando de contexto a medida que evolucionan las prioridades empresariales. Curiosidad y proactividad, con una comprensión profunda de los problemas antes de saltar a las soluciones. Colaborativo/a, con excelentes habilidades de gestión de colaboradores. Si te apasiona usar la ciencia de datos para crear experiencias de juegos excepcionales y estás listo/a para liderar productos de datos hacia el éxito, queremos saber de ti. Únete a Aristocrat y ayuda a desarrollar el futuro de los juegos móviles. En cualquier caso, todo el contenido final, los requisitos del puesto y las decisiones de contratación están sujetos a la revisión y aprobación de Aristocrat. Nuestro enfoque se basa en una filosofía de remuneración por desempeño, recompensando el impacto individual. Tu paquete de compensación específico se determinará en función de factores como tus habilidades, experiencia, cualificaciones y ubicación. Dependiendo de tu puesto y ubicación, podrás optar a bonificaciones e incentivos anuales, beneficios de salud y bienestar, tiempo libre remunerado, planes de jubilación, cobertura de seguros y otros beneficios locales o establecidos por la legislación aplicable. Los detalles específicos sobre la compensación y los beneficios para este puesto se tratarán durante el proceso de selección.

items.desc: Job Description Who we are Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. The role Software only matters when it is actively being used and making a difference. As a Deployed AI Engineer, you will be at the heart of this - taking state-of-the-art software and integrating it into complex systems. You will be defining and executing against the end-to-end outcome and all steps on the way to delivering novel capabilities in some of the most challenging environments around. For example: you collaborate directly with customer avionics engineers to understand the data structures and APIs used in aircraft mission control systems. Instead of being scared, you embrace the complexity of unfamiliar databases, APIs, or network protocols; you dig into the specification and use your creativity and ingenuity to implement adapters for integrating them with Helsing’s cloud infrastructure. By working closely with our partners and customers (both metaphorically and quite literally), you continuously evolve, improve, and operate Helsing software. You own the outcome end-to-end. The day-to-day In close collaboration with our product teams, you will discover and formalise customer requirements, identify bugs, and ship the latest features directly to our users. Technology demonstrations are our chance to shine - you will coordinate between customers, partners, and Helsing engineers to showcase Helsing’s software and AI capabilities in simulations or with real systems. You should apply if you Have a degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant fields. Have a broad understanding and creative use of computer systems; this is the Swiss army knife in Helsing’s toolbox of world-class talent. Prefer asking questions over stipulating answers. Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work. Are not afraid of legacy systems and would rather make them work than give up and try to rewrite it all. Are comfortable with scripting languages such as Bash or Python and have experience with software engineering in C++, Java, Rust, or similar. Can navigate and configure Linux systems and have an understanding of network stacks and database systems. If applying for Germany- it is a requirement that you are able to speak business level or fluent German Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Nice to have Experience with Rust and Python. Experience with container-based, cloud-native and edge application architectures. Experience with maintaining and operating production systems using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar. Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming database systems. Experience with production ML systems. Bonus points: you have professional experience working in a defence context. Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns. The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world. Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward. In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts. We …

Own deployments in both our AWS global and AWS China environments, partnering with our regional experts on data residency requirements. Pour poursuivre notre trajectoire de développement, nous recherchons de nouveaux talents tous complémentaires avec plusieurs niveaux de qualification et séniorité, qui travailleront en synergie avec la large palette de compétences de Niji en développement, design, cybersécurité et en conseil. En tant que PO/PM Data & IA , vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Développer et maintenir une vision claire des Data Products, en alignement avec la stratégie globale de l'entreprise Collecter les besoins des clients et des parties prenantes, et les traduire en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques pour les équipes de développement Élaborer des roadmaps et des plans de développement pour les Data Products, en tenant compte des besoins des utilisateurs et des opportunités du marché Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement pour assurer une mise en œuvre efficace et de haute qualité des fonctionnalités des Data Products Effectuer des analyses approfondies des données pour identifier les tendances, les opportunités et les problèmes potentiels, et recommander des améliorations basées sur les données Profil recherché Si Vous Avez obtenu un diplôme en université, école de commerce ou équivalent type bac +5 Maîtrisez l'anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral Avez de solides connaissances en architecture et en modélisation des données Maîtrisez des technologies et des outils liés au Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, etc.) Maîtrisez les outils d’industrialisation des pipelines data tel que docker, kubernetes, Dataiku, Jenkins… Avez une expérience avec les langages de programmation utilisés dans le domaine des données, tels que : Python,R, Scala, SQL, etc. Avez une expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de pipelines de données Alors… Venez participer au dynamisme de notre site en rejoignant notre Team Data Niji ! Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Des projets de la stratégie à la mise en œuvre, avec un impact concret chez nos clients grands comptes et ETI, alliant ambition et agilité grâce à notre taille idéale ; Des équipes pluridisciplinaires mêlant Conseil, Design, Data, IA, Cyber et Tech ; Une montée en compétences rapide, via notre plateforme de formation : Niji University (plus de 33 000 contenus) et l’apprentissage terrain Les derniers outils IA à disposition des équipes et des experts pour vous accompagner ; Un accompagnement personnalisé pour construire votre trajectoire : 1-1 réguliers, HRBP dédié, référentiel de compétences ; Un cadre de travail flexible et des avantages solides : horaires flexibles, télétravail, tickets restaurant, forfait mobilité, plateforme de services ; Un engagement dans une entreprise responsable (Ecovadis, site éco conçu, fresque du numérique, engagements associatifs...). La Posture Niji S'engager avec exigence - Collaborer avec sens - Agir avec impact - Transmettre avec conviction. Nos valeurs : Audace - Bienveillance - Performance – Talent. Si ces mots vous parlent, venez nous rencontrer ! Chez Niji, nous sommes fiers de notre politique RSE qui contribue à la promotion de la diversité et de l’égalité des chances, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap.

items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. Intérêt marqué pour l'IA et ses enjeux de gouvernance, de maîtrise et de conformité. Aisance pour animer des ateliers, des communautés et des instances de gouvernance. Excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Curiosité, pragmatisme et sens du collectif. Ce poste ne sera malheureusement pas pour vous cette fois-ci si : vous n'avez aucune expérience en audit, contrôle, gestion des risques, conformité ou gouvernance des données ; Vous ne connaissez pas les principes BCBS239 vous recherchez un poste purement technique de développement ou de data engineering ; vous n'êtes pas à l'aise pour animer des communautés, présenter en comité et embarquer des interlocuteurs variés ; la Data et l'IA ne suscitent pas chez vous une vraie curiosité. 🎯 Ce qui fera la différence Votre capacité à relier les enjeux métiers, technologiques, réglementaires et de maîtrise des risques. Votre goût du challenge constructif, qui fait avancer les dispositifs sans bloquer les projets. Votre pédagogie pour rendre la Data et l'IA accessibles à tous. Une pratique de Python, SQL ou d'un outil …

items.desc: About This Opportunity We're building a paid, confidential panel of developers who regularly run workstation-sized AI models locally in real coding work. Relevant profiles include software engineers, freelance developers, researchers and data scientists, founders and technical product managers, and open-source tooling builders. Panel members take part in surveys, interviews and hands-on testing of new models on a flexible, ongoing basis. Key Requirements Runs workstation-sized AI models locally on personal hardware as part of regular coding work. Can describe at least two recent local workflows in detail, including the models, tooling and agent setup used. Can compare the strengths and weaknesses of at least two local models, including when to switch to a hosted frontier model. Is comfortable signing a restrictive NDA and discussing experience without breaching employer or client confidentiality.

Du baust Software leistungsfähig und hältst sie produktiv. AI-natives Operating System: Du baust und betreibst die Plattform, über die alle Buchhaltungsservices laufen: erst als MVP, dann als produktiver Pilot mit echten Mandanten. Agentische
items.desc: Als Venture Builder suche ich das Gründerteam für ein AI-natives Tax-Start-Up. Wir arbeiten noch im Stealth Mode: bewusst unter dem Radar, bis Produkt und Team stehen. Wer jetzt einsteigt, gestaltet von Anfang an mit. Unsere Vision: Wir denken Tax- und Accounting Services von der KI aus neu. Kunden kaufen keine Software, sie bekommen fertige Ergebnisse: erstellt von einer AI-nativen Plattform, abgesichert durch fachliche Qualitätskontrolle. Schneller, günstiger und spürbar angenehmer als alles, was der Markt heute bietet. Dieser Markt ist riesig und wird gerade neu verteilt: Wer Fachtiefe mit echter Automatisierung verbindet, gewinnt. Fundament und Finanzierung stehen. Jetzt fehlen die richtigen Köpfe.. Aufgaben Du bist der Techie und AI Lead im Team: Self-Starter, Hacker-Typ und Autodidakt, der nichts lieber tut, als Tech mit AI zu bauen, und permanent up-to-date bleibt. Du baust Software leistungsfähig und hältst sie produktiv. AI-natives Operating System: Du baust und betreibst die Plattform, über die alle Buchhaltungsservices laufen: erst als MVP, dann als produktiver Pilot mit echten Mandanten. Agentische Kernpipeline: Du entwickelst die Pipeline vom Belegeingang (E-Mail, Upload, Bank) über Dokumentenextraktion und automatische Kontierung bis zum Confidence-basierten Routing in die Human-Review-Queue, zur Buchung und zum Export. Automatisierungsquote: Du verantwortest unsere zentrale Steuerungsgröße: Du definierst die Messmethodik, baust das Eval-Framework (Golden Datasets, Fehlerraten je Belegtyp und Prozessschritt) und hebst die Quote Jahr für Jahr. Du entscheidest datenbasiert, ab welcher Fehlerrate ein Schritt ohne Human-Review läuft. Data-Flywheel: Du stellst sicher, dass jede menschliche Korrektur strukturiert erfasst wird und automatisiert in Evaldaten und Modellverbesserung zurückfließt. Integrationen: Du bindest externe Systeme per API an (DATEV, Banking etc.) und baust interne Tools ad-hoc bei Bedarf selber. Infrastruktur und Security: Du verantwortest die Cloud-Infrastruktur (EU-Hosting, Mandantentrennung) und setzt Security und Compliance technisch um: DSGVO, GoBD-konforme revisionssichere Audit-Trails, Verschwiegenheitsschutz, Verschlüsselung, rollenbasierte Zugriffe. Stack und Sparring: Du triffst Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen über den gesamten Stack und verantwortest ihn selbst. Du trägst die technische Verantwortung für die KI-Plattform, der Commercial-Co-Founder die kommerzielle Verantwortung. Als technisches Sparring validierst du die Automatisierungs-, Kapazitäts- und Kostenannahmen des Business Case gegen die reale Systemleistung. Qualifikation Must-Have: AI-Engineering: Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, agentische Workflows produktionsreif zu entwickeln: strukturierte Extraktion mit Schema-Validierung, versionierte Prompts, Confidence-Scoring als Routing-Trigger, definierte Fallbacks bei Modellfehlern. Eval-Disziplin: Du beherrschst den Aufbau von Testdatensätzen und Eval-Pipelines und bist es gewohnt, Automatisierung an gemessenen Fehlerraten festzumachen statt an Bauchgefühl. Modell-Urteilsvermögen: Fundiertes Verständnis, welches Werkzeug (großes LLM, kleines Spezialmodell, klassische Klassifikation) sich je Task nach Qualität, Kosten und Latenz eignet. Open-Weights-Praxis: Praktische Erfahrung im lokalen Hosting von Open-Weights-Modellen sowie in Fine-Tuning und kontinuierlichem Training mit eigenen Daten. Datenhandwerk: Tiefe Data-Science-Kenntnisse: Du weißt, wie Datenstrukturen modelliert sein müssen, damit sie für KI-Verarbeitung, Evals und Training direkt nutzbar sind. Workflow-Automatisierung: Erfahrung mit langlaufenden, wiederaufsetzbaren, idempotenten Prozessen mit Deadlines und Fehler-Retries statt Request-Response. Backend und Integration: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in REST-API-Entwicklung und -Anbindung sowie solides Handwerk in Datenbank-Design, Auth und Logging. Security: Sicherer Umgang mit Verschlüsselung, Zugriffskontrolle und unveränderlichen Logs; Security by Default ist für dich selbstverständlich. Unternehmerisch und pragmatisch: Du hast erste eigene Projekte live gebracht, shippst allein oder im Mini-Team und wählst bei knappem Funding die einfachste tragfähige Lösung. Produktmanagement: Erfahrung darin, Anforderungen der Fachseite aufzunehmen, zu priorisieren und in Software zu übersetzen. Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch fließend. Standort: Saarbrücken/Saarland vor Ort. Das wäre ein Plus: Domänenerfahrung: Accounting- und Steuerprozesse oder eine andere regulierte, fehlerintolerante Domäne (Fintech, Payments, Legal, Health). DATEV: Ökosystem-Erfahrung aus erster Hand. Stationen: Start-up oder Scale-up, idealerweise als Founding Engineer oder erster technischer Hire. Führung: Steuerung interner und externer Entwickler. Netzwerk: Vernetzt in der deutschen Tax-Tech- und AI-Szene. Benefits Anschubfinanzierung steht: Du kämpfst nicht parallel um Geld, sondern konzentrierst dich vom ersten Tag an voll auf den Aufbau. Hoher Equity-Anteil: Du bist echter Mitgründer, kein …

Then you follow the thread outwards. Your job is to own capabilities, meaning end-to-end business activities such as how we reconcile funds at the end of the day or how an
items.desc: Join us as a frontrunner and change the way we build software, with AI at the centre. Software engineering is being rewritten right now, and we want to be among the ones holding the pen. The best companies of the next few years will not simply be the biggest. They will be the ones that learned early how to work with AI as part of the team: people setting the direction, agents doing much of the work, and every step tested and traceable. At Framm, the platform company of Inpay Group, we have already started. Our AI-driven development lifecycle (AI-DLC) is up and running, and agents write tests for us today. But we do not want to follow the pack. We want to be the frontrunner, and we really want to change the way we work, and not just in engineering. What we need now is an engineer who can take what works in development and carry it into the rest of the business. If you want to do more with AI than speed up a single team, and would rather help reinvent how a whole company works, keep reading. The role This is a rare chance to reshape a business from the inside. You will start in development, where our AI-DLC is already running, and build on it: strengthening how engineering works with agents and making it the way the whole team works. Then you follow the thread outwards. Your job is to own capabilities, meaning end-to-end business activities such as how we reconcile funds at the end of the day or how an IT operations service is delivered. For each one, you understand the workflow, see where AI can make it work better or differently, and engineer the improvement all the way to practical use. Over time, the scope is the whole business: how we can run better, and differently, with AI. And because our platform moves money for customers every day, it has to be done safely. That is part of the fun: using AI where it counts, with the guardrails to match. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves to build. There is no people management and no evangelist hat to wear, no second AI platform or center of excellence to run and no strategy slides to produce. Your time goes where the difference is made: in the code, the specifications and the work itself. You sit in development and report to the CTO, and you have the final say on the method: how agents are used, how work is specified, how output is reviewed and how tests are written. You will work side by side with colleagues across the business, bringing them along with working results and real influence. What You Will Own The way engineering works with AI: the agent harness, shared repository and compliance-gated pipeline, improved continuously from today’s baseline The method the team works by: how agents are used, how work is specified, how output is reviewed and how tests are written Business capabilities: following them across teams, systems and processes, starting with areas such as reconciliation, funds management and IT operations, and engineering AI-assisted improvements all the way into daily use Documentation and remediation: using agents to express what our platform does as specifications and tests, speed up security fixes and automate evidence for our control framework Guardrails that let engineers build their own AI-powered tooling safely, within the group’s shared permissions model Bringing colleagues with you: pairing with engineers and business colleagues, showing what works and following improvements through to adoption, so that people build confidence in working with agents Your first months You will start where we are strongest: in development. Our AI-DLC will be measurably faster and better and in daily use across the team, with the first capabilities documented as executable specifications and tests, and control evidence generated by the pipeline. From there, your first business capability will be in your hands: mapped end to end, with AI-supported improvements delivered into the way the work is actually done. You will spend more time building than presenting. Success will be visible in concrete results: more efficient workflows, reliable outputs, stronger control evidence, more engineers working with agents daily on real work, and colleagues across the business who adopt what you build and ask for more. What You Will Bring You are a senior engineer who still writes code most days and has changed how you work because of coding agents, not just added them to the toolbar. Your career includes at least one long stretch inside a production platform that handled money or other regulated data. Eight or more years in software engineering, five or more of them in backend or platform engineering on production systems, with fluency in at least one of Python, Go, Java or TypeScript You have modernised something old while it stayed live, whether monolith to services, on-premise to cloud or a language or runtime migration, and you can tell us what you documented first, what you tested first and what went wrong Two or more years building LLM-based systems that …

items.desc: Delphi HR-Consulting GmbH Unser Auftraggeber ist mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitern an mehr als 30 Standorten in Deutschland einer der führenden Unternehmen innerhalb seiner Branche. Das Unternehmen ist seit vielen Jahrzehnten im Bereich Environmental Services ein innovativer und leistungsstarker Anbieter zahlreicher Dienstleistungen im Bereich Umweltschutz und Kreislaufwirtschaft. items.desc: Risketeers is een jonge en ambitieuze organisatie die zich richt op het vinden, opleiden en begeleiden van Young Professionals. We matchen talenten met de juiste klanten, waar ze een passende rol kunnen vervullen. Wij bieden een uniek Talent Development Programma waarin je wordt opgeleid tot een specialist met expertise in AI, data en business binnen de financiële sector. Je leert niet alleen hoe AI-technologieën en data-analyse bedrijfsprocessen verbeteren, maar ook hoe regelgeving zoals de AI Act impact heeft op AI-implementaties en organisaties. Het bedrijf is gebouwd op de solide fundamenten van twee succesvolle organisaties die hun waarde in de financiële sector al ruimschoots hebben bewezen. Dit garandeert een high-end ontwikkelingsprogramma dat jou als Young Professional voorziet van alle benodigde tools, trainingen en persoonlijke begeleiding. Zo kun je snel uitgroeien tot een succesvolle professional en toekomstige specialist die het verschil maakt in een wereld waar AI, technologie en regelgeving steeds meer met elkaar verweven zijn. Taken Wat kun je verwachten? Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformeert de financiële sector, maar de komst van de AI Act en strengere regelgeving zorgen voor nieuwe uitdagingen. Hoe zorg je ervoor dat AI niet alleen efficiënt wordt ingezet, maar ook middels verantwoord beleid? Welke AI-use cases leveren de meeste waarde op en hoe breng je naar de praktijk? En hoe versterk je AI-literacy binnen organisaties om technologie optimaal te benutten? Als AI Business & Data Expert werk je op het snijvlak van AI, data en business en ben jij de schakel tussen techniek, data en business. Je helpt financiële instellingen bij het identificeren en implementeren van AI-oplossingen die bedrijfsprocessen verbeteren en tegelijkertijd voldoen aan regelgeving. Je ontwikkelt AI-use cases, analyseert data en vertaalt complexe AI-technologie naar concrete toepassingen. Daarnaast speel je een cruciale rol in AI Literacy binnen organisaties: je helpt teams beter te begrijpen hoe AI werkt, welke risico’s en mogelijkheden er zijn en hoe ze AI verantwoord kunnen inzetten. Je werkt nauw samen met IT, Risk en Compliance en zorgt ervoor dat AI-oplossingen niet alleen technisch kloppen, maar ook bijdragen aan strategische doelstellingen. Met jouw kennis van AI, data-analyse en regelgeving maak je innovatie praktisch toepasbaar en zorg je ervoor dat AI-oplossingen realistisch, schaalbaar en effectief worden geïntegreerd binnen de organisatie. Mogelijke rollen AI Business Analyst AI & Data Consultant AI Risk & Compliance Specialist Responsible AI Officer AI Model Risk Manager Vereisten Wat maakt jou een Risketeer? Wij zijn op zoek naar proactieve, enthousiaste talenten die klaar zijn om zichzelf te ontwikkelen binnen het vakgebied ‘ AI Business & Data Expertise ’ . Je hebt de ambitie om een succesvolle carrière op te bouwen en bent geïnteresseerd in hoe Artificial Intelligence (AI) de financiële dienstverlening transformeert. Bovendien ben je klaar om jouw analytische en technische vaardigheden in te zetten om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen met behulp van AI-technologieën. Je hebt een relevante HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond, zoals Econometrie, Finance, Risk Management, Business Administration/Economics of een gerelateerd vakgebied. Hoewel kennis van AI en Machine Learning een vereiste is, is deze rol specifiek voor professionals met een business-, financiële- of economische achtergrond, en niet voor kandidaten met uitsluitend een technische AI-opleiding. Daarnaast heb je een sterke affiniteit met AI-governance, financiële regelgeving en risicomanagement, en beschik je over kennis van AI-modellen, data-analyse en machine learning. Waarom kiezen voor Risketeers? Werk in een omgeving die je ondersteunt met training en mentorschap van de beste experts in het veld, met een sterke focus op de integratie van Artificial Intelligence (AI) in jouw werkzaamheden. Leer hoe je AI-tools en -technieken effectief en verantwoord kunt inzetten om complexe uitdagingen in de financiële sector op te lossen. Profiteer van een unieke aanpak die niet alleen jouw vakinhoudelijke expertise versterkt, maar je ook voorbereidt op een toekomst waarin technologie en data-analyse centraal staan. Van business analyse, AI wet- en regelgeving tot datamanagement en -modelleren: je krijgt alle middelen om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Volg een gepersonaliseerd leertraject dat speciaal is ontworpen om jouw skills en carrière-ambities te ondersteunen. Dit traject helpt je niet alleen om mee te groeien met de huidige trends, maar ook om deze trends te sturen. Benefits Wat bieden wij jou? Een contract van 12-18 maanden 8,33% vakantiegeld 24 vakantiedagen per jaar Uitstekend startsalaris: €3.100 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur €10.000,- opleidingsbudget (certificeringen, trainingen en coaching) NS Business card en bij autogebruik een kilometervergoeding van €0,23 per km 2 bonusmomenten in het 1e jaar met een maximum van €3.000 100% …

items.title: Sektionsleder til AI-implementering i PET
items.loc: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
items.card: Vil du være med til at gøre AI til en integreret del af PET’s opgaveløsning og lede de specialister, der omsætter teknologi til konkrete løsninger for Danmarks sikkerhed? Her får du ansvaret for at omsætte vores AI-visioner til robuste, skalerbare løsninger, der understøtter Danmarks sikkerhed. PET er i gang med en digital transformation. Vi styrker vores digitale kapacitet og udvikler både teknologien, fundamentet
items.desc: Vil du være med til at gøre AI til en integreret del af PET’s opgaveløsning og lede de specialister, der omsætter teknologi til konkrete løsninger for Danmarks sikkerhed? Her får du ansvaret for at omsætte vores AI-visioner til robuste, skalerbare løsninger, der understøtter Danmarks sikkerhed. PET er i gang med en digital transformation. Vi styrker vores digitale kapacitet og udvikler både teknologien, fundamentet og måden, vi arbejder på, så vi står stærkere til at løse PET’s opgaver i en stadig mere digital virkelighed. Det kræver stærke IT-kompetencer hele vejen rundt; fra det, der skal virke i dag, til det, vi bygger for fremtiden. Som vores nye sektionsleder i IT-Afdelingen får du en central rolle i at forbedre PET's muligheder for at udvikle og anvende AI. Du skal lede og udvikle en sektion, der arbejder med at gøre nye teknologiske muligheder til konkrete løsninger for PET's brugere. Det kræver en leder, der kan samle dygtige specialister, skabe resultater gennem andre og sikre, at løsningerne gør en reel forskel i organisationen. Fra idé til løsninger, der skaber værdi Din vigtigste opgave bliver at opbygge og udvikle en sektion, der kan omsætte PET's mål inden for AI til konkrete resultater. Du får ansvar for både medarbejdernes faglige udvikling og for at sikre, at sektionens arbejde tager afsæt i organisationens behov. En central del af opgaven bliver at prioritere, hvilke muligheder inden for AI der skal arbejdes videre med. Det kræver, at du kan se potentialet i teknologien, forstå brugernes behov og vurdere, hvor nye løsninger kan gøre størst gavn. Du skal samtidig sikre, at sektionen har de rette færdigheder og kan udvikle sig i takt med opgaverne. Dine Centrale Opgaver Bliver At Opbygge og udvikle sektionen gennem rekruttering og involverende ledelse. Omsætte strategiske ambitioner til konkrete mål og prioriteringer for sektionens arbejde. Lede arbejdet med at identificere og prioritere relevante AI-use cases i samarbejde med PET's brugere. Sikre fremdrift i udviklingen af AI-produkter med fokus på kvalitet, anvendelighed og ansvarlig brug af teknologien. Fremme samarbejdet mellem sektionen, øvrige IT-fagligheder og PET's brugere. Understøtte implementeringen af nye løsninger og følge op på, om de skaber de forventede gevinster. Du får dermed en ledelsesopgave, hvor du både skal udvikle sektionens faglige kapacitet og sikre, at arbejdet fører til løsninger, som bidrager til Danmarks sikkerhed og skaber værdi for PET. Ledelse med fokus på både mennesker og teknologi Som sektionsleder kommer du til at lede medarbejdere med specialiserede tekniske færdigheder. Du skal kunne sætte retning og skabe følgeskab, samtidig med at du lytter, involverer og giver medarbejderne plads til at bidrage med deres faglige viden. Du behøver ikke selv være den dybeste tekniske specialist. Til gengæld skal du have en solid forståelse for AI, machine learning, LLM'er, data og moderne softwareudvikling, så du kan sparre med medarbejderne, udfordre faglige overvejelser og træffe kvalificerede beslutninger. Du skal også kunne se ud over sektionens egne opgaver. Udviklingen af AI-løsninger kræver samarbejde med både brugere og andre IT-fagligheder, og som leder skal du kunne samle forskellige perspektiver og skabe fælles forståelse for, hvad der skal lykkes. Samtidig skal du sikre, at arbejdet sker med respekt for PET's særlige krav til informationssikkerhed, governance og ansvarlig anvendelse af AI. Du kan udvikle mennesker og skabe resultater Vi søger en leder, der skaber tydelig retning, sætter mål og skaber retning. Du motiveres af at udvikle mennesker og teams og har lyst til at bygge en organisation op, hvor medarbejdernes kompetencer og samarbejde er grundlaget for gode resultater. Du formår at engagere medarbejderne og få dem med, når nye beslutninger skal føres ud i livet. Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du: Har erfaring med at lede tekniske teams og kan udvikle medarbejdere og skabe et velfungerende fagligt miljø. Kan opbygge og udvikle en organisation gennem rekruttering, kompetenceudvikling og klare prioriteringer. Har god forretningsforståelse og kan vurdere, hvor nye teknologiske løsninger kan skabe værdi. Kan omsætte strategi til konkrete indsatser, træffe beslutninger og følge op på resultater. Har erfaring med forandringsledelse og kan involvere medarbejdere og brugere, så nye løsninger bliver taget i anvendelse. Kan samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og forklare komplekse problemstillinger, så der kan træffes fælles beslutninger. Inddrag gerne i din ansøgning, hvis du har erfaring med AI-produktudvikling, identifikation og prioritering af use cases, brugerinddragelse, implementering eller gevinstrealisering. Du kan være en erfaren personaleleder eller have erfaring med faglig ledelse og være klar til dit første job med personaleansvar. Måske har du allerede erfaring med at lede tekniske teams som teamleder eller en lignende rolle. Det afgørende er, at du har vist, at du kan skabe resultater gennem …

items.desc: Job Description Who we are Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. The role As a Field Engineer at Helsing, you will play a crucial role in maturing Helsing's cutting-edge military AI products from proof of concept to large-scale rollout. You will testing combined software and hardware products throughout the product development lifecycle, in collaboration with world-class software and AI engineers, product managers, and end users as part of a tight iteration loop. You will ultimately help assure the safety and reliability of Helsing's products. The day-to-day Testing combined software and hardware products end to end in the lab and in the field (including flying drones), capturing data, and providing feedback to Helsing’s software and AI engineers Packing equipment, transporting it to the test locations (eg, airfields), setting it up, performing tests, and then packing up at the end of the day Installing AI software onto edge computing devices, using Helsing's in-house deployment tools Helping to design and improve test plans and safety SOPs Defining and securing the resources we need to maintain an effective and efficient field testing operation, and helping to secure them. For example, this may include purchasing hardware, trialing new software tools for inventory management and QA, establishing new secure storage facilities, and preparing safety cases and submissions to aviation authorities. Advising on training course design and in-service support procedures Opportunities to travel to other testing locations in the UK, France, Germany, and beyond You should apply if you Have a strong technical aptitude and natural curiosity. You can understand complex hardware and software products at a systems level (not necessarily at the code level). You’re not satisfied until you understand how something works (or why it doesn’t work). Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can write clear and concise documentation and speak fluently about technical concepts with engineers and non-engineers. Are a natural problem solver. Can independently own critical work streams, identify problems, and take the initiative to solve them. Are passionate about protecting liberal democratic values by contributing to the defence and security sector Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systemically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Nice to have Experience testing software and/or hardware products, at any stage of maturity (from prototype to production system) Experience flying drones, possession of pilot licences Experience training end users on how to use complex hardware and/or software products, or providing support to end users Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns. The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world. Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward. In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts. We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible …

items.desc: Description Adaptive Intelligence Circle Foundation (AIC Foundation) is an independent, nonprofit foundation established to support the long-term development of adaptive intelligence, public digital infrastructure, and governance systems for the 21st century. Founded by Nguyen Duc Tri in 2025, AIC Foundation serves as the stewardship layer of the broader Adaptive Intelligence Circle ecosystem. Its mission is to advance open technologies, decentralized governance, ethical infrastructure, and human-centered adaptive intelligence, particularly for communities in the Global South. The Foundation supports a growing ecosystem of open-source projects, research initiatives, educational resources, and public digital infrastructure efforts designed to strengthen human agency, resilience, and responsible technological development. Role Description Infrastructure and Systems Contributors at Adaptive Intelligence Circle Foundation are part-time team members working remote, collaborating closely on open technology projects aligned with AIC’s mission. In this role, individuals design, develop, and maintain software and infrastructure across AIC’s repositories, with a focus on decentralized governance tools, ethical AI systems, and transparent technical protocols. Day-to-day tasks include contributing clean, well-documented code, reviewing and improving peers’ contributions, participating in architectural discussions, and helping shape technical roadmaps for open projects. Technical Contributors also engage in research on emerging technologies and governance models, produce technical documentation, and support community interactions across public platforms. The role involves close collaboration with cross-functional partners to ensure that all technical work reflects AIC’s commitment to software freedom, ethical standards, and long-term intellectual resilience. Skills + Knowledge of distributed systems, networking fundamentals, peer-to-peer architectures, or decentralized technologies. + Experience with cloud platforms, Linux servers, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, or DevOps tooling. + Understanding of reliability, observability, security, and transparent deployment practices. + Interest in large-scale infrastructure, Edge computing, DePIN, or adaptive coordination systems. Contacts Email (Founder): ndtribk@gmail.com Github: AdaptiveIntelligenceCircle Open Collective: https://opencollective.com/adaptive-intelligence-circle

items.desc: Role Title: Business Analyst (Swedish Language) Role Type : Full-time Location : Remote Role Overview: We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: 1. Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) 2. In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: 1. Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Swedish) 2. Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills 3. Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. 4. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. 5. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 6. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. 7. Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. 8. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: 1. Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. 2. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) 3. Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. 4. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: 1. Work in a fully remote environment. 2. items.desc:
Únete a nuestro equipo de Analytics & Pricing y empieza tu desarrollo profesional en un entorno colaborativo, diverso y orientado a negocio, formando parte de un equipo analítico de gran experiencia que, basándose en la analítica avanzada, asesorará a las áreas y procesos de negocio más importantes de la compañía. 
 Durante tus prácticas, tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar soluciones analíticas para obtener conocimientos de los datos y apoyar las decisiones estratégicas, y de contribuir al día a día del equipo con tareas de valor. 
 ¿Qué harás durante tus prácticas? 
 Transformar y depurar los datos para proporcionar asesoramiento y conocimientos técnicos sobre los modelos actuariales y las cuestiones de riesgo. 
 Desarrollar cuadros de mando analíticos para ayudar en el seguimiento del rendimiento del negocio. 
 Iniciación en el desarrollo y la mejora de las herramientas de modelización predictiva de acuerdo con las mejores prácticas del mercado como: 
 Modelización de pricing. 
 Ingeniería inversa a partir de la información del mercado. 
 Modelos de elasticidad para renovaciones y modelos de descuento. 
 Técnicas de Machine Learning como métodos supervisados y no supervisados. 
 Pruebas y mantenimiento de modelos y herramientas actuales. 
 Aprender desde el punto de vista del negocio. Estar en contacto durante toda la vida de la póliza (producto, suscripción, renovación, siniestros, cancelación, fraude...) 
 Apoyo en la Investigación de nuevos enfoques como web scrapping, análisis de textos, procesamientos de imágenes, etc. 
 ¿Qué perfil buscamos? 
 Formación universitaria relacionada con Ciencias Actuariales, Matemáticas, Estadística, Big data o Física. 
 Interés por desarrollarse profesionalmente y seguir aprendiendo en un entorno corporativo. 
 Motivación por trabajar en equipo y aportar al día a día del área. 
 Buena organización, atención al detalle y habilidades de comunicación. 
 Capacidad analítica y desarrollo de nuevos enfoques. 
 Capacidad de síntesis e interpretación de resultados. 
 Capacidad de aprendizaje, comunicación y trabajo en equipo. 
 Proactividad e implicación, autonomía y orientación a la mejora continua. 
 Lo que te ayudará a destacar 
 Conocimientos en Herramientas estadísticas y de programación como Python, R, SAS, SQL u otros lenguajes de programación estadística. 
 Idiomas: B2 Inglés. 
 Valorable experiencia en el proceso de transformación, limpieza y calidad de datos. 
 Adicionalmente, se valorará muy positivamente: 
 Experiencia en el sector de seguros, banca, farmacéutica, venta masiva, mercado on-line y otros sectores afines. 
 Experiencia en entorno actuarial (Emblem, Radar y GLM). 
 Experiencia en herramientas de BI (PowerBI, Tableau, QlikView). 
 Experiencia con Plataformas en la nube (Azure, AWS, Google). 
 Experiencia previa en prácticas, voluntariado o proyectos académicos (no imprescindible). 
 Información imprescindible 
 Es imprescindible poder firmar un convenio de colaboración con tu Universidad, por un periodo mínimo de 6 meses (posibilidad de extensión). 
 Jornada parcial de 9:00h a 14:00h, con cierta flexibilidad horaria 
 Antes de aplicar, asegúrate de tener: 
 Confirmación de que puedes formalizar convenio de prácticas. 
 Duración prevista del convenio y posibilidad de extensión. 
 Fecha de inicio. 
 Modalidad: curricular o extracurricular. 
 Persona de contacto en tu centro para la gestión. 
 Ventajas y beneficios 
 Se ofrece una ayuda económica de 800 € netos al mes durante el período de prácticas. 
 Modelo presencial con opción a formato híbrido una vez superado el periodo inicial de adaptación, según acuerdo con tu tutor/a. 
 Oficinas modernas con espacios pensados para el bienestar y aparcamiento gratuito para coche, moto, bicicleta y patinete. 
 Participación en iniciativas de sostenibilidad, voluntariado y cultura corporativa. 
 Entorno inclusivo, diverso y comprometido con el bienestar de las personas. 
 Acompañamiento cercano, aprendizaje continuo y acceso a recursos formativos. 
 Sobre nosotros 
 Sabadell Zurich es la alianza entre Banco Sabadell y Zurich Insurance Group. Somos más de 350 profesionales en España con un propósito común: estar para cuidar. 
 Promovemos un entorno inclusivo basado en la igualdad de oportunidades, sin discriminación por género, edad, origen, discapacidad, orientación sexual u otras circunstancias personales. 
 Si buscas un entorno exigente, colaborativo y con impacto real en negocio, queremos conocerte. 
En Sabadell Zurich, el talento se convierte en valor.

items.desc:
THEORETISCH DIE BESTE ENTSCHEIDUNG. PRAKTISCH AUCH. 
 TEILE DEINE LEIDENSCHAFT. 
 Nur hochprofessionelle Abläufe in dynamischen Teams produzieren innovative Spitzentechnologie. Aber Fahrfreude wird bei uns von der Entwicklung bis zur Fertigung vor allem auch mit Spaß an der Arbeit und Begeisterung für das gemeinsame Projekt realisiert. Deshalb geben wir Studierenden bei uns nicht nur die Gelegenheit zum Zuhören, sondern auch zum Mitreden und Weiterdenken.
 Unser Team bei der BMW Group gestaltet innovative Lösungen für die Fahrzeugsicherheit mit Fokus auf Fahrerassistenzsysteme. Im Rahmen deines Praktikums unterstützt du uns bei der datengestützten Analyse von Versuchsdaten und wirkst in einem zukunftsorientierten Projektumfeld mit. 
 Was erwartet dich? 
 Du wirkst maßgeblich bei der datengestützten Analyse und Bearbeitung von Projekten im Bereich Fahrzeugsicherheit mit Fokus auf Fahrerassistenz mit.
 Außerdem unterstützt du bei der Analyse von Video- und Signaldaten aus Fahrzeugdaten mithilfe von Mustererkennung und Labeling.
 Darüber hinaus hilfst du bei der Entwicklung von Methoden zur Aufbereitung und Analyse von Versuchsdaten.
 Zudem erhältst du Einblicke in die BMW Fahrzeugsicherheit und wirkst in einem zukunftsorientierten Projektumfeld mit.
 Was bringst du mit? 
 Studium in Data Science, Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
 Kenntnisse in Data Science / Data Analytics und Machine Learning, idealerweise Erfahrung mit Videoanalyse und Signalverarbeitung.
 Strukturierte, sorgfältige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
 Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
 Du bringst Begeisterung für neue Technologien und ein innovatives Umfeld mit? Bewirb dich jetzt!
 Was bieten wir dir? 
 Umfassendes Mentoring & Onboarding.
 Persönliche & fachliche Weiterentwicklung.
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten.
 Mobilarbeit.
 Attraktive & faire Vergütung.
 Apartments für Studierende (nach Verfügbarkeit & nur am Standort München).
 Und vieles mehr siehe bmw.jobs/waswirbieten 
 Startdatum: ab frühestens 01.11.2026
 Dauer: 6 Monate
 Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit

 Wir bei der BMW Group legen großen Wert auf Gleichbehandlung und Chancengleichheit. Unsere Recruiting-Entscheidungen basieren auf der Persönlichkeit, den Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten der Bewerber:innen. Mehr dazu hier .

Auf dieser Basis entscheidet sich unser Fachbereich, ob du zu einem persönlichen Online-Gespräch eingeladen wirst. Mit diesem Auswahlverfahren hast du die Möglichkeit, deiner Bewerbung noch eine persönliche Note zu verleihen – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
