items.desc: Job Description : Huntsman is a global manufacturer and marketer of differentiated chemicals, with a diverse range of products that improve the quality of life for people around the world. Our products are used in various sectors including transportation, construction, and energy, to name a few. We are committed to innovation, sustainable development, and making a positive impact in the communities where we operate. At our Krakow Global Business Services (GBS) Hub, we provide essential services across multiple functions, including automation, finance, purchasing, human resources, supply chain, and more. We are currently seeking motivated and talented individuals to join our Internship Program About the Program This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop your skills in a dynamic, global business environment. Our Internship Program offers exposure to various functions, enabling you to work alongside experienced professionals and contribute to real projects that have a direct impact on our business. Do you think you’re the right fit for this opportunity? Apply today! You can join as an Intern - Data Science Modelling, supporting the GR&A Data Science team throughout the modelling lifecycle and working on well-defined tasks under the supervision of senior colleagues In this role, you will: Support data preparation and analysis. Contribute to documentation and process mapping. Support the ideation, development and evaluation of statistical and machine learning models. Contribute to forecasting and decision-optimization activities. Present results to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Write clean, version-controlled code and documentation in a collaborative environment About You You are currently pursuing or have recently completed studies in Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Economics or another related quantitative field. You have solid foundations in statistics, probability theory and machine learning fundamentals. You have practical exposure to Python. You have a strong quantitative mindset and enjoy working with statistical, mathematical or modelling problems. You can identify what is essential in a complex subject and communicate it clearly and concisely. You have strong attention to detail and mathematical rigour. You enjoy working collaboratively and discussing your ideas with others. You have excellent written and spoken communication skills in English. What We Offer Paid internship with a Civil Contract ( Umowa zlecenie ) for 6 months (with the possibility of extension). Initial training and continuous support working with experienced mentors and colleagues who will guide you throughout the Internship Program. Flexibility related to working hours (with a minimum of 20 hours/week and a maximum of 40 hours/week). Hybrid work policy allowing you to work both in the office and remotely. A friendly and stimulating atmosphere, with the possibility to work with experts in their field within a global company and the chance to develop your career based on your ambitions, while building a professional network. A modern office in the city center for a newly established Hub, with coffee/tea/fruit (and more) available to you. High-performing interns may be considered for future full-time positions within Huntsman. What next? If you would like to join an innovative, collaborative, and multicultural team, please apply now. Your application will be forwarded to a Talent Acquisition Partner, who will strive to get back to you as soon as they can. We understand that applying for a new job is a big decision and we will work hard to keep you updated and support you along the way. About Us At Huntsman, we pride ourselves on being a people-oriented organization. Our family-like atmosphere is cultivated by our diverse groups of team members around the world. We welcome the talent, experience and fresh ideas that employees at all stages of their careers, from interns to seasoned professionals, bring to Huntsman. In return, we offer you the opportunity to become an integral part of a dynamic, industry-leading company, where safety and ethics always come first. Additional Locations:

They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place. Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. As our Full Stack Developer, AI Pentest, you’ll own have massive impact and ownership, working on something that has truly disrupted the market. Responsibilities Write Python, TypeScript, PHP and Vue across the entire stack Own AWS, LLM deployment, the API and the pentest agents Scale the architecture to thousands of simultaneous agents Turn customer feature requests around fast Ship small iterative changes to prod the moment they’re ready Really comfortable in a very entrepreneurial environment Can think along with architectural and impactful decisions Willing to learn new languages when the product requires it Comfortable researching and tackling hard problems and algorithms (eg parsing with ASTs) Willing to experiment (and also willing to perhaps throw away some code) Medior to Senior: We are going fast and need experienced people that can hit the ground running with us. You need to be comfortable with the above mentioned languages and tech-stack. Big ownership. Shape the projects that matter and ship fast. Grow as fast as we do. Take on more, own more, and carve out your own path. Top-tier tech pay and equity. High trust, strong values, zero corporate BS. Flexibility in working hours. A company that sticks to its values in an open and informal atmosphere. We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

items.desc: Weatherden — Data Science & Strategic Insights Team : Data Science & Strategy Duration : 12-week internship or 12-month industrial placement (flexible to fit your programme) Location : London, hybrid Start date : Flexible — to be agreed with successful candidate About Weatherden Weatherden is a physician, scientist and led clinical development partner supporting biotech, pharma, and investors to develop medicines in the right direction. We focus on reducing technical, strategic, and execution risk across the full development pathway – from translational strategy and IND readiness through to First-in-Human, clinical proof-of-concept, and pivotal studies. With over 200 projects delivered, more than 500 clinical trials supported, and experience across numerous therapeutic areas and modalities, our team combines deep clinical, regulatory, statistical and operational expertise. We are London headquartered and composed predominantly of MD/PhD-qualified team members and senior industry leaders with decades of cumulative industry experience. About the Role We are looking for a candidate who can combine practical data science skills with knowledge of the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector. The successful candidate will help turn complex scientific, clinical and industry data into structured information and actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. Working with data science, engineers, clinical development and strategy colleagues, the candidate will contribute to projects that bring together information from multiple sources, improve its quality and accessibility, and use analytical methods to identify patterns, emerging trends and potential white-space opportunities – areas where unmet needs or gaps in existing approaches may warrant further investigation. The project includes helping to build a structured, searchable intelligence database, developing repeatable data collection and scalable workflows, and interpreting the data to support clinical decision making. The balance between data engineering, analysis and research will be shaped around the candidate’s strengths, development interests and business priorities, rather than a single predefined workstream. Key Responsibilities Translate scientific and business questions into clear analytical tasks, working with colleagues to define useful datasets, measures and outputs. Collect, clean, combine and validate data from relevant scientific, clinical and industry sources, documenting provenance, assumptions and limitations. Help develop and maintain structured intelligence datasets or a searchable database, using consistent definitions and quality checks. Apply exploratory data analysis, statistical methods and visualisation to identify trends, relationships and changes across the pharma/biotech landscape. Contribute to data pipelines, API connectors or automated refresh processes that reduce manual effort and keep information current (experience-dependent). Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues through concise summaries, visualisations or dashboards. Document code and methods so that outputs are reproducible, maintainable and useful to others. Combine analytical findings with sector knowledge to highlight potential unmet needs, competitive gaps and white-space opportunities for further assessment, distinguishing genuine signals from gaps in data coverage. What We’re Looking For Essential Currently studying towards, or recently completed, a relevant degree in data science, bioinformatics, computational biology/chemistry or similar, biotechnology, computer science, statistics, or a related discipline; alternatively, a life sciences background with demonstrable quantitative or programming skills. Practical programming skills in Python or R, demonstrated through coursework, research, personal projects or relevant experience. A sound understanding of data science fundamentals, including data preparation, exploratory analysis, basic statistics and visualisation. Knowledge of the pharma/biotech sector and an understanding of the drug development process, gained through study, research or industry experience. A careful, critical approach to working with incomplete or inconsistent data, including recognising uncertainty, bias and limitations. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain analytical findings and their relevance to scientific or business questions. Curiosity, structured problem-solving and a willingness to learn new tools and work collaboratively across disciplines. Desirable We welcome complementary strengths and will shape the project scope around the successful candidate’s experience and development interests. SQL and relational database experience, including structuring, querying or combining datasets. Experience using APIs or building API connectors to retrieve and integrate data. Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL processes or workflow automation. Experience with scientific, …

items.desc: Company Description An entrepreneurial structure, Mirova is a conviction-driven asset management company dedicated to impact investing. It develops high-performing investment solutions for its individual and institutional clients, aimed at accelerating the transformation of our economy towards a sustainable model. Already a pioneer in sustainable investment, Mirova made the choice to become a mission-driven company in 2020 and obtained B Corp certification. Mirova is an affiliated management company of Natixis Investment Managers. It develops a comprehensive approach to responsible investing by offering solutions across various asset classes: equities, fixed income, diversified investments, infrastructure, renewable energy, natural capital, private equity, and solidarity investments. With €32 billion in assets under management as of the end of 2024 , Mirova relies on more than 240 employees in Paris, London, Singapore, and Boston, with strong growth prospects in Europe, Asia, and the United States. Job Description You are joining the Investor Relations – Private Assets team as Investor Relations, Data & AI Assistant , for a internship of 6 months from January 2027 . The team supports fundraising activities on Private Assets strategies, coordinates investor relations and contributes to the management and continuous improvement of Investor Relations tools and processes. In collaboration with your tutor, your main tasks will be: Coordinate responses to investors' requests, particularly in the context of RFPs, due diligence and Client Service, in liaison with the various internal and external teams; Analyze and structure Investor Relations and CRM data, improve their quality, and develop monitoring and management tools; Develop and implement automation solutions and generative AI to optimize recurring requests, data consolidation, media production, investor responses, and knowledge management; Contribute to the structuring of shared tools and resources in order to facilitate access to information, collaboration, and working methods within the team; Participate in different transversal projects. As an Investor Relations, Data & AI intern, you contribute to the team’s missions and help transform the way the Investor Relations team works by identifying and deploying new efficiency levers around data, automation and artificial intelligence. You work in an international environment, within a community of experts who place excellence, impact and collective action at the heart of everything they undertake. #FinanceTransformative You will operate in an international and inclusive environment, promoting collaboration, with concrete missions and a real impact. We will accompany you throughout your experience with us so that you can learn and develop your skills working alongside experienced professionals. You will also have the opportunity to commit yourself in favor of society and causes that are important to you through our corporate foundation. In addition to an attractive internship allowance, calculated according to your training and level of education, you will receive a reimbursement of 60% of your travel pass for one day of authorized absence paid for each month worked, and access to the company restaurant. You will also be able to access the benefits of the works council, depending on your attendance time. Required Skills/Qualifications/Experience As a BAC+5 student, you are preparing your degree at an engineering school or in a quantitative or technological program. You are interested in private assets, asset management and finance. You have strong analytical and quantitative capabilities. You know how to spot time-consuming tasks, analyze processes and propose concrete solutions to improve team efficiency. You are proficient in Excel and Microsoft Office tools, and are comfortable with generative AI. You are curious, proactive, autonomous, rigorous and pragmatic. You have good interpersonal skills and know how to collaborate with a variety of contacts, both internal and external. And last but not least, you are perfectly fluent in English. You will be contacted by one of our recruiters before meeting our business experts. An ideal moment of exchange to highlight your personality and your project.

items.desc:
En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Unéo recherche actuellement des profils : Unéo, la mutuelle des forces armées Née de l’exigence et de la solidarité propres au monde militaire, Unéo protège aujourd’hui plus d’1 million de personnes et opère l’un des plus grands contrats collectifs de protection sociale en France, confié par le ministère des Armées. Mutuelle affinitaire par son histoire, Unéo est un acteur d’assurance santé et prévoyance qui déploie son expertise auprès des militaires en activité, des réservistes et de leurs familles comme auprès des entreprises qui concourent à l’intérêt national et partagent ses valeurs. Au-delà de la santé et de la prévoyance, Unéo propose avec ses partenaires des solutions financières (banque, épargne, assurance emprunteur) pour accompagner ses adhérents dans tous les moments de vie. Unéo offre également des services exclusifs comme Avantagé, son programme de bons plans pour renforcer le pouvoir d’achat au quotidien, et Engagé, son initiative en faveur de la prévention en lien avec les politiques publiques de santé. Entre attachement à son ADN militaire et ouverture au monde de l’entreprise, Unéo affirme sa vocation : protéger et accompagner durablement celles et ceux qui servent, s’engagent et entreprennent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Rejoindre Unéo, c’est rejoindre une mutuelle soucieuse d‘offrir un cadre de travail stimulant à ses collaborateurs. La politique RH d’Unéo, en cohérence avec ses valeurs, l’amène à rechercher des candidats aux parcours et expériences variés (parcours, expériences, âges, …). La Mutuelle attache une importance particulière au développement des compétences de ses équipes, à travers des formations et une gestion attentive des carrières (mobilité interne et géographique). Rejoindre Unéo, c’est aussi faire partie d’une entreprise qui se transforme et se modernise en permanence, en s’appuyant notamment sur la digitalisation de ses services, ce qui lui permet de se concentrer sur son cœur de métier : la protection de ses adhérents. Espace de travail partagé « coworking », restaurant avec patio, rooftop, salle de sport, contribuent à créer une atmosphère conviviale pour le bien-être des collaborateurs. Unéo recrute de nouveaux talents en CDI, en CDD, alternance et stage, impliqués et qui partagent ses valeurs. 

 Unéo recherche un(e) chargé de gestion clients confirmé(e) Vie du contrat / Cotisations H/F disposant d’une bonne maîtrise de la gestion des contrats individuels en santé et/ou prévoyance. Vous assurerez de manière autonome la fiabilité des données contractuelles et financières, depuis l’adhésion et les évolutions du contrat jusqu’à sa résiliation, tout en traitant les opérations de cotisations et les anomalies associées. Missions : Adhésions individuelles : contrôler la complétude et la conformité des demandes, vérifier les pièces et conditions d’adhésion, enregistrer les contrats et notifier leur prise d’effet. Vie du contrat : traiter les modifications de situation personnelle ou professionnelle, les changements de coordonnées, de bénéficiaires, de formule ou de garanties, ainsi que les suspensions, réactivations et résiliations. Gestion des ayants droit : enregistrer les ajouts, modifications et radiations, contrôler les justificatifs et veiller à la bonne application des dates d’effet. Gestion des cotisations : calculer ou contrôler les cotisations et proratas, enregistrer les modalités de paiement, traiter les changements de coordonnées bancaires et vérifier l’affectation des règlements. Anomalies financières : analyser et régulariser les prélèvements rejetés, paiements non affectés, écarts de cotisation, trop-perçus, remboursements et autres anomalies de compte. Suivi des impayés : appliquer les procédures de relance, de mise en demeure, de suspension ou de radiation prévues, dans le respect des règles contractuelles et réglementaires. Relation adhérent : répondre aux demandes écrites ou téléphoniques liées au contrat et aux cotisations, expliquer les opérations réalisées et demander les compléments nécessaires. Contrôle et qualité : sécuriser les dates d’effet, les données contractuelles et les mouvements financiers, assurer la traçabilité des actes et signaler les dysfonctionnements. Amélioration continue : contribuer à l’actualisation des procédures et proposer des améliorations de traitement. items.desc: ML Engineer – Forecasting, Series Temporales y Optimización Matemática Ubicación: 100% remoto Cliente: Santander Salario: Hasta 40.000 € brutos anuales Proyecto: Gestión de efectivo y previsión de demanda en el sector bancario. Sobre el proyecto Buscamos un/a Machine Learning Engineer para incorporarse a un proyecto estratégico en el sector bancario, orientado a la previsión de demanda y optimización de la gestión de efectivo. La persona seleccionada participará en el análisis, desarrollo, validación y mejora de modelos de Machine Learning tradicionales, especialmente modelos de series temporales, forecasting y optimización matemática aplicados a problemas operativos y de negocio. Se requiere una base sólida en modelización predictiva, entrenamiento y evaluación de modelos, así como conocimientos de optimización para mejorar la toma de decisiones. También participará en la adaptación y productivización de los modelos en entornos corporativos. Responsabilidades principales Analizar, desarrollar, entrenar y validar modelos de Machine Learning supervisado. Trabajar con modelos de series temporales y forecasting para la previsión de demanda. Evaluar y comparar diferentes enfoques de modelización, analizando precisión, estabilidad y capacidad predictiva. Optimizar modelos de forecasting y proponer mejoras en los algoritmos y estrategias de entrenamiento. Trabajar con modelos de optimización matemática aplicados a la asignación de recursos, planificación y toma de decisiones operativas. Analizar problemas de optimización de denominaciones y gestión de efectivo. Evaluar la combinación de modelos predictivos con algoritmos de optimización y reglas de negocio. Participar en el diseño y mejora de procesos de entrenamiento, inferencia y reentrenamiento de modelos. Colaborar en la adaptación de modelos a entornos productivos mediante buenas prácticas de MLOps. Trabajar con plataformas analíticas y entornos distribuidos como Azure Databricks y PySpark. Documentar los modelos, experimentos, resultados y decisiones técnicas. Requisitos imprescindibles Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Estadística, Data Science o similar. Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, Data Science o desarrollo de soluciones analíticas. Python avanzado aplicado a Machine Learning y modelización. Experiencia práctica en Machine Learning tradicional: entrenamiento, evaluación, validación y optimización de modelos. Conocimientos sólidos de series temporales, forecasting y previsión de demanda . Conocimientos aplicados de optimización matemática , programación matemática, heurísticas o investigación operativa. Experiencia con modelos supervisados y técnicas de evaluación de modelos. SQL para consulta, transformación y validación de datos. Conocimientos de PySpark / Apache Spark. Experiencia con Azure Databricks o plataformas equivalentes. Conocimientos de Git y metodologías de desarrollo colaborativo. Inglés técnico suficiente para trabajar con documentación y librerías especializadas. Tecnologías y herramientas Machine Learning y Forecasting: Python, Scikit-learn, LightGBM. Prophet, StatsForecast, MLForecast o Nixtla. Modelos de regresión y aprendizaje supervisado. Modelos de series temporales y previsión de demanda. Optimización matemática: Programación matemática. Optimización de restricciones. Heurísticas y algoritmos de optimización. Investigación operativa y optimización de decisiones. Entorno tecnológico: Python, SQL, PySpark y Apache Spark. Azure Databricks. MLflow. Git y herramientas CI/CD. Se valorará Experiencia en banca, sector financiero, retail o entornos operativos. Experiencia en proyectos de previsión de demanda y planificación de recursos. Conocimientos de MLOps, versionado y monitorización de modelos. Experiencia migrando modelos desde notebooks a entornos productivos. Conocimientos de Azure y herramientas corporativas de gobierno de modelos. Experiencia con procesos batch de entrenamiento, predicción y optimización. Uso de herramientas de IA aplicadas al desarrollo, como GitHub Copilot. Competencias personales Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas. Criterio técnico para evaluar y mejorar modelos. Autonomía y capacidad de aprendizaje. Comunicación con equipos técnicos y de negocio. Orientación a resultados y mejora continua. Condiciones Salario: hasta 40.000 € brutos anuales. Modalidad: 100% remoto. Proyecto en el sector bancario con Santander. items.desc: ABOUT US Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care. Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on. Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members. We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you. The position requires a physical presence at our office in Copenhagen, Denmark. If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use. THE JOB We're looking for a product-focused Backend Engineer who sits with the product team and owns the backend for new customer-facing features. Care workers and care managers rely on what you ship every shift, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking platform role. You'll work closely with users and product, design the APIs and data models new features need, ship them into production, and check afterwards whether what you built actually made a shift easier. Your goal is to shrink the time from a customer request to a reliable backend in production, without cutting corners on privacy of residents' health data. In this role, you will focus on: Feature Backend: Own the backend for new product features end-to-end, from design discussions through APIs, data models and services to production rollout across multiple markets. Product Partnership: Sit with the product team. Shape how features work under the hood, cut scope when needed, and make the backend choices that keep iteration fast without painting us into a corner. Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team, visit care facilities when it helps, and turn messy feedback into concrete backend and product decisions. Come with ideas and push them forward. APIs & Data Models: Design and build the APIs, schemas and services product features need. Improve and fix the systems behind them when they get in the way of shipping. Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Keep the alerts and workflows care teams depend on reliable when new features land. QUALIFICATIONS Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build. Solid production experience building backend APIs and services, and working with relational databases (e.g. Postgres). Comfortable owning the backend side of product features, not only platform or infrastructure work. AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience. Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team. NICE TO HAVE Experience working closely with product managers, designers and frontend engineers on customer-facing features. Familiarity with real-time systems, event-driven architectures or push notifications. Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR). Experience shipping products across multiple markets and languages. Some frontend exposure (React / React Native) so you can reason about the full feature, even if backend is your focus. WHAT WE OFFER Participation in our warrant program (stock options). A small team where your decisions directly shape the product. A Copenhagen-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture. Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate. JOIN OUR TEAM We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job. At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work. If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

Job description The AI Economics Institute (AIEI) is a joint research organisation of HM Treasury and the Office for the Prime Minister and Cabinet (OPMC). The AIEI has been established to build and maintain the analytical capability needed to put the UK government at the forefront of understanding AIs economic impacts. Announced by the Chancellor in the March 2026 Mais Lecture and launched in June 2026, it is the first government-backed institute of its kind in the world. AI has the potential to substantially reshape the structure of firms, sectors, and labour markets. The opportunities are extraordinary. AI could drive productivity gains and unlock new sources of growth. At the same time, the transition also carries risks depending on the pace of technological development and how the economy adapts. The AIEI exists to build the data infrastructure, research capability and external relationships needed to assess these impacts rigorously and at pace, and to ensure the resulting evidence informs policy makers. The Institute will assess both opportunities and risks under a range of scenarios, examining how AI affects productivity, labour markets, firms, growth and the income distribution, with particular attention to how the gains are shared across regions, income groups, sectors and generations. The AIEI is not a policy-setting body. UK government departments remain responsible for policy decisions in response to AI. The Institutes role is to improve the quality and timeliness of the evidence and analysis on which those decisions rest. It focuses on priorities where it has a comparative advantage as a research institute at the heart of government, avoiding duplication of work that can happen equally well elsewhere, and engaging widely with academia, business and civil society to inform its work and contribute to public understanding. The AIEI is modelled on the AI Security Institute, particularly in its research focus, its approach to bringing in external talent, and its access to advanced tools. It is a small, high-calibre organisation, planning to grow to around 35 FTE by the end of its first year. It will bring together talented civil servants with Research Economists who have hands-on experience of delivering frontier economic research. It is chaired by Nobel Prize winning economist and former Chief Economist of the IMF, Simon Johnson. A world-first ambition is to link private sector data, including AI usage data, to government administrative data, providing a unique and rich data ecosystem for empirical research. The Institutes ambitions for developing world leading macroeconomic modelling capability are similarly high. The two research pillars The AIEIs research function is organised around two complementary pillars set out in the published prospectus. All four role types in this campaign are being recruited into one of these two pillars, depending on the specialism of the candidate: Data & Empirical Research - developing the data infrastructure, measurement frameworks and empirical research needed to establish an evidence-based picture of AIs economic effects as they develop, including causal analysis of AIs impacts on productivity, labour markets, firms and workers. Modelling & Scenarios - connecting potential pathways for AIs development and adoption to economy-wide outcomes, building cutting edge economic models and plausible but stretching scenarios, testing assumptions, and ensuring policy conclusions are robust to the uncertainty that remains. items.desc: At Product Madness , we create mobile games that bring entertainment to players around the world. Data plays an important role in understanding player needs, improving gaming experiences, and making informed business decisions. Join our collaborative team, where your ideas and expertise will help us explore new opportunities, solve meaningful challenges, and shape the future of mobile gaming. The Role As a Data Scientist at Product Madness, you will use data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modelling to better understand player behaviour, solve business challenges, and improve gaming experiences. You will contribute to projects dedicated to player involvement, retention, and revenue. You will also help develop analytical tools and machine learning solutions that support informed decisions and create more personalised experiences for our players. Working with a variety of datasets, you will take ownership of clearly defined analytical and modelling tasks while learning from experienced data scientists on more complex projects. You will collaborate with game developers, data analysts, product managers, and game operations teams to translate data into meaningful insights and practical improvements. What You'll Do Explore business challenges, develop hypotheses, choose suitable analytical methods, and deliver data-driven solutions with support from experienced colleagues when needed. Develop, test, and improve predictive algorithms and artificial intelligence techniques to improve player experiences, engagement, retention, and revenue. Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, predictive modelling, and simulation to understand player behaviour and business performance. Support A/B testing and experiments by selecting relevant metrics, analysing results, and sharing findings that guide business decisions. Create analytical models, simulations, and tools that help teams make informed decisions and find opportunities for improvement. Prepare, validate, and explore large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that support business goals. Work with senior data scientists, Data Engineering, and MLOps teams to develop and integrate analytical models and machine learning solutions into business processes. Share findings with collaborators, explain key insights and limitations, and offer practical recommendations. Contribute to a supportive team environment by documenting your work, participating in peer reviews, sharing knowledge, and developing your technical skills. What We're Looking For MSc or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or possessing equivalent experience. 1+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or quantitative analytics, with practical experience delivering analytical or modelling projects. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, descriptive analysis, and statistical inference. Practical experience in exploratory data analysis, data preparation, and working with large datasets. Experience developing and evaluating predictive or machine learning models, including regression, classification, or clustering. Understanding of statistical modelling, forecasting, and simulation techniques. Familiarity with hypothesis testing, split testing, and experimental analysis. Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and modelling, including common libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Ability to write SQL queries to extract, join, transform, and aggregate data. Basic understanding of software development practices, including version control, testing, and documentation. Experience using AI assistants to support coding, analysis, and other professional tasks, with appropriate validation of outputs. If you’re passionate about demonstrating data science to create exceptional gaming experiences and are ready to lead data products to success, we want to hear from you. Join Product Madness and contribute to the evolution of mobile gaming! items.desc: Our clients make countless decisions every day. Our goal is that they base them on how their processes actually run, not on gut feeling and assumptions. Processand is a process intelligence consultancy of around 40 people, headquartered in Munich with an office in Prague. We help large companies understand how their processes really run - in Sales, Procurement, Production and Supply Chain - and turn that into measurable improvement. We combine Celonis and other process intelligence and automation tools with our own data science. Clients include Deutsche Bahn, Freudenberg Sealing Technologies, Knorr-Bremse and Rational, as well as leading brands in beverages, automotive and consumer goods. The role You work on process intelligence and automation projects for large clients, from raw system data to measurable changes in how a business runs. You dig into millions of orders, invoices or production steps and find where time is lost, where money is stuck and what can be automated. You set up the data models, dashboards and automations, then explain to the client what it means and how to turn those insights into value. A team lead and experienced colleagues review your work and help you grow. What you will do Analyse any client process with a good amount of data behind it - e.g. in Sales, Procurement, Production or Supply Chain - to find inefficiencies, bottlenecks and automation potential. Build data models, dashboards and automations in Celonis and other process intelligence tools. Work with clients to design and roll out process improvements. Run workshops and present findings in business terms. What you bring Must-haves Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science or a similar field. 0-3 years of experience. Graduates with relevant internships or thesis work are welcome. Hands-on with SQL or a programming language such as Python or R. A structured, analytical approach and the ability to explain findings in business terms. Fluent English (C1). Nice-to-haves First experience with process mining tools (Celonis, Signavio, UiPath or similar). Consulting or client-facing experience (internships count). Czech and/or German. Who you are You care about getting it right, and you say so when something does not add up. You like hard problems and do not need everything spelled out. You ask for feedback and use it. You share what you know and ask when you are stuck. We hire for fit with our values as much as for experience: https://www.processand.com/about-us/ What we offer Contract: permanent, full-time employment contract. Flexible work: home office is possible on any day. Still we value regular time together in our Karlín office. Workations are possible. Little travel: under 10% of your time. Growth: Budget per year for personal development, dedicated time for innovation, regular feedback and development talks. Time off: 5 weeks of holiday. Your first 5 sick days each year are fully paid. Flexible working hours Flat hierarchy: around 40 people, short decision paths and direct access to management. Titles describe responsibility, not status. The Prague team Our Prague data science team has 4 people today and is growing. We work on shared projects with colleagues in Munich, to one standard. We are hiring a Data Science Team Lead and Data Scientists at the same time - you will help build the team, not just join it. How to apply Send your CV. A cover letter is optional. items.desc: Introductie Ben jij geïnteresseerd in data, technologie en het verbeteren van processen? Wil je leren hoe data wordt ingezet om kwaliteit en prestaties binnen een hightech productieomgeving te verbeteren? Dan is deze hbo-deeltijdfunctie binnen het Quality & Operational Excellence team van ASML een mooie start van jouw carrière. ASML is een toonaangevend hightechbedrijf en speelt een sleutelrol in de wereldwijde halfgeleiderindustrie. Met onze technologie maken we innovatie in vrijwel alle moderne elektronica mogelijk. Samenwerking, precisie en kwaliteit staan centraal in alles wat we doen. Binnen deze functie ontwikkel je kennis van manufacturing, data-analyse, kwaliteitsverbetering en Statistical Process Control (SPC) in een innovatieve productieomgeving. Je draagt bij aan het Manufacturing SPC Competence Center en ontwikkelt tegelijkertijd jouw analytische, probleemoplossende, communicatieve en kwaliteitsmanagementvaardigheden. Jouw rol en verantwoordelijkheden Samen met ervaren collega's en onder begeleiding van een mentor bouw je stapsgewijs kennis op van SPC binnen manufacturing en draag je bij aan verschillende activiteiten binnen het Competence Center. Analyseren van data uit productieprocessen en inline gemonitorde machines om trends, afwijkingen en verbeterkansen te identificeren. Ondersteunen bij de analyse en optimalisatie van SPC-controllimieten op basis van beschikbare procesdata. Signaleren van mogelijkheden om procesmonitoring te verbeteren en voorstellen doen voor data-gedreven verbeteringen. Deelnemen aan relevante teamoverleggen, workshops en evenementen en leren hoe kwaliteits- en operational excellence-principes in de praktijk worden toegepast. Onderhouden en verbeteren van de Manufacturing SPC Competence Center-webpagina en ondersteunende documentatie. Ondersteunen bij het opstellen van wekelijkse en maandelijkse rapportages en het vertalen van SPC-informatie naar heldere managementinzichten. Wat bieden wij? Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €2.600 en €2.850. 8,33% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. 40 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. Volledige vergoeding van je collegegeld en een betaalde studiedag. Begeleiding door een vaste mentor en coach. Praktijkervaring binnen een internationale hightechorganisatie. Baangarantie bij succesvolle afronding van het programma. Wie ben jij? Voor dit bachelor traject zoeken wij iemand die: Nauwkeurig werkt en graag met systemen, processen en data bezig is. De Nederlandse taal beheerst op minimaal B2-niveau. Zich comfortabel voelt in een internationale en Engelstalige werkomgeving. Nog niet eerder een Nederlandse bacheloropleiding heeft afgerond. Binnen 45 km van Veldhoven woont en minimaal 18 jaar oud is. Voldoet aan de toelatingseisen voor een hbo-bacheloropleiding. Skills Je bent analytisch sterk en hebt interesse in data en procesverbeteringen. Je toont initiatief en hebt oog voor detail. Je bent communicatief vaardig en weet anderen mee te nemen in jouw analyses en inzichten. Je bent nieuwsgierig en gemotiveerd om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen binnen een technische omgeving. Je werkt graag samen in multidisciplinaire teams. Je bent geïnteresseerd in hoe data ingezet kan worden om productieprocessen te verbeteren en staat open om SPC en geavanceerde kwaliteitsmethodieken te leren. items.desc: Find new ways to make EV charging cheaper and smarter, from the data pipeline to the model. About Deftpower We make EV charging less annoying. Drivers find a charger, pay with one app or card across Europe, and charge at moments that are easier on the grid. You won't see our name on that app. You'll see ANWB's, or one of the other brands we power. We like it that way: we'd rather make it work than make it loud. Three e-mobility experts founded Deftpower, and they still run it. You can walk up to any of them, or to anyone else, with a question. Most people tell us they learn more from their colleagues here than from any course. We're 120+ people now, with the energy of a team of 30. We'll keep growing, just more deliberately than before. About The Job The team. The Flexibility team builds a virtual power plant: we aggregate thousands of EV charging sessions into flexibility for the energy markets. That makes charging cheaper for drivers and helps balance the grid. You join two AI engineers and a group of C#/.NET backend developers, led by Gerben. Why now. Our platform works and has grown rapidly. We’re now entering the flexibility markets, and that raises the bar for our predictions and data. This is the moment to step in and help build what those markets demand. What you do. Prediction is at the core of this role, on two levels. For each driver and charging session, we predict behaviour: when the car leaves, how fast it charges and how much energy it needs. Across thousands of sessions combined, we predict how much flexibility the pool can reliably deliver to the market. Those predictions are only as good as the data and models behind them, and you build both. Design and build the data pipelines behind our predictions, from raw charging and market data to model-ready datasets Keep the data reliable: monitor quality, and catch issues before they reach a model Develop prediction models and put them into production as soon as they beat what’s running now Work with our .NET developers to integrate models into the platform, and monitor them once they’re live How we work. We work with Shape Up instead of Scrum: five-week cycles with a clear goal, and the team decides how to get there. You get a lot of freedom in how you solve the problems we face, and you own the result. For you You get trust from day one. Contracts, roadmaps and numbers are open to you. You make the call, and you own it. You learn fast here. AI is part of every team's work, and feedback goes in every direction. Every quarter, we celebrate together at D-Day, the company day we work towards. It's not always tidy. We grew fast, and not everything is figured out yet. If that sounds like an opportunity, you'll fit right in. 8% holiday allowance, 25 vacation days and a good pension €2,000 training budget a year and your own choice of laptop 40 hours a week, or 36 if you prefer On average 2 days a week at the office in Arnhem About You You have 3+ years of experience building data pipelines on high-volume data, and you’ve put prediction models into production. You’re rigorous with data: you test your assumptions and know how far a prediction can be trusted. You take initiative and dig into questions nobody has asked yet. You turn what the data shows into clear choices for technical and business colleagues. You work in English every day. Dutch is nice to have. Must-have: Python and its data and ML stack, SQL, deploying models to the cloud, Git and pull requests, and curiosity about AI coding tools. Nice to have: probabilistic forecasting, Azure and Bicep, and experience in energy markets, EV charging or battery optimisation. This is for you if… you see a gap and plug it, without anyone having to ask. you say it when you disagree, and then you commit. change gives you energy. When plans shift, you shift with them. you share what you know and make your work visible. This is not for you if… you need a fixed plan before you start. Our plans change, and often. you wait for instructions. direct feedback feels personal to you. you want to work fully remote. Join Deftpower! Intro call with People & Culture Meeting with the Team Lead Case of about one hour Meeting our Head of Engineering Offer You'll also do a short personality test, as a conversation starter. Once we're moving, we move fast. Want to plug some gaps with us? We'd love to hear from you.

Identificarás proactivamente áreas de mejora; construirás y ejecutarás análisis y modelos que conduzcan a recomendaciones accionables. Colaborarás con los equipos de Análisis de Datos e Ingeniería para asegurar una base de datos fiable y disponibilidad de características. Aprenderás y compartirás ideas con un equipo diverso y distribuido globalmente de científicos de datos. Lo que buscamos Grado en Matemáticas, Estadística, Economía, Informática o un campo cuantitativo similar, o experiencia equivalente. Más de 2 años de experiencia profesional en ciencia de datos, con un historial demostrado de entrega de proyectos de datos o ML de principio a fin. Experiencia práctica aplicando ciencia de datos para resolver desafíos empresariales reales, idealmente en un entorno de marketing, crecimiento o digital. Experiencia en juegos o entretenimiento digital es una ventaja importante. Dominio de Python y SQL. Experiencia construyendo modelos de previsión y de series temporales. Familiaridad con métodos de inferencia causal (por ejemplo, diff-in-diff, discontinuidad de regresión, modelado de uplift). Conocimiento de análisis estadístico y experimentación (pruebas A/B, pruebas de significancia). Experiencia con herramientas de visualización de datos y presentación clara de resultados analíticos. Enfoque pragmático para la resolución de problemas, favoreciendo soluciones prácticas. items.desc: M2 INTERNSHIP 2027 Machine Learning and Nonlinear Model Reduction for the Fast Simulation of Metal Additive Manufacturing Scientific Machine Learning and Reduced Order Models for scan-path-resolved thermal simulations Topics Scientific Machine Learning · Reduced Order Models · Finite Elements · Metal 3D printing Where I2M laboratory, Arts et Métiers campus, Talence (Bordeaux), France When Starting February 2027, 5 to 6 months (M2 internship) Next step A funded PhD position (ANR project SMART) is open after the internship Contact simon.essongue-boussougou@u-bordeaux.fr Scientific context Metal Additive Manufacturing (AM) enables the production of parts of unprecedented geometrical complexity and the repair of components rather than their replacement. However, the quality of printed parts remains difficult to control: residual stresses, distortions and undesired microstructures are governed by the thermal history of the part, and process parameters are still mostly tuned by trial and error. Numerical simulation could replace these costly experimental campaigns, but realistic thermal simulations remain orders of magnitude too slow for the optimization of machine parameters (deposition strategy, power input over time). Their cost stems from strong nonlinearities (phase changes, temperature-dependent properties, radiative exchanges), from a computational domain that grows over time , and from a time step constrained by the size and speed of the heat source, which typically requires millions of time steps for an industrial part. Objectives of the internship Our team has already accelerated these computations within a finite element framework, through stabilized explicit time integration and space-time parallelism. The internship aims to assess the potential of projection-based Reduced Order Models (ROM) for further speed-ups. Linear ROMs such as Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) perform poorly for problems involving a moving heat source and an evolving domain, owing to the slow decay of the Kolmogorov n-width. This motivates the use of nonlinear model reduction , based either on neural networks or on registration techniques, i.e. coordinate transformations that follow the moving heat source. ▸ High-fidelity data: generate finite element simulations with the in-house code and build snapshot databases. ▸ Linear baseline: implement a POD-based ROM and analyse its limitations in terms of accuracy and speed-up. ▸ Nonlinear ROM: implement either a neural-network-enhanced POD approach (e.g. POD-DL-ROM) or a registration-based ROM, depending on the candidate’s background and on preliminary results. ▸ Assessment: accuracy in the vicinity of the melt pool, prediction of cooling rates, and computational gains with respect to the full-order model. ▸ Dissemination: write a report and present the results to the project team. Supervision and environment ▸ The internship takes place at I2M laboratory under the supervision of Simon Essongue , in collaboration with Eric Lacoste (I2M, physics of AM processes) and with model reduction experts Tommaso Taddei (Sapienza University of Rome) and the MONHADE team (Inria Bordeaux). ▸ It is part of the ANR project SMART and is intended as a first step towards the project’s funded PhD . Candidate profile Prior knowledge of nonlinear ROMs or machine learning is not required. However, only applicants who meet all of the following requirements will be considered: ▸ Enrolled in an M2 or final year of engineering school in applied mathematics, computational mechanics or scientific computing. ▸ A strong background in numerical methods for PDEs (finite elements in particular), supported by good grades in the relevant M1 and M2 courses. ▸ Solid programming skills and the willingness to pursue a PhD . Knowledge of machine learning, additive manufacturing, GPU computing or git is a plus. Application Send your application to simon.essongue-boussougou@u-bordeaux.fr with all of the following documents. Incomplete applications will not be considered. ▸ A cover letter ▸ A CV ▸ Transcripts of grades for M1 and M2 (if M2 grades are not yet available, list at least the courses taken in M1 and M2) ▸ A letter of recommendation would be a considerable plus ▸ An internship or research report, if available Selected references S. Essongue, B. Diarra, E. Lacoste, Runge–Kutta–Chebyshev schemes to accelerate thermal modelling of additive manufacturing processes, Finite Elem. Anal. Des. 256 (2026) 104527. T. Taddei, A registration method for model order reduction: data compression and geometry reduction, SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 42(2) (2020) A997–A1027. S. Fresca, A. Manzoni, POD-DL-ROM: enhancing deep learning-based reduced order models for nonlinear parametrized PDEs by proper orthogonal decomposition, Comput. Methods Appl. Mech. Eng. 388 (2022) 114181.

items.desc: Zie jij snel hoe iets slimmer kan? Ben je nieuwsgierig naar AI en nieuwe technologie? En vind je het leuk om niet alleen mee te kijken, maar zelf met ideeën en oplossingen te komen? Dan zoeken we jou! Bij BOS Innovatie & Projecten van Aeres Hogeschool werken we aan het verbeteren en vernieuwen van onze onderwijslogistiek. Denk aan alles wat achter de schermen nodig is om onderwijs goed te organiseren: van planning en roostering tot diplomering, stages en tentamens. Wat je gaat doen Je gaat tijdens je stage aan de slag met een echte verbeteropdracht binnen Aeres Hogeschool. Bijvoorbeeld: hoe kunnen we een planningsproces slimmer maken? Kan een aanmeldproces eenvoudiger? Waar doen we nog onnodig handmatig werk? En kan AI of automatisering dat slimmer overnemen? Je gaat: uitzoeken hoe een proces nu werkt. praten met de collega's die ermee werken. ontdekken waar het slimmer, makkelijker of sneller kan. oplossingsrichtingen onderzoeken en deze ook toetsen onderzoeken. kijken wat AI en technologie daarin kan betekenen. waar mogelijk jouw oplossing ook echt testen. Geen opdracht die alleen in een verslag verdwijnt dus. Als jouw idee werkt, gaan we het ook echt gebruiken. Wie ben jij Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding die hierbij past. Welke opleiding dat precies is, vinden we minder belangrijk dan jouw nieuwsgierigheid en manier van denken. Je bent geïnteresseerd in AI en technologie. Je vindt het leuk om dingen slimmer te maken. Je denkt in oplossingen en durft buiten de gebaande paden te denken. Je stapt makkelijk op mensen af. Je stelt vragen en durft je mening te geven. Je kunt zelfstandig werken én samenwerken. Jouw frisse blik kan ons helpen om dingen te zien die voor ons inmiddels vanzelfsprekend zijn geworden. Wij bieden Een stage waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om te onderzoeken, uit te proberen en met eigen ideeën te komen. Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt begeleiding vanuit BOS Innovatie & Projecten. We passen de opdracht aan op jouw opleiding en niveau. Of je nu mbo of hbo doet: we zorgen voor een opdracht waarin je wordt uitgedaagd én iets kunt maken of verbeteren waar we daadwerkelijk iets aan hebben. De stagevergoeding is €300,- bruto per maand voor een volledige stageweek. Bij parttime vindt berekening naar rato plaats. Interesse Ben je ervan overtuigd dat wij op zoek zijn naar jou? Solliciteer dan vóór 30 november 2026 t.a.v. Marjolein van Amstel. Wil je graag eerst meer weten over deze functie? Bel dan Marjolein van Amstel via 06-278986950 In verband met de AVG wetgeving accepteren we alleen sollicitaties via onze website.

items.desc: Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI. Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme. Das Projekt Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb. Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen. Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an. Aufgaben Die Rolle Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht. Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar. Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert. items.desc: Project Controls Engineer Join nPlan - build the cities of the future We're nPlan, a Series B startup backed by leading investors, including GV (formerly Google Ventures) and DeepMind's founder, Sir Demis Hassabis. Our technology helps the world's biggest construction projects make faster, more confident, data-driven decisions. By combining one of the world's largest datasets of project plans with advanced machine learning, we forecast project outcomes and reduce risk - reshaping how infrastructure gets built. The Role We are looking for a Project Controls Engineer with a background in project controls, planning, or risk analysis on construction projects to join our growing client team. You'll be curious about generative AI, or keen to build that exposure, with a genuine interest in the space. In this role, you'll work closely with our senior client engineers to help clients get real value from nPlan, and be part of the change to revolutionise the industry. If you've ever been frustrated by the limitations of QSRA workshops, poor forecasting data, or limited time for analysis, this could be the job for you. You'll be given real ownership early, backed by the support and mentorship of a team that cares deeply about our mission and about your development. You'll attend monthly client visits and team meetings in our London office, as well as have the opportunity to visit our international clients. What We're Looking For We're excited to hear from people who bring curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in construction and technology. To succeed in this role, you'll bring: Up to 2 years of experience in a planning, risk, PMO, or project management role on construction projects (or equivalent academic/professional grounding in project controls, looking to move into a client-facing tech role). A solid understanding of construction schedules (P6) - how they're built and how to read them, with an eagerness to deepen that skill. A solid understanding of probabilistic schedule risk analysis and foundational statistics. An interest in supporting projects that meaningfully improve outcomes for an organisation. Passion for implementing technology to improve the construction industry. Attention to detail - please mention the word 'crane' in your application form. A relationship-building instinct: You care about delighting customers. Nice to haves: Experience working in a software company or on the implementation of software in the construction context Experience working with LLM applications We care more about potential and drive than perfection. If you're excited by what we're building, we want to hear from you. About The Role You'll work cross-functionally across multiple areas, building your domain knowledge and skills to have a real, tangible impact: Client engagement Supporting the wider Deployment Engineering team in coaching clients on how they can maximise the value they get from nPlan. Building relationships within client organisations, and starting to understand their needs and pain points. Helping configure the product so it brings value to clients. Product deployment Supporting delivery of projects that improve how we embed our products within client organisations. Helping clients understand and adopt our advanced analysis features, including custom LLM-based analysis. Commercial Working with the Commercial team to support engagement, retention, and expansion activity. Product Working with Product Managers and AI Engineers, contributing to prototyping. Contributing as an emerging domain-expert voice in our LLM evaluation cycle, helping ensure reliable, accurate analyses. Learning and development Close mentorship from senior client engineers as you build your client-facing and technical skills. Why You'll Love Working Here Competitive salary between £40k-£60k + generous equity - when nPlan succeeds, so do you! Flexible hours, remote-friendly, with a Shoreditch office HQ. Uncapped holiday, private medical insurance, personal learning and development budget, enhanced family and sick leave, and more. Room to grow - we're just over 50 people and scaling fast. Guided by our values: Learn from Everything. Be Radically Truthful. Aim High, Run Fast. Listen to interviews with our team here, to hear how they found the move from construction to tech Our Culture We're a curious, diverse, and mission-driven team united by a belief that better data can change how the world builds. We value openness, honesty, and diversity of thought - and believe the best ideas win, no matter where they come from. Expect openness, collaboration, and balance - plus plenty of socials! Application Process Once you've applied, you will hear from us within a week. Interview stages typically include: A 30-minute intro chat A role-specific interview or assignment An interview focusing on our culture and values A final stage to test collaboration with our team (on-site or remote) We aim to complete the process within 3-4 weeks, but can move …

items.desc: Werken bij Aeres Vacatures Stageopdracht Procesverbetering & AI Ondersteunend / Staf Aeres Hogeschool Almere, Dronten, Wageningen Sluitingsdatum: 30-11-2026 Direct solliciteren Zie jij snel hoe iets slimmer kan? Ben je nieuwsgierig naar AI en nieuwe technologie? En vind je het leuk om niet alleen mee te kijken, maar zelf met ideeën en oplossingen te komen? Dan zoeken we jou! Bij BOS Innovatie & Projecten van Aeres Hogeschool werken we aan het verbeteren en vernieuwen van onze onderwijslogistiek. Denk aan alles wat achter de schermen nodig is om onderwijs goed te organiseren: van planning en roostering tot diplomering, stages en tentamens. Wat je gaat doen Je gaat tijdens je stage aan de slag met een echte verbeteropdracht binnen Aeres Hogeschool. Bijvoorbeeld: hoe kunnen we een planningsproces slimmer maken? Kan een aanmeldproces eenvoudiger? Waar doen we nog onnodig handmatig werk? En kan AI of automatisering dat slimmer overnemen? Je Gaat uitzoeken hoe een proces nu werkt. praten met de collega's die ermee werken. ontdekken waar het slimmer, makkelijker of sneller kan. oplossingsrichtingen onderzoeken en deze ook toetsen onderzoeken. kijken wat AI en technologie daarin kan betekenen. waar mogelijk jouw oplossing ook echt testen. Geen opdracht die alleen in een verslag verdwijnt dus. Als jouw idee werkt, gaan we het ook echt gebruiken. Wie ben jij Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding die hierbij past. Welke opleiding dat precies is, vinden we minder belangrijk dan jouw nieuwsgierigheid en manier van denken. Je bent geïnteresseerd in AI en technologie. Je vindt het leuk om dingen slimmer te maken. Je denkt in oplossingen en durft buiten de gebaande paden te denken. Je stapt makkelijk op mensen af. Je stelt vragen en durft je mening te geven. Je kunt zelfstandig werken én samenwerken. Jouw frisse blik kan ons helpen om dingen te zien die voor ons inmiddels vanzelfsprekend zijn geworden. Wij bieden Een stage waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om te onderzoeken, uit te proberen en met eigen ideeën te komen. Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt begeleiding vanuit BOS Innovatie & Projecten. We passen de opdracht aan op jouw opleiding en niveau. Of je nu mbo of hbo doet: we zorgen voor een opdracht waarin je wordt uitgedaagd én iets kunt maken of verbeteren waar we daadwerkelijk iets aan hebben. De stagevergoeding is €300,- bruto per maand voor een volledige stageweek. Bij parttime vindt berekening naar rato plaats. Interesse Ben je ervan overtuigd dat wij op zoek zijn naar jou? Solliciteer dan vóór 30 november 2026 t.a.v. Marjolein van Amstel. Wil je graag eerst meer weten over deze functie? Bel dan Marjolein van Amstel via 06-278986950 In verband met de AVG wetgeving accepteren we alleen sollicitaties via onze website. Contribute and coordinate the design, development, and deployment of sophisticated BI solutions. Integrate with the developed solutions to the BNP Paribas CIB ecosystem including referential, marketplace and DevSecOps Toolchain. Partnership with business stakeholders along with product owners to analyse complex processes and translate business needs into detailed functional specifications. Preparing comprehensive, high-quality documentation for both end-users and IT Support. Participation in the full rollout lifecycle, from strategic deployment planning to the delivery of user training. Profile & Skills Experience in a Business Analyst role, preferably within a complex corporate or financial environment. Good presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively to audiences of various sizes and levels of seniority. Experience in the design of data visualization products (preferably Power BI, including ability to build of DAX queries) A solid understanding of data architecture concepts, ability to perform complex data analysis and build data processing tools leveraging on AI tools. Strong skills in SQL development on main DB technologies such as SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres. Some experience in development of ETL pipelines and some usage of Python. Strong capability in process analysis, synthesis, and the design of robust support systems. Some knowledge in terms of tools and tech such as Dataiku, Autosys, API and Cloud solutions. Understanding of the Scrum methodology and the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Great interpersonal skills with team player mindset. High on problem-solving skills and attention to detail. items.desc: Taken en verantwoordelijkheden In deze rol ondersteun je de beleidsafdeling bij het uitvoeren en verfijnen van statistische analyses op bodemdata. Je werkt onder meer aan de volgende onderwerpen: Vlaams bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk Het Vlaamse bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk werd in juli 2021 opgestart. Over een periode van 10 jaar worden bodems onder alle landgebruiken bemonsterd, waaronder bodems in waterrijke gebieden, (half-)natuurlijke graslanden en bodems die worden beheerd door overheden, lokale besturen en burgers. Na drie werkjaren is veel data beschikbaar voor verdere statistische analyse. De resultaten moeten op termijn bruikbaar zijn voor LULUCF-rapporteringen en prognoses. Zo kunnen ze helpen onderbouwen of landbouwbodems of bodems in residentieel gebied koolstof opslaan of verliezen. Daarnaast brengen de analyses verbanden tussen verschillende bodemeigenschappen verder in kaart. Digital Soil Mapping Het monitoringnetwerk genereert puntdata over Vlaanderen. Om die data gebiedsdekkend te maken, combineer je puntdata met gebiedsdekkende predictoren via digital soil mapping en random forest. Een historische bodemdataset werd eerder op dezelfde manier verwerkt. Het is de bedoeling om die doorrekening te optimaliseren en af te stemmen op de verwerking van de monitoringdata. Europese Soil Monitoring Law De Europese Soil Monitoring Law is momenteel in onderhandeling. Als de wet wordt aangenomen, moet Vlaanderen verschillende aspecten van de monitoring van bodemdata statistisch uitklaren. Het gaat onder meer om het aantal monitoringplots, verbanden tussen verschillende methodes en de nauwkeurigheid, betrouwbaarheid en accuraatheid van de monitoring. Ook moeten monitoringseenheden worden uitgewerkt. Indicatoren en rapportering Je berekent indicatoren voor de opvolging van het Vlaamse bodembeleid en voor de voorbereiding van rapportering over de Europese Soil Monitoring Law. Je past bestaande methodieken toe, stuurt ze bij en werkt nieuwe methodieken uit in samenwerking met beleidsmedewerkers. Daarbij gebruik je statistische analyses, geostatistiek, datakwaliteitscontrole en machine learning. Je optimaliseert ook berekeningsmethoden. Jouw profiel Ervaring met het optimaliseren en tunen van databases en queries. Ervaring met digital soil mapping. Ervaring met het analyseren van datastromen. Ervaring met R. Ervaring met de publieke sector. Ervaring met databanken, in het bijzonder SQL en Oracle. Kennis van geostatistiek. Ervaring met machine learning. Ervaring met rapportering. Ervaring met scripting in Shell, Perl en Python. Vertrouwdheid met het domein bodem. ️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (50%).

items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. Intérêt marqué pour l'IA et ses enjeux de gouvernance, de maîtrise et de conformité. Aisance pour animer des ateliers, des communautés et des instances de gouvernance. Excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Curiosité, pragmatisme et sens du collectif. Ce poste ne sera malheureusement pas pour vous cette fois-ci si : vous n'avez aucune expérience en audit, contrôle, gestion des risques, conformité ou gouvernance des données ; Vous ne connaissez pas les principes BCBS239 vous recherchez un poste purement technique de développement ou de data engineering ; vous n'êtes pas à l'aise pour animer des communautés, présenter en comité et embarquer des interlocuteurs variés ; la Data et l'IA ne suscitent pas chez vous une vraie curiosité. 🎯 Ce qui fera la différence Votre capacité à relier les enjeux métiers, technologiques, réglementaires et de maîtrise des risques. Votre goût du challenge constructif, qui fait avancer les dispositifs sans bloquer les projets. Votre pédagogie pour rendre la Data et l'IA accessibles à tous. Une pratique de Python, SQL ou d'un outil …
