items.desc: The Opportunity Lumai is moving from optical-compute research into production AI systems, and the architecture and compiler decisions that shape the product are being made now, ahead of the silicon that will confirm them. This hire builds the modelling capability those decisions rest on. The Role You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai's photonic AI hardware performs against real inference workloads, giving the architecture and compiler teams one shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across device configurations. You will model the compute engines, interconnect, memory and bridge interfaces; keep the model honest by characterising operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results; and turn what the model says into decisions teams act on. What is genuinely hard about this is balancing speed, fidelity and usability. The model has to capture concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency in enough detail to support real architecture decisions, and still compare configurations in minutes rather than overnight. The gap between what the model predicts and what the hardware does has to be measured rather than assumed, and closing it is the part that never stops. By month six, you will have a reliable modelling flow for priority workloads and device configurations, a demonstrated path for closing the gap between model and hardware, and a simulator the architecture and compiler teams use to make decisions rather than a side artefact. You will report to the Head of Architecture or the VP of Engineering, and may build a small team around the capability. What You'll Do Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships. Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations. Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results. Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows. Analyse simulation traces with the architecture and compiler teams to improve layer-to-hardware mappings and resolve performance discrepancies. Run industry benchmarks and representative models - UL Procyon, Geekbench AI, Stable Diffusion and contemporary LLMs - to produce decision-ready KPIs. Develop block-level power models and validate worst-case power scenarios with the micro-architecture, verification and physical-design teams. Own the CI/CD pipelines and simulation flows that keep results reliable and reproducible as usage scales. Translate modelling findings into architecture and compiler decisions, setting technical direction and developing engineers or interns as the team grows. What We're Looking For Must-have Proven experience building or substantially extending a hardware/software performance modelling or simulation framework for AI/ML accelerators, ideally in Python. Strong understanding of hardware concurrency, event-driven modelling and AI inference accelerator micro-architecture: compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect and dataflow. Hands-on experience characterising AI operators and correlating model predictions with real hardware or hardware-accurate reference data. Familiarity with compiler internals and intermediate representations such as MLIR, including tooling that consumes compiler output to drive simulation. Strong software engineering and technical leadership practice: framework design, CI/CD ownership, and direction or review of junior engineers' or interns' work. Strong preference for Direct experience with NPU, GPU or other edge or client AI inference accelerator architectures. Experience across multiple compiler toolchains, reconciling architecture-level and production compiler behaviour. Exposure to power modelling, RTL, emulation, FPGA prototyping, photonic compute or another non-traditional compute architecture. About Lumai Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics. In April 2026 we launched the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time. Our first optical computing server is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford. Why Lumai You'll work …

items.desc: Job Description 🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers. Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. Aikido builds developer-first security products that reduce real risk without getting in the way of shipping software. We focus on what actually matters and automate the rest. We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place. Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. Build things that matter. Our AI Pentest is one of the best out there, and it has to scale to thousands of agents running at once. As our Full Stack Developer, AI Pentest, you’ll own have massive impact and ownership, working on something that has truly disrupted the market. Responsibilities Write Python, TypeScript, PHP and Vue across the entire stack Own AWS, LLM deployment, the API and the pentest agents Scale the architecture to thousands of simultaneous agents Turn customer feature requests around fast Ship small iterative changes to prod the moment they’re ready Job Requirements Really comfortable in a very entrepreneurial environment Can think along with architectural and impactful decisions Willing to learn new languages when the product requires it Comfortable researching and tackling hard problems and algorithms (eg parsing with ASTs) Willing to experiment (and also willing to perhaps throw away some code) Medior to Senior: We are going fast and need experienced people that can hit the ground running with us. You need to be comfortable with the above mentioned languages and tech-stack. No stranger to implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests Fluent in English Candidates must be located in or able to work within CEST timezone. What you can expect Short decision lines. Big ownership. Shape the projects that matter and ship fast. Grow as fast as we do. Take on more, own more, and carve out your own path. Top-tier tech pay and equity. High trust, strong values, zero corporate BS. Flexibility in working hours. A company that sticks to its values in an open and informal atmosphere. We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office How you can make a difference to our business? Join Thermo Fisher Scientific in Eindhoven, where your work will have a global impact. You will collaborate with an ambitious team to develop world-class customer solutions for our Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) portfolio, working within the applications development team and closely with product management, engineering, and R&D. During this six-month internship, you will develop an autonomous-lab concept for our Phenom XL Desktop SEM. The core assignment is to create an autoloader that can load a sample holder into the electron microscope. This base assignment is designed to stand on its own. If you complete the core work and want to take the concept further, you can choose one or more optional stretch assignments. These can be completed separately or combined, depending on the agreed scope and available time. You will learn how to understand laboratory workflows and customer application needs, translate them into practical requirements, and communicate a technical concept to a multidisciplinary team. If you are curious about microscopy, automation, and solving challenging technical problems, this internship will help you build on your existing skills and develop new ones. What will you be doing? Core assignment Learn about the electron microscope workflow, sample handling, and the constraints that matter when loading a sample into the instrument. Describe the requirements and workflow for an autoloader concept that can load a sample holder into the electron microscope. Develop and document the concept, including its main components, interfaces, assumptions, and important design trade-offs. Present your concept and recommendations to colleagues in applications, product management, and R&D. Optional stretch assignments After the core assignment is on track, you may take on one or more of these additional topics: Competitive analysis and product USPs: research relevant markets and high-growth verticals, compare automation or microscopy solutions, identify customer-facing differentiators and unique selling propositions, and explain where the proposed concept could add value. Sample handling and preparation: explore how samples could be prepared, identified, transferred, and presented to the instrument as part of an automated workflow. Multimodal techniques: develop a workflow concept that combines SEM with an optical microscope or another complementary technique, including how samples and information could move between steps. Electron microscope UI and automated software integration: explore how the autoloader could be configured, started, monitored, and integrated with the electron microscope user interface or a wider automated-lab workflow. Translate user and system needs into functional requirements, map key workflow states and information exchange, and consider notifications, errors, and recovery. Develop interface mock-ups or a software workflow proof of concept, depending on scope and available tools. Document the interfaces, assumptions, and limitations, then present the concept to the project team. The Experience We Are Looking For You bring relevant coursework or project experience in at least one area of the assignment. You do not need experience across every area; the optional stretch assignments can be matched to your interests and background. Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, materials science, physics, computer science, software engineering, or a related field. Available for a six-month internship. Relevant Coursework And Experience Interest in laboratory automation, robotics, scanning electron microscopy, or microscopy workflows. Hands-on SEM experience is useful, but not required. Relevant coursework or project experience in software development or scripting, automation software, UI/UX design, human-computer interaction, or system integration is useful for the UI and workflow stretch assignment. Relevant coursework or project experience in CAD, mechanical design, robotics, controls, or systems engineering is useful for the autoloader assignment. Coursework or experience in sample preparation, materials science, optical microscopy, or market and competitor analysis can support the optional stretch assignments. Internship details Duration: six months. Location: Eindhoven, The Netherlands. The specific stretch topics and deliverables will be agreed with the intern and supervisor. Apply today!

items.desc: Advocaat-stagiair Data (Protection), AI & Tech Standplaats Den Haag · 32 tot 40 uur · € 3.500 tot € 4.500 bij 40 uur Over Lawrence Lawrence is een advocatenkantoor gespecialiseerd in Data (Protection), AI & Tech. We zetten onze kennis in waar het er echt toe doet: van de AI-transitie tot de energie- en duurzaamheidstransitie, van digitale veiligheid en weerbaarheid tot de digitalisering van de zorg en de data-economie en online platforms. Complexe EU-data- en techwetgeving is voor veel organisaties een rem op innovatie. Voor ons is dat het startpunt van strategisch advies. Wat de vraag ook is: we willen begrijpen hoe het product en de techniek onder de motorkap werkt. Alleen zo zorgt juridisch advies voor daadwerkelijke versnelling in de praktijk. Die focus werkt. In januari 2026 waren we met z’n tweeën. Binnen drie maanden na onze start noteerde The Legal 500 ons als Firm to Watch in Data Protection & Data Privacy. Na zes maanden zijn we met vijf, hebben we een partnership met Hunt & Hackett en ging kantoor Eindhoven open. We zoeken nu een advocaat-stagiair die inhoudelijk excelleert en actief met ons meewerkt aan die groei. Wat je gaat doen Je adviseert bijvoorbeeld innovatieve softwareleveranciers, platforms en datagedreven organisaties over strategische AI, data- en tech-vraagstukken. Je bent inhoudelijk regisseur van je eigen dossiers. Concreet houd je je bezig met: • AI- en tech-implementaties: je begeleidt AI Act-trajecten bij bedrijven die nog moeten uitzoeken of ze provider of deployer zijn, en je vertaalt de Data Act, DORA, NIS2 en DSA naar praktische kaders. • Privacy en compliance in de praktijk: je stelt DPIA’s en legitimate interest assessments op waarvan de uitkomst echt richting geeft, en je zet AVG-implementaties neer in weken in plaats van maanden. • Transacties en incidentrespons: bij overnames doe je Legal Data Due Diligence, waarmee we verschillende Corporate / M&A teams ondersteunen. Gaat het bij een cliënt toch mis, dan sta je samen met Hunt & Hackett klaar voor incidentrespons. • Externe rollen en internationaal: je treedt op als externe FG of product counsel en begeleidt trajecten voor cliënten met vestigingen buiten de EU. Waar het kan, zit je bij de cliënt in huis. Hoe zwaar dit meeweegt, bepalen we samen op basis van je voorkeur. • Productontwikkeling en innovatie: je bouwt mee aan eigen proposities, fast-track implementaties en interne tools, waaronder onze eigen AI-agent. Ook hier geldt: het accent hangt af van waar jouw energie ligt. Wie we zoeken • Je durft te experimenteren en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen; • Aantoonbare interesse in technologie en recht; • Bereid om een stap harder te zetten als het nodig is (geen 9-5 mentaliteit); • Je bent enthousiast, leergierig en positief ingesteld! Wat wij bieden • Salaris en voorwaarden: conform ons salarishuis € 3.500 (1e jaar) tot € 4.500 bruto (3e jaar) per maand bij 40 uur, plus vakantiegeld, een pensioenregeling, onbeperkte vakantiedagen en een bonusregeling. • De creatieve woensdagochtend: wekelijks ongeveer tien procent van je tijd, niet declarabel, om inhoudelijk te verdiepen, te experimenteren en nieuwe proposities of tools te ontwikkelen. Hoe we werken Op vrijdag reflecteren we samen: wat hebben we geleerd, wat kan beter. Op woensdag experimenteren we en bouwen we aan nieuwe ideeën en producten. Wie vastloopt, krijgt niet alleen de vraag wat er aan de hand is, maar vooral hoe we het samen kunnen oplossen. We zijn een team zonder hiërarchisch gedrag, maar met een duidelijke visie. Lawrence is één kantoor, ook als we groeien. Vaste kantoorruimtes in Den Haag en Eindhoven en vanaf 2027 in Amsterdam: drie volwaardige vestigingen die even zwaar tellen. Vanaf 2029 kijken we over de grens. We doen jaarlijks dingen die een kantoor van onze omvang niet 'hoort' te doen. We houden namelijk van “bold moves”. Wie hier begint bouwt daaraan mee, want bij ons geldt: stilstand leert niets, actie wel. Interesse? Stuur een mail of een bericht op LinkedIn naar Jeroen van Woezik (jeroen@lawrence-advocaten.nl). We zijn vooral benieuwd naar jouw visie: welke creatieve ideeën heb jij om mee te bouwen aan Lawrence? Het proces verloopt snel en persoonlijk: 1. Eerste kennismakingsgesprek met Jeroen. 2. Inhoudelijk sparren met Frederick en Robert-Guillaume en direct daarna een kennismaking met Myrthe of Arvin. 3. Bij een wederzijdse klik doen we je binnen twee weken een concreet voorstel. Lawrence, de juridische partner voor Data Protection, AI & Tech.

Du erkennst Automatisierungspotenziale, bewertest deren Nutzen und begleitest Fachbereiche bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse. Du arbeitest eng mit Business, IT, Governance und Architektur zusammen und bringst deine Ideen aktiv in den Ausbau unserer unternehmensweiten Automation- & AI-Plattform ein. Zudem beobachtest du neue Technologien und prüfst kontinuierlich, wie KI, Agentensysteme und moderne Automatisierungsansätze einen echten Mehrwert für unsere Versicherung schaffen können. Du baust selbständig Assistenzfunktionen für unsere Aufgaben auf und entwickelst Self-Learning-Prozesse, mit dem Ziel einer zukunftsfähigen Automatisierungs-Roadmap. Mit uns arbeitest du gemeinsam an der Zukunft der ADAC-Versicherung, an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischer Prozessautomatisierung und Generativer KI. Deine Rolle hat echten Impact auf Effizienz, Qualität und Kundenerlebnis. Kurz gesagt: Eine Rolle für technikaffine Gestalter, die eigenständig mit neuen Technologien arbeiten, sie beherrschen – und gleichzeitig aktiv die nächste Generation intelligenter, KI-gestützter Prozessautomatisierung vorantreiben wollen Wir bieten Attraktive Vergütung Beim ADAC findet u. a. der Tarifvertrag für die private Versicherungswirtschaft Anwendung. Außerdem werden besondere Qualifikationen, Berufserfahrung sowie die individuelle Leistung honoriert. Hybrides Arbeiten Je nach Tätigkeit kannst du bis zu 50 % deiner Arbeitszeit ortsunabhängig in Deutschland gestalten. Damit kombinieren wir die Vorteile von mobilem Arbeiten mit der Stärke der Präsenz im Büro. Physische Treffen, kreative Teamarbeit und spontane Kommunikation bleiben essenziell, während die mobile Arbeit Flexibilität und Zeitersparnis bietet. Flexible Arbeitszeiten Manchmal ist es schwierig, Privates und Beruf unter einen Hut zu bekommen. Mit unseren individuellen Arbeitszeit- und Schichtmodellen meisterst du diese Herausforderung. In Bereichen, in denen es möglich ist, arbeiten wir in Gleitzeit ohne Kernarbeitszeit. Mit dem Ticket ABO JOB haben wir ein Ticket, welches speziell für Unternehmen entwickelt wurde und dir besondere Ermäßigungen im öffentlichen Personenverkehr bietet. Denn ein kurzer Arbeitsweg lässt dir einfach mehr Zeit für Familie und Freizeit. Das ist nur eine kleine Auswahl der Vorteile, die wir unseren Mitarbeitenden bieten. items.desc: About Refractal Refractal is an AI security company building the infrastructure organisations need to defend against autonomous AI threats. 2026 has shown that generally capable intelligence is here. The challenge now is modernising security to stop AI-enabled threats, whether they come from internal agents going rogue or from attackers using AI to become more dangerous. Refractal was founded on cybersecurity and AI expertise from MIT, Microsoft, NASA and the U.S. Navy. Our product lets organisations detect AI-enabled threats at low cost without sacrificing detection quality. We take a practical approach to AI risk, combining proven cybersecurity methods with frontier AI security research. Today, we work with governments and organisations that can't afford to get security wrong. We're backed by leading deep-tech and cybersecurity investors and are growing the team to deliver on this mission. The role You'll test how deployed AI systems and agents fail under adversarial pressure. You'll run authorised, controlled security assessments, show what each finding means in practice, and work with our engineering and research teams to turn findings into stronger defences and repeatable tests. What you'll do Design and execute assessments of AI applications and agents, grounded in realistic attacker goals and clearly defined test scope. Test realistic threats such as indirect prompt injection, misuse of connected tools, sensitive data exposure and attempts to cross permission boundaries. Build reproducible test cases and small testing tools that demonstrate security impact and distinguish reliable failures from one-off outputs. Analyse how model behaviour, application design, identity and permissions combine to create vulnerabilities. Document findings, recommend practical mitigations and retest fixes with the engineers responsible for the affected systems. Success in your first six months You've established a repeatable assessment approach that connects realistic adversaries, test scenarios and security outcomes. You've produced actionable findings with reproducible evidence and helped validate the resulting fixes. You've built a growing set of regression tests that captures recurring failure modes and checks whether fixes hold. About you: essential Hands-on experience in offensive security, application security testing or adversarial testing of AI systems. A solid understanding of web applications, APIs, authentication, authorisation and common security failure modes. An understanding of how AI applications use prompts, retrieved information, memory and connected tools, and where trust boundaries arise. The ability to write code that automates testing, reproduces findings and inspects application behaviour. Good judgement around test scope and sensitive data, and the ability to explain technical findings in terms of practical impact. Nice to have Experience assessing LLM applications, agent workflows or systems that retrieve external content. Experience building security evaluation suites or testing proposed mitigations systematically. Experience combining application testing with cloud, identity or infrastructure security assessment. Our values Radical transparency. We believe the best work happens when everyone feels able to give and receive honest, constructive feedback. Public service. We see AI security as a form of public service. Getting the AI transition right means putting the right infrastructure in place to manage the threats that come with it, and our work helps protect the institutions and services society depends on. Fail fast. We test ideas early, seek feedback and learn quickly. We experiment rapidly and change course when something isn't working, without compromising on security. Pragmatism, not dogmatism. We choose approaches based on how well they solve the problem. That means combining established cybersecurity methods with frontier AI research, questioning our assumptions, and changing our minds when the evidence changes. Compensation And Benefits Salary: £65,000–£125,000 Competitive equity to share in Refractal's growth Pension contribution Private medical and dental cover Visa and relocation support Compensation Range: £65K - £125K

Lieu : Valence, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à Valence, vous intégrez le centre de gravité mondial de nos activités avioniques hélicoptères. Il abrite également nos activités de services numériques. 
 Au sein du Centre de Compétences Systèmes Aéronautiques et Spécialités de la division Avionique de Vol (FLX), le poste est rattaché au département « Traitement du signal et Automatique ».
 Le département est en charge de la maitrise fonctionnelle des produits du type "capteurs de navigation" : on parle ici de capteurs (accéléromètres, gyromètres), de centrales de navigation (IRS) et de récepteurs GNSS (GPS, GALILEO, etc.).
 Ces produits offrent d'importantes perspectives de croissance, tirées notamment par :
 - La nécessité d'offrir aux aéronefs d'aujourd'hui et de demain des équipements embarqués toujours plus fiables, robustes et sécurisées, même dans des environnements complexes et contraints
 - L'orientation du marché vers des équipements plus compacts, plus digitaux, et dotés de fonctionnalités intelligentes, qui mènent à repenser les architectures matérielles et logicielles ainsi que les méthodes de conception.
 Intégré(e) à une équipe expérimentée et pluridisciplinaire, dont le mot d'ordre est la maîtrise technique des produits, vous participerez aux études fonctionnelles et au développement des équipements qui constituent le socle de nos solutions dans le domaine de la Navigation et ses capteurs de haute technologie.
 Le poste est basé à Valence (26), avec un travail en lien étroit avec les équipes réparties sur plusieurs sites (Valence, Châtellerault, Vendôme). Cette organisation implique des interfaces régulières, en présentiel (déplacements ponctuels) ou en distanciel, entre les différentes équipes.
 Le poste offre une flexibilité en matière de télétravail, permettant au candidat de travailler à distance selon un accord établi avec l’équipe projet et le responsable du département.
 Intégré à nos projets de développement, vos missions seront principalement axées sur la maturité technique des produits CAPTEURS :
 1) Vous participez à la définition, à la conception, ainsi qu’à la réalisation d’études et de simulations dans des domaines tels que la navigation inertielle, le GNSS, ou encore l’antibrouillage.
 2) Vous établissez les dossiers justificatifs des conceptions des produits attestant de la tenue « prédictive » des performances des produits (par analyse et/ou simulations rigoureuses).
 3) Par votre maîtrise technique, vous êtes l'interlocuteur privilégié des ingénieurs produits, électroniques et logiciels. A ce titre, vous les accompagnez tout au long des phases de mise au point, d’intégration continue, de vérification des performances ainsi que dans les conduites des Analyses de Causes Racines (RCA).
 4) Vous communiquez régulièrement sur l’avancement des projets, identifiez les risques et proposez les actions correctives nécessaires.
 5) Vous contribuez activement au développement des compétences en «Traitement du signal et Automatique» en participant à l’amélioration continue des pratiques et à l’enrichissement des savoir-faire de l’équipe. L’esprit d’initiative et l’engagement sont des qualités essentielles pour réussir dans ce poste.
 Pour exercer ces missions, vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les pairs du domaine présents au sein du service qui vous permettront d'acquérir progressivement votre autonomie sur les designs confiés.

 Vous disposez d’une expérience préalable d'au moins 3 ans avec de solides compétences en navigation inertielle, fusion de données capteurs, traitement du signal (GNSS, radar), automatique, asservissements ? $

items.desc:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
 The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 
 Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
 The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 
 About Iso 
 Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
 Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
 We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
 Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
 Your Impact 
 You will join our newly formed Scheduling team to own and extend the systems that orchestrate compute allocation to complex machine learning workloads running on Kubernetes. You will be responsible for optimizing our compute footprint, ensuring that dynamic batch inference and large-scale training runs are scheduled reliably and efficiently.
 We are looking for an engineer who operates comfortably at the intersection of distributed systems and modern ML infrastructure. You will design systems that support large-scale, topology-sensitive workloads, optimize batch queuing frameworks and write custom Kubernetes controllers. Your work will directly determine our ability to maximize hardware utilization and accelerate the pace of AI-driven drug discovery.
 What you will do 
 Own the Scheduling Layer: Design, operate, and extend ML workload scheduling systems to handle dynamic batch inference and long-running training workloads.

 Partner with Research: Collaborate directly with ML researchers and the broader Infrastructure team to understand workload behavior, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and turn research requirements into platform capabilities.
 Ensure Reliability: Build systems with clear failure semantics. Participate in the operational lifecycle of the scheduling ecosystem, designing robust processes, runbooks, and SLOs to maintain high availability.
 Build Custom Infrastructure: Build and maintain custom Kubernetes controllers, operators, and CRDs that adapt the cluster orchestration layer to the specific requirements of our ML pipelines.

 Scheduling Frameworks: Practical experience building or operating cluster schedulers, batch systems, or queuing frameworks (e.g., Kueue, Volcano, Slurm).
 Deep Kubernetes Expertise: Deep, hands-on Kubernetes experience, moving beyond standard usage to write and maintain custom K8s controllers, operators, or interacting directly with cluster orchestration APIs. Strong familiarity with K8s scheduler.
 Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Strong practical experience with cloud providers, focusing on compute provisioning, networking, and Infrastructure as Code to build scalable foundational environments.
 Adaptability: A solid foundation in DevOps/SRE best practices, with the ability to adapt these principles to the dynamic nature of AI accelerator infrastructure.

items.desc:
Join our Team
 Shape the future of sensing and wireless communication 
 What if the next generation of mobile networks could do more than connect people and devices? What if they could also sense, interpret, and understand the world around them?
At Ericsson, we are turning that vision into reality through Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) research. Join us as a researcher and help develop the sensing and tracking technologies that will influence future 5G and 6G radio networks.
 About the Opportunity 
You will join the AI & Technology Foresight unit within Business Area Networks. We explore what comes next across Ericsson’s full technology portfolio—from antennas and radio systems to cloud, and turn promising ideas into real-world solutions. We are a community of nearly 400 researchers based across our main sites in Kista, Lund, and Paris. Our strength is the breadth of expertise we bring together: the capabilities to research, prototype, and build state-of-the-art mobile networks.
Within this environment, you will collaborate with experienced researchers and product teams to prove new concepts, challenge established thinking, and help set the direction for future radio network products. You will be part of Ericsson’s Integrated Sensing and Communication research program, where we research, develop, and validate advanced ISAC systems for 5G and 6G. You will work with one of the world’s most experienced teams in this field, contributing to research that connects theory, experimentation, and product development. Your work will focus on radar sensing, signal processing, and tracking in challenging environments; including dense urban areas and complex sea-clutter scenarios.
 What you will do 
• Conduct research in radar sensing, signal processing, detection, and tracking algorithms.
• Develop simulations and generate data for synthetic use cases focused on urban environments.
• Investigate methods for robust radar sensing and tracking in challenging urban scenarios.
• Explore extended-object radar trackers suitable for dense urban environments.
• Develop algorithms for tracking sea objects in the presence of dense sea clutter.
• Collaborate with product teams to integrate research results into Ericsson products in an efficient and optimized way.
• Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in sensing design and wireless communication.
• Generate intellectual property in the ISAC area.
• Share knowledge and communicate results with stakeholders across research and product development.
 Skills you bring 
 • A recently completed PhD, or equivalent research experience, focused on radar detection pipelines, signal processing, or related fields.
• Strong understanding of radar sensing and the characteristics of different sensors, including sensor artefacts such as phase noise.
• Practical experience working with environmental clutter, with hands-on knowledge of sea clutter considered essential.
• Working knowledge of data fusion and end-to-end tracking pipelines.
• Experience developing and evaluating both point-object and extended-object tracking algorithms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical research to practical prototypes and product solutions.
• A passion for innovation, curiosity to explore new approaches, and the confidence to turn ideas into demonstrable results.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the personal drive to challenge ideas respectfully, work across diverse teams, and deliver results.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. items.desc:
Your contribution to something big: 
You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on the development and optimization of heat pump systems. You will combine machine learning, data analysis, modelling, and experimental testing to develop predictive models based on experimental and field data, supporting the characterization and optimization of key parameters of the heat pump refrigeration cycle. Your main responsibilities will be: 
 Machine Learning Development: Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models using experimental and field data from heat pump systems. 
 Data Analysis & Modelling: Analyse data, model and simulate dynamic systems, and develop numerical approaches to address complex engineering problems. 
 Heat Pump Optimization: Support the development and optimization of refrigeration cycles and heat pump systems using data-driven and model-based approaches. 
 Predictive Models: Apply data-based methods to improve model-based concepts and support the analysis and optimization of constrained linear and nonlinear systems. 
 Experimental Testing & Data Acquisition: Define and prepare experimental data acquisition systems, conduct tests, and analyse the resulting data to support model development and engineering decisions. 
 Test Planning: Define and prepare structured test plans to generate high-quality experimental data for predictive model development and improvement. 
 Field Data Analysis: Use available field data to analyse heat pump performance and support the optimization of control parameters. 
 Machine Learning Assessment: Investigate the benefits, limitations, and risks of machine learning models, including their potential to reduce testing effort and support heat pump development.

 Education: University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a comparable technical field. 
 Machine Learning: Good understanding of machine learning models and data-driven engineering methods, with the ability to apply them to engineering problems.

 Modelling & Simulation: Understanding of dynamic systems, numerical modelling, and simulation, with the ability to analyse complex engineering problems using model-based and data-driven approaches. 
 Data Analysis: Experience working with experimental and/or field data, including data processing, analysis, and interpretation. 
 Testing & Experimentation: Understanding of testing methodologies and data acquisition, with the ability to prepare test plans and support experimental activities. 
 Digital Tools: Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Experience with MATLAB and/or Simulink in engineering or laboratory environments. 
 Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-oriented mindset and attention to detail. 
 Working Style: Proactive and responsible, with the ability to independently organize your work, take ownership of assigned activities, and propose solutions. 
 Teamwork & Communication: Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative and Agile environment.

 At a glance 
 Early Careers at Sanofi aren’t just about landing a role – they’re about starting a journey that stretches you from day one. You’ll dive into projects that matter, surrounded by people who challenge, mentor, and inspire you to explore more every step of the way.
Here, you can navigate paths across science, digital, manufacturing, and business – following your curiosity, growing your expertise, and building skills for tomorrow. With AI-powered tools, world-class learning, and a culture rooted in collaboration, we give you the opportunity to develop your expertise and transform our future.
 Back to nav 
 Location: Waterford, Ireland 
 Start Date: 1 September 2027 
 Duration: 24 months | Three 8-month rotations 
 Working Model: on-site 
 Working Hours: Full-time 
 Salary: €41,600 gross per annum
 Assessment Centre: January 2027 | In person, Waterford 
 Your opportunity at Sanofi 
 Ready to turn your academic knowledge into real-world experience? 
 Join Sanofi, a global biopharmaceutical company, through our 24-month Graduate Programme in Waterford . Explore three different functions, gain hands-on industry experience and develop the skills to shape your future career. 
 Our engineers are at the heart of bringing innovative medicines to patients, solving complex challenges and driving continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. This programme offers a unique opportunity to explore different engineering disciplines, contribute to real projects and develop the skills and experience needed to become a future engineering leader. 
 One programme. Three rotations. A world of experience. 
 Why explore just one area when you could experience three? 
 Our structured Graduate Programme takes you through three 8-month rotations , providing exposure to different functions, meaningful projects and opportunities to learn from experienced professionals. 
 Your rotation journey 
 Rotation 1: Engineering | Months 1–8 
 Start your journey in Engineering, where you'll gain an understanding of the technical infrastructure and systems that enable a world-class biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility to operate safely, efficiently and reliably. Working alongside engineering teams, you'll develop practical knowledge of equipment, utilities, maintenance and continuous improvement practices that support the delivery of medicines to patients worldwide. 
 Gain hands-on experience across Engineering functions including Maintenance, Projects and Utilities. 
 Support equipment reliability and preventive maintenance activities, helping to ensure safe and efficient manufacturing operations. 
 Contribute to troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve operational challenges and enhance process performance. 
 Rotation 2: Operations | Months 9–16 
 Build on your engineering foundation by moving into Operations, where you'll gain first-hand experience of biopharmaceutical manufacturing and learn how products are produced in a highly regulated GMP environment. You'll work closely with manufacturing teams to understand the processes, systems and controls that ensure the safe and reliable supply of medicines to patients. 
 Support batch execution and day-to-day manufacturing activities within a GMP-regulated environment. 
 Develop an understanding of manufacturing processes, SOPs, quality requirements and operational excellence principles. 
 Gain exposure to Quality, Supply Chain and other site functions, building an understanding of how different teams collaborate to ensure reliable product delivery. 
 Rotation 3: Engineering Projects & Validation | Months 17–24 
 Complete your graduate journey in Engineering Projects and Validation, where you'll apply the technical and operational knowledge gained throughout the programme while contributing to projects that support site expansion, equipment implementation and regulatory compliance. You'll gain valuable experience managing complex initiatives and ensuring systems and equipment are fit for their intended use in a regulated environment. 
 Support engineering projects from planning through execution, collaborating with internal stakeholders and external vendors to deliver project objectives safely, on time and within scope. 
 Participate in qualification and validation activities, including commissioning, IQ/OQ/PQ execution, documentation review and compliance with GMP requirements. 
 Contribute to continuous improvement, technology implementation and facility enhancement projects while developing project management, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills.

items.desc: Das AIT Austrian Institute of Technology ist Österreichs größte Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) . Unser Ziel ist es, wissenschaftliche Exzellenz in Innovation mit Wirkung zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnerinnen und Partnern entwickeln wir Technologien und Lösungen für eine nachhaltige, resiliente und digitalisierte Zukunft und stärken damit die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und technologische Souveränität Europas. Unsere internationalen Teams verbinden Spitzenforschung mit hoher Umsetzungskompetenz und schaffen messbaren Nutzen für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Die Competence Unit Transformation Governance im Center for Innovation Systems and Policy befasst sich mit aktuellen und zukünftigen Anforderungen an Forschungs- und Innovationssystemen, sowie mit den Handlungsoptionen, die sich hieraus für die Forschungs-, Technologie- und Innovationspolitik und ihre Akteure ergeben. Wir konzentrieren uns einerseits auf Prozesse des Systemwandels („Transformation“) in Bereichen wie KI, Energie und Mobilität und andererseits auf potenziell disruptive Technologien und ihre möglichen Auswirkungen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Digitalisierung und Dekarbonisierung von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Dabei geht es auch um die Stärkung von Akteuren in den Sektoren öffentliche Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Infrastruktur und Wissenschaft. Für den Standort Wien (Giefinggasse, 1210) suchen wir eine:n: Junior Scientist (w/m/d) AI Governance (Teilzeit: 25-30 h / Woche) CENTER FOR INNOVATION SYSTEMS & POLICY Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem interdisziplinären KI Ethik- und Governance Lab an innovationspolitischen Fragestellungen im Kontext der Transformation von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft , insbesondere an Themen der KI Governance. Sie wirken zunächst insbesondere im Kontext der AI:AT AI Factory Austria am Aufbau und an der Umsetzung der AI Governance Sie begleiten gemeinsam mit der AIT AI Taskforce den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung des neuen AIT AI Ethik Boards. Sie arbeiten häufig transdisziplinär mit Kooperationspartner:innen aus Verwaltung, Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Zivilgesellschaft . Im Team werden gemeinsam mit nationalen und internationalen Kooperationspartner:innen Projekte entwickelt und durchgeführt , bei denen qualitative und quantitative Methoden zum Einsatz kommen. Sie erarbeiten Forschungsergebnisse und kommunizieren diese gegenüber Auftraggeber:innen aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Wissenschaft. Sie publizieren die Ergebnisse Ihrer Forschungsarbeiten und Ihrer Arbeit für das AIT AI Ethik Board in wissenschaftlichen und politikorientierten Kanälen sowie in sozialen Medien. Als Ingenious Partner zeichnet Sie aus: Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Soziologie, Politikwissenschaft, STS oder einer verwandten Studienrichtung Auseinandersetzung mit dem Thema KI während oder nach dem Studium Wissen in den Bereichen KI Ethik und KI Governance von Vorteil Methodenausbildung in qualitativen und quantitativen Methoden der empirischen Sozialforschung Interesse an aktuellen forschungs- und innovationspolitischen Fragestellungen mit Relevanz für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Bereitschaft zur inter- und transdisziplinären Arbeit Erste Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit von Vorteil Selbstständige, verlässliche und genaue Arbeitsweise, Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Was Sie erwarten können: Das Bruttojahresgehalt bei Vollzeit (38,5 h / Woche) gemäß Kollektivvertrag beträgt etwa EUR 56.784, -. Das aktuelle Gehalt wird entsprechend Ihren Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen individuell festgelegt. Zu den Highlights unserer Mitarbeiter:innen-Benefits zählen eine Kantine mit Essenszuschuss, Bio-Kaffee, Tee und Obstkörbe, Angebote zur Gesundheitsvorsorge sowie ein Betriebsarzt, eine Pensionskasse, zusätzliche freie Tage für verschiedene Lebensereignisse, Familienbenefits (einschließlich zwei Wochen bezahlter Papawochen und Freizeitförderungen), ein Gutscheinprogramm, Sport-, Kultur- und Teamevents sowie viele weitere Benefits. Darüber hinaus bieten wir Gleitzeitmodelle (inkl. bis zu 50 % Homeoffice), Unterstützung bei Konferenzreisen und Networking sowie individuelle Weiterbildungs und Karriereemöglichkeiten. Am AIT schaffen wir ein inklusives und familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld, das Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt in der Belegschaft sowie in Führungspositionen gezielt ausbaut. Unter anderem setzen wir uns für eine Erhöhung unseres Frauenanteils im Unternehmen ein und freuen uns daher besonders über Bewerbungen von Frauen. items.desc: About the role: Join the Machine Learning department at Quantum Systems and contribute to autonomy and perception functions for our unmanned vehicles across air, land and sea domains. During this 12-month internship, you will work with experienced engineers on practical machine learning projects—from preparing sensor data, training and evaluating cutting-edge supervised models and improving the workflows on the cloud that bring our functions into real systems. Your project focus will depend on your interests, skills, and the team’s priorities. What is your Day to Day Mission: Our machine learning pipeline offers different internship areas of expertise including, but not limited to: Prepare, inspect, and curate datasets from cameras, LiDAR, telemetry, and other sensor sources. Support the development, training, and evaluation of machine learning and computer vision models. Help test and improve models for deployment on resource-constrained embedded systems. Contribute to reproducible training and evaluation workflows, including data and model tracking. Analyze results, document experiments, and share findings with colleagues across machine learning tasks, hardware, testing, and operations. Manage and extend our cloud services to automate and accelerate machine learning development. Develop and integrate AI agents that automate and streamline employee workflows across the development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, monitoring, security, and cost efficiency of our ML infrastructure. What you bring to the team: You are currently studying computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related engineering subject, and are looking for a 12-month internship. You already have practical experience in machine learning and are interested in applying them to real-world systems. You can write Python and have used it for coursework, personal projects, or research. You are curious, analytical, and comfortable learning new tools and working through technical problems with a team. You communicate confidently in English and are able to explain your work and discuss ideas with colleagues. It is a plus if you have: Worked with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch or explored computer vision. Used Git and Linux, or worked with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, or GPU-based training. Handled image, geospatial, LiDAR, or other sensor data, or have an interest in simulation and synthetic data. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. items.desc: Robotics Perception & Localization Engineer “Geef onze AGV’s ogen en een richtingsgevoel.” Bij Mabo Engineering & Automation NV bouwen we aan de logistiek van vandaag en morgen. We ontwikkelen, implementeren en ondersteunen autonome vorkheftrucks (AGV’s en AMR’s) en geautomatiseerde intralogistieke oplossingen die onze klanten helpen om hun logistieke processen slimmer te organiseren. Onze voertuigen navigeren zelfstandig door complexe industriële omgevingen, herkennen hun omgeving en detecteren obstakels om goederen veilig en efficiënt te verplaatsen. Jouw functie: Als Robotics Perception & Localization Engineer bouw je mee aan de intelligentie achter onze autonome voertuigen. Je ontwikkelt geavanceerde algoritmes waarmee onze autonome vorkheftrucks hun omgeving waarnemen, hun eigen positie bepalen en objecten nauwkeurig lokaliseren. Je ontwikkelt jouw technologie niet alleen, je ziet ze ook in actie op echte autonome voertuigen. Jouw werkdag: Ontwikkelt en optimaliseert algoritmes voor Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), map matching en robuuste lokalisatie in dynamische industriële omgevingen; Verwerkt en analyseert 2D/3D-puntenwolken afkomstig van LiDAR- en 3D-sensoren voor mapping, segmentatie, objectherkenning en obstakeldetectie; Combineert informatie van LiDAR, camera's, IMU's, wielencoders en andere sensoren (sensor fusion en state estimation) met technieken zoals Kalman Filters (EKF/UKF) voor een nauwkeurige en betrouwbare positiebepaling; Ontwikkelt algoritmes voor ego pose estimation die continu de positie en oriëntatie van het voertuig bepalen, ook in uitdagende omgevingen met beperkte of veranderende referentiepunten; Ontwikkelt oplossingen voor object pose estimation en load detection om pallets, ladingen en andere objecten te detecteren, herkennen en lokaliseren, zodat onze voertuigen deze autonoom en nauwkeurig kunnen opnemen en afzetten; Ontwikkelt real-time perceptiealgoritmes (obstacle detection en environmental perception) voor het herkennen, classificeren en volgen van statische en dynamische obstakels; Onderzoekt en implementeert AI-, computer vision-, machinelearning- en deep-learningtechnieken om de omgevingswaarneming en autonomie van onze voertuigen verder te verbeteren; Vertaalt complexe algoritmes naar efficiënte, robuuste en performante real-time C++-software die draait op onze voertuigen; Test en valideert algoritmes met simulaties, geregistreerde sensordata en praktijktesten op echte autonome vorkheftrucks; Werkt nauw samen met software-, automation- en mechanical engineers om innovatieve algoritmes te integreren in betrouwbare, industriële toepassingen. Jouw professionele troeven: Master in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence of Engineering, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Sterke programmeervaardigheden in modern C++; kennis van Python is een plus. Ervaring met of grondige kennis van SLAM, localization en sensor fusion. Sterke wiskundige basis in 2D/3D-geometrie, lineaire algebra en probabilistische algoritmes. Affiniteit met LiDAR, 3D-camera’s, IMU’s en andere sensortechnologieën. Ervaring met ROS2, PCL, OpenCV of Eigen is een plus. Kennis van AI en deep learning voor 2D/3D-sensordata is een plus. Ervaring met AGV’s, AMR’s of andere mobiele robots is een plus. Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Jouw werkstijl: Analytisch – je bent een analytisch sterke engineer met een passie voor robotica, wiskunde en softwareontwikkeling. Probleemoplossend – je vindt het uitdagend om complexe problemen op te lossen. Betrouwbaar en kwaliteitsgericht – je ontwikkelt oplossingen die ook buiten een gecontroleerde testomgeving betrouwbaar functioneren. Oplossingsgericht – je houdt rekening met nauwkeurigheid, rekentijd en betrouwbaarheid. Autonoom – je werkt zelfstandig aan je opdrachten. Teamgericht – je functioneert uitstekend binnen een multidisciplinair engineeringteam. Jouw winst: Je komt terecht in een innovatieve en groeiende sector, binnen een technologisch vooruitstrevende onderneming: een hechte, familiale en tegelijk professionele organisatie met korte communicatielijnen. Groei, passie, samenwerking en een aangename werksfeer staan er centraal, en je maakt deel uit van een enthousiast team. Je krijgt een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur, ruimte voor initiatief, technische verdieping en persoonlijke groei, en een uitgebreid opleidingstraject met mogelijkheden tot verdere professionele ontwikkeling. Daarnaast mag je rekenen op een aantrekkelijk salarispakket, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen; Elektronische maaltijdcheques Hospitalisatieverzekering Fietsleasing + fietsvergoeding Een laptop voor professioneel gebruik 6 extra vakantiedagen Bedrijfsfeesten, geschenken en teambuildings Ben je klaar om mee te bouwen? Ben jij gepassioneerd door robotica, autonome systemen en intelligente algoritmes en heb je ervaring met SLAM, 2D/3D-puntenwolken, sensorfusie of computer vision? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar …

items.desc: Data that drives smarter decisions. At Sky, Data Science is central to how we make decisions and connect with customers. Our teams deliver analytics that guide growth strategies, build tools for personalised experiences, and lead experimentation through test-and-learn approaches. As an intern, you’ll learn from industry experts and get support to bring your ideas to life. Impress us, and you could secure a place on our Data Science graduate programme starting in September 2028. What you’ll be doing On our Data Science internship, you’ll work with stakeholders across the business to turn data into insight and action. You’ll learn analytical techniques, apply predictive algorithms, and help deliver meaningful solutions — from building new data products to forecasting customer behaviour or unlocking the value of our content. You’ll join one of our specialist teams in Sky Data: Consumer – Help protect and grow our customer base by enabling smarter decisions and personalised experiences. Content – Optimise how we produce, promote, and position content using viewing data. Product & Operations – Improve internal systems and streamline processes to maximise value and performance. What we’re looking for The one essential requirement is that you're currently studying for an undergraduate degree in any subject, and in your penultimate year. You might be studying maths, statistics, computer science, economics, or physics — or you may have shown your passion for data through personal or university projects. We’re looking for curiosity, drive, and ambition. Skills that will help you thrive: Logical, end-to-end thinking Strong problem-solving, presentation, and IT skills Experience with Python, SQL, R, SAS, or MATLAB Understanding of machine learning (e.g. regression, decision trees, boosting) Enjoy fast-paced, task-focused environments Collaborative and curious about market trends Your application journey Here’s what to expect, step by step: Step 1 – Apply online Tell us a bit about yourself — your details, your degree, and anything else you think we should know (like part-time jobs, volunteering, or cool projects you’ve worked on). Once you hit submit, keep an eye on your inbox (and your junk folder!) — we’ll send you a link to start your digital assessments. Please note, you can only apply to one programme per year. Step 2 – Show us your skills You’ll complete two online assessments designed to help us get to know you better — how you think, what motivates you, and how you might fit into the programme. The coding test includes basic SQL/Python — feel free to use resources during the test. Don’t worry - you’ll get a chance to practice first, and we’ll send you tips to help you feel confident. We understand that you might want to utilise AI to support your preparation for taking the assessments – understanding Sky etc. But we ask that you complete the assessments themselves without the assistance of AI. Want to go a step further? Check out our Preparation Hub — it’s packed with practice exercises, insights into the assessment process, and stories from current grads and apprentices. You’ll even learn more about your values, learning style, and the kind of work that suits you. Step 3 – Virtual Assessment Centre If you make it to the final stage, we’ll invite you to a virtual assessment day. You’ll take part in a range of activities designed to show us how you think, solve problems, and work with others — all while getting a real feel for what it’s like to work in Data at Sky. We'll let you know when to expect a decision once the assessment day has taken place. Need Support? If you need us to make any adjustments to help you complete any stage of your application, let us know when you submit your application and someone from our Early Careers team will get in touch if we need more detail. So why wait? This is your chance to be part of something big. Our internship puts you right at the centre of the action — learning, growing, and helping make the magic of Sky happen every day. No matter your background, interests, or degree subject, there’s space here for your ideas and ambition. A career at Sky is where better begins — and it starts with you. Got questions? We’re here to help. Drop us a line at earlycareers@sky.uk If your application is successful, your offer will depend on passing a Criminal Record Check Application deadline - 15th November 2026. We may close for applications earlier than 15th November due to high volumes, however this programme will not close any earlier than 1st November 2026.

At Novonesis, we are building the next generation of Global Quality Control laboratories. We are looking for a curious and solution-oriented Data Scientist who is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and intelligent solutions. Working at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, automation, and business processes, you will use technologies such as Python, AI, and advanced analytics to optimize workflows, increase transparency, and enable smarter decision-making across our global QC operations. You will join our Digital Tools team as its fourth member and become part of a department of 25+ dedicated colleagues. Your work will span hands-on data engineering, analytics, and solution development as well as stakeholder engagement and strategic transformation initiatives. You will act as a bridge between technology and business needs, helping turn complex data and laboratory challenges into practical solutions that create measurable value. Your key responsibilities in this role Drive digitalization and automation initiatives using technologies such as Python, Databricks, Power BI, machine learning, and RPA. Ensure data integrity, compliance, and traceability across global laboratory systems. Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and compliance experts to develop scalable, value-creating digital solutions. Dans le cadre du projet CARBURE (projet DGA Rapid mené en partenariat avec la société eXO maKina), qui vise l'explicabilité de la prise de décision dans la lutte contre la falsification d'images à partir de réseaux profonds, nous recrutons une ingénieure ou un ingénieur de recherche et développement au sein de notre Département Sciences des Données. En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet et les équipes de recherche partenaires, vous aurez pour mission principale de développer un outil d'accompagnement à l'analyse et à l'explicabilité de la falsification d'images. Vous concevrez une architecture reposant sur des RAGs multimodaux spécialisés (liés à l'interprétation des filtres du logiciel Tungstène) et assurerez leur synthèse dynamique. Vous mettrez également en place un démonstrateur (PoC) autonome fonctionnant hors réseau et valoriserez ces travaux par la rédaction de livrables techniques et de publications scientifiques. Le profil recherché devra être titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 ou équivalent (Master 2 ou diplôme d'Ingénieur) en Informatique, Data Science ou Intelligence Artificielle. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. At Subsea7, we are looking for people who think differently. In turn we will lift you up and encourage you to go further. Onshore or offshore, embark on a journey of opportunities, continuous learning and development. Start your journey with us today. Title: Trainee Engineer - Rigid Pipelines Location: Paris, FR Job Closing Date: 13 nov 2026 Vos responsabilités Le stagiaire sera intégré à l'équipe « Conduites rigides » (Rigid Pipelines) au sein du département « Ingénierie, conception et analyses » (Design & Analyses Engineering) de Subsea 7 GPC (Global Project Centre). Ce département est responsable de l'ingénierie des conduites sous-marines et des systèmes de raccordement pour des projets de construction offshore. Dans les systèmes de conduites sous-marines, il est crucial d'ancrer les extrémités lorsque la dilatation thermique ou le phénomène de « déplacement progressif » (accumulation de déplacements au fil des cycles, ou *pipe walking*) devient trop important. Ces systèmes d'ancrage se composent de fondations fixes ancrées dans le sol, d'un point de connexion sur la conduite, et de chaînes reliant la fondation à ce point de connexion. Les chaînes présentent toujours un certain jeu ; il est donc essentiel de vérifier, après l'installation, que ce jeu se situe bien dans les limites admissibles définies lors de la conception. Les objectifs du stage sont les suivants : Compiler les données relatives au jeu des chaînes issues de projets antérieurs et constituer une base de données regroupant tous les paramètres pertinents. Cela implique l'examen des rapports de conception traitant de l'impact du jeu des chaînes, l'analyse des rapports de relevés effectués en mer après l'installation, ainsi que l'utilisation de logiciels géospatiaux dédiés aux infrastructures sous-marines. Étudier des modèles analytiques permettant d'estimer le jeu des chaînes après installation, en s'appuyant sur les rapports de relevés. Quantifier la précision de cette estimation en tenant compte des diverses tolérances (précision des équipements de mesure, tolérances de fabrication des maillons de chaîne, incertitudes liées à la fabrication des structures). Développer un modèle par éléments finis (EF) sous Abaqus afin de représenter fidèlement les maillons de chaîne et d'évaluer les limites du modèle analytique. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Collecter des données issues de projets passés et constituer une base de données des relevés effectués. Développer un modèle analytique pratique permettant d'estimer le jeu des chaînes. Étudier l'impact des tolérances et rechercher des solutions pour en limiter les effets autant que possible. Élaborer un modèle par éléments finis (EF) pour obtenir une représentation précise du jeu des chaînes. Établir une procédure permettant de vérifier le jeu des chaînes à partir des données de relevés. Documenter la méthodologie et formuler des recommandations en vue de son intégration dans les processus d'ingénierie. Profil recherché Étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou en master, spécialisé(e) en génie mécanique, ingénierie offshore ou modélisation numérique. Esprit analytique, autonomie et approche proactive dans la résolution de problèmes. Compétences en programmation (Python, MATLAB ou équivalent) pour l’automatisation et le traitement de données. Connaissance de l’analyse par éléments finis (par ex. Abaqus, Ansys ou équivalent). Intérêt pour les systèmes offshore, l’analyse de la fatigue et l’intégrité structurelle. items.desc: At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees. Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so. Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us! Role The Analytical Method Development (AMD) team is part of Analytical Development within CMC Product Development. The team develops biochemical and molecular assays that support manufacturing process development, pilot-scale manufacturing and future quality control activities at designated GMP sites. We are looking for a laboratory professional who is genuinely enthusiastic about hands-on experimental work and is motivated to build their expertise in a predominantly lab-based role. The majority of your time will be spent in the laboratory, performing experiments. The remainder of your time will be dedicated to data analysis, interpretation, documentation and discussing results with colleagues. Working alongside scientists and fellow research associates, you will coordinate laboratory activities for multiple projects simultaneously. You will be joining a group of down-to-earth colleagues who value openness, collaboration and a good sense of humour. We work closely together and enjoy supporting one another, while embracing the fact that priorities in drug development can change quickly and no two weeks are exactly the same. We are therefore looking for someone who enjoys a dynamic environment, stays flexible when plans shift, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work. If you enjoy being hands-on in the lab, have a keen eye for detail, and like being part of a supportive team that celebrates successes together, we look forward to receiving your application! Are you interested in developing your skills and gaining valuable experience within an international biotech company? We look forward to receiving your CV and motivation letter. Responsibilities As a Research Associate in AMD , you will join scientists and research associates developing and qualifying new methods, contributing to assay development for one of our clinical candidates. Your work will support our growth ambitions and expanding pipeline of new antibody products. Your responsibilities will include: Working with scientists and research associates to establish new assays and to monitor their performance by proper trending. Conducting experiments, interpreting data and documenting results for assigned studies. Sharing findings with colleagues within the team and across departments. Proactively identifying ways to improve method robustness, efficiency, data quality and scientific relevance, while supporting continuous improvement of team processes. Requirements You are motivated to contribute your current knowledge of molecular biology, protein biochemistry and related techniques to our team. You conduct experiments and document results accurately and precisely. You communicate effectively, take a service-oriented approach and adapt to changing priorities and unexpected workloads. You work well both independently and as part of a team. Specifically, we ask the following of you: You have a BSc (HLO) or MSc degree in a life science-related field and at least one year of relevant hands-on laboratory experience (industry or academia). Knowledge of and experience with some binding assays (ELISA- and SPR-based) and impurity assays (dPCR-, ELISA- and HTRF-based) - primary focus. Knowledge of and experience with at least some biochemical technologies, such as absorbance spectroscopy, capillary electrophoresis (CE-SDS and icIEF) and analytical chromatography (HPLC) - secondary focus, based on priorities. You have basic statistical knowledge (ideally hands-on with GraphPad and/or JMP). You are highly organized and motivated to produce high-quality documentation. You can work on several projects in parallel and adjust priorities appropriately. You are a team player with a proactive attitude and a can-do mentality. You are fluent in English. This is an onsite role in Utrecht. You are currently living in the Netherlands and you are eligible to work in the Netherlands without needing to apply for a permit. items.desc: Data Scientist (BA + Dev BI) ABOUT THE JOB Join our multidisciplinary team as a Data Scientist , driving innovation through a hybrid expertise in Business Analysis and BI Development. We are looking for a problem-solver who can navigate both the boardroom and the codebase, acting as the essential conduit between business objectives and technical execution. In this role, you will go beyond simple reporting to design complex data processing tools and visualization products that empower our organization. Utilizing a powerful tech stack—including SQL, Python, Dataiku, and Cloud solutions—you will oversee the full software development lifecycle (SDLC). From initial requirement gathering and user story elaboration to the deployment of AI-driven analytics, you will play a decisive role in shaping the future of our data landscape. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Position is for a dual role with Business Analyst and Dev BI responsibilities. Preferably with Dev BI background and ability to get closer to the business as a business analyst. Contribute and coordinate the design, development, and deployment of sophisticated BI solutions. Integrate with the developed solutions to the BNP Paribas CIB ecosystem including referential, marketplace and DevSecOps Toolchain. Partnership with business stakeholders along with product owners to analyse complex processes and translate business needs into detailed functional specifications. Contributing to high-level roadmaps categorized by system components and development streams. Elaboration of the Users Stories and presentation to the development and testing teams. Acting as the interface between business stakeholders and the delivery team, presenting functional requirements, and resolving ambiguities to ensure seamless execution. Preparing comprehensive, high-quality documentation for both end-users and IT Support. Participation in the full rollout lifecycle, from strategic deployment planning to the delivery of user training. PROFILE & SKILLS Experience in a Business Analyst role, preferably within a complex corporate or financial environment. Good presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively to audiences of various sizes and levels of seniority. Experience in the design of data visualization products (preferably Power BI, including ability to build of DAX queries) A solid understanding of data architecture concepts, ability to perform complex data analysis and build data processing tools leveraging on AI tools. Strong skills in SQL development on main DB technologies such as SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres. Some experience in development of ETL pipelines and some usage of Python. Strong capability in process analysis, synthesis, and the design of robust support systems. Some knowledge in terms of tools and tech such as Dataiku, Autosys, API and Cloud solutions. Understanding of the Scrum methodology and the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Great interpersonal skills with team player mindset. High on problem-solving skills and attention to detail. WHAT WE OFFER: Hybrid work mode, 50% working from home within a month Equivalent for remote work expenses (120 PLN per month) Stable employment in the international company Fully paid private medical care for employee Pre-paid lunch card Employee Pension Plan Co-financed Multisport Card MyBenefit Cafeteria Platform Life insurance Car parking availability in the office building Trainings and development opportunities Starts on a fixed‑term contract; later possibility to change to permanent. WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS? We are BNP Paribas S.A. (Branch in Poland), a part of BNP Paribas Group with 200years of experience in banking. Since 2008, we are at the heart of Warsaw, and now we are also in Krakow. As Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB), we offer financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients in a number of locations globally. Our Securities Services business line is a multi-asset servicing specialist. We are an exciting, dynamic, and growing operations centre; therefore, we are looking for candidates who are willing to be a vital part of the expansion of BNP Paribas’ operational scope in Poland. It’s our values that drive us forward and are a cornerstone of our business. We rely on our strengths, which include stability, responsibility, expertise, and being a good place to work. READY TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE? If the offer sounds interesting to you - please be invited to apply with your resume in English.
