items.desc: At Product Madness , we create mobile games that bring entertainment to players around the world. Data plays an important role in understanding player needs, improving gaming experiences, and making informed business decisions. Join our collaborative team, where your ideas and expertise will help us explore new opportunities, solve meaningful challenges, and shape the future of mobile gaming. The Role As a Data Scientist at Product Madness, you will use data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modelling to better understand player behaviour, solve business challenges, and improve gaming experiences. You will contribute to projects dedicated to player involvement, retention, and revenue. You will also help develop analytical tools and machine learning solutions that support informed decisions and create more personalised experiences for our players. Working with a variety of datasets, you will take ownership of clearly defined analytical and modelling tasks while learning from experienced data scientists on more complex projects. You will collaborate with game developers, data analysts, product managers, and game operations teams to translate data into meaningful insights and practical improvements. What You'll Do Explore business challenges, develop hypotheses, choose suitable analytical methods, and deliver data-driven solutions with support from experienced colleagues when needed. Develop, test, and improve predictive algorithms and artificial intelligence techniques to improve player experiences, engagement, retention, and revenue. Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, predictive modelling, and simulation to understand player behaviour and business performance. Support A/B testing and experiments by selecting relevant metrics, analysing results, and sharing findings that guide business decisions. Create analytical models, simulations, and tools that help teams make informed decisions and find opportunities for improvement. Prepare, validate, and explore large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that support business goals. Work with senior data scientists, Data Engineering, and MLOps teams to develop and integrate analytical models and machine learning solutions into business processes. Share findings with collaborators, explain key insights and limitations, and offer practical recommendations. Contribute to a supportive team environment by documenting your work, participating in peer reviews, sharing knowledge, and developing your technical skills. What We're Looking For MSc or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or possessing equivalent experience. 1+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or quantitative analytics, with practical experience delivering analytical or modelling projects. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, descriptive analysis, and statistical inference. Practical experience in exploratory data analysis, data preparation, and working with large datasets. Experience developing and evaluating predictive or machine learning models, including regression, classification, or clustering. Understanding of statistical modelling, forecasting, and simulation techniques. Familiarity with hypothesis testing, split testing, and experimental analysis. Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and modelling, including common libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Ability to write SQL queries to extract, join, transform, and aggregate data. Basic understanding of software development practices, including version control, testing, and documentation. Experience using AI assistants to support coding, analysis, and other professional tasks, with appropriate validation of outputs. If you’re passionate about demonstrating data science to create exceptional gaming experiences and are ready to lead data products to success, we want to hear from you. Join Product Madness and contribute to the evolution of mobile gaming! Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. items.desc: Company description: Scandinavian Airlines System SAS Job description: Data Scientist Focused on Revenue Management & Network Optimization At SAS, we're passionate about transforming aviation with cutting-edge technology. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making to create smarter customer experiences and stronger commercial performance. As part of our AI Team, you'll shape the future of air travel by creating innovative, data-driven solutions that maximize revenue. You will work on one of the most challenging and rewarding problems in the industry: finding the right price, for the right customer, at the right time. Your work will ensure that the airline's Revenue Optimization remains scientifically robust, operationally scalable, and commercially impactful, directly shaping how revenue is optimized in a dynamic, competitive marketplace. Your responsibilities will center on turning business challenges into well-defined analytical problems and building end-to-end machine learning solutions that deliver measurable impact. You will design, train, and maintain models that power SAS's revenue optimization, ensuring they are accurate, scalable, and production-ready. A priority will be to deliver dynamic pricing, a groundbreaking shift in how SAS competes in the marketplace. At the same time, we are developing AI-driven revenue optimization at scale, ensuring our models continuously learn, adapt, and evolve with industry dynamics. Your work will help SAS unlock the full potential of AI in airline revenue optimization, making smarter pricing and network decisions a reality today. Challenges You Will Work On Machine Learning & Optimization Techniques Build and deploy algorithms that power revenue and network decisions. Among other solutions, you'll develop demand forecasting, purchase probability, and revenue optimization models, leveraging a broad spectrum of AI methods. From classical ensemble methods to deep learning architectures and reinforcement learning frameworks, you'll select the most effective approach for each complex problem. Operations Research Beyond building models, you'll explore new formulations, test novel algorithms and findings that push the boundaries of airline revenue optimization. You will convert advanced research into production-ready optimization and modeling solutions, collaborating with the Operations Research team to embed novel algorithms into initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. MLOps Leverage end-to-end ML infrastructure to take models from research to production at scale. This includes designing reproducible training and inference pipelines, integrating CI/CD workflows for seamless deployment, and ensuring robust monitoring to detect drift and trigger automated retraining, keeping models stable and accurate in production. To be successful we believe you have Master's Degree or higher with strong mathematics focus (Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Optimization, Computer Science) or related field. At least 3 years of industry experience within the Data Science domain. Proven record of taking on loosely defined problems and translating them into practical applications. Strong mathematical background (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, statistics, optimization). More than 3 years' experience with Python, SQL and popular machine/deep learning libraries. Proficient with statistical and machine learning models (both supervised and unsupervised learning). Well-versed in cloud computing. Prior experience with Azure is a big plus. We believe you share our passion for data and algorithms. You're self-driven, persistent, creative, and curious, with a strong passion for learning. You seek to understand both the big picture and the intricate details that make it up. Like us, you get excited by commercial opportunities and proactively strive to create business value. Additional information Apply by November 16, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early, as the position may be filled before the closing date. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email. This is a full-time position (100%) based at our headquarters in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. We value in-person collaboration, although flexible working arrangements may be available depending on team and business needs. As this role contributes to security-classified systems and business-critical capabilities, a background check will be conducted as part of the final stage of the recruitment process. Please note that applications must be submitted through our careers site, as we are unable to process applications received by email.

items.desc: Job description The AICell Lab (https://aicell.io) in the department of Applied Physics at KTH and Science for Life Laboratory is a new research group funded by the Data-driven Life Science Fellows program. The group, led by Wei Ouyang, focuses on building AI systems for data-driven cell and molecular biology. To expand the team, we are now opening a position for a researcher in privacy-preserving AI for sensitive biomedical data. The researcher will play a key role in developing our platform where AI agents analyse data where it is, so that sensitive data never has to leave the data owner’s environment. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how sensitive data can be shared and used safely in research and healthcare across Europe, and to be part of an enthusiastic and dynamic team. The responsibilities are: Lead research and development of the group’s platform for AI agents and privacy-preserving analysis of sensitive data Represent KTH in EU projects and identify opportunities to use the platform in them Initiate applications for external funding and build collaborations with healthcare, industry and data owners Supervise students and contribute to the supervision of doctoral students in the group Publish research findings in high-quality scientific journals and conferences Qualifications Requirements A doctoral degree in a relevant field such as Physics, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or other life sciences or an equivalent foreign degree. Extensive experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and computational biology Collaborative abilities Independence We are looking for someone who is reliable, collaborative, and communicative. You need to be able to work independently, actively contribute to problem solving, and to help move projects forward. It is commendable if you are well organized and thorough. As an employee at KTH, awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality, is required. Preferred qualifications International postdoctoral experience Training in machine learning, information security or data protection Experience of advanced use of AI agents and workflows built on large language models, e.g. multi-agent systems Experience of EU-funded projects and of working with European research infrastructures Experience in a management or leadership role, e.g. head of a unit or platform in academia, a research infrastructure or other R&D work, with responsibility for operations, budget and external collaborations A record of winning external research or innovation funding in open competition, e.g. a personal research grant or fellowship from a national or international funder Knowledge of regulations for sensitive data, e.g. GDPR and the European Health Data Space (EHDS) Scientific publications in the field Good knowledge of Swedish as is required for the day-to day work. Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills. Join us at KTH KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. items.desc: Om rollen I kundsupportteamet “Klientstöd” utvecklar vi hur människor och AI-assistenter arbetar tillsammans. Vår utgångspunkt är att AI-assistenter är en del av ärendehanteringen och när ett ärende kräver mänsklig bedömning, dialog eller anpassning tar en kollega vid. Rollen kommer att jobba nära kollegornas vardag, där analys, gemensamt lärande och ett bra bemötande hänger ihop. Människors förståelse, inflytande och egenmakt styr hur vi använder tekniken. AI-assistenter ska ingå i hanteringen av alla ärendetyper, med mänsklig medverkan när den behövs för att ge rätt stöd. Som analytiker med inriktning mot AI organiserar och strukturerar du arbetet mellan kundsupportens medarbetare och AI-assistenter för att nå våra gemensamma mål. Det är ett löpande arbete där du formar arbetssätten tillsammans med kollegor, utvecklingsteamet och teamledaren. Det här kommer du att arbeta med Samla in kollegornas frågor, erfarenheter och återkoppling och bearbeta och analysera verksamhets- och ärendedata för att hitta behov och förbättringsmöjligheter. Strukturera och utveckla en gemensam kunskapsbank med tillförlitliga data, rutiner och regelverk som är användbara för både kollegor och AI-assistenter. Stärka teamets gemensamma kompetens genom kunskapsdelning, genomgångar och stödmaterial som gör komplexa frågor lättare att förstå. Granska och förbättra AI-svarens saklighet, förklaringar och bemötande. Undersöka om svaren är begripliga och anpassade till mottagarens kunskapsnivå och behov. Organisera och samordna arbetet mellan medarbetare och AI-assistenter utifrån analys av ärendeflöden, köer och servicenivåer, tillsammans med teamledaren. Omsätta analysens slutsatser i konkreta förbättringar och pröva nya arbetssätt tillsammans med kollegorna. Du arbetar med analys och informationskvalitet, men också med hur svar och arbetssätt hjälper människor att förstå och agera. Det handlar om både vad stödet säger och hur det möter mottagaren. Det här behöver du ha med dig Minst tre års relevant erfarenhet av självständigt analysarbete med verksamhetsdata. Du har själv bearbetat och kvalitetssäkrat underlag, dragit slutsatser och lämnat rekommendationer, inte enbart sammanställt färdiga rapporter. Statistisk grundkompetens: du kan välja, tolka och förstå relevanta mått, jämföra grupper och tidsperioder och förstå databrister. Vana att självständigt bearbeta, kombinera och analysera strukturerade underlag och skapa analysflöden som går att återanvända när nya data tillkommer, exempelvis i Power Query eller motsvarande verktyg. Praktisk erfarenhet av att strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data eller information, hantera exempelvis dubbletter och motstridiga uppgifter och skapa spårbarhet till källan. Erfarenhet av att använda egna analyser som underlag för beslut eller förbättrade arbetssätt. Obehindrad svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har Använt språkmodeller i ett arbetsrelaterat analys-, informations- eller förbättringsarbete och kan beskriva din egen insats, underlaget och hur resultatet kontrollerades. Arbetat med kunskapsbanker eller med att testa och förbättra AI-baserat kunskapsstöd eller AI-flöden. Erfarenhet från eller nära kundservice, support eller operativ ärendehantering. Varit med i en förändringsresa eller ett utvecklingsarbete där nya verktyg, processer eller arbetssätt införts tillsammans med berörda kollegor. Erfarenhet av Power BI eller andra visualiseringsverktyg. Relevant utbildning inom statistik, dataanalys eller närliggande områden. Så tror vi att du arbetar Du är nyfiken på hur människor lär sig och förstår att samma förklaring inte fungerar för alla. Du lyssnar, ställer frågor och anpassar ditt stöd efter mottagarens kunskapsnivå och behov. Du delar gärna kunskap och involverar kollegor när arbetssätt förändras. Vårt uppdrag är utgångspunkten för dina prioriteringar. Du använder data och teknik som verktyg för att skapa bättre stöd, kontrollerar dina slutsatser och uppmärksammar när en effektivisering inte hjälper användarna. Du arbetar metodiskt och är tydlig med vad underlaget faktiskt visar. Hos Frilans Finans Vi gör det möjligt för människor att arbeta uppdragsbaserat och fakturera utan att starta eget företag. Klientstöd hjälper egenanställda i Sverige, Danmark och Norge, och verksamheten satsar även på en plattform för Europa. Vi arbetar enligt TEAL-principer med självstyre och delaktighet. Våra värdeord caretaking, ansvarstagande, möjliggörande och premium tech and knowledge präglar arbetet. items.desc: Build the future with breakthrough tech. At Sky, we’re not just keeping up with technology—we’re shaping it. From AI and data to automation and digital products, our Technology Graduate Programme helps you build skills in the technologies shaping the future. The programme combines an immersive bootcamp with two years of rotational experience, giving you the opportunity to build strong foundations before developing your skills across a range of technology teams and projects. Over two years, you’ll rotate through teams working on cutting-edge projects that power millions of customer experiences. Whether it’s building with software, experimenting with GenAI, or delivering in an agile framework, you’ll gain hands-on experience and support with the tools and technologies that are transforming the industry. You don’t need to choose a specialism right away. This programme is designed to help you explore, grow, and find your path—whether that’s in development, networks, broadcast, cyber, AI, or delivery. We’re looking for curious, motivated people who want to build a career in technology. You don’t need a technical background to apply. What matters most is a genuine interest in technology and the impact it can have on our customers. Over two years, we’ll help you develop into a well-rounded technology professional, giving you insight into how our teams create and deliver great customer experiences across Sky’s products and services. As you gain experience across different technology teams, you’ll discover where your strengths and interests lie and have the opportunity to specialise in the areas that excite you most. What you’ll be doing Technology never stands still, and neither do we. From exploring new ideas to delivering solutions used by millions of customers, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects from concept through to launch. If you enjoy learning, adapting to change, and solving problems, you’ll thrive at Sky. Throughout the programme, you'll rotate across a range of teams and develop a blend of technical, analytical, and delivery skills while gaining exposure to Sky’s wider technology landscape. You could: Build digital products using technologies like AI, cloud platforms, and modern software development tools. Learn about cyber security, threat modelling, and how we protect customers, systems, and data from emerging risks. Explore network technologies across physical, virtual, and broadcast environments. Help shape the future of new technology solutions as a Product Owner or Technical Product Owner. Use machine learning, large language models (LLMs), and generative AI to solve real-world business and customer challenges. From day one, you'll work on real projects with real impact, supported by experienced mentors and surrounded by people who are passionate about technology. By the end of the programme, you'll have the confidence, experience, and specialist skills needed to take the next step in your career at Sky. What we’re looking for The one essential requirement is that you’re currently in the final year of your undergraduate degree, completing a postgraduate qualification, or have already graduated. Your degree can be in any subject. Skills that will help you thrive: You should be able to demonstrate a capability to learn new technical skills quickly Curious about emerging technologies and how they’re changing the world Passionate about solving problems and building smart, scalable solutions Comfortable learning new tools and working in agile teams Excited to explore areas like AI, data, automation, and cloud platforms. Right to work: Please be aware that Sky do not offer sponsorship for this role, employment is contingent on you having a valid right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme. items.desc: The Department of Computer Science invites applications for one-year research assistant positions focused on developing innovative robot control and navigation techniques using simulation-based learning for medical robotic endoscope devices. Project Background This project addresses two critical challenges in the field of medical robotics to improve patient care through advanced simulation and control: Image-Based Navigation: Creating reward functions for scoring navigation policies for medical robotic devices moving inside the human body, relying solely on image information and accounting for environment changes through interaction models. Soft Robot Control: Developing learning-based methods to control a soft robot endoscope via high-level navigation policies to perform clinical procedures inside the human body, including quality assessment of these methods during in-vivo interventions. The successful candidates will join a multidisciplinary and collaborative team renowned for cutting-edge research in medical imaging and simulation technologies, operating within a global network across France, Germany, and Spain. Roles and Responsibilities The successful candidates will play a central role in the project’s technical and scientific success. While the level of autonomy will vary by position, both roles will share the following core responsibilities: Technical Development & Implementation : Designing and implementing machine learning methods for motion planning and control. This includes integrating simulation-based learning frameworks and demonstrating the resulting systems on real robotic hardware and soft robot endoscopes. Research & Scientific Contribution : Contributing to the project’s core objectives by producing impactful research outputs. This includes writing high-quality papers for peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at international conferences. Collaboration & Knowledge Exchange : Facilitating collaborations with industrial partners and academic collaborators to ensure that the developed methodologies are meaningful and translatable to real-world clinical practice. Professional Growth & Mentorship : Engaging in a high-growth research environment. The positions can be extendable and towards a PhD depending on the future funding status. The project has a trackrecord of landing members in top PhD program and faculty positions. Interdisciplinary Integration : Actively participating in team discussions and workshops to integrate expertise across medical imaging, physics simulation, and robotics control. Profile We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies and experience: Essential experience and skills MSc in the fields mentioned above. You have a strong foundation and track record in robotics simulation, robot control, computer vision and/or machine learning for physical systems. You are highgly experienced in numerical optimization algorithms, preferably applied to motion planning or reinforcement learning. Hands-on experience on real robots especially soft robot systems is a plus. Proficient scientific computing and programming (C++/Python) and experience with libraries such as PyTorch, JAX, Warp, Taichi, or ROS. Excellent communication skills and a high level of motivation to work in a multidisciplinary, international research environment. Desireable experience and skills Experience in publishing peer-reviewed research in top-tier robotics or AI venues. Familiarity with physics simulation such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Newton Physics, SOFA etc. Terms of employment The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week. The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 1 year. The starting date is 15 February or after agreement Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years. The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. Questions Further information on the Department is linked at https://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the positions can be made to kenny@di.ku.dk and hayi@di.ku.dk. Application procedure Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. items.desc: Do you thrive in the unknown and love to build from scratch? At JENSEN-GROUP, we offer a unique opportunity to be part of something from the very beginning, helping us build a modern, scalable software platform for the future. You’ll play a key role in shaping the technical direction and helping define the tools and technologies we’ll build on. We also strongly believe that LLMs and AI in general can, and should, play an active role in modern software development, and we’re excited to explore that together with you. Location: Denmark What you’ll be doing: Design and build a distributed data platform running across laundries worldwide Translate business needs and ideas into concrete, working solutions with a short real world feedback loop Contribute to recruiting, onboarding, and growing the future software team Lay the foundation for a healthy engineering culture, including code quality, documentation, and DevOps practices What you’ll bring: A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or similar At least five years of professional experience, covering some of (and interest in most of) the following: Docker, databases, backend development, data analysis & AI, distributed systems, observability, test automation, and CI/CD You work independently, methodically, and know when to ask for help You thrive in an environment where not everything is defined up front and where direction may change as we learn You think long-term in architecture and patterns, but aren’t afraid of temporary solutions when they make sense You contribute hands-on to implementation, both leading the way and backing up the rest of the team You’re driven by curiosity and engagement, and the kind of person who thinks: “If it needs to be built, I’ll learn how” — whether it’s infrastructure, dataflows, or frontend A Danish work permit and proximity to Odense as the team works in-office. Mezcada Mezcada is JENSEN-GROUP’s next-generation software platform for industrial laundries worldwide, a hybrid MES/SCADA system that gives laundries full visibility into performance, bottlenecks, and energy consumption. It provides the data foundation needed to predict maintenance, optimize flow, and make better decisions on the laundry floor. That said, you don’t need experience with industry, SCADA, or MES. In fact, we’re looking for someone who brings a fresh perspective and dares to question the assumptions the rest of us might take for granted. The platform uses distributed edge computing and is continuously delivered to customer sites on-prem, as well as to the cloud for analysis and support. Machine and sensor data is collected via OPC-UA and MQTT and made available through a well-designed API, both to the customer and to the frontend. JENSEN-GROUP & INWATEC — The LAUNDRYNERDS JENSEN-GROUP is a global leader in industrial laundry technology with a strong R&D focus that keeps the company ahead of the curve. The Mezcada team is based at the innovation hub in Odense, together with the subsidiary Inwatec that delivers cutting-edge tech for sorting, automation, and smarter laundry processes. Together, we’re looking forward to moving into beautiful new offices on Hvidkærvej in 2026. We’re a fast-growing engineering company, and our team is creative, dynamic, and deeply dedicated. We love our informal work culture, where every idea is taken seriously, and everyone is treated equally. And yes, we also have fun together: on Fridays, we meet up in the office bar for beers and a game of ping pong amongst many other things. Join us on this exciting journey of innovation and development — where every line of code you write makes a difference. If you are passionate about software engineering and eager to be part of a dynamic team, this opportunity is perfect for you! Let’s build the future of laundry together! Sounds good? What are you waiting for? now at www.inwatec.dk/job. Please upload your documents in PDF format.

items.desc: À propos de nous Premier pôle européen de recherche, de soins et d’enseignement sur les maladies génétiques créé en 2007 au cœur du campus de l’Hôpital Necker-Enfants malades. Sa mission ? Mieux comprendre les maladies génétiques pour mieux les guérir. L’Institut Imagine est un endroit unique au monde qui rassemble chercheurs, patients, médecins et personnels de santé dans une architecture créatrice de synergies au service d’une même ambition : changer la vie des familles touchées par les maladies génétiques. Mission Marie-Louise Frémond, chercheuse dans le laboratoire du Pr Yanick Crow à l'Institut Imagine (Paris) recrute un(e) ingénieur(e) d’étude pour le projet SABLE. Ce projet étudie l'inflammation pulmonaire dans le SAVI et le syndrome COPA à l'aide de modèles cellulaires, notamment des cellules endothéliales et épithéliales pulmonaires dérivées de cellules iPS humaines. https://www.institutimagine.org/fr/yanick-crow-180 Créé à l’initiative des chercheurs et médecins de l’Hôpital Necker, l’Institut des maladies génétiques Imagine (Institut Hospitalo-Universitaire (IHU), INSERM U1163) développe des programmes scientifiques fondés sur une continuité entre recherche fondamentale, recherche clinique et soins innovants sur les maladies génétiques et les prédispositions génétiques aux maladies fréquentes, de l’enfance à l’âge adulte. Imagine est un institut internationalement reconnu qui assure une recherche de haute qualité en termes de formation pluridisciplinaire et de taux de publication. Contexte scientifique : Le laboratoire de neurogénétique et neuroinflammation dirigé par Yanick Crow identifie et étudie les bases moléculaires et cellulaires des interféronopathies de type I, des maladies génétiques caractérisées par une production chronique d’interférons de type I. L’étude de ces maladies a montré que deux d’entre-elles, le SAVI (STING-associated vasculopathy with onset in infancy) et le syndrome COPA présentent une inflammation pulmonaire sévère responsable de fibrose et d’une mortalité élevée. De façon intéressante, le rôle de l'interféron de type I comme médiateur de l'inflammation pulmonaire a été récemment mis en évidence. Dans un travail supervisé par Marie-Louise Frémond, nous avons montré que la protéine COPA, qui est mutée dans le syndrome COPA, a un rôle dans le trafic de la protéine STING au sein du système Golgi – réticulum endoplasmique (Lepelley et al. J Exp Med 2020, PMID: 32725128). Ce lien mécanistique explique le chevauchement clinique et histologique observé entre le SAVI et le syndrome COPA (Frémond & Crow. J Clin Immunol 2021, PMID: 33532887). Cependant, les mécanismes de la fibrose induite par l’inflammation pulmonaire restent inconnus. Au sein de l’équipe, Marie-Louise Frémond (PU-PH, HDR, Université Paris Cité) s’intéresse aux mécanismes de l’inflammation pulmonaire observée dans les interféronopathies de type I. Missions : L'ingénieur(e) d'étude participera au développement et à l'utilisation de modèles cellulaires pulmonaires pour étudier la réponse inflammatoire dans le SAVI et le syndrome COPA. Il/elle travaillera en particulier sur des modèles 2D dérivés d'iPSC humaines (déjà générées), différenciées en cellules endothéliales et épithéliales. Activités principales : Culture et entretien de cellules primaires, de lignées cellulaires et d'iPSC humaines / Constitution et gestion des banques cellulaires ; Différenciation des iPSC en cellules pulmonaires, notamment endothéliales et épithéliales, en modèles 2D (organ-on-a-chip, co-cultures) ; Caractérisation des cellules différenciées et contrôle qualité des différenciations ; Stimulations et traitements cellulaires, y compris l'évaluation de molécules thérapeutiques ; Analyse de la réponse inflammatoire : expression de gènes (extraction d'ARN, RT-qPCR, préparation d'échantillons pour RNAseq bulk), expression protéique (western blot, ELISA, cytométrie en flux) et immunofluorescence et microscopie confocale ; Mise au point et optimisation de protocoles. Activités associées : Analyse, mise en forme et présentation des résultats en réunion d'équipe ; Rédaction et mise à jour des protocoles ; Participation aux tâches communes du laboratoire (par exemple : commandes, gestion des stocks, entretien des équipements) ; Respect des règles d'éthique, d'hygiène et de sécurité de l'Institut Imagine. Marie-Louise Frémond, a researcher in Pr Yanick Crow's laboratory at the Institut Imagine (Paris), is recruiting a research engineer for the SABLE project. The project studies lung inflammation in SAVI and COPA syndrome using cellular models, in particular endothelial and epithelial lung cells derived from human iPSCs. The Institut Imagine (IHU, ‘Institut Hospitalo-Universitaire’, INSERM U1163) is a recent research structure located within Necker Children’s Hospital (Paris). Its research labs are focused on understanding the molecular mechanisms of genetic diseases that affect the adaptive and innate immune systems, the nervous system, stem cell …

items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Institut de biologie de l'Ecole Normale Supérieure Type de Contrat IT en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 75230 PARIS 05 Durée du contrat 6 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration Selon expérience – Entre : 2 571€ et 3 817€ Date limite de candidature : vendredi 27 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Développer des méthodes de traitement et d’analyse des signaux EEG enregistrés pendant l’anesthésie, à partir des enregistrements provenant de Dan Longrois. Étudier les signatures EEG associées à la S-kétamine et les asymétries entre hémisphères droit et gauche. Contribuer au développement d’indicateurs et de modèles pour le suivi et, à terme, le pilotage de l’anesthésie dans un cadre de recherche. L'Activité Structurer les enregistrements EEG et les métadonnées disponibles ; documenter leur qualité et leur synchronisation avec les événements anesthésiques. Développer des chaînes reproductibles de prétraitement : filtrage, détection et correction des artéfacts, segmentation et contrôle qualité. Réaliser des analyses spectrales et temps-fréquence ; caractériser les signatures associées à la S-kétamine selon les informations disponibles sur son administration. Quantifier les asymétries droite–gauche sur des dérivations homologues, en contrôlant les effets du montage, de la référence et des artéfacts. Développer et évaluer des indicateurs de suivi et des prototypes de modèles destinés à la recherche sur le pilotage de l’anesthésie. Documenter le code, assurer la traçabilité des analyses et présenter les résultats à l’équipe scientifique et clinique. Compétences attendues : Traitement du signal, analyse de séries temporelles, statistiques et modélisation numérique. Programmation Python, notamment MNE et les bibliothèques scientifiques ; gestion de versions et analyses reproductibles. Connaissances en EEG, neurosciences et prétraitement des données neurophysiologiques. Apprentissage automatique apprécié ; capacité à évaluer les modèles et leurs limites. Unité mixte ENS-CNRS-INSERM, l’IBENS accueille plus de 300 personnes regroupées en 30 équipes autonomes conduisant une recherche hautement collaborative et multidisciplinaire qui allie approches expérimentales et théoriques. L’activité de recherche couvre des champs thématiques variés : Neurosciences, Biologie du développement, Génomique fonctionnelle, Écologie et biologie de l’évolution. Plusieurs plateformes technologiques, notamment en imagerie, génomique, protéomique et bio-informatique sont à la disposition des chercheurs. Les recherches menées à l’IBENS bénéficient des interactions avec d’autres disciplines présentes à l’ENS (physique, chimie, sciences cognitives, mathématiques). L’IBENS est activement impliqué dans la formation des étudiants et jeunes chercheurs à tous les niveaux. L’équipe d’accueil Mathématiques appliquées et Biologie computationnelle, dirigée par David Holcman comprend une dizaine de d’étudiants et chercheurs tous confondus. L’objectif de l’équipe est de comprendre et de quantifier les mécanismes sous-jacents de la biologie computationnelle. Contraintes et risques Travail sur écran et manipulation de données de santé ; respect de la confidentialité, des autorisations d’accès et des règles de sécurité applicables au projet. Les développements de pilotage seront évalués dans un cadre de recherche ; toute utilisation clinique nécessitera une validation et un cadre adaptés. Déplacements ou présence au bloc : à confirmer. items.desc: About the Role As a Prediction Model Expert, you bring deep expertise in AI forecasting, software development in Python, backed by a dissertation on prediction models or time series forecasting. You have hands-on experience with foundation models for forecasting, multi-modal prediction frameworks (can be across disciplines like medicine), cloud environments. You excel at building production-grade prediction engines that detect anomalies, forecast threats, and power proactive threat detection logic at compute scale. You will be one of Haste's first senior AI researchers pioneering prediction models that anticipate stealthy threats across HPC clusters, AI and quantum workloads before they strike. Key Responsibilities Predictive Model Development & Engineering: Designing, building, and deploying Machine Learning (ML) and Foundation models to forecast potential security breaches. Anomaly Detection & Behavior Analysis: Establishing "normal" baselines and flagging deviations that indicate malicious behaviour together with our security experts and research teams. Threat Intelligence & Forecasting: Analyzing historical data, threat intelligence feeds, to extract and predict future attack trends, emerging vulnerabilities, and malicious campaigns. Vulnerability & Risk Assessment: Scoring and prioritizing security vulnerabilities (e.g., predicting which CVSS vulnerabilities are most likely to be exploited) to guide risk-based view. Data Pipeline Construction: Managing the full lifecycle of data, including gathering, cleaning, and processing vast amounts of diverse data sources like network logs, indicators of compromise, and threat intel. Model Optimization & Maintenance: Continuously refining algorithms, hyperparameter tuning, and adapting models to combat "model drift" as attacker tactics evolve. Collaboration & Communication: Translating complex mathematical models into actionable insights, and producing research reports, white papers, or conference presentations. Why Join Haste? If you’ve ever wanted to build the world’s fastest threat detection and hunting platform for the future of compute, this is the place for you. If you want to build technology that pushes the boundaries of cybersecurity for HPC, AI, and quantum environments, this is where you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career. From detecting AI model poisoning mid-training to hunting quantum side-channel leaks and nation-state IP theft in HPC clusters. Haste mirrors the complexity of high-stakes compute infrastructure—HPC supercomputers, trillion-parameter AI workloads, quantum computers, and enterprise infrastructure—letting security teams detect, hunt, and analyze only relevant threats lightning fast. We are a EU funded, fast-growing cybersecurity startup securing compute for governments, research labs, and Fortune 500 enterprises. Our mission is to secure every compute-intensive workload from AI training to quantum simulations—revolutionizing cyber defense. What It's Like Working With Us Impact from day one: Your work shapes how we protect current and future infrastructure. Top Tier-experts: Join security veterans solving globally unique problems in threat detection for the future of compute. Fully remote, real ownership: We care about results, not clock-in times. Location: Remote (within Europe)

items.desc: About the Role You will be responsible for developing and deploying key autonomy functions within our interceptor platform, focusing on Guidance, Navigation & Target Tracking, or Control. From algorithm development and system integration to flight testing and field debugging, you will help deliver reliable autonomous capabilities in demanding operational environments. What is your Day to Day Mission: Depending on your background and expertise, your primary focus will be in Guidance, Navigation, or Control . You will take ownership of one of these areas while working closely with engineers across the broader GNC stack to deliver a reliable autonomous interceptor system. Guidance: Develop and deploy guidance algorithms that convert mission objectives and estimated vehicle and target states/predictions into feasible control commands. Develop predictive approaches that account for target motion and maneuvers. Navigation & Target Tracking: Develop and integrate state-estimation, sensor-fusion, and target-approaches that provide reliable states and short-horizon predictions, including sensor fusion and uncertainty modeling. Control: Develop and tune flight-control algorithms that translate guidance commands into stable, responsive, and feasible aircraft behavior across the operating envelope. Across all three focus areas, you will: Integration: Integrate algorithms with perception, flight-control, simulation, and operator systems through ROS 2, MAVLink, and related interfaces. Benchmarking and Validation: Validate performance through simulation, recorded-data replay, SITL/HITL, and flight testing. Field Debugging: Analyze real logs, reproduce failures, isolate root causes, and improve the system until it works not only on your machine, but in the field. What You Bring to the Team You’re structured, fast-moving, and a team player. You iterate fast and work with a high degree of autonomy. You love building things that last and analyze and fix root cause problems over applying short-term patches. Degree in robotics, aerospace, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied mathematics, computer vision, or a comparable technical field. Several years of hands-on experience in the field. We also consider relevant experience gained through student clubs, internships, or working-student positions. Strong fundamentals in guidance, control, vehicle kinematics and dynamics, state estimation, optimization, and dynamical systems, with deep expertise in at least one of these areas. Strong implementation skills in C++ or Rust and experience with ROS 2. Good understanding of coordinate frames, quaternions, NED/ENU conventions, timing, and filtering. Experience with interception or predictive guidance, PID or model-based control, trajectory optimization, or model-predictive approaches. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar flight-control ecosystems. Experience with system identification, flight-dynamics modeling, target tracking, or GNSS-denied navigation. Experience with simulation, SITL/HITL, flight-log analysis, structured flight testing, or multi-vehicle autonomy. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Why Join Quantum-Systems? Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation . Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact. Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization. About us: Quantum Systems specializes in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors. How to Apply Please include as your cover letter: A detailed description of your hands-on projects , including photos, GitHub links, and videos, drawings.

items.desc: About the Role As an HPC Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in high-performance computing, software development in C/C++ or Rust/Python, backed by a minimum MSc in HPC, Scientific Computing, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with SLURM, AI workloads, advanced algorithms, parallel computer architectures, Linux, network protocols in high performance computing. You excel at modeling HPC threats— resource exhaustion, lateral movement across compute nodes, Slurm exploits—and translating them into practical security defenses. You will be one of Haste's first HPC security researchers pioneering defenses for supercomputing clusters alongside AI and quantum workloads. Key Responsibilities Investigating Threat Actors & Attack Vectors: Identifying, analyzing, and documenting threats targeting HPC systems and ecosystem trends and developments. Developing Defenses and Mitigations: Designing detection logic and mitigation methods for HPC-specific threats that do not significantly degrade performance. Security Modeling: Developing threat models for HPC infrastructures with Cyber threat intelligence input in adjacent technologies to predict potential attack paths. Developing HPC-Specific Detection Rules: Authoring custom security rules for monitoring tools (e.g., SLURM, PBS) to detect abnormal user behavior, such as suspicious logins, resource usage, and data transfers. Engineering Collaboration - Translating HPC security research into production-grade detection requirements for Haste's threat engine and HPC integration. Documentation & Reporting- Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization, to the public or conferences. Securing Heterogeneous Environments: Designing security for complex, hybrid platforms integrating cloud, AI/ML workflows, and on-premise, bare-metal hardware. Requirements University degree in a relevant field. Current residence in Germany or Austria. Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only. experience with SLURM

 Transform the everyday.

 Was wir dir bieten: 
 Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket 
 30 Tage Urlaub sowie vielfältige, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, die eine Auszeit für dich und deine Familie ermöglichen 
 2 bis 3 Tage pro Woche mobiles Arbeiten als globaler Standard

 Du führst und koordinierst ein interdisziplinäres Team im Fehleranalyse-Labor, förderst die fachliche Weiterentwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden und arbeitest eng im internationalen Labornetzwerk zusammen 
 Darauf aufbauend übernimmst du die technologische Verantwortung für das Labor und entwickelst die zugehörigen Mess- und Analysetechnologien innovativ und strategisch weiter 
 In diesem Rahmen führst du komplexe Fehler- und Schadensanalysen an Bauteilen, Baugruppen und Systemen durch, setzt dabei verschiedene Analyseverfahren gezielt ein und unterstützt dabei die Elektronikfertigung, das Repair-Center sowie Entwicklung und das Component-Engineering und gewährleistest dabei höchste Qualitäts- und Zuverlässigkeitsstandards

 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in Elektronikfertigung, Technologieentwicklung oder Qualitätsmanagement sowie weitreichende Kenntnisse über den Aufbau und die Funktion von Bauteilen für die Elektronikfertigung 
 Idealerweise Sachkundenachweis nach § 5 ChemVerbotsV (z.B. bestandene Zwischenprüfung im Rahmen eines Hochschulstudiums) 
 Du bist versiert in Fehleranalyse, Root-Cause-Methodik, Problemlösung und metallographischen Gefügeanalysen sowie Fraktographie 
 Arbeitsweise: Du zeichnest dich durch strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen, hohe Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeit sowie Freude an interdisziplinärer, globaler Zusammenarbeit aus 
 Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Deshalb schaffen wir ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Person ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit erfährt und in dem individuelle Perspektiven und Erfahrungen geschätzt werden. Unser Engagement für Fairness und Respekt gilt für alle Bewerbenden.

items.desc: Vous rejoignez notre Studio IA , une équipe de trois personnes dont la mission est de transformer la façon dont nos entités travaillent grâce à la data, à l’automatisation et à l’intelligence artificielle. En tant que Junior Business Analyst, vous faites le lien entre le terrain et les solutions digitales. Vous comprenez les besoins des équipes opérationnelles, vous les traduisez en solutions concrètes (outils, automatisations, tableaux de bord, cas d’usage IA) et vous veillez à ce qu’elles soient vraiment adoptées. Vous êtes rattaché au Managing Director et travaillez en transverse dans les entités opérationnelles et les fonctions support. Vous contribuez ainsi à la performance opérationnelle, à la cohérence des pratiques et à la fiabilité des données, dans un environnement industriel structuré. Le Studio IA Le Studio IA est une équipe agile, créée pour accélérer la transformation digitale du groupe. Nous : identifions les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée qui peuvent être automatisées ou assistées par l’IA ; concevons et déployons des outils simples, utiles et adoptés par les équipes ; fédérons et fiabilisons les données dispersées pour mieux piloter l’activité ; testons rapidement, mesurons l’impact et industrialisons ce qui fonctionne. Vous arrivez dans une équipe à taille humaine, où chacun compte, où les idées circulent vite et où vous apprendrez au contact direct des projets. Votre mission Comprendre en profondeur les métiers et les processus opérationnels. Transformer les besoins des équipes en solutions digitales concrètes et pragmatiques. Identifier les opportunités d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA. Contribuer à la fiabilité des données et au pilotage par les KPI. Garantir l’adoption réelle des outils et des nouveaux standards sur le terrain. Vos responsabilités principales 1) Analyse des besoins et des processus Aller sur le terrain, observer et interviewer les utilisateurs pour comprendre leurs pratiques et leurs difficultés. Cartographier les processus existants (as-is) et proposer des processus cibles (to-be). Identifier les écarts entre les processus définis et les pratiques réelles. Rédiger les besoins fonctionnels (user stories, spécifications, critères d’acceptation). 2) Studio IA : automatisation et cas d’usage Détecter, qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage IA et d’automatisation avec les équipes métier. Conception, développement, tests et déploiement des solutions (IA générative, automatisation de tâches, low-code, scripts…). Mesurer les gains obtenus (temps, qualité, fiabilité) et partager les résultats. Assurer une veille sur les outils et les bonnes pratiques IA. 3) Data opérationnelle et pilotage Contribuer à la qualité, à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données opérationnelles. Assurer le suivi et la mise à jour des KPI. Participer au développement et à la maintenance des tableaux de bord (Power BI ou équivalent). Aider la Direction et les équipes à exploiter les données pour la prise de décision. 4) Documentation, déploiement et accompagnement du changement Structurer et maintenir la documentation opérationnelle (intranet, DocLab ou équivalent) : procédures, instructions, modes opératoires. Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des nouveaux outils et processus. Suivre l’adoption sur le terrain et ajuster les solutions selon les retours. Votre profil Diplôme de niveau Master (ingénieur, gestion, business analysis, data, informatique de gestion). Une première expérience (stage, alternance, premier emploi) en contexte industriel ou opérationnel est un plus. Intérêt marqué pour l’IA, l’automatisation et la transformation digitale. Sensibilité à la qualité, à la sécurité ou à l’amélioration continue. Prérequis (must-have) Très bonne maîtrise des outils digitaux et des données : Excel avancé, Power BI ou Tableau. Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse, esprit structuré, pragmatique et orienté solutions. Notions de développement ou d’automatisation (Python, VBA, Power Automate, SQL, low-code…). Aisance relationnelle pour dialoguer aussi bien avec les équipes terrain qu’avec le management. Autonomie, curiosité et rigueur. Usage concret des outils d’IA générative pour automatiser des tâches. Atouts Connaissance des méthodes de modélisation de processus (BPMN) ou des méthodes agiles. Capacité à « vendre » une solution sans l’imposer. Sensibilité aux enjeux QSE/HSE. Notre offre Un rôle à fort impact, au cœur d’une équipe IA naissante, où vous verrez concrètement le résultat de votre travail. Vous aurez une vraie autonomie, sans micro-management, et une vision transverse de l’entreprise. Vous évoluerez dans un domaine en pleine croissance (data, IA et digitalisation), avec un accompagnement pour monter rapidement en compétences. Un contrat à durée indéterminée. Un salaire en adéquation avec vos connaissances et votre expérience. Un package salarial complet : chèques-repas, assurance groupe, assurance hospitalisation, éco-chèques, ordinateur portable, smartphone avec …

items.desc: Op deze pagina: Dit ga je doen Dit krijg je Dit bieden we nog meer Dit vragen wij Hier kom je te werken Bijzonderheden Stel gerust je vraag Dit ga je doen Het antwoord op die vraag is een inkoppertje. Want ons Traineeship draait maar om één ding: dat jij je talenten als professional maximaal ontwikkelt en inzet! We halen alles uit de kast, met een programma op maat van jou! In twee jaar tijd krijg je volop de kans om kennis en ervaring op te doen en je soft skills te vergroten. Als IT-trainee data engineer bij IVO Rechtspraak werk je vanuit het IVO Datalab. Jij helpt dataproducten en -analyses te ontwikkelen en rechters en andere Rechtspraak-medewerkers datagedreven te werken. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data engineering, ML engineering en cloud engineering. Heel belangrijk dus! En dat is nog niet alles. De Rechtspraak wil flinke stappen zetten in datagedreven werken. Daar draag jij op allerlei manieren aan bij vanuit het IVO Datalab. Je kunt je creativiteit helemaal kwijt! Zo ontwikkel je pipelines (Infrastructure as Code) en koppelvlakken voor data ingestion en ben je betrokken bij de deployment van diverse dataproducten. Ook ben je bezig met cloud engineering. Samen met de Cloud Engineers van het lab doe je aan resource deployment en richt je de netwerkinfrastructuur vanaf scratch in. De eerste verkenningen zijn op een on-premise cloud, met later een transitie naar een private cloud. Een mooie gelegenheid om OpenShift en Azure Cloud beter te leren kennen. Word jij als data engineer blij van een rol met ruimte om initiatief te nemen? Waar je de techniek in kunt duiken en meer doet dan alleen de dagelijkse routine? Dan is dit jouw start. Dit krijg je €3579 Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd 36 uur Dit bieden we nog meer Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij: Contract: een jaarcontract voor 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Salaris: Je zit in schaal 9 (trede 0) en hebt een salaris van € 3.579,02 bruto per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur Daarnaast heb je een Individueel Keuzebudget van € 590,54, waarmee je zelf je arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt. Koop bijvoorbeeld extra verlof, schaf een fiets aan of los je studieschuld fiscaal vriendelijk af. Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen. Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek. Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 26 vrije dagen op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer. Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld. Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz. Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarden > Dit vragen wij Kun jij analytisch denken? gestructureerd te werk gaan? goed samenwerken? zorgvuldig en helder communiceren? Heb jij Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met als richting software of informatica? maximaal 2 jaar werkervaring na je studie? een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel in mondelinge als schriftelijke communicatie? een brede leergierigheid en de wil om jezelf te ontwikkelen? veel initiatief en houd je wel van een uitdaging? En, ben jij: een starter in de wereld van IT? Dan is ons IT-traineeship écht iets voor jou! Samen ontwikkelen en beheren we de digitale systemen voor de rechtspraak. Zo zorgen we dat rechtszaken iedere dag soepel verlopen. Onze kernwaarde integriteit is verweven in het DNA van al onze medewerkers. Van IT’er tot communicatieadviseur of beleidsmedewerker. Daarom vinden wij het ook belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt, plezier heeft in het werk en zichzelf kan zijn in een informele werksfeer. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous souhaitez rejoindre un Groupe bancaire international et participer au déploiement des solutions IA et Data science dans une grande banque? Rejoignez-nous! Vous intégrez la Direction Data&IA de la banque SG en charge de mettre en place des solutions data&IA pour la gestion des risques et l’optimisation des tâches bancaires. Pour apporter un maximum de la valeur à la banque, notre équipe doit mettre en œuvre le traitement intelligent de tâches en : Traitant la variabilité des données et demandes reçues (documents, mails, données struturées, etc.) Exécutant les tâches via l’agentique (appels d’API, mise à jour de données, task management, etc.) Livrant des bots conversationnels à usage interne ou clients Assurant une explicabilité parfaite des décisions prises (ou non prises) Problématique du stage de recherche : Les méthodes d’évaluations traditionnelles (labellisation, dataset d’évaluation, confrontation aux données validées par les processus) montrent des limites : la variété des cas devient infinie et les zones de risques de modèle sont difficiles à détourer, sont très variables. En tant que Data Scientist de recherche, vous êtes intégré à la direction data science et IA de la banque et concrètement, sous la supervision de votre tuteur, vous serez amené à : Documenter les problématiques d’évaluation des modèles rencontrées sur les différents projets Identifier comment le besoin d’évaluation a été traité sur chaque projet Identifier des approches possibles puis les tester sur les données de chaque modèle Produire des conclusions et des préconisations sur les méthodes d’évaluation à utiliser En interaction avec les équipes et le management de la direction nous attendons que vous : Soyez force de proposition Restituiez les résultats via des restitutions soignées Présentiez les travaux et ajuster les analyses en fonction de leurs retours Durée du stage : 6 mois. Et si c’était vous ? Vous êtes étudiant de niveau Bac+5 en École d'Ingénieur, École de Commerce ou Université avec une spécialité en data science-IA et un très bon bagage mathématique et statistique Vous savez concevoir des modèles data science et les améliorer Vous connaissez les langages de manipulation de la data Python et PySpark Vous savez restituer vos travaux via des solutions de DataViz (PowerBi, Streamlit) Vous avez une appétence pour l'environnement bancaire Vous êtes rigoureux, autonome et avez un fort sens de l’écoute des interlocuteurs Vous faites preuve de qualité de synthèse et de bonnes capacités de restitutions écrites et orales You're confortable in English ! Alors vous êtes notre candidat ! Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, en France et à l’international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail, vous bénéficiez d’avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d’Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport) Offre variée de restaurants d’entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l’action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s’engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l’éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. items.desc: How you can make your mark Are you a data-driven engineer who wants to improve complex offshore operations through automated decision support and practical software solutions? At DSE, we automate the boring and strengthen informed decision-making. We turn data and processes into meaningful tools that help optimise OE’s business. We excel at delivering software solutions that empower the organisation. As a DSE-er, You Will Turn Engineering Knowledge, Operational Data And Advanced Algorithms Into Practical Solutions For Global Tenders, Engineering Studies And Offshore Projects. Depending On The Challenge, You Will Work On Data Integration & Visualisation Generative AI, including LLMs, NLP & Machine Learning Planning, Simulation & Optimisation Engineering Business Optimisation Software Engineering You will develop Python-based models and applications using platforms such as Azure DevOps and Databricks. Working closely with our Offshore Energy business units, you will help optimise project execution, fleet deployment and the performance of offshore assets such as our Bokalift crane vessels. We are looking for someone with a background in engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, operations research or a related field, with experience or a strong interest in data science, simulation, optimisation, generative AI or Python software development. Experience in offshore energy or maritime contracting is an advantage, but not essential. More important are curiosity, analytical thinking and the ability to translate engineering and business challenges into reliable, transparent and usable solutions. We encourage continuous learning and provide on-the-job support to help you develop your expertise. Your Responsibilities As a Data Science Engineer Develop and implement DSE solutions with and for the Offshore Energy business units, improving the commercial and operational performance of tenders and projects. Develop our capabilities in planning, simulation, and optimization, considering factors such as fleet capacity, weather conditions, and unforeseen events. Develop and improve Python models and applications in close collaboration with colleagues from the business. Integrate and visualize data to create web applications and dashboards that support engineering and operational decision-making. Apply generative AI, including LLMs and NLP, as well as machine learning, where these technologies add practical business value. Apply professional software-engineering practices to create reliable, reusable, and maintainable solutions. We will guide and coach you to work in our development toolchain and the Boskalis business, for you to quickly: Identify opportunities for data integration and visualisation, generative AI, including LLMs and NLP, machine learning, simulation, optimization, and automation. Understand the needs of multidisciplinary project teams and independently translate them into practical DSE solutions. Combine engineering knowledge, data, and algorithms to improve business and operational performance. Act as a knowledgeable DSE partner for other departments by sharing expertise and inspiring the effective use of data-driven solutions. Your qualities You can make your mark as data science engineer if you have: An MSc degree in computer science, applied mathematics, econometrics, computational engineering, or a related engineering discipline, such as civil, offshore, dredging or applied physics. Experience in analyzing data and developing data-driven design-decision models using methods such as machine learning, engineering optimisation, constraint programming or advanced metaheuristic algorithms, discrete-event simulation, finite-element modelling. Experience in developing Python-based software is essential. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, PySpark or Databricks is an advantage, but not required. A proactive attitude, the ability to collaborate effectively within the team and the wider organisation, and a strong curiosity and drive to learn. A good command of written and spoken English. We offer A dynamic environment: A job where you can make an impact, in an earth-moving company, as part of a diverse, international team of experts. Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement of 31 days (based on a full-time contract), a non-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance and travel allowance. Our new, larger office in Corby includes a dedicated development and testing lab, giving engineers hands-on access to the latest technology. items.desc: Wil je niet zomaar een IT-traineeship? En spreekt leren door te doen je aan? Als IT trainee Data Engineer werk je bij IVO Rechtspraak, de IT-dienstverlener van de Rechtspraak aan iets van betekenis. Samen met de collega’s in je team help je dataproducten en -analyses te ontwikkelen, zodat rechters en andere medewerkers van de Rechtspraak datagedreven kunnen werken. Spannend? Geen zorgen, je kunt rekenen op je collega’s en je buddy. Interessant? Zeker, want je ontwikkelt je ook persoonlijk. En dat samen met de andere IT-trainees, dus ook nog leuk! Wat ga je doen? Het antwoord op die vraag is een inkoppertje. Want ons Traineeship (https://www.werkenbijderechtspraak.nl/ivo-rechtspraak/traineeship)draait maar om één ding: dat jij je talenten als professional maximaal ontwikkelt en inzet! We halen alles uit de kast, met een programma op maat van jou! In twee jaar tijd krijg je volop de kans om kennis en ervaring op te doen en je soft skills te vergroten. Als IT-trainee data engineer bij IVO Rechtspraak werk je vanuit het IVO Datalab. Jij helpt dataproducten en -analyses te ontwikkelen en rechters en andere Rechtspraak-medewerkers datagedreven te werken. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data engineering, ML engineering en cloud engineering. Heel belangrijk dus! En dat is nog niet alles. De Rechtspraak wil flinke stappen zetten in datagedreven werken. Daar draag jij op allerlei manieren aan bij vanuit het IVO Datalab. Je kunt je creativiteit helemaal kwijt! Zo ontwikkel je pipelines (Infrastructure as Code) en koppelvlakken voor data ingestion en ben je betrokken bij de deployment van diverse dataproducten. Ook ben je bezig met cloud engineering. Samen met de Cloud Engineers van het lab doe je aan resource deployment en richt je de netwerkinfrastructuur vanaf scratch in. De eerste verkenningen zijn op een on-premise cloud, met later een transitie naar een private cloud. Een mooie gelegenheid om OpenShift en Azure Cloud beter te leren kennen. Word jij als data engineer blij van een rol met ruimte om initiatief te nemen? Waar je de techniek in kunt duiken en meer doet dan alleen de dagelijkse routine? Dan is dit jouw start. Een bijzonder IT-traineeship omdat... je leren en werken vanaf dag één combineert, onder persoonlijke begeleiding. je samen met andere IT-trainees niet alleen opleidingen volgt, maar ook leuke dingen doet. je onderdeel bent van een organisatie die inclusiviteit en diversiteit koestert. je werk onmisbaar is voor een rechtvaardige samenleving. Dit krijg je ervoor terug Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij: Contract: een jaarcontract voor 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Salaris: Je zit in schaal 9 (trede 0) en hebt een salaris van € 3.579,02 bruto per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur Daarnaast heb je een Individueel Keuzebudget van € 590,54, waarmee je zelf je arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt. Koop bijvoorbeeld extra verlof, schaf een fiets aan of los je studieschuld fiscaal vriendelijk af. Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen. Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek. Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 26 vrije dagen op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer. Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld. Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz. Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarden > (https://www.werkenvoornederland.nl/over-de-rijksoverheid/arbeidsvoorwaarden) Wat jouw collega Hieu waardeert aan het traineeship Hieu heeft niet dezelfde functie als jij, maar kan je wel vertellen hoe het is om IT-trainee bij de Rechtspraak te zijn. Hij deelt zijn ervaringen graag met jou. “Met mijn manager kijk ik welke cursussen het meest waardevol zijn voor mij en mijn team. Voor de rest leer ik on the job met tools te werken, ik pas mijn kennis meteen toe. Mijn buddy begeleidt me bij het werk en geeft me tips. Ook mijn soft skills ontwikkel ik, via leiderschaps- en communicatietrainingen. Daar heb ik veel aan!” Hieu, IT-trainee test automation engineer Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van Trainee test automation engineer Hieu? Je leest het in zijn blog . Wat we van jou verwachten Kun jij: analytisch denken? gestructureerd te werk gaan? goed samenwerken? zorgvuldig en helder communiceren? Heb jij: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met als richting software of informatica? maximaal …

items.desc: About The Position As an AI & Data Analytics Engineer, you will work with technical data from our manufacturing processes, product and process development, and technical documentation. A key part of the role is understanding how data flows through our production environments, how it can be structured and analyzed, and how it can be used to create value for the organization. You will work with everything from data flows and pre-processing to analysis and visualization of production data. The role also includes exploring how advanced analytics, Machine Learning and AI can be applied to our processes and technical information. You will work closely with our production systems and data infrastructure, where Python, databases, data workflows and DCS data are important components. Experience of ABB 800xA is particularly valuable. As AI becomes an increasingly important part of our technical landscape, you will also contribute to developing and evaluating solutions based on Machine Learning and LLM-based AI. Cybersecurity and secure data handling are natural considerations throughout this work. Your Main Responsibilities Develop secure, robust and scalable data solutions for production environments. Collect, process, analyze and visualize technical and production data using Python, databases and data workflows. Work with industrial process and DCS data, including ABB 800xA. Explore and develop solutions using Machine Learning, advanced analytics and LLM-based AI. Design and evaluate data and AI workflows, including feasibility studies for new technical solutions. Ensure cybersecurity aspects are considered in data and AI solutions. Develop and maintain technical documentation, procedures and models to support system users. Your profile A Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or another relevant technical field Experience with Python and data analysis Knowledge of databases and data workflows Experience with data processing and visualization Fluency in English, both written and spoken Experience or knowledge within the following areas is considered meritorious: DCS environments, particularly ABB 800xA Machine Learning and advanced data analytics Generative AI and LLM-based solutions Cybersecurity in data or industrial environments Working in Linux environments Who are you? To thrive in this position, we believe you are analytical, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy working with complex technical challenges and are comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and a broader understanding of systems and processes. You have an interest in new technologies and enjoy turning ideas and possibilities into practical solutions. As the role involves collaboration with technical specialists and users across the organization, you are communicative and able to explain complex technical topics in a clear and accessible way. Sounds interesting? Please submit your application before the deadline on December 4th. The position might be filled before the application deadline. Contact Ola Litström Director Digitalization & Operation Technology ola.litstrom@hoganas.com Ebba Folkesson HR-generalist ebba.folkesson@hoganas.com Working at Höganäs We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfill your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world - and we - face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred supplier of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net-zero climate emissions. More About Höganäs Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials. The company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and Höganäs is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. Höganäs collaborates with customers across multiple industries to develop innovative solutions, including applications in automotive components, electric motors, brazing, surface coating, welding consumables and additive manufacturing. Operating 15 production centers worldwide and employing 2,200 people, Höganäs’ turnover for 2025 was 11,045 MSEK. Höganäs is owned by Lindéngruppen and FAM. www.hoganas.com Interested? Apply today!
