items.desc: Our Mission As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. Our Values Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down. Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today. Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate. Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same. Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us. Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters. Where You’ll Work This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration in Ghent three times per week. The Team Or Role As a Data Scientist Intern on Tinder’s Modes team in Ghent, you’ll help build new ways for people to meet on Tinder, from group and shared experiences to new modes of using the app. You’ll work with product, engineering, and data science partners to understand how members use these experiences, define how we measure success, and turn insights into product decisions. In This Role, You Will Design and execute A/B experiments to measure the impact of product features and algorithmic changes. Help build and improve the team’s experimentation and analytics tooling, including AI-assisted workflows, with a focus on standardization, automation, and clear documentation. Take a scoped analysis from question to recommendation, with guidance from your mentor. Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Data Science, Product, and Engineering to translate insights into actionable strategies. Present key findings and project outcomes to Product and Leadership teams during end-of-internship demos. Translate data insights into clear narratives and recommendations that inform product roadmaps and user experience improvements. Explore and analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities. You’ll Need Passion for using data and experimentation to solve complex problems. Intermediate to advanced SQL skills for data querying and analysis. Familiarity with / building to proficiency in Python. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and experimental design (A/B testing, hypothesis testing). Clear written communication and a curious, fast-learning mindset. Comfort using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based coding and analysis assistants) as a regular part of your workflow, and the judgment to check their output. Currently pursuing a BS/BA, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Applied Math, or a related field. As Part Of Our Team, You'll Enjoy The hustle of a startup with the impact of a global business Tremendous opportunity to solve some of the industry’s most exciting problems Working with an extraordinary team of smart, creative, fun and highly motivated people Commitment to Inclusion At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. items.desc: Vi har masser af idéer til, hvordan vi kan gøre marketing i NORMAL endnu hurtigere, smartere og mere effektiv. Vi har allerede udviklet vores egne PIM- og UGC-platforme, og nu vil vi bygge videre, udvikle nye værktøjer og automatisere flere af vores processer. Derfor søger vi en nysgerrig, teknisk stærk og lidt opfinderagtig MarTech & AI Specialist, der har lyst til at omsætte idéer og udfordringer til løsninger, der rent faktisk virker. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores nye MarTech-team, hvor du sammen med vores MarTech Lead skal være med til at udvikle fremtidens marketingværktøjer. Hvad skal du lave? Kort fortalt skal du være med til at gøre vores marketingarbejde smartere ved hjælp af teknologi, AI og automatisering. Du får mulighed for både at videreudvikle de løsninger, vi allerede har, og bygge nye værktøjer, der gør hverdagen lettere for dine kolleger. Og ja, måske også sende et par Excel-ark på pension undervejs. Dine Opgaver Bliver Blandt Andet At Drifte og videreudvikle vores eksisterende PIM- og UGC-platforme. Udvikle nye interne værktøjer, der automatiserer marketingprocesser og gør arbejdsgangene mere effektive. Bruge Claude og Claude Code til at udvikle funktioner, prototyper og digitale løsninger. Arbejde med API'er, integrationer og data, så vores forskellige systemer spiller bedre sammen. Samarbejde tæt med vores MarTech Lead om at finde nye muligheder, udforske idéer og omsætte dem til løsninger, der skaber værdi. Hvem er du? Du er nysgerrig, handlekraftig og teknisk stærk. Du kan lide at finde smartere løsninger og er ikke bange for at prøve dig frem – heller ikke når du skal lære noget nyt undervejs. Måske med lidt hjælp fra Claude. Du behøver ikke være klassisk softwareudvikler, men skal kunne læse, forstå og arbejde med kode. Vi forestiller os, at du har 1-3 års erfaring fra fx digital produktudvikling, teknisk marketing eller udvikling af digitale løsninger. For os er det vigtigere, hvad du kan bygge, end hvad der står på dit eksamensbevis. Vi Forestiller Os Desuden, At Du Har erfaring med at bygge digitale løsninger, interne værktøjer eller automatiseringer. Har arbejdet med API'er, integrationer og data og forstår, hvordan forskellige systemer hænger sammen. Kan gennemskue kode, logik og tekniske sammenhænge – også uden en 40-siders kravspecifikation. Bruger AI aktivt til at udvikle og bygge løsninger. Har praktisk erfaring med Claude, Claude Code eller lignende værktøjer. Kommunikerer godt på dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk. Hvem er vi? Vi er ikke så vilde med teknologi for teknologiens skyld. Vi foretrækker løsninger, der virker i virkeligheden, frem for dem, der kun ser fantastiske ud i PowerPoint. Vi kan godt lide at eksperimentere, tage ansvar og komme fra idé til handling – gerne uden alt for mange møder undervejs. Du bliver en del af et nyt MarTech-team i vores marketingafdeling, hvor ambitionerne er høje, beslutningsvejene korte, og der er gode muligheder for at sætte dit eget præg på både løsningerne og måden, vi arbejder på. Skal vi mødes? Vi er mere interesserede i, hvad du kan bygge, end hvad der står på dit CV. Så vis os meget gerne noget, du har lavet – det kan være et projekt, en prototype eller en smart løsning, du selv har fundet på. Det behøver hverken være stort eller perfekt. Vi vil bare gerne se, hvordan du tænker, og hvad du kan få til at ske. Stillingen er på fuld tid på vores kontor i Skanderborg med forventet opstart i januar eller februar 2027. Send din ansøgning snarest. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette talent. Stillingen er med reference til Mads Haulund, Martech Lead (maha@normal.dk). PS. Du må gerne bruge AI til din ansøgning, bare sørg for, at vi også kan mærke mennesket bag prompten 😉 Vi anbefaler, at du bekræfter SMS-kommunikation, så vi nemt kan komme i kontakt med dig i rekrutteringsprocessen.

items.desc: Outside Edge · St Albans · Hybrid (at least 3 days a week in the office) Full-time, permanent · £60k base + discretionary bonus https://outsideedge.io/ About us We’re a specialist analytics consultancy, building models and tools for predicting cricket matches around the world. Our technical team works across modelling, data, engineering and deployment, taking responsibility for its work from the first idea through to production. We share a goal of solving cricket. You’ll focus on modelling, with scope to get involved wherever your skills and ideas are useful. The role We’re trying to understand cricket better than anyone else. We have the best data available, and you’ll build the models that make the most of it. You’ll explore new ideas, test them rigorously and turn the strongest into useful prediction tools. AI is central to how we work. We use agents every day to help us plan, build, review and run our systems. That lets a small team take on work that would once have needed a much larger one, and lets each person cover far more ground. We’re still discovering the best ways to work like this, and we want people who’ll help shape it. Above all, we’re looking for the right person. Energy, ideas, a positive attitude and initiative matter more to us than any specific experience or skill on this list. What you’ll do Develop and improve the statistical and machine-learning methods behind our cricket models. Take ideas from exploratory analysis through to clear, well-tested production code, and review colleagues’ work. Use AI agents throughout your work, and help improve the team’s tools and workflows. Work closely with engineers and analysts to understand how your models perform in practice and where they could improve. What we’re looking for Ideally you’ll have: A postgraduate degree (MSc or PhD) in statistics, maths, physics, computer science or another quantitative subject. Relevant industry experience will also be considered. An ability to identify problems and opportunities, develop your own ideas and take responsibility for seeing them through. Strong Python skills and familiarity with the standard data science stack (e.g. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch), including experience writing production code. A solid grounding in probability, statistics, regression and model evaluation, and the judgement to question whether a result stands up to scrutiny. Hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, including breaking down tasks, reviewing outputs and knowing when to challenge them. Good engineering habits, including Git, code review, testing and reproducible analysis. Clear communication, including the ability to explain modelling decisions to people who aren’t modellers. Nice to have: Experience with Bayesian modelling, such as hierarchical models in PyMC or Stan. Experience building or evaluating forecasting models or other predictive systems. Experience working with sports data or similarly noisy real-world data. Experience with C# or React. An interest in cricket, though you don’t need to be an expert. Why join us Challenging modelling problems, with your work used directly in our prediction tools. A small team where you’ll have real ownership and a say in technical decisions. The opportunity to help improve how we use AI across the business. The tools you need to do your best work. If there’s hardware, software or an AI tool that would help, we’ll generally get it for you. A discretionary, performance-related bonus that has typically matched or exceeded base salary. Regular team socials, private healthcare and paid conference attendance. How to apply Every application must include something you’ve built using AI. It can be a side project, a tool, an analysis or anything else that shows how you think. Share a link to a repo or demo or, if it can’t be shared publicly, a short write-up. Send this with your CV and a short covering note to careers@outsideedge.io, using the subject line “Member of the Technical Team: Data Science”. In your note, tell us about the project: what you set out to achieve, the decisions you made and what you learnt. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their background.

items.desc: About The Role You will join a growing AI team of 19 talented colleagues with a shared mission: transforming data and AI into measurable business value for Flatpay and our merchants. We are hiring for two open roles in separate teams: fraud prevention and our meeting booker software tool. As a Data Scientist, you will design, build, and productionize data and Machine Learning powered products and pipelines that support business-critical processes across the organization. You will own the implementation of solutions together with colleagues from the AI team and the wider business. This includes understanding the underlying business problem, shaping the solution, building it, deploying it to production, and continuously improving it based on real-world performance. The role is ideal for someone who combines strong data and software engineering skills with the ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders. You should enjoy turning ambiguous operational challenges into practical AI products that create measurable value. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, and is comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders to pursue opportunities, align solutions with business needs, and continuously drive improvement. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI products and pipelines using Python, Databricks, and MLflow. Work within one of our key focus areas: Fraud prevention: Build and maintain solutions that support our Fraud department, including alert automations, data pipelines and case tracking. You will help evolve our rule-based system into a true data-driven setup. Meeting booker software tool: Develop and maintain a software tool for the sales meeting bookers that includes automatically optimized routeplanning and AI-driven context analysis. Integrate models and AI applications with internal systems, APIs, and external platforms. Write clean, maintainable, and tested Python code, with monitoring, validation, guardrails, and fallback mechanisms appropriate to the use case. Evaluate solutions against relevant technical and business measures, including accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and operational impact. Collaborate with data engineers and other technical teams to build on reliable, scalable, and well-governed data foundations. Work directly with stakeholders to understand processes, define requirements, and take solutions from proof of concept through production and ongoing improvement. Apply traditional machine learning and GenAI techniques, choosing the right approach based on the business problem, available data, and operational requirements. Who You Are We are hiring across several focus areas and do not expect you to have experience in all of them. We are looking for a strong technical foundation, a practical approach to problem-solving, and relevant experience in the area you would join. Required You have 2–4 +years of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or a similar technical role. You have strong Python skills and write clean, maintainable, and tested code. You understand core machine learning concepts, including data preparation, model evaluation, and validation. You have hands-on experience building solutions with traditional machine learning, GenAI, or a combination of both. You are comfortable working with SQL and data processing libraries. You understand what it takes to move a solution from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and reliability. You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and can translate business needs into practical technical solutions. You take ownership, enjoy learning, and care about building solutions that create measurable business value. Nice to Have - Depending on Your Focus Area Relevant experience in one or more of the areas below is a plus. You do not need to cover every area. Fraud prevention: Experience handling large-scale financial data, rule- or ML-based fraud detection, software engineering concepts, imbalanced datasets and MCC software tool: Practical experience with software deployment, automated testing, CI/CD practices, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Experience with monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting distributed systems, including tools and practices for logging, metrics, tracing, and performance analysis. Experience with front-end development and design. items.desc: Deloitte er et av verdens ledende profesjonelle tjenestehus med over 470 000 ansatte globalt. I Norge er vi ca. 1600 medarbeidere som hjelper klienter med rådgivning, revisjon, skatt og juridiske tjenester. Hos oss jobber du i et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø der vi setter pris på ulike perspektiver, kompetanser og bakgrunner. Er du nyutdannet, eller fullfører du snart studiene? I Deloitte AI & Data får du jobbe med spørsmål som betyr noe for virksomheter: Hvordan kan data brukes bedre? Hvor kan AI skape verdi? Og hvordan bygger vi løsninger som faktisk blir tatt i bruk? Vi hjelper virksomheter med å skape verdi med AI og data – fra strategi og dataplattformer til AI-løsninger og innsikt. Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig, lærer raskt og har lyst til å bruke det du kan til skape impact that matters. Hva kan du jobbe med? Du vil bidra innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: AI Strategy & Governance: Finne ut hvor AI og data kan skape verdi, prioritere muligheter og bidra til en tydelig retning for virksomheten. Data Platform & Engineering: Bygge dataplattformer, arkitektur og datapipelines som gjør data tilgjengelige og anvendelige. AI Solutions & Insights: Bruke AI og analyse til å skape innsikt og utvikle løsninger som forbedrer beslutninger og arbeidsmåter. Hvem ser vi etter? Du er nyutdannet eller i ferd med å fullføre en relevant utdanning på masternivå (NHH, CBS, NTNU, BI, NMBU, UiO, UiB og anerkjente internasjonale universiteter). Du liker å forstå både hvilket problem som skal løses , og hvordan teknologi kan bidra . Du arbeider strukturert, stiller spørsmål og samarbeider godt med mennesker med ulik fagbakgrunn. Kanskje har du gjennom en internship, deltidsjobb, et studieprosjekt eller et eget initiativ brukt data eller AI til å løse et problem? Fortell oss gjerne hva utfordringen var, hva du selv bidro med , og hva resultatet ble. Vi söker nu en Data Scientist till ett långt konsultuppdrag inom utveckling av intelligenta beslutsstöd och prediktiva modeller för ett komplext och högteknologiskt driftområde. Fokus ligger på att utveckla: Prognosmodeller Prediktiva och ordinerande modeller Beslutsstöd för drift och planering Applikationer för flaskhalshantering och budfiltrering Produktionssatta ML-lösningar med hög kvalitet och spårbarhet Du kommer arbeta genom hela ML-livscykeln – från analys och modellutveckling till deployment, övervakning och vidareutveckling i produktionsmiljö. items.desc: We are looking for you if you want to work at one of Hungary's leading telecommunications companies to help our clients navigate the digital world. Take the first step, bring your inspiring ideas and join our supportive and creative Data Scientist team. Be curious and responsible, work passionately and be open to development. Let’s reach our goals together, because at Yettel you can inspire true change while being yourself. Who are we? More than 1,800 colleagues working at nearly 130 locations across the country forming one big team and enjoying an unlimited experience. We have a lime heart and Yettel enables us to make our dreams come true. Join Yettel Hungary as Data Scientist Expert, be yourself and make a difference in the world. You will have the following responsibilities: Supporting business and marketing decisions with data-driven solutions, developing predictive models such as churn scoring to drive retention offers and product propensity scoring to realise additional value for our customers. Translating business needs into actionable ML and AI solutions across marketing, customer care, and network operations - including next best offer, customer lifecycle management, recommendation systems, and demand forecasting. Participating in generative AI projects , including working with LLMs , and custom NLP to build innovative solutions like customer service chatbots and automated interaction tools. Summarising and presenting analytical results , making findings clear and actionable for stakeholders. Managing production-ready code , documentation, and large-scale customer/transactional data assets according to agreed standards, ensuring transparency and traceability across all processes. Collaborating with data and MLOps engineers to ensure data science solutions remain reliable, high-quality, and scalable. You are the ideal candidate for our team if you have / are: BSc or MSc degree in Economics, Technology, Natural or Social Sciences. 2-3 years of relevant professional experience in data science or analytics. Intermediate knowledge of statistics, data analysis and machine learning techniques. Confident use of Python and SQL . Able to deliver projects independently or with light supervision. Excellent communication skills, able to present complex technical results clearly. Proficient level of English . Experience working in a consumer setting and marketing is a plus. You’ll feel at home in the Yettel team if you enjoy working collaboratively, take ownership of your work, think in a data-driven way, have a proactive mindset, and treat everyone with respect. At Yettel, we are relentlessly working to reshape the telco industry, which is why it’s important to us that you use AI tools at least at a basic level and confidently integrate them into your day-to-day work to become even more effective. Discover the opportunities offered by Yettel. #FlexibleWorking: We work in the nature-friendly and innovative Yettel House, and during the summer, the Garden Office is also available to us. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home, with the number of home office days varying by department; in most roles, this is typically up to 6 days per month. #Health: We provide our colleagues with collective life and health insurance, paternity leave, and free advice in the areas of lifestyle, psychology, law and finance. Our office gym and saunas also await our employees. #Technology: It is natural that you will receive a company smartphone with unlimited internet, and we even offer discounted rates for your family and friends. #Learning: Trainings, courses and an online platform are also available so that you never stop developing! Our goal is to support you throughout your personal and professional career, while you are constantly learning new things! #YettelHQ: Our headquarter at Törökbálint is one of the most unique office buildings in the country, with a panoramic terrace, an outdoor sports field and an alternative garden office. #YettelBus: You can also get to Törökbálint with Yettel's buses, which are available to everyone. You don’t need to show any documents when boarding. These buses leave from several stations in the city: Népliget, Kelenföld, as well as Déli pályaudvar stations, and you can recognize them by the "Yettel bus - Yettel" sign on the front of the vehicles. Are you interested? Please submit your application and we’ll contact you soon. For more information about the application process please visit our career page. Until then, please follow us for the best Yettel moments on Instagram and LinkedIn.

items.desc: Challenges you will work on At SAS, machine learning has moved well beyond experimentation. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in machine learning, automation, data platforms, and Generative AI. We design, deploy, and operate production models that support pricing decisions, personalize customer experiences, and make our operations smarter every day. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will play an important role in developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning solutions that create real business value. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and AI engineers to help bring models from development into production and ensure they perform reliably at scale. If you're passionate about applying machine learning to real-world challenges and want to help shape the future of AI at SAS, this is the role for you! As our Machine Learning Engineer, you will help develop and operationalize machine learning solutions across SAS. In this role, you will work hands-on with deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production ML solutions. You will collaborate closely with data scientists to transition models from experimentation to production, help improve deployment processes and contribute to the ongoing development of our ML platform and engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, deploy and monitor end-to-end pipelines for machine learning models in Azure. Apply MLOps best practices, including version control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, continuous training, testing, and monitoring, to ensure the quality and reliability of the machine learning solutions. Monitor model performance and help identify issues related to model quality, drift, and reliability. Support automation of model training, deployment, and retraining processes. Contribute to best practices for machine learning engineering, testing, documentation, and deployment. Work with Data Engineering and IT teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable. Help develop and improve CI/CD processes for machine learning applications. Participate in troubleshooting and resolving issues in production ML systems. Stay up to date with developments in machine learning, MLOps, and cloud technologies. The Team We are a central AI & Automation function within SAS Digital & IT that develops and operates solutions across machine learning, automation, MLOps, and Generative AI. Our team consists of data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, and automation specialists who work together to deliver solutions that create measurable business impact. As SAS continues to strengthen its AI capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable AI solutions, and engineering practices that enable machine learning to create value across the business. As part of the team, you will contribute to a growing portfolio of machine learning products and collaborate across disciplines to ensure solutions are production-ready, scalable, and valuable to the business. To be successful we believe you have Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, or a related role. Experience developing, deploying, and operating machine learning solutions in production environments. Hands-on experience with Azure ML, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud-based ML platforms. Proficiency in Python, SQL, Git, and Bash. Experience deploying and serving machine learning models through APIs, as well as monitoring model performance in production. Understanding of model evaluation techniques, hyperparameter tuning, and validation approaches such as back-testing. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform on Azure. Solid understanding of software engineering practices, including testing, version control, and CI/CD principles. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain and document technical concepts clearly and effectively. Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI agents is considered a plus. We believe you are a curious and pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving problems with data and machine learning. You are comfortable working across the ML lifecycle, from experimentation to production, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines. You are eager to learn, improve your technical skills, and contribute to building reliable AI solutions that create real business value. Most importantly, you understand that successful machine learning is not only about models, but about delivering solutions that work in the real world and continue to provide value over time. items.desc: ¡En Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a ML Engineer | Forecasting & Mathematical Optimization! En Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a Machine Learning Engineer para participar en un proyecto estratégico del sector bancario, colaborando en el desarrollo, análisis y mejora de modelos de Machine Learning orientados a la previsión de demanda, análisis de series temporales y optimización matemática . Buscamos un perfil con una sólida base analítica y experiencia práctica en Machine Learning tradicional, especialmente en entrenamiento, validación y optimización de modelos predictivos. Participarás en un caso de uso de gestión de efectivo para una entidad bancaria de primer nivel como Santander. La parte de productivización y MLOps también estará presente, aunque el foco principal estará en el conocimiento de modelos predictivos, series temporales y técnicas de optimización. Responsabilidades principales Diseñar, entrenar, validar y optimizar modelos de Machine Learning supervisado. Desarrollar y analizar modelos de forecasting para la previsión de demanda mediante técnicas de análisis de series temporales. Evaluar el comportamiento de los modelos, analizar métricas de rendimiento y proponer mejoras en su precisión y estabilidad. Aplicar técnicas de optimización matemática, programación matemática y heurísticas para resolver problemas de negocio y apoyar la toma de decisiones operativas. Combinar modelos predictivos con modelos de optimización para mejorar la planificación y asignación de recursos. Analizar y mejorar modelos existentes, evaluando diferentes algoritmos, variables y estrategias de entrenamiento. Participar en la adaptación y productivización de modelos en entornos corporativos. Colaborar en la implementación de pipelines de entrenamiento e inferencia utilizando Python, PySpark y Databricks. Trabajar con herramientas de seguimiento, versionado y gestión de modelos como MLflow. Aplicar buenas prácticas de desarrollo, testing, trazabilidad y monitorización. Colaborar con equipos de Data Science, Data Engineering, Plataforma y Negocio. Requisitos imprescindibles Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, Data Science o desarrollo de soluciones analíticas. Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Estadística, Data Science o similar. Experiencia sólida con Python avanzado aplicado a Machine Learning. Conocimientos prácticos de Machine Learning tradicional: entrenamiento, validación, selección y optimización de modelos. Experiencia con Series Temporales y Forecasting, especialmente en modelos de previsión de demanda. Conocimientos de Optimización Matemática, programación matemática, heurísticas o investigación operativa. Experiencia trabajando con modelos predictivos y análisis de métricas de rendimiento. Conocimientos de SQL para consulta, transformación y validación de datos. Experiencia con PySpark / Apache Spark. Conocimientos de Azure Databricks o plataformas analíticas equivalentes. Experiencia con Git y metodologías de desarrollo colaborativo. Español fluido e inglés técnico. Conocimientos valorables Experiencia en banca, sector financiero, retail o gestión de operaciones. Experiencia combinando modelos de forecasting con modelos de optimización. Conocimientos de MLOps y productivización de modelos de Machine Learning. Experiencia con MLflow para tracking, registro y gestión de modelos. Conocimientos de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions u otras herramientas). Experiencia migrando notebooks y modelos experimentales a entornos productivos. Conocimientos de monitorización, testing y gobierno de modelos. Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como apoyo al desarrollo. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Participación en un proyecto estratégico para el sector bancario. Incorporación a un entorno tecnológico con retos reales de Machine Learning y optimización. Trabajo con tecnologías como Python, Machine Learning, Databricks, PySpark y MLflow. items.desc: To accelerate the growth of German Mittelstand! vent.io GmbH entwickelt als Unternehmen der Deutsche Leasing AG und Teil der Sparkasse Finanzgruppe digitale Geschäftsmodelle, Produkte und Services. Wir suchen DICH als Data Scientist / AI Engineer (w/m/d) im Team Engineering: DAS ERWARTET DICH Als Data Scientist / AI Engineer (w/m/d) bist du Teil unseres Data-Science-Chapters und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Data Science, Data Engineering und Software Engineering. Du entwickelst datengetriebene Lösungen von Anfang bis Ende, von der Datenaufnahme und -verarbeitung bis hin zur Modellierung und zum Produktivbetrieb. Du erforschst und analysierst Daten, um Muster zu erkennen und analytische Erkenntnisse in datengetriebene Lösungen für geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu übersetzen. Du entwickelst und bewertest Lösungen auf Basis von ML, KI und LLMs, unterstützt durch zuverlässige Datengrundlagen und ein solides Verständnis der zugrunde liegenden Daten. Du arbeitest eng mit Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers und Business Stakeholdern zusammen, um Lösungen vom Prototyp bis in die Produktion zu entwickeln. Du bewertest neue Technologien, Frameworks und Architekturansätze und prüfst deren Eignung für unsere Produkte und Plattform. Du trägst zum Wissensaustausch im Team bei und unterstützt die Präsentation unserer Arbeit in internen und externen Communities. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Data Science, Statistik oder eines anderen quantitativen bzw. technischen Fachgebiets. Du bringst akademische und/oder berufliche Erfahrung in Data Science, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering oder einem verwandten quantitativen Bereich mit. Du beherrschst Python sehr gut und hast idealerweise Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktionsreifer Anwendungen und Datenpipelines. Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis von ML-, NLP- und GenAI-Konzepten und kannst geeignete Anwendungsfälle identifizieren sowie deren Eignung für geschäftliche Problemstellungen bewerten. Du konntest bereits Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KI-Anwendungen, einschließlich LLM- oder agentenbasierten Systemen, sammeln. Du kennst dich mit der Bewertung und dem Vergleich von ML- oder LLM-basierten Lösungen mithilfe geeigneter Kennzahlen und Experiment-Tracking-Tools wie MLflow aus. Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL und kannst Daten in relationalen Datenbanken oder analytischen Datenplattformen abfragen, transformieren und analysieren. Du kennst die grundlegenden Konzepte rund um Datenverarbeitung, Datenmodellierung und ETL/ELT. Du wendest bewährte Praktiken des Software Engineerings an, einschließlich Containerisierung (z. B. Docker), automatisiertem Testing, Versionskontrolle (Git) und CI/CD-Pipelines. Du bringst Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten Diensten mit, idealerweise in Microsoft Azure oder einer vergleichbaren Cloud-Plattform. DAS ZEICHNET DICH AUS Du verbindest analytisches Denken mit Software-Engineering-Prinzipien und hast Freude daran, datengetriebene Lösungen zu entwickeln, die produktiv eingesetzt werden können. Du kannst komplexe Probleme in handhabbare Komponenten zerlegen und Geschäftsanforderungen in effektive technische Lösungen übersetzen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, vom Verständnis der Daten über die Entwicklung einer Lösung bis hin zu deren Bereitstellung und Betrieb. Du arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams mit Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Ownern und Business Stakeholdern. Du bist pragmatisch und kannst Geschwindigkeit, technische Qualität und langfristige Wartbarkeit sinnvoll gegeneinander abwägen. Du kommunizierst sehr gut in Deutsch und Englisch. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Flexible Möglichkeiten der Arbeitsgestaltung in den Office-Räumen in Frankfurt am Main oder im Rahmen des mobilen Arbeitens Kostenfreie Getränke und Snacks im vent.io-Office Moderne Hardware, welche Du auch privat nutzen kannst Fitnessbudget, welches Du selbst in der emplu-App verwalten kannst Deine Zukunft, unser Beitrag: betriebliche Altersvorsorge Teilnahme an vent.io internen Veranstaltungen (Offsite, Kick-Off usw.) Raum für Verantwortungsübernahme, Qualität, Mitgestaltung und Teamgeist Start-up Flair mit der Sicherheit der Sparkassen Finanzgruppe im Rücken Du hast noch Fragen? items.desc: Das AIT Austrian Institute of Technology ist Österreichs größte Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) . Unser Ziel ist es, wissenschaftliche Exzellenz in Innovation mit Wirkung zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnerinnen und Partnern entwickeln wir Technologien und Lösungen für eine nachhaltige, resiliente und digitalisierte Zukunft und stärken damit die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und technologische Souveränität Europas. Die Competence Unit Transformation Governance im Center for Innovation Systems and Policy befasst sich mit aktuellen und zukünftigen Anforderungen an Forschungs- und Innovationssystemen, sowie mit den Handlungsoptionen, die sich hieraus für die Forschungs-, Technologie- und Innovationspolitik und ihre Akteure ergeben. Wir konzentrieren uns einerseits auf Prozesse des Systemwandels („Transformation“) in Bereichen wie KI, Energie und Mobilität und andererseits auf potenziell disruptive Technologien und ihre möglichen Auswirkungen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Digitalisierung und Dekarbonisierung von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Dabei geht es auch um die Stärkung von Akteuren in den Sektoren öffentliche Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Infrastruktur und Wissenschaft. Für den Standort Wien (Giefinggasse, 1210) suchen wir eine:n Junior Scientist (w/m/d) für AI Governance. Ihre Aufgaben: Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem interdisziplinären KI Ethik- und Governance Lab an innovationspolitischen Fragestellungen im Kontext der Transformation von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft , insbesondere an Themen der KI Governance. Sie wirken zunächst insbesondere im Kontext der AI:AT AI Factory Austria am Aufbau und an der Umsetzung der AI Governance Sie begleiten gemeinsam mit der AIT AI Taskforce den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung des neuen AIT AI Ethik Boards. Sie arbeiten häufig transdisziplinär mit Kooperationspartner:innen aus Verwaltung, Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Zivilgesellschaft . Im Team werden gemeinsam mit nationalen und internationalen Kooperationspartner:innen Projekte entwickelt und durchgeführt , bei denen qualitative und quantitative Methoden zum Einsatz kommen. Sie erarbeiten Forschungsergebnisse und kommunizieren diese gegenüber Auftraggeber:innen aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Wissenschaft. Sie publizieren die Ergebnisse Ihrer Forschungsarbeiten und Ihrer Arbeit für das AIT AI Ethik Board in wissenschaftlichen und politikorientierten Kanälen sowie in sozialen Medien. Als Ingenious Partner zeichnet Sie aus: Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Soziologie, Politikwissenschaft, STS oder einer verwandten Studienrichtung Auseinandersetzung mit dem Thema KI während oder nach dem Studium Wissen in den Bereichen KI Ethik und KI Governance von Vorteil Methodenausbildung in qualitativen und quantitativen Methoden der empirischen Sozialforschung Interesse an aktuellen forschungs- und innovationspolitischen Fragestellungen mit Relevanz für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Bereitschaft zur inter- und transdisziplinären Arbeit Erste Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit von Vorteil Selbstständige, verlässliche und genaue Arbeitsweise, Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Was Sie erwarten können: Das Bruttojahresgehalt bei Vollzeit (38,5 h / Woche) gemäß Kollektivvertrag beträgt etwa EUR 56.784, --. Das aktuelle Gehalt wird entsprechend Ihren Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen individuell festgelegt. Zu den Highlights unserer Mitarbeiter:innen-Benefits zählen eine Kantine mit Essenszuschuss, Bio-Kaffee, Tee und Obstkörbe, Angebote zur Gesundheitsvorsorge sowie ein Betriebsarzt, eine Pensionskasse, zusätzliche freie Tage für verschiedene Lebensereignisse, Familienbenefits (einschließlich zwei Wochen bezahlter Papawochen und Freizeitförderungen), ein Gutscheinprogramm, Sport-, Kultur- und Teamevents sowie viele weitere Benefits. Darüber hinaus bieten wir Gleitzeitmodelle (inkl. bis zu 50 % Homeoffice), Unterstützung bei Konferenzreisen und Networking sowie individuelle Weiterbildungs und Karriereemöglichkeiten. Am AIT schaffen wir ein inklusives und familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld, das Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt in der Belegschaft sowie in Führungspositionen gezielt ausbaut. Bitte übermitteln Sie uns Ihre kompletten Bewerbungsunterlagen, bestehend aus Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, relevanten Zeugnissen und Dokumenten sowie einem Identitätsnachweis , online.

items.desc: Kan du navigere i komplekse tekniske udfordringer, og har du erfaring med teknologier relateret til udvikling og drift af GenAI-løsninger? Og kan du blive ved, når det virkelig gælder? Så er du måske vores nye GenAI-specialist i PET’s IT-afdeling. Her udvikler og implementerer vi GenAI-løsninger, som understøtter PET's analytikere og efterforskere i arbejdet med at beskytte rigsfællesskabet. PET er i gang med en digital transformation. Vi styrker vores digitale kapacitet og udvikler både teknologien, fundamentet og måden, vi arbejder på, så vi står stærkere til at løse PET’s opgaver i en stadig mere digital virkelighed. Det kræver stærke IT-kompetencer hele vejen rundt; fra det, der skal virke i dag, til det, vi bygger for fremtiden Fra model til løsning, der virker AI & Machine Learning-teamet er i fuld gang med at udvikle og implementere GenAI-løsninger via vores GenAI-platform. Vi sigter højt og leder efter dig, der både kan arbejde teknisk med løsningerne og være med til at finde ud af, hvordan teknologien skaber reel værdi. Det betyder, at du kan komme ind forskellige steder i arbejdet. Nogle gange skal et behov afdækkes og oversættes til noget, der kan bygges. Andre gange handler det om at integrere en model med eksisterende systemer, afprøve et nyt framework eller forbedre den tooling, som resten af teamet bruger. Det interessante begynder ofte dér, hvor den oplagte løsning ikke helt passer til virkeligheden. For løsningerne skal fungere i vores air-gapped on-prem-miljø, hvor sikkerhed og robusthed er en grundlæggende præmis. Det stiller krav til både de tekniske valg og din evne til at finde en vej frem, når standardløsningen ikke kan bruges. Du Kommer Blandt Andet Til At udvikle og implementere GenAI-løsninger via vores GenAI-platform integrere GenAI-modeller og applikationer med eksisterende systemer og datakilder undersøge nye GenAI-teknologier og frameworks og vurdere, hvor de giver mening hos os forbedre tooling til GenAI-udvikling, blandt andet inden for model-tracking, eksperimentstyring og automatisering etablere og dele best practices for sikker, etisk og effektiv brug af GenAI hjælpe kolleger godt i gang med platformen gennem dokumentation, onboarding, workshops og faglig sparring. Afhængigt af det tekniske niveau i din profil ville du også kunne spille en rolle i procesafdækning og være bindeled mellem dem, der har et behov, og dem, der skal udvikle løsningen. Når den første løsning ikke er den rigtige Vi arbejder med teknologi, hvor der sjældent findes ét oplagt svar. Derfor søger vi en specialist, der bliver ved, også når noget viser sig mere udfordrende end forventet. Du undersøger mulighederne, udfordrer de første antagelser og finder den pragmatiske løsning inden for de rammer, vi har. Nogle gange betyder det, at du må tænke kreativt. Andre gange er den bedste løsning den mindst smarte, men den, der faktisk virker. Og når du har fundet en god vej frem, sørger du for, at resten af teamet kan forstå den og bygge videre på dit arbejde. Det gør du ikke alene. Vi sparrer, deler viden og diskuterer løsninger med hinanden. Vi har forskellige faglige og uddannelsesmæssige baggrunde, fra universiteter og erhvervsakademier til Forsvaret, politiet og selvlærte veje ind i IT. Det interessante for os er ikke kun, hvad der står på dit eksamensbevis eller din nuværende jobtitel. Vi er mindst lige så interesserede i, hvad du kan, hvordan du angriber et svært problem, og hvad du har lyst til at lære. Omgangstonen er uformel, og der er plads til at udfordre hinandens idéer. Til gengæld tager vi det, vi bygger, alvorligt. Du er nysgerrig nok til at undersøge og vedholdende nok til at komme i mål Du har erfaring med GenAI og open source-sprogmodeller og forstår, det der kræves for at få teknologien fra eksperiment til en løsning, der kan bruges. Vi Forestiller Os Især, At Du har praktisk erfaring med udvikling eller implementering af GenAI-løsninger kan arbejde med open source-sprogmodeller og sætte dig ind i nye modeller, frameworks og værktøjer ser sammenhænge på tværs af applikationer, platforme og behov kan finde pragmatiske løsninger, også når de tekniske forudsætninger gør opgaven vanskelig dokumenterer og deler dit arbejde, så andre kan forstå, bruge og videreudvikle det. Kendskab til Linux, Python, vLLM, FastAPI, Git, basal CI/CD eller Docker er værdifuldt. Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have arbejdet med alle teknologierne fra starten. Vi lægger samtidig mærke til, hvordan du arbejder. Du søger sparring, når det gør løsningen bedre, og deler selv den viden, andre kan bruge. Du er nysgerrig på nye teknologier uden at vælge noget alene, fordi det er nyt. Og når prioriteter eller forudsætninger ændrer sig, kan du omstille dig uden at slippe opgaven. Kort sagt leder vi efter en, der kan lide at få ting til at virke, også når det kræver et ekstra forsøg. Vis os gerne, hvad du har bygget Vi vil gerne se, hvad du konkret har arbejdet med, også hvis noget af din erfaring kommer fra projekter uden for …

items.title: ML Engineer – Forecasting, Optimización y MLOps
items.card: Buscamos un/a ML Engineer con experiencia en productivización de modelos de Machine Learning, previsión de demanda (Forecasting) y modelos de optimización para incorporarse a un proyecto del sector bancario. La persona participará en la industrialización de modelos ya desarrollados, trabajando para llevarlos a entornos productivos con garantías de robustez, escalabilidad, trazabilidad y mantenibilidad. El objetivo
items.desc: Buscamos un/a ML Engineer con experiencia en productivización de modelos de Machine Learning, previsión de demanda (Forecasting) y modelos de optimización para incorporarse a un proyecto del sector bancario. La persona participará en la industrialización de modelos ya desarrollados, trabajando para llevarlos a entornos productivos con garantías de robustez, escalabilidad, trazabilidad y mantenibilidad. El objetivo principal será transformar modelos analíticos en soluciones preparadas para producción, colaborando en la mejora de modelos de previsión de demanda basados en series temporales y modelos de optimización aplicados a la toma de decisiones operativas. Responsabilidades Productivizar modelos de Machine Learning existentes, adaptándolos a los estándares técnicos y operativos del entorno bancario. Analizar y mejorar modelos de forecasting y previsión de demanda basados en series temporales. Diseñar y adaptar pipelines de entrenamiento, inferencia y generación de predicciones. Trabajar con entornos Azure Databricks y PySpark. Evaluar estrategias de reentrenamiento, actualización de modelos y persistencia de artefactos. Participar en la optimización de modelos y decisiones operativas, incluyendo la optimización de denominaciones. Integrar modelos con MLflow y herramientas corporativas de gobierno y despliegue. Aplicar buenas prácticas MLOps: versionado, testing, CI/CD, monitorización y trazabilidad. Diagnosticar incidencias en producción y realizar análisis de causa raíz. Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering, Data Science, Plataforma y Negocio. Documentar soluciones, decisiones técnicas y procedimientos operativos. Requisitos imprescindibles Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, MLOps, Data Science Engineering o posiciones similares. Experiencia real llevando modelos de Machine Learning a producción. Experiencia con forecasting, series temporales o modelos de previsión de demanda. Conocimientos aplicados de modelos de optimización, programación matemática o heurísticas. Python avanzado aplicado a Machine Learning y productivización. Conocimientos de Machine Learning supervisado y validación de modelos. SQL para consulta, transformación y validación de datos. Experiencia con PySpark / Apache Spark. Experiencia con Azure Databricks o plataformas analíticas equivalentes. Experiencia con MLflow o herramientas similares de gestión y seguimiento de modelos. Git y herramientas de CI/CD como Jenkins o GitHub Actions. Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: modularización, testing, logging, control de errores y documentación. Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física, Data Science o similar. Español fluido e inglés técnico.

items.desc: ¿Te interesa llevar modelos de machine learning a producción de verdad, con criterios de escalabilidad, trazabilidad y negocio? En NTT DATA buscamos una persona con experiencia como ML Engineer para incorporarse a un proyecto relevante en un cliente de Barcelona. Formarás parte de un equipo que trabaja en la industrialización de soluciones de IA, conectando desarrollo, cloud y operación para que los modelos generen impacto más allá del entorno experimental. En NTT DATA encontrarás la escala y diversidad de una compañía tecnológica global, junto con equipos cercanos que comparten conocimiento, se apoyan y buscan hacer las cosas mejor. Trabajamos en proyectos que combinan tecnología, negocio e innovación, sin conformarnos con soluciones que solo funcionan sobre el papel. Tu reto: Convertir soluciones de machine learning en productos fiables, desplegables y sostenibles en un entorno Azure. Qué harás en tu día a día: Desarrollar, entrenar y evolucionar modelos de machine learning con Python . Diseñar y mantener pipelines de entrenamiento, validación y despliegue de modelos. Trabajar con servicios cloud de Microsoft Azure , especialmente en entornos de Azure Machine Learning. Aplicar prácticas de MLOps para asegurar versionado, reproducibilidad, monitorización y calidad de los modelos. Colaborar con perfiles de Data Science, Data Engineering, arquitectura y negocio para llevar casos de uso a producción. Optimizar el rendimiento, la mantenibilidad y la escalabilidad de las soluciones desarrolladas. Participar en decisiones técnicas y proponer mejoras sobre herramientas, procesos y arquitectura. Qué buscamos: Al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones de Machine Learning con Python. Experiencia práctica con Azure y, preferiblemente, con Azure Machine Learning . Conocimientos de ciclo de vida de modelos: entrenamiento, evaluación, despliegue y monitorización. Experiencia con herramientas y prácticas de MLOps: CI/CD, control de versiones, contenerización o automatización de pipelines. Capacidad para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinares y trasladar necesidades de negocio a soluciones técnicas. Interés por seguir profundizando en IA aplicada, cloud y operación de modelos. Qué encontrarás en NTT DATA: Un proyecto en el que tu trabajo ayudará a que la IA llegue a producción con impacto tangible. Espacio para crecer en especialización técnica, asumir retos progresivamente más complejos y compartir conocimiento con otras personas expertas. Una modalidad de trabajo híbrida en Barcelona , diseñada para combinar colaboración y flexibilidad. Acceso al paquete de beneficios de NTT DATA España . Una cultura en la que la cercanía, la colaboración y el respeto por las personas forman parte de la manera de trabajar. En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad. #WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique Make THIS the place to GROW

items.desc: Internship details Periode: 4 – 6 maanden Uren: 32 - 40 Locatie: Amsterdam ITO office Start datum: Flexibel, eerste werkdag van de maand Als stagiair Data & AI draai je mee in het team wat verantwoordelijk is voor diverse projecten voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Het Data & AI team focust zich voornamelijk op het verbeteren en/of automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen middels het implementeren van technologische toepassingen bij klanten in diverse industrieën. Tijdens de periode doe je onderzoek naar een onderwerp wat jij interessant vindt en kun je gebruik maken van onze expertise en technologieën. Team: Het team binnen Data & AI bestaat uit ca. 200 collega’s. Je vaste begeleider is een senior consultant met veel ervaring in het vak. Daarnaast worden stagairs opgenomen in de Technology General Practice Interns – community van alle stagairs in de overkoepelende Technology General Practice– die je op weg helpt in de brede Accenture wereld. Dagelijkse taken: Tijdens jouw internship hebben we iedere week een meeting met de gehele community op ons kantoor. Verder ben je gedurende de dag bezig met jouw onderzoek, voer je taken uit zoals het ontwikkelen van een proof of concept (PoC), en netwerk je met collega’s om aan benodigde kennis te komen. Technologie: Binnen het domein Data & AI werken we samen met onze klanten om allerlei digitale technologieën te implementeren. Data: De waarde van data is cruciaal voor het creëren van extra waarde voor onze klanten en het ontwikkelen van oplossingen. Als Accenture hebben wij een Data-driven approach richting onze klanten om het onderscheid te maken. Geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan met jouw cv en motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft waar je onderzoek naar wil doen. Je kunt jouw motivatiebrief toevoegen in ons Workday systeem. Wie wij zijn Dankzij ongeëvenaarde branche-ervaring, toonaangevende technologieën van onze ecosysteempartners en startups en het grootste delivery network ter wereld, bieden wij een krachtig scala aan mogelijkheden die kunnen worden afgestemd op de meest complexe behoeften van onze klanten. Met meer dan 100 innovation hubs wereldwijd helpen we klanten voortdurend te innoveren – snel en schaalbaar – zodat zij hun concurrenten voor kunnen blijven. Jij brengt innovatie, intelligentie en branchekennis samen met de nieuwste technologieën om klanten te helpen innoveren en hun bedrijf te transformeren. Technology is een van de vijf diensten die samen One Accenture vormen – de andere zijn Strategy & Consulting, Operations, Song en Industry X. items.desc: Ready to put what you’ve learned during your studies into practice and tackle real-world challenges, helping a growing international Software as a Service company become more AI-enabled and data-driven? Join UNIwise as an AI & Data Analyst Intern at our headquarter in Aarhus - starting as soon as possible in early 2027, for approximately 20 weeks. What you will do We already have a number of internal AI tools in place and a clear, ambitious strategy to make even better use of AI across the business. You will assist our commercial AI Lead in developing new internal AI tools, while also maintaining and improving our existing tools and integrations, helping turn that ambition into effective everyday use. Alongside this, you will support our Finance Manager and CFO in delivering on our data and BI ambitions. This includes helping optimise our master data management and use of databases, as well as improving reports and dashboards, with the clear aim to be a more data-driven organisation. Your primary contact person will be our CFO and you will also work closely with our Finance team, our commercial AI Lead, the management team and colleagues in our administrative functions to connect technology and data with everyday business needs. In practice, your tasks will include: AI Tools – operations and development: Help maintain and further develop our internal AI tools and integrations. You will troubleshoot issues, build automations and workflows, help set up new tools and support colleagues adopting the tools. AI strategy and adoption: Support our commercial AI Lead and the rest of the organisation where relevant in driving and implementing our strategy for internal use of AI. This includes mapping processes where AI can save time or improve quality, testing solutions with colleagues and following up on usage and value. Master data management: Assist our Finance Manager in mapping and optimising master data management across our systems and improving our use of databases. BI and reporting: Help develop and optimise BI reports and dashboards that improve our reporting and make insights clear and useful for management and the wider organisation. Who we’re looking for You are enrolled in a higher education programme and can start an internship of approximately 20 weeks as soon as possible. There may be an opportunity to continue as a student assistant afterwards. Your field of study could be Business Intelligence, Computer Science, IT Architecture or a related programme, ideally in the Aarhus area. You are curious about AI and have experimented with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot, and want to explore how technology and data can create value for colleagues. You can write simple scripts, work with databases or set up integrations - or are quick to learn. You are interested in data quality, data structures and BI, and enjoy turning data into clear, useful insights. You work in a structured and independent way, take initiative and follow tasks through, with the ambition to build solutions that remain useful after your internship. You communicate clearly in Danish and English and enjoy helping colleagues understand and use new tools. What you can expect from us Hands-on experience with internal AI tools, data management and BI tasks in an international SaaS company. Close collaboration with our Finance team and commercial AI Lead on practical business challenges. An internship with real responsibility and the opportunity to take ownership of tools and improvements. The opportunity to develop both your technical skills and business understanding. Delicious lunch scheme to fuel the energy throughout the day. A friendly and collaborative work environment and a culture built on trust that empowers creativity and encourages continuous learning professionally and personally. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a cover letter. Tell us about an AI tool, automation or BI project you have built or used, and the problem it helped solve. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible and no later than 30 November 2026. For questions about the internship, please contact CFO Peder Dahl at peder.dahl@uniwise.dk. About Us UNIwise is a Danish EdTech company behind WISEflow, a platform for digital examinations and assessment. More than 150 higher education institutions in over 14 European countries use our solutions. In addition to WISEflow, we develop solutions including Originality, Marking Studio, AI-Assisted Feedback and Proctoring.

Formarás parte de un equipo dinámico en el que realmente te desarrollarás y crecerás como profesional. Trabajarás con un equipo multidisciplinar que te apoyará en todo momento. Formarás parte de una red de más de 100.000 profesionales que trabajan para crear un mundo más sostenible. ENGIE es la respuesta si... Buscas un proyecto profesional sólido y con proyección profesional. Valoras formar parte del primer grupo energético independiente del mundo. Quieres crecer y desarrollarte dentro de una compañía dinámica y retadora. Si consideras que tu trabajo, sumado al esfuerzo de las personas que forman parte de la compañía, puede y debe tener un reflejo positivo en el entorno. items.desc: Interested in a career that matters? Are you enthusiastic about transforming laboratory workflows through automation, AI, data science, and emerging technologies? Do you enjoy turning innovative ideas into practical solutions that make a real difference for scientists and technicians? Then we might be looking for you. At Novonesis, we are building the next generation of Global Quality Control laboratories. Within Global Assay Innovation and Automation, Global LIMS, Automation & Digitalization develops and implements technology solutions that help shape the laboratory of the future. We are looking for a curious and solution-oriented Data Scientist who is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and intelligent solutions. Working at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, automation, and business processes, you will use technologies such as Python, AI, and advanced analytics to optimize workflows, increase transparency, and enable smarter decision-making across our global QC operations. You will join our Digital Tools team as its fourth member and become part of a department of 25+ dedicated colleagues. We work in a fast-evolving environment where curiosity, innovation, and collaboration are encouraged, giving you the opportunity to explore emerging technologies and turn new ideas into globally relevant solutions. You will act as a bridge between technology and business needs, helping turn complex data and laboratory challenges into practical solutions that create measurable value. Your Key Responsibilities In This Role Drive digitalization and automation initiatives using technologies such as Python, Databricks, Power BI, machine learning, and RPA. Ensure data integrity, compliance, and traceability across global laboratory systems. Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and compliance experts to develop scalable, value-creating digital solutions. Act as a bridge between technical development and business needs in global projects. Manage projects and drive change in a structured way, taking ownership of solutions from development through implementation and ongoing support. Design and maintain analytical dashboards and KPIs that provide actionable insights into laboratory performance. What you’ll need to be successful in this role We are looking for someone who combines strong data capabilities with curiosity, initiative, and an interest in solving real laboratory and business challenges and: Holds an MSc or PhD in engineering, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. Has strong programming skills and experience with machine learning, and data-driven solution development. Has experience with data processing, analytics, and technologies such as Power BI, Databricks, Python, and SQL. Is comfortable communicating and collaborating in English. Enjoys combining hands-on data work with stakeholder engagement and translating business needs into technical solutions. Takes ownership of the solutions you build, including the support and updates needed after implementation. Thrives in a collaborative, agile, and fast-changing environment where you can take initiative and drive progress. Additional Skills & Interests We Value Experience from QC, QA, or laboratory environments, including familiarity with LIMS or other digital systems used in regulated environments, would be an advantage. What We Offer You You will become part of a multidisciplinary environment where scientific expertise meets data, digitalization, and automation. You will have the opportunity to explore emerging technologies, develop solutions with global impact, and contribute to the broader digital transformation of our QC laboratories. Application deadline: November 15th, 2026. We will screen incoming applications and invite for interviews continuously during the application period, so please apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications via our Career Site. Contact information: Senior Department Manager Hanne Jarmer at HJR@novonesis.com. Conocimientos de Machine Learning supervisado y validación de modelos. SQL para consulta, transformación y validación de datos. Experiencia con PySpark / Apache Spark. Experiencia con Azure Databricks o plataformas analíticas equivalentes. Experiencia con MLflow o herramientas similares de gestión y seguimiento de modelos. Git y herramientas de CI/CD como Jenkins o GitHub Actions. Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: modularización, testing, logging, control de errores y documentación. items.desc: Department: Sustainability Data Solutions & AI Location: Bagsværd, Denmark Your impact begins here As an intern in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI, you will turn sustainability data into insight Novo can act on. You will develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, and help make that data cleaner, more reliable and easier to reuse. Working on real business challenges alongside experienced data analysts and engineers, you will see your work support decisions across the organisation. What You’ll Bring You are curious, analytical and motivated by using data and technology to solve sustainability challenges. You are a student, and you bring: A basic understanding of sustainability, environmental data or ESG topics, for example energy, water or greenhouse gas emissions. Experience with Power BI or another data visualisation or BI tool. Experience with at least one coding language, such as Python. An interest in AI, automation and advanced analytics, and in how they can be applied to sustainability challenges. A structured way of working with a clear eye for detail, and the ability to work independently while supporting those around you. The ability to explain data clearly to colleagues with less technical insight, with strong written and spoken English. Familiarity with data engineering, data pipelines or cloud-based analytics platforms, such as Databricks. Knowledge of statistical modelling, operational research or operations management. Experience with larger datasets, including data cleaning, transformation, validation or analysis. What You’ll Do You will contribute to real projects, taking ownership of selected tasks while supporting the wider team’s initiatives. Your work will help strengthen how sustainability data is collected, integrated, analysed and used across Novo. Develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, turning operational data into actionable business insight. Support the integration and automation of sustainability data in the Sustainability Data Foundation, including data pipelines and automated recurring reporting and data-quality controls in Databricks. Improve the quality, transparency and availability of sustainability data by creating clean, reliable and reusable datasets in line with the FAIR principles: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable. Support the digitalisation of sustainability data and analytics by connecting sustainability information with relevant business and operational metrics. Contribute to BI solutions for reporting, forecasting and decision-making, as well as ad hoc analyses across sustainability data and technology. Who You’ll Work With You will join the Sustainability Data Solutions & AI team, part of the Sustainability Strategy and Insights department. The team of data analysts and data engineers drives data analytics on the sustainability agenda for Novo. The department has eight colleagues at headquarters, two in Poland and two in Bangalore, India, so you will work with colleagues across locations. You will also work closely with stakeholders across Novo who are helping to implement the sustainability strategy across the value chain. Your manager will be [insert hiring manager name]. You will move work forward by bringing technical depth and clear communication together, from deep dives into the data to conversations with colleagues who are less familiar with it. What You Can Expect Here You will work on real business challenges, with room to take ownership and make your voice heard. You will learn from experienced data and sustainability professionals, build practical skills in tools such as Databricks and Power BI, and see how data and AI are applied to sustainability across a global organisation. The pace is fast, and you will be supported to perform at your best. If allowed by your educational institution, the internship is paid at a fixed monthly base rate of DKK 15,900, plus a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution). Start now Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn sustainability data into insight and progress, apply for the Internship in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI by November 20, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

items.desc: Data Scientist Focused on Revenue Management & Network Optimization At SAS, we're passionate about transforming aviation with cutting-edge technology. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making to create smarter customer experiences and stronger commercial performance. As part of our AI Team, you'll shape the future of air travel by creating innovative, data-driven solutions that maximize revenue. You will work on one of the most challenging and rewarding problems in the industry: finding the right price, for the right customer, at the right time. Your work will ensure that the airline's Revenue Optimization remains scientifically robust, operationally scalable, and commercially impactful, directly shaping how revenue is optimized in a dynamic, competitive marketplace. Your responsibilities will center on turning business challenges into well-defined analytical problems and building end-to-end machine learning solutions that deliver measurable impact. You will design, train, and maintain models that power SAS's revenue optimization, ensuring they are accurate, scalable, and production-ready. A priority will be to deliver dynamic pricing, a groundbreaking shift in how SAS competes in the marketplace. At the same time, we are developing AI-driven revenue optimization at scale, ensuring our models continuously learn, adapt, and evolve with industry dynamics. Your work will help SAS unlock the full potential of AI in airline revenue optimization, making smarter pricing and network decisions a reality today. Challenges You Will Work On Machine Learning & Optimization Techniques Build and deploy algorithms that power revenue and network decisions. Among other solutions, you'll develop demand forecasting, purchase probability, and revenue optimization models, leveraging a broad spectrum of AI methods. From classical ensemble methods to deep learning architectures and reinforcement learning frameworks, you'll select the most effective approach for each complex problem. Operations Research Beyond building models, you'll explore new formulations, test novel algorithms and findings that push the boundaries of airline revenue optimization. You will convert advanced research into production-ready optimization and modeling solutions, collaborating with the Operations Research team to embed novel algorithms into initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. MLOps Leverage end-to-end ML infrastructure to take models from research to production at scale. This includes designing reproducible training and inference pipelines, integrating CI/CD workflows for seamless deployment, and ensuring robust monitoring to detect drift and trigger automated retraining, keeping models stable and accurate in production. The Team We are a central machine learning team within SAS Digital & IT that collaborates closely with stakeholders across various business units, identifying business challenges and opportunities that can be addressed through advanced analytics. As SAS continues to strengthen its AI and advanced analytics capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable machine learning solutions, and engineering practices that enable AI to create measurable value across the business. We work with diverse machine learning projects, collaborate and contribute to the machine learning practice to ensure that we have a solid foundation for SAS to scale and realize the full potential of machine learning. We are now strengthening our team with an experienced Data Scientist focused primarily on optimization projects within Revenue Management and Network, enhancing our advanced analytics capabilities to drive continuous business optimization. To be successful we believe you have Master's Degree or higher with strong mathematics focus (Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Optimization, Computer Science) or related field. At least 3 years of industry experience within the Data Science domain. Proven record of taking on loosely defined problems and translating them into practical applications. Strong mathematical background (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, statistics, optimization). More than 3 years' experience with Python, SQL and popular machine/deep learning libraries. Proficient with statistical and machine learning models (both supervised and unsupervised learning). Well-versed in cloud computing. Prior experience with Azure is a big plus. We believe you share our passion for data and algorithms. You're self-driven, persistent, creative, and curious, with a strong passion for learning. Job Description You will join our Data team , currently in its growth phase, with a twofold challenge: industrializing a platform able to absorb massive real-time volumes (1,000,000 events per second), and turning that critical mass of information into tangible product value. This Role Deliberately Straddles Two Worlds Within the Data team, you build and harden the pipelines that feed the entire company. As reinforcement for our tech and product squads, you join pitches that call for genuine mathematical, statistical and algorithmic depth: designing, adapting and implementing the advanced algorithms behind the features we want to build and then shipping them to production yourself. Understand the business needs of our analysts and Product Managers, and translate them into an algorithmic methodology or a statistical learning model. Select, adapt or design the right algorithm, including when the answer isn't an off-the-shelf model: heuristics, statistical methods, graph algorithms, anomaly detection, and so on. Define the evaluation metrics and demonstrate that the solution genuinely answers the need, at our scale. Ship it and keep it running (MLOps hat) Deploy your algorithms to production for the long run, within a quality assurance process: automated testing, continuous integration, code review. Industrialize the model lifecycle: packaging, reproducibility, versioning, retraining, monitoring and drift tracking. Propose innovative solutions to ensure the resilience and performance of our processing under heavy load. Empower your colleagues by providing the tools they need to leverage high-quality data independently. Bring a critical eye and contribute to the team's growth (knowledge sharing, mentoring). 📍 The position is ideally based in Paris, or can be based in Rennes, with up to 3 remote days per week. You are proficient in Python and its scientific ecosystem: pandas, scikit-learn, as well as SQL. You have strong skills in algorithms, complexity classes, optimization, and machine learning: you can reason about an algorithm before implementing it, and estimate what it will cost at scale. You are an engineer, not just a prototyper: you write tested, reviewed, maintainable code, and you are comfortable with continuous integration and software engineering best practices. You are a proactive "doer": autonomous and mature, you take ownership of your subjects rather than waiting for instructions. You are driven by efficiency and resilience, capable of building systems that stay performant under heavy loads. You are deeply curious about new trends in the data ecosystem and about technological change. You write and speak English fluently. 🚀 Bonus Point You have experience in cybersecurity You are comfortable with Spark (PySpark). Don't hesitate to apply, and tell us in the cover letter section why we absolutely must meet! items.desc: AI and data are becoming part of more business processes. To make sure that security keeps pace, we are looking for an AI Security Engineer to help us build and improve secure AI capabilities in our Cyber Defense Center (CDC). You will bring together security engineering, platform integration, and AI expertise to support AI capabilities across CDC platforms and the security monitoring of AI services used throughout the organization.
