Build and maintain security monitoring for AI and data platforms. Look for ways AI workloads or their supporting infrastructure could be attacked or misused. Help build scalable ways to onboard AI and data platforms, such as Databricks or similar environments. Set up agreed logging and connect security-relevant data from AI platforms. Deliver your part of projects with support from senior engineers and the Product Owner. Make technical decisions within your area and raise those with a wider impact. Use and promote good engineering practices and help us improve how we work. Help adopt modern Azure services and emerging AI technologies. Document your work and share what you know with the team. You’ll have room to take ownership, shape technical solutions, and work with people across security and engineering. What Makes This a Good Place To Work Real AI security: Help build and secure AI capabilities that strengthen threat detection and investigation across the CDC. Room to learn and grow: Support for certification, training, and continuous development. Hybrid working that works: A strong home office culture, flexible time off, and a setup where you can work from home most of the time. We meet in the office once a week. People-first team: Down-to-earth colleagues, open communication, and no unnecessary formalities. No ego, no blame. Just real support. The tools you need: A company laptop and iPhone with a fully paid plan. Benefits that add up: Cafeteria up to 20,000 CZK, pension contributions, a MultiSport card, meal allowance, a discount on life insurance, and a contribution to home office expenses. Referral bonus: Up to 60,000 CZK for bringing new colleagues on board. Onboarding built around you: More in-person support during your probation period to help you settle in. What You’ll Bring 2-5 years of relevant experience. Professional knowledge of cloud and DevOps tooling. A good understanding of AI, LLM, and ML technologies and their security risks. Experience designing AI workflows and connecting them to business processes and third-party systems. Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. A responsible approach and the ability to follow through. The ability to make decisions within your technical area and flag those with a wider impact. Advanced English at C1 level. A university degree. What Happens After You Apply Send us your CV in English. If your experience looks like a good match, we’ll get in touch and keep the conversation going. You can expect three rounds: first, a chat with HR and the hiring manager to get to know each other and talk about the role; then, a technical interview with the Product Owner and members of the team; and finally, a short call with the CDC manager. AI Solutions & Insights: Utvikle analyser og AI-løsninger som gir bedre innsikt, støtter beslutninger og forbedrer arbeidsprosesser. Hvem ser vi etter? Du har fullført en relevant utdanning på masternivå (NHH, CBS, NTNU, BI, NMBU, UiO, UiB og anerkjente internasjonale universiteter). Du har erfaring med å forstå et forretningsbehov og omsette det til en konkret leveranse . Du kan forklare hvilke valg du tok, hva du selv hadde ansvar for, og hvilken verdi arbeidet skapte. Avhengig av fagprofilen din har du erfaring med noen , men ikke nødvendigvis alle, av disse områdene: Klassisk AI, AI-assistenter, agenter eller bruk av AI til å forbedre arbeidsprosesser Dataplattformer og skytjenester som Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Innsikt og visualisering gjennom Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, Power Platform eller skreddersydde applikasjoner Programmering, datamodellering, datatransformasjon og datapipelines med for eksempel Python, SQL, PySpark eller DAX Som seniorkonsulent forventer vi i tillegg at du kan ta større ansvar for leveranser, gjøre faglige avveininger og bidra til å utvikle både løsninger og kolleger. Hvorfor Deloitte? Hos oss får du jobbe med reelle problemer, tverrfaglige team og virksomheter med ulike behov. Du får et inkluderende fagmiljø, tilgang til et globalt nettverk og tydelige muligheter for læring og utvikling – blant annet gjennom Faglig Community og Deloitte University . Du får muligheten til å jobbe i et selskap som hjelper andre aktører med sin grønne omstilling, samtidig som vi arbeider målrettet med egne ambisjoner innenfor både klima og miljø og samfunnsansvar. Som ansatt i Deloitte integreres bærekraft i arbeidshverdagen, og du får anledning til å bidra i ulike prosjekter og initiativer knyttet til dette. Som samfunnsaktør, arbeidsgiver og tjenesteleverandør har Deloitte et stort fokus på mangfold og inkludering. Vi ser at ulike perspektiver fremmer nytenkning, gir dypere innsikt og bedre beslutninger, og ikke minst mobiliserer potensialet til medarbeiderne våre! Vi ønsker derfor et stort mangfold blant søkere.

items.desc: Ausschreibungs-ID: ZE-0086-MCDCI-wmz-2026 Eintrittstermin: nächstmöglich Bewerbungsfrist: 29.11.2026 Entgeltgruppe: E 13 TV-H Befristung: 31.07.2027 Umfang: Teilzeit (50 %) Die 1527 gegründete Philipps-Universität bietet vielfach ausgezeichnete Lehre für rund 22.000 Studierende und stellt sich mit exzellenter Forschung in der Breite der Wissenschaft den wichtigen Themen unserer Zeit. Am Marburg Center for Digital Culture and Infrastructure (MCDCI) und am Institut für Medienwissenschaft ist im Drittmittelprojekt DiCi-Hub (Digital Cinema Hub): A Research Hub for Digital Film Studies zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt befristet bis 31.07.2027 eine drittmittelfinanzierte Teilzeitstelle (50 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit) als Wissenschaftliche r Mitarbeiter in (Data Science) zu besetzen. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach Entgeltgruppe 13 des Tarifvertrages des Landes Hessen. Das MCDCI ist ein interdisziplinäres wissenschaftliches Zentrum, das digitale Methoden in den Geistes- und Sozialwissenschaften sowie die digitale Transformation von Gesellschaft, Kultur und Wissenschaft erforscht. Das MCDCI wird von der Philipps-Universität Marburg gemeinsam mit dem Herder-Institut für historische Ostmitteleuropaforschung – Institut der Leibniz-Gemeinschaft, dem Hessischen Landesarchiv, der Archivschule Marburg – Hochschule für Archivwissenschaft sowie dem Hessischen Institut für Landesgeschichte getragen. Das Projekt „DiCi-Hub (Digital Cinema-Hub): A Research Hub for Digital Film Studies“ wird von der VolkswagenStiftung im Rahmen der Förderinitiative „Weltwissen – Strukturelle Stärkung Kleiner Fächer“ gefördert und von der Philipps-Universität Marburg federführend in Kooperation mit der Filmwissenschaft der Universitäten Mainz und Frankfurt durchgeführt. Das Projekt entwickelt digitale Tools und Methoden für die filmwissenschaftliche Lehre und Forschung mit den Schwerpunkten Netzwerke (Marburg), Formate (Mainz) und Märkte (Frankfurt). Die Stelle bietet eine anregende kollegiale Forschungsumgebung, anspruchsvolle anwendungsbezogene Explorationen, vielfältige disziplinäre und transdisziplinäre Vernetzungen auf regionaler, nationaler und internationaler Ebene und eine aktive Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung eines internationalen Profils. In Marburg ist das Projekt eingebunden in eine dynamisch wachsende Forschungsumgebung von verwandten Projekten und Institutionen, die sich rund um das „Marburg Center for Digital Culture and Infrastructure“ (MCDCI) gruppieren, mit dem eng kooperiert wird. Zu den Projekten gehören u. a. FID Media (media/rep/), NFDI4Culture und AVefi - Automatisiertes Verbundsystem für audiovisuelle Bestände über einheitliche Filmidentifikatoren. items.title: ML Engineer (Fully Remote)
items.card: In this role, you will bridge the gap between research and production, taking models out of notebooks and packaging them into versioned, production-ready artifacts served behind standardised APIs. You will own inference performance, cost, and output provenance across cloud, on-premise, and fully air-gapped environments. For this role, you need to be located in Malta or willing to relocate. Key Responsibilities
items.desc: We are seeking an ML Engineer specialising in Python to package, serve, and operate AI capabilities across our client's shared platform. Their customers rely on fast, defensible answers across massive volumes of unstructured text, documents, audio, and video for critical missions in defence, intelligence, and law enforcement. In this role, you will bridge the gap between research and production, taking models out of notebooks and packaging them into versioned, production-ready artifacts served behind standardised APIs. You will own inference performance, cost, and output provenance across cloud, on-premise, and fully air-gapped environments. For this role, you need to be located in Malta or willing to relocate. Key Responsibilities Production Serving: Package models as immutable, versioned artefacts, deploy them onto shared runtime infrastructures (e.g., Triton, vLLM), and expose them behind standards-compliant contracts. Benchmarking & Model Selection: Evaluate and select models using a centralised testing framework with reproducible runs, clear task metrics, and complete documentation. Performance & Cost Optimisation: Manage inference latency, throughput, dynamic batching, quantisation, and GPU placement to keep performance high and cost accountable. Observability & Operations: Instrument dashboards, trace request pipelines, monitor for quality/drift, and participate in on-call rotations for served capabilities. Constrained & Offline Delivery: Prepare ML pipelines and OCI artefacts for unattended execution in air-gapped customer environments with strict audit and provenance constraints. Requirements Depth in at least one key domain: Language & NLP, Speech & Audio, Vision & Document AI, or Agentic & LLM Systems. Advanced production skill in Python (3.12+, uv, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers) with a proven track record of reading, adapting, and evaluating model implementations. Hands-on experience with production model serving (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton), FastAPI, and streaming OpenAI-compatible API contracts. Experience deploying GPU workloads on Kubernetes (node selection, autoscaling, scheduling constraints) and managing observability (tracing, latency percentiles, GPU utilization). Strong evaluation hygiene with task-appropriate metrics (F1, mAP, WER, BLEU/COMET, DER), regression gating in CI, and experiment tracking. Firm grasp of ML provenance, reproducible builds, and immutable artefact packaging (OCI model supply chain). Benefits Fully Remote Set-Up Company equipment and a home office budget Relocation Support Education and experience Passionate about EU Security and Defence.

items.desc: Shape confidence in technology, risk and digital transformation Programme Overview On the Technology Risk Graduate Programme, you’ll shape the future with confidence by helping organisations identify and manage the technology risks that matter. You’ll work in collaborative teams, using data, technology and insight to support responsible innovation across areas like cloud, AI and cybersecurity. Problem solving — identify technology risks and support the development of practical, effective solutions. Inclusive collaboration — work with diverse teams and stakeholders to evaluate systems and deliver outcomes. Critical thinking and judgement — assess risks, controls and evidence to form sound conclusions and recommendations. Adaptability — respond to evolving technologies, regulations and client environments with confidence. Collaborate with teams and clients to evaluate systems, identify issues and deliver practical recommendations. Build your skills through hands-on project work, learning key frameworks, tools and regulatory requirements.

items.desc: About The Role ARX Robotics develops modular robotic platforms and autonomy software for military and security forces across Europe. As an AI Operations Engineer (m/f/d), you will make sure that the AI systems we build run reliably, securely, and at scale, from model deployment and monitoring to the internal AI tools our teams use every day. You will work at the intersection of engineering, data, and operations, turning AI capabilities into dependable products and workflows. What You'll Build Reliable pipelines for deploying, monitoring, and updating AI and autonomy models in production environments Observability and evaluation frameworks to track model performance, data drift, and system health Automation for data ingestion, training workflows, and release processes Integrations and internal AI tooling that support engineering, operations, and governance teams Documentation and runbooks that keep AI systems auditable and maintainable Operational controls aligned with information security, compliance, and export control requirements What You Bring Several years of experience in MLOps, DevOps, platform engineering, or a comparable operations role Solid Python skills and experience with containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes) Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools and model monitoring solutions Understanding of data pipelines, APIs, and modern software architectures A structured, documentation-driven way of working and high standards for accuracy and accountability Awareness of security, compliance, and responsible AI practices; experience in regulated or defense-related environments is a plus Fluency in English; German is a plus Please note: You do not need to meet every single requirement to apply. We welcome motivated candidates who are eager to grow into the role and develop their expertise further. What We Offer Join a mission-driven European defense tech company at a pivotal stage of growth, where you can help shape meaningful technology, take ownership early, and grow with the business! Competitive compensation package including a bonus opportunity 27 vacation days to start, increasing with tenure up to 30 days Employer-supported pension contribution Learning & development support and team events budget Employee discounts and flexible benefits budget via Probonio Hybrid working setup depending on role and team needs Structured salary bands, levelling framework, and bi-annual development conversations Referral bonus program, dog-friendly office, and relocation support where applicable About Us ARX is a dual-use technology company that specializes in developing autonomous unmanned systems and sensors for the European defence sector. Our dual-use unmanned ground systems and sensors assist NATO Armies and civilian first responders in tackling their most challenging problems by providing them with training and information to make better decisions and take effective actions in life-or-death situations. As our team continues to expand rapidly, we are seeking motivated candidates who are excited to work in a highly energetic, creative, and innovative team dedicated to developing autonomous systems for challenging environments. We operate in a dynamic sector where collaboration, sharing innovative ideas, and developing novel problem-solving strategies are ingrained in our work culture. If you are passionate about overcoming challenges that have a real impact on the security of our democracies, apply here to join ARX and help shape the future of dual-use technology! ARX is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. You can find ARX Robotics Applicant Privacy Policy here.

items.desc: Data Scientist - Public Sector Data Programme - SC eligible About the role Blackstone& is placing a Data Scientist with a UK government department whose decisions affect millions of people. Their data sits in a secure, AWS-hosted analytics environment, and they want someone who can turn it into models and insight that policy and operational teams will use. You'll work in a small multidisciplinary team alongside data engineers, analysts and subject-matter experts. You'll take questions from first conversation through to a tested, documented and reproducible result. What you'll be doing Exploring large, messy administrative datasets and judging whether they can answer the question being asked Building statistical and machine learning models, including NLP on free text records where it helps Writing clean, version controlled Python or R that colleagues can read, rerun and extend Querying and shaping data with SQL on Amazon Athena and S3 Working with data engineers on the features, tables and pipelines your models depend on Turning results into clear outputs for non technical audiences, from short briefings to interactive dashboards Quality assuring your own and others' work through code review, testing and peer checks What we're looking for Essential: Strong Python or R for analysis and modelling (pandas, scikit-learn, or tidyverse and tidymodels) Confident SQL on large datasets Experience on AWS, especially Athena, S3 or SageMaker A practical grasp of machine learning and statistical methods, including when not to use them Git-based workflows, with code review and reproducible analysis as normal practice Explaining technical findings to senior and non-technical stakeholders Eligible for SC clearance Nice to have: Working in JupyterLab or RStudio on a shared cloud platform NLP or text classification Building apps or dashboards (Shiny, Streamlit or similar) Experience in the public sector or another highly regulated setting where data protection and auditability matter Why this role Your work will feed into decisions with real public impact. You'll join a team that treats good engineering practice as part of good data science, on a modern open-source stack. ENGAGEMENT DETAILS This engagement is offered outside IR35, reflecting the genuine independence and expertise the role requires. Key terms: Rate: Competitive Outside IR35 - engaged as an independent contractor via your own limited company or umbrella Initial contract length: 6 months, with extensions expected subject to performance and project progression Hybrid working - a mix of remote and on-site with the client as the engagement requires Start date: to be agreed. We are looking to move quickly for the right person

items.desc: Deloitte er et av verdens ledende profesjonelle tjenestehus med over 470 000 ansatte globalt. I Norge er vi ca. 1600 medarbeidere som hjelper klienter med rådgivning, revisjon, skatt og juridiske tjenester. Hos oss jobber du i et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø der vi setter pris på ulike perspektiver, kompetanser og bakgrunner. I AI & Data Deloitte hjelper virksomheter med å skape verdi med AI og data – fra strategi og dataplattformer til AI-løsninger og innsikt. Vi ser etter deg som kan kombinere faglig kompetanse med forståelse for virksomhetens behov – og som vil være med på å utvikle løsninger som gir verdi i praksis. Vi ser etter deg som har relevant arbeidserfaring, er nysgjerrig og lærer raskt, og som ønsker å bruke kompetansen din til å skape impact that matters. Hva vil du jobbe med? Du vil bidra innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: AI Strategy & Governance: Hjelpe virksomheter med å identifisere verdifulle muligheter, prioritere initiativer og etablere retning og rammer for bruk av AI og data. Data Platform & Engineering: Utforme og bygge trygge, skalerbare dataplattformer, dataarkitektur og datapipelines som legger grunnlaget for analyse og AI. AI Solutions & Insights: Utvikle analyser og AI-løsninger som gir bedre innsikt, støtter beslutninger og forbedrer arbeidsprosesser. Hvem ser vi etter? Du har fullført en relevant utdanning på masternivå (NHH, CBS, NTNU, BI, NMBU, UiO, UiB og anerkjente internasjonale universiteter). Du har erfaring med å forstå et forretningsbehov og omsette det til en konkret leveranse . Du kan forklare hvilke valg du tok, hva du selv hadde ansvar for, og hvilken verdi arbeidet skapte. Avhengig av fagprofilen din har du erfaring med noen , men ikke nødvendigvis alle, av disse områdene: Klassisk AI, AI-assistenter, agenter eller bruk av AI til å forbedre arbeidsprosesser Dataplattformer og skytjenester som Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Innsikt og visualisering gjennom Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, Power Platform eller skreddersydde applikasjoner Programmering, datamodellering, datatransformasjon og datapipelines med for eksempel Python, SQL, PySpark eller DAX Som seniorkonsulent forventer vi i tillegg at du kan ta større ansvar for leveranser, gjøre faglige avveininger og bidra til å utvikle både løsninger og kolleger. Hvorfor Deloitte? Hos oss får du jobbe med reelle problemer, tverrfaglige team og virksomheter med ulike behov. Du får et inkluderende fagmiljø, tilgang til et globalt nettverk og tydelige muligheter for læring og utvikling – blant annet gjennom Faglig Community og Deloitte University . Arbeidssted: Oslo eller Bergen Søknadsfrist: Fortløpende Dersom du er nysgjerrig eller har spørsmål om stillingen er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Victoria Dessen (458 63 586). For spørsmål om søknadsprosessen kan du kontakte Amalie Worm Andersen (amaandersen@deloitte.no). Du får muligheten til å jobbe i et selskap som hjelper andre aktører med sin grønne omstilling, samtidig som vi arbeider målrettet med egne ambisjoner innenfor både klima og miljø og samfunnsansvar. Som ansatt i Deloitte integreres bærekraft i arbeidshverdagen, og du får anledning til å bidra i ulike prosjekter og initiativer knyttet til dette. Som samfunnsaktør, arbeidsgiver og tjenesteleverandør har Deloitte et stort fokus på mangfold og inkludering. Vi ser at ulike perspektiver fremmer nytenkning, gir dypere innsikt og bedre beslutninger, og ikke minst mobiliserer potensialet til medarbeiderne våre! Vi ønsker derfor et stort mangfold blant søkere.

items.card: About The Job At Opella, we’re constantly looking for better and simpler ways to bring health into people’s hands. We’re looking for a curious, analytical and digitally minded intern who wants to explore how Artificial Intelligence can make a real difference in Supply Chain operations. You will combine Supply Chain, data analytics, process improvement and AI, identifying practical opportunities to automate
items.desc: Salary Range: €0.00 - €0.00 All Compensation Will Be Determined Commensurate With Demonstrated Experience. Your career shouldn’t start with waiting in line. At Opella, early careers are built differently. You’re trusted early, supported strongly, and given real space to make an impact. As a Supply Chain & AI Intern , you’ll join our Supply Chain team and contribute to the digital transformation of the way we work, exploring how data, automation and Artificial Intelligence can make our processes simpler, smarter and more effective. About The Job At Opella, we’re constantly looking for better and simpler ways to bring health into people’s hands. We’re looking for a curious, analytical and digitally minded intern who wants to explore how Artificial Intelligence can make a real difference in Supply Chain operations. You will combine Supply Chain, data analytics, process improvement and AI, identifying practical opportunities to automate repetitive activities, simplify processes and turn operational data into actionable insights. Working closely with Supply Chain teams and key stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to develop and test real AI and automation use cases using tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Excel, Power BI and Power Automate, while learning how an end-to-end Supply Chain operates. Main Responsibilities Identify repetitive or manual Supply Chain activities that could be simplified or automated through AI and digital solutions. Develop and test practical AI use cases using tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Excel, Power BI and Power Automate, supporting data analysis, reporting and information retrieval. Measure and document the impact of AI and automation initiatives in terms of time saved, process simplification and quality improvement. Analyse operational data across areas such as service level, inventory, forecast accuracy, distribution and logistics, identifying trends, exceptions and improvement opportunities. Support recurring Supply Chain performance reviews by preparing analyses, dashboards and actionable insights. Map existing processes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across Planning, Logistics and Distribution. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to help build more standardised, data-driven and automated ways of working, while supporting the adoption of AI through simple guidelines, templates and best practices. What You Will Learn During your internship, you’ll have the opportunity to: Understand how an end-to-end Supply Chain operates within a global Consumer Healthcare business. Explore how AI and automation can be applied to real business challenges, moving from an idea to a practical use case. Build hands-on experience with tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, Power Automate and Excel. Turn complex operational data into clear insights and recommendations that support business decisions. Develop practical knowledge of Planning, Logistics, Distribution and Supply Chain performance management. Strengthen your skills in data analysis, process improvement, problem solving and project management. Work with different teams and stakeholders and see how digital transformation can improve everyday ways of working. About You You are currently completing, or have recently completed, a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field. You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with data, processes and digital tools. You are confident using Excel; familiarity with Power BI, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot or other AI tools would be a plus. You are curious about Artificial Intelligence, automation and digital transformation and interested in understanding how they can solve real business problems. You approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and propose simpler ways of working. You are proactive, hands-on and comfortable collaborating with different teams and stakeholders. You have a good command of English and strong communication skills. The mindset we value At Opella, we believe in working in a way that is bold, simple, collaborative and focused on impact. We’re looking for someone who is ready to bring these behaviours to life every day: Brave: explore new technologies, experiment with ideas, ask questions and challenge existing ways of working. Simplify. Radically: use data, AI and automation to remove unnecessary complexity and make processes smarter and easier. All In. Together: collaborate openly with Supply Chain teams and other stakeholders, share knowledge and help others embrace new ways of working. Outcome obsessed: focus on solutions that deliver measurable improvements, whether through time saved, better quality or more effective decision-making. This isn’t a stop on your CV, it’s the start of something bigger. If you want to grow, be heard and help change how self-care works for people …

items.desc: Gerflor ist ein weltweit führender Spezialist für elastische Bodenbeläge und steht für innovative und nachhaltige Produktlösungen, hochwertiges Design sowie verlässliche Qualität. Das Unternehmen bietet ein nahezu lückenloses Sortiment – vom homogenen oder heterogenen Objektbelag über LVT Designbeläge bis hin zu Linoleum- und Sportböden. Im Bereich Boden vereint Gerflor mehrere weltbekannte Markennamen wie DLW, Mipolam und Creation. Im Rahmen der technologischen Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmensprozesse suchen wir als Verstäkerkung für uns IT-Team eine/n AI Implementation Engineer (m/w/d) am Standort Troisdorf Wir suchen keinen reinen Strategen oder Berater, sondern einen praxisorientierten KI Spezialisten (m/w/d), die/der Ideen in funktionierende Anwendungen verwandelt – von der Identifikation geeigneter Use Cases und Tools über die technische Entwicklung bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung im Unternehmen. Ihre Mission KI-Potenziale identifizieren: Bestehende Geschäftsprozesse in unterschiedlichen Fachabteilungen analysieren, Optimierungsmöglichkeiten erkennen und geeignete KI-Anwendungsfälle hinsichtlich Machbarkeit und Nutzen bewerten. KI-Lösungen entwickeln und implementieren: Praxisnahe KI-Anwendungen, intelligente Workflows und Automatisierungslösungen eigenständig konzipieren, entwickeln und in den produktiven Einsatz bringen. Systeme und Prozesse integrieren: KI-Anwendungen über geeignete Schnittstellen mit bestehenden IT-Systemen, Datenbanken und Geschäftsprozessen verbinden. Projekte eigenverantwortlich umsetzen: KI-Projekte von der Anforderungsanalyse und technischen Konzeption über die Entwicklung und Testphase bis zum erfolgreichen Rollout planen und steuern. Fachabteilungen begleiten: Eng mit den Fachbereichen und der IT zusammenarbeiten, Anwender bei der Einführung unterstützen und die nachhaltige Nutzung der Lösungen sicherstellen. Technologien evaluieren: Neue KI-Technologien, Plattformen und Tools beobachten, ihre Einsatzmöglichkeiten bewerten und konkrete Verbesserungspotenziale erschließen. Unsere Anforderungen Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender praktischer Erfahrung. Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Implementierung oder Integration von KI-basierten Anwendungen im Unternehmensumfeld. Gute Kenntnisse moderner KI-Technologien, insbesondere LLMs, KI-Agenten, Chat-Bots, Workflow-Automatisierung sowie der Anbindung von Systemen über APIs. Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, Prozessautomatisierung oder Integration bestehender Unternehmensanwendungen. Fähigkeit, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse zu verstehen, Verbesserungspotenziale zu erkennen und daraus praktikable technische Lösungen abzuleiten. Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Planung und Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachabteilungen. items.desc: 6-month internship in Marseille, France: agents, TypeScript & outbound. Starting December 2026 to February 2027. At a glance Term: 6 months, starting between December 2026 and February 2027 Location: Marseille, France (coworking with a sea view, hybrid) Stack: TypeScript · Next.js · React · Python · SQL · LLM APIs · PostgreSQL · BigQuery · Node.js · Pipedrive API · PostHog · AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) About Influentials Influentials is a creator marketing platform and managed service built to help brands scale creator content. More than 16,000 creators are directly connected and verified on our platform, and more than 500 brands, including McDonald's, Disney, Samsung, ALDI and Volvo, have run over 5,000 campaigns with us. We're headquartered in Rotterdam, Netherlands and building our tech hub in Marseille, France. How we build AI is both how we build and what we build. We practise agentic engineering on a modern TypeScript stack: AI agents write most of the code, and humans specify and review everything that goes live. We merge hundreds of PRs each month, and our velocity keeps accelerating. We're not tied to one tool (Claude Code today, Codex before), and we adopt new practices as they land, like cloud coding agents and agent loops. The job is changing fast right now, and you'll learn it with us. Our next step is international: the UK, Scandinavia and France. We're looking for a GTM & growth engineer intern to build the machine that gets us there. Go-to-market as engineering We treat GTM as a systems problem, not a creative writing exercise: pipelines, enrichment, sequencing, attribution. It's the same technical work as any full-stack engineer, backend and frontend, applied to growth instead of product features: pipelines and APIs, tools for our team, and small full-stack apps that brands use. You'll sit between sales, marketing and engineering, write TypeScript, Python and SQL, build AI agents that run in production, and measure what they bring. No-code is fine for a quick test; anything that lasts is built in code. This is AI engineering, not machine learning: agents, tools, prompts and evals built on top of existing LLMs. No model training. What you'll build This is an internship: you're here to learn, working alongside the CTO and the sales team. These are the projects you'll contribute to: 01. Free tools that bring brands to us. Small free apps on our website, built on our creator data and LLMs. You'll build them and measure how many brands they bring to the platform. 02. An AI agent that spots brands doing influencer marketing. Build an agent that analyses social media content (our creators' posts, captions and hashtags) to detect sponsored content and the brands behind it, then scrapes those brands' websites to enrich them. That's an intent signal: score these brands so the sales team calls the right ones first. 03. Pages built from our data. Public research pages generated from our creator data, that brands find on Google and in AI assistants. 04. Outbound sequences. Email sequences to brands, personalised with our creator data and research done by AI agents, A/B tested against clear conversion targets. 05. The creator acquisition engine. Our system finds creators and contacts them by email. Add AI analysis of their content to target the right creators, and improve deliverability and conversion. 06. CRM and attribution, from first contact to invoice. Leads pushed to Pipedrive in one click, deal stages in sync, and dashboards that show which source brings which revenue. You won't do all six. With the CTO, you'll pick one, ship it, measure it, then move to the next. Technical challenges AI agents you can trust: evals on real social content to measure what the LLM gets right, and keeping cost and latency under control. APIs in the real world: rate limits, retries, webhooks. Deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain warm-up, bounces. Data pipelines: from GTM tools (CRM, email, enrichment) to BigQuery, without losing data quality. Experiments: A/B tests that are statistically sound, not "it felt better". What success looks like Month 1: you've learned the stack and the data, your first change is in production, and you've picked your first project with the CTO. Months 2–3: your first project is live and measured. Months 4–6: a second project, plus a weekly GTM dashboard the team actually reads, documented so it keeps running after you leave. Who you'll work with You'll work directly with Matthieu, our CTO, who cares as much about business and product as about code, and with our sales and partnerships leads. The rest of the team is in Rotterdam: weekly video calls with sales, campaign management and product, in English, with no travel needed. You'll be one of the first people in our Marseille tech hub, with a real scope and someone next to you to help you get there. items.desc: Zie jij snel hoe iets slimmer kan? Ben je nieuwsgierig naar AI en nieuwe technologie? En vind je het leuk om niet alleen mee te kijken, maar zelf met ideeën en oplossingen te komen? Dan zoeken we jou! Bij BOS Innovatie & Projecten van Aeres Hogeschool werken we aan het verbeteren en vernieuwen van onze onderwijslogistiek. Denk aan alles wat achter de schermen nodig is om onderwijs goed te organiseren: van planning en roostering tot diplomering, stages en tentamens. Wat je gaat doen Je gaat tijdens je stage aan de slag met een echte verbeteropdracht binnen Aeres Hogeschool. Bijvoorbeeld: hoe kunnen we een planningsproces slimmer maken? Kan een aanmeldproces eenvoudiger? Waar doen we nog onnodig handmatig werk? En kan AI of automatisering dat slimmer overnemen? Je Gaat uitzoeken hoe een proces nu werkt. praten met de collega's die ermee werken. ontdekken waar het slimmer, makkelijker of sneller kan. oplossingsrichtingen onderzoeken en deze ook toetsen onderzoeken. kijken wat AI en technologie daarin kan betekenen. waar mogelijk jouw oplossing ook echt testen. Geen opdracht die alleen in een verslag verdwijnt dus. Als jouw idee werkt, gaan we het ook echt gebruiken. Wie ben jij Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding die hierbij past. Welke opleiding dat precies is, vinden we minder belangrijk dan jouw nieuwsgierigheid en manier van denken. Je bent geïnteresseerd in AI en technologie. Je vindt het leuk om dingen slimmer te maken. Je denkt in oplossingen en durft buiten de gebaande paden te denken. Je stapt makkelijk op mensen af. Je stelt vragen en durft je mening te geven. Je kunt zelfstandig werken én samenwerken. Jouw frisse blik kan ons helpen om dingen te zien die voor ons inmiddels vanzelfsprekend zijn geworden. Wij bieden Een stage waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om te onderzoeken, uit te proberen en met eigen ideeën te komen. Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt begeleiding vanuit BOS Innovatie & Projecten. We passen de opdracht aan op jouw opleiding en niveau. Of je nu mbo of hbo doet: we zorgen voor een opdracht waarin je wordt uitgedaagd én iets kunt maken of verbeteren waar we daadwerkelijk iets aan hebben. De stagevergoeding is €300,- bruto per maand voor een volledige stageweek. Bij parttime vindt berekening naar rato plaats. Interesse Ben je ervan overtuigd dat wij op zoek zijn naar jou? Solliciteer dan vóór 30 november 2026 t.a.v. Marjolein van Amstel. Wil je graag eerst meer weten over deze functie? Bel dan Marjolein van Amstel via 06-278986950 In verband met de AVG wetgeving accepteren we alleen sollicitaties via onze website.

items.desc: Introductie Onze visie? ‘To advance the world through the power of people and Microsoft’. Elke dag zetten onze mensen zich in om met de nieuwste Microsoft-technologie onze klanten te helpen transformeren. Door de combinatie van een brede expertise van onze talentvolle mensen en een enorme passie voor Microsoft kunnen we onze klanten wereldwijd vooruithelpen op technologisch vlak en creëren we geweldige ervaringen & oplossingen Binnen het Technical Advisory (TA) team adviseren wij organisaties over de strategische inrichting van hun IT‑landschap. Wij helpen klanten niet alleen bij hoe technologie wordt ingericht, maar vooral bij welke keuzes zij maken om technologie duurzaam te laten bijdragen aan hun langetermijndoelstellingen. Data & Artificial Intelligence ontwikkelen zich snel tot strategische capaciteiten binnen organisaties. Veel organisaties experimenteren met AI, maar missen duidelijke richting, samenhang en sturing. Hierdoor ontstaan versnipperde oplossingen, onduidelijk eigenaarschap en toenemende complexiteit in het IT‑landschap. In deze afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe organisaties Data & AI strategisch organiseren: welke keuzes zij maken, hoe zij deze vertalen naar operating modellen en governance, en hoe dit landt in de inrichting van het IT‑landschap. Kom Ons Joinen Avanade is een internationaal IT-consultancybedrijf, waarbij mens en IT de krachten bundelen. Je zult jezelf herkennen in de 450 collega’s die rondlopen, maar ook zeker in de 40 andere stagiaires die jaarlijks stagelopen bij Avanade. We hebben veel passie voor en plezier in het werk dat we verrichten en hechten waarde aan een gezellige sfeer op de werkvloer. Met ontzettend veel talent voor Microsoft-technologie, is Avanade een unieke club waar veel ruimte is voor ontwikkeling. Gezamenlijk met de andere stagiaires vorm je een enthousiaste groep & community binnen Avanade. Je kan meedoen aan veel leuke activiteiten zoals kennissessies tijdens de lunch, koffiemomenten met consultants en werkborrels! Daarnaast bieden we een aantal soft skilltrainingen speciaal voor de groep interns en mogelijkheid tot het behalen van een Microsoft certificaat. Je komt te werken binnen het Technical Advisory team: een multidisciplinair team van consultants dat organisaties adviseert bij complexe vraagstukken rondom IT-strategie, architectuur en digitale transformatie. We opereren op het snijvlak van businessdoelen en technologische keuzes en combineren analytisch en strategisch denkwerk met pragmatische, hands-on realisatie. Binnen het team staat kennisdeling en inhoudelijke begeleiding centraal en werk je samen met ervaren adviseurs. Je wordt actief betrokken bij lopende klantvraagstukken en krijgt de ruimte om jouw onderzoek te verdiepen én te vertalen naar concrete adviezen, ontwerpen en toepasbare oplossingen voor de praktijk. Wat zal je doen? Tijdens deze afstudeerstage doe je onderzoek naar hoe organisaties richting geven aan Data & AI als enterprise capability. De focus ligt op het maken van bewuste strategische keuzes en het vertalen daarvan naar concrete inrichting, governance en sturing. Mogelijke Onderzoeksvragen En Denkrichtingen Zijn Onder Andere Welke strategische keuzes maken organisaties bij het positioneren van Data & AI binnen hun IT‑ en organisatiestructuur? items.desc: 🇬🇧About the role You'll be one of our first engineers, building the core of V10: agents that run real business processes, and the system they run on. A single agent might close a month's books, reconcile a bank account against sales and payouts, catch a supplier price rise before it eats the margin, or prepare a VAT return. Your job is to make that work reliably for every client, with every figure exact to the cent and every action inside the rules the client set. The architecture decisions you make now will still be in the product years from now. In this role, you will: - Build agents that run end-to-end processes: sales and cash reconciliation, purchasing, the monthly close, tax returns. - Build the financial-intelligence layer that turns a client's data into findings measured in euros, with clear actions. - Design how agents act safely in clients' ERPs and banks, with rules the client sets, approvals tied to exactly what gets written, and a full audit trail. - Ship to production every day, and help decide what we build next. You may be a good fit if you - Have built and run production systems where a mistake costs something real - Have shipped LLM-based features or agents and know where they break - Write strong Python and know Postgres and SQL well - Are curious about how businesses actually make money - Work with AI coding agents every day and review their output critically - Want the ownership and ambiguity of being an early engineer Strong candidates may also have - Experience in fintech, accounting, ERP or payments - BigQuery, Temporal or experience building evaluation systems - Founded or been an early engineer at a startup Logistics Palma de Mallorca or remote. Competitive salary + equity. We work in English or Spanish and work extremely hard. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 🇪🇸 El puesto Serás de los primeros ingenieros del equipo y construirás el núcleo de V10: agentes que ejecutan procesos reales de negocio y el sistema sobre el que funcionan. Un mismo agente puede cerrar el mes contable, conciliar el banco con las ventas y los cobros, detectar una subida de precio de un proveedor antes de que se coma el margen o preparar el modelo de IVA. Tu trabajo es que todo eso funcione de forma fiable para cada cliente, con cada cifra exacta al céntimo y cada acción dentro de las reglas que fijó el cliente. Las decisiones de arquitectura que tomes ahora seguirán en el producto dentro de años. Qué harás - Construir agentes que ejecutan procesos de principio a fin: conciliación de ventas y tesorería, compras, cierre mensual, impuestos - Construir la capa de inteligencia financiera que convierte los datos del cliente en hallazgos medidos en euros, con acciones claras - Diseñar cómo actúan los agentes de forma segura en los ERPs y bancos del cliente, con reglas que fija el cliente, aprobaciones ligadas exactamente a lo que se escribe y trazabilidad completa - Ser responsable de la infraestructura clave - Llevar código a producción cada día y ayudar a decidir qué construimos después Encajarás si - Has construido y operado sistemas en producción donde un error tiene un coste real - Has lanzado funcionalidades o agentes basados en LLMs y sabes dónde fallan - Programas bien en Python y conoces a fondo Postgres y SQL - Te interesa entender cómo ganan dinero de verdad los negocios - Trabajas a diario con agentes de IA para programar y revisas su trabajo con criterio - Te atrae la responsabilidad y la incertidumbre de ser de los primeros ingenieros Como plus - Experiencia en fintech, contabilidad, ERPs o pagos - dbt / BigQuery, Temporal o experiencia construyendo sistemas de evaluación - Experiencia como founder o como uno de los primeros ingenieros de una startup Condiciones Palma de Mallorca o remoto. items.desc: As a Data Scientist, you’ll play a pivotal role in advancing the data maturity of our Digital function. Working at the intersection of analytics, customer behaviour and commercial decision-making, you’ll develop innovative data science solutions that help shape customer experiences, optimise performance and drive measurable business value. From predictive modelling and behavioural segmentation through to AI and machine learning solutions, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of impactful data science initiatives across Greene King. Company Description Join us at Greene King the country's leading pub company and brewer, where our mission is to pour happiness into lives and become the pride of great British hospitality. We have something special, deeply rooted in our 220-year brewing and pub history, creating the business we are proudly known for today. Still today our 39,000 strong team are the guardians of what’s wholly British, the pub experience. Additional Information We’re all about rewarding our team’s hard work, that’s why… You’ll receive a competitive salary, pension contribution as well as: The chance to further your career across our well-known brands – as one of the industry's top apprenticeship providers, we can provide training and development at each level of your career. Discount of 33% for you and 15% for your loved ones on all of our brands – so you enjoy your favourite food and drink at a discount. Free employee assistance program – mental health, well-being, financial, and legal support because you matter! Discount of 50% for you and 25% for your loved ones at our Greene King Inns and hotels. – so you can enjoy a weekend away without breaking the bank. Refer a friend – who do you know who could be interested in a new role? When they are placed, you could earn £1,500 for referring them! Wagestream – access your wage before payday for when life happens. Retail discounts – Receive up to 30% off at Superdrug, exclusive discounts with three mobile along with many more… Qualifications As a Data Scientist, you will… Own and deliver the Digital data science roadmap, ensuring solutions create demonstrable commercial value across the business. Design, develop and deploy advanced data science solutions including predictive models, customer segmentations and AI/ML decision engines. Partner with Product, CRM and Digital teams to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable data-led solutions. Lead the monitoring, optimisation and enhancement of data science models and environments to ensure ongoing effectiveness and accuracy. Transform complex analytical findings into compelling, easy-to-understand insights that drive business adoption and informed decision-making. What You'll Bring… Significant experience in data science, with strong expertise in predictive modelling, machine learning and statistical analysis. Advanced technical skills in Python, SQL and data science platforms, alongside experience with visualisation tools such as Power BI or Looker. Experience using experimentation methodologies including A/B testing, control groups and significance testing. Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to identify trends, extract value from data and influence business decisions. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

items.desc: Job Title: Data Engineer - Azure & Machine Learning (Mid-Level) Location: Portugal Work Model: Full-time & Remote About Us MOZAYDO was built by people who believe work should feel human - even when powered by technology. We’re a remote-first company that connects talent, technology, and purpose to help companies grow sustainably. We also believe recruitment should be more than matching keywords to job descriptions. It's about understanding people, recognising potential, and creating the right conditions for long-term success. Here, ownership matters more than control, and progress matters more than perfection. People powered, tech enabled. About the Role We're looking for someone who can bring their expertise, ambition, and unique perspective to one of the project teams we support. At MOZAYDO, we believe great careers are built where talent, purpose, and opportunity meet. While we're currently hiring for a specific project environment, our focus goes beyond matching skills to requirements. We want to understand where you can create the most impact and continue growing. In this role, you will build data solutions on Microsoft Azure and contribute to traditional Machine Learning projects, including classification, regression, clustering and/or time-series forecasting. Working with business stakeholders, Data Scientists and technical teams, you will help prepare data, train and evaluate models, and integrate them into production pipelines. Responsibilities Gather and analyse requirements with business and technical teams. Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks, PySpark and, where applicable, Azure Data Factory. Implement data ingestion, transformation and modelling within Data Lakehouse architectures. Prepare datasets for Machine Learning, including data cleaning, missing-value handling and feature engineering. Contribute to model development, training and evaluation, selecting metrics appropriate to the business problem. Implement batch inference and scoring pipelines, integrating model outputs into data processes. Monitor data quality and model performance in production. Apply good practices in version control, documentation, testing and software development. Requirements Mid-Level: 2-3 years of experience in Data Engineering, including participation in traditional Machine Learning projects. Strong practical experience with Azure Databricks. Good knowledge of Python, SQL and PySpark. Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage, Parquet and Delta Lake. Experience across the data solution lifecycle: ingestion, transformation, modelling and delivery. Hands-on experience with Machine Learning libraries, data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation and evaluation. Understanding of overfitting, data leakage, train/test separation and cross-validation. Experience integrating models into data processing and batch scoring pipelines. Experience with Git and good software engineering practices. Ability to develop scalable solutions with attention to performance and execution costs. Analytical thinking, autonomy, attention to detail and the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Native Portuguese; intermediate English. Nice to have: Azure Machine Learning, including training jobs/pipelines, model registration and inference endpoints. Azure Data Factory. Model monitoring, data drift detection and retraining processes. Model deployment through APIs or online endpoints. Unity Catalog, data governance and access control. Scrum, Jira and Confluence. Hiring Process Our hiring process is designed to help both sides make an informed decision and ensure the best possible match between your experience, aspirations, and the project environment. Please note that the process may vary depending on the complexity and specific requirements of each opportunity. Initial Conversation with Us: a first discussion focused on understanding your background, strengths, motivations, and the type of environment where you can thrive and create the greatest impact. Project Team Qualification: a conversation with the project team to explore the role, responsibilities, expectations, and mutual alignment. Role-Specific Evaluation (when applicable): depending on the position, this stage may include technical assessments, practical exercises, certification validation, personality assessments, security clearance requirements, or other evaluation methods relevant to the role. Final Alignment Meeting: a final conversation to ensure expectations are aligned on both sides and that, if we move forward together, we start with clarity, confidence, and shared objectives.

items.desc:
Introduction
 The Business Engineering team within Operational Excellence supports manufacturing and operational organizations in improving performance, resource utilization, and decision-making. As part of this team, you will help explore how artificial intelligence and advanced analytics can solve real operational challenges in a high-tech manufacturing environment. This Business Analytics | Data Science internship: AI-driven operations, offers the opportunity to work directly with stakeholders, analyze complex processes, and develop practical solutions that create measurable impact. You will contribute to turning operational data into actionable insights while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
 Your assignment
 As an intern, you will join the Business Engineering team and contribute to projects that combine operational excellence, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. During this , you will investigate operational challenges, develop proof-of-concept solutions, and assess how these solutions can be scaled and embedded into daily operations. You will interact with business stakeholders, operational teams, and analytics specialists to ensure solutions deliver practical value. Your main responsibilities will be:
 Identify operational challenges that could benefit from AI or advanced analytics solutions.
 Analyze business processes, operational data, and stakeholder needs.
 Translate business questions into structured analyses and data-driven recommendations.
 Develop and test AI-driven prototypes, forecasting models, or decision-support solutions.
 Evaluate proof-of-concept solutions and assess industrialization opportunities.
 Present insights, findings, and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization.
 Document outcomes and support knowledge transfer within the Business Engineering team.
This is a bachelor's/master's (non-thesis) internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 4 days per week (preferred 4 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.
 Your profile
 To be suitable for the internship, you:
 Are pursuing a master's degree, or are a final-year bachelor's student, in industrial engineering, data science, applied mathematics, operations management, business analytics, computer science, or a related engineering discipline.
 Have an analytical approach and enjoy translating complex challenges into structured solutions.
 Have experience with data analysis and programming tools such as Python, SQL, R, or business intelligence platforms.
 Are collaborative and can effectively engage with different stakeholders, from operational teams to technical specialists.
 Are proactive, curious, and comfortable working on open-ended problems with practical business impact.
The internship is ideal for students who enjoy combining technical analysis with business understanding. Throughout this internship, you will gain exposure to operational decision-making, stakeholder management, and applied AI in a complex manufacturing environment.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

As a Software Engineering Intern with the Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems team, you'll explore how the latest large language models can be combined with established static analysis techniques to improve how issues in code are detected. It's an open, hands-on problem at the intersection
items.desc:
Static analysis helps engineers find software defects early — and there's a real opportunity to push it further with modern AI. As a Software Engineering Intern with the Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems team, you'll explore how the latest large language models can be combined with established static analysis techniques to improve how issues in code are detected.
It's an open, hands-on problem at the intersection of program analysis, software security, and applied AI — with plenty of room to experiment and make a visible contribution. If you enjoy reasoning about code and applying AI to practical engineering problems, we'd like to meet you.
The Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems team builds tools and infrastructure that help engineers develop high-quality software. In this internship, you'll investigate how AI — in particular large language models (LLMs) — can enhance static code analysis, working alongside experienced engineers in static analysis and applied AI.
You'll help prototype approaches, evaluate how well they work, and build tooling to measure and compare results. Because this is an open problem with no established playbook, you'll have the freedom to experiment with different techniques and see your ideas tested against real engineering questions.
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on programming experience in C and/or C++ — you have actively written, debugged, or analyzed C/C++ code (e.g. in a university project or thesis) and are comfortable with the fundamentals: pointers, memory allocation, and structs. (You do not need to be a C++ expert.)
Proficiency in at least one scripting language, Python strongly preferred.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to reason clearly about unfamiliar code — we care more about how you think through a problem than about a memorized answer.
Good written and spoken English.
Coursework, projects, or interest in static code analysis, program analysis, or software security.
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and generative-AI tooling, and an intuition for where AI-based approaches help and where they don't.
Familiarity with modern AI developer tools (e.g. LLM-assisted coding assistants).
Exposure to open-source software development tools.
A collaborative, curious, and self-driven attitude — comfortable working on an open problem where the right answer is not known in advance.

Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro.

items.desc:
As part of our team, you will own the robotics AI architecture and technical hypotheses, selecting world-action and video-action models, VLA policies, embodied reasoning, or classical planning according to task, data, and execution constraints.
 You will design heterogeneous systems that connect learned models with Code-as-Policy programs, Graph-as-Policy structures, and reusable skills. You specify state and action representations, interfaces, execution checks, as well as recovery behavior.
 Additionally, you will implement and adapt models and agentic robot programs. You investigate predictive dynamics, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or feedback-driven skill refinement, then justify your choices with baselines and ablations.
 You will also define evaluation across simulation and physical rollouts, including held-out tasks, embodiment transfer, intervention rate, latency, recovery, and repeatability. In doing so, you distinguish first-attempt success from results achieved through retries.
 Furthermore, you will collaborate closely with the deployment engineer to turn the architecture into a functioning embodiment. Together, you diagnose model, planning, or control failures and revise the design based on measured robot behavior.
 Using the Agentic AI Software Factory, you will drive implementation and experiments while validating generated code and experimental conclusions. You maintain reproducible artifacts, versioned skills, and accountable release decisions.
Education: completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Control Engineering or a related field
 Experience and Knowledge: substantial hands-on contributions to robotics AI systems on physical robots, with defensible architecture decisions and reproducible results
 deep expertise in predictive world-/video-action modeling or agentic robot planning and Code-as-Policy, integrating learned and classical components; relevant experience may include GaP, CaP-X, or ASPIRE/ENPIRE-style feedback loops; comparable implementations are equally accepted, and mastery of every named framework is not required
 proven expertise in action grounding, temporal consistency, uncertainty, and failure recovery
 strong Python and PyTorch/JAX skills in training/adaptation, inference, and experiment design, combined with the ability to inspect C++ and robot-control interfaces
 demonstrated own code or model contributions, supported by meaningful baselines and measured hardware outcomes
 terminology familiarity or model-API integration alone is insufficient
 Personality and Working Practice: you are an architect who writes and debugs code, challenges weak assumptions, and follows ideas through to physical evidence
 Enthusiasm: building robot intelligence that combines prediction, reasoning and reliable execution
 Languages: very good spoken and written German and English

 Job title : Data Scientist
 Location: Lyon, M&S Accelerator 
 Work Arrangement: Hybrid (Three days from office and two days from home) 
 About the job 
 As a Data Scientist within our Digital Manufacturing & Supply (M&S) Accelerator , you'll take ownership of turning real-time signals from our factories and labs into decisions that matter — working at the intersection of drug development, advanced manufacturing, and cutting-edge AI. Ready to get started?
 Join Sanofi's Manufacturing & Supply team right in the heart of Lyon, in a vibrant startup-style environment in the city centre. You'll support 12 blockbuster launch teams and 40 global factories across R&D and M&S, helping accelerate the launch of new medicines, build digitalised "Lighthouse" factories, and drive manufacturing performance improvements — all while enjoying an easy commute and a great work-life balance in one of France's most dynamic cities.
 About Sanofi:
 We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
 Main responsibilities 
 Partner with business teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions, working with a good degree of autonomy
 Own the ingestion, cleaning, and harmonisation of IoT and sensor data from a mixed estate — some fully connected and streaming, plenty of it legacy, manual, or messy. A meaningful part of the role is data cleaning and wrangling: it's the foundation everything is built on, and doing it well is genuinely high-impact here
 Design and deliver time-series models — forecasting, anomaly detection, and monitoring — on streaming sensor data to drive manufacturing performance and quality
 Design, build, and support real-time and streaming data pipelines together with engineers and MLOps, and help bring legacy sites up to a usable state
 Write highly optimised, production-ready code, taking models from experiment through to deployment
 Scope, define, and deliver AI-based data products end to end, using data analysis, visualisation, and storytelling
 Be accountable for the robustness of the AI solutions you deliver, applying responsible AI practices (monitoring, explainability, trustworthiness, ethics)
 Contribute to — and help raise the bar within — the global data science community of practice
 Support junior data scientists and analysts with informal guidance and code review
 You'll also work across the wider AI portfolio — including LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI workflows — as our products increasingly blend sensor intelligence with GenAI. Strong here is a plus, but IoT and time-series is the core of this role. 
 About you 
 You're a capable data scientist with a few years under your belt, genuinely excited by physical-world data — sensors, signals, and the machines that produce them. You can take a problem from vague business need to deployed model with limited hand-holding, and you've got a keen eye for improvement opportunities.
 Experience: 
 Hands-on track record working with IoT data, sensor streams, or time-series (this is what we care about most)
 Demonstrated experience applying machine learning to real problems, ideally involving signals or temporal data
 Experience developing deployable code and taking models to production in an agile environment
 You're not put off by messy, real-world data — a big part of this role is turning inconsistent legacy data into something usable, and doing it well is where a lot of the value sits
 Knowledge of the pharmaceutical or chemical domain is a huge advantage — understanding of manufacturing processes, GxP, or lab environments will set you apart
 Soft skills: 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 Experience working with multiple teams to drive alignment and results
 Service-oriented, flexible, positive team player
 Self-motivated, takes initiative
 Problem solving & critical thinking
 Technical skills: 
 Strong Python , and comfortable with at least one database system — time-series databases (e.g. InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) especially valued 
 Solid command of time-series methods — forecasting, anomaly detection, signal processing — on …

Graduate Electrical Engineer 
 Description - 
 HP Barcelona is a worldwide reference site for HP’s Graphic Solutions Business. The site is home to the Large Format Printing organization, responsible for the Research & Development, Marketing, and Operations of our portfolio of Large Format Printers, including HP DesignJet and HP Latex.
 We are looking for a Graduate Electrical Engineer to join our R&D team in Barcelona. This opportunity is ideal for a recent graduate in Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Physics, or a related field who is looking to start their career in electronic systems design and development.
 You will join a multidisciplinary and international development team, collaborating with colleagues in Barcelona and other locations around the world. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers, contribute to real product development, and progressively take ownership of technically challenging projects .
 What you’ll do 
 As a Graduate Electrical Engineer, you will:
 Support the design and development of electrical and electronic solutions , including components, subsystems, integrated circuitry, and algorithms.
 Participate in the testing and validation of electronic designs , covering areas such as functionality, reliability, electromagnetic compatibility, thermal performance, safety, and power measurements.
 Contribute to the development of reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality hardware solutions for HP products.
 Work closely with experienced electrical engineers and multidisciplinary teams throughout the different stages of product development.
 Collaborate with internal teams and external development partners, gaining exposure to an international engineering environment .
 Build your technical expertise and progressively take on greater responsibility within the team.
 Education & Experience 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field .
 Must have graduated during 2026
 This is an entry-level graduate opportunity, so previous professional experience is not required . However, relevant academic projects, internships, university research, or extracurricular technical experience are a plus.
 What we’re looking for 
 Foundational knowledge of electronic design principles, tools, and software .
 Academic or practical exposure to at least two of the following areas is an advantage: Power and mechatronics electronics, including DC/BLDC motor drivers, DC-DC converters, and adjustable voltage regulators. 
 High-speed digital design, computer buses, memory subsystems, and high-speed communication channels. 
 Sensors, precision analog circuitry, and analog signal processing.
 Good analytical and problem-solving skills and curiosity to understand how complex systems work.
 Basic programming knowledge in C and/or scripting languages .
 Basic understanding of electronic components, integrated circuitry, thermal management, and electromagnetic compatibility.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English . Knowledge of other languages is a plus.
 A proactive mindset, willingness to learn, and ability to progressively work with greater autonomy.
 Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills , with an interest in collaborating in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

 A truly international experience: Work in a global organization with colleagues from 60+ nationalities, collaborating across cultures and geographies.
 Continuous growth & career development: Multiple internal mobility and career opportunities, supported by HP’s learning platform to keep growing your skills.

 Give back to the community: Participate in volunteering initiatives or join our annual HP Charity Day held onsite.

 Onsite medical services: Doctor and medical team are available for annual checkups, nutrition, oral hygiene, physiotherapy, and general health.

items.desc: POLITIQUE SOCIALE UNIQUE À Narbonne, Les Grands Buffets rendent le luxe culinaire accessible à tous et mettent à l’honneur la cuisine d’Auguste Escoffier. L’entreprise se distingue aussi par son modèle social : salaires indexés, intéressement et engagements en faveur de l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Pour accompagner notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Chargé(e) RH – IA et transformation digitale , en CDI à temps plein. VOTRE MISSION Rattaché(e) au service Administratif et Comptable, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Générale, la Direction Administrative et le service RH. Vous assurez la gestion opérationnelle des ressources humaines et développez des projets concrets de digitalisation et d’intelligence artificielle. Ressources humaines Assurer l’administration du personnel : embauches, contrats, suivi des absences et du temps de travail, mutuelle, prévoyance et visites médicales. Préparer et contrôler les éléments variables de paie, en lien avec les interlocuteurs concernés. Accompagner les recrutements et l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs. Suivre les dossiers disciplinaires et les procédures de fin de contrat, avec l’appui du cabinet juridique. Participer à la préparation et au suivi des réunions du Comité Social et Économique. Coordonner les entretiens annuels et professionnels et suivre les actions de formation. Produire les reportings RH et les tableaux de bord sociaux. Conseiller les managers et les salariés, assurer une veille sociale et contribuer à la communication interne et à la marque employeur. IA et transformation digitale Identifier les processus pouvant être simplifiés, digitalisés ou automatisés. Piloter le déploiement de solutions digitales et d’IA, de l’analyse du besoin à leur utilisation par les équipes. Concevoir des automatisations et des usages concrets : aide à la rédaction, recherche documentaire, assistants internes et traitement de données. Créer des requêtes et des modes opératoires adaptés aux besoins métiers. Vérifier la fiabilité des résultats et veiller à la confidentialité des données. Former les utilisateurs et accompagner l’adoption des outils. Mesurer les gains obtenus et améliorer les solutions mises en place. Exigences : Formation supérieure en Ressources Humaines, idéalement Bac+5, ou expérience équivalente. Au moins cinq ans d’expérience dans une fonction RH généraliste et opérationnelle. Expérience professionnelle concrète en digitalisation et en déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle obligatoire. Participation active à des projets digitaux et IA, avec des réalisations et des résultats que vous pourrez présenter. Maîtrise des outils d’IA générative, de la conception de requêtes et de la vérification des résultats. Expérience dans l’automatisation de tâches et l’amélioration des processus. Bonne maîtrise de l’administration du personnel, des processus de paie et du droit du travail. Aisance avec Excel et les outils de gestion RH. La connaissance de Kelio et de Sylae serait appréciée. Autonomie, organisation, discrétion, diplomatie et sens de la pédagogie. Une expérience dans l’hôtellerie-restauration serait un atout. Avantages : Une fonction associant expertise RH et conduite de projets digitaux et IA. Une collaboration étroite avec la Direction et les équipes opérationnelles. Rémunération moyenne nette de 2400€/mois, intéressement compris. Formation assurée sur place par une équipe expérimentée. Opportunités d'avancement professionnel dans l'entreprise. Environnement de travail stimulant et convivial. Nous vous proposons un CDI, avec un intéressement trimestriel, mutuelle d’entreprise, repas offerts et avantages du Comité d’Entreprises. Si vous êtes motivé, nous vous invitons à présenter votre candidature dès aujourd'hui. Nous avons hâte de vous connaître et de vous accueillir au sein de notre équipe !

Title: Trainee Engineer - Rigid Riser Location: Paris, FR Job Closing Date: 19 Nov 2026 Vos responsabilités Le « Global Projects Centre » constitue le centre d'excellence de Subsea 7 dédié à l'exécution de ses projets les plus importants à travers le monde. Vous intégrerez la spécialité « Risers, Installation, Analysis & Umbilicals » (colonnes montantes, installation, analyse et ombilicaux) au sein du département « Design & Analysis » (conception et analyse), et vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le département « Technology Development » (développement technologique). Les « risers » (colonnes montantes) sont des conduites thermo-hydrauliques polyphasiques reliant une plateforme en surface (fixe ou flottante) au fond marin. Ces conduites sont conçues selon différentes configurations en chaînette (caténaire), ce qui leur permet de résister aux sollicitations du milieu marin. Par exemple, les sollicitations induites par la houle, les courants marins et les mouvements de la plateforme génèrent des efforts dynamiques qu'il est nécessaire d'estimer avec précision afin de garantir une conception sûre. À ce titre, vous serez chargé(e) d'examiner nos dernières campagnes hydrodynamiques et d'en exploiter les conclusions pour optimiser la conception de nos risers. Une comparaison quantitative des résultats sera attendue, afin d'évaluer les écarts observés en utilisant les logiciels de référence de l'entreprise. Les résultats obtenus permettront d'identifier des axes d'amélioration, tant pour l'application de nos produits dans le cadre de la transition énergétique que pour les activités historiques de l'entreprise Profil recherché Diplômé(e) d'un master 2 ou diplôme d'ingénieur Continuum Mechanics, Hydrodynamics, Critical thinking & Analytical models development, Numerical Analysis (python) La maitrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.
