items.desc: remote type Hybrid locations Warsaw - Poland Porto - Portugal Galway - Ireland time type Full time posted on Posted Yesterday job requisition id JR12624 About Us Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide. In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence. With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions. Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers. Role Overview You will protect Planet's enterprise AI platforms and autonomous agents, reducing exposure while enabling teams to adopt AI securely and responsibly. Working with the Global SOC, engineering and platform teams, agent owners, and governance stakeholders, you will strengthen AI incident response and embed practical security controls across a multi-AI environment. What you will do Protect AI platforms, assistants, models, integrations, and autonomous agents from misuse, data leakage, excessive permissions, prompt-based attacks, insecure connectors, and emerging threats. Partner with the Global SOC to triage, investigate, contain, and learn from AI-related security incidents. Develop AI-focused monitoring, detection logic, threat-hunting approaches, response playbooks, and measurable control improvements. Identify and reduce exposure from unmanaged AI use, public agents, exposed credentials, risky integrations, insecure plugins, and over-permissioned identities. Assess AI applications, copilots, agents, models, retrieval systems, prompts, data sources, and third-party services through security reviews and threat modelling. Implement guardrails for identity, access, secrets, data handling, connector security, logging, monitoring, permissions, and human oversight. Maintain clear ownership, risk classification, findings, and remediation tracking, communicating progress to technical teams and senior stakeholders. Who you are Experience in security engineering, cloud security, security operations, detection engineering, application security, or a closely related discipline. Practical knowledge of AI and agent risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, insecure tool use, identity abuse, secrets exposure, and supply-chain risk. Experience with Microsoft security technologies, cloud platforms, SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, logging, and automation. Familiarity with enterprise AI services and developer tooling such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and Agent 365. Ability to translate technical risk into implementable controls and work constructively with platform, engineering, and agent owners. Comfort developing or reviewing automation using PowerShell, Python, KQL, or similar languages. Strong investigation, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills, with an engineering mindset focused on scalable risk reduction. Why Planet Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce. We would love to hear from you – Apply now. At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office. Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully. About Us Company Background Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners. Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first. With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

Experience with Salesforce, AI or IT transformation is more important for this role than any specific Finance or HR background. Key responsibilities ● Work with business stakeholders to understand processes, pain points and goals, and identify where Salesforce and AI can add value. ● Define and prioritise AI use cases, including Salesforce AI capabilities such as Einstein and Agentforce, as well as wider AI tools. ● Gather and document business and functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. ● Map current and future state processes, and design solutions with Salesforce architects, developers and AI specialists. ● Support configuration, testing and user acceptance testing, making sure solutions meet business needs. ● Support change management, training and adoption so that new capabilities are used well. ● Work within Agile delivery teams, managing the backlog with the Product Owner and taking part in ceremonies. ● Track and report the benefits delivered by AI and Salesforce solutions. What you'll bring - Essential ● Proven experience as a Business Analyst on Salesforce implementation or enhancement projects. ● Experience defining or delivering AI use cases, ideally including Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce or generative AI tools. ● Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and documentation skills. ● Experience working in Agile delivery teams, writing user stories and acceptance criteria. ● Ability to work with both business users and technical teams, translating needs into workable solutions. ● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluent English. Desirable ● Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Business Analyst, Administrator or AI Associate. ● Experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or other Salesforce clouds. ● Experience with data and integration topics, such as Data Cloud or MuleSoft. ● Consulting experience or experience on IT transformation programmes for global organisations. ● Experience supporting change management and user adoption. Why join Proservartner ● Work on AI implementation and technology projects for an international client. ● Be part of an independent consulting firm where honest, practical advice comes first. ● Build your expertise across AI, automation and digital transformation. ● Work alongside experienced practitioners and technology partners. items.desc: AI Implementation & Automation Specialist W Sportano rozwijamy wykorzystanie sztucznej inteligencji i automatyzacji w codziennych procesach biznesowych. Szukamy osoby, która dołączy do naszego zespołu AI i pomoże nam przekładać możliwości nowych technologii na konkretne rozwiązania usprawniające pracę organizacji. Jeśli AI to dla Ciebie coś więcej niż zadawanie pytań ChatGPT, lubisz eksperymentować, szukać nowych rozwiązań i dostrzegasz potencjał automatyzacji – dołącz do #SportanoTeam! AI Implementation & Automation Specialist Miejsce pracy: 100% zdalnie lub jedno z naszych biur – Zielona Góra/Wrocław/Tychy/Kraków/Warszawa Twoje zadania: Identyfikowanie obszarów i procesów biznesowych, które można usprawnić z wykorzystaniem AI i automatyzacji. Projektowanie, testowanie i wdrażanie rozwiązań opartych na narzędziach sztucznej inteligencji. Tworzenie i rozwijanie automatyzacji wspierających codzienną pracę zespołów. Analizowanie procesów biznesowych i proponowanie rozwiązań zwiększających ich efektywność. Testowanie nowych narzędzi AI oraz ocenianie możliwości ich praktycznego zastosowania. Współpraca z zespołami biznesowymi i IT przy wdrażaniu nowych rozwiązań. Monitorowanie skuteczności wdrożonych usprawnień oraz ich dalsza optymalizacja. Dzielenie się wiedzą i wspieranie zespołów w efektywnym wykorzystywaniu narzędzi AI. Nasze oczekiwania: Praktyczne doświadczenie w wykorzystywaniu narzędzi AI, np. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot lub podobnych, wykraczające poza podstawowe generowanie treści. Znajomość możliwości zastosowania sztucznej inteligencji do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesów biznesowych. Umiejętność tworzenia skutecznych promptów i wykorzystywania AI do rozwiązywania konkretnych problemów. Analityczne myślenie, umiejętność identyfikowania problemów i poszukiwania efektywnych rozwiązań. Kreatywność, inicjatywa i otwartość na eksperymentowanie z nowymi technologiami. Samodzielność w poszukiwaniu informacji, testowaniu rozwiązań i wyciąganiu wniosków. Komunikatywność i umiejętność współpracy z osobami z różnych obszarów biznesowych. Chęć ciągłego rozwijania kompetencji w dynamicznie zmieniającym się obszarze AI. Znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalająca na swobodne czytanie dokumentacji technicznej. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w tworzeniu automatyzacji z wykorzystaniem narzędzi takich jak Make, n8n, Zapier lub Power Automate. Znajomość podstaw integracji systemów i wykorzystania API. Realizacja własnych projektów z wykorzystaniem AI lub automatyzacji, również poza pracą zawodową. Podstawowa znajomość Python lub JavaScript, lub innych języków programowania. Co możemy Ci zaoferować? Kultura organizacyjna budowana w oparciu o zasady fair play, Wyzwania, których nie znajdziesz nigdzie indziej, Realny wpływ na biznes - jesteśmy w fazie dynamicznego wzrostu, Pakiet benefitów dostosowanych do Twoich potrzeb, w tym m.in. karta Multisport, prywatna opieka medyczna Luxmed i program MultiLife, Możliwość skorzystania z ubezpieczenia na życie oraz zniżek na nasze produkty. Możliwość współpracy w ramach UoP lub B2B, Swobodna i inspirująca atmosfera, Brak dress code’u – jesteśmy firmą sportową, Komfortowe warunki i elastyczne godziny pracy, Więcej czasu dla siebie: 26 dni urlopu bez względu na staż pracy, Zapraszamy do naszego zespołu osoby z niepełnosprawnością. O nas Sportano to nowoczesny sklep sportowy, który w jednym miejscu skupia najlepsze marki i topowe produkty z niemal wszystkich dyscyplin sportowych. Naszą misją jest promowanie zdrowego stylu życia poprzez zarażanie sportową energią osób, które dopiero zaczynają przygodę ze sportem, a także motywowanie i podnoszenie poziomu sportu wśród pasjonatów. Przyciągamy najlepszych ekspertów w dziedzinie produktu, marketingu, IT, logistyki i zakupów, tworząc nową jakość na europejskim rynku e-commerce. Szeroka oferta sprzętu sportowego, przełomowe rozwiązania logistyczne i najnowocześniejsze technologie e-commerce wspierające naszych klientów sprawiają, że przyszłość branży sportowej może być w Twoich rękach! Budujemy przyjazną organizację, dla której tak samo jak biznes, ważni są ludzie, ich rozwój i wspólne osiąganie celów. Chcesz razem z nami tworzyć tę niesamowitą historię? Dołącz do nas! items.desc: About us Symrise is a global leader in creating inspiring fragrance, flavor, nutrition, and health solutions. Within Group IT, we are expanding our established Global Data & AI Hub in Barcelona (Poblenou), which has successfully launched and continues to grow as a key pillar of our digital transformation strategy. The Global Data & AI Graduate Career Program is now entering its next intake, building on the success of previous cohorts. It offers early-career talent the opportunity to join a proven and evolving program that combines structured learning, hands-on experience, and exposure to real-world global business challenges. As part of the 2026 intake, we offer a range of specialized graduate tracks including AI Enablement & Community, Application / Full-Stack Development, Data Engineering, Data Science / Machine Learning, DevOps, Integration / API Engineering, and UX/UI Design. Each role contributes to building innovative, data-driven, and scalable digital solutions within a truly global and agile environment. About the Program The 12-month global program is designed for recent graduates who want to launch their careers with Symrise through a structured and immersive learning journey. You will benefit from: Formal technical and professional training Hands-on work in real global projects Continuous tutoring and personal mentoring Exposure to senior leadership A highly collaborative, agile, and international environment This program is built to accelerate your growth, strengthen your technical expertise, and help you develop into a future expert in your field. Your role As a Data Engineering Graduate, you will join the Data and Integration/API Architecture and Engineering team, contributing to the development of Symrise’s enterprise-wide data strategy and foundational data capabilities. You will work in a global environment supporting the digital and AI transformation of the business, helping to build scalable, high-quality data solutions across a wide range of systems and domains. In this role, you will support the design and implementation of modern data architecture and engineering practices, contributing to the development of a strategic enterprise lakehouse and reusable data products. You will work with both structured and unstructured data, helping to enable advanced analytics, AI use cases, and data-driven decision-making. You will also contribute to improving data pipelines, automation, and data lifecycle management to ensure efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Working closely with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders, you will help translate business needs into data solutions that drive value and innovation. You will gain exposure to enterprise architecture, data governance, and modern engineering practices, while contributing to large-scale transformation initiatives. This role offers a strong opportunity to develop your skills in data engineering within a collaborative, fast-paced, and innovation-driven environment. About you You should have: A Master’s degree in a relevant field (Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Cybersecurity, UX/UI Design, or similar) Graduation no later than 31 July 2026 Maximum 2 years of prior professional experience in a similar role Availability to start full-time in September 2026 Eligibility requirements: EU citizenship is required (we do not offer visa sponsorship) For candidates based in Spain , employment will be under a local Spanish contract For eligible candidates outside of Spain , employment may be arranged via the VIE program (subject to Business France eligibility rules) Candidates must not have previously completed a VIE assignment Age must be under 29 at the time of hiring Willingness to relocate to Barcelona (Poblenou) You ideally bring: Strong analytical and/or technical skills depending on the role Interest in data, AI, software development, or digital innovation Strong communication and collaboration skills A proactive, curious, and learning-oriented mindset Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment Advanced English (C1 / TOEFL 95+) Our offer A unique opportunity to start your career in our established and expanding Global Data & AI Hub in Barcelona (Poblenou). You can expect: 12-month paid graduate program €32,000 Private health and life insurance Flexible working arrangements Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies International exposure and cross-functional collaboration Learning, development, and certification opportunities Modern, collaborative workplace At the end of the program, there is a possibility of a permanent role within Symrise, depending on performance and business needs. Job Reference: EA04382

items.desc: Hur utvecklar man nästa generations ledningssystem när tekniken förändrar förutsättningarna för vad mjukvara kan göra? Här möts djup C++-utveckling och nya möjligheter med AI i ett teknikskifte där befintliga system ska vidareutvecklas och nya plattformar ta form. Du får arbeta med komplexa tekniska utmaningar och utveckla lösningar som används inom försvarsindustrin, där kraven på funktion, tillförlitlighet och användbarhet är höga. OM TJÄNSTEN Vår kund utvecklar avancerade ledningssystem för försvarsindustrin. Systemen används för att samla, hantera och förmedla information som ligger till grund för beslut och samordning i militära verksamheter. Nu står verksamheten inför ett teknikskifte. Befintliga lösningar ska fortsätta utvecklas samtidigt som nya tekniska plattformar och arbetssätt introduceras. Här spelar både traditionell mjukvaruutveckling och AI en viktig roll. Som C++-utvecklare blir du en del av ett utvecklingsteam som arbetar med komplexa system där mjukvara, kommunikation och andra tekniska komponenter behöver fungera tillsammans. Programmering är kärnan i rollen, men du får också möjlighet att arbeta nära systemdesign, integration, kravställning och verifiering. Det här är en miljö för dig som tycker om att förstå hela systemet, inte bara den del du själv utvecklar. Du får arbeta nära andra tekniska kompetenser och vara med och påverka hur lösningarna byggs, förbättras och utvecklas vidare. Du blir en del av en relativt liten organisation med omkring 75 medarbetare, där utvecklingen sker i team med nära till tekniska diskussioner och beslut. Här finns utrymme att ta ansvar, bidra med idéer och fortsätta utveckla din kompetens inom både C++ och AI. VI SÖKER DIG SOM Flera års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling med goda kunskaper i C++. Praktisk erfarenhet av AI inom mjukvaruutveckling. Erfarenhet av att utveckla och arbeta i komplexa mjukvarusystem. Teknisk universitetsutbildning. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska. Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet från Försvarsmakten och förståelse för militära processer och arbetssätt. Erfarenhet av ledningssystem, kommunikationssystem eller andra försvarstekniska lösningar. Erfarenhet av systemdesign, integration och större systemarkitekturer. Vi tror att du är en person som tycker om att lösa tekniska problem och som gärna sätter dig in i hur olika delar av ett system hänger ihop. Du är nyfiken på ny teknik, men har också erfarenheten att avgöra vilka lösningar som faktiskt fungerar i praktiken. Om anställningen: Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer att vara anställd av Friday och arbeta som konsult ute hos vår kund. Denna befattning kräver att du genomgår och blir godkänd vid var tids gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där vår kund har krav på säkerhetsklassplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Övrig information: Placering: Solna Strand Omfattning: Heltid Start: Så snart som möjligt med hänsyn till eventuell uppsägningstid Rekryteringsansvarig: Anna Persson Lön: Fast månadslön Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängas ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail. Om Friday På Friday hjälper vi Tech-talanger att hitta roller där de trivs, utvecklas och gör skillnad. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

items.card: Är du en erfaren jurist med ett stort intresse för artificiell intelligens och dess juridiska möjligheter och utmaningar? Vi söker nu en engagerad och pedagogisk jurist med specialistkompetens inom AI-relaterad juridik till ett inspirerande föreläsningsuppdrag i Malmö. Här får du
items.desc: Är du en erfaren jurist med ett stort intresse för artificiell intelligens och dess juridiska möjligheter och utmaningar? Brinner du för att göra komplex juridik begriplig, relevant och användbar i praktiken?Då har vi ett spännande konsultuppdrag för dig! Vi söker nu en engagerad och pedagogisk jurist med specialistkompetens inom AI-relaterad juridik till ett inspirerande föreläsningsuppdrag i Malmö. Här får du möjlighet att dela din expertis med cirka 50 chefer och ledare och bidra till ökad förståelse för hur AI kan användas på ett tryggt, ansvarsfullt och utvecklingsorienterat sätt. Om uppdraget I rollen som föreläsare får du möjlighet att kombinera din juridiska expertis med din förmåga att inspirera och engagera. Du ansvarar för att planera och genomföra en inspirationsföreläsning på cirka två timmar, där du hjälper chefer och ledare att förstå det juridiska landskapet kring AI och hur de kan fatta välgrundade beslut vid införande och användning av tekniken. En central frågeställning är: Hur kan vi dra nytta av AI möjligheter på ett tryggt och ansvarsfullt sätt – utan att juridiken blir ett hinder för innovation? Föreläsningen ska vara framåtblickande, pedagogisk och fylld med konkreta exempel som deltagarna kan omsätta i sina egna verksamheter. Ditt uppdrag innebär att: Planera och genomföra en engagerande och inspirerande föreläsning om AI och juridik. Belysa aktuella juridiska krav, risker och möjligheter kopplade till AI. Tydliggöra vilket ansvar och handlingsutrymme chefer och ledare har vid användning av AI. Göra komplexa juridiska frågor begripliga genom konkreta och verksamhetsnära exempel. Inspirera till en trygg, ansvarsfull och innovationsdriven användning av AI. Anpassa innehåll och upplägg efter målgruppens behov i dialog med uppdragsgivaren. Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som kombinerar gedigen juridisk kompetens med ett genuint engagemang för AI och teknikutveckling. Du är en trygg och inspirerande föreläsare som har förmågan att fånga en publik, väcka nyfikenhet och förvandla komplexa regelverk till tydliga och praktiska insikter. För att vara aktuell för uppdraget behöver du ha: Juristexamen eller motsvarande juridisk utbildning. Minst 5 års relevant yrkeserfarenhet inom juridik. Aktuell kompetens inom AI-relaterade juridiska frågor. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att föreläsa eller utbilda inom juridik. Mycket god kommunikativ och pedagogisk förmåga på svenska. Det är extra meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av att föreläsa om AI och dess juridiska aspekter. Vana att utbilda och inspirera chefer och ledare. Erfarenhet av att omsätta juridiska regelverk till praktisk vägledning. Arbetat med juridisk rådgivning vid införande eller användning av AI i organisationer. Praktisk information Placeringsort: Malmö Uppdragsperiod: December 2026 – januari 2027 Omfattning: Planering och förberedelser samt en fysisk föreläsning på cirka 2 timmar ️ Genomförande: Januari 2027, exakt datum fastställs senare Arbetsform: Föreläsningen genomförs på plats i Malmö. Förberedelser kan delvis ske på distans enligt överenskommelse. Ersättning: Fast pris för hela uppdraget, inklusive eventuella omkostnader Sista ansökningsdag: 10 november 2026 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att ta del av din kompetens! Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher. Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

items.desc: Slingshot AI Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want. We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London. We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others. We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London. We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others. The role As a Member of Technical Staff focused on Machine Learning, you will ship models, training infrastructure, harnesses and evals end-to-end: designing, building, and launching the tech that makes Ash differentiated as a specialized model for mental health, to change a billion minds and lives. As a core member of a small but highly skilled team, we expect you to act as an owner and to care passionately about delivering value to our users and ultimately to make people's lives better. We are looking for builders who care deeply about the quality of their work and want to ship things that make a real difference in people's lives. We care more about how you think and build than your specific background. If you're a great engineer who's curious about ML, we'd love to hear from you. We work on a model-agnostic post-training engine running on our own cluster of leased GPUs managed by SkyPilot, trained by an auto-research loop, and evaluated with our home-grown eval index aimed specifically at mental health. We’re constantly improving, and focus on building feedback loops over features, and constantly learning from our production performance, our psych research team, and scalable data sources. Our product tech stack uses Dart/Flutter for the app, Kotlin for core backend services, and Next.js/TypeScript for internal tooling, as well as Rust for low level media streaming. We use gRPC and GCP (Kubernetes, Cloud Run) as our primary cloud provider. You're not required to be an expert in all of these tools, but we would like you to come with a learning mindset and to not be afraid of getting your hands dirty with whatever tool the job might require. About you 3+ years of engineering experience, owning systems other people rely on. Experience working with LLMs, ideally with fine-tuning, harness engineering, and evals Proficient in using agents to do your homework for you Driven by creating a world-class product with a world-class team, want to own what you build, and you're happy tearing down experiments and features as we learn Experience in a fast-paced startup, or the drive to thrive in one. Collaborative and direct. You enjoy working in person with a small team. What we offer A chance to join a passionate tight knit team working on something to change the world Competitive compensation (top of personal market) and meaningful equity Travel between our NYC and London offices Usual startup perks like free lunch and coffee in office plus a generous learning budget We cover your personal therapy

items.card: The AIT Austrian Institute of Technology is Austria’s largest Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) . We aim to transform scientific excellence into innovation with impact. Together with our partners, we develop technologies and solutions for a sustainable, resilient, and digitalised future, strengthening Europe’s competitiveness and technological sovereignty. Our international teams combine cutting-edge
items.desc: The AIT Austrian Institute of Technology is Austria’s largest Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) . We aim to transform scientific excellence into innovation with impact. Together with our partners, we develop technologies and solutions for a sustainable, resilient, and digitalised future, strengthening Europe’s competitiveness and technological sovereignty. Our international teams combine cutting-edge research with strong implementation expertise to create measurable value for industry and society. Our Center for Digital Safety & Security is looking for further Ingenious Partners for our location in Vienna (Giefinggasse, 1210). At the Center for Digital Safety & Security , we develop state-of-the-art information and communication technologies to make our systems highly secure and reliable in the context of comprehensive digitalisation and global networking - focusing on a variety of key technologies such as distributed IT systems, Internet of Things, IoT, cybersecurity, data science, artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain technologies, quantum and photonic technologies, wireless systems (6G) and digital solutions for crisis and disaster management. Our Research Field Quantum Key Distribution , within the Competence Unit "Optical Quantum Technologies" , specialises in applied research of new methods to exploit the physical properties of optical and wireless communication media and use quantum effects to increase digital security. Scientist (f/m/d) for Experimental Quantum Communication CENTER FOR DIGITAL SAFETY & SECURITY As part of our interdisciplinary, international team, you develop new areas of application for photonic quantum technologies . You work on experimental prototypes for Optical Quantum Technologies and Quantum Communication (e.g. generation of ultra-narrow bandwidth entangled photons, integrated/bulk optics, photonic quantum information processing, etc.). You implement quantum communication protocols in the laboratory and in deployed networks as well as in interfaces with other quantum technologies (e.g. trapped ions). You collaborate with the team to plan, submit and lead research projects in quantum communication as well as implement them according to the highest scientific standards. You publish your findings in international journals and present them at international conferences. You actively support and supervise students . With your innovative work, you help master the latest challenges in quantum communication . Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: Completed PhD studies in physics, electrical engineering or a similar technical degree working in experimental quantum optics, quantum communication, or related fields In depth knowledge of experimental quantum communication Experience with cavity optics, cavity-enhanced entangled photon sources, optics simulations, frequency locking and/or ion traps is an asset Analytical thinking and structured work High level of commitment and ability to work in a team Good written and spoken English What to expect: Expected starting date: 01.01.2027 The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 68.152, -. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions, individual training and career opportunities. At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity. Apply now!

items.card: About the role As Kubernetes and Container Platform Security Specialist you own the security of Verda's Kubernetes offering: multi-node and single-node clusters, the container registry, and the credentials that reach it. The workloads running on it are not ours, the tenants do not trust each other, and the boundary between them is what customers are paying for. That is a different problem from securing your own
items.desc: At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work. We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco. Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished. Why Verda Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits. 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team. A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem. About the role As Kubernetes and Container Platform Security Specialist you own the security of Verda's Kubernetes offering: multi-node and single-node clusters, the container registry, and the credentials that reach it. The workloads running on it are not ours, the tenants do not trust each other, and the boundary between them is what customers are paying for. That is a different problem from securing your own cluster, and it is the center of this role. This is a securing role rather than a platform engineering one. You would not run the clusters or carry the platform on-call rota. The platform team operates and implements, and you define the security standard and verify what ships against it. Your responsibilities In this role, you would be the technical authority on Kubernetes and container platform security at Verda. Own the security design of Verda's Kubernetes offering, container registry, and registry credentials, including image provenance, signing, and admission verification requirements Own the tenant isolation model on shared Kubernetes infrastructure: namespace, node and cluster boundaries, tenant reachability, and kubelet and API server exposure Own the GPU-specific surface that most Kubernetes security work never touches: device plugins, privileged operator workloads, and partitioning boundaries Define the Kubernetes hardening baseline across control plane, node OS, container runtime, etcd and secrets handling, and the policy and admission enforcement model behind it, expressed as policy-as-code so conformance is continuously observable Design the Kubernetes network security model alongside Network Security: CNI-level policy, L3/L4/L7 controls, DNS and egress policy Specify runtime detection requirements for the Security Operations Center to operate and triage, scope assessments and attack simulation for red teams to execute, and act on what both surface Judge Kubernetes and container ecosystem advisories against Verda's configuration and set remediation priority, research new releases and ecosystem technology in a lab ahead of production adoption, and support Verda's compliance position through technical evidence and audit support Your key competencies Strong production Kubernetes and Linux experience, at a depth that lets you find problems rather than only configure around them Direct experience of multi-tenant Kubernetes: shared clusters, untrusted workloads, isolation as a requirement rather than a nice-to-have Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, the container runtime layer, and container and image security Strong Kubernetes networking, including CNI-level policy design Practical experience of policy-as-code and admission control, and working knowledge of software supply chain security: signing, provenance, SBOMs, and what admission-time enforcement actually requires Ability to write a standard that someone else implements, verify conformance without owning the change, and influence an engineering team you do not manage A research mindset: testing new technology, finding weaknesses, building proofs of concept, and turning findings into requirements that ship Comfortable operating with incomplete information and deciding quickly Nice to have GPU infrastructure: device plugins, GPU operators, partitioning, and the privileged workloads they require Multi-tenant container registry operation at scale eBPF-based observability or runtime security Cluster lifecycle and fleet management tooling CVE analysis, advisory triage, or upstream contribution in the Kubernetes or CNCF ecosystem Confidential computing, or attested execution environments Cloud provider, hosting, or another environment where the infrastructure is the product, ideally one certified to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or C5 where you produced the technical evidence Practicalities Location: Helsinki, Finland or London, United Kingdom or remotely from EU Hybrid mode: working 3 days a week from our Helsinki or London office, or remotely from EU Employment type: full-time and permanent What's next We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now. Please submit …

items.desc: Company Description Bosch Sensortec GmbH is a technology leader in sensing solutions based on microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and dedicated to the consumer electronics world. We develop and market key technologies for smartphones and tablets, hearables, wearables, smartglasses, augmented and virtual reality applications, gaming devices and many more. Our sensors improve people’s well-being and lifestyle and enable consumer electronic devices to sense the world around us. MEMS sensors are therefore an essential part of the foundation for a connected world. Bosch Sensortec GmbH is a wholly owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH. Job Description At our Munich ASIC Development Center, we create the technology behind the next generation of smart consumer sensors. Join our team and turn innovative ASIC concepts into high-volume products: As an ASIC Analog Designer, you work in leading-edge development projects for MEMS consumer sensor ASICs, contributing to top-level system architecture and block-level design of analog circuits for next-generation sensors With your experience in analog integrated circuit design, you implement challenging blocks and mixed-signal sensor systems ready for high-volume production Your technical expertise enables you to translate complex design requirements into robust architectures, block specifications and circuit solutions, while collaborating closely on layout and production test development Rounding off your responsibilities, you take ownership of product validation and assess characterization and qualification results to ensure robust product performance Qualifications Personality: High level of enthusiasm and creativity; willingness to work in international and interdisciplinary teams Working Style: Team player with a quality-oriented and independent working style Experience and Knowledge: Minimum five years of professional experience in Analog IC design; preferably experience in system level architecture of sensor front-end in CMOS technology; deep knowledge of state-of-the-art EDA Software tools for IC design and system level modeling Languages: Fluent English, German beneficial Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or comparable qualifications Additional Information We offer great opportunities for mobile working as well as different part-time models or job-sharing. Feel free to contact us. Diversity and inclusion are not just trends for us but are firmly anchored in our corporate culture. Therefore, we welcome all applications, regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity. As a globally active company, we are legally required to comply with applicable EU and US (re)export control and sanctions regulations. This means: For certain highly sensitive roles, we are only allowed to employ people who have passed an additional legal verification. This position is such a sensitive role. Consequently, we will ask you to provide further information necessary for this verification as the process progresses. For details on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Data Protection Notice for the application process. Bosch Sensortec GmbH is looking forward to your application! Need support during your application? Samuel Zinn (Human Resources) +49 7121 35-33717 Need further information about the job? Andreas Täuber (Functional Department) +49 89 45481391

items.desc: Job Title Trainer - Customer Experience Job Description Compensation details will be shared by the recruiter during the first interview . So, who are we? IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses. The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here . Your team You’ll join the Learning, Training and Knowledge Management team within Customer Experience (CX) and work closely with stakeholders across other operational teams. Your role in the Team's Success As a Trainer, you’ll help develop the talent across our CX teams. You’ll deliver product, process and soft-skills training to colleagues at every stage of their journey with us. You’ll be the first point of contact for every new joiner in CX. Reporting to the Manager of L&D, you’ll also help shape how our people learn and grow using cutting-edge AI tooling and human judgement. What you’ll do CX Onboarding Deliver a new and revamped New Joiner Onboarding programme alongside the learning designers to reflect a quicker, more efficient onboarding. Deliver live training sessions and assessments throughout onboarding. Serve as the first point of contact for all CX new joiners. Act as the SME for all onboarding topics and collaborate with the designers to create e-learning. Upskilling Pathways Help the content designers develop upskilling pathways for CX teams. Deliver Advanced Product Test (APT) training and assessments and oversee the Trade Execution Test (TET) batches. Deliver engaging e-learning for product launches and regulatory refreshers. Stakeholder Management Scope new training needs in collaboration with stakeholders. Work with WFM, Config and QA teams to develop and maintain training feedback loops and conduct TNA thereafter. Manage the learning management system (LMS) and related admin. What you’ll need Proven experience delivering training or similar. Experience with AI-enabled learning and knowledge management platforms (Sana, Docebo, LearnUpon, ServiceNow KM, or similar). Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. A continuous improvement mindset with high attention to detail. Confidence engaging audiences of differing experience and seniority. Strong organisation and time-management skills. The ability to work independently and keep stakeholders updated. Flexibility to accommodate different time zones and learning styles. Desirable Background in financial services, fintech, or trading environments. Familiarity with regulatory training requirements in financial markets. The Perks It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on. items.card: You will design security tasks that a leading AI model cannot solve, then analyse how and why it fails. What you will do Design self-contained command line security tasks, such as finding and exploiting a vulnerability in a small service, analysing a binary or malware sample, reconstructing an attack from logs, hardening a misconfigured system, or breaking a flawed cryptographic implementation. Build the task
items.desc: Job Type: Flexible Contract (Remote), 10 to 40 hours per week Job Summary: We are hiring security researchers with a completed PhD, including faculty, research scientists and experienced postdocs, for a contract project that tests whether frontier AI models can do real security work in a command line environment. You will design security tasks that a leading AI model cannot solve, then analyse how and why it fails. What you will do Design self-contained command line security tasks, such as finding and exploiting a vulnerability in a small service, analysing a binary or malware sample, reconstructing an attack from logs, hardening a misconfigured system, or breaking a flawed cryptographic implementation. Build the task environment (code, services, data and dependencies in Docker), write a reference solution, and write automated tests that check whether a solution is correct. Run your task against a frontier AI model, review its attempt with the rigour of a peer reviewer, and refine the task until the failure reflects a real gap in capability rather than ambiguity. Work with reviewers to bring each task to acceptance. Who we are looking for A completed PhD in computer security, computer science or a closely related field. Current PhD students are not eligible for this project. Research or industry experience in security: vulnerability research, exploitation, reverse engineering, systems or network security, or applied cryptography. At least one publication, ideally at a security venue (USENIX Security, CCS, IEEE S&P, NDSS) or a related journal. Fluency in Linux, shell scripting, Docker and Git, plus strong Python or C. CTF experience, or experience designing security course labs or automated grading, is a strong advantage. Why Cobalt AI Advance frontier AI where it counts. Apply your research expertise to the data that frontier labs cannot obtain any other way, where your reasoning directly shapes how the next generation of models works through technical problems. Grow professionally. Expand your influence through evaluation projects, advisory roles, and research collaborations, while deepening your understanding of how frontier models are trained and assessed. Work with a top-tier network. Collaborate with researchers from leading institutions and labs on high-impact, flexible work. Set your own schedule. Flexible 10 to 40 hour weeks that fit around your research position and your life. Competitive pay. Rates vary by project and are determined by a number of factors, including scope, skillset, and experience. Job Type: Part-time Work Location: Remote

We believe the best ideas emerge where intelligence and creativity unite, where insight sparks imagination, and where innovation turns possibility into progress. We are explorers of new frontiers, shaping bold strategies that move people, brands, and businesses forward. Individually and together, our specialist teams provide the vision, data, and confidence brands and organisations need to make braver, more impactful decisions. Today as GAIN, we work as a united force, using data to fuel creativity, and technology to unlock new possibilities. items.desc: About Vet Vision AI Vet Vision AI is a University of Nottingham spin-out, founded by veterinary surgeons on a simple belief: animals are always telling us how they are, just not in words, but through their behaviour. We build vet-led, welfare-focused computer vision that watches continuously and turns behaviour into clear, actionable welfare evidence for dairy and equine teams, helping them deliver great care. Our systems are already deployed on commercial farms and equine yards and trusted within the supply chains of major retailers. We are a small, fast-moving, science-led team on an enormous mission, to revolutionise the welfare of millions of animals worldwide, and we are just getting started. About the role We are looking for an Electronics Hardware Engineer to work shoulder-to-shoulder with our current team of vets, developers and engineers. You will be hands-on designing, prototyping and building new hardware, as well as diagnosing and fixing our camera and AI-processor hardware, on the bench and on customer farms and equine yards across the UK. In your first year you’ll take new hardware from first prototype to working installs on farms and yards, and keep a fast-growing fleet running, continuously developing solutions that are better, more scalable, and more robust. This role is for someone equally at home with a soldering iron and on the command line, who wants to move fast and iterate quickly based on feedback from real world users. What you'll be doing Design and build new hardware: Prototype, test and build new hardware alongside our developers and engineers, and improve how we source and assemble it. Troubleshoot, diagnose and fix faults: Keep the fleet running as our second line: diagnose hardware and software problems remotely and on the bench. Site work: Visit farms and yards to trial new hardware and fix what can't be fixed remotely, working safely around cattle and horses, and occasionally at height. Write up what you build: Keep build, test and fix instructions current as the hardware evolves, so the rest of the team can use them. Governance & safety: Make sure our hardware meets technical and safety standards. Close the feedback loop: Feed real-world install experience straight back into hardware design at HQ. What you'll bring Essential Hands-on electronics: you have 2 years or more hands-on experience in hardware, electronics or a closely related engineering field. You can read a schematic, layout PCBs, solder, fault-find with standard lab equipment. You’re able to quickly deliver prototypes and production ready hardware. You are as comfortable in software as in hardware: you are happy on the Linux command line and configuring, updating and troubleshooting networked edge devices, so you can diagnose a software fault as readily as a physical one. Networking basics: you’re happy with networking principles (IP addressing, DHCP, DNS) and the hardware behind them (routers, switches, wireless access points). Problem solving: Sharp, independent problem-solving, able to diagnose and fix in the field without on-call support. Travel: A full UK driving licence, and happy working on farms and yards around cattle and horses. Security clearance: If successful, the ability to pass BPSS clearance, this a requirement for one of our contracts. Desirable Experience in the agricultural and/or equestrian sectors. PCB design (for example Altium), and enclosure design using CAD and 3D printing. Experience writing software in C++, Python or bash. Deeper networking, such as VLANs, WireGuard and firewalls. Experience training or overseeing contractors or junior installers. IPAF 3A and 3B (or equivalent). A degree in electrical, electronic or mechanical engineering, embedded systems or similar. Travel & working conditions Three days a week at our Belper HQ, plus site days, with more time at HQ during your first couple of months. Regular UK travel to farms and yards; a full UK driving licence is required. This may vary depending on how the needs of the business evolve. Occasional work at height from ladders, cherry pickers and other temporary platforms in busy farm and equine-yard environments, around cattle and horses. What we offer A competitive salary of £35,000 – £50,000 per year, depending on experience. 25 days' paid holiday, plus the usual bank holidays. Automatic enrolment into our workplace pension scheme. Cycle to Work scheme, and travel and expenses covered for field work. Support for relevant professional certifications (for example IPAF 3A and 3B). Flexible, supportive working and a purpose-driven, science-led culture. The chance to get in early at a fast-growing, vet-led AI company, and to see your work improve animal lives at real scale. To apply: Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you. Send your CV, a cover letter and a short note about something you built or fixed under your own steam. We review applications as they arrive, so please don't wait. Applicants must have the right to work in the …

items.title: Kubernetes and Container Platform Security Specialist
items.card: About the role As Kubernetes and Container Platform Security Specialist you own the security of Verda's Kubernetes offering: multi-node and single-node clusters, the container registry, and the credentials that reach it. The workloads running on it are not ours, the tenants do not trust each other, and the boundary between them is what customers are paying for. That is a different problem from securing your own
items.desc: At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work. We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco. Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished. Why Verda Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits. 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team. A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem. About the role As Kubernetes and Container Platform Security Specialist you own the security of Verda's Kubernetes offering: multi-node and single-node clusters, the container registry, and the credentials that reach it. The workloads running on it are not ours, the tenants do not trust each other, and the boundary between them is what customers are paying for. That is a different problem from securing your own cluster, and it is the center of this role. This is a securing role rather than a platform engineering one. You would not run the clusters or carry the platform on-call rota. The platform team operates and implements, and you define the security standard and verify what ships against it. Your responsibilities In this role, you would be the technical authority on Kubernetes and container platform security at Verda. Own the security design of Verda's Kubernetes offering, container registry, and registry credentials, including image provenance, signing, and admission verification requirements Own the tenant isolation model on shared Kubernetes infrastructure: namespace, node and cluster boundaries, tenant reachability, and kubelet and API server exposure Own the GPU-specific surface that most Kubernetes security work never touches: device plugins, privileged operator workloads, and partitioning boundaries Define the Kubernetes hardening baseline across control plane, node OS, container runtime, etcd and secrets handling, and the policy and admission enforcement model behind it, expressed as policy-as-code so conformance is continuously observable Design the Kubernetes network security model alongside Network Security: CNI-level policy, L3/L4/L7 controls, DNS and egress policy Specify runtime detection requirements for the Security Operations Center to operate and triage, scope assessments and attack simulation for red teams to execute, and act on what both surface Judge Kubernetes and container ecosystem advisories against Verda's configuration and set remediation priority, research new releases and ecosystem technology in a lab ahead of production adoption, and support Verda's compliance position through technical evidence and audit support Your key competencies Strong production Kubernetes and Linux experience, at a depth that lets you find problems rather than only configure around them Direct experience of multi-tenant Kubernetes: shared clusters, untrusted workloads, isolation as a requirement rather than a nice-to-have Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, the container runtime layer, and container and image security Strong Kubernetes networking, including CNI-level policy design Practical experience of policy-as-code and admission control, and working knowledge of software supply chain security: signing, provenance, SBOMs, and what admission-time enforcement actually requires Ability to write a standard that someone else implements, verify conformance without owning the change, and influence an engineering team you do not manage A research mindset: testing new technology, finding weaknesses, building proofs of concept, and turning findings into requirements that ship Comfortable operating with incomplete information and deciding quickly Nice to have GPU infrastructure: device plugins, GPU operators, partitioning, and the privileged workloads they require Multi-tenant container registry operation at scale eBPF-based observability or runtime security Cluster lifecycle and fleet management tooling CVE analysis, advisory triage, or upstream contribution in the Kubernetes or CNCF ecosystem Confidential computing, or attested execution environments Cloud provider, hosting, or another environment where the infrastructure is the product, ideally one certified to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or C5 where you produced the technical evidence Practicalities Location: Helsinki, Finland or London, United Kingdom or remotely from EU Hybrid mode: working 3 days a week from our Helsinki or London office, or remotely from EU Employment type: full-time and permanent What's next We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now. Please submit …

items.desc: FLiiTS es una de las mayores flotas de food delivery de España. En solo un año y medio hemos desarrollado la tecnología y los procesos necesarios para escalar desde cero hasta gestionar miles de repartidores en España, Polonia y pronto otros países de Europa. Trabajamos en un entorno muy dinámico, con problemas complejos de optimización, operaciones y datos que requieren agilidad, capacidad analítica y una fuerte orientación a la ejecución. Buscamos a una persona con gran capacidad analítica, gusto por programar y muchas ganas de aprender. Te incorporarás al equipo de Data y trabajarás mano a mano con todo el equipo en el desarrollo de algunos de los sistemas más críticos de la compañía. Es un rol "full stack" de datos: en un equipo pequeño como el nuestro, la misma persona entiende el problema de negocio, diseña la solución (un modelo de optimización, un pipeline, un modelo de ML o un agente de IA) y la lleva a producción con rapidez. También es una de las posiciones con mayor recorrido dentro de FLiiTS: buscamos a alguien con potencial para crecer junto al área de Data y asumir cada vez más responsabilidad. Qué harás Desarrollar agentes de IA para automatizar procesos internos y mejorar la productividad de los equipos. Diseñar e implementar modelos de optimización (MILP) para planificar los turnos de miles de repartidores. Desarrollar algoritmos de dispatching, routing y asignación de pedidos a repartidores en tiempo real con distintas técnicas de optimización (matching, blossom y MILP). Diseñar y mantener los sistemas de cálculo de nóminas y pagos, incentivos de los repartidores, scoring y performance. Construir pipelines y procesos de datos con Python, SQL y Dagster. Construir modelos predictivos de ML para distintos casos de uso, por ejemplo la predicción de absentismo. Trabajar a diario con operaciones, producto, backend y el resto de equipos para entender sus problemas y convertirlos en soluciones basadas en datos. Resolver cualquier otro problema de FLiiTS que se resuelva manejando grandes volúmenes de datos. Llevar tus desarrollos a producción en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de backend, programando en Python y Kotlin. No esperamos que domines todas estas áreas desde el primer día. Buscamos a alguien con una base técnica sólida y capacidad para aprender rápido a medida que se enfrenta a nuevos retos. Qué buscamos Idealmente buscamos a alguien con 1-3 años de experiencia laboral, pero si acabas de terminar tus estudios y tienes muchas ganas, también queremos conocerte. Valoramos más el potencial, la perseverancia y la ambición para crecer muy rápido que los años de experiencia. Valoramos especialmente: Formación en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Física o disciplinas cuantitativas similares (Ingeniería Industrial, Caminos, Informática, etc.). Muy buen nivel de Python y SQL. Gran capacidad analítica y facilidad para aprender tecnologías nuevas. Gusto por programar y construir producto. Capacidad de comunicar con claridad y de relacionarte de forma proactiva con el resto de equipos. Es un rol que necesita tener contexto de todas las partes de la empresa, así que buscamos a alguien a quien le guste preguntar, escuchar y explicar. Perseverancia para resolver problemas complejos. Mentalidad de ownership: identificar problemas, proponer soluciones y llevarlas hasta producción. Autonomía, curiosidad y ganas de asumir responsabilidad desde el primer día. Se valorarán conocimientos o ganas de aprender sobre optimización matemática, algoritmos, LLMs, Kotlin, Docker, AWS y orquestación de datos con Dagster. Qué ofrecemos Modelo de trabajo híbrido con oficina en Barcelona (Sants): 3 días presencial y 2 en remoto. Máxima flexibilidad en fechas especiales como verano o Navidad. La oportunidad de trabajar en problemas reales de optimización, inteligencia artificial y operaciones con impacto directo en miles de repartidores. Mucha autonomía para llevar proyectos completos desde la identificación del problema hasta su puesta en producción. Aprendizaje directo junto a un equipo con mucha experiencia y colaboración estrecha con los equipos de ingeniería y operaciones. Un entorno joven, dinámico y de rápido crecimiento, con poca jerarquía y contacto directo entre equipos. Posibilidades reales de asumir más responsabilidad dentro del área de Data. Retribución flexible a través de Coverflex. Café ilimitado en la oficina. Actividades de equipo y eventos internos. Cómo aplicar Envíanos tu CV a people.rrhh@fliits.com o inscríbete a través de LinkedIn.

items.title: Data Scientist (Martech)
items.card: Desde Hays estamos colaborando con una compañía especializada en Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Marketing Analytics que busca incorporar un/a Junior Data Scientist para reforzar su equipo de MarTech. Funciones Preparación, limpieza y análisis de datos de clientes: inversión en medios, ventas, pricing, estacionalidad y factores externos. Ejecución, calibración y validación de modelos de Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM)
items.desc: Desde Hays estamos colaborando con una compañía especializada en Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Marketing Analytics que busca incorporar un/a Junior Data Scientist para reforzar su equipo de MarTech. Funciones Preparación, limpieza y análisis de datos de clientes: inversión en medios, ventas, pricing, estacionalidad y factores externos. Ejecución, calibración y validación de modelos de Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) . Desarrollo de análisis de optimización para recomendar la distribución del presupuesto entre diferentes canales. Transformación de los resultados de los modelos en insights y visualizaciones fácilmente interpretables. Mejora y evolución de la plataforma, incorporando nuevas funcionalidades y automatizando procesos recurrentes. Investigación de nuevas metodologías y herramientas relacionadas con MMM y analítica avanzada. ¿Qué buscamos? Hasta 2 años de experiencia en Data Science, Machine Learning o Advanced Analytics. Se valorarán prácticas y proyectos de máster. Conocimientos de Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) o experiencia/exposición a frameworks como Robyn, Meridian o PyMC-Marketing . Este punto es especialmente importante. Buen manejo de Python , especialmente pandas, NumPy y scikit-learn. Conocimientos de SQL . Base sólida en estadística: regresión, series temporales y validación de modelos. Capacidad para interpretar y explicar resultados técnicos a perfiles no técnicos. Castellano e inglés profesional . Perfil proactivo, con curiosidad y capacidad para asumir progresivamente mayor responsabilidad. Se valorará Experiencia o conocimientos en marketing, publicidad o agencias de medios . Familiaridad con plataformas como Google Ads, Meta o Amazon Ads . Conocimientos de técnicas de optimización no lineal. Conocimientos de estadística bayesiana . Experiencia con entornos Cloud como AWS, GCP o Azure . ¿Qué ofrecemos? Modalidad híbrida en Madrid: 1 día por semana en oficina y el resto en remoto. Salario : 30,000€ + Retribución flexible Contrato indefinido con HAYS

What we offer you NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you: Salary between €4.526 and €6,036, based on 36 hours, depending on your knowledge and experience 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary 27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and one Diversity Day A modern pension administered by BeFrank Plenty of training and learning opportunities NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately. L'objectif n'est pas seulement la performance : nous cherchons la solution la plus sobre et la plus rapide, capable d'être industrialisée dans nos pipelines de données. Tu travailleras au cœur d'une équipe R&D, avec un vrai
items.desc: Ce sujet de stage est rattaché au lab'Innov d'Aubay. il s'agit de la cellulle d'innovation du groupe Aubay. Tu pourras intervenir sur des projets en mode R&D adoptant une approche agile. À Paris ou à Lyon, nous te proposons des sujets Innovants notamment sur l’IA, la Data, le numérique responsable ... et encore pleins d’autres à découvrir ! ici, nous te proposons le stage "Data Quality Challenge" Et si on rendait la donnée irréprochable ? Benchmarke les algorithmes les plus récents – des statistiques classiques aux modèles de diffusion – pour imputer les valeurs manquantes et détecter les anomalies. LE SUJET : La qualité de la donnée est un élément essentiel en entreprise : pour la prise de décisions, un pilotage efficace, ou être le point de départ d'un projet réussi. C'est pourquoi le Lab'Innov d'Aubay en a fait un axe de recherche majeur, adossé à une thèse en cours sur le sujet. Ta mission : explorer et confronter trois familles d'approches – méthodes statistiques, réseaux profonds et modèles de diffusion – pour imputer les données manquantes et détecter les anomalies. L'objectif n'est pas seulement la performance : nous cherchons la solution la plus sobre et la plus rapide, capable d'être industrialisée dans nos pipelines de données. Tu travailleras au cœur d'une équipe R&D, avec un vrai sujet ouvert, des moyens de calcul et la liberté de proposer tes propres pistes. TA CONTRIBUTION : Il te faudra : • Établir un état de l'art structuré des trois familles d'algorithmes (statistiques, profonds, diffusion) pour l'imputation et la détection d'anomalies. • Concevoir un protocole d'évaluation commun mesurant performance, robustesse, temps de calcul et consommation énergétique. • Implémenter et comparer des algorithmes représentatifs de chaque famille sur des jeux de données de référence. • Identifier les conditions dans lesquelles les modèles de diffusion apportent un gain réel face à des méthodes plus simples – et à quel coût. • Restituer tes résultats à l'équipe et contribuer aux publications / livrables du Lab'Innov. POUR TOI : • Une immersion dans un projet de recherche. • La maîtrise de modèles de pointe (dont les modèles de diffusion) sur un cas d'usage concret, pas un exercice d'école. • Une compétence très recherchée : savoir évaluer et industrialiser un modèle, pas seulement l'entraîner. • Un livrable valorisable (benchmark, article, soutenance) et une porte d'entrée vers un CDI chez Aubay. Mots clés : Data Quality, Imputation, Détection d'anomalies, Modèles de diffusion, Deep Learning, Stack technique : Benchmark, R&D, Thèse, Frugalité numérique Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Pandas / NumPy, modèles de diffusion, Git, Jupyter / MLflow QUI ES-TU ? Tu es en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou équivalent, et tu recherches un stage de fin d'études de 4 à 6 mois , pour démarrer entre février et avril 2027. Tu es une personne motivée, dynamique et autonome. Avec un attrait pour la R&D et l'innovation. Tu aimes le travail en équipe. Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage.

Deze keuzes beïnvloeden
items.desc: Jouw werkzaamheden Hoe je samen met ons vooruit gaat Goods-to-Person (GtP)-oplossingen met Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) worden steeds belangrijker binnen logistieke automatisering. Bij het ontwerpen van zo’n oplossing moeten keuzes worden gemaakt over de magazijnlayout, het aantal robots, de inrichting van werkstations, verkeersstromen, bufferplaatsen en de aansturing vanuit WMS/WCS. Deze keuzes beïnvloeden elkaar en zijn in een vroege projectfase lastig integraal te beoordelen. Met de komst van AI en moderne 3D-technologie kunnen we zelf realistische emulatieomgevingen ontwikkelen. Daarmee willen we concepten niet alleen berekenen, maar ook zichtbaar maken, aansluiten op onze eigen software en met representatieve orderdata beproeven. Je ontwerpt en bouwt een configureerbaar 3D-emulatiemodel van een GtP-pickingomgeving. In deze virtuele omgeving rijden merk-onafhankelijke AMRs tussen opslaglocaties en pickingstations. Op de werkstations worden de pickhandelingen van operators gevisualiseerd en verwerkt. De omgeving moet integraal kunnen samenwerken met algoritmes uit ons WMS/WCS en met een dataset van orders en orderregels. Zo ontstaat een experimenteeromgeving waarmee verschillende systeemconfiguraties herhaalbaar kunnen worden uitgevoerd, geobserveerd en vergeleken. Jouw vaardigheden Jouw kijk op vooruit gaan Je bent bijna klaar met een hbo- of wo-opleiding in ICT & Technology, Industrial IT, Software Engineering, Industriële Automatisering, Game/Simulation Technology of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt aantoonbare interesse in softwarearchitectuur, 3D-ontwikkeling, simulatie/emulatie en logistieke automatisering. Je kunt zelfstandig ontwerpen en realiseren, maar zoekt actief afstemming met software-engineers, projectteams en eindgebruikers. Kennis van .NET, SQL, API-koppelingen, versiebeheer en een 3D-engine is een pré. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwe technieken snel eigen maakt. Je werkt gestructureerd, test je aannames en kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen. Wat wij jou bieden Zo helpen we jou vooruit Je werkt aan een tastbaar en visueel resultaat dat direct aansluit op actuele vraagstukken binnen magazijnautomatisering. De combinatie van 3D, AI, AMRs, logistieke processen en WMS/WCS maakt dit een brede opdracht met ruimte voor zowel onderzoek als softwareontwikkeling. Een fijne, informele werksfeer en begeleiding op maat door enthousiaste professionals Volop ruimte voor jouw innovatieve ideeën Een afstudeerplek met veel afwisseling binnen een netwerk dat volop in beweging is (Door)groeimogelijkheden na het afronden van je opdracht Flexibele werktijden

items.desc: From Data to Decisions. From Platform to Value At Hilti, our Data Science Interns turn complex data into meaningful insights that power our digital products and customer experience. In this role, you’ll design experiments, build models, and work hands-on with large-scale data to shape real business decisions. Embedded in a highly skilled engineering community, you’ll gain end‑to‑end exposure, from hypothesis testing to production-ready solutions, without the typical barriers of slow processes or limited impact. This is a full‑time internship position. Start date is flexible. Duration for at least 6 months. No travel is foreseen for this position. What You'll Do As a Data Science Intern, you’ll work at the intersection of advanced analytics and real-world business needs. You will participate in discovery phases to understand business requirements, identify data-driven opportunities, and translate them into actionable use cases. Your daily work involves designing experiments, testing hypotheses, and developing statistical or machine learning models using Python. You’ll be embedded in an experienced team of data engineers and data scientists, benefitting from pair programming, version control, and a fully established CI/CD environment. You’ll work with diverse data sources-internal, external, structured, and unstructured-and assess what is relevant for each use case. You will help shape strategies for data collection, integration, and retention, and will collaborate closely with domain experts across the company. A key part of the role is communicating complex insights into clear, business-friendly language. You’ll support stakeholders in adopting data science methods, run statistical validations, and guide teams through agile delivery using Scrum. Throughout your internship, you’ll contribute to impactful, production-oriented solutions that enable better decisions across Hilti’s digital business. What You’ll Bring Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or similar throughout the full internship duration Hands-on experience with Python and SQL with exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS Basic knowledge of software engineering practices (e.g. architecture basics, version control, CI/CD). Ability to communicate complex analytics clearly Strategic problem-solving mindset What’s In It for You Benefits At Hilti, you’ll join a family-owned company that thinks long term, invests in its people, and trusts individuals to make a real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to business success, and be supported in creating your future through continuous learning, development opportunities, and diverse career paths. Some of the benefits of building your career with us include: A diverse global headquarters community of more than 2,100 colleagues representing 70 nationalities. The opportunity to create visible, long-term impact on Hilti’s business and global reputation. Career opportunities across functions, regions and leadership roles, supported by a transparent development framework. A flexible, trust-based working model, including remote work and workation. Opportunities to contribute to local and global social-impact initiatives. More than 60 employee-led networks and activities. A modern campus with an onsite gym, restaurants and access to outdoor activities. Why Hilti Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. At our global headquarters in Schaan, Nendeln, Buchs, and nearby hubs, we shape Hilti’s digital strategy and enterprise platforms worldwide. Our cross‑functional teams in product IT, data & analytics, cybersecurity, ERP, and digital customer platforms work side‑by‑side with business leaders to design, build, and run solutions at global scale. HQ offers a collaborative environment where architecture decisions, platform reliability, and secure-by-design engineering translate into real impact for our customers and teams. Commitment to Inclusion At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.
