items.desc: Cobalt Fairy is a digital innovation company dedicated to enriching the digital world through ebooks, audiobooks, and innovative digital products, including FairyMail, our email marketing platform currently in its Early Adopter phase. We are currently looking for an AI Solutions & Automation Specialist to help us leverage AI across Cobalt Fairy and FairyMail. This role focuses on identifying opportunities, designing and implementing AI-powered workflows, automating repetitive processes, improving internal efficiency, and supporting team members in adopting AI tools that create measurable value. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, building practical solutions, and helping teams work smarter. Core responsibilities Map workflows and convert business pain points into clear, ranked automation opportunities. Prototype and productionize AI workflows across internal tools, APIs, dashboards, content systems, and communications platforms. Build the priority automations, including meeting intelligence, cross-tool reporting, monitoring/alerts, and research pipelines. Can frame ambiguous problems, prioritize by value/risk, prototype quickly, and distinguish a demo from a reliable workflow. Can interview stakeholders, map processes, challenge assumptions, and find unrecognized opportunities. Demonstrates confidentiality, security awareness, data minimization, ethical restraint, and sound escalation instincts. Ability to work independently under tight deadlines, take initiative, and collaborate effectively as part of a team. Strong analytical, problem solving and critical thinking skills. Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with AI and technology trends. Fluent in Greek and English; can explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical teammates and document systems clearly. What we offer Fully remote & flexible working hours High ownership & autonomy; you'll have the freedom to identify opportunities, propose solutions, and shape how AI and automation are used across the company. Build the function from the ground up; you'll be the first person dedicated to AI solutions and automation, with the opportunity to establish processes, tools, standards, and best practices. Direct impact on the business; your work will directly influence how our teams operate and how we develop FairyMail and other digital products. Experimentation & innovation; freedom to test new AI tools, models, platforms, and approaches and turn promising ideas into practical solutions. Access to real business problems and data; rather than working on isolated technical projects, you'll work directly with teams across the company to identify and solve operational challenges. Opportunity to grow with the role; as our use of AI and automation expands, there is room for the position and its responsibilities to evolve with it. Collaborative, international environment; work with a remote team across different functions and contribute to a growing digital company. Location Anywhere there is a wi-fi connection. Work from home, in your PJs or in your hometown’s library, as long as you ensure the quality of work and comfortable working space. Schedule As a full-time position, we calculate a total 40-hour work week but with flexible working hours. Your attendance however on occasional morning meetings is to be considered as mandatory. items.desc: We are looking for young talent willing to combine writing their thesis with working as a student assistant in one of our departments. We firmly believe that this combination provides the candidate with the best opportunity to experience what working for Ortec Finance is like. The length of this program is typically 7 months but can be tailored to the candidate's preferences. During the application process, R&D Labs will explore relevant quantitative thesis topics to work on during your internship. In addition, based on your ambitions and interests, we match you to one or more departments to work for us as a student assistant. Starting dates are flexible, with the earliest possible start in December 2026. Who are you? We Are Looking For Candidates who are creative; who like problem solving; who are able to bring theory into practice. And, preferably with expertise in one of the following areas: Quantitative Finance/Econometrics Applied mathematics Computer Science Other quantitative studies This position is only open to students that are in their last stage of their Master of Science (MSc). What do we offer? Our organization employs highly educated people who invest in their careers. Our corporate culture is open and informal; we are always receptive to good ideas. We offer you plenty of room to fully apply your talents and highly value an entrepreneurial spirit. In addition, we provide you with a salary based on the ratio, internship and student assistantship. You will be based at either our Rotterdam or Amsterdam office. Flexibility in working from home or at the office. Possibility to grow within the company. Master students receive 1.597 euro (gross month allowance) based on a combined function of two days as a student assistant and three days internship. R&D Labs Since its establishment, Ortec Finance has put innovation through applied scientific research and IT developments on the forefront. Our research and innovation activities are concentrated within the Ortec Finance R&D Labs where we have strong ties with academic institutions. We work and experiment with both new modelling approaches and IT techniques and concepts in order to research their applicability to investment decision-making. R&D Labs aims to be the linking pin between Ortec Finance and the scientific research community. It performs innovative, high-quality research with a strong practical focus. We collaborate with students, academics and external parties to design the future of investment decision making. Who is Ortec Finance? Working at Ortec Finance means working somewhere else. It means working in a world where colleagues meet, gather knowledge and where likeminded peers are always willing to help each other. Where the organizational culture is friendly, flat and non-political. Working at Ortec Finance also means working in a continuously innovating world where science, academics and mathematics dominate, since models are key in helping Ortec Finance’ clients with complex financial decisions. Because that’s what we love: giving our clients the best advice possible. Where the daily job is very in-dept, based on evidence and relevant for society. It means a job that matters. Where the learning curve is steep; we learn something new every single day. And we need to, because continuous innovation is key. Especially in a fin tech world. We don’t necessarily follow all conventions. Because yes, we are a bit rebellious too. Ortec Finance is the leading provider of technology and solutions for risk and return management. It is our purpose to enable people to manage the complexity of investment decisions. We do this through delivering leading technologies and solutions for investment decision-making to financial institutions around the world. Our strength lies in an effective combination of advanced models, innovative technology and in-depth market knowledge. More at www.ortecfinance.com. More information or to apply? For more information regarding this position please send an email to: Recruitment@ortec-finance.com. To apply, please use the application button to send us below documents: CV list of grades cover letter (including preferred start date). We hope to meet you soon! We model and map relevant uncertainties to help you monitor your goals and decisions. Established by foremost experts in the fields of Econometrics and Technology in 1982, we have garnered an exceptional reputation for reliability. Serving over 600 clients across more than 20 countries, we play a pivotal role in enhancing our clients' investment decision making, and managing their uncertainty.

Funciones Arquitectura Agentic y Orquestación Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas multiagente utilizando LangGraph . Desarrollar sistemas de planificación, enrutamiento, razonamiento iterativo y toma de decisiones basados en patrones como ReAct y Plan-and-Execute . Construir soluciones basadas en Mixture of Agents (MoA) , donde agentes especializados colaboren para analizar, validar y consolidar respuestas. Gestión del Conocimiento e Inteligencia Artificial Generativa Diseñar e implementar pipelines de extracción, procesamiento y vectorización de información procedente de PDFs y documentación no estructurada. Afinar, evaluar y desplegar modelos open-source mediante técnicas como LoRA y QLoRA . Desarrollar e implementar Small Language Models (SLMs) para entornos on-premise, edge computing y casos de uso orientados a optimización de costes. Implementar mecanismos de aprendizaje continuo a partir de resultados aceptados y rechazados por los usuarios. Diseñar la infraestructura necesaria para la ejecución de agentes: gestión de contexto, memoria, herramientas, observabilidad y evaluación. Sistemas Basados en Reglas y Optimización Transformar criterios de negocio en reglas auditables y verificables. Integrar herramientas de optimización, routing y razonamiento como recursos reutilizables dentro del ecosistema de agentes. Experiencia demostrable con LangGraph y sistemas multiagente. Experiencia en diseño de sistemas con memoria, guardrails, aprobación humana y llamadas a herramientas ( tool calling ). Conocimiento y experiencia práctica con Model Context Protocol (MCP) . Experiencia en arquitecturas RAG , embeddings, vectorización y bases de datos vectoriales como Qdrant , Weaviate , Milvus o pgvector . Conocimiento de arquitecturas MoE (Mixture of Experts) , MoA (Mixture of Agents) y MoT (Mixture of Thought) . Experiencia afinando modelos mediante LoRA y QLoRA utilizando PyTorch . Conocimiento sólido de Small Language Models (SLMs) y criterios para su utilización frente a LLMs de propósito general. Experiencia desarrollando entornos de ejecución para agentes inteligentes, incluyendo gestión de contexto, herramientas, aprobaciones y evaluación. Experiencia o conocimientos en modelos híbridos basados en reglas de negocio y Machine Learning. Conocimientos de Docker , CI/CD, experimentación, despliegue y monitorización de modelos. Nivel alto de inglés , tanto oral como escrito. Capacidad para comunicar decisiones técnicas y resultados de IA a perfiles no especializados. items.desc: CrowdFarming es una empresa tecnológica. Conectamos a 3.500 agricultores en 15 países con más de 500.000 hogares en toda Europa a través de productos que hemos construido nosotros: nuestro marketplace, CrowdSender (nuestro TMS) y Farmeneur, la plataforma donde los agricultores gestionan sus datos agronómicos y acceden a los servicios que les damos. En el equipo de Sustainability & Impact llevamos años construyendo nuestro programa de agricultura regenerativa. Hoy trabajamos con 100 agricultores, con un protocolo científico sólido y datos agronómicos sobre sobre 10.000 hectáreas en 6 países. El programa está demostrado y es la base de lo que queremos escalar, pero necesitamos construir nuestro propio producto digital. Tu misión inicial será crear el software con el que corre el programa: las herramientas con las que los agrónomos recogen datos en campo, el sistema que normaliza los analíticos de laboratorio (distintos por país) y los convierte en planes de acción concretos para cada agricultor, y los dashboards con los que modelamos las tendencias y defendemos nuestras cifras de impacto con rigor de auditoría. Todo conectado con Farmeneur y el marketplace, y con la IA integrada donde de verdad ahorra tiempo o mejora decisiones. Construyes sobre la misma infraestructura que Farmeneur y pasas por los mismos estándares y revisiones de código que el resto del equipo tech. [Vídeo: Conoce al equipo] ⚠️ Buscamos a alguien que construya Buscamos a una persona que piense en producto, que asuma los retos de principio a fin (esto no es un rol de IT de soporte esperando a que lleguen tickets) y que use la IA como palanca para multiplicar lo que hace. Tres rasgos que nos importan de verdad: Creador, no picacódigo. Entiendes el problema y buscas soluciones; para entregar productos que se usen, no esperas que alguien te diga exactamente que botón quiere y en dónde. Pragmático, autónomo, end-to-end, y con criterio para decidir dónde está el reto, qué construir y cómo. El dato en el centro. Te mueves con soltura en pipelines, APIs e integraciones, análisis y BI/dashboarding. Conviertes un dataset desordenado en algo que un agricultor entiende a la primera. IA’s best friend. Ya trabajas con herramientas de IA en tu día a día porque te hacen mejor, y sabes llevar a otros a adoptarlas. Conviertes un “aquí podríamos usar IA” en algo que el equipo acaba integrando de verdad. 🧰 Qué necesitas para tener éxito imprescindible 3-4 años de experiencia como desarrollador/a, trabajando tanto en back como en front. Node.js (también valen Express o NestJS). Angular 15 o superior (AngularJS no cuenta). TypeScript (incluyendo linters para asegurar la calidad del código). Desarrollo de APIs REST y conexión a APIs de terceros. Git (Bitbucket, GitHub o GitLab). Español o inglés con comodidad plena de trabajo. Suma puntos: Bases de datos: al menos dos de MongoDB, DynamoDB y PostgreSQL (la más importante es Mongo). AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, ECS…). Testing (Jest, Jasmine, Karma o Cypress). Experiencia en empresa con producto propio, o en equipos con diseño/UX y producto. Señales de seniority: mentoring, revisión de código, decisiones de arquitectura o liderazgo técnico. Background o curiosidad activa por agronomía, biología de suelo o ciencia ambiental. 👉 Por qué CrowdFarming, y por qué ahora Somos líderes en la venta directa de producto ecológico a nivel europeo. Founders muy implicados, con los pies en el suelo pero ambición enorme. Y un momento claro: pasar de estar presentes en 31 países a competir de verdad en cada uno de ellos con los grandes supermercados . 👉 Lo que te ofrecemos Pocas veces vas a poder aplicar lo que sabes de tech, dato e IA a una misión tan tangible: construir desde cero la plataforma sobre la que corre la agricultura regenerativa europea, con ownership real y la posibilidad de ver tu código traducido en decisiones de manejo en una finca en Sicilia o en Murcia. Lo demás también: contrato indefinido, flexibilidad real, formato híbrido en Madrid, y los típicos perks de una empresa que entiende que las personas que la forman son su activo más valioso. 🌱 Si has llegado hasta aquí No nos importa que tu CV encaje al milímetro. Nos importa cómo piensas, qué has construido y si tienes ganas de tener impacto real tanto en el negocio como en los suelos europeos. Valoramos las trayectorias que se salen del guion y a quien no espera que le digan cómo hacer bien su trabajo: alguien que asume la responsabilidad end-to-end y habla de dato más que de cosas etéreas. Si quieres construir la columna digital de la agricultura regenerativa europea, modelar el dato que hoy no sabe modelar casi nadie y meter IA en la forma de trabajar de un equipo científico, queremos conocerte.

items.desc: Das Deutsche Krebsforschungszentrum (DKFZ) ist eines der größten Krebsforschungszentren Europas. „Forschen für ein Leben ohne Krebs“ ist unsere Mission und hierfür arbeiten unsere Weltklassewissenschaftler:innen gemeinsam mit allen Mitarbeitenden. Wir erforschen, wie Krebs entsteht, erfassen Krebsrisikofaktoren und suchen nach neuen Strategien, die verhindern, dass Menschen an Krebs erkranken. Wir entwickeln neue Methoden, mit denen Tumore präziser diagnostiziert und Krebspatient:innen erfolgreicher behandelt werden können. Jeder Beitrag zählt – ob in der Forschung, in der Administration oder der Infrastruktur. Das macht unsere tägliche Arbeit so bedeutungsvoll und spannend. Die Abteilung „Medizinische Bildverarbeitung“ (Medical Image Computing – MIC) entwickelt Methoden und Softwarelösungen an der Schnittstelle von medizinischer Bildgebung, künstlicher Intelligenz, Cloud-Technologien und moderner Forschungsinfrastruktur. Für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer verteilten Bildgebungs- und Analyseplattformen suchen wir ab Januar 2027 eine:n motivierte:n Softwareentwickler:in / Research Software Engineer (m/w/d) für medizinische Bildgebungs- und Analyseplattformen . Kennziffer: 2026-0222 Unsere Plattformen basieren auf dem Open-Source-Toolkit Kaapana, einer Kubernetes-basierten Plattform für medizinische Datenanalyse, KI-Workflows sowie föderierte Analyse- und Lernszenarien. Auf dieser gemeinsamen technischen Basis betreiben wir mehrere standortübergreifende Forschungsinfrastrukturen, die lokale Instanzen an den beteiligten Standorten mit zentralen Komponenten verbinden. Zwei aktuelle Beispiele: RACOON (Radiological Cooperative Network) ist die bundesweite Bildgebungsplattform des Netzwerks Universitätsmedizin (NUM). RACOON verbindet lokale Standorte an den deutschen Universitätskliniken mit zentralen Komponenten in RACOON-CENTRAL und unterstützt multizentrische Forschungsprojekte, klinische Studien, strukturierte Befundung, Annotation, KI-gestützte Bildanalyse und die standardisierte Nachnutzung radiologischer Daten. RACOON-AI ist die zentrale KI-Plattform innerhalb dieser Infrastruktur. NCT IDAI (Image Data and Analysis Infrastructure for NCT) stellt die gemeinsame Bildgebungs- und Analyseinfrastruktur für das Nationale Centrum für Tumorerkrankungen bereit und verbindet die NCT-Standorte für standortübergreifende onkologische Forschung. Die technischen Aufgaben sind in beiden Infrastrukturen ähnlich. Im Wesentlichen unterscheiden sich die angebundenen Standorte und die fachlichen Anwendungsfälle. Ihr Schwerpunkt ergibt sich aus Ihrem Profil und dem Projektbedarf. Wichtiger Hinweis zum Profil der Stelle: Diese Position ist keine Data-Science-, Modelltraining- oder Promotionsstelle. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf robuster Softwareentwicklung, Plattformbetrieb, Methodenintegration, Support und technischer Koordination innerhalb produktiv genutzter, standortübergreifender medizinischer Forschungsinfrastrukturen. Die Stelle richtet sich an Bewerber:innen, die Forschungssoftware in nutzbare Plattformkomponenten überführen, containerisierte Dienste betreiben, KI-Methoden in reproduzierbare Workflows integrieren und technische Fragestellungen gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Standorten, deren IT-Teams und Projektpartnern lösen möchten. Ihre Aufgaben: Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattformen durch Softwareentwicklung im Open-Source-Toolkit Kaapana Integration, Bereitstellung und Pflege von KI-Methoden, Analyse-Workflows und containerisierten Anwendungen Unterstützung der Methodentranslation aus dem Medical Image Computing in die Infrastruktur an den beteiligten Standorten Softwaretechnische Integration von Werkzeugen und Konzepten zur Verarbeitung multimodaler medizinischer Daten, einschließlich Bilddaten, strukturierter klinischer Daten und weiterer forschungsrelevanter Datenquellen Technische Unterstützung multizentrischer Forschungsprojekte, klinischer Studien und medizinischer Use Cases Betrieb, Wartung, Monitoring und Fehleranalyse der lokalen und zentralen Plattform-Instanzen Second-Level-Support für IT-Ansprechpersonen und lokale IT-Teams an den angebundenen Standorten Weiterentwicklung und Wartung von Plattformkomponenten im Umfeld von Kubernetes, Helm, Docker/Podman, Apache Airflow, OpenSearch, dcm4chee, S3, Keycloak, Prometheus/Grafana und webbasierten Nutzeroberflächen Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentation, Betriebsanleitungen und Support-Materialien Teilnahme an Projektmeetings, technischen Abstimmungen und Workshops Präsentation der Plattform bei Veranstaltungen, Vernetzungsformaten und Projekttreffen Mitwirkung an Reporting, Planung und technischer Koordination Ihr Profil: Sie passen besonders gut zu uns, wenn Sie Freude an robuster Forschungssoftware, verteilten Infrastrukturen und der Zusammenarbeit mit klinischen, wissenschaftlichen und technischen Partnern haben. Zwingend erforderlich sind: Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Informatik, Medizininformatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik, …

items.desc: Ready to take the next step in your career and make your mark in the financial world? At Vontobel, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. That’s why we’re excited to welcome passionate, ambitious, and curious students into our Early Careers Internship Program. Whether you’re fascinated by finance, technology or investments, this program offers you the chance to collaborate with a dynamic team, receive personalized support, and contribute to projects that truly matter. Over 6 months, starting on 1 March 2027, you’ll gain hands-on experience and insights into the financial industry while building lasting connections in a globally recognized investment firm. What would your role be? We are looking for a motivated, analytical, and autonomous Quant Data Engineer Intern who can bridge the gap between financial data and institutional-grade infrastructure. While our core expertise lies in deep fundamental market analysis and investment strategies, we process vast amounts of quantitative data daily. We trade a variety of financial indices composed of commodity futures and are now looking to elevate our data infrastructure to the next level. As fundamental portfolio managers, we will provide financial insights, portfolio models, and the requirements for the output. Your mission is to build the backend, the data pipelines, and the front-end. You will design a robust, fully automated system that handles everything from daily data ingestion to advanced portfolio analytics and interactive visualization. items.desc: Are you passionate about digital signal processing and wireless communication? Do you want to become a part of a cross-disciplinary development group with dedicated and experienced colleagues? Would you like to leave your mark on future technology choices in Kamstrup within wireless communication? Here Is What The Job Entails As our intern, you will become part of our technology projects, where we investigate and develop new intelligent radio systems. You will be involved in several phases of the projects with tasks ranging widely from concept development to analysis and simulation of performance to actual prototyping. More specifically, you will be: Working with digital signal processing (DSP) Developing tools for testing new radio technologies and protocols Preparing mathematical analyses and simulation using Python Working with prototype implementation on radio development boards, possibly in C++, VHDL, MatLab, C#, etc. Exploring Software Defined Radio (SDR) platforms and the GNU Radio framework. During your internship, you will have the opportunity to work with different projects and in different areas depending on your interests and aspirations. Moreover, you will work with dedicated and experienced colleagues who will support your personal and professional development through close collaboration and continuous sparring. Meet your future team As our intern in Tech Lead, you will become part of our technology development team consisting of 6 dedicated employees. Here, you will participate on equal terms with your colleagues in a cross-disciplinary development group who are developing and shaping the wireless communication systems of the future for remote reading of utility meters. The department has a good working environment, where you will discover that both freedom with responsibility and personal development are in focus. The team has extensive experience with employing interns and has, over time, had more than 20 interns. Several of the former interns are still employed at Kamstrup. Did you know? We are all interested in technology and go on team events where we have, among other things, had guided tours of the parking garage beneath Dokk1 in Aarhus, the robotic warehouse at Proshop, and the waste incineration plant in Lisbjerg. Less About Us, More About You We are looking for an enthusiastic student who is eager to apply up-to-date theoretical knowledge and contribute to the development of wireless technologies at Kamstrup. During the internship, you will collaborate with the team on a variety of tasks and technical areas, including some you may not have encountered before in your studies. Therefore, a can-do attitude and a willingness to learn are important to us. Of course, we will support and guide you throughout the process. In order to succeed, we imagine that you: Are currently studying Electronics, Software Technology or a related degree Have a professional interest in, particularly, electronics, mathematics, communication theory, and software development Are thorough and structured and are excited by seeing your ideas become reality Can work independently and possess a critical mindset with the aim of finding the best solution Value collaboration and proactively seek professional sparring with your colleagues on your own initiative As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish. Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply. We offer more than just an internship At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. items.desc: Septeo est un acteur de référence du software en Europe , présent à l’international et reconnu parmi le top 5 des éditeurs de logiciels sectoriels en France . En forte croissance et en transformation permanente, le groupe s’impose comme un acteur clé de l’édition logicielle grâce à la force de son collectif : des équipes déterminées, audacieuses et engagées. Chez Septeo, l’intelligence artificielle est placée au cœur de notre évolution . Nous la concevons comme un levier de performance durable, de collaboration et d’innovation, intégrée de manière responsable dans les pratiques du quotidien et démocratisé sur l’ensemble de nos métiers. L'ambition est claire : “make intelligent software for Europe”. Notre culture repose sur des valeurs fortes : être, faire et transformer ensemble . Elle n’est pas figée; elle se vit chaque jour dans nos actions et nos décisions, à travers un équilibre entre performance, responsabilité et plaisir. Cette ambition s’incarne dans ce que nous faisons au quotidien : concevoir des logiciels qui accompagnent les moments de vie essentiels, au service de millions de citoyens. Être présent derrière ces instants clés est une responsabilité forte. C’est la nôtre. Et peut-être bientôt la votre. Rejoindre Septeo, c’est intégrer une aventure collective à dimension internationale , porter la transformation du groupe dans un environnement en mouvement rapide, et faire de l’IA un levier concret de création de valeur, aujourd’hui comme demain. Prêt(e) à faire partie de l’aventure ? Description Du Poste Nous recherchons un Développeur IA H/F , en CDI à Montpellier (Lattes), pour rejoindre notre filiale Septeo Solutions Notaires . Intégré(e) aux équipes R&D, vous participez au développement d'un nouveau produit dans un environnement où l'intelligence artificielle transforme en profondeur notre manière de concevoir et de développer des logiciels . Ici, l'IA ne se limite pas à utiliser Copilot ou ChatGPT pour générer quelques lignes de code. Notre ambition est d'aller plus loin : cadrer un besoin, concevoir une solution, déléguer une partie du développement à des agents IA, challenger leurs propositions et intégrer leurs productions dans un environnement logiciel exigeant. Nous recherchons donc un profil capable d'allier solides compétences en ingénierie logicielle et pratiques avancées du développement assisté ou piloté par l'IA . Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble Au sein d'une équipe organisée par domaine métier, vous contribuez à la construction d'un nouveau produit ainsi qu'à l'évolution de nos solutions existantes. Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à produire du code. Vous intervenez sur la conception technique, l'architecture et la qualité des solutions , avec l'objectif d'exploiter au maximum les possibilités offertes par l'IA dans le cycle de développement. Vous contribuez notamment à faire évoluer nos méthodes vers des approches où développeurs et agents IA collaborent sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement . Votre quotidien Concevoir techniquement les fonctionnalités et participer aux choix d’architecture Cadrer les besoins et piloter des agents IA pour leur déléguer tout ou partie du développement ; Analyser, challenger, tester et intégrer les productions de l’IA, tout en faisant évoluer les workflows de développement associés ; Développer et faire évoluer les fonctionnalités front et back en garantissant qualité, fiabilité et maintenabilité ; Contribuer aux revues de code, aux pratiques CI/CD et à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de développement. IA & pratiques de développement : Claude / Cursor / développement agentique / SDD. Stack technique : C# / .NET / Angular, React ou Vue.js / SQL Server / PostgreSQL / Azure DevOps / Git / Kubernetes. Qualifications Et si c'était vous ? Au-delà de la maîtrise de la stack, c'est votre façon de concevoir et de développer avec l'IA qui fera la différence. Vous avez idéalement déjà dépassé le simple usage de l'IA comme assistant de code. Vous savez par exemple : Cadrer et décomposer un besoin pour en déléguer tout ou partie à des agents IA, jusqu'à la réalisation de fonctionnalités complètes Intégrer l'IA dans vos workflows de développement, de la compréhension d'un existant à la conception, aux tests et au refactoring Challenger les productions de l'IA avec un regard d'ingénieur, afin de valider, modifier ou rejeter ses propositions. Garder suffisamment de recul technique pour savoir quand accepter, modifier ou rejeter une proposition produite par l'IA. Vous n'avez pas encore complètement industrialisé ces pratiques ? Votre candidature peut également nous intéresser si vous disposez d'une très solide maîtrise de la conception, de l'architecture et de l'ingénierie logicielle , associée à une réelle volonté de faire évoluer votre manière de développer avec l'IA. items.desc: Job Description Perplexity is looking for a Search Machine Learning Engineer Intern to help build the next generation of advanced search technologies, with a focus on retrieval and ranking. You will work closely with experienced engineers to improve search quality, experiment with new models, and ship features that directly impact how users search and discover information. Internship program: 12 - 24 weeks, full-time, in-person in the London office. Responsibilities Contribute to experiments that improve search quality through better models, data usage, and evaluation tools, under the guidance of senior engineers. Design and implement components of the search platform and model stack, including retrieval, ranking, and classification models. Train evaluating models (including LLM-based approaches) for retrieval, ranking, and classification tasks. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Framatome recherche actuellement des profils : Chez Framatome, filiale d’EDF, nous concevons et fournissons des équipements, des services, du combustible, et des systèmes de contrôle-commande pour les centrales nucléaires du monde entier. Nos 20000 collaborateurs permettent chaque jour à nos clients de produire un mix énergétique bas-carbone toujours plus propre, plus sûr et plus économique. Nos équipes développent également des solutions pour les secteurs de la défense, de la médecine nucléaire et du spatial. Implantée dans une vingtaine de pays, Framatome rassemble les expertises d'hommes et de femmes passionnés et convaincus que le nucléaire est une énergie d'avenir. \n\n Le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle appliquées aux Contrôles Non Destructifs a été identifié comme un axe stratégique pour renforcer la compétitivité d’Intercontrôle et accompagner l’évolution de ses métiers. La mise en œuvre de ces approches soulève toutefois plusieurs enjeux structurants : gestion de volumes importants de données, adaptation des outils d’annotation aux besoins métier, traçabilité et versionnement des jeux de données, suivi des expérimentations, reproductibilité des entraînements, gestion et comparaison des versions de modèles, dans la continuité des bonnes pratiques aujourd’hui regroupées sous le terme de MLOps. Ces enjeux dépassent donc la seule performance des algorithmes. Ils nécessitent de structurer progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée et des modèles d’IA, depuis l’acquisition et l’annotation jusqu’à l’entraînement, l’évaluation et l’exploitation. L’objectif est de disposer d’un socle commun permettant de capitaliser sur les développements IA, de les rendre réutilisables et de faciliter leur passage du prototype à un usage industriel. Dans ce contexte, Intercontrôle souhaite développer un POC logiciel permettant d’éprouver ces pratiques, d’en valider la pertinence sur des cas d’usage concrets et de disposer d’un démonstrateur capable d’en illustrer la valeur auprès des utilisateurs et des différentes parties prenantes. Le stage aura pour objectif de concevoir et développer un POC logiciel dédié aux problématiques de computer vision appliquées aux Contrôles Non Destructifs. Le prototype devra notamment permettre de : Définir une ontologie métier commune décrivant les analyses, composants inspectés, zones ou faces, défauts, acquisitions, annotations, métadonnées et résultats d’analyse ; Définir des standards de données permettant de structurer, tracer et versionner de manière homogène les données image et vidéo, dans une logique inspirée des pratiques MLOps ; Définir des interfaces et standards d’entrée/sortie communs permettant d’intégrer de manière modulaire les modèles de classification, de détection et de segmentation développés en interne ; Permettre l’intégration, l’entraînement, l’évaluation et la comparaison de différents modèles au sein d’une même plateforme ; Mettre en œuvre une démarche de développement assisté par des agents de codage, afin d’accélérer les itérations tout en garantissant la qualité et la maîtrise du code produit ; À l’issue des 6 mois, proposer un démonstrateur concret permettant d’éprouver les besoins, de recueillir les retours utilisateurs et de démontrer la valeur de ces pratiques avant leur intégration progressive dans les outils existants. Vous êtes en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou suivez une formation universitaire équivalente de niveau Bac +5, avec une spécialisation en informatique, génie logiciel, data science ou intelligence artificielle. Vous disposez d’un intérêt pour le développement logiciel, la structuration de données et l’intelligence artificielle. La maîtrise de l’ensemble des compétences ci-dessous n’est pas indispensable : votre capacité à apprendre rapidement, à expérimenter et à monter en compétences sera également déterminante. Compétences requises : Développement logiciel en HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Python et C# Connaissances en architecture logicielle (MVC, Plugin Architecture, Pipeline, etc.) et en conception d’applications modulaires Connaissances en Spec-Driven Development et capacité à formaliser des besoins fonctionnels et techniques Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : tests unitaires, documentation, qualité et maintenabilité du code Utilisation de Git et des workflows de développement collaboratif Utilisation d’agents de codage assistés par IA Conception et manipulation de bases de données relationnelles (SQL, PostgreSQL/SQLite), structuration de schémas et gestion de métadonnées Manipulation de données image et vidéo et connaissances en computer vision/deep learning (PyTorch, OpenCV) Compréhension des pratiques MLOps Autonome, …

Pour plus d'informations, visitez notre site www.3ds.com/fr La mission de Dassault Systèmes est de fournir aux entreprises et aux individus des jumeaux virtuels de mondes réels, leur permettant d'imaginer des innovations durables qui harmonisent Produit, Nature et Vie. Avec les « 3D UNIV+RSES », septième génération de représentation du monde développée par Dassault Systèmes en plus de 40 ans d'innovation, l'entreprise associe jumeaux virtuels, intelligence artificielle générative et modèles scientifiques du monde industriel pour donner corps à une économie générative, où innovation et durabilité avancent de concert. Dans le domaine des Sciences de la Vie et de la Santé, cette vision prend une dimension singulière : Dassault Systèmes est pionnier des jumeaux virtuels du monde vivant, de la cellule à l'organe jusqu'au patient, avec l'ambition de faire du jumeau virtuel le socle d'une médecine plus prédictive, personnalisée et préventive. Imaginez modéliser et comprendre le corps humain dans son intégralité, comme nous l'avons fait dans l'aérospatial avec le Boeing 777… Cette ambition prend aujourd'hui forme grâce à l'IA et aux compagnons virtuels qui accompagnent scientifiques et cliniciens dans leurs découvertes. items.card: About the role: Patent data is hard for people and machines alike. One invention can be filed in dozens of countries under different numbers and rules; one company can hold patents under many names, subsidiaries, and spellings; and whether a patent is still alive depends on events spread across years and jurisdictions. Any data or AI system built on top is only as good as the answers to a few basic questions. Which
items.desc: Patent Data Specialist (Enrichment Quality & AI Readiness) Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools? Do you revel in finding the root cause of an error, then making sure it never happens again? Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent data, ready for the AI that professionals worldwide rely on. About the team: LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy. Every one of those decisions rests on the same foundation: patent data that is grouped, attributed, and kept up to date correctly. We are looking for someone who wants to help get that foundation right. About the role: Patent data is hard for people and machines alike. One invention can be filed in dozens of countries under different numbers and rules; one company can hold patents under many names, subsidiaries, and spellings; and whether a patent is still alive depends on events spread across years and jurisdictions. Any data or AI system built on top is only as good as the answers to a few basic questions. Which filings belong to the same family? Who really owns a patent once subsidiaries, acquisitions and spelling variants are untangled? Is a patent still in force, and do we know this for every country we are interested in? A single wrongly grouped family or misattributed owner can quietly change how a customer sees a competitor. In this role, you will work alongside senior patent data experts to define what correct looks like for these foundations, test our data against it, and track down why things go wrong. It is a rare chance to combine patent knowledge with hands-on data work, and to grow into a recognised expert in an area that underpins everything we do. Key Responsibilities: Work with our senior patent data experts to define and maintain governed quality standards and acceptance criteria for patent families, ownership, legal status, and coverage, including how to handle tricky edge cases. Build and maintain versioned test sets and worked examples, such as correctly grouped families or correctly resolved owners, that engineering teams build closed-loop evaluations on, so data quality is checked automatically and continuously. Analyse our data to find quality problems, investigate their root causes with engineering teams, recommend fixes, and help design checks so they do not recur. Lead smaller quality-improvement projects end to end, with support from senior colleagues. Assess the quality of data from new sources and patent authorities before and after it enters our platform. Review the output of automated and AI-assisted enrichment, such as ownership mapping, and feed what you learn back into the standards and evaluations. Document rules and decisions clearly so they can be applied consistently, by people and by automated tools, including agentic workflows. Help resolve data questions raised by product teams and customers, sometimes against tight timelines, and turn recurring ones into reusable guidance. Present findings to colleagues and stakeholders Requirements: Experience working with patent data or patent information, for example as a patent analyst, patent information specialist, searcher, or in a data role at a patent office, data provider, or IP firm. Understanding of how patent data is structured: families, priority claims, kind codes, legal status, assignees, and the differences between patent authorities. Hands-on data skills: you are comfortable querying and analysing data yourself, for example in SQL, Python, or similar tools. A methodical approach to data quality: spotting anomalies, finding root causes and checking that fixes work. Practical use of AI tools in your own work beyond basic chat, for example AI-assisted data analysis, coding assistants or automated extraction, and an understanding of where automated and AI-based enrichment can go wrong. Precision and care with detail, combined with the judgment to know which problems matter most. Clear written communication: you can explain a data rule or an edge case so others can apply it. Experience and education. Typically, 2 or more years in patent information, patent analysis, or data roles involving patents or similarly complex data. A degree in a scientific, engineering, technical, information science or related subject, or equivalent practical experience It would be great if you also have. Experience with company ownership data, corporate hierarchies, or entity resolution Experience with non-English patent data, for example Chinese, Japanese or Korean Familiarity with data modelling, taxonomies, or classification systems …

items.desc: About Us_ // At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. The Role_ At Masabi, we’re powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible and seamless. We’re building our next data platform. Our ticketing, validation and payment services already publish events to Kafka, and over the coming year we’re turning those events into a governed lakehouse on AWS that transit agencies, internal teams and our APIs can query. It will replace our current Elasticsearch-based data store. You’ll join a small Data team of software engineers who design as well as build: choosing approaches, measuring performance and cost, and writing your choices down. You’ll bring software engineering practices to a data platform, from well-tested services and CI checks to infrastructure as code. What you build will shape how agencies and our own teams use their data. Location_ This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania Responsibilities_ Build and run the services that ingest Kafka topics into Apache Iceberg tables on AWS, including partitioning, compaction, deduplication and backfills of historical data Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, using AI tools with good judgement, and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards Work with the teams that produce the data on data contracts, including Avro schemas with field-level classification, schema evolution rules and the CI checks that enforce them Build privacy and access into the platform: personal data erasure, retention and per-agency access control Build the query layer behind our customer-facing data API, and give others access through Athena Evaluate technical approaches, measure performance and cost, and document the choices you make Migrate existing dashboards, reports and finance extracts onto the new platform Later, build the curated layer of shared metrics and business-ready datasets for BI tools and an AI analytics assistant About You_ What you’ll need: Solid software engineering fundamentals: you write production code, test it properly and work comfortably with Git and CI pipelines AI fluency: you use AI coding tools daily and check their output carefully, especially for SQL, schema changes and anything that affects data correctness Good SQL and some experience building or running data pipelines, so you’re comfortable working with data from source to query A solid grasp of data modelling Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English What will help you thrive: Experience running a lakehouse or data warehouse in production Production experience with Kafka and schemas (ideally Avro) Experience handling personal data, including privacy, retention and access control You’re comfortable making design decisions and explaining the trade-offs, in writing as well as in conversation You enjoy working closely with the teams that produce the data, not just the ones that use it Nice to have: JVM experience (Kotlin or Java), Apache Iceberg, Terraform, AWS Lake Formation, DuckDB We don’t expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work. What You’ll Learn_ How to build a data platform from the ground up for a global fare payment platform used by transit agencies and millions of riders Hands-on experience with a modern lakehouse stack: Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation, Kafka and Avro on AWS How to shape technical direction in a small team, where your design choices and write-ups set the standard How to use AI tools well in real engineering work, in a team that encourages them and cares about getting the results right Our Stack_ Java or Kotlin AWS: S3, Apache Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation (and potentially more query engines) PostgreSQL, DuckDB Kafka with Avro Terraform, GitLab CI Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all. // We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Institut des Neurosciences Paris-Saclay Type de Contrat Chercheur en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 91400 SACLAY Durée du contrat 4 mois Date d'Embauche 10/01/2027 Rémuneration salaire entre 3131 € et 3569 € selon expériences et grilles salaire CNRS Date limite de candidature : samedi 28 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Exploration et modélisation des propriétés d’oscillation d’un réseau de neurones biologiques : le Claustrum. Expérimentation (électrophysiologie, optogénetique, imagerie), analyse des données, modélisation des résultats obtenus via des réseaux de neurones AdEx et champs moyens. Maitrise de la chaine opératoire complète depuis la dissection du cerveau, découpe des tranches et maintien en survie artificielle, enregistrements en patch-clamp ou MEA des neurones, interventions pharmacologiques et optogénétiques, incubation des tranches et imagerie calcique Acquisition des données, analyse des résultats ; maîtrise de l’IA CNRS Emmy et utilisation des données dans le cadre de la modélisation. Mise en forme et écriture des résultats sous la forme de publication. L'Activité Expérimentation et modélisation. Dissections du cerveau de la souris en vue de prélèvements (EVP), expériences complémentaires d’enregistrement électrophysiologiques sur tranches de cerveau en vue de clore une publication. Analyse des données. Modélisation des propriétés électrophysiologiques des sous-types de neurones du claustrum, d’après les résultats obtenus en vue d’élaborer une publication. Votre Profil Compétences Une solide connaissance des principes biologiques en neurosciences, des neurones au réseau de neurones. Une compétence en chirurgie petit animal pour l’élaboration des tranches de cerveau avec diplôme niveau concepteur et niveau chirurgie. Une pratique approfondie des techniques d’électrophysiologie (dual patch-clamp, current-clamp, voltage-clamp, optogénétique, MEA), d’imagerie calcique et de marquage immunohistochimique (révélation Biocytin ; anticorps ; coloration). Une double compétence biologie-informatique avec au moins maîtrise du langage Python, un expérience dans la modélisation (AdEx et champs moyens) Votre Environnement de Travail L’ANR CLAwaves réunit 4 équipes de recherche, dont deux expérimentales et deux computationnelles et a financé les recherches de ce programme. Le programme dans lequel s’intègre à présent le poste consiste à terminer l’explorer des propriétés oscillatoires du réseau de neurone claustral en vue d’en extraire les mécanismes aux échelles cellulaire et synaptique pour les intégrer ensuite dans des simulations à différentes échelles (population, champs moyens, virtual brain). La fonction du poste sera de terminer les expériences in vitro en cours sur le claustrum et de les mettre en forme pour la modélisation et pour une publication devant être soumise au cours de quatre mois de postdoc. Rémunération et avantages Rémunération salaire entre 3131 € et 3569 € selon expériences et grilles salaire CNRS Congés et RTT annuels 44 jours Pratique et Indemnisation du TT Pratique et indemnisation du TT Transport Prise en charge à 75% du coût et forfait mobilité durable jusqu’à 300€ À propos de l’offre Référence de l’offre UMR9197-ODILEC2-198 Section(s) CN / Domaine de recherche Neurobiologie moléculaire et cellulaire, neurophysiologie À propos du CNRS Le CNRS est un acteur majeur de la recherche fondamentale à une échelle mondiale. Le CNRS est le seul organisme français actif dans tous les domaines scientifiques. Sa position unique de multi-spécialiste lui permet d’associer les différentes disciplines pour affronter les défis les plus importants du monde contemporain, en lien avec les acteurs du changement. items.desc: Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day. Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead. At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves. We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them. Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast Job D escription : Darktrace builds advanced cybersecurity technologies designed to help organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Our teams combine deep security expertise with innovative thinking to deliver products that detect, prevent, and respond to attacks across complex digital environments. We are expanding our security engineering and research function, and we’re looking for a Security Researcher who can turn deep cybersecurity knowledge into innovative ideas that enhance and evolve our product portfolio. As a Security Researcher, you will apply your offensive-security expertise to drive innovation across our cybersecurity product portfolio. Your work will focus on researching emerging attacker techniques, exploring how real-world adversaries operate, and experimenting with new approaches for detecting and preventing novel threats. You will generate insights that directly inform the design of new product features, detection logic, and prototype capabilities. During all this you will be teaming up with the development teams to put your valued contributions into production. This is a hybrid role requiring 2 days per week in the The Hague office. What will I be doing: You will work closely with engineering, product management, data science, and threat research teams to translate offensive research into practical defensive solutions. Whether developing proof-of-concept software, identifying opportunities for improved threat coverage, or contributing to early-stage product ideation, you will play a key role in ensuring our technology continues to anticipate and counter modern cyber threats. Your work will sit right in the middle of our R&D department at the intersection of offensive research, product innovation, and software development. Responsibilities include: Research and Development into methods that discover and prevent novel threats, Researching emerging exploit techniques, threat actor methodologies, and novel attack vectors, Building proof-of-concept software solutions that pave the way to new product features, Support the transition of proof of concepts to the development teams who will oversee the actual creation of the products and/or features, Collaborating with engineering and product teams, providing regular updates on projects and sharing cybersecurity relevant trends, Document the process of transitioning ideas to proof of concepts through research publications and potentially patents. What experience do I need: We’re looking for someone with strong offensive-security foundations paired with curiosity, creativity, and a passion for building better security products. Ideal experience includes: Strong Cybersecurity knowledge and being on top of Cybersecurity trends, Ability to think like an attacker and creatively explore how systems can be misused or subverted, Proficiency with scripting or automation languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell) Familiarity with version control systems (e.g. Git) Ability to craft proof-of-concept scripts to validate findings, Strong communication skills and ability to explain offensive insights to product and development teams, Broad but strong knowledge of architecture, operating systems, networking, virtualization/containerization platforms, API design and interfacing etc. is a plus Experience with Machine Learning / AI applications (within security context) is a plus. Join Us If you’re passionate about using offensive-security expertise to shape world-class cybersecurity products, and you enjoy solving complex problems at scale, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now or explore more opportunities on our careers page. Benefits: 25 days’ holiday + all public holidays, Additional day off for your birthday, Commuting allowance, Pension Scheme, Life & Disability insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Bicycle Leasing Scheme. items.desc: About Us_ // At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. The Role_ At Masabi, we’re powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible and seamless. We’re building our next data platform. Our ticketing, validation and payment services already publish events to Kafka, and over the coming year we’re turning those events into a governed lakehouse on AWS that transit agencies, internal teams and our APIs can query. It will replace our current Elasticsearch-based data store. You’ll join a small Data team of software engineers who design as well as build: choosing approaches, measuring performance and cost, and writing your choices down. You’ll bring software engineering practices to a data platform, from well-tested services and CI checks to infrastructure as code. What you build will shape how agencies and our own teams use their data. Location_ This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Poland Responsibilities_ Build and run the services that ingest Kafka topics into Apache Iceberg tables on AWS, including partitioning, compaction, deduplication and backfills of historical data Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, using AI tools with good judgement, and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards Work with the teams that produce the data on data contracts, including Avro schemas with field-level classification, schema evolution rules and the CI checks that enforce them Build privacy and access into the platform: personal data erasure, retention and per-agency access control Build the query layer behind our customer-facing data API, and give others access through Athena Evaluate technical approaches, measure performance and cost, and document the choices you make Migrate existing dashboards, reports and finance extracts onto the new platform Later, build the curated layer of shared metrics and business-ready datasets for BI tools and an AI analytics assistant About You_ What you’ll need: Solid software engineering fundamentals: you write production code, test it properly and work comfortably with Git and CI pipelines AI fluency: you use AI coding tools daily and check their output carefully, especially for SQL, schema changes and anything that affects data correctness Good SQL and some experience building or running data pipelines, so you’re comfortable working with data from source to query A solid grasp of data modelling Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English What will help you thrive: Experience running a lakehouse or data warehouse in production Production experience with Kafka and schemas (ideally Avro) Experience handling personal data, including privacy, retention and access control You’re comfortable making design decisions and explaining the trade-offs, in writing as well as in conversation You enjoy working closely with the teams that produce the data, not just the ones that use it Nice to have: JVM experience (Kotlin or Java), Apache Iceberg, Terraform, AWS Lake Formation, DuckDB We don’t expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work. What You’ll Learn_ How to build a data platform from the ground up for a global fare payment platform used by transit agencies and millions of riders Hands-on experience with a modern lakehouse stack: Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation, Kafka and Avro on AWS How to shape technical direction in a small team, where your design choices and write-ups set the standard How to use AI tools well in real engineering work, in a team that encourages them and cares about getting the results right Our Stack_ Java or Kotlin AWS: S3, Apache Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation (and potentially more query engines) PostgreSQL, DuckDB Kafka with Avro Terraform, GitLab CI Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all. // We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. items.desc: Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools? Do you revel in finding the root cause of an error, then making sure it never happens again? Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent data, ready for the AI that professionals worldwide rely on. About The Team LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy. Every one of those decisions rests on the same foundation: patent data that is grouped, attributed, and kept up to date correctly. We are looking for someone who wants to help get that foundation right. About The Role Patent data is hard for people and machines alike. One invention can be filed in dozens of countries under different numbers and rules; one company can hold patents under many names, subsidiaries, and spellings; and whether a patent is still alive depends on events spread across years and jurisdictions. Any data or AI system built on top is only as good as the answers to a few basic questions. Which filings belong to the same family? Who really owns a patent once subsidiaries, acquisitions and spelling variants are untangled? Is a patent still in force, and do we know this for every country we are interested in? A single wrongly grouped family or misattributed owner can quietly change how a customer sees a competitor. In this role, you will work alongside senior patent data experts to define what correct looks like for these foundations, test our data against it, and track down why things go wrong. It is a rare chance to combine patent knowledge with hands-on data work, and to grow into a recognised expert in an area that underpins everything we do. Key Responsibilities Work with our senior patent data experts to define and maintain governed quality standards and acceptance criteria for patent families, ownership, legal status, and coverage, including how to handle tricky edge cases. Build and maintain versioned test sets and worked examples, such as correctly grouped families or correctly resolved owners, that engineering teams build closed-loop evaluations on, so data quality is checked automatically and continuously. Analyse our data to find quality problems, investigate their root causes with engineering teams, recommend fixes, and help design checks so they do not recur. Lead smaller quality-improvement projects end to end, with support from senior colleagues. Assess the quality of data from new sources and patent authorities before and after it enters our platform. Review the output of automated and AI-assisted enrichment, such as ownership mapping, and feed what you learn back into the standards and evaluations. Document rules and decisions clearly so they can be applied consistently, by people and by automated tools, including agentic workflows. Help resolve data questions raised by product teams and customers, sometimes against tight timelines, and turn recurring ones into reusable guidance. Present findings to colleagues and stakeholders Requirements Experience working with patent data or patent information, for example as a patent analyst, patent information specialist, searcher, or in a data role at a patent office, data provider, or IP firm. Understanding of how patent data is structured: families, priority claims, kind codes, legal status, assignees, and the differences between patent authorities. Hands-on data skills: you are comfortable querying and analysing data yourself, for example in SQL, Python, or similar tools. A methodical approach to data quality: spotting anomalies, finding root causes and checking that fixes work. Practical use of AI tools in your own work beyond basic chat, for example AI-assisted data analysis, coding assistants or automated extraction, and an understanding of where automated and AI-based enrichment can go wrong. Precision and care with detail, combined with the judgment to know which problems matter most. Clear written communication: you can explain a data rule or an edge case so others can apply it. Experience And Education. Typically, 2 or more years in patent information, patent analysis, or data roles involving patents or similarly complex data. A degree in a scientific, engineering, technical, information science or related subject, or equivalent practical experience It would be great if you also have. Experience with company ownership data, corporate hierarchies, or entity resolution Experience with non-English patent data, for example Chinese, Japanese or Korean Familiarity with data modelling, taxonomies, or classification systems Experience with data quality tooling or automated testing of …

items.desc: Patent Data Specialist (Enrichment Quality & AI Readiness) Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools? Do you revel in finding the root cause of an error, then making sure it never happens again? Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent data, ready for the AI that professionals worldwide rely on. About the team: LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy. Every one of those decisions rests on the same foundation: patent data that is grouped, attributed, and kept up to date correctly. We are looking for someone who wants to help get that foundation right. About the role: Patent data is hard for people and machines alike. One invention can be filed in dozens of countries under different numbers and rules; one company can hold patents under many names, subsidiaries, and spellings; and whether a patent is still alive depends on events spread across years and jurisdictions. Any data or AI system built on top is only as good as the answers to a few basic questions. Which filings belong to the same family? Who really owns a patent once subsidiaries, acquisitions and spelling variants are untangled? Is a patent still in force, and do we know this for every country we are interested in? A single wrongly grouped family or misattributed owner can quietly change how a customer sees a competitor. In this role, you will work alongside senior patent data experts to define what correct looks like for these foundations, test our data against it, and track down why things go wrong. It is a rare chance to combine patent knowledge with hands-on data work, and to grow into a recognised expert in an area that underpins everything we do. Key Responsibilities: Work with our senior patent data experts to define and maintain governed quality standards and acceptance criteria for patent families, ownership, legal status, and coverage, including how to handle tricky edge cases. Build and maintain versioned test sets and worked examples, such as correctly grouped families or correctly resolved owners, that engineering teams build closed-loop evaluations on, so data quality is checked automatically and continuously. Analyse our data to find quality problems, investigate their root causes with engineering teams, recommend fixes, and help design checks so they do not recur. Lead smaller quality-improvement projects end to end, with support from senior colleagues. Assess the quality of data from new sources and patent authorities before and after it enters our platform. Review the output of automated and AI-assisted enrichment, such as ownership mapping, and feed what you learn back into the standards and evaluations. Document rules and decisions clearly so they can be applied consistently, by people and by automated tools, including agentic workflows. Help resolve data questions raised by product teams and customers, sometimes against tight timelines, and turn recurring ones into reusable guidance. Present findings to colleagues and stakeholders Requirements: Experience working with patent data or patent information, for example as a patent analyst, patent information specialist, searcher, or in a data role at a patent office, data provider, or IP firm. Understanding of how patent data is structured: families, priority claims, kind codes, legal status, assignees, and the differences between patent authorities. Hands-on data skills: you are comfortable querying and analysing data yourself, for example in SQL, Python, or similar tools. A methodical approach to data quality: spotting anomalies, finding root causes and checking that fixes work. Practical use of AI tools in your own work beyond basic chat, for example AI-assisted data analysis, coding assistants or automated extraction, and an understanding of where automated and AI-based enrichment can go wrong. Precision and care with detail, combined with the judgment to know which problems matter most. Clear written communication: you can explain a data rule or an edge case so others can apply it. Experience and education. Typically, 2 or more years in patent information, patent analysis, or data roles involving patents or similarly complex data. A degree in a scientific, engineering, technical, information science or related subject, or equivalent practical experience It would be great if you also have. Experience with company ownership data, corporate hierarchies, or entity resolution Experience with non-English patent data, for example Chinese, Japanese or Korean Familiarity with data modelling, taxonomies, or classification systems …

items.desc: Role Title: Portuguese AI Evaluator (Remote) Role Type : Full-time Location: Remote Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications 1. Portugueese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. 2. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. 3. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. 4. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. 5. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. 6. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. 7. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. 8. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. 9. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. 10. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 11. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. 12. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: 1. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: 2. Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. 3. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. 4. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. 5. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating". 6. Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. 7. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. 8. Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. 9. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience 1. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). 2. Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: 1. Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. 2. Engagement type: Contractor 3. Engagement Length: 3 months 4. Our offered rate for this project is $15 per hour. Evaluation Process - 1. Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. 2. items.title: Research Fellow in AI Engineering and Commercialisation
items.card: About The Role You will contribute to the development and commercialisation of AI-enabled healthcare tools, combining hands-on software engineering and system architecture with product development, evaluation and implementation. Working closely with the Chief Investigator and clinical, academic and industry partners, you will design and implement technical architectures connecting diverse datasets, research
items.desc: The Health Data, MLTC and AI Group (HMAI) is based in the University of Southampton’s Primary Care Research Centre. We combine complex data with AI and clinical expertise to understand health and transform care. Our work spans population health intelligence, digital phenotyping and product innovation — translating research into scalable technologies for more personalised, predictive and preventative healthcare. About The Role You will contribute to the development and commercialisation of AI-enabled healthcare tools, combining hands-on software engineering and system architecture with product development, evaluation and implementation. Working closely with the Chief Investigator and clinical, academic and industry partners, you will design and implement technical architectures connecting diverse datasets, research algorithms, AI components and external services. You will build, test and deploy software, incorporating large language model and agentic AI capabilities where appropriate, and translate clinical and user requirements into practical product features. Alongside technical delivery, you will support product planning, commercial partnerships, customer discovery, business models, demonstrations, funding applications and pilot delivery. You will maintain robust engineering workflows and documentation, addressing interoperability, security, governance and responsible AI throughout development. The post is part-time (20 hours per week) fixed-term until 30/04/2027, at Level 4 with potential for extension About You You will hold a relevant PhD or equivalent professional experience in software engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence or a related discipline. Strong programming skills and demonstrable experience of building functioning software are essential. You will have practical experience of system architecture, APIs, databases, testing and deployment, alongside experience of integrating AI into applications. You will combine technical rigour with commercial awareness and an interest in translating research into usable products. You will be able to organise development activities, deliver agreed milestones and explain technical decisions clearly to clinical, academic and commercial colleagues. Experience of digital health, commercial product development, industry partnerships, customer discovery or university spin-outs would be advantageous. We value collaborative working, user-centred development and a commitment to safe, inclusive and reproducible innovation. For an informal discussion, contact Dr Hajira Dambha-Miller at H.Dambha-Miller@soton.ac.uk.
