items.desc: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Growth at Kraken is being rebuilt around an AI-native platform. Instead of people manually building audiences, writing copy, adjusting budgets, and scheduling sends, agents find opportunities, make decisions, and execute across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels. They learn from every result and keep going. People still run the system. Operators use a central hub to set the rules the agents follow, review and approve what they produce, and handle exceptions when something doesn’t fit. The platform also has to work across many markets and languages, and it operates in a regulated industry, so there are compliance checks and approval steps built in. The team is a small, cross-functional group of growth, product, and engineering people who build this platform and run it day to day. We ship often, learn fast, and raise the quality bar with every release. You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted. The opportunity You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues moving, and report on how it’s performing. You will work closely with product, engineering and operators to make sure the platform works and keeps working. This is a hands-on, detail-focused role. You will spend your days in the product, testing what’s new, checking what should already work, and writing up what you find so it gets fixed. Test the platform regularly. Cover new releases, rule changes, and edge cases, and run regression checks to make sure existing features still work. Find bugs and document them clearly, with steps to reproduce, severity, and impact. Follow them through until engineering fixes them and you’ve verified the fix. Monitor platform performance and agent activity, flag anything that looks wrong, and escalate it to the right person. Work the approval queues daily. Keep items moving and make sure nothing is left unreviewed. Check agent output against defined checklists and standards, and escalate anything unclear or risky.Note where flows are confusing or inconsistent, and flag them to the team. Write and maintain documentation: test plans, QA checklists, runbooks, and release notes. What You Bring Experience in QA, testing, operations, support, or analytics, ideally on a software product or complex system Exceptional attention to detail. You notice what others miss and double-check your work. A structured approach to testing. You can create and follow a test plan, and think about what could break. Clear written communication. Your bug reports and documentation should be easy for anyone to follow. Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard and tell when a number looks off. Fast learner. You pick up new tools and systems quickly and ask thoughtful questions. AI-native habits. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you’re curious about where they get things wrong. Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs Reliability. You keep to a routine, keep your queues clear, and tell people early when something is stuck. Nice to haves Experience testing software products or AI and LLM-based tools Familiarity with Jira, Mixpanel, or similar tools Exposure to marketing, CRM, or lifecycle messaging workflows Interest in fintech or crypto Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right …

items.card: your role As a Copilot & AI Agent Engineer, you'll get hands-on with Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI, designing, building and deploying intelligent solutions that integrate with Microsoft 365, Power Platform and wider enterprise systems. You'll help us work out how AI agents can operate securely and reliably at serious scale, contributing to services supporting over 100,000 users. You don't need to know everything
items.desc: Pay up to £53,347 plus 28.97% employer pension contributions, hybrid working, flexible hours, and great work life balance. DWP. Digital with Purpose. We are looking for a Copilot & AI Agent Engineer to work closely with our multi-disciplined teams and join our community of tech experts in DWP Digital. We're using fresh ideas and leading-edge tech to build and maintain digital solutions that will be used by nearly every person in the UK, every day and at key moments in their lives. DWP is the UK's largest government department. We help people into work and make payments worth over £280bn a year to support and empower millions of people. The scale of what we do is extraordinary, and our purpose is unique. We'd love you to join us. What skills, knowledge and experience will you need? Proven ability to integrate with Microsoft 365 workloads (such as SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive and the Power Platform), using workflow orchestration tools like Power Automate or Logic Apps. Demonstrable experience of using Microsoft Graph, JSON, REST APIs and connectors. Proven experience of data security and permissions within Microsoft 365 environments with outcomes. Evidence of how AI-driven Co-pilots function, including prompts, responses and grounding in organisational data. Proven experience designing and delivering AI-powered solutions using Microsoft Co-pilot technologies or comparable AI development platforms, including the use of agents, co-pilots or intelligent automation to meet business needs. You and your role As a Copilot & AI Agent Engineer, you'll get hands-on with Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI, designing, building and deploying intelligent solutions that integrate with Microsoft 365, Power Platform and wider enterprise systems. You'll help us work out how AI agents can operate securely and reliably at serious scale, contributing to services supporting over 100,000 users. You don't need to know everything from day one. You'll get coaching, training and support to grow your expertise. Experience with Azure, APIs, Entra ID, PowerShell, CI/CD, monitoring or automation would be useful, but isn't essential. If you want to move beyond experimenting with AI and start engineering it for the real world, this could be the role for you. Details. Wages. Perks. Location: You'll join us in one of our brilliant digital hubs in Blackpool, Leeds, Manchester or Newcastle, whichever is more convenient for you. Hybrid Working: We work a hybrid model - you'll spend some time working at home and some time collaborating face to face in a hub. Pay: We offer competitive pay of up to £53,347. Pension: You'll get a brilliant civil service pension with employer contributions worth 28.97%, worth over £13,000 per year. Holidays: A generous leave package starting at 26 days rising to 31 days over time. You can also take up to 3 extra days off a month on flexi-time. You'll also get all the usual public holidays. We have a broad benefits package built around your work-life balance which includes: Flexible working including flexible hours and flex-friendly policies Time off volunteering and charitable giving Bring your authentic self to work with 'I Can Be Me in DWP' Discounts and savings on shopping, fun days out and more Interest-free loans to buy a bike or a season ticket, so it's even easier for you to get to work and start making a difference Professional development, coaching, mentoring and career progression opportunities. Process We know your time is valuable, so our application and selection process is just two stages: Apply: complete your application on Civil Service Jobs. There'll be full instructions when you click through. Interview: a single stage interview online. CLICK APPLY for more information and to start your application.

items.desc: At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change. Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale. As an Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning, you'll own the simulator behind SDL, our programme building a world-first, reinforcement-learning-driven orchestration framework for people and robots. That framework needs a simulator that is trustworthy enough to develop, tune and validate it before it touches a live warehouse. You will take over day-to-day ownership of our discrete-event simulation (built on SimPy), make it measurably closer to reality, and use it as the training and evaluation ground for learning-based policies. Simulation comes first; reinforcement learning grows to be the larger part of the role as the simulator matures. You'll compare your simulations against live operational data from some of the world's largest fulfilment sites, and your work will decide what is validated and shipped to fleets of robots in customer sites worldwide. This is not a notebook role. The simulator you own is the foundation that decides what ships to customer sites worldwide. You will work in a small, collaborative team where research meets production, as part of Applied Data Science (ADS), reporting to Oscar Mendez. Location: This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside in the UK. Right to Work: Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Locus Robotics is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future. Responsibilities Own the simulator Own and develop our SimPy-based discrete-event simulator, including its logic, design choices and the fragile areas that need care. Pay down technical debt: improve test coverage, code quality, reproducibility and developer tooling. Build the experiment infrastructure around the simulator: orchestration, study management, reporting and automated runs across benchmark sites. Generate and maintain site data (e.g. distance files, configs) needed to simulate customer warehouses. Support scenario testing and sensitivity analysis for our order-engine and orchestration teams. Tune and close the sim2real gap Define, measure and reduce the sim-to-real gap against real site data. Run parameter optimisation and tuning studies (e.g. Optuna), and diagnose anomalies and non-determinism. Model warehouse processes such as congestion, picker behaviour and queueing at the right level of fidelity. Communicate results and confidence clearly to engineering, product and operations stakeholders. Use Optimization, RL & DL to tune the simulator Grow into reinforcement learning Turn the simulator into a proper RL environment (Gymnasium/Gym-style interfaces) with fast, repeatable, scalable training runs. Design, train and evaluate RL policies, starting with guidance generation, and benchmark them against current heuristic algorithms. Guard against overfitting to simulator artefacts, and design experiments that show what transfers to the real world. Prototype, evaluate and productionise learning-based components alongside the wider ML, MLOps and OE teams. Stay current with RL, multi-agent systems and simulation research, and assess what is applicable to Locus. Contribute to internal technical papers, patents and, where appropriate, publications. Qualifications A PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field, or MSc and 5+ years of industry experience applying AI/ML or simulation to real-world problems. Hands-on experience building, extending or validating simulators, ideally discrete-event simulation (SimPy or similar). Practical experience with reinforcement learning and training simulation-based agents, including simulation for RL and Gym-style environments. Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, maintainable and reproducible code. Rigorous experimental and statistical thinking: benchmarking, tuning, ablations, uncertainty. Experience in robotics, logistics, warehouse or other operations-heavy domains. Publications in major AI, ML, robotics or vision venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV). Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. Éventuellement, les travaux menés donneront lieu à une publication scientifique Contexte : Dans le cadre de nos activités de conception de circuits intégrés (ASIC), nous développons une plateforme de calcul embarqué basée sur un processeur RISC-V. Pour le traitement des données proche capteur, nous utilisons des algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle (IA) de type transformer. Ces modèles améliorent considérablement les performances, mais exigent une puissance de calcul élevée. Pour augmenter la capacité de calcul de la plateforme tout en respectant un budget énergétique strict, l’intégration d’accélérateurs matériels optimisés peut être une solution, notamment pour les opérations de multiplication matrice-vecteur et matrice-matrice. De plus, en raison de la mémoire limitée, il est nécessaire de compresser les modèles d’IA, par exemple en stockant les poids du réseau dans des formats binaires à faible nombre de bits (moins d’un octet), ce qui est en dessous de la granularité d’un processeur généraliste. Les accélérateurs matériels doivent donc prendre en charge ces représentations. Objectifs du stage : L’objectif du stage est d’intégrer un accélérateur de multiplication matricielle à précision réduite dans la plateforme au niveau RTL (SystemVerilog). En plus de la conception matérielle, le stage inclura la démonstration de l’environnement logiciel permettant de piloter les calculs sur l’accélérateur depuis le processeur embarqué. À partir d’un design existant, l’accélérateur pourra être optimisé pour prendre en charge de nouveaux formats binaires, comme le flottant sur 4 bits (FP4). Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Prise en main de l’architecture matérielle de la plateforme et de l’environnement de simulation (niveau RTL) Etude de l’accélérateur de calcul et des solutions d’intégration dans la plateforme Intégration de l’accélérateur, mise en place du flot logiciel pour le déploiement du calcul sur l’accélérateur et validation fonctionnel Projection silicium (performance, consommation, surface) avec un flot de synthèse logique Estimation de performance, efficacité énergétique, sur des applications cibles Evolution du design de l’accélérateur pour l’intégration du nouveaux formats binaires et reprises des étape précédentes # Cea-List Moyens / Méthodes / Logiciels Outils de conception Profil du candidat Profil: Fin d'étude d'ingénieur ou Master 2 (Bac+5) Compétences en architecture de systèmes embarqués, conception de systèmes numériques, design RTL, logiciel embarqué Languages VHDL, SystemVerilog, C/C++, Python Connaissances sur l'intelligence artificielle, réseaux de neurones utiles Localisation du poste Site Grenoble Localisation du poste France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Isère (38) Ville Grenoble Critères candidat Langues Anglais (Intermédiaire) Diplôme préparé Bac+5 - Diplôme École d'ingénieurs Formation recommandée Master 2 / Ingénieur Possibilité de poursuite en thèse Non Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/02/2027

items.desc: En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Éventuellement, les travaux menés donneront lieu à une publication scientifique. Contexte : Le stage proposé s’inscrit dans le cadre du développement de méthodes d’imagerie ultrasonores pour le contrôle de structures dont la microstructure atténue fortement les ondes ultrasonores. Classiquement, celles-ci sont émises par des transducteurs piézoélectriques excités par une impulsion électrique brève. Dans le cas de matériaux comme le PMMA, le polyéthylène ou les aciers à gros grains, cette impulsion est rapidement atténuée et devient inexploitable à cause du faible rapport signal à bruit après propagation dans le matériau. Les émetteurs ultrasonores programmables permettent potentiellement de pallier ce problème par l’utilisation d’émissions codées qui augmentent l’énergie acoustique générée, au prix d’une perte en résolution temporelle. Les signaux reçus sont ensuite décodés, ce qui permet, dans le meilleur des cas, de reconstruire les signaux acoustiques débruités [2]. On distingue généralement deux types de codages. Le codage temporel consiste à moduler le signal dans sa dimension temporelle, comme c’est par exemple le cas pour un chirp. Le codage spatial consiste à exploiter les différents émetteurs d’un capteur multiéléments pour combiner leurs signaux avec différentes amplitudes, comme dans la méthode d’encodage par matrices de Hadamard. Qu'attendons-nous de vous ? L’objectif du stage sera d’identifier et d’évaluer les deux ou trois méthodes de codage de la littérature les plus pertinentes pour l’imagerie ultrasonore multiéléments TFM et PWI [3, 4]. Le stage se déroulera de la manière suivante. Après un temps consacré à l’approfondissement de la bibliographie sur le sujet, un plan de mise en œuvre des méthodes de la littérature sera défini. Ensuite, celles-ci seront mises en œuvre de manière expérimentale sur des matériaux atténuants disponibles au laboratoire (polyéthylène, acier à gros grains), à l’aide d’une chaîne électronique programmable en Python. # Cea-List Moyens / Méthodes / Logiciels Python, CIVA Profil du candidat Profil: Un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, le traitement d’image/signal, l’acoustique ultrasonore et la programmation (Python, Matlab, C, C++) est attendu. Aber auch abseits Deines eigenen Teams, wirst Du eng mit Kollegen anderer Fachbereiche zusammenarbeiten, wie dem Support, Produktmanagement oder dem Vertrieb. Wenn Du Lust hast, kannst Du irgendwann auch zusätzliche Aufgaben als Produktmanager für ein bestimmtes Produkt oder Projekt übernehmen und so immer weiter über den Tellerrand hinausschauen. Diese Position kann zu 100% aus dem Home-Office ausgeübt werden. Du musst also nicht in Thüringen oder der näheren Umgebung wohnen, um bei uns zu arbeiten, sondern kannst selbst bestimmen, wann Du wo arbeiten willst. items.desc: A 2.5-year Postdoctoral Research Associate position is available for an outstanding and ambitious scientist to study transition metal molecular spin qubits using pulse EPR spectroscopy and related methods. This position, funded by an UKRI grant managed by Dr Floriana Tuna (https://research.manchester.ac.uk/en/persons/floriana.tuna/), involves close collaboration with the University of Rhode Island (Huh group) and Brown University (Robinson group) under an UK-US research partnership to explore quantum information science concepts in metal organic systems. As part of the project, the successful applicant will interact closely with experts at the UK National EPR Facility at Manchester (Prof David Collison, Prof Eric McInnes) and access state-of-the-art instrumentation for cw and pulse EPR (1-34 GHz), rapid scan, light-induced EPR, and SQUID magnetometry (https://www.chemistry.manchester.ac.uk/epr/). Recent publications relevant to the project: J. Am .Chem. Soc. 2024, 146, 15000; Nat. Commun. 2019, 10, 3330; Chem. Sci. 2024, 15, 3003, Chem.Eur.J. 2026, e71619, Inorg. Chem. 2026, 65, 6544. Purpose of the Job The role holder is expected to characterise the electronic structure and coherence properties of a series of d-block metal complexes to a standard suitable for publication, using pulse EPR and magnetometry, and to supervise junior researchers in the research group. Candidates should have or expect to obtain a PhD qualification in chemistry, physics, or a closely related field. They should have experience in performing advanced spectroscopic and/or magnetic measurements. Experience of EPR spectroscopy and handling and measuring highly air-sensitive samples, using glove boxes, d/f block chemistry, and being adept at a variety of characterisation techniques and calculations, are all highly desirable. The successful candidate will be a highly capable, motivated and independent researcher who is able to manage a group of PhD and undergraduate students working on a variety of spectroscopy and magnetism projects. You will be part of a larger research team working across synthesis, measurements and calculations to characterise qubits and establish the electronic structures of paramagnetic complexes. You will be expected to take a leading role in the research group, including coordination with the Huh group at Rhode Island University involved in chemical syntheses, organising group meetings, and presenting findings at international conferences. The start date is 1 February 2027, or soon after, and the position is available for up to 2.5 years. The Department of Chemistry is strongly committed to promoting equality and diversity, including the Athena SWAN Charter for gender equality in higher education. The School of Natural Sciences holds a Silver Award, which recognises their good practice in relation to gender; including flexible working arrangements, family-friendly policies, and support to allow staff to achieve a good work-life balance. We particularly welcome applications from women for this post, who are currently under-represented at this grade. Appointment will always be made on merit. For further information, please visit: https://www.manchester.ac.uk/connect/jobs/equality-diversity-inclusion/awards/athena-swan/ The University will actively foster a culture of inclusion and diversity and will seek to achieve true equality of opportunity for all members of its community. (Grades 6-9) Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working here. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Find out more from our Freedom of Speech Policy. items.desc:
Introduction
 At ASML in Veldhoven, the System Delivery Management team plays a key role in coordinating the delivery of highly complex systems. The team works across multiple business functions to support operational decision-making, improve visibility into potential risks, and enhance collaboration. As data volumes and operational complexity continue to grow, there is an opportunity to leverage artificial intelligence to support faster and better-informed decisions. In this internship, you will help design and demonstrate an AI-powered solution that enables operational teams to work more effectively. This internship offers the opportunity to contribute to a real business challenge with visible impact.
 Your assignment
 During this internship, you will explore how artificial intelligence can support operational processes and decision-making within System Delivery Management. You will investigate business challenges, identify opportunities for automation and prediction, and develop practical AI solutions. The ultimate goal is to design and demonstrate an AI-powered System Delivery Control Tower that helps teams make faster and better-informed decisions. 
 Your main responsibilities will be:
 Analyze current operational workflows and identify improvement opportunities
 Investigate how generative AI and intelligent agents can support decision-making
 Design and develop AI-powered prototypes to address operational challenges
 Build and evaluate AI agents that support information gathering and action tracking
 Explore methods to predict operational risks and improve readiness assessments
 Translate technical findings into practical recommendations for stakeholders
 Present results, demonstrations, and improvement proposals to stakeholders
 This is a master thesis/non-theses internship for minimum 6 months, minimum 4-5 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.
 Your profile
 To be suitable for the internship, you:
 Are pursuing a master's degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related engineering field
 Have hands-on experience with artificial intelligence through academic projects, research, internships, or professional experience
 Have a strong technical and analytical mindset
 Are proactive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with different stakeholders
 Can translate technical concepts into practical business value
 This internship is particularly suitable for students who enjoy solving complex problems and creating innovative AI-based solutions. During this internship, you will work closely with experienced professionals while gaining exposure to operational strategy, advanced analytics, and digital transformation initiatives. Your contribution can help shape the future of AI-enabled operational decision-making at ASML.
 Other requirements you need to meet: 
 You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; 
 If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); 
 You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; 
 You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. 
 This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. 
 Inclusion and diversity

It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture.
 Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage en Intelligence Artificielle pour le centre d'Essais en vol et intégration (F/H) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus Commercial Aircraft sur son site de Toulouse. Vous rejoindrez le département « Digital Test Means » du Centre d'Essais en Vol et d'Intégration, au sein de l'équipe Intelligence Artificielle (IA).
 Votre stage consistera à concevoir, implémenter et évaluer des approches de certification et d'estimation de l'incertitude (notamment via la prédiction conforme et les réseaux de neurones Lipschitz) appliquées à des modèles d'IA critiques en computer vision pour la chaîne de mesure et les essais en vol.
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois , débutera idéalement en premier semestre 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée).
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 Réaliser un état de l'art approfondi et explorer les méthodes de prédiction conforme (Conformal Prediction) appliquées aux réseaux de neurones profonds.
 Mettre en œuvre des approches de quantification de l'incertitude indépendantes de la distribution (Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification) afin de générer des ensembles de confiance garantis (ex. à 90 %) adaptés à la complexité des données d'entrée.
 Développer et expérimenter des techniques de robustesse et de certification algorithmique (notamment via des réseaux de neurones Lipschitz ou des garanties théoriques formelles).

 Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'essais, les physiciens et les data scientists pour intégrer ces briques fiabilisées au sein de la chaîne de traitement de bout en bout.

 Expertise théorique et pratique en Conformal Prediction et en quantification de l'incertitude dans les réseaux de neurones.

 Expérience opérationnelle du déploiement d'algorithmes d'IA sur des données réelles et critiques de vision par ordinateur (OCR, analyse d'images).
 Compréhension approfondie des processus de mesure, d'instrumentation et d'essais en vol dans l'industrie aéronautique.
 Méthodologie de travail transverse en R&D industrielle combinant rigueur mathématique et implémentation logicielle.
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure : 
 Vous êtes actuellement en Master 2, 5ème année d'école d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Bac+5), spécialisé en Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques Appliquées, Informatique ou Data Science.
 Vous possédez idéalement les compétences suivantes :
 - Compétences techniques :
 Solides fondations en mathématiques appliquées (probabilités, statistiques, optimisation) et en Machine Learning / Deep Learning.
 Maîtrise des frameworks de Deep Learning et du développement Python (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.) ainsi que des bibliothèques de Computer Vision (OpenCV, etc.).
 Connaissances en quantification de l'incertitude, robustesse algorithmique ou prédiction conforme (une expérience en laboratoire de recherche appliquée ou lors d'un projet industriel est un plus).
 Une familiarité avec les environnements industriels complexes (aéronautique, spatial, automobile) constitue un atout apprécié.

 Autonomie, curiosité scientifique et rigueur méthodologique.

Job Description: 
 Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain? 
 AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain #Discover I 2027 2028 Starting date March 2027 until February 2028. 
 We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating.
 The selection process will be during October 2026 until January 2027. 
 What does this internship consists in? 
 Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.
 You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background.
 The start of the internship will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full time experience (40 h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant.
 Internship Job Description: 
 Monitor project milestones: Track the development lifecycle of AI initiatives within the Repairs department to ensure on-time delivery.
 Gather business requirements: Shadow and interview repair team to translate their daily operational pain points into functional AI features.
 Own project documentation: Create clear user guides, workflow diagrams, and technical documentation for the deployed AI repair tools.
 By the end of this internship, you will have acquired the following core competencies:
 End-to-End AI Deployment: Practical knowledge of how AI models move from data preparation to operational use.
 Agile Methodology (User Stories): Ability to test, benchmark, and audit AI outputs against expert human diagnostics.
 Smart Operations (Repairs): Deep understanding of repair process and KPIs and workflows optimization.
 Change Management: Skills to bridge the gap between technical teams and end-users, facilitating AI adoption in the field.
 Deploying AI solutions within operations, combining hands-on technical validation in BRAIN and MAIA with data tracking in SAP. 
 Required skills #AirbusDiversit 
As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
 - Degree in Data Analytics & Visualization.
 - AI & Prompt Engineering Basics
 - Data Management.
 - Level B2 English.
 - General knowledge in ERP & Logistics Systems
 Skills valued:
 - Analytical and problem solving skills.
 - Team spirit and great collaboration skills.
 - Ability to work in complex and international environments.
 Why should you apply? 
 - Foster your professional development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects.
 - Expand your network within the aeronautical industry.
 - Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place.
 - Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary on the ground, in the sky and in space.
 For any inquiries concerning this selection process, please contact us at randstad-airbus@randstad.es
 Are you interested? Apply and make it fly!

Job Description: 
 A vacancy for a Reliability, Maintainability and Testability (RMT) Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence & Space in Getafe (Madrid).
 Reliability, Maintainability and Testability (RMT) is a major core process of Support Engineering and Integrated Logistic Support. The RMT process is fully integrated with design, development and verification processes. One of the main functions and roles of RMT is to participate in development activities to ensure “Design to Services”.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Establish and agree with the Design Office and Suppliers the RMT Requirements and ensure that they are implemented in the design.
 Perform Maintainability, Reliability, Operational & Mission Reliability, Availability and Maintenance Economics Analysis and produce engineering design documentation (FMECA, Failure Catalogue, BIT concept document, MTA, QMA, FRACAS…)
 Perform Maintainability Demonstration (On-Aircraft and with Digital Mock-Up).
 Attend Design Reviews with Design Office and Customers
 Representation of RMT discipline within multi-disciplinary design teams.
 Link to Design Offices (concurrent engineering) and Suppliers regarding RAMT issues (requirements, deliverables)
 Support to other areas in Customer Services (ILS, Technical Publications, Materiel Services)
 Responsible for RMT data in Logistics Data Bases
 Support to the offers preparation.
 Conduct technical investigations to establish the root cause of in-service problems and recommend cost-effective corrective action(s) to be implemented
 Prepare and developed RMT procedures, guidelines and technical reports for the customer.
 Answer Customer queries dealing with RMT issues
 Candidates must meet all legal and professional requirements for the role. 
 SKILLS 
 Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Aeronautical/Aerospace, Industrial, or relevant engineering field.
 Core Engineering Background: Solid track record in Reliability & Maintainability (R&M / RMT / RAMS) within aerospace/defence, or solid experience in aircraft design and development engineering.
 Analysis & Methodologies: Hands-on experience with FMECA/FMEA, MTA, FRACAS, BIT concepts, failure catalogues, and availability/maintenance economics.
 Tools & Environment: Familiarity with Digital Mock-Up (DMU) for maintainability demonstrations and working knowledge of logistics/ILS databases.
 Technical Mindset: Strong passion for deep technical analysis, root-cause investigations, and data-driven problem solving.
 Stakeholder Management & Teamwork: Proven ability to work in multi-disciplinary teams and act as a key liaison between Design Offices, Customer Services, suppliers, and customers.
 Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and presentation abilities to defend technical requirements in Design Reviews and draft clear engineering reports.
 Languages: Advanced proficiency (C1 or equivalent) in both English and Spanish , essential for technical documentation, customer-facing interactions, and on-site coordination.

 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. 
 Attractive salary.

 On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. 
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. 
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. 
 Option to access special rates in products & benefits.

items.desc:
Lieu : Palaiseau, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. 
 En nous rejoignant au sein du Laboratoire Ondes et Traitement du Signal du Groupe de Recherche en Physique, vous travaillerez dans le domaine de la conversion de longueur d'onde pour la détection de faibles flux de lumière infrarouge, jusqu'au régime de photon unique. Atteindre ce régime de comptage de photon est aujourd’hui déterminant pour le développement de nouvelles méthodes d’imagerie longue portée et ouvre la voie à des méthodes d’interférométrie quantique basées sur les corrélations présentes dans la statistique des flux de photons.
 Dans ce contexte, vos missions seront les suivantes :
 Etude théorique et expérimentale de dispositifs de conversion de fréquence pour la détection infrarouge bas flux en régime continu.
 Etude de schémas de détection directe ou cohérente.
 Dimensionnement d'expériences d'interférométrie d'intensité, de LIDAR à comptage de photons ou de synthèse d'ouverture par détection hétérodyne tirant parti de ces dispositifs.
 Communication des résultats dans le cadre de publications dans des revues à comité de lecture et de conférences nationale et internationales.
 Participation possible à des projets européens.
 Votre profil 
 Doctorant - Apports des technologies quantiques aux concepts d’imagerie longue portée dans l’infrarouge (H/F) 
 Votre priorité est de de faire une thèse entre recherche et industrie ?
 Vous avez l’ambition de rejoindre Thales et de contribuer à l’innovation ?
 Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche fondamentale et appliquée et les innovations technologiques ?
 Vous disposez d’un diplôme Bac+5 en école d’Ingénieur ou formation équivalente en optique, et avez des compétences en :
 Lasers ;
 Optique quantique ;
 Domaine infrarouge ;
 Matlab ;
 Français courant et Anglais (lu, parlé, écrit) niveau C1 attendu.
 Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et travail en équipe sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.
 
We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.
 
This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 


We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join the Advanced Technology team. We explore emerging technologies and transform them into practical innovations that shape the future of robotics at ANYbotics. We bridge cutting-edge research with real-world industrial applications by rapidly validating new ideas, building prototypes, and transferring successful technologies into our products. Working closely with leading universities, startups, and internal engineering teams, we tackle challenging problems in robotics, AI, computer vision, and autonomous systems to create the next generation of industrial inspection robots.
 
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation intern to join our Advanced Technology team and contribute to advancing ANYmal's mobility capabilities. Utilizing the latest reinforcement learning techniques and simulation tools, we define, train, and integrate ML models into ANYmal to safely and robustly navigate challenging industrial environments. 
Your role includes evaluating and fine tuning state of the art RL-based navigation & locomotion policies  in simulation and on real quadruped robots. This internship provides a profound and impactful opportunity to work at the forefront of machine learning in robotics, playing a significant role in shaping ANYmal's autonomous capabilities and contributing to real-world applications. 
You will work closely with Robotics experts and research partners who will provide you with guidance and mentorship. The preferred starting date is September 2026, and the full-time paid internship lasts six months.
 

Your Contributions:
Project Support: Work closely with our engineers and researchers on active projects across the entire software stack, from application software to autonomy stack and low-level software.
 Algorithm Implementation: Design, implement, test, and validate new algorithms and features in core software areas.
 Testing & Infrastructure: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing infrastructure, simulation environments, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure the robustness and reliability of the ANYmal platform
 Code Development & Testing: Write clean, efficient, and well-documented C++ and Python code for real-time operation on the robot. Contribute to our robust testing and simulation infrastructure
Your Profile:
Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
 Foundational Knowledge: Solid academic knowledge and proven ability in one or more areas relevant to mobile robotics, such as Control Theory, Machine Learning, Computer Vision.
 Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and/or C++ (Modern C++ is highly valued).
 Software Development Skills: Experience with Git, Docker, and AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).
 Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in our highly interdisciplinary, English-speaking environment.
 Attitude: A hands-on, proactive, and analytical attitude towards complex problem-solving and eagerness to learn rapidly.
Bonus points, a few extra things that would make us especially excited about your application:
You have trained AI models on GPUs and have explored CUDA or other GPU-accelerated computing frameworks.
 You spend your weekends automating your workflows with Agentic AI.
 You know and worked with Robotics Middleware (ROS/ROS 2).

 General Summary: 
 About the Role 
 Are you an experienced Java developer with experience in creating Java-based server applications that use the most sensitive of security assets — cryptographic keys? We are looking for a passionate and skilled software engineer to join the development branch of Qualcomm's Cryptographic Operations Group. This team creates the services that support device image signing and factory provisioning with keys protected by Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) across the entire Qualcomm organisation. Our services our mostly exposed through Java implementations running on standalone, on-premises servers with attached HSMs which have to meet very high security and assurance requirements. 
 You will be an integral part of a highly-skilled team and will contribute to all facets of the system: architecture, development, testing, integration, and debugging. You will also contribute to the architecture of Qualcomm's products by working with the device engineering teams about what is possible and efficient with our secure infrastructure systems. 
 Please note that this position is part of the Qualcomm engineering team. It is not a cybersecurity IT position. 
 What are we looking for? 
 Proven programming skills with C and Python.
 Experience using build toolchains to support code base and working with multi-modular projects.
 Experience with 'C' targeting embedded environments (e.g., PowerPC architecture, ELF binary generation).

 Experience with Java development, and Java frameworks, including Spring, RESTEasy, JAXB, and JCA/JCE.
 Experience building, signing, and publishing native applications using Java-centric/Python-centric based toolchains in a cross-platform environment.
 Clear understanding of PKI/certificates, and cryptographic key management.
 Broad understanding of Web and REST API services.
 General understanding of UI frameworks.
 General understanding of interoperable data formats, like XML and JSON.
 Working experience with OpenSSL integration (1.x FIPS and 3.x) for various cryptographic operations.
 Working experience with PKCS11.
 Working experience with Hardware Security Module (HSM) platforms and associated toolchains for application signing and deployment.
 Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, sign, and publish workflows.
 Familiarity with Post-Quantum Cryptography.
 Experience with Containerization concepts (using technologies Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)

Mission 
 The Cryogenic Electron Microscopist will be responsible for the operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of specialized scientific equipment, including one Glacios and three Titan Krios microscopes, within the cryo-EM core facility of the Dubochet Center for Imaging (DCI). 
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 As part of the DCI team, your responsibilities will include: 
 Cryo-EM sample preparation 
 Data acquisition for single-particle analysis (SPA) and cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) 
 On-the-fly and offline data processing, advanced image processing 
 Structure determination and interpretation 
 As a cryo-EM support, you will provide technical and scientific support to researchers from EPFL, UNIL as well as external customers, advising users throughout the different stages of their projects, from experimental planning and data acquisition to image processing and structure determination. You will also contribute to the continuous development and improvement of the DCI cryo-EM platform, helping to ensure a high level of service, reliability and performance for its users. 
 Profile 
 Ph.D. in tructural biology or related field with experience in Cryo-EM 
 At least one year of hands-on experience in cryo-EM, including instrument operation, facility support, training, data acquisition, data processing and/or cryo-ET 
 Experience with cryo-EM image-processing software such as cryoSPARC, IMOD/eTomo, and Scipion 
 Experience with SPA and/or cryo-ET workflows is desirable 
 Good understanding of cryo-EM data acquisition and processing workflows 
 Excellent communication skills in an English-speaking environment 
 Strong motivation to explore new research domains 
 We are looking for a person who is: 
 Service-oriented, proactive, and enthusiastic 
 Practical and hands-on, with the flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, service-oriented platform 
 Comfortable with change and able to adapt quickly to evolving priorities and workflows 
 Reliable and committed to delivering high-quality results for all types of users and customers 
 Collaborative, with clear communication skills and a constructive team spirit 
 Able to work independently while contributing effectively to a team environment 
 We offer 
 The position is based in the campus of EPFL and UNIL in Lausanne, Switzerland, and is available from 01 January 2027. It will initially be offered as a one-year contract, with the possibility of renewal. The position offers a competitive salary, and EPFL as well as UNIL are committed to being an equal opportunity employer. 
 The Dubochet Center is currently equipped with three 300 kV Titan Krios with Cold-FEG and Falcon 4i direct electron detectors, and a Glacios 200 kV microscope. You will join a collaborative, international, and diverse research team from UNIL and EPLF with interdisciplinary expertise in biology, physics, computer science, and engineering. 
 For more information about the Dubochet Center please visit our website: https://dci-lausanne.ch/ . 
 Informations 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply: 
 A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages) 
 And in one PDF: 
 A CV with a publication list 
 Contact details for 3 referees 
 At least one reference letter 
 For any further information, please contact: 
 Dr. Bertrand Beckert: bertrand.beckert@epfl.ch 
 Prof. Henning Stahlberg: henning.stahlberg@epfl.ch 
 Dr. Christel Genoud: christel.genoud@unil.ch 
 Contract Start Date : 01/01/2027 
 Activity Rate : 100.00 
 Contract Type: CDD 
 Duration: 1 an

items.desc:
Overview 
 When Microsoft experiences a significant service outage, customers expect more than service restoration. They want to understand what happened, why it happened, what Microsoft has done to address it, and what measures have been implemented to prevent recurrence.
 The Incident Communications and Coordination (ICC) team is responsible for developing Microsoft's customer-facing Post Incident Reports (PIRs), one of the most important deliverables produced following major service incidents. These reports are a critical component of Microsoft's commitment to transparency, accountability, and customer trust.
 We are seeking a Mission Critical Incident Analysis Engineer to lead the investigation, development, and publication of customer-facing PIRs for high-impact Microsoft 365 service incidents. This role combines service engineering, incident analysis, stakeholder management, investigative research, and technical communication.
 Success in this role requires someone who is naturally curious, highly analytical, comfortable engaging senior engineering teams, and capable of transforming complex technical investigations into clear and trustworthy customer communications.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Responsibilities 
 You will develop a foundational understanding of service and/or system design, interactions between technology layers and components, functions of infrastructure and dependencies at scale. 
 You may contribute to the identification and recommendation of optimal configurations of technology components. 
 You will participate in reviews with the engineering teams that develop and/or manage services and share learnings and recommendations across engineering teams working on related services within their organization. 
 You will actively seek to develop an understanding of key learnings, insights and best practices that can be applied to improve development and operations of the system, platform, or product components and features. 
 You will develop foundational technical knowledge, judgment, and decision making in crisis situations to contribute to mitigation plans and assist with resolving, reducing, or mitigating the impact of a crisis by engaging with necessary teams and escalating to appropriate stakeholders as instructed. 
 You will learn about and begin to contribute to root cause analyses based on incidences/crises with guidance from other engineers and learn about communicating customer impact and other relevant information with key stakeholders, leadership, and customers. You will contribute to projects and programs as instructed to improve crisis response and learn about how to increase service stability. 
 You will embody our culture and values . 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Associates Degree or Trade Certification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field OR equivalent experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Bachelors in Computer Science or Information Technology or industry equivalent experience 
 Critical Thinking and Critical Question skills.
 Must have excellent written English language skills and a healthy desire to improve the environment.

items.desc:
You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures.
 You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries.
 You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities.
 Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact.
 You’ll be based in Copenhagen or Stockholm as part of our global Data Engineering community. Working in cross-functional Agile teams, you’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver AI solutions. By partnering with clients from data owners to C-level executives you’ll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and begin to build your skills as a client-facing technologist.
 You will a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI, data engineering, and emerging agentic technologies. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of how data engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some leading AI and data experts in the industry.
 Degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent experience
 Experience in a data-focused role (internships, academic projects)
 Ability to write clean, well-documented code in a modern programming language, with a strong preference for Python and SQL
 Interest in or exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods (streaming vs batch)
 Familiarity with commonly used data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PSQL, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and engineering tools (Pandas, Spark, dbt, LangChain, etc.)
 Exposure to modern software development practices, including version control (Git) and foundational concepts in DevOps and MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD principles
 Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
 Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to different project situations and tech stacks
 Experience using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) is a plus
 Business level language fluency skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s)

 About us
 At Mercedes-Benz Cars, we're passionate about developing the next generation of talent. Our Undergraduate Programmes are designed to give you the opportunity to learn, grow and make a real impact from day one, while helping shape the future of mobility through innovation, sustainability and exceptional customer experiences.
 We believe great careers start with the right support, which is why you'll be encouraged to explore new ideas, build valuable skills and learn from experienced colleagues across the business. Together, we create an inclusive environment where everyone feels they belong, can contribute confidently and reach their full potential. Our culture is built on respect, equal opportunity and the belief that diverse perspectives make us stronger, helping us deliver better outcomes for our customers, colleagues and communities.
 About our IT undergraduate programme
 We’re looking for two motivated undergraduates, currently studying IT, Business Analysis or Project Management, to join our dynamic IT team and ready to make an impact from day one. You’ll get hands-on experience across meaningful projects, building your commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and stakeholder skills while helping deliver real business value.
 Some of the skills you can expect to gain:
 · Practical business insight gained from real-world challenges
 · Sharp commercial awareness and an understanding of what drives performance
 · Clear, confident, and professional communication skills
 · The ability to think strategically and make informed decisions
 · A deep understanding of our industry and how it’s evolving
 What's in it for you
 As well as the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment, with a great team and culture, you will receive:
 · Thirteen-month programme based in our offices in Milton Keynes
 · A competitive salary
 · 25 days holiday per year, plus bank holidays
 What you'll bring
 · Currently studying a degree with an expected 2:1 grade or above that has focus on IT, Business Analysis or Project Management
 · Currently studying a degree that enables you to complete a year in industry before you graduate
 · Organised, detail-focused, and proactive
 · Excel-savvy with strong digital skills
 · Clear communicator and collaborative team player
 · Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn
 · Confident taking initiative and solving problems
 · Passionate about technology and innovation
 · Excited to grow your career with Mercedes-Benz
 What's next?
 Once you click apply, we'll take you through to the Mercedes-Benz Group careers portal – our parent company site. Here, you'll find a short application form to complete.
 If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to an online video interview so we can get to know you a little better. Candidates who progress will then complete a set of online situational judgement assessments. Those who are successful will move on to the final stage, an interview with the IT Team at our head office in Milton Keynes, where you’ll learn more about being an undergraduate here and meet our team. Successful candidates will receive a placement offer shortly after the interview.
 Need adjustments during the recruitment process?
 We want every candidate to feel supported throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to help you participate fully and comfortably, please let us know. We're committed to creating an accessible experience and will work with you to provide any support or adjustments you may need.
 Right to work
 Due to UK legislation, we can only accept applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

 We care about your personal data. The UK General Data Protection Regulation provides you with more control and by submitting an application to us, we consider this to be an agreement to process your personal data in support of our recruitment and selection process.
 Data categories that we process in relation to your application are the ones that you provided as part of the application process. items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 06, 2026, 2:34PM Durée du contrat : 6 mois Je recherche un.e Chargé.e d’IA Générative en formation. Notre enjeu est de développer l’usage de l’Intelligence Artificielle Générative par les acteurs de la Formation Orange dans leurs projets, notamment dans les domainesde la pédagogie et des outils numériques de la formation. C'est là que vous intervenez ! Quelles sont vos activités ? a/ Benchmark IA Générative Vous menez un benchmark constant sur les cas d’usage et les pratiques de l’IA Générative en formation, en interne Orange, ainsi qu’en externe. Vous en restituez régulièrement les résultats. b/ Test des outils Vous testez les outils d’IA Générative (LLM, outils d’e-learnings…) qui sont mis à disposition par l’entreprise sur les différents cas d’usage formation: conduite de projet de formation, cahier des charges, ingénierie pédagogique, conception de storyboard, animation… Vous êtes amené à animer d’autres testeurs. Vous analysez les résultats des tests et en assurer la restitution. c/ Animation des acteurs de la formation Vous accompagnez les acteurs de la formation Orange sur l’IA Générative: connaissance, cas d’usage, partage de pratiques, mise-en-œuvre dans leurs activités formation. Vous concevez et animez des ateliers de pratique IA. Vous contribuez à animer la Communauté des acteurs de la formation sur l’IA. d/ Production Vous contribuez à produire des prompts-types et alimentez les bibliothèques dédiées. Vous préparez un Master 2 en Ingénierie pédagogique, EdTech ou équivalent. La qualité de votre prise de parole en public et votre aisance relationnelle sont reconnues. Vous aimez le contact et vous aimez travailler en équipe et en transverse. Vous avez de la curiosité et des idées que vous n’hésitez pas à proposer. Vous connaissez des outils numériques de la Formation (ex. Articulate 360, Synthesia…) pour lesquels des accompagnements d’approfondissement peuvent être proposés en fonction des besoins. Vous avez une bonne maitrise de l’usage d’un ou plusieurs modèles d’Intelligence Artificielle Générative (LLM) et de la conception de prompts élaborés. Cette mission est l’occasion de développer vos compétences d’animation. Une mission variée qui vous permettra de comprendre les stratégies de Développement des Compétences sur une entité de 20 000 personnes. Toute l’équipe vous attend pour partager son expérience et vous accompagner. L'indemnité mensuelle brute de stage proposée est comprise entre 1550€ et 1700€ euros pour un profil niveau BAC+5. A cela s'ajoutent l'accès aux Activités Sociales et Culturelles proposées par votre Comité Social et Economique, l'accès subventionné au restaurant d'entreprise ou aux titres restaurant, ainsi que la prise en charge à hauteur de 50% de votre abonnement aux transports en commun. Au sein d'Orange France, à la Direction Technique, vous rejoignez l’École des Métiers Techniques en charge du Développement des Compétences de 20 000 salariés. L’École des Métiers Techniques est une entité à taille humaineoù l’accompagnement des nouveaux entrants est clé à nos yeux pour la réussite de la mission. Date de début souhaitée : Feb 08, 2027, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

Acteur majeur de la protection sociale, l’Assurance Maladie permet aux assurés sociaux d’accéder à tous types de prestations. Forte de nos 600 collaborateurs, la Caisse Primaire d’Assurance Maladie (CPAM) de Haute-Savoie se mobilise quotidiennement au service de nos publics. Nous vous offrons une grande diversité de métiers, vous permettant tout au long de votre carrière d’exprimer votre potentiel professionnel. Rejoignez-nous dans un cadre de travail agréable et stimulant ! Rattaché à la Direction des Ressources, le Département Système d’information répond à des enjeux majeurs dans les domaines : Informatique technique : en assurant la continuité de service au travers de la gestion des matériels et logiciels informatiques, réseau et téléphonie Informatique fonctionnel : en assurant la mise en place et l’appui des applicatifs de production, la gestion et le suivi des habilitations, en préparant et suivant les traitements informatiques automatisés Développement : en assurant le développement des solutions numériques en interne Sécurité du Système d’information : assurer, à tout moment, la disponibilité, la confidentialité, l’intégrité ainsi que la preuve des informations détenues et traitements opérés par l’Assurance Maladie MISSIONS ET ACTIVITES PRINCIPALES Dans le cadre d’une création de poste vos missions seront : Pilotage de projets IA : Identifier et analyser les besoins métiers pour proposer des solutions innovantes basées sur l’IA. Concevoir, planifier et suivre la mise en œuvre de projets IA en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et métiers. Assurer le respect des délais et des objectifs qualité. Collaboration et coordination : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes informatiques, les experts métiers et les éventuels partenaires / prestataires externes. Animer des ateliers et des réunions pour recueillir les besoins et valider les livrables. Faciliter la communication entre les parties prenantes pour garantir une compréhension commune des enjeux et des solutions. Garantir la conformité des projets avec les réglementations en vigueur (RGPD, SSI, éthique de l’IA, etc.). Capacité à conduire des expérimentations et à évaluer les résultats obtenus. Aptitude à expliquer des sujets techniques auprès de publics non spécialistes. Capacité à accompagner le changement et à faciliter l'adoption de nouveaux outils. Savoir-être : Curiosité et appétence pour les nouvelles technologies. Esprit d'initiative et force de proposition. Créativité et capacité à innover. Pédagogie et qualités relationnelles. Rigueur, sens de l'organisation et autonomie. Capacité à travailler en équipe, en transversalité et à fédérer autour de projets innovants. Adaptabilité. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous souhaitez intégrer un groupe international et multiculturel ? Rejoignez-nous ! Au sein du groupe Société Générale, vous rejoindrez la Direction des Systèmes d'Information de la Banque de Grande Clientèle et Solutions Investisseurs (GBIS), qui accompagne la transformation digitale de la Banque de Financement et d'Investissement. Vous intégrerez l'équipe ACE - AI Capabilities & Engineering, chargée de concevoir et d'industrialiser des capacités d'intelligence artificielle au service de la transformation de notre direction. L'équipe développe des solutions fondées sur l'IA générative et les systèmes agentiques, depuis l'expérimentation et le Proof of Concept jusqu'à leur industrialisation. Elle intervient dans un environnement où les enjeux de sécurité, de qualité, d'adoption, d'observabilité et de passage à l'échelle sont essentiels. Au sein d'ACE, le programme AI for Non-Developers vise à transformer les pratiques quotidiennes des fonctions IT telles que Business Analysts, Product Owners, Agile Masters, Project Managers, Testeurs... L'objectif est de faire de l'IA un véritable outil de travail quotidien, permettant de transformer les réunions, documents, besoins et décisions en livrables structurés, évalués, traçables et réutilisables. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Concevoir et améliorer les skills IA Participer à la conception fonctionnelle de nouveaux skills IA adaptées aux métiers non-développeurs. Recueillir et analyser les besoins des Business Analysts, Product Owners, Agile Masters, Project Managers, testeurs, architectes et autres communautés IT. Participer à la rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles des skills et de leurs différents modes d'utilisation. Tester les skills sur des cas d'usage représentatifs, analyser les résultats et documenter les anomalies ou axes d'amélioration. Organiser des expérimentations et des phases bêta avec les communautés utilisatrices. Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pour améliorer en continu les skills existants et identifier de nouveaux besoins. Participer à l'enrichissement du catalogue de skills afin de couvrir progressivement de nouvelles populations et de nouveaux usages. Produire et maintenir les contenus de formation Produire et maintenir le curriculum de formation AI for Non-Developers. Rédiger des handbooks, guides pratiques, fiches réflexes et supports pédagogiques. Concevoir et maintenir un corpus d'exercices réalistes permettant aux utilisateurs de se former sur des situations proches de leur activité. Mettre à jour les supports en fonction des évolutions des skills et des retours des premières cohortes. Veiller à la qualité, à la cohérence, à la traçabilité et au versionnement des contenus produits. Créer les contenus et les supports post-formation Concevoir des démonstrations courtes présentant l'utilisation des différents skills. Produire des tutoriels, guides pas-à-pas et contenus vidéo. Transformer les questions récurrentes des utilisateurs en mini-FAQ ou contenus de support réutilisables. Maintenir des supports permettant aux utilisateurs de se remettre rapidement à niveau après leur formation. Participer à la capitalisation des bonnes pratiques et des cas d'usage développés par les équipes. Contribuer à l'animation des communautés Participer à l'organisation des sessions des communautés AI for Non-Developers. Produire et diffuser les comptes-rendus, décisions et actions issus des sessions. Travailler avec le réseau de champions pour collecter les besoins et les retours du terrain. Assurer le suivi des demandes et leur transmission vers le backlog des skills. Contribuer à valoriser les cas d'usage et les bonnes pratiques développés par les différentes équipes. Et si c'était vous ? Vous préparez un Bac+4/5, en Ecole d'Ingénieurs ou Université avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, transformation digitale, systèmes d'information, gestion de projet, business analysis, product management ou ingénierie pédagogique. Vous avez une forte appétence pour l'IA et les outils numériques, de solides qualités rédactionnelles, un intérêt pour la formation et la conduite du changement, ainsi qu'une réelle capacité à expérimenter et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés. Vous faites par ailleurs preuve de curiosité, d'une bonne capacité d'organisation et avez un esprit d'initiatives développé. You're fluent in English ! Vous êtes notre candidat idéal ! Pensez à accompagner votre CV de votre planning de formation ! Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Au sein de Société Générale, vous rejoindrez la Direction des Risques. La Direction des Risques est au cœur de l'activité du Groupe avec pour principale mission de contribuer au développement des métiers et de leur rentabilité par la mise en œuvre de l'appétit au risque. L'équipe RISQ/MDL/MOD développe des solutions innovantes basées sur l'intelligence artificielle afin de transformer et d'innover les procédures de modélisation du risque de crédit. Les équipes de modélisation produisent de nombreux documents réglementaires et méthodologiques qui nécessitent l'analyse de données, l'application de frameworks internes et la rédaction de rapports techniques. Ces travaux mobilisent un temps important et nécessitent un haut niveau de rigueur afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire. Dans ce contexte, nous développons une nouvelle génération d'outils s'appuyant sur l'IA générative pour automatiser la production de ces documents tout en conservant un contrôle humain sur les résultats. Au cours de ce stage, vous participerez à la conception et au développement d'une plateforme d'IA permettant de générer automatiquement des documents de modélisation à partir de données, d'analyses et de référentiels méthodologiques. Vos missions incluront notamment : Participer à la conception fonctionnelle et technique de l'outil Développer des composants Python dédiés à l'automatisation des analyses et de la génération documentaire Concevoir et optimiser des prompts pour les modèles d'IA générative Développer des interfaces utilisateurs facilitant l'utilisation de l'outil par les modélisateurs Mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de contrôle qualité et de validation des résultats générés Participer aux phases de test, de recette utilisateur et d'amélioration continue Contribuer à la documentation technique et fonctionnelle de la solution Réaliser une veille technologique sur les dernières avancées en IA générative et agents IA Technologies et environnement : Python ; Streamlit; LLM ; Git / GitHub ; API et services Azure IA; Prompt Engineering Durée du stage: 6 mois.
