items.desc: AI & Automation Engineer Student Assistant We are looking for a curious and technically skilled student with an interest in AI, automation, and digital business development. The position is for 15-20 hours per week and focuses on developing AI-powered tools and automations that improve workflows across the organisation. Based at the New Works headquarters in Copenhagen, you will become part of a passionate team working in an international design company, with the opportunity to turn new technologies into practical solutions that make a real difference. About the Position As part of the Digital Business Development team, you will contribute to developing and implementing AI-driven solutions across New Works. Working with live business data across our ERP, product information system, helpdesk and project tools, you will identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual tasks and create more efficient ways of working. Reporting to the Head of Digital Business Development, you will work across Sales Support, Operations, Marketing and Product Development, turning business needs into practical solutions. The position is for 15-20 hours per week, with flexible working hours to accommodate your studies and exam periods. Your responsibilities will include Working closely with different departments to understand their daily workflows and identify opportunities for improvement through AI and automation. Translating business needs into practical solutions, from defining the problem to developing and implementing a working tool. Building AI agents, tools and integrations that connect AI to live business data, including orders, stock, product information, customer emails and internal tasks. Developing and implementing automated workflows that reduce manual work, improve efficiency and save time across the organisation. Writing, testing and maintaining reliable code in accordance with company AI policies, security requirements and data protection guidelines. Supporting colleagues in adopting new tools and documenting solutions to ensure they can be maintained and further developed. Your Profile You are currently studying computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field, with at least one year remaining of your studies. You have experience writing and deploying code in Python, TypeScript or similar programming languages. You have a good understanding of version control, testing and responsible data handling. You have experience building applications, tools or agents using Large Language Models (LLMs), preferably solutions that have been used by others. You are familiar with AI tool calling, context management and connecting language models to external data through APIs or MCP. You are curious about how businesses operate and able to translate technical concepts into clear, practical solutions. You are proactive, structured and comfortable taking initiative, asking questions and exploring new approaches. Experience with ERP, PIM or helpdesk systems, or an interest in physical products and B2B businesses, is considered an advantage. Why Work at New Works A part-time student position of 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility to accommodate your studies and the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in AI, automation and digital business development. You will have the opportunity to develop and implement real solutions while gaining insight into how technology can support an international design company. We offer a collaborative and informal working environment, great breakfast and lunch at Meyer’s restaurant in the building, flexible working hours, beautiful surroundings, friendly colleagues and good coffee. About New Works New Works is found where contrasts meet and enrich one another. Our collection explores the dialogue between opposites, balancing sculptural forms with everyday function and contemporary expression with lasting appeal. We collaborate with an international circle of designers and artisans who share our fascination with honest materials, refined craftsmanship, and thoughtful design. Together, we create furniture, lighting, and objects designed to be lived with and cherished over time. How to apply Please send your CV, a short introduction about yourself and, most importantly, something you have built with AI: a link, a repo or a short description of what it did and what it changed, to Oliver@newworks.dk. Please present your documents in English or Danish. Kindly note that we only consider applications sent directly to Oliver@newworks.dk, and do not review applications submitted via LinkedIn. The position is open for immediate hire, with the aim of onboarding the right candidate as soon as possible. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact our Head of Digital Business Development, Oliver Kubicki, at (+45) 27 26 68 95.

items.desc: Werk mee aan een nieuw internet. Niet als toeschouwer, maar als bouwer van de technische fundering. Upod is net gelanceerd. De volgende stap: Upod toegankelijk maken voor AI-agents en LLM's, op een manier die privacy-first blijft. Daarvoor bouwen we een MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, en jij bouwt die mee, direct samen met ons tech team. Utonomy ontwikkelt technologie gebaseerd op een nieuw protocol van de uitvinder van het world wide web (Solid, van Tim Berners-Lee) dat mensen weer controle geeft over hun persoonlijke data. Daarmee leggen we de basis voor privacy-first producten, eerlijke AI en een Europees alternatief voor Big Tech. De grove richting van de MCP staat vast: AI-agents moeten op een veilige, privacy-respecterende manier met Upod-data kunnen werken. De concrete invulling, architectuur en scope bouwen we samen met jou uit. Taken Dit is geen meekijk-stage. Je bouwt mee aan een systeem dat nog niet bestaat, met directe begeleiding. Ontwerpen en bouwen van de MCP-server voor Upod, samen met Martijn (co-founder) Uitdenken van API-structuur, scopes en autorisatie, met privacy-by-design als uitgangspunt Testen van de MCP-integratie met LLM's en AI-agents Documenteren van architectuurkeuzes en implementatie Meedenken over de bredere toekomst van personal AI agents op Upod Ideaal voor studenten informatica, AI, data science of software engineering met interesse in protocollen en API's. Vereisten Je bent een self-starter die goed gaat op: Het krijgen van vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid, met directe begeleiding van een founder Zelf meedenken over architectuur, niet alleen uitvoeren wat is opgeschreven Snel schakelen tussen zelfstandig bouwen en samen sparren Ruimte om te experimenteren, ook als iets de eerste keer niet werkt We zoeken geen "perfect CV". Wel echte technische nieuwsgierigheid en de wil om iets nieuws te bouwen. Je: volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in informatica, AI, data science of vergelijkbaar hebt ervaring met API's en minimaal één programmeertaal (bijvoorbeeld Python, TypeScript/Node) bent minimaal 5-6 maanden beschikbaar bent pro-actief, technisch nieuwsgierig en leergierig spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels Benefits Benefits Stagevergoeding (marktconform) Kantoor in hartje Utrecht + hybride werken Directe, inhoudelijke begeleiding, geen tussenlagen Echte verantwoordelijkheid over een technisch fundament, niet een side-project Netwerk en ervaring waar je jaren later nog profijt van hebt Kansen om na je stage betrokken te blijven Waarom dit een uitzonderlijke stage is Je bouwt een technisch component dat bepaalt hoe AI straks met Upod werkt Je zit dicht op de besluitvorming, direct samen met de co-founder die dit begeleidt Je bouwt mee aan een nieuw protocol-ecosysteem, niet aan een geïsoleerde feature Je leert protocollen, architectuur en privacy-by-design in de praktijk, niet uit een tutorial Geef in je motivatie aan: welke ervaring je al hebt met API's, protocollen of AI-integraties wanneer je kunt starten wat je wilt leren over MCP, AI-agents of privacy-by-design Geen lange brief nodig, vertel ons vooral waarom jij dit wilt bouwen en wat je al hebt gebouwd.

items.desc: AI Engineer (AI Platform & Data Engineering) Location: Remote, Spain Candidates must be based in Spain and have the existing right to work in Spain. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role Salary: EUR 60,000–70,000 per annum (depending on experience) Overview Of Position Speedcast delivers highly customizable, mission-critical communication solutions for remote sites worldwide. Our Data Engineering team operates a modern lakehouse platform — Kafka streaming, Iceberg on S3, a cloud query layer, and time-series databases on AWS — and we are building AI-powered products and internal tools on top of it. As an AI Engineer on the platform side, you will build and operate the infrastructure that makes AI applications reliable in production: the data pipelines that feed them, the embedding and retrieval layers behind them, and the services, APIs, and monitoring around them. This role carries a strong data engineering component — you will cross-function with the wider team on platform duties, contributing to ingestion pipelines, data quality, and operational excellence across our data systems. The successful candidate is a strong software and data engineer who is excited by the LLM application stack, cares about reliability, security, and cost, and is capable of working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues across Data Engineering, Data Science, and DevOps. What You Will Do Design, build, and operate the pipelines that power AI applications: document and data ingestion, chunking and embedding pipelines, vector stores, and retrieval services. Productionize LLM-powered applications as reliable services: APIs, containerised deployments, observability, cost monitoring, and access control. Integrate AI workloads with the data lakehouse platform — streaming (Kafka) and batch sources, query layers, and time-series stores. Build and maintain evaluation, logging, and feedback infrastructure for AI applications in production. Contribute to core data engineering duties: developing and maintaining data pipelines, ensuring data quality and reliability, and improving platform performance and efficiency. Implement security, privacy, and governance best practices for AI systems handling company data. Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions. Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritisation activities. Evaluate and support the adoption of new AI platform technologies, tools, and architectural approaches. What We Need From You 3–5 years of experience in software engineering or data engineering, with hands-on exposure to AI/LLM application development. Commercial experience with Python and strong SQL skills (any major SQL dialect). Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in production. Experience integrating foundation model APIs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into applications or services. Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, Step Functions, S3, ECR, Glue) and AWS security best practices. Experience containerising applications using Docker. Experience building and operating APIs and backend services. Understanding of data quality, data governance, and data engineering best practices. Experience using Git for source control and working within Agile/Scrum environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Even better if you have Experience with streaming platforms: Confluent Kafka, Avro/Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, or Apache Flink. Experience with lakehouse architectures: Apache Iceberg, Parquet, medallion patterns, and dbt. Experience with query engines such as Dremio and time-series databases such as TimescaleDB. Experience with vector search (pgvector or dedicated vector databases) and retrieval infrastructure at scale. Experience with agentic frameworks, tool use, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with cost monitoring and optimisation of cloud and AI workloads. Good understanding of GDPR and data governance principles. Advanced AWS expertise, including relevant AWS certifications. Working at Speedcast At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you're in the right place. We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. We're united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects and our love of getting the job done right. You will experiment, learn and grow here, right alongside us, every single …

Ton futur environnement Tu évolueras au sein d’un pôle d’ingénierie data et IA de pointe, à la jonction entre la Data Science, le génie logiciel et les opérations (DevOps). En interface quotidienne avec les data scientists, les data engineers et les équipes de production informatique, tu interviendras sur des flux d’inférence critiques. C’est le cadre idéal pour appliquer les standards les plus stricts du génie logiciel à l’écosystème du Machine Learning, exploiter des infrastructures de calcul accéléré (GPU) et déployer des pratiques MLOps avancées. Tes missions clés Industrialisation, Packaging & Services d’Inférence (Mode BUILD) : Reprendre, refactoriser et packager le code issu des équipes de data science selon les standards de production (modularité, robustesse, tests unitaires et d’intégration). Optimiser les performances d’inférence (latence, débit) et maîtriser les coûts de calcul liés aux infrastructures GPU. Solide compréhension des modèles et bibliothèques de Machine Learning (scikit-learn, PyTorch ou TensorFlow). Culture éprouvée du code de production : tests automatisés, intégration continue (CI/CD), revue de code et gestionnaire de versions (Git). Culture MLOps & Infrastructure : Maîtrise des environnements conteneurisés (Docker, Kubernetes) et de la gestion des ressources GPU. Pratique confirmée de MLflow et des outils de monitoring de modèles (Evidently, Grafana). Connaissance du stockage distribué et stockage objet (S3). Langues : Anglais professionnel opérationnel. items.desc: En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. Éventuellement, les travaux menés donneront lieu à une publication scientifique. Contexte : La Direction de la Recherche Technologique (DRT) du CEA a pour mission de développer des solutions innovantes et d’interagir avec les acteurs industriels pour valoriser ces technologies. Le laboratoire LIIIM (Intelligence Intégrée Multi-capteurs) possède une expertise en perception de l’environnement grâce à sa maîtrise de différents capteurs (caméra, LiDAR, RADAR, infrarouge) appliquée à des domaines tels que l’automobile, la robotique ou les drones. Le stage consistera à : Prendre en main les différents capteurs disponibles. Mettre en place un algorithme de calibration en utilisant des méthodes à base d'IA. Adopter une méthode scientifique rigoureuse pour valider la pertinence des algorithmes proposés. Cette plateforme permettra d'acquérir une base de données utilisant les deux modalités dans le cadre de la détection de gestes. Cette base de données pourra potentiellement être mise à disposition de la communauté scientifique. Ce dataset servira ensuite à développer des méthodes de perception bénéficiant des 2 modalités. Qu'attendons-nous de vous? Participer à la mise en œuvre d’une plateforme d’acquisition combinant un RADAR et une caméra. Contribuer au développement d’outils permettant de réaliser la calibration à base de méthodes d’IA. Évaluer la pertinence des résultats obtenus. Ce travail permettra la création d’un dataset multimodal RADAR/caméra pour détecter des mouvements ou gestes de personnes. En collaboration avec les chercheurs de l’équipe, le candidat développera des algorithmes d’IA pour la calibration en tenant compte des spécificités des données de chaque capteur. Il devra faire preuve d’un esprit critique et mettre en œuvre les outils permettant de déterminer la qualité des solutions proposées. Dans un second temps, le candidat participera à la création du dataset. Le stagiaire pourra ensuite mettre en évidence l’intérêt de la double modalité RADAR/caméra, un travail qui pourra faire l’objet d’une publication scientifique. La plateforme développée au cours de ce stage pourra faire l’objet d’un démonstrateur présenté lors de conférences scientifiques ou à des industriels. # Cea-List Profil du candidat Profil : Bac +5 Ecole d'ingénieur en informatique Localisation du poste Site Grenoble Localisation du poste France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Isère (38) Ville Grenoble Critères candidat Langues Anglais (Courant) Diplôme préparé Bac+5 - Diplôme École d'ingénieurs Possibilité de poursuite en thèse Non

We enter projects in early stages – greenfield, ready-to-build (RTB), EPC-ready – and take them through procurement, financing and construction to operation. From RTB, our projects reach COD in 12–18 months: our first two Finnish projects, 125 MW / 300 MWh each, are heading for COD in 2027. We are looking for an IT Intern who wants to put AI to work in a real business. You build and run the Claude/ChatGPT agents that read, draft and analyse for our small team, connect them securely to our tools and data, and own the SharePoint sites and third-party access we use with partners. Your work keeps the overviews and dashboards up to date that our founders and managers use to steer the portfolio. What you will achieve during your internship Run and extend our Claude/ChatGPT setup – agents, skills and connectors – so the team saves hours every week on email, documents and data rooms. Turn manual processes into reliable, documented AI workflows on top of our tools, such as Notion, Attio and Slack. Bring our SharePoint sites and third-party access into a clean, secure structure that agents and people can both work with. Deliver a portfolio dashboard, kept current with AI support, and make AI part of the daily routine of our investment, finance and project teams. What you will do AI agents and workflows Build, test and maintain Claude/ChatGPT agents, skills and prompts for our investment, finance and project teams. Map team processes and turn the repetitive ones into agentic workflows – from email triage and document drafting to data room reviews. Track what works, test new models and features, and write short guides and demos so everyone gets the most out of the tools. IT, access and data Connect agents to our tools and data – Notion, Attio, Slack, email, calendar and Drive – through APIs and MCP connectors, with clear access rules and secure credentials. Run our SharePoint sites and third-party access – shared spaces for partners, advisors and lenders, external access granted and revoked on time, and agents that index and review the content. Keep portfolio overviews, project trackers and open-point lists current, with agents that pull updates from emails, models and documents. Build and update dashboards for project milestones, cash and key financials, fed from one consistent source of truth. Basic Python and a good understanding of APIs, authentication and access rights; experience with SharePoint, Make or Zapier, or Power BI is a plus. A structured, careful way of working, and you enjoy clear documentation. Very good German and English, and a genuine interest in energy and finance. What we offer Real responsibility for AI and IT tools the whole team uses every day, with short decision lines to our founders. First-hand insight into how large-scale battery storage is invested in, financed and built. Full-time internship with hybrid working from our [Munich] office. Hands-on access to current AI tools – and the freedom to try new ones. A small, high-trust team that moves fast, celebrates wins together and still makes time for ski trips and Oktoberfest.

Our new Sovereign Territory Surveillance (STS) Systems will play a crucial role in enhancing civil defence security through the deployment of advanced automated security infrastructures. items.desc:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion, dedication, and a no-excuse mindset to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.
Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic cellular transceivers. We are looking for a motivated RF engineer with strong programming skills to join our PLL validation efforts. This is a hands-on role where you will verify that our new silicon designs meet specifications, working in an agentic engineering flow where you direct AI agents across specs, code, lab setups and data, while staying accountable for the result. Join us and leverage your passion for RF excellence to enable the world's most innovative mobile devices.
As an RF PLL Silicon Validation Engineer, you will own the bring-up and characterization of frequency generation subsystems in market-leading transceivers. Your work style is collaborative and proactive, driving technical solutions across interdisciplinary teams. You will work in an agentic work flow, you scope the problem and define pass/fail criteria, delegate implementation and execution to AI agents, and verify every result against the specification.
Proficiency in Python programming. Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agents, together with the judgement to verify their output, is a major plus.
Hands-on experience with standard lab equipment (Spectrum Analyzers, Oscilloscopes, Power Supplies) and board-level troubleshooting.
Ability to process and analyze data using libraries like NumPy, Pandas, or Matplotlib.
Solid foundation in RF and mixed-signal theory, particularly regarding PLLs, LNAs, Mixers, and oscillators.
Familiarity with RF measurement concepts such as Phase Noise, Harmonics, IP3, and Noise Figure.
Understanding of cellular standards (5G NR, LTE)
Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with a focus on RF/Analog circuits or Signal Processing.

Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture.
 Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage en Gestion de Produits de Données / Operations Data Product (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus sur son site de Toulouse. Vous rejoindrez le département « Excellence Opérationnelle (OED) » en charge d'apporter son soutien aux Opérations, de maximiser la valeur ajoutée grâce aux solutions d'analyse et d'IA, et de fournir des données fiables et conformes pour répondre aux défis stratégiques de l'entreprise.
 Votre stage consistera à faire le lien entre la feuille de route des fondations de données (data foundations) et les besoins d'analyse et d'IA pour l'ensemble des domaines métiers des Opérations (Achats, Supply Chain, Fabrication, Qualité), en contribuant à la définition, la consolidation et la visualisation de la roadmap de l'Operations Data Analytics & AI Factory.
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois , débutera idéalement au premier semestre 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée).
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 Recueillir et analyser activement les besoins et attentes des utilisateurs métiers (Business Owners, Data Custodians) en matière de données opérationnelles.
 Identifier et cartographier les interdépendances entre les applications sources fournissant les données et les applications métiers consommatrices, avec l'appui des Data Product Owners.
 Proposer une méthode de consolidation et de structuration des informations pour la feuille de route (roadmap) intégrée.
 Rechercher, concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions visuelles et ergonomiques pour communiquer efficacement la roadmap de la Factory auprès des parties prenantes (métiers, Data Office, IM).
 Mettre en place un système de gestion des versions de la roadmap ainsi qu'un processus méthodologique pour sa diffusion et sa mise à jour continue.
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : 
 Maîtrise du cycle de vie et du management de produits de données (Data Products) dans un environnement industriel d'envergure.
 Compétences en gestion de projet transverse et méthodologies agiles (Scrum, SAFe) appliquées à la data et à l'IA.
 Capacité à concevoir des visualisations stratégiques et des roadmaps pour aligner les équipes techniques (IM, architectes de données) et les directions métiers opérationnelles.
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure : 
 Vous êtes actuellement en Master 1, Master 2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou de commerce (Bac+4 / Bac+5) en gestion de projet, ingénierie, informatique, data management ou un domaine équivalent.
 Vous possédez idéalement les compétences suivantes : 
 - Compétences techniques :
 Compréhension des enjeux de modélisation, de structuration et d'intégration de données.
 Connaissance ou expérience pratique des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Scrum, SAFe).
 Capacité à définir, documenter et diffuser une démarche méthodologique ou des spécifications fonctionnelles.
 - Soft Skills :
 Esprit très structuré, grande rigueur d'analyse et forte capacité de synthèse.
 Proactivité, curiosité industrielle et force de proposition face aux défis complexes.
 Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens prononcé du travail en équipe multiculturelle.
 - Langues :
 Anglais : Courant / Négociation (usage quotidien dans un contexte international).
 Français : Courant / Avancé.
 Notre processus de recrutement : 
 Votre candidature sera analysée attentivement par notre équipe de recrutement. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo. Suite à cette étape, si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager pour un entretien.

What You Will Do • Invent novel video coding tools (signal processing and neural approaches) to improve video coding performance and efficiency as well as invent ways to increase robustness and flexibility of video coding standards. • Implement inventions in
items.desc:
Grow with us
 About the Opportunity 
Ericsson is Europe’s leading network technology company and a global pioneer shaping the 6G era. Our 6G vision will transform business and society in the 2030s through secure, efficient, and sustainable communications.
Video already accounts for 75% of mobile data traffic. In an AI-enabled world of immersive experiences, digital twins, autonomous systems, and generative media, advanced video coding is indispensable. To deliver these services on a global scale, video compression and standards must keep advancing in efficiency, flexibility, and sustainability.
Join our international team of world-class researchers at the forefront of both advanced signal processing and neural network–based compression. You will invent, implement, and evaluate algorithms that power next-generation video coding standards shaping the technology stack of 6G and AI-native media.
 What You Will Do 
• Invent novel video coding tools (signal processing and neural approaches) to improve video coding performance and efficiency as well as invent ways to increase robustness and flexibility of video coding standards. 
• Implement inventions in software (C++/Python) and run large-scale evaluations.
• Contribute to global video coding standardization such as JVET/MPEG, author patents and publications.
• Collaborate with researchers and engineers across Ericsson as well as leading industry and academia experts globally. 
• Be working in a dynamic team with opportunities for learning, taking on new responsibilities, impacting ways of working, and much more.
 The Skills You Bring 
 We welcome outstanding graduates, postdocs, and experienced researchers passionate about video coding innovation who:
• Hold an M.Sc. or Ph.D. in a relevant technical field.
• Are exceptional problem solvers with a passion for innovation.
• Write high-quality, efficient code and are strong in C++ and/or Python.
• Are curious, collaborative, and able to communicate complex ideas clearly.
 Nice to have: 
• Experience in video coding and processing.
• Experience in signal processing and neural networks applied to compression or video processing.
• Familiarity with standards such as H.265/HEVC and H.266/VVC.
• Contributions to standardization, publications, or talks at conferences/industry events.
 Why join Ericsson: 
• Be part of Europe’s leading tech company at the forefront of 6G and global standards.
• Work with a top-tier international research team and have your work validated and recognized on the world stage.
• Have a real impact at scale with your innovations targeting billions of devices and a large share of global data traffic. 
• Grow in a dynamic environment with strong mentorship, learning opportunities, and real impact.
• Perform at your best, enabled by a healthy work-life balance and a commitment to long-term, sustainable progress.
 Location: for this job opportunity is Stockholm Sweden. For exceptional candidates other locations may be considered
 How to apply: 
Send your application and describe how your experience and skills will advance state-of-the-art video coding for the AI-enabled 6G world.
 What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.We encourage you to consider applying to jobs where you might not meet all the criteria. We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.

Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 Au sein d’une équipe d’automatisation développant des outils pour la modélisation SPICE en microélectronique, vous contribuerez au développement de nouvelles solutions d’intelligence artificielle appliquées à la modélisation technologique.
 L’extraction des parasites (PEX) permet de caractériser les capacités et résistances parasites associées aux structures d’interconnexion et joue un rôle essentiel dans la qualité des modèles utilisés pour la simulation des circuits. La construction et la calibration de ces modèles reposent sur de nombreuses simulations de référence afin d’évaluer l’impact des paramètres de modélisation et des variations de procédé sur les performances électriques extraites.
 Dans le cadre de la poursuite de travaux autour de l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle pour le PEX, ce stage vise à développer un surrogate model basé sur des Graph Neural Networks (GNN) capable de reproduire rapidement les résultats de simulations de référence et d’assister les modélistes dans l’étude et la calibration des paramètres de modélisation.
 A propos de vos missions 
 Découvrir les principes de la modélisation des interconnexions en microélectronique et leur impact sur les performances des circuits.
 Comprendre les travaux réalisés lors du précédent projet et identifier les pistes d'amélioration.
 Prendre en main les outils et données utilisés dans les flows de caractérisation électrique.
 Générer et analyser des jeux de données.
 Étudier l'influence de paramètres technologiques sur les caractéristiques électriques des interconnexions.
 Concevoir et développer un modèle d'Intelligence Artificielle capable de reproduire le comportement observé dans les simulations.
 Évaluer les performances et la robustesse du modèle sur des cas représentatifs.
 Collaborer avec les experts modélisation afin de valider les résultats obtenus et orienter les développements.
 Présenter les conclusions et recommandations issues du stage.
 A propos de vous 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur.
 Vous possédez de solides bases en machine learning, intelligence artificielle ou science des données.
 Vous maîtrisez Python et avez une première expérience avec des frameworks tels que PyTorch ou TensorFlow.
 Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre développement logiciel, analyse de données et modélisation scientifique.
 Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d’autonomie et d’esprit d’initiative.
 Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse et d’un goût pour la résolution de problèmes complexes.
 Une connaissance du domaine de la microélectronique, de la modélisation SPICE ou des simulations physiques constitue un plus.
 Vous disposez d’un bon niveau d’anglais technique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

items.title: PhD Student Position in Fabrication and Characterization of Plasmonic Crystals for Solar Energy
items.card: responsibilities As a PhD Student, you will be expected to: Assume full responsibility for your PhD dissertation; Perform research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators; Design and execute experiments; Analyze and interpret experimental results; Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals; Present at international conferences; Contribute to teaching,
items.desc:
Mission 
 We are seeking a candidate with experience in preparation and experimental characterization of nanostructured materials to join our SNSF project “Coupled oscillations in plasmonic crystals”.
 In this project, we focus on the effects of coupling of plasmonic oscillations in metallic micro-/nanostructures. It might be possible to achieve plasmonic crystals featuring broad frequency bands of extraordinary optical transmission (EOT) in the UV-VIS-NIR spectral range. The insights from this project will have considerable impact on the fields of photovoltaics, flat screens and flexible displays, as well as energy efficient OLED lighting, electrochromic devices and energy-efficient insulating glazing.
 Research Group SCI-ENAC-AS: Nanotechnology for Solar Energy Conversion
Prof. Andreas Schüler 
 In our research group, we develop novel micro- and nanostructured smart materials for active and passive solar energy applications being integrated into the building envelope. We focus on thin films, because these allow covering a large surface area with a small quantity of raw material - and we focus on their electronic and optical properties, because these closely interrelated properties are most important for the use of solar energy.
 https://www.epfl.ch/labs/sci-enac-as/ 
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:
 Assume full responsibility for your PhD dissertation;
 Perform research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators;
 Design and execute experiments;
 Analyze and interpret experimental results;
 Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals;
 Present at international conferences;
 Contribute to teaching, coach Master students and provide basic administrative support.
 Profile 
 An excellent Master’s-level degree in Micro-/Nanotechnology, Physics, Materials Science, Energy, or a related quantitative field
 A strong background in several of the following fields: reactive magnetron sputtering, electron-beam lithography, UV-VIS-NIR spectrophotometry, ultra-high vacuum scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), and/or photoelectron spectroscopies (XPS, UPS)
 A sincere interest in micro-/nanostructures, electronic and optical material properties, plasmonics and solar energy
 Proficiency in English (French is a plus)
 Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and excellent team spirit
 Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset
 We offer 
 A stable position for up to 4 years in order to complete your PhD;
Term of employment: 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years
 An international research environment
 Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project
 Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions
 The opportunity to work on innovative materials in a laboratory with a cutting-edge equipment 
 Information 
 Your application should include:
 CV
 Motivation letter
 Diplomas
 Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies
 If you are successful, you will need to enrol in one of the EPFL doctoral school programs in parallel. Please check this page for additional information. Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL. Potential doctoral program for this position: EDEY, EDCE, EDMX, EDPY
 Expected start date : May 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.
 Application : Application deadline is November 30, 2026. Apply through the EPFL job opportunities webpage . Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 For any further information, please contact nanosolar.jobs@epfl.ch

items.desc:
Mission 
 The Institute of Mathematics at the Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) invites applications for a full-time Bernoulli instructorship in algebra.
 Profile 
 Bernoulli Instructors are expected to teach algebra courses at all levels, notably algebraic geometry. The initial teaching load is light, corresponding to half the teaching load of regular faculty, and gradually progresses to the latter. 
Bernoulli Instructors are expected to develop and sustain an excellent independent research program. They are welcome to collaborate and encouraged to interact with members of the Institute, but they maintain full research independence.
 Bernoulli Instructors must have a PhD in Mathematics by the starting date, and must teach in French, English or both.
The EPFL actively aims to increase the presence of women amongst its employees, and women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.
 We offer 
 The term of the position is two years, with the possibility of extension for another two years. 
EPFL salaries for Bernoulli instructors are highly competitive. In addition, instructors receive a substantial yearly budget for travel expenses and other expenditures.
 Informations 
 Contact:
 For further information, please contact Ms Carole Weissenberger, Secretary of the Institute of Mathematics (carole.weissenberger@epfl.ch)

items.title: Data Science Intern - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
items.card: You will be part of a multidisciplinary data science team working alongside experienced data scientists, engineers, and technologists, where you will learn the craft of applied AI and analytics by doing, contributing to real client solutions from day one. During this 6 month internship you will assist in building and evaluating analytical and AI solutions, taking on well-defined tasks with close guidance and growing
items.desc:
You will be part of a multidisciplinary data science team working alongside experienced data scientists, engineers, and technologists, where you will learn the craft of applied AI and analytics by doing, contributing to real client solutions from day one.
 During this 6 month internship you will assist in building and evaluating analytical and AI solutions, taking on well-defined tasks with close guidance and growing your skills across machine learning, data analysis, and AI engineering with every engagement. You'll develop a foundational understanding of how great data science teams work, from understanding business problems to delivering models and insights that drive real decisions. This work will help you learn fast, embrace feedback, and build a strong technical foundation in a high-impact environment.
 Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you'll help develop innovative AI and analytics capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You'll help design and deliver production-ready AI and analytics solutions that create meaningful impact for clients. Your contributions will directly support clients in accelerating AI adoption and solving complex business problems at scale.
 You'll be based in Milan as part of our global Data Science community. Working in cross-functional teams, you'll collaborate closely with data engineers, machine learning engineers, and industry experts to deliver AI and analytics solutions. By partnering with clients from technical teams to C-level executives, you'll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and begin to build your skills as a client-facing technologist.
 Your work offers a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI and data science. You'll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you'll gain a holistic understanding of how data science enables advanced AI while collaborating with some of the leading technologists and AI practitioners in the industry.
 Students in the last semester of their master’s degree
 Foundational knowledge of machine learning concepts and statistical methods, with an eagerness to build hands-on experience across supervised, unsupervised, and forecasting approaches with guidance
 Basic understanding of data quality assessment and exploratory data analysis, with the ability to contribute to well-defined analytical tasks under close guidance
 Familiarity with using and evaluating GenAI tooling and simple agentic AI frameworks, with an eagerness to learn how large language models 
 Ability to write accurate, modular code with guidance, with foundational knowledge of software development best practices and introductory exposure to MLOps and CI/CD concepts; proficiency in Python or R is a plus
 A quality and risk mindset — beginning to check own work using provided QA steps, with a growing awareness of common modeling risks including fairness, explainability, hallucination, and human oversight considerations
 Experience working in cross-functional teams, collaborating closely with peers and cross-functional teammates
 Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
 Availability to work full-time during the 6-week internship
 Business level language skills, both verbal and written, in English and Italian, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

items.desc:
ChainSecurity | Blockchain Security Engineer | Full-time | INTERNS , HYBRID/REMOTE, Zurich, Switzerland | VISA possible (for an employment) | https://chainsecurity.com/ 
ChainSecurity is a young and innovative cybersecurity company that operates in the blockchain and cryptocurrency space. Our mission is to make the blockchain space secure and trustworthy for people, companies, and governments alike. We are proud of our security experts from the renowned universities ETH Zurich, EPFL Lausanne and others.
We are trusted by 100+ blockchain companies and established corporations with security audits and services. We have secured complex systems for top blockchain clients, such as decentralized finance (DeFi) projects, and multinational organizations, such as banks and industrial consortia. A ChainSecurity Auditor will review the most complex blockchain projects to find vulnerabilities which no-one else can. By using state of the art tools, expert knowledge and a deep understanding of the fundamentals, we secure projects handling billions, often forming the foundation in the new paradigm of an open financial system.
Your Responsibilities:
* Work directly with the developers of the most successful teams in the blockchain industry to audit their code and secure their products
* Contribute to our security tools and create new ones in collaboration with our internal research team
* Conduct security research and publish your findings
Requirements:
* Strong background in software engineering, focused on security relevant areas and most importantly being able to reason about complex code
* Experience with penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, threat modeling or similar is a plus
* Good knowledge of cryptography
* Proficiency with Linux and Git
* Good written communication skills
* Fluent in OOP programming language
Bonus Points:
* Formal Verification, White Box, Vulnerability Scanning
* Solid Blockchain Knowledge
* Consensus Algorithms
Join us here: https://www.chainsecurity.com/jobs/blockchain-security-engin...

Your primary responsibility will be to keep our platforms secure, reliable, resilient and cost-effective, with particular focus on security, disaster recovery and business continuity. You will establish clear ownership, strengthen operational processes and move our approach from reactive problem-solving towards proactive prevention and continuous improvement. Working closely with our CTO and engineering colleagues, you will combine technical leadership with practical delivery. As we grow, we need infrastructure that can support increasing demand, enable safe and efficient development, and minimise disruption to students, landlords and commercial partners. You need to help support AI initiatives specifically providing infrastructure for agentic systems and knowledge of supporting models of cloud platforms like AWS & GCP. This role will provide dedicated ownership of those foundations, reducing the operational burden on other engineers and allowing them to focus on customer-facing features, partner integrations and future platform capabilities. Improve observability, logging, monitoring and alerting so issues can be identified and addressed early. Lead infrastructure incident response, coordinating technical investigation, recovery and stakeholder updates. Conduct constructive post-incident reviews, identify underlying causes and ensure agreed improvements are completed. Improve redundancy, capacity planning and performance to reduce avoidable disruption and support growth. Help define sustainable arrangements for incident escalation and out-of-hours support. Strengthen identity and access management, applying least-privilege access and appropriate authentication controls. Maintain effective processes for patching, vulnerability remediation, secrets management and secure configuration. Protect infrastructure, systems and data through appropriate network controls, encryption and monitoring. Identify and communicate technical risks, recommending proportionate improvements based on their potential business impact. Support security reviews, supplier assessments and relevant audit or compliance requirements. Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Own the technical disaster recovery approach and contribute to wider business continuity planning. Agree recovery priorities, recovery time objectives and recovery point objectives with relevant stakeholders. Implement and maintain backup, restoration and failover arrangements for critical systems and data. Test recovery procedures regularly, document the results and resolve identified gaps. Maintain clear recovery runbooks so the business can respond effectively to significant disruption. Identify single points of failure and reduce reliance on individual systems, suppliers or people. Automation & Developer Experience Drive the adoption and improvement of Infrastructure as Code, ensuring changes are repeatable, version-controlled and reviewable. items.desc: About London CIV London CIV is the investment pool for the Local Government Pension Schemes (LGPS) of London and Buckinghamshire local authorities. Authorised and regulated by the FCA, the pool is owned by all London boroughs, the City of London and Buckinghamshire (also known as London CIV's Partner Funds). The pool provides a broad investment offering across public markets through its Authorised Contractual Scheme (ACS), alongside a range of private markets funds. London CIV also provides Partner Funds with investment strategy and Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) advice, alongside specialist pension advisory and support through LGPS PASS (Pension Advisory and Support Services). As of 30 September 2026, assets under management stood at c.£65 billion. The role London CIV is investing in AI and automation to make it easier for colleagues across the organisation to do their jobs, from streamlining routine processes to building intelligent digital assistants. This contractor role sits at the heart of that programme, working alongside London CIV's Data & AI team to design, build and deploy AI-powered solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform and Microsoft Fabric. You'll take priority use cases from concept through to live deployment, partnering with business analysts, users and technical stakeholders across teams including Investment Management, Operations & Processing, Data/Finance & Risk, People, Client & Commercial and Governance to ensure solutions are secure, well-governed and genuinely useful. What you'll be doing AI & Automation Solution Delivery Design, develop, test and deploy AI-powered solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Build and maintain intelligent agents, conversational AI experiences and automated business processes. Apply appropriate security, governance, compliance and responsible AI practices to every solution. Support solution architecture, documentation, testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance. Systems Integration Integrate AI solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL and other business applications. Support database-related activities Troubleshoot application and system issues, including code fixes and SQL scripting. Coordinate releases and maintain application change history. Stakeholder Engagement & Continuous Improvement Work with business analysts, users and technical stakeholders to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into practical solutions. Identify opportunities to use AI, automation and low-code technologies to improve business processes. Provide technical support, troubleshooting and knowledge sharing across AI, Copilot and Power Platform initiatives. Work closely with development, infrastructure and technical support teams. Professional Standards Demonstrate the behaviours and standards that contribute to a strong organisational culture. Maintain high standards of professionalism at all times. Proactively engage across all London CIV teams, ensuring clear and timely communication on progress and priorities. Be available for occasional out-of-hours support, including weekday evenings when required. What we're looking for Essential Proven experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate. Proven experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, including building, configuring, testing and deploying Copilot agents. Experience with Dataverse, including table design, relationships, business rules, security and governance. Experience with Azure, including Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus and Azure DevOps. Experience with API integration and enterprise application integration. SQL database experience, including SQL scripting. Power BI experience. Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI practices. A strong technical communicator, confident working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A strong personal commitment to professionalism, integrity, and equality, consistent with the Nolan Principles of public life. Desirable Experience developing advanced AI agents using generative AI, custom topics, autonomous agents and orchestration capabilities. Experience with low-code application platforms. What we offer This is a contract engagement (inside IR35) for an initial term of 6 months with the potential to extend up to 12 months, subject to programme needs. You'll work on a hybrid basis, with 3 days per week in our London office. We are committed to building an inclusive team and welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.

DHL Express is looking for a Road & Capacity Scientist in Diegem. Road & Capacity Scientist is responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing DHL’s road network using advanced modeling, optimization tools, and data science techniques. This role translates operational data into actionable network decisions that improve cost, service, asset utilization, and customer experience across linehaul, hubs, and first/last mile operations. Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Description du poste L’intelligence artificielle redéfinit aujourd’hui les métiers, les processus et les modèles opérationnels des organisations. De la banque à l’industrie, en passant par le luxe, les dirigeants cherchent désormais à passer de l’expérimentation à l’impact : où l’IA crée-t-elle réellement de la valeur et comment transformer durablement l’entreprise ? En rejoignant Wavestone, vous accompagnerez de grandes organisations françaises et internationales dans cette transformation, à la croisée de la stratégie, de l’IA et des enjeux métier. Vous développerez ainsi une double compétence recherchée : comprendre les possibilités offertes par l’IA et savoir les traduire en transformations concrètes pour les entreprises. Vous n’avez pas besoin de choisir votre secteur avant de postuler. Qui sommes-nous ? La Caisse Fédérale de Crédit Mutuel (CFCM) est une société anonyme à statut de société coopérative de banque. Elle est responsable de l’ensemble des services communs au réseau et assure son animation. La CFCM centralise l’ensemble des dépôts des Caisses locales et assure parallèlement leur refinancement, tout en portant les emplois réglementaires pour leur compte (réserves obligatoires, dépôts affectés, etc.). items.desc: Data Analyst / Bioinformatician for Proteomics and Metabolomics The Max Planck Institute for Terrestrial Microbiology in Marburg is one of the world’s leading research institutions in the field of microbiology. Around 220 employees and approximately 125 guest scientists from a wide range of countries work together to investigate the fundamental principles of microbial life. An exciting opportunity has arisen within the Max Planck Institute for Terrestrial Microbiology, and we are actively seeking qualified candidates to fill the following vacancy as soon as possible. The institute has established state-of-the-art Proteomics and Metabolomics Core Facilities that provide advanced mass spectrometry-based technologies for the quantitative and qualitative analysis of proteins, metabolites, and other small molecules in biological systems. Both facilities support a broad range of research projects by combining cutting-edge analytical technologies with specialized expertise in mass spectrometry, data analysis, and method development. To strengthen the data analysis and bioinformatics capabilities of both facilities, we are seeking a highly motivated Data Analyst / Bioinformatician. The position will be shared between the Proteomics and Metabolomics Core Facilities and will contribute to the development, implementation, and application of advanced computational solutions for mass spectrometry-based research. Vertragsart: Teilzeit Angebot a collaborative, international, and scientifically stimulating working environment; access to state-of-the-art mass spectrometry technologies and research infrastructure; opportunities for professional development and further training; the possibility to contribute to method development, software development, and scientific publications; flexible working conditions within the framework of the institute’s regulations; 31 days of annual leave, plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve; annual special payment, with the option to convert part of this payment into up to three additional days off; capital-forming benefits; supplementary occupational pension scheme; subsidy towards the Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport ticket). The position is initially limited to 24 months, with the possibility of a permanent contract. It is offered on a full-time basis (39 hours per week) in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. If you wish to work part-time, please indicate your preferred number of working hours per week in your application. The Max-Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society seeks to increase the number of women in those areas where they are underrepresented and therefore explicitly encourages women to apply. Aufgaben You will become part of an interdisciplinary team supporting a broad range of research projects in proteomics, metabolomics, and mass spectrometry. Your main responsibilities will include the analysis, statistical evaluation, interpretation, and visualization of complex mass spectrometric data sets. A particular focus of the position will be the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of computational workflows and software tools for data processing, data management, quality control, statistical analysis, and visualization. You will use programming languages such as Python and R to establish reproducible and efficient analysis pipelines and to develop project-specific solutions for scientific data analysis. You will contribute to the structured management and documentation of research data and associated metadata, including the development of concepts for reproducible and FAIR-oriented data handling. You will also support the implementation and further development of tools for data organization, quality assurance, and long-term data management. As part of your scientific support activities, you will work closely with researchers from different scientific backgrounds. You will independently support research projects from data analysis planning through statistical evaluation and interpretation to the preparation of results for publications, presentations, and reports. This includes advising researchers on suitable analytical strategies, statistical methods, and visualization approaches. An additional important aspect of the position is knowledge transfer. You will communicate complex analytical and computational concepts in an accessible manner, contribute to training and educational activities, and support scientists, students, and technical staff in the use and interpretation of data analysis workflows. Profil Applicants should hold a university degree, ideally a PhD, in bioinformatics, computational biology, data science, life sciences, analytical chemistry, or a related discipline. I noen få tilfeller kan det være feil, så husk å sjekke hele annonsen. Søk senest tirsdag 15. desember PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering - AI tools for early validation and development of complex integrated systems Do you want to contribute to the development of knowledge, insight and solutions that are relevant to society and working life today and in the future? Some of tomorrow's most innovative systems are shaped by weather, ocean currents and thousands of design choices. How do you know that the design will work before it is built? Help engineers find out with the use of AI. We are looking for a PhD research fellow in Systems Engineering. About the position Do you want to help engineers design data-intensive systems where huge amounts of data and a vast design space make early decisions hard? Join us as a PhD research fellow at the Department of Science and Industry Systems, campus Kongsberg. Start: May 2027 (at the latest August 2027). You will be part of SFI CELECT (https://www.celect.no) - the Centre for Effective Engineering and Learning in Complex Systems - whose vision is to do more with less, and faster. The centre, funded by the Research Council of Norway, brings together Norway's leading industrial companies and 30 PhD candidates across USN, NTNU and the University of Agder. You will also join the Industrial Research School in Complex Systems (INRESCOS). Campus Kongsberg sits at the heart of one of Norway's strongest technology clusters, with world-leading companies in maritime, defence, aerospace, energy and subsea technology. Research and industry work side by side - giving you a unique network and strong career opportunities in industry or academia. The position is a three-year educational position with pure organised research training. A four-year appointment with 25% career-advancing may be considered. You must apply for and be admitted to the doctoral programme in Technology (https://www.usn.no/forskning/doktorgradsutdanning/vare-ph-d-utdanninger/teknologi/) (Systems Engineering) within three months of starting. The programme includes courses of about six months (30 ECTS), an independent thesis, research dissemination, a trial lecture and a public defence. Your main supervisor will be Professor Kristin Falk. Your workplace will be shared between campus Kongsberg and one or several CELECT partner companies: depending on the project, you will spend between 3 and 30 months located at a company's premises. You are expected to be present at campus or at the company during ordinary working hours. About the doctoral project The aim of this PhD is to develop AI-supported design methods and tools that enable early validation of complex, data-intensive integrated systems. Data-intensive systems have huge design spaces, and their behaviour emerges from many interacting factors. Design and operation become intertwined - and today's methods catch problems too late. In this PhD you will develop AI-supported design assistance: methods and tools, backed by digital twins, that help engineers explore large design spaces and validate systems early. Questions you could explore: How are data-intensive systems designed and validated in industry today? How can AI and digital twins support early design decisions? You will help shape the final research questions together with your supervisors and industry partners. The PhD project is part of SFI CELECT (https://www.celect.no), headed by Professor Kristin Falk. Industrial cases will be selected among CELECT partners such as Kongsberg Maritime, Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, Siemens Energy, H. Henriksen, Umoe Mandal and cDynamics. Using industry as your laboratory, you will work alongside engineers and systems architects on real development projects. This position is one of several related CELECT PhD positions at USN: it focuses on early design and validation, and complements positions on life-cycle management of long-living systems (PhD1.4), early systems integration in systems-of-systems (PhD1.5) and competence development for industry (PhD5.1). You will be part of the Norwegian Industrial Systems Engineering Research Group (NISE (https://www.usn.no/english/research/our-research-centres-and-groups/technology/norwegian-industrial-systems-engineering-research-group/)). items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. Description of the workplace The positions are linked to the Division of Solid State Physics at the Department of Physics, where extensive research is conducted in nanophysics, ranging from materials science to bio- and quantum physics to various applications. The department is a central part of NanoLund, Lund University's large interdisciplinary research centre for nanoscience and nanotechnology. The department includes Lund Nano Lab, a central and shared facility for the production of materials and components on the nanoscale. The department is also strongly involved in undergraduate education, not least in the civil engineering programme ‘Technical Nanoscience’ at LTH. The division hosts the research group of Prof Vanya Darakchieva whose research over the past twenty years on the fabrication and advanced characterization of wide- and ultra-wide bandgap semiconductors has been at the international forefront. https://portal.research.lu.se/en/persons/vanya-darakchieva/ Work duties As a teaching assistant, your duties may vary and should provide insight into the academic world at the faculty where you are studying. The duties include: calibrating optical instruments in the terahertz lab participating in research and supporting researchers in terahertz ellipsometry programming in Matlab and Python for data analysis and calibration 3D printing of equipment components spectroscopic ellipsometry data modelling and analysis Qualification requirements Only those admitted to a basic or advanced level programme at the faculty (or a related subject for the joint departments) may be employed as teaching assistants. You must not have completed your degree. Required qualifications: admitted to a degree programme in Physics or Engineering Physics very good knowledge of spoken and written English spectroscopic ellipsometry data modeling and analysis Meritorious qualifications: knowledge of terahertz ellipsometry basic knowledge of programming (Matlab/Python) skills in 3D printing We offer Lund University is a public authority which means that employees get particular benefits, generous annual leave and an advantageous occupational pension scheme. Through employment as a teaching assistant, you can combine your studies with work and complement your theoretical knowledge with practical experience. Read more on the University website about being a Lund University employee Work at Lund University. Further information The positions are a fixed term employment from as soon as possible until 31 May 2027 and each of the two is a 25% position. The positions must not adversely affect the teaching assistants' studies and may not be combined with other positions. The employment as a Teaching Assistant is regulated in the Higher Education Ordinance (SFS 2017:284), 5 chapter 8-12 §§. The position is covered by the Working Hours Agreement for Teachers. How to apply Applications are to be submitted via the University’s recruitment system. The application should include a CV and a personal letter justifying your interest in the position and how it matches your qualifications. We ask you to attach documentation from LADOK certifying your eligibility. The application should also include a degree certificate or equivalent and any other document to which you would like to be considered (copies of grade transcripts, details of referees, letters of recommendation, etc.)” Welcome to apply! items.desc: The Department of Chemistry , with more than 200 employees, is one of the largest departments at Stockholm University. The Research spans all areas of chemistry such as analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, materials chemistry, inorganic and structural chemistry and organic chemistry. The research projects are many from theory to experiment, from basic research to more applied projects often focusing on sustainable chemistry but also advanced analytical methods of chemicals and materials. The department has a very well-developed research infrastructure with state-of-the-art equipment with qualified support from staff scientists. The department also hosts the Bachelor's degree programme in chemistry and three Master's programmes: analytical chemistry, sustainable chemistry, and organic chemistry. PhD programmes are conducted in five areas: analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, materials chemistry, inorganic chemistry and organic chemistry. More information about us, please visit: Department of Chemistry. Project description The position focuses on pharmaceutical nanotechnology within analytical chemistry, integrating the development of therapeutic delivery systems with quantitative characterization of their physicochemical properties and biological interactions. The research aims to establish how the composition, structure, and surface properties of nanoparticles and polymeric biomaterials influence drug loading, release, stability, and transport in biological environments. The work includes nanoparticle-based carriers, functional polymers, hydrogels, and electrospun nanofibrous materials for the delivery of small-molecule drugs and biological therapeutics, including peptides, proteins, and nucleic acids. Particular emphasis will be placed on developing analytical approaches and experimental models to investigate controlled release, diffusion through extracellular matrices, and cellular uptake. The research will be conducted in collaboration with academic, clinical, and industrial partners. Main responsibilities The researcher will independently plan, conduct, and develop research in pharmaceutical nanotechnology within the group. Main responsibilities include the synthesis, formulation, and functionalization of nanoparticles and polymeric biomaterials for therapeutic delivery, as well as the development and application of analytical methods to evaluate their performance. The work involves physicochemical characterization of delivery systems, quantitative analysis of drug loading and release kinetics, and investigation of material degradation, therapeutic transport, and interactions with biological components. This includes developing hydrogel-based models of extracellular environments and conducting cell-based studies to assess cellular uptake and biocompatibility. The researcher will contribute to the development of experimental protocols, reproducible analytical workflows, and laboratory practices. Responsibilities also include supervising and training students, supporting doctoral researchers, coordinating collaborative research activities, and contributing to applications for external research funding. The successful candidate is expected to disseminate results through peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations and to contribute actively to the scientific development of the research group. Qualification requirements Researchers are appointed primarily for purposes of research and must hold a Swedish doctoral degree or an equivalent degree from another country. Assessment criteria In the appointment process, special attention will be given to research skills within pharmaceutical nanotechnology and to the relevance and quality of previous research in the development and analytical characterization of therapeutic delivery systems. Applicants must demonstrate experience in the preparation and physicochemical characterization of polymeric biomaterials or nanoparticle-based delivery systems, together with experience in quantitative investigation of drug release, molecular transport, or material–biological interactions. A demonstrated ability to plan and conduct research independently, critically analyse experimental data, and communicate results through peer-reviewed publications is required. Particular merit will be given to experience in: Synthesis and functionalization of biocompatible and biodegradable polymers, including polymer–drug conjugates and polyelectrolyte complexes. Preparation and characterization of hydrogels and electrospun nanofibrous materials for pharmaceutical or biomedical applications. Development of nanoparticle-based systems for the delivery of biological therapeutics, including peptides, proteins, or nucleic acids. Quantitative studies of release kinetics and therapeutic diffusion in hydrogels or models of extracellular matrices. Cell-based evaluation of delivery systems, including cellular uptake and biocompatibility. Research collaboration across …

items.desc: Toumetis Job Description Graduate Analyst Salary £35,000 About our Company Our mission at Toumetis is to deliver intelligence that can transform business operations and enable new revenue via the application of machine learning. We combine experience in applied machine learning, frontend development, data engineering, and cloud computing to help Fortune-1000 companies bring elegant IoT solutions to life, surfacing unique insights to predict and prevent problems and improve organisational performance. Our engineers, developers and data scientists share a passion for innovation and are dedicated to providing our customers with solutions that enable new insights that revolutionise business processes. We have a friendly working environment with flexible hours, WFH (1-2 days in the office P/W), regular social events, great coffee and snacks, free parking, ride to work scheme, bike racks, shower facilities and you will be supplied with a MacBook Pro. Our main office is based in the heart of the wonderful and vibrant city of Bristol around the corner from the SS Great Britain and one of the street artist, Banksy’s infamous works. It is only a short stroll to Cargo and the Harbourside area which boasts a tremendous array of bars, restaurants, cafes and other assorted nice places all ripe for a lunch break visit or relaxing after work. About our Role This is an exciting opportunity for someone who has either recently graduated or has 1-2 years commercial experience, to join a team working on a project considered cutting edge by Utility companies across the world. There will be a steep learning curve within the field of Electrical Engineering, and whilst we don’t expect you to have knowledge of this as you start, the ability to learn quickly, and an interest in the area is vital! The Analyst role will be to review the three-phase voltage and current waveforms, time-series data, that are captured and displayed on the Cascadence platform. Cascadence presents the data in a particular classification that has been determined by the machine learning algorithms. The role will either validate the classification is correct or assign the appropriate classification. The Analyst position will also utilise knowledge of electrical power engineering and circuit analysis to develop models to better understand the performance of the systems that are being measured. As the Cascadence platform evolves, the role of the Analyst will also evolve. There will be new event classifications, additional data requirements such as event point-on-wave determination and spectral energy and frequency content determination. Additional duties such as interfacing with the clients may also be required. Experience you will gain You will become proficient in utilising our Cascadence platform. This will include the ability to visually associate patterns in the waveforms and apply various transforms to validate the classifications. You will be able to understand and explain the taxonomy of the event classifications. There may also be a need to train and supervise junior staff. You will become proficient in the development of documents, spreadsheets and presentations. This role will focus around good interpersonal skills and require some public speaking. You'll also have access to company paid training services as we're keen for you to grow your skills. Experience you should have A degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or other related STEM background will be highly advantageous Solid writing and presentation skills Some experience with Python would be advantageous A drive to succeed and learn on the job. This position can offer multiple routes of progression within the company. Interested in the role? For a confidential discussion about this role, or if you feel your skillset would be of benefit to the Toumetis team but doesn’t match a specific job spec, please get in touch with our Talent Acquisition team - george.wrightson@Toumetis.com.
