items.desc: Mieux nous connaître Vous cherchez à mettre à profit votre expertise en analyse de données ? Vous êtes en quête d'un nouveau challenge professionnel dans une entreprise solide et innovante ? Rejoignez l'aventure E. LECLERC ! Faire partie de l'enseigne, c'est intégrer une fédération d'entreprises dynamiques, en croissance et qui se démarquent autant par leur mode de fonctionnement que par leur capacité à bouleverser les idées reçues. Au sein de ce mouvement d'indépendants, la SCAPEST est une centrale d'Achats et Logistique Régionale (635 salariés) desservant plus de 150 points de livraison E. LECLERC. Basée à Saint-Martin-sur-le-Pré (51), la SCAPEST recrute un(e) Data Analyst pour piloter la valorisation de ses informations au sein du pôle Système d'Information. Dans ce rôle clé, vous garantirez l'exploitation stratégique des données, le développement d'outils décisionnels intégrant les opportunités de l'IA, et la diffusion d'une véritable culture data auprès des équipes pour accompagner leurs prises de décision. Descriptif de l'offre Sous l'autorité du Responsable du pôle exploitation, le Data Analyst recueille et analyse les données de l'entreprise dans le but de fournir des rapports aux différents services et ainsi les aider dans les prises de décision. Doté(e) d'une forte appétence pour l'Intelligence Artificielle, il ou elle explore et intègre les nouvelles opportunités offertes par ces technologies pour maximiser la valorisation de la donnée. Vos attributions sont notamment les suivantes : Collecter et mettre en forme les données obtenues à partir des diverses sources logicielles de l'entreprise. Concevoir divers tableaux de bord, rapports et indicateurs après avoir établi un cahier des charges en lien avec le service demandeur. Analyser la cohérence des données exploitées et transmises. Identifier et expérimenter des cas d'usage liés à l'IA (Machine Learning, IA générative, analyse prédictive) pour enrichir l'aide à la décision et optimiser les processus métiers. Concevoir et/ou fiabiliser les outils d'analyse, notamment par la mise en place de process, de requêtes, d'automatisations de données et l'exploration de nouveaux modèles algorithmiques. Communiquer les solutions définies aux équipes métiers, participer à leur acculturation sur les nouveaux outils intelligents, et assister les utilisateurs dans l'utilisation des rapports existants. Profil recherché De formation supérieure (Bac +4/5) en Informatique, Statistiques, Data Science ou issu(e) d'une École d'Ingénieurs/Commerce avec une spécialisation Data, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative (2 à 3 ans minimum) sur un poste de Data Analyst, idéalement dans le secteur de la distribution, ou de la logistique.

items.desc: Context & Job description Vos missions principales en tant que scientifique de ligne seront les suivantes : Apporter un soutien aux utilisateurs externes à travers votre rôle de local contact et participer activement à l’exploitation de la ligne de lumière. Contribuer à la maintenance et au développement de la ligne de lumière, de nouveaux environnements d’échantillons et de méthodes d’analyse de données, en collaboration avec les autres membres de la ligne de lumière. Développer votre propre programme de recherche qui doit rester à l’avant-garde de la science de la matière molle ou de la biophysique. Les sujets de recherche interne comprennent la dynamique des colloïdes entraînés, les processus d’auto-assemblage spontané dans les systèmes amphiphiles et la relation entre la microstructure et la rhéologie dans les fluides complexes. Votre programme de recherche devra être axé sur l’exploitation des méthodes de diffusion à haute résolution et à résolution temporelle pour l’étude de la structure et de la dynamique de la matière molle ou des systèmes biologiques, ce qui permettra de diversifier davantage les activités actuelles. Expected profile Vous êtes titulaire d'un Doctorat en physique, chimie, biologie ou tout sujet connexe. Vous justifiez de plusieurs années d’expérience postdoctorales en particulier en techniques de diffusion par rayons X pour l’étude de la matière molle ou d’autres domaines connexes. Une forte aptitude dans l’instrumentation des lignes de lumière synchrotron, ainsi que des compétences en programmation et IA. De solides connaissances en analyse de données de diffusion et modélisation seraient essentiels pour la recherche interne et le support aux utilisateurs. Vous êtes à même d'interagir avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et les utilisateurs de l’installation. Vous maîtrisez l'anglais (langue de travail à l'ESRF). Working conditions Contrat à durée déterminée de 5 ans Le salaire sera calculé en fonction du niveau de qualifications et de l'expérience professionnelle pertinente Vous cherchez votre prochaine aventure professionnelle ? Postulez dès aujourd’hui ! items.desc: Au sein du service Emploi / Formation / Installation / Transmission (EFIT), et sous l’autorité du chef de service, vous contribuez à la conception et au déploiement de projets innovants en faveur du renouvellement des générations en agriculture, de l’attractivité des métiers et de l’accompagnement des parcours professionnels. Vos missions s’inscrivent principalement dans deux projets complémentaires : RELAIS, un projet européen Interreg associant des partenaires français et belges, visant à renforcer l’attractivité des métiers agricoles, à améliorer l’accompagnement des transmissions et à faciliter la mise en relation entre cédants et repreneurs. EMERGE – « De l’envie au projet », une démarche innovante visant à mieux comprendre les profils des personnes intéressées par l’agriculture et à développer, avec l’appui de l’intelligence artificielle, un outil d’aide à la décision pour les conseillers. Vous travaillez en lien étroit avec les Chambres d’agriculture du Grand Est, les partenaires transfrontaliers et les acteurs de l’emploi, de l’orientation, de l’installation et de la transmission agricole. Avantages : Rémunération sur 13 mois RTT Télétravail Vos missions seront les suivantes : 1. Déployer les actions du projet européen Interreg RELAIS Au sein d'une coopération transfrontalière associant notamment les territoires de la Marne, des Ardennes et de la Wallonie, vous contribuez à imaginer, tester et développer de nouveaux outils pour faciliter le renouvellement des générations en agriculture. Vos principales missions seront de : Piloter la mise en œuvre des actions confiées à la Chambre régionale d'agriculture Grand Est et en assurer le suivi opérationnel. Contribuer à la création d'un observatoire transfrontalier de la transmission agricole , en développant des méthodes permettant d'identifier et d'analyser les exploitations susceptibles d'être cédées, avec une perspective de transposition à l'échelle du Grand Est. Faire évoluer les pratiques d'accompagnement des cédants , en travaillant notamment sur les grilles d'entretien, l'analyse des besoins et la définition de profils-types. Imaginer et tester de nouveaux outils pour faire découvrir les métiers agricoles et les possibilités de parcours dans le secteur : supports pédagogiques, témoignages, ateliers et actions auprès des jeunes, avec une attention particulière portée aux publics féminins. Participer à la création d'un référentiel commun pour analyser les profils et évaluer les compatibilités entre cédants et repreneurs, afin de faciliter leur mise en relation. Organiser les expérimentations sur le terrain , auprès des publics concernés et des conseillers, analyser les résultats et contribuer à valoriser les méthodes et outils développés. Vous travaillerez en lien étroit avec les partenaires français et belges et veillerez à la bonne réalisation des actions et des livrables portés par la Chambre régionale d'agriculture. 2. Concevoir et expérimenter la démarche EMERGE Vous prenez part au développement d'une démarche innovante visant à mieux orienter et accompagner les personnes qui souhaitent découvrir les métiers agricoles ou construire un projet professionnel dans ce secteur. Concrètement, vous serez amené(e) à : Développer une méthode d'analyse des profils , prenant en compte les motivations, les aspirations, les compétences, les freins et les attentes des personnes intéressées par l'agriculture, en mobilisant notamment des approches issues des sciences humaines et sociales. Construire une typologie de profils et identifier les solutions adaptées à chacun : découverte des métiers, immersions professionnelles, formation, emploi salarié, installation progressive, entrepreneuriat, etc. Définir les critères permettant de rapprocher les profils des différentes solutions , en développant une approche multicritère intégrant des mécanismes de scoring. Contribuer à la conception d'un outil d'aide à la décision intégrant l'intelligence artificielle , en lien avec les partenaires techniques. Tester la démarche avec les conseillers de terrain , recueillir leurs retours, analyser les résultats et proposer les évolutions nécessaires. Formaliser les méthodes et les outils développés , créer les supports facilitant leur appropriation par les équipes et contribuer à préparer le déploiement de la démarche à plus grande échelle. Une attention particulière sera portée à la pertinence des critères d'analyse, à la fiabilité des recommandations et à la complémentarité entre les outils développés et l'expertise humaine des conseillers. 3. Faire vivre les partenariats et contribuer au pilotage des projets En lien avec les différents acteurs impliqués, vous contribuez à la dynamique collective et au bon déroulement des projets. À ce titre, vous serez chargé(e) de : Mobiliser et faire vivre les groupes de travail réunissant les Chambres d'agriculture et les partenaires des projets. items.desc: Intro For our location in Freiburg im Breisgau, we are looking for a Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d) to strengthen our Design Engineering team. At NexWafe, we are redefining how silicon wafers are manufactured. Our innovative epitaxial wafer technology reduces process steps, energy consumption, and CO₂ emissions, setting a new benchmark for sustainable photovoltaic production. As a Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d), you will be at the interface between simulation, design, and manufacturing. Your mission will be to convert simulation results into robust and manufacturable designs, creating functional showerhead systems for our next-generation production tools. Through close collaboration with process engineers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, you will contribute directly to the advancement of NexWafe's groundbreaking wafer manufacturing technology. Join our international team and help drive the transition toward a more sustainable energy future. Your Mission Initiate and evaluate solutions to optimize equipment and machinery. Create specifications from user requirements from stakeholders and translate them into functional designs. Evaluate concepts and perform engineering calculations for new equipment and installations. Convert simulation results into manufacturable designs, contributing to the development of functional showerhead systems. Support the evaluation and implementation of concepts for digital manufacturing documentation. Proactively manage, support, and coordinate suppliers together with Supply Chain. Initiate, facilitate, and manage technical specifications for parts and assemblies used in procurement activities. Participate in technical discussions with suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Your profile Must-Haves: Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable engineering discipline (Bachelor's or Master's degree; Master's degree preferred). Minimum 3 years of full-time industrial experience in mechanical design and engineering after graduation, within semiconductor equipment, photovoltaic manufacturing, vacuum technology, process equipment, plant engineering, or metalworking industries. Please note that internships, working student positions, academic research activities, and thesis projects are not considered equivalent to the required professional experience. Practical knowledge of gas distribution systems, including interconnections, component design, and nozzles/diffusers. Practical understanding of manufacturing processes, including machining and welding technologies and welded assemblies used in equipment manufacturing. Proficiency in CAD software such as Inventor, AutoCAD, or similar design tools. Fluent English skills (B2 level or above). Good communication and teamwork skills. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience supporting equipment installation, commissioning, or supplier coordination is considered an advantage. Proficient user of Microsoft Office applications. Why us? A diverse team: Short decision-making processes, flat hierarchies and collaboration with experts from different areas await you. A diverse and exciting job: A company that contributes to the commercialisation of environmentally friendly solar energy with a low carbon footprint. Stability with a certain degree of flexibility: A permanent position with flexible working hours. Attractive remuneration programme: An attractive salary, a company pension scheme and profit-sharing for employees. Healthy balance: Take your physical and mental health to the next level with an annual health budget and a HanseFit membership! Expand your language skills: Optimise your career prospects with the language courses offered. About us At NexWafe, we're striving to set a new standard for the future of photovoltaic wafer production. The need for efficient, affordable and cleanly produced solar technology has never been greater – we're rising to meet that challenge.

items.desc: Euro&Promos FM S.p.A . è una delle realtà più importanti del settore Integrated Facility Management . Con Headquarters a Udine, Euro&Promos è specializzata nella gestione integrata dei servizi di Soft Facility, Hard Facility e Logistics e vanta un portfolio clienti molto ampio tra enti pubblici e aziende private, operando capillarmente su tutto il territorio nazionale e contando oltre 7.500 dipendenti. Posizione: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una AI Graphic Designer da inserire nell'Ufficio Progetti – Ingegneria dell’Offerta & Proposal Engineering. La risorsa, riportando direttamente al Bid Manager, entrerà in un team strutturato e si occuperà della progettazione grafica dei contenuti a supporto delle gare d'appalto, trasformando informazioni e contenuti complessi in elaborati visivi chiari, efficaci e di impatto, attraverso l'utilizzo integrato di software grafici e strumenti di intelligenza artificiale generativa. Mansioni: Realizzazione di infografiche, icone, diagrammi, schemi di processo, illustrazioni e altri contenuti visivi. Impaginazione e progettazione grafica di documenti e offerte tecniche. Trasformazione autonoma di contenuti testuali in rappresentazioni grafiche efficaci. Utilizzo di strumenti AI generativa per la creazione e l'ottimizzazione dei contenuti visivi. Collaborazione con il Bid Manager e i redattori dell'Ufficio Progetti, con eventuale supporto all'area Marketing. Requisiti: La persona che vorremmo incontrare dovrà preferibilmente essere in possesso di: Titolo di studio in Graphic Design, Comunicazione Visiva, Design, Multimedia o percorsi affini. Competenze solide nell'ambito della progettazione grafica e della comunicazione visiva. Ottima conoscenza di Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop e InDesign. Capacità di utilizzare l'AI come strumento concreto di supporto al processo creativo e progettuale, mantenendo il controllo sulla qualità e sull'efficacia del risultato finale. La conoscenza di strumenti quali Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, Claude e Canva costituisce un elemento di interesse. Completano il profilo creatività, precisione, autonomia operativa, capacità organizzative e attitudine al lavoro in team. La presentazione di un portfolio grafico sarà considerata un elemento preferenziale. items.desc: Nell’ambito del potenziamento della practice di Quality Assurance, NTT DATA è alla ricerca di un Middle Test Automation Engineer che garantisca l’efficacia e l’efficienza delle attività di collaudo attraverso l’automazione dei test e l’adozione di tecnologie innovative, incluse soluzioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale e Generative AI. Il tuo contributo in questo ruolo Ti occuperai di: Progettazione ed esecuzione di scenari, strategie e framework di test automation efficaci, scalabili e manutenibili, garantendo la qualità delle soluzioni software in contesti tecnologici complessi; Integrazione di test automatizzati nei processi di sviluppo e nelle pipeline CI/CD, collaborando con i team di sviluppo e DevOps per favorire feedback rapidi e continui sulla qualità del software; Applicazione di strumenti e tecniche AI, Generative AI e LLM al processo di software testing, sperimentando e adottando soluzioni innovative a supporto delle diverse fasi del ciclo di test; Valutazione di nuovi tool e approcci AI-based per il Quality Engineering, contribuendo alla definizione di best practice; Redazione di documentazione tecnica chiara e dettagliata, comunicando efficacemente soluzioni e problematiche tecniche anche a interlocutori non specialistici; Partecipazione attiva a workshop, riunioni tecniche e momenti di confronto con clienti e stakeholder, contribuendo alla definizione delle strategie di qualità e automazione; Collaborare a stretto contatto con team di sviluppo, DevOps e Product Owner in ambienti Agile/DevOps, promuovendo una cultura della qualità, dell’innovazione e del continuous testing. Il profilo ideale Required skills: 3-5 anni di esperienza lavorativa in ambito test automation; Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o discipline affini; Solide competenze di programmazione, con esperienza nell’utilizzo di Java e/o Python per lo sviluppo di soluzioni di automazione; Conoscenza approfondita ed esperienza pratica con uno o più framework di test automation quali Selenium, Playwright e Appium; Esperienza nell’utilizzo di piattaforme di test automation enterprise quali Tricentis Tosca e/o UiPath e/o UFT (Unified Functional Testing); Esperienza nella progettazione ed esecuzione di test end-to-end, con particolare attenzione alla robustezza, manutenibilità e riusabilità delle soluzioni automatizzate; Conoscenza dei principi di Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) e dell’integrazione dei test automatizzati nelle pipeline; Esperienza o forte interesse nell'utilizzo di AI e Generative AI applicate al Software Testing e alla Test Automation; Conoscenza delle potenzialità dei Large Language Models (LLM) e dei principali approcci di AI-assisted development/testing; Capacità di utilizzare strumenti AI a supporto di attività quali test design, generazione e manutenzione degli script, analisi dei risultati e defect analysis; Attitudine alla sperimentazione e alla valutazione di nuovi strumenti e use case AI applicabili ai processi di Quality Engineering; Competenza nell’ambito dei performance test, utilizzando strumenti quali JMeter, LoadRunner o equivalenti; Familiarità con metodologie Agile/DevOps e con i principi di continuous testing; Eccellenti capacità comunicative, attitudine al lavoro in team e forte orientamento al problem solving; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, parlata e scritta. Sedi di assunzione : Milano, Bologna, Roma, Napoli, Salerno, Bari. Costruisci il tuo futuro con NTT DATA. Entra a far parte di un’azienda globale, leader nei servizi di business e tecnologici, che ascolta la tua voce e riconosce il valore del tuo lavoro. Collaborerai con clienti, partner e colleghi di tutto il mondo per creare soluzioni innovative capaci di avere un impatto reale sulla società. Qui potrai sviluppare nuove competenze e ampliare il tuo network. Siamo presenti in Italia con oltre 6000 dipendenti a Milano, Roma, Torino, Genova, Bologna, Treviso, Pisa, Padova, Napoli, Cosenza, Bari e Salerno. Make this the place where you grow. Unisciti a noi!

items.desc: Company: Marsh Description: Are you a recent graduate looking to kickstart your career in risk engineering consulting? We are seeking a talented individual to join our Property Risk Consulting team at Risk Consulting through our Professional Graduate Programme . This role will be based in Milan and/or Rome for a hybrid role. Risk Consulting is a management consulting firm that provides risk management services as part of Marsh Risk , a leader in insurance brokerage and head of the international Marsh Group, a group of expertise in strategic and management consulting, reinsurance, human capital, and investments ( Oliver Wyman, Guy Carpenter, Mercer ). We will count on you to: As a Risk Consultant in the Property team, you will support clients in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating the risks that threaten their production, logistics, and commercial facilities , by visiting sites and gaining direct exposure to plants and technologies. You will have the opportunity to apply your technical skills with the goal of reducing the likelihood that fires, catastrophic natural events, explosions, and machinery breakdowns cause property damage and disrupt critical operations. More specifically, you will have the opportunity to carry out the following activities: On-site property risk assessments: you will assess risks related to fire, explosion, theft, catastrophic natural events, and more. Support for property-related insurance and risk transfer activities. Loss prevention activities : you will support clients by proposing practical solutions to mitigate risks, defining loss prevention plans in line with international standards and local regulations. Engineering activities on fire protection topics: you will analyze and review fire protection projects, sprinkler systems, technical specifications, hydraulic calculations, and more. Business Interruption risk analysis : you will assess the potential economic and operational impacts arising from critical events or asset loss, helping clients prepare in advance. Special projects : you will work on advanced analysis projects related to extreme natural events, machinery breakdown analysis, and more. What you need to have: University Master Degree in Engineering Language skills: Fluency in Italian and English IT skills: Advanced skills in using main IT tools, especially the Microsoft Office Package (Excel and PowerPoint) Willingness to travel for short business trips in Italy Valid Driving Licence (B) Why join our team: Accelerated growth : Experience a journey of growth and acceleration through our comprehensive training program, combining technical and theoretical training with hands-on experience. Benefit from guidance provided by a Tutor, Mentor, and Buddy to ensure a supportive learning environment. Strategic vision: Gain a deep understanding of Marsh Risk's organizational structure and strategic vision during our comprehensive induction training. Meet Senior Leaders and their Teams, providing valuable networking opportunities. Unlock your potential: Nurture your talents and receive high-quality training. What we offer: Tailored career progression : The programme starts with a 6-month internship and €8 meal vouchers per working day, smart working policy and well-being initiatives. At the end of the 6-month internship, based on the tutors' evaluation, the internship can proceed through an apprenticeship contract offering a gross annual salary starting from €28.000. The National Collective Bargaining Agreement (NCBA) applied is 'Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi’. For candidates with prior experience , direct placement into an apprenticeship program will be considered. Additional attractive benefits offered with the apprenticeship contract: insurance coverages, supplementary pension plan, facultative health assistance, flexible benefits, optional stock purchase plan. Further details will be shared during the selection process. Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. items.desc: Carbon Robotics is the leader in physical AI for agriculture, helping farmers become more profitable and sustainable. Its flagship product, the LaserWeeder, is the world’s leading commercial laser weeding system with hundreds of units operated by farmers in 15 countries worldwide. LaserWeeder combines computer vision, AI, robotics, and high-powered lasers to identify weeds and destroy them with sub-millimeter precision—no herbicides, hand labor, or soil disturbance required. Growers achieve weed control cost reductions of up to 80% and crop yield increases of 5–50%, with payback in one to three years. The system is powered by Carbon AI’s Large Plant Model (LPM), trained on 150 million labeled plants, and can start weeding any crop or field in minutes. The company's second product is Carbon Autonomy , the most dependable tractor autonomy solution. Carbon Autonomy includes a retrofit tractor autonomy kit for John Deere tractors, autonomy software, and remote supervision for real-time interventions if required. Carbon Robotics is based in Seattle, Washington State, USA and has raised $185 million in capital since 2018 from leading investors including NVIDIA’s NVentures and BOND. YouTube | X | Instagram | LinkedIn | News Location : Ijmuiden, Netherlands As a Manufacturing Technician at Carbon Robotics you'll be responsible for the assembly, testing, and quality control of all sub-assembly parts. This role requires attention to detail, technical skills, and the ability to work as part of a team to ensure the production of high-quality, reliable products What you’ll do :: Assembly: Assemble Sub assembly components according to detailed engineering specifications and assembly instructions. Use hand and power tools to assemble mechanical components, optical components, and electronic parts. Ensure that all components are correctly aligned and securely fastened. Calibration: Calibrate scanning devices to ensure accurate and precise operation. Adjust and fine-tune optical components, sensors, and other critical elements as needed. Quality Control: Document and report any issues to the Manufacturing Supervisor for resolution. Conduct functional tests to verify that components meet performance specifications. Documentation: Maintain accurate and detailed records of assembly, calibration, and quality control processes. Update and complete production logs, checklists, and other relevant documentation. Collaboration: Work closely with the Manufacturing Supervisor and other team members to meet production goals and deadlines. Communicate effectively with engineers and product designers to address technical issues and improvements. Safety: Adhere to all safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment. Report any safety hazards or concerns to the appropriate personnel. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities for Success : Secondary education or equivalent; additional technical education or certifications are a plus. Willingness to work across multiple functional teams required Prior experience in manufacturing or assembly of electronic or mechanical components is preferred. Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow precise assembly instructions. Proficiency with hand and power tools. Basic understanding of optical systems, electronics, and sensors is a plus. Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic manufacturing environment. Effective communication and teamwork skills. Physical Requirements: Ability to lift, carry, and move equipment weighing up to 50lbs. Ability to stand or sit for extended periods during assembly and calibration tasks. Why would you join Carbon Robotics? We’re combining robotics, AI, and computer vision to solve some of agriculture’s toughest challenges. Our team is building innovative technology that helps farmers operate more efficiently, reduce reliance on herbicides, and move toward more sustainable farming practices. Join a team of passionate engineers, innovators, and problem-solvers who are pushing the boundaries of agricultural technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of farming. items.desc: REQ-10121483 06/11/2026 Meta Data Management & Data Modelling Amsterdam, Netherlands €5.677 - €9.137 ING Bank Want to help shape how customer data works across a global bank? At ING, customer data connects customers, products and services across countries and business lines. Getting that foundation right is critical to creating great digital experiences, meeting regulatory expectations and enabling secure, efficient banking. It is the DNA of the digital operating model of the bank. That is where Global Customer Domain (GCD) comes in. We design and deliver ING’s global customer data capabilities and enable customer data to be used consistently across the bank. The Center of Expertise Customer Data Design defines the architecture and models behind these capabilities. We work at the intersection of business, data and technology, setting direction while working closely with countries and delivery teams to turn complex customer data challenges into clear, scalable designs. Your role & work environment The Information Modeler - Analyst is responsible for all data related aspects of developments that require new or changed data. This includes working as a contributing member of multiple concurrent projects, working with business/enterprise architects in understanding architectural directions, gathering and analyzing business data requirements, data modelling and designing data structures that align with architecture goals. You will work together with product managers, customer journey experts and engineers of the Tribe to develop business capabilities for a perfect customer experience. Responsibilities are: Modelling new features in conceptual and logical model. Assist and advice in mappings from country models to the global harmonized model. Consult ING domains on usage of the model and data concepts. Define and maintain business definitions, taxonomy, controlled vocabularies and reference data. Contribute to development of capabilities and services (API’s, notifications) from the model viewpoint. Ensuring compliance with data related policies, standards, roles and responsibilities. Create and maintain high quality data documentation that allows the data to be understood and used for additional purposes. We hire smart people like you for their potential. Our biggest expectation is that you remain curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we will support you in developing into an even better version of yourself. Hold a master’s degree in information science or an equivalent qualification. Bring at least five years of relevant professional experience in business information analysis, semantic modeling, data modeling, or a closely related field. Demonstrate strong business orientation and analytical ability, translating business concepts into data designs and vice versa. Understand entity-relationship data modeling and interpret and explain logical and conceptual models in natural language. Build strong working relationships and demonstrate a strong customer-service orientation. Apply good general knowledge of the banking industry, its processes, and its products. Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Work proactively and collaboratively as a team player with strong communication and documentation skills. Feel at ease in a cross-border culture, listen to others, and invest in shared goals. Ideally, bring experience with business-process redesign, data management, data-modeling techniques, architecture, comparable industry models, enterprise-wide information or data models, and associated governance processes. Rewards and benefits We want to make sure you can strike the right balance between your career and your private life. items.desc: The Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute (IJC) is a comprehensive cancer research center dedicated to conduct research and drive innovation in the epidemiological, preventive, clinical, translational, and basic aspects of leukaemia and other hematologic malignancies, with the final aim of finding a cure for these diseases. It was created in 2010, and since then has experienced an exponential growth. The IJC is also part of the network of Excellence Research Centers of Catalonia (CERCA) and was accredited as a Severo Ochoa Center of Excellence by the Ministry of Science, Innovation, and Universities in 2024. Since 2018, the Institute has also been accredited by the Scientific Foundation of the Spanish Association Against Cancer (FCAECC) Additionally, IJC is one of the centers integrated into the Institut de Recerca Germans Trias i Pujol (IGTP) accreditation as Accredited Health Research Institute (IIS) by the Carlos III Health Institute (ISCIII) . The IJC's main headquarters is located within the Can Ruti Biomedical Campus, alongside other leading biomedical institutions, providing direct access to cutting-edge scientific and technological facilities, as well as complementary community services. The IJC has six locations integrated into reference hospitals : Hospital Germans Trias i Pujol, Hospital Clínic, Hospital Sant Pau, Hospital Josep Trueta, Hospital del Mar and Hospital San Joan de Déu. This facilitates close collaboration between basic and clinical researchers, fostering translational research that integrates basic science with clinical practice in clinical settings. We are looking for a POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCH to be part of the Graupera lab. RESEARCH DESCRIPTION Our research is devoted to study the biology of the endothelium and its role in disease towards the development of therapeutic strategies to target this compartment. Specifically, we aim to untackel the fundamental insights of vessel growth and function in developmental setting as well as to identify the pathological contexts in which the vasculature plays a critical role either intrinsically, as in vascular anomalies, or extrinsically as in cancer. MAIN RESPONSABILITIES Experimental design of the project. Working with complex genetically engineered mouse models including monitoring of the colony. Isolation and culture of primary endothelial cells. Work with mouse models of vascular malformations. scRNAseq data, processing and analysing. Spatial scRNAseq data, processing and analysing. Supervision of master and PhD students. Write fellowships applications and manuscripts together with the PI. Prepare formal reports for oral and written presentations. Data integration and interpretation. WHAT WE NEED PhD in the biomedicine or similar. Background in disease models. Expertise in vascular biology. Expertise in scRNAseq. A high level of motivation and interest. Ability to handle varying workloads and aptitude for teamwork. High level of collaborative and communicative skills. Good level of English speaking and writing skills (required). Spanish (helpful). WHAT WE OFFER Temporary position: 3 years (postdoctoral contract). This position is funded by ‘la Caixa’ Foundation under the project code HR26-00476. An exciting and innovative research project. Working in the mixed basic and clinical research environment of the Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute. Incorporation in a multinational and highly collaborative team. The stimulating environment of the Barcelona metropolitan area. DEADLINE Please submit your application by the end of 20th of Nov 2026 WHO WE ARE? What makes us different? The mission of the Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute is to conduct research and drive innovation in the epidemiological, preventive, clinical, translational, and basic aspects of cancer, with a special emphasis on Leukaemia and other malignant blood diseases, with the aim of finding a cure for these diseases. The IJC’s vision is to be a world-class reference and excellent research center that contributes to the improvement of results, and the cure of patients affected by leukaemia and other malignant haemopathies, through innovation, sustainability, social responsibility, talent, and professional experience. HR Excellence In 2019, IJC was honored with the “Human Resources Excellence in Research Award” by the European Commission, recognizing the alignment of our human resources policies with the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers. The Human Resources Strategy for Researchers (HRS4R) guides research centers of excellence in implementing and upholding these standards within their policies, emphasizing training, professional development, and mobility opportunities. The IJC’s commitment to these values and principles strengthens our internal policies and ensures that our members have the optimal conditions and environment for their professional development. items.desc: About The Opportunity The role We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our IT team and play a key role in the development of our firmwide data capability. This is a newly created position and our first dedicated Data Engineering hire, joining at an important stage in the development of Gateley’s wider data strategy. We are building the foundations that will allow us to bring together data that currently sits across different systems and areas of the business, improve its quality and governance, and make it easier to use for insight, reporting, analytics and emerging AI capabilities. You will have the opportunity to get involved at the ground level of that journey. Working predominantly within Microsoft Fabric, you will help us unlock data from existing sources, bring it into our developing data platform and engineer the pipelines and structures needed to cleanse, consolidate and transform it into trusted, reusable data products. A key part of this will be helping us develop reliable "golden records" and stronger master data practices, providing a trusted foundation for dashboards, analytics and future AI-enabled use cases. The scope is deliberately broad. You will combine hands-on engineering with problem solving, technical advisory work and stakeholder engagement, working across IT, Change and different business areas to understand their data, identify priorities and turn requirements into practical solutions. As the first Data Engineer in a growing capability, you will also have the opportunity to influence how we do things. You will help establish repeatable engineering patterns, standards and ways of working that can support the Data Programme as it develops. Responsibilities: Design, build and maintain data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric, creating reliable ingestion and transformation processes that move data from source systems into governed, reusable data products. Develop our Fabric data architecture, creating scalable lakehouse, warehouse and medallion-style structures in line with agreed architecture, governance and security standards. Onboard and integrate data from across the business, working with structured and semi-structured information held within core business applications, SaaS platforms, databases, files and approved APIs. Build appropriate batch and near-real-time integrations, selecting the right engineering approach based on the underlying business requirement rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach. Help unlock and consolidate data that currently sits across different systems and areas of Gateley, cleansing, transforming and structuring it so that it can be used more effectively for reporting, analytics, decision-making and future AI use cases. Ensure production data services are reliable and supportable, implementing appropriate monitoring, logging, exception handling, data lineage and operational support. Work directly with application owners, suppliers and internal stakeholders to identify and resolve issues relating to source data, connectivity, schemas, data quality and performance. Support the development of master and reference data capabilities, including data matching, entity resolution, identifiers, survivorship and golden-record processes, helping Gateley establish more trusted and consistent information across the organisation. Turn data governance and stewardship requirements into practical engineering solutions, including validation rules, quality controls, remediation processes and appropriate workflows. Create clear technical and operational documentation, including data definitions, mappings and lineage, ensuring the solutions you develop can be understood and supported by data stewards, technical teams and business stakeholders. Provide technical guidance on analytics and Power BI, advising on semantic models, measures, dashboard structure, visual selection, accessibility and performance. Help establish consistent definitions and trusted sources of data, ensuring Power BI outputs and other reporting products make use of governed data products rather than recreating business rules and logic locally. Challenge requirements constructively, working with stakeholders to understand the problem they are trying to solve and identifying whether a dashboard, metric, alert, workflow or another data product offers the most effective solution. Support the development of Fabric agents and AI-enabled data experiences, helping establish the data products, grounding approaches, permissions and access controls required to use these technologies responsibly. Assess whether data is ready for AI and agent-based use cases, considering data quality, metadata, access permissions, semantic consistency, governance and traceability before solutions are progressed. Work collaboratively with colleagues responsible for AI and data governance, ensuring experimentation remains controlled, transparent and aligned with Gateley’s wider governance and security requirements. …

items.desc: Vil du være med og forme hva vi bygger innen Data & AI? Vi har erfaring og spennende kundeprosjekter å bygge videre på, og nå ser vi etter flere som vil være med og forme veien videre. Derfor ser vi etter deg som har noen års praktisk erfaring som Data Scientist, og som ønsker å bruke data til å løse reelle forretningsproblemer. Hos oss får du jobbe med hele reisen fra å forstå problemet og utforske data, til å utvikle modeller og få løsningene til å skape verdi i praksis. Du får ikke bare en rolle i kundeprosjektene våre, men også muligheten til å påvirke hvordan vi jobber, hva vi satser på og hvordan Data & AI-fagmiljøet vårt utvikler seg. Dette ser vi etter Relevant høyere utdanning innen teknologi, informatikk, statistikk, matematikk eller tilsvarende Noen års praktisk erfaring med Data Science, maskinlæring eller avansert analyse God forståelse for statistikk, prediktiv modellering og evaluering av modeller Erfaring med Python og relevante biblioteker for analyse og maskinlæring Erfaring med å bearbeide, utforske og analysere større datasett Forståelse for hvordan modeller kan tas fra eksperimentering til løsninger som faktisk brukes Evne til å forstå forretningsproblemer og oversette dem til gode analytiske problemstillinger Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig Det er et pluss om du også har erfaring med Azure Machine Learning, Databricks eller Microsoft Fabric MLOps og produksjonssetting, monitorering og videreutvikling av modeller Generativ AI, RAG eller utvikling av løsninger basert på store språkmodeller Tidsserieanalyse og prognoser Optimalisering, klassifisering eller andre metoder for beslutningsstøtte Hvorfor Itera? Itera er et teknologidrevet konsulentselskap der teknologi, design og forretning møtes. Vi jobber sammen om komplekse kundeutfordringer, og kombinerer sterke fagmiljøer med korte veier fra idé til handling. Hos oss får du: Faglig utvikling, gjennom kurs, sertifiseringer, faggrupper og læring i prosjekter Tverrfaglighet, med kolleger innen data, AI, software, design og forretning Konkurransedyktige betingelser Aksjeprogram Et sosialt og inkluderende miljø, med både faglige og sosiale aktiviteter Og kanskje viktigst: Du får mennesker rundt deg som liker å dele det de kan, spørre om det de ikke kan og finne løsninger sammen. Kanskje dette er neste steg for deg? Kjenner du deg igjen i det vi beskriver, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Du trenger ikke kunne alt på listen. Det viktigste for oss er at du har et godt fundament innen data og analyse, er nysgjerrig på hvordan teknologi kan løse reelle problemer og ønsker å utvikle deg videre sammen med flinke folk. Legg ved CV og svar kort på spørsmålene under. Vi ser frem til å bli bedre kjent med deg! Relevante kandidater blir kontaktet fortløpende.

items.desc: A propos d’Atos Atos est la marque d’Atos Group dédiée aux services numériques de bout en bout, sécurisés et accélérés par l’IA. Atos conçoit, développe et opère des environnements numériques essentiels à la performance, à la résilience et à la souveraineté. L’entreprise aide les organisations publiques et privées du monde entier à garder la maîtrise de leurs données et de leurs infrastructures, tout en répondant à leurs exigences de conformité. Avec plus de 52 000 collaborateurs au service de plus de 4 500 clients dans 54 pays, Atos accompagne la modernisation des systèmes IT, accélère la transformation cloud et data, renforce la cybersécurité et déploie des environnements de travail numériques sécurisés, au bénéfice de ses clients, de leurs collaborateurs et de la société. Atos propose également des services de conseil et d’accompagnement à travers sa marque Atos Amplify. Partenaire de confiance dans la gestion d’environnements complexes et critiques, Atos accompagne les organisations dans des contextes hautement réglementés et souverains. A propos d’Atos Group Atos Group est un leader international de la transformation digitale avec près de 54 000 collaborateurs et un chiffre d’affaires annuel de près de 7,2 milliards d’euros. Présent commercialement dans 54 pays, il exerce ses activités sous deux marques Atos pour les services et Eviden pour les produits et systèmes. Numéro un européen de la cybersécurité et leader dans le domaine du cloud, Atos Group s’engage pour un avenir sécurisé et décarboné. Il propose des solutions sur mesure et intégrées, accélérées par l’IA, pour tous les secteurs d’activité. Atos Group est coté sur Euronext Paris. Au sein d'Atos, vous intégrerez les équipes en charge du programme LP ISIS, une plateforme générique de contrôle commande satellitaire utilisée pour la mise en œuvre de systèmes spatiaux et de centres de contrôle. LP ISIS est un produit riche fonctionnellement et hautement configurable permettant de répondre aux besoins de missions spatiales variées. En contrepartie de cette flexibilité, les phases d'assemblage, de configuration et d'intégration d'une nouvelle instance LP ISIS nécessitent aujourd'hui une forte expertise métier et technique. Ces activités de missionisation mobilisent de nombreux paramètres, fichiers de configuration et outils spécialisés. Elles constituent souvent une étape critique des projets et peuvent représenter un investissement important pour les équipes d'intégration. Dans un contexte où l'Intelligence Artificielle ouvre de nouvelles perspectives d'assistance aux utilisateurs, le programme LP ISIS souhaite étudier comment des technologies d'IA Open Source, souveraines et frugales pourraient accompagner les intégrateurs et les experts dans ces activités. L'objectif est d'évaluer la pertinence d'un assistant intelligent de configuration et de missionisation, capable de simplifier et d'accélérer la mise en œuvre d'une nouvelle instance LP ISIS tout en réduisant les risques d'erreurs. Votre mission L'objectif du stage est d'étudier les apports potentiels de l'Intelligence Artificielle dans les activités de missionisation LP ISIS et de démontrer la faisabilité d'une telle approche au travers d'un prototype fonctionnel. Pour limiter le périmètre de l'étude tout en conservant une forte valeur opérationnelle, les travaux se concentreront dans un premier temps sur la chaîne d'acquisition Monitoring & Control (M&C), premier composant généralement mis en œuvre lors du déploiement d'une nouvelle plateforme LP ISIS. Ce périmètre pourra être étendu en fonction de l’avancement des travaux réalisés Phase 1 Compréhension du domaine et analyse de l'existant Phase 2 Étude des technologies IA adaptées Phase 3 Définition de la solution cible À partir des conclusions de l'étude, vous définirez une architecture permettant d'assister progressivement les utilisateurs lors des différentes étapes de missionisation. Deux niveaux d'assistance ont d'ores et déjà été identifiés Niveau 1 Assistant de configuration en ligne de commande Cette première approche vise à démontrer rapidement la valeur ajoutée de l'IA dans les activités de missionisation. Niveau 2 Missionisation assistée par interface graphique Dans une approche plus ambitieuse, l'étude devra explorer la faisabilité d'une interface utilisateur moderne permettant de guider l'utilisateur tout au long du processus de missionisation Phase 4 Réalisation d'un Proof of Concept À partir de l'architecture définie, vous développerez un prototype permettant de valider les principaux concepts étudiés. Environnement technique Selon les orientations retenues, vous pourrez être amené(e) à travailler avec Intelligence Artificielle Typescript/Javascrip Développement Python React Node.js DevOps & Industrialisation GitLab Linux Jenkins Méthodes Agile Scrum Architecture logicielle Ingénierie système Profil recherché Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 Informatique, Master IA ou bien Génie …

Après plusieurs années de forte croissance en France, Mayday entre dans une nouvelle phase décisive :
items.desc: À propos Contexte : l'IA au cœur d'une ambition mondialee structurante pour devenir leader mondial du CSKM Mayday est une plateforme de Knowledge Empowerment boostée par l’IA, conçue pour aider les entreprises à structurer, activer et faire vivre leur connaissance au service de la performance de la relation client. Après plusieurs années de forte croissance en France, Mayday entre dans une nouvelle phase décisive : Un rapprochement stratégique avec USU, acteur international de référence des solutions IT et Service Management, permettant à Mayday d’accélérer son déploiement à l’échelle mondiale. Un objectif clair : devenir le leader mondial du Customer Service Knowledge Management (CSKM) d’ici 2028. Un positionnement assumé comme tiers de confiance IA, en faisant de la connaissance le socle indispensable de tous les cas d’usage IA en relation client (conseillers, selfcare, bots, formation). Descriptif du poste Ce qu'on cherche avant tout Mayday vise à devenir le leader mondial de son marché d'ici 2028. Pour y arriver, on cherche des personnes qui voient loin : un super profil, ambitieux, qui a envie de se projeter et de grandir avec nous sur la durée plutôt que d'occuper un poste. L'état d'esprit et l'ambition priment sur la checklist des compétences. Concrètement : à partir de 4 ans d'expérience, tu peux y aller. Le reste de cette fiche décrit le rôle, mais c'est l'envie qui fait la différence. Tu rejoins une équipe Data structurée et en croissance, composée de Data Engineers, Back-End Engineers et Data Scientists, encadrée par un Tech Lead Data et pilotée par un Head of Data & AI. Tu travailles au quotidien avec un PM AI, et tu peux être amené(e) à intervenir auprès de clients en collaboration avec les équipes de Customer Success Managers. Ce que ce poste a de particulier : tu n’est pas là pour simplement intégrer un LLM ou multiplier les prompts. Tu es là pour concevoir les systèmes de RAG et les agents qui permettront à nos clients d’exploiter pleinement leur base de connaissances, de manière fiable, pertinente et scalable. Tu interviens sur toute la chaîne : compréhension du besoin, ingestion et structuration des contenus, retrieval, génération, orchestration des agents, évaluation et mise en production. C’est un rôle à forte autonomie intellectuelle, avec un impact direct sur le produit et sur la trajectoire technique de l’équipe. Applied AI, RAG & Agents Identifier les opportunités IA à fort impact business, de la définition du problème jusqu’au déploiement. Concevoir et améliorer des architectures de Retrieval-Augmented Generation : ingestion et parsing des contenus, chunking, embeddings, indexation, recherche hybride, filtres par métadonnées, reranking et génération de réponses contextualisées. Développer des agents IA capables de raisonner à partir de la base de connaissances propre à chaque client, d’utiliser des outils et d’exécuter des workflows métier de manière fiable. Travailler sur les principaux enjeux du retrieval : pertinence, fraîcheur des informations, gestion des permissions, désambiguïsation, personnalisation et passage à l’échelle. Expérimenter avec différents modèles, stratégies de retrieval et architectures d’agents, puis arbitrer en fonction de la qualité, de la latence, du coût et de la maintenabilité. Mettre en place des frameworks rigoureux d’évaluation des systèmes RAG et agentiques : jeux de données de référence, tests automatiques, human evaluation, métriques de retrieval et mesure de la qualité des réponses. Assurer une veille active sur l’état de l’art des LLMs, du RAG et des agents, en sachant distinguer les avancées réellement utiles au produit des effets de mode. Engineering & MLOps Écrire du code Python propre, testé et maintenable, en combinant expertise data et rigueur d’ingénierie. Construire et maintenir des pipelines robustes couvrant toute la chaîne : ingestion → transformation → indexation → retrieval → génération → évaluation → monitoring. Intégrer des modèles et services d’IA générative, notamment via les APIs des différents provider, et choisir les modèles adaptés à chaque cas d’usage. Assurer la fiabilité des systèmes en production : observabilité, analyse des erreurs, gestion des fallbacks, alerting, versioning des prompts et des modèles, maîtrise de la latence et des coûts. Concevoir des mécanismes de sécurité adaptés aux systèmes agentiques : contrôle des outils, gestion des droits, protection contre les prompt injections et validation des sorties. Collaborer avec les Data Engineers et Back-End Engineers pour intégrer ces capacités au produit et les faire fonctionner à l’échelle. Contribuer aux choix d’architecture et aux standards techniques de l’équipe Data & AI. Collaboration & Impact Produit Travailler en binôme avec le PM AI pour transformer les enjeux produit et les retours utilisateurs en problèmes bien formulés, en hypothèses testables et en solutions actionnables. Collaborer avec les équipes customer-facing pour comprendre les usages réels, …

items.desc: Deine Aufgaben – gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: In unserem modernen Reinhold Würth Innovationszentrum CURIO erwarten dich vielseitige praktische Tätigkeiten. Werde Teil des neuen Feldes "Robotik im Handwerk" und lege mit uns den Grundstein für Robotik-Anwendungen, die unsere Kunden begeistern. Du unterstützt bei der Vorentwicklung robotischer Systeme in Kombination mit unseren Powertools. Erweiterung einer bestehenden Softwarearchitektur sowie Implementierung neuer Ansätze und Applikationen im Bereich Robotik und/oder Computer Vision. Aktive Mitwirkung an Robotik-Anwendungen und Sammeln von Erfahrungen mit neuesten Greifarmrobotern. Du bringst eigene Ideen mit ein und gestaltest aktiv die Forschung und Entwicklung in diesem neuen Bereich mit. Arbeite in einer agilen Projektumgebung und tausche dich aktiv mit verschiedenen Entwicklungsingenieuren (m/w/d) aus. Dein Profil – gemeinsam wachsen: Studium im Bereich Robotik, Automatisierung, Informationssysteme oder vergleichbarer Studiengang. Du hast gute bis sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und/oder C/C++. Grundkenntnisse in Roboterprogrammierung, idealerweise erster Kontakt mit ROS/ROS2. Du interessierst dich für autonome Systeme und aktuelle technische Entwicklungen. Du zeichnest dich durch Eigeninitiative, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und Durchhaltevermögen aus. Erste eigene Projekterfahrung sind von Vorteil (z. B. selbstfahrendes Auto, selbstgebauter Roboter-Arm, Arduino-Setup, ROS-Experiment). Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Deep Learning, OpenCV/YOLO oder CAD. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für den Austausch mit internationalen Kollegen und Kolleginnen. So sagen wir bei Würth Danke Wertschätzende Kultur Vom ersten Tag an wirst du Teil einer Gemeinschaft, die zusammenhält, Vertrauen schenkt und dich auf deinem Weg begleitet – mit starkem Teamgeist, festen Ansprechpersonen und echtem Spaß bei der Arbeit. Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Wir begleiten dich individuell. So wächst du nicht nur fachlich, sondern auch persönlich über dich hinaus. Sicherer Arbeitsplatz Starte bei uns mit besten Aussichten – in einem zukunftssicheren Familienunternehmen, das dich langfristig begleitet und echte Perspektiven bietet. Flexible Arbeitszeiten Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und bis zu zwei Tagen Mobile Office pro Woche unterstützen wir dich dabei, Arbeit und Privatleben optimal zu verbinden. Eigener Laptop Du bekommst von Anfang an deinen eigenen Laptop und alles, was du brauchst, um eigenständig zu arbeiten, Ideen umzusetzen und direkt loszulegen. Über 10.000 Sport- mitgliedschaften Ob Workout oder Entspannung, ob Kurse vor Ort oder online: Mit unserem internen Gesundheitsmanagement und dem arbeitgebergeförderten EGYM Wellpass bleibst du aktiv, ausgeglichen und fit im Alltag. Deine Benefits in einer wertschätzenden Unternehmenskultur: Dein Einsatz wird belohnt. Bei einem Pflichtpraktikum erwarten dich 1.400 € brutto pro Monat. Machst du für vier Monate oder länger ein freiwilliges Praktikum oder schreibst deine Abschlussarbeit bei uns, erhältst du 2.541 € brutto pro Monat. Bleibe aktiv und gesund mit unseren Sport- und Entspannungskursen - vor Ort und online - sowie der Nutzung von über 10.000 Sport- und Wellnesseinrichtungen mit dem arbeitgebergeförderten EGYM Wellpass. Um dir deinen Start in einer neuen Umgebung zu erleichtern, bieten wir - je nach Verfügbarkeit - die Möglichkeit, in einer unserer Firmenwohnungen zu wohnen. Genieße in unserem hervorragenden Betriebsrestaurant täglich frische, regionale Speisen in entspannter Atmosphäre - dabei wird dein Mittagessen zu 50 % vom Arbeitgeber bezuschusst. Zusätzlich kannst du dich kostenlos an unseren Heißgetränken bedienen. Unser Praktikumsprogramm „GO WÜRTH“ steht für „gemeinsam orientieren“ und bietet jedes Semester unterschiedliche Bausteine. Bei Veranstaltungen wie „HELLO NEWCOMER“ hast du die Gelegenheit zu netzwerken und fachbereichsübergreifende Einblicke zu erhalten. Das wichtigste Wort im Umgang bei uns ist DANKE. Dich erwartet ein familiäres und herzliches Miteinander, in dem du deine bestehenden Stärken weiterentwickeln und neue entdecken kannst.

items.desc: Au sein du site de Dassault Systèmes à Plouzané (Brest), vous rejoindrez une équipe de six ingénieurs, répartis entre Brest, Nantes et Nancy, spécialisée dans le développement de solutions de génération de code C/C++ à partir de modèles UML/SysML pour les systèmes embarqués. Dans un contexte où l'intelligence artificielle transforme les pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, notre équipe explore de nouvelles approches pour enrichir ses solutions et automatiser certaines étapes du développement logiciel. Vous contribuerez à un projet innovant visant à intégrer les capacités de l'IA générative et des agents intelligents dans les processus de génération de code, de validation et de test logiciel. Vos missions Dans la continuité des travaux déjà engagés sur la génération de code assistée par l'IA, votre mission consistera à concevoir et développer un agent IA capable d'automatiser et d'orchestrer différentes étapes du cycle de développement logiciel, depuis la conception des modèles jusqu'à l'analyse des résultats des tests. À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Contribuer à la génération de code assistée par l'IA, à partir de modèles UML/SysML, pour des applications embarquées. Développer des capacités de génération automatique de tests, en exploitant différentes sources d'information : modèles de conception UML, modèles d'ingénierie système (MBSE) et exigences système et logiciel. Automatiser l'exécution des tests générés afin de faciliter la validation du code produit. items.desc: Your next mission Do you like being ahead of the curve? Do you want to work on developing software for new, market-leading technology? As a Software Developer at Robin Radar, you will do just that! The ideal candidate will have the opportunity to directly work on our software development and will be able to build, adapt, and modify the software of our radar products. To put it in simple terms, you will develop mind-blowing radar tech! Your work will be crucial, as equipping our radars with the best performing software also creates a better functioning product for our customers and increases safety, too. Not only that, but you would be part of an amazing, growing, and agile R&D Software Development Team, reporting to a team lead who is there to support and guide you every step of the way. What you'll do Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable C++ code with a special focus on complex algorithms. Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to these problems. Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization. Working with other departments on technical issues including software system design and maintenance. Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system. Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements. Give direction to software programming and documentation development. What you bring MSc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years' experience as a C++ software developer with current knowledge of (advanced) C++ 17/20 standards. Extensive experience developing and deploying software on Linux, with a strong grasp of multithreaded code and real-time environments. Proficiency in Qt and experience with complex algorithms (e.g., image processing or tracking) with real-time performance. Knowledge of PostgreSQL databases, JSON, and XML. Familiarity with low-level hardware interactions and unit testing using GoogleTest. Experience with Bitbucket (or similar), Jira, Qt Creator and CI/CD (Jenkins). Solid understanding of the SDLC and experience in Agile/Scrum environments. Excellent communication in English (Dutch proficiency is a plus). Nice to have Experience with radar systems or a similar industry. Experience with embedded systems design. But of course, you should identify with our core values: We trust, We own it & We aim high. What we offer Working for a Great Place to Work certified company. Comprehensive pension plan. Commuting allowance: our teams work hybrid. 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days). Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications. High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role. An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks! Our hiring process First Interview An introductory conversation with our Head of Software and one of the Team Leads to discuss your background, experience and mutual cultural fit. Coding Challenge A practical take-home C++ assignment designed to let you showcase your technical skills on your own time. Final Interview A technical deep-dive with 2 other team members to review your solution. Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world. We're growing. Fast. In fact, we are one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands. But despite this growth, we stay true to our core values of trust, ownership and aiming high. At Robin, you don’t join just a team. You join a collective of bright minds driven by the belief that 'doing things better' is a continuous challenge. Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You’ll fit right in, we’re saving you a seat.

items.desc: Oglasi za zaposlitev Kolektor > Kariera > Kvantitativni analitik za dobavo električne energije Kvantitativni analitik za dobavo električne energije 11. 2026 Ljubljana m/ž V ekipo vabimo kvantitativnega analitika , ki bo energetske sisteme pretvarjal v optimizacijske modele, jih uvajal na platformo OPTIMA in z analizami pomagal razvijati nove energetske rešitve in poslovne modele. Če vas veseli matematično modeliranje, razumete, kako delujejo energetske naprave in trgi, in želite, da vaši modeli vsak dan upravljajo resnične naprave, se nam pridružite! Pri razvoju uporabljamo sodobna orodja umetne inteligence. Iščemo kandidata na ravni junior ali senior. Obseg nalog, samostojnost in plačilo prilagodimo izkušnjam izbranega kandidata. Zaupali Vam Bomo Naslednje Naloge: Optimizacijski modeli na platformi OPTIMA: modeliranje in optimizacija energetskih in finančnih tokov v energetsko intenzivni industriji, daljinskih sistemih ogrevanja in energetskih podjetjih ter za kombinacije baterijskih hranilnikov, sončnih elektrarn, polnilnic za električna vozila, odjema in mikro omrežij; upoštevanje tehničnih, obratovalnih in varnostnih omejitev, omrežnine in konične moči ter optimizacija voznih redov za dan vnaprej in znotraj dneva, analize energetskih postrojev: modeliranje in vrednotenje postrojev (npr. baterijski hranilnik + sončna elektrarna + polnilnice + odjem), dimenzioniranje enot, izračun prihrankov in prihodkov na trgih, ocena ekonomičnosti elektrolizerja na energetskem trgu in v industriji, scenariji cen in analize občutljivosti, strategije na energetskih trgih: zasnova, backtest in parametrizacija strategij avtomatskega zapiranja pozicij in trgovanja na trgu znotraj dneva ter vključevanje prožnih enot na trg za dan vnaprej, izravnalni trg in trg sistemskih storitev, napovedi za optimizacijo: napovedi odjema naprav in lokacij, proizvodnje sončnih elektrarn, cen ter prožnosti (npr. polnjenja električnih vozil), razvoj novih rešitev, storitev in poslovnih modelov: samozadostna vozlišča, upravljanje z energijo in viri prožnosti, trg prožnosti, obnovljivi viri energije, energetske skupnosti, mikro omrežja, virtualna elektrarna, e-mobilnost, vodik in drugo, medsektorsko povezovanje: skupna optimizacija elektrike, toplote, pare, plina, vodika, e-mobilnosti in biomase, analitična podpora strateškim storitvam: strategije prehoda v brezogljičnost, strategije nabave energije, cenovni trendi, dobava zelene energije in projekti za programe financiranja EU, delo s partnerji: zajem tehničnih omejitev in poslovnih ciljev na delavnicah, priprava analiz za ponudbe ter predstavitev rezultatov in ekonomskih učinkov, produkcija in razvoj z orodji umetne inteligence: uvedba modelov v produkcijo s spremljanjem in alarmi, dokumentacija ter uporaba AI orodij za programiranje (Claude Code) pri razvoju, analizah in testiranju. Predstavi Idealnega Sodelavca Se Boste Približali, Če Imate: Najmanj VI. stopnjo izobrazbe tehnične (FE, FS, FRI …), naravoslovne (FMF …) ali ekonomske (EF …) smeri, znanje matematičnega modeliranja in optimizacije (linearno in mešano celoštevilsko programiranje), aktivno znanje angleškega jezika, znanje programskega jezika Python in jezika SQL, razumevanje delovanja energetskih sistemov in naprav (elektrika, toplota, plin) ter osnov energetskih trgov, analitično in kritično razmišljanje - rezultat preverite, preden mu zaupate, sposobnost jasno predstaviti rezultate tehničnim in poslovnim sogovornikom, tudi pri partnerjih, odgovornost, natančnost in samoiniciativnost. Za Raven Junior: Zaključen študij ali do 2 leti izkušenj; primer projekta, naloge ali diplome z optimizacijo ali modeliranjem energetskih sistemov, interes za energetske trge in nove energetske tehnologije ter pripravljenost, da se jih hitro naučite. Za Raven Senior Dodatno: Vsaj 4 leta izkušenj z optimizacijskimi modeli ali tehnično-ekonomskimi analizami v energetiki ali industriji, izkušnje s samostojnim vodenjem modeliranja od zajema zahtev do uvedbe v produkcijo, poznavanje energetskih trgov (dan vnaprej, znotraj dneva, izravnalni trg, sistemske storitve) in omrežnine, pripravljenost za mentorstvo in pregled kode mlajših sodelavcev. Prednost (ne Pa Pogoj) Predstavljajo: Izkušnje z orodji za optimizacijo (Pyomo, PuLP, OR-Tools, Gurobi, CPLEX ali podobno), izkušnje s platformami za optimizacijo ali algoritmično trgovanje v energetiki, poznavanje tehnologij: baterijski hranilniki, toplotne črpalke, SPTE, elektrolizerji, polnilnice za električna vozila, izkušnje s stohastično optimizacijo, modelnim prediktivnim vodenjem (MPC) ali napovednimi modeli, znanje investicijskih analiz (NPV, IRR, LCOE, LCOH) in razvoja poslovnih modelov, izkušnje s projekti, financiranimi iz programov EU, izkušnje z Git, Docker, CI/CD in oblakom (Azure), izkušnje z AI orodji za programiranje (Claude Code, Copilot ali podobno), če imate javno dostopen projekt (npr. GitHub), ki prikazuje vaše delo, nam pošljite povezavo. Poleg Dela v Prijetnem Delovnem Kolektivu Vam Nudimo: …

items.desc: Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Whether we’re developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward. Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits. Who We're Looking For The Machine Learning Operations Consultant enhances the reliability, quality, and automation of Syniverse's ML model development and deployment lifecycle. This role focuses on modernizing Ground Truth (GT) dataset management, strengthening model quality assurance and validation practices, and designing a fully automated model re-training pipeline. The consultant works independently and collaboratively with the Technical Curation (TC) team and other stakeholders, delivering recommendations, designs, and implementation support through workshops, analysis, and documentation. This is an engagement-based, time-and-materials advisory role rather than a traditional full-time position. Some Of What You'll Do Ground Truth (GT) Maintenance Assess current S3-based GT storage and versioning practices. Recommend and design a scalable GT management system supporting seamless, criteria-based (age, source, quality) replacement or updating of records at the record level, while preserving vital historical data needed for domain-specific classifiers. Evaluate migration toward a more structured storage solution (e.g., database-backed repository) to enable advanced filtering, automated quality/validation checks, and access by multiple downstream services. Provide implementation support or a prototype for automated GT refresh and validation processes tailored to the training pipelines. Model Quality Assurance and Validation Evaluate the current post-training assessment approach, including use of small live-data snapshots and empirical accuracy/degradation thresholds. Design and set up an independent integration testing framework using small, highly curated test datasets targeted to specific product requirements, run alongside the latest production data snapshots. Recommend additional quality checks, including methods to detect and quantify data distribution shifts (data drift) between historical GT blends and live production data. Define procedures and tools for ongoing model quality monitoring post-deployment. Re-training Automation Design and support implementation of a fully automated monthly re-training pipeline that ingests new material from the TC team and integrates with the updated GT management system. Recommend best practices for handling imbalanced datasets, including evaluation of privacy-aware, LLM-based synthetic data augmentation techniques where appropriate. Select and configure orchestration tooling (e.g., MLflow, Apache Airflow, or a custom system) to establish a formal, well-documented, and reproducible re-training process that reduces reliance on manual curation or any single individual. Integrate GT maintenance and model quality checks into the automated pipeline, and deliver comprehensive documentation, knowledge transfer, and handover. Program and Communication Participate in regular progress review meetings and provide periodic status updates against the agreed work plan and milestones. Maintain written documentation of issues, proposed solutions, and any agreed changes to scope or priorities. Track and report hours/effort weekly in accordance with time-reporting requirements. Experience, Education, And Certifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Demonstrated experience designing or operating machine learning data pipelines, including dataset versioning, storage, and validation practices. Hands-on experience with cloud object storage (e.g., AWS S3) and evaluating relational/NoSQL database-backed alternatives. Experience with ML orchestration/automation tools such as MLflow, Apache Airflow, or comparable platforms. Familiarity with model validation techniques, including drift detection and integration/regression testing for ML models. Additional Requirements Understanding of supervised learning workflows and Ground Truth dataset management at scale. Familiarity with privacy-conscious, LLM-based synthetic data generation approaches for addressing imbalanced datasets. Working knowledge of data quality and distribution-shift (data drift) monitoring methods. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, reproducible technical designs and runbooks. Good communication and analytical skills; able to work independently in an iterative, workshop-driven engagement. Ability to comply with client data-handling protocols and security requirements, …

items.desc: About Refractal Refractal is an AI security company building the infrastructure organisations need to defend against autonomous AI threats. 2026 has shown that generally capable intelligence is here. The challenge now is modernising security to stop AI-enabled threats, whether they come from internal agents going rogue or from attackers using AI to become more dangerous. Refractal was founded on cybersecurity and AI expertise from MIT, Microsoft, NASA and the U.S. Navy. Our product lets organisations detect AI-enabled threats at low cost without sacrificing detection quality. We take a practical approach to AI risk, combining proven cybersecurity methods with frontier AI security research. Today, we work with governments and organisations that can't afford to get security wrong. We're backed by leading deep-tech and cybersecurity investors and are growing the team to deliver on this mission. The role You'll connect Refractal to the security systems our customers already use, building the integrations and data pipelines that make their security data usable. You'll work closely with our security engineers and with customers to understand their environments and turn their requirements into reliable software. What you'll do Build and maintain integrations with security and observability tools, including platforms such as Splunk. Develop pipelines to ingest, validate and transform security data, accounting for inconsistent formats, incomplete records and changing source systems. Design clear interfaces between integrations and the wider product, working with platform engineers to keep responsibilities well defined. Make integrations reliable in production through testing, monitoring, useful error messages and safe handling of credentials and sensitive data. Investigate customer integration issues and turn recurring problems into product improvements, documentation and reusable implementation patterns. Success in your first six months You've shipped and supported priority integrations that customers can use with clear setup guidance. The data flows you own handle common failures predictably and make problems straightforward to diagnose. You've established reusable patterns that make the next integration easier to build and maintain. About you: essential Experience building and maintaining software, with a clear approach to testing, debugging and code review. Familiarity with data engineering concepts, including ingestion, transformation, data quality and pipeline reliability. Experience working with APIs and external systems, including authentication, pagination, rate limits and error handling. Ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and turn incomplete requirements into a practical implementation. Clear communication and a willingness to own work through deployment and ongoing support. Nice to have Experience integrating with Splunk or other SIEM and observability platforms. Familiarity with security telemetry, event schemas or detection workflows. Experience with high-volume data processing or customer-facing integration projects. Our values Radical transparency. We believe the best work happens when everyone feels able to give and receive honest, constructive feedback. Public service. We see AI security as a form of public service. Getting the AI transition right means putting the right infrastructure in place to manage the threats that come with it, and our work helps protect the institutions and services society depends on. Fail fast. We test ideas early, seek feedback and learn quickly. We experiment rapidly and change course when something isn't working, without compromising on security. Pragmatism, not dogmatism. We choose approaches based on how well they solve the problem. That means combining established cybersecurity methods with frontier AI research, questioning our assumptions, and changing our minds when the evidence changes. Compensation And Benefits Salary: £60,000–£115,000 Competitive equity to share in Refractal's growth Pension contribution Private medical and dental cover Visa and relocation support Compensation Range: £60K - £115K
