items.desc: Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. items.desc: Über CHAPTERS Group CHAPTERS Group ist eine börsennotierte deutsche Holding, die vertikale Softwareunternehmen erwirbt und hält. In den letzten fünf Jahren sind wir um das Zehnfache gewachsen und besitzen heute mehr als 60 Unternehmen. Jedes führt sein eigenes Geschäft, nah an seinen Kunden. Wir machen sie stärker, ohne ihnen das Steuer aus der Hand zu nehmen. KI ist eine der größten Chancen, die wir für sie sehen. Sie wirkt aber nur, wenn die Menschen in diesen Unternehmen sie auch nutzen. Die Rolle Du bist Teil des AI Core Teams im Office des CTO und arbeitest als Forward Deployed Engineer nah an den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Du betreibst unseren AI Hub, eine Open WebUI-basierte KI-Plattform, für mehr als 10 Unternehmen. Du bringst mit, was du im Feld siehst, testest neue Fähigkeiten und gestaltest die Plattform für alle 60+ Unternehmen mit. Deutsch (C1+) und Englisch sind Pflicht. Was du machst Den AI Hub für 10+ Unternehmen betreiben: Deployments, Updates, Konfiguration, SSO mit Entra ID, Monitoring, Backups und Incident Handling Unternehmen und Teams onboarden: Skills, Knowledge Bases und Tools einrichten, damit jedes Unternehmen produktiv mit dem Hub arbeitet Technische Ansprechperson sein: Wenn etwas ausfällt oder ein Champion nicht weiterkommt, analysierst und behebst du das. Wiederkehrende Probleme dokumentierst du, damit sie nur einmal gelöst werden müssen. Den Hub anbinden, wo ein Use Case es braucht: Microsoft 365 / Graph, CRM, Ticketing und ERP-Systeme über Tools, MCP-Server und REST-APIs Wiederkehrende Fragen in wiederverwendbare Bausteine verwandeln: Dokumentation, Vorlagen und kurze Hands-on-Sessions Im AI Core Team arbeiten: Muster über Unternehmen hinweg teilen, neue Features testen und Erkenntnisse in die Plattform-Roadmap einspeisen Gelegentlich das M&A-Team unterstützen (etwa 10 bis 20% deiner Zeit) bei technischen Fragen, zum Beispiel bei der Bewertung des Tech- und AI-Stacks von Übernahmekandidaten Das bringst du mit Deutsch (C1 oder höher) und fließend Englisch. Du arbeitest täglich auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführern und nicht-technischen Teams. Hier machen wir keine Ausnahmen. Erfahrung im Produktivbetrieb. Du hast containerisierte Anwendungen produktiv deployt und betrieben (Docker, CI/CD, Linux, eine große Cloud, Azure bevorzugt) und warst verantwortlich, wenn sie ausgefallen sind. Das heißt meist mindestens 2 Jahre in einer DevOps-, Platform-, SRE- oder Backend-Rolle. Python, das du sicher lesen, debuggen und erweitern kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs. Du nutzt sie im eigenen Arbeitsalltag ernsthaft, hast beruflich oder privat etwas damit gebaut und weißt, wo sie scheitern. Du erklärst Technik so, dass Nicht-Techniker sie verstehen und danach handeln können. Du bist gern die technische Ansprechperson für Teams ohne technischen Hintergrund. Starke Signale Enterprise Identity: Entra ID, OAuth, SSO. Selbst gehostete LLM-Plattformen wie Open WebUI oder LibreChat. MCP, Tool Calling, Agent-Frameworks. Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform). Erfahrung in einer Support-, Solutions- oder kundennahen technischen Rolle. Erfahrung in der Arbeit über mehrere Unternehmen, Tenants oder eine Gruppenstruktur hinweg. Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du den Großteil deiner Zeit damit verbringen willst, neue AI-Produkte von Grund auf zu bauen ML-Forschung oder Modelltraining suchst nur mit Engineers arbeiten und direkten Kontakt mit Fachbereichen vermeiden willst. Das bekommst du Echte Verantwortung: 10+ Unternehmen, eine Plattform, und du sorgst dafür, dass KI dort funktioniert. Ein kleines AI Core Team mit direktem Draht zum C-Level. Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Wirkung über deine Plattform hinaus: Was in deinen Unternehmen funktioniert, wird Standard für 55+. Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle , Remote-first mit gelegentlichen Präsenzterminen. Entwicklung: Talent Reviews, Events und Konferenzen. Wir stellen Leute ein, die mit uns wachsen wollen.

items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 The Internationalisation team builds the platform that helps Stripe products work naturally across languages and markets. We create and operate the infrastructure that enables Stripe teams to localize product interfaces, services, and written communications while delivering consistent, high-quality experiences to users around the world.
 We work closely with our sister Localization team and its language experts, as well as with product and service engineering teams integrating localized content. Together, we combine engineering, automation, and linguistic expertise to help Stripe build products that feel native to each market.
 What you’ll do
 You will design, implement, and maintain Stripe’s internationalisation platform at scale, including the developer and user experiences around it. You’ll help teams continuously localize their products while improving the quality, speed, reliability, and efficiency of Stripe’s localization processes.
 This role combines backend and platform engineering with emerging LLM technology. Depending on the project, you may build end-to-end functionality for internal customers, evolve production LLM systems, develop quality-evaluation capabilities, improve platform reliability and observability, or lead migrations from legacy localization infrastructure.
 Responsibilities
 Design and build internationalisation infrastructure that supports diverse content surfaces, including backend services, product interfaces, and written communications.
 Integrate localization into Stripe’s software-development and content-production workflows, enabling teams to ship translated experiences continuously and safely.

 The Position
 As an Observability DevOps Engineer within our Digital Operations and Reliability team, you optimize and automate the deployment and management of platform and cloud-based services. In this role, you drive cost-effectiveness, scalability, and security throughout the digital product lifecycle. You collaborate with a global team to evolve our systems from reactive troubleshooting to proactive site reliability engineering, accelerating developer velocity and reducing system downtime to deliver seamless healthcare solutions. 
 Your Responsibilities 
 Automate Software Delivery: Drive the design, implementation, and maintenance of efficient Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software deployments. 
 Manage Infrastructure as Code: Deploy and manage application underlying infrastructure using modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and maintain stable, version-controlled configurations. 
 Embed Observability Frameworks: Implement robust monitoring and observability solutions (such as Grafana Cloud) to measure and optimize the availability, scalability, and performance of software platforms. 
 Integrate Lifecycle Security: Drive the adoption of DevSecOps practices by implementing security controls and infrastructure hardening throughout the development and deployment cycles. 
 Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architects and developers to translate high-level product strategies and business requirements into concrete development tasks. 
 Foster Technical Innovation: Stay at the forefront of industry trends and emerging technologies, keeping documentation clear and providing technical mentorship to engineering colleagues. 
 Who You Are 
 You are a proactive, growth-minded engineer who thrives on solving complex, ambiguous technical challenges and enjoys sharing knowledge within an international team environment. 
 Professional Experience: You bring 3 to 7 years of experience in the software development lifecycle, preferably within a multinational or healthcare corporate environment, backed by a technical degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 CI/CD & Source Code Expertise: You demonstrate strong hands-on experience with source code management tools (such as GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring automated deployment pipelines. 
 Infrastructure & Cloud Capabilities: You hold practical knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and configuration management tools (such as Terraform, Ansible, Vault, or Consul) along with experience in containers or Kubernetes environments. 
 Monitoring & Observability Proficiency: You possess a solid understanding of centralized observability and monitoring systems (such as Grafana Cloud, Splunk, or LogicMonitor). 
 Communication & Collaboration: You bring essential effective oral and written communication skills in English, with the flexibility to work effectively across multiple time zones and travel occasionally. 
 At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together. 
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Where every single person within the organisation is aligned to one main motivating force, that at the centre of everything they do, and their number one priority; are patients. A place that gives every individual the autonomy and empowerment to make a difference, where you are not defined by a job title. Imagine waking up every morning feeling fulfilled, having purpose and meaning in your work.
 Imagine you are at Roche.
 We are a pioneer in pharmaceuticals, advancing science to help people in the UK live longer and healthier lives. For over 120 years we have created truly differentiated medicines for cancer, the immune system, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. 
 We work from bench to bedside - researching new medicines, running global clinical trials, and collaborating with the NHS to try to ensure rapid uptake and delivery of our products and services. Our drive, every day, is to ensure our medicines reach those who need them as soon as possible.
 None of this would be possible without our extraordinary employees; our people make our business. We offer inspirational opportunities for employees that are as unique as they are. We have created an inclusive, respectful work environment where people can be authentic and truly invested in their work, a place to belong. Our outstanding commitment to workplace engagement has recently been recognised by our inclusion at number four on the Sunday Times Top 25 Best Big Companies to Work
 Health Economics, Health Outcomes & Medical Writing Partner - Medical/HTA Writer 
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Medical/HTA Writer to work as part of the Health Economics, Health Outcomes, Pricing and Writing team.
 The team works together with the affiliate and the NHS to deliver transformative access for innovative solutions and to support creation of a sustainable healthcare system.
 The Medical/HTA Writer has a key role in gaining reimbursement for Roche’s innovative medicines. Working with the Health Economist and Medical Partner, the HTA Writer helps shape the access strategy, write the reimbursement submission dossier to the relevant HTA authority, and provide continued support throughout the remainder of the process, with the aim of achieving a positive recommendation. 
 An outstanding communicator, you will have experience of writing and delivering effective communications strategies to ensure key clinical messages resonate with decision makers
 Medical Writer: Expectations
 Support the development of HTA strategy for prioritised therapeutic areas and products
 Support all aspects of the HTA appraisal process: Attending and preparing minutes of HTA focussed advisory boards
 Develop and deliver high quality submissions to national and local health technology assessment organisations, such as NICE, SMC and AWMSG to achieve positive recommendations - focussed on the clinical aspects of the submissions
 Collaborate with health economists and medical affairs partners in delivering high quality responses for the remainder of the HTA: clarification questions, technical engagement, NDC response etc
 Develop and deliver high quality conference abstracts, posters and manuscripts for prioritised therapeutic areas and products
 Provide subject matter expertise and strategic input to cross-portfolio and cross-chapter initiatives, with a balance between solutions, constructive challenge, & support of agreed objectives

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
The Drug Safety Scientist is a member of the Drug Safety & Risk Management (DS&RM) team, supporting proactive safety surveillance and risk management activities. The Drug Safety Scientist performs pharmacovigilance activities and prepares high-quality, submission-ready regulatory and safety documents within established timelines and in compliance with GE HealthCare business requirements, standard operating procedures, and applicable global and local regulatory requirements. 
The role provides scientific support to Medical Directors for the assessment of safety data from clinical trials and post-marketing experience and supports the EU QPPV in maintaining inspection readiness. Daily activities involve planning, conducting meetings, database searching, aggregate safety analysis and case level review, writing, and project management/coordination of strategic safety documents including aggregate reports (including PSURs/PBRERs, PADERs, IND-related reports, and DSURs). The Drug Safety Scientist partners closely with Medical Directors, the QPPV, internal cross-functional stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure timely and effective delivery of safety surveillance and risk management activities.
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
 Job Description 
 Primary responsibilities 
 Performs safety signal detection and evaluation using safety data and analytical tools to identify and assess potential signals, authors safety review documentation, and partners with cross-functional Safety Review Teams to develop data-driven recommendations and actions.
 Apply data analytics and visualization tools to create and interpret trending analyses, investigate significant changes in reporting patterns, and communicate actionable safety insights
 Authors, reviews, and coordinates high-quality safety content for clinical development and post-marketing regulatory documents, including clinical study protocols, DSURs, RMPs, Safety
 Management Plans, clinical study reports, PSURs/PBRERs, and medical expert statements.
 Gathers, analyzes, and evaluates relevant scientific and safety information to support the development and maintenance of reference safety information within Company Core Documents, including the CCDS and CCSI.
 Collaborates with PV Scientists and Medical Directors to provide scientific and medical input to responses to safety-related questions from regulatory authorities.
 Prepares or facilitates writing of accurate, medically sound and submission ready statements, safety assessments and benefit-risk evaluations within agreed time frames.
 Performs Medical Reviewer of Individual Case Safety Reports.
 Serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Global Pharmacovigilance and cross-functional teams on applicable ICH, EU, US, and other international clinical and post-marketing safety regulations, guidelines, and product-specific safety information.
 Other activities, special projects and assignments may be assigned where required. As a result, the percentage of time spent across roles for which the employee is responsible for or assisting others will vary depending on project assignments and the requirements within the department.
 Assist in creating and maintaining standard operating procedures and working practices to ensure inspection readiness and compliance with regulations and guidelines.
 Specific Qualifications: 
 Experience in drug safety risk management and pharmacovigilance (safety signal detection, data mining techniques, preparation risk management plans, aggregate reports and company core safety information). Relevant experience in clinical development or medical affairs in industry or with service provider will be considered.
 Highest Level of Education achieved : 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, Business/Data Analytics, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related healthcare discipline.
 Required Competence/Work Experience/Skills: 
 Working knowledge in FDA, EU, ICH guidelines, initiatives and regulations governing pharmacovigilance.
 Minimum of 3+ years of validated experience working in safety &/or scientific activities in at least 3 of the following areas: Post-Marketing Surveillance (including signal detection & evaluation). Periodic Safety Reports (deliver strategy, preparation and authoring), DSURs, INDs, including data analysis
 Knowledge of safety systems (Argus & Veeva)

 Good medical writing skills and ability to analyse safety data.
 Good communication skills.

 Strong ability to leverage AI and emerging digital tools to improve data analysis, automation, and operational efficiency.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Aircraft Control - Test engineer (f/m) to join our Control Modelling, Simulation & V&V department based in Toulouse, France. 
 ​You will be part of an integrated team and will work collaboratively with system designer teams and V&V test teams to coordinate the maturity testing activities of Aircraft control systems (Auto-flight ATA22, Flight Control ATA27) on a simulated platform (VSIM-D) on one or several programs. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 You will be part of a supportive team who will support you upon your arrival with a specific learning path and all along your journey with us. 
 This position will offer the opportunity to discover/extend your knowledge on Aircraft Control systems and their development working in close collaboration with the designers. 
 The maturity tests are an essential step in the V&V process to ensure maturity of the final products. They allow testing and identifying/correcting potential defects in early stages of the development before the official test campaign. 
 Your challenges: 
 Prepare, perform Tests and associated analysis and investigation on simulated platform 
 Coordinate maturity tests activity on simulated platform: testing roadmap, workload estimation, test results report all along the development and for the dedicated milestones (ex: Flight Clearance) 
 Work in close collaboration with Design team and other testing teams 
 Participate to Testing tools development: Define & update Testing Tools needs, follow-up development and validation 
 Define, update and validate Testing Usage Domain 
 Support V&V manager/leader activities 
 Your boarding pass: 
 System Design and Development 
 Aircraft Control System knowledge 
 Test execution 
 Negotiation level of English (+ French will be a strong additional asset) 
 Knowledge which would facilitate job mission: 
 V&V Referentials (ARP4754, DO178 …) 
 Requirements and V&V management process 
 Required-based / Model-based engineering process (RBE/MBE) 
 Configuration process (GIT) 
 Change process (JIRA, Trackdev) 
 Designers evidences / documents 
 SAO/SCADE/SQUID-NG process 
 Tests management (MAGIC, LTM, JIRA XRAY, FTA-NG …) 
 DevOps 
 Test means (VSIM-D, SIMPA/OSMA, A/C 0 …) 
 This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung der Abteilung Test Means sucht Airbus Operations eine/n: 
 Electrical Lab Test Means Design & Build Engineer (d/f/m) 
 Als Lab Test Means Designer sind Sie verantwortlich für den Entwurf, die Spezifikation, Realisierung und Verifizierung der elektrischen Komponenten unserer Labor-Testeinrichtungen. Diese Prüfeinrichtungen werden später von Testingenieuren, Testpiloten und weiteren Kunden genutzt, um neue Flugzeugsysteme oder -funktionen zu integrieren und zu validieren. Wir decken alle Arten von Laborprüfständen ab – von Avionik- und mechanisch-physikalisch-hydraulischen Prüfständen bis hin zu virtuellen Plattformen. 
 Dein Standort 
 Bremen ist eine charmante, geschichtsträchtige Stadt im Nordwesten von Deutschland. Sie ist nicht nur eine der grünsten Städte des Landes, sondern bietet auch wunderbare Sehenswürdigkeiten, eine reiche Kultur, urbanes Flair und kulinarische Köstlichkeiten. Die Stadt ist auch ein großartiger Ort für Küstenliebhaber, da sie nur eine Autostunde von der Nordseeküste entfernt liegt. 
 Unsere Benefits für dich 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Sie dimensionieren und konzipieren neue Prüfeinrichtungen und -komponenten oder modifizieren und modernisieren bestehende Prüfstände, um auf Änderungen an den Flugzeugsystemen von Airbus zu reagieren. 
 Sie erarbeiten technische Lösungen sowie Konzepte, wenden elektrotechnische Konstruktionsprinzipien und Vorschriften an und stellen eine termingerechte, kosteneffiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung sicher. 
 In Zusammenarbeit mit einer internationalen Abteilung an den Standorten Hamburg, Bremen, Toulouse und Filton integrieren Sie Technologien aus Forschungsprojekten in bestehende und neue Testanlagen – beispielsweise standardisierte Protokolle zur Kopplung von Prüfeinrichtungen, umfangreiche Tools zur Datenerfassung und -analyse, virtuelle Testumgebungen usw. 
 Sie leiten elektrische Designanforderungen und -lösungen aus Flugzeugspezifikationen und Systemtestanforderungen ab. 
 Sie erstellen technische Spezifikationen für Zukaufteile, unterstützen die Beschaffung und überwachen die Leistung der Lieferanten. 
 Sie tragen zur digitalen Transformation von Airbus bei, indem Sie neue Komponenten und Technologien einführen sowie bestehende Tools und Ressourcen anpassen. 
 Sie unterstützen den laufenden Betrieb der Prüfstände und übernehmen die Fehlersuche und -behebung (Troubleshooting). 
 Gewünschte Qualifikationen und Kenntnisse 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder vergleichbar – oder eine äquivalente Berufserfahrung / Qualifikation als Meistertechniker bzw. Industriemeister 
 Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Elektriker/Elektroniker ist von Vorteil 
 Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Arbeit an elektrischen Anlagen 
 Erfahrung in Architektur, Design und Aufbau von Labor-Testmitteln (Lab Test Means) 
 Erfahrung in der Fehlersuche, Störungsbeseitigung und Fehlerursachenanalyse 
 Vertrautheit mit Vorschriften und Normen wie DGUV, VDE-Richtlinien und europäischen Richtlinien 
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus 
 Freude an der Arbeit in einem agilen, dynamischen Umfeld 
 Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen nach Hamburg 
 Hohe Eigenmotivation, Engagement und eine proaktive Arbeitsweise 
 Erfüllen Sie nicht jedes Kriterium zu 100%? Kein Problem! Airbus fördert Ihr persönliches Wachstum mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungsangeboten. 
 Bringen Sie Ihre Karriere auf das nächste Level und bewerben Sie sich jetzt online!

Job Description: 
 Responsibilities - your mission 
 This position is in the Airline Operations Intelligence team whose main mission is to gather airline operational data from multiple sources, transform and augment it. It is then delivered to the Airbus internal departments such as aircraft program, engineering, marketing and strategy either as data products, or as reports or as dashboards. The quantity of data is in the big data perimeter with billions of data lines being analyzed.
 Your contribution will need to be perfectly in line with the project guidelines and ways of working. 
 You will create/maintain/optimise data pipelines, respecting state of the art practice. 
 You will create/maintain/optimise BI dashboards 
 You will create/maintain/optimize AI agents. 
 Most of your developments will be done on the Skywise/Palantir Foundry platform. 
 This role requires a very good understanding of distributed computations, data architecture and state of the art data engineering. 
 You will be joining a team of developers organised in Agile Scrum. 
 Your initiatives, reliability and ability to drive the project with your colleagues will determine your responsibilities and scopes over the years as we are flexible with these 
 Requirements - our ideal candidate will have 
 A master degree in engineering or computer science. 
 Several years (3+) of working experience as a data engineer with proven records of enormous data volume manipulation. 
 Excellent level in Python, pySpark and distributed computation. 
 Excellent understanding of AI solutions 
 Good understanding of time series processing 
 Qualifications/experience/knowledge of the airline industry is a major advantage. 
 Qualifications/experience/knowledge of data science is a major advantage. 
 English must be fluent. 
 We are looking for a candidate that is reliable and delivers without multiple reminders, that we can trust in sharing success but also difficulties and mistakes, that is willing to drive and take initiatives and share their knowledge. We are also looking for someone that values colleagues for their strengths. We also value very much the behaviour in a team including ability to contribute to a nice to work in atmosphere, to help colleagues and constructively push the team to improve. 
 Benefits - what’s in it for you 
 The chance to work in a multicultural environment. 
 The opportunity to grow your skills and capabilities thanks to our Airbus learning offer (digital solutions, classroom sessions, certified training....) and career opportunities across the globe. 
 A hybrid working model, allowing you to combine onsite and offsite work.

 A motivated and fun crew to grow and build and shape the GBS together. 
 An intense and exciting onboarding experience. 
 Work in a balanced environment: Beyond the many benefits offered to its employees, joining Airbus is also the guarantee of a respectable work-life balance. Job Description: 
 An opportunity for an Electrical & Wiring Manufacturing Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space , Getafe (Madrid). 
 The selected candidate will join the Manufacturing Engineering (ME) Team within the MRTT (Multi Role Tanker Transport) Program . Our multidisciplinary engineering team interfaces directly between Design Office and Production, driving the industrial conversion of civil A330-200 aircraft into world-class tanker variants across all MRTT Final Assembly Lines (FALs). 
 You will reinforce our industrialization and shop-floor enablement activities, playing a decisive role in defining robust industrial sequences, testing solutions, and technical dossier creation for electrical harnesses, wiring installations, and aircraft systems. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Industrialize Electrical & Wiring Dossiers: Define and deliver integrated Manufacturing Dossiers, technical wiring check job cards, and work orders across Series, Retrofit, Working Parties, and FTB (Flight Test Bed) aircraft. 
 Lead Production & Workshop Enablement: Support the electrical workshop (TPAP) and aircraft assembly lines (AG-2) with harness and control unit reworks, off-aircraft/on-aircraft troubleshooting, and automated wiring test data generation. 
 Resolve Technical Nonconformities (NCs): Investigate shop-floor discrepancies, author actionable nonconformity resolutions (HNCs), track design engineering changes (ERCs), and implement corrective job cards to eliminate bottlenecks. 
 Define Test Tooling & Industrial Means: Specify, adapt, and validate electrical test equipment, tooling, and PDU emissions in direct collaboration with the Test Means department. 
 Drive Design-to-Manufacturing Concurrence: Partner with the Design Office and external suppliers in model revisions (including F927 and wiring reviews) to integrate industrial constraints early into product definitions. 
 Foster Continuous Improvement & EHS: Implement Lean manufacturing standards, line balancing, and digital tool optimization, actively participating in SQCDP panels while strictly upholding environmental, health, and safety regulations. 
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you: 
 Education: Aerospace, Telecommunications or Industrial Engineering degree,with deep knowledge of electrical systems/installations. 
 Experience: At least 2-3 years of proven experience in Manufacturing Engineering specialised in wiring, within the aerospace, defense, automotive, or naval sectors. 
 Soft skills: Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset across cross-functional organizations, positive and constructive approach to conflict resolution, accountability, and strong KPI/performance focus. 
 Highly motivated, proactive, and result-oriented mindset , with a strong enthusiasm and commitment to the role. 
 Languages: Advanced / Professional lev el in English & Spanish (both written & spoken). 
 Technical knowledge: In-depth understanding of manufacturing and wiring processes, Lean Manufacturing principles, and root-cause analysis methodologies. Proficiency in CAD/CAM and engineering tools (such as CATIA, SAP, EPD, Sidie, or SNT or similar). 
 Valuable / Nice to have: Previous manufacturing engineering experience in electrical systems or EWIS within the aerospace industry. 
 Working knowledge of automated continuity measurement systems and electrical test equipment. 
 Hybrid working model: On-site presence is essential for this role due to close collaboration with manufacturing operations; remote work is limited to a maximum of 1 fixed day per week , agreed upon with the manager. 
 WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? 
 At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: 
 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. 
 Attractive salary. 
 Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance. 
 Collective transport service in some sites. 
 Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. 
 On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. 
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. 
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. 
 Special rates in products & benefits.

Job Description: 
 In order to support our structure development team, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for an 
 Airframe Design Approver (d/f/m) 
 Are you motivated to work in an international environment where collaboration is key? Here, you will be part of our dedicated team of development engineers in the fuselage area for the primary/secondary structure of all our commercial Airbus aircraft programs and their derivatives. You will therefore be involved with your expertise from the concept study through detailed design to certification. 
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks. 
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Guarantee product quality and airworthiness by taking full responsibility for design approval according to established processes 
 Develop and optimize metal, composite, and hybrid components and assemblies with regard to weight, cost, performance, manufacturing, and assembly requirements. 
 Collaborate in multifunctional teams alongside structural analysis, production, program, project, configuration, and systems functions to achieve optimal technical solutions. 
 Evaluate design changes, estimate implementation efforts, and ensure full compliance with regulations, design principles, and guidelines. 
 Manage engineering partner and supplier activities, serving as their key technical contact. 
 Drive digitalization and automation innovations actively, taking all relevant regulations and stakeholders into account. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering (or a related discipline), or equivalent practical experience
 Initial experience in structural design 
 Solid understanding of metal, composite, and hybrid design principles, including manufacturing/assembly requirements and tolerance definition. 
 Practical knowledge in project management and motivation to work with agile methodologies. 
 Hands-on proficiency with CATIA V5, VPM and a PLM tool. 
 Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills to align diverse stakeholders, foster continuous improvement, and achieve team goals. Interest in both detailed work and the big picture.

items.desc:
Lieu : Toulouse, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Votre destination pour une maîtrise totale du ciel ! De la conception à l'installation, nous créons des systèmes de contrôle aérien de pointe ! Nous rendons l'accès à l'espace aérien fluide, équitable et durable. 
 Les orages ont un impact majeur sur la circulation aérienne. Lorsqu’un avion contourne une cellule orageuse, il quitte sa trajectoire prévue et augmente la charge de travail des contrôleurs aériens. Dans ce contexte, vous contribuez au développement d’un outil de prévision permettant d’anticiper les situations de surcharge des contrôleurs afin d’aider les responsables opérationnels à prendre les mesures adaptées. 
 En nous rejoignant, vos missions sont : 
 Modélisez les cellules orageuses et leur évolution temporelle dans un secteur de contrôle,
 Intégrez des données de trafic réel et les trajectoires des vols dans le modèle développé,
 Identifiez les vols susceptibles de modifier leur route pour contourner les zones orageuses,
 Analysez l’impact des déroutements sur la charge de travail des contrôleurs aériens,
 Évaluez les situations de surcharge et contribuez à l’amélioration des capacités d’anticipation opérationnelle. 
 Votre profil 
 Vous souhaitez effectuer un stage d'une durée de 6 mois minimum. Vous effectuez une formation de niveau Bac+5 en école d’ingénieur ou en formation universitaire de niveau Master 2, à dominante informatique ou intelligence artificielle.
 Vous avez des compétences en :
 Développement logiciel
 Modélisation algorithmique
 Intelligence artificielle
 Analyse de données
 Autonomie, rigueur, bon relationnel et curiosité technique sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnaît ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! 
 Mot de l'équipe 
 Vous serez intégré au sein d’une équipe polyvalente qui regroupe des expertises métiers et techniques.
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
About the job 
 Make global business travel simpler for colleagues, candidates and guests, balancing individual needs with company policy. As a Corporate Travel Coordinator in Bristol, you’ll provide hands-on support across Graphcore’s global travel operations.
 You’ll help employees and guests arrange journeys through our online booking tool and offline travel agents. Well-organised travel for candidates and new joiners will help create a positive first impression of Graphcore. You’ll also coordinate group travel that brings colleagues together for company events. Day to day, you’ll answer visa questions, arrange airport transfers and manage travel expense approvals. You’ll support the Travel Manager with ad-hoc projects and initiatives.
 Beyond travel, you’ll support the wider Chief Financial Officer’s team with administrative tasks. You’ll book training courses, support onboarding and help our Graphcare committee.
 The team and culture 
 You’ll join a growing travel team, supporting colleagues through the shared Travel inbox and Slack. You’ll take ownership of requests, respond promptly and use calm judgement when priorities change.
 You’ll stay informed about travel trends, policies and global mobility updates. Professional development and learning resources will help you build your skills.
 What we’re looking for 
 At least two years’ experience in a similar travel coordination support role in business travel and travel support.
 Calm judgement under pressure and the ability to adapt when travel plans or priorities change.
 Clear, empathetic and professional communication, with a focus on travellers’ needs.
 Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and a willingness to learn travel booking tools.
 A proactive approach to teamwork, with the confidence to make decisions and take responsibility.
 Benefits 
 Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
 Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
 Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
 Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
 Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
 Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
 Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
 Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Sponsorship 
 Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.
 Access to controlled technology 
 Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.
 Join the Team at Graphcore 
 Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
 As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.
 Put your coordination skills to work keeping Graphcore’s global teams moving. Apply now to join our travel team in Bristol.

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.
 The day-to-day
 Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.
 Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.
 Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
 Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.
 Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.
 Participate in design reviews, contributing innovative solutions and improvements.
 Conduct simulations, stress analysis, and FEA to ensure reliability, durability, and safety of the designs.
 Provide technical support and troubleshooting during product development and manufacturing processes.
 Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.
 You should apply if you 
 Hold a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master’s preferred).
 Have demonstrated of experience in mechanical design, preferably in robotics or automation.
 Are proficiency with CAD software (ideally SolidWorks).
 Have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, including statics, dynamics, and material properties.
 Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.
 Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.
 Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.
 Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
 Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
 Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 …

items.desc:
This is a graduate position within the QUEST programme, funded by the EOSC4ALL project of the European Commission. It is open to recent graduates in computer science, engineering or a related field. You do not need to tick every box or have every skill listed below, if you are motivated to learn, we encourage you to apply.
 Join CERN's Storage and Data Management Group and help evolve the storage systems behind the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), while learning large-scale storage, cloud-native technologies and open-source software with the support of an experienced team.
 You will work on CERNBox, the cloud storage used by the whole CERN community, from scientists to administrative staff. Your main task is to help make it interoperable with research infrastructures across Europe, through the Open Cloud Mesh (OCM) standard, and easy to deploy anywhere using Kubernetes. You will also explore how AI can help users find and use their data.
 If you enjoy open standards, open source and building tools that many institutions can adopt, this is the place for you! You will be supported by experienced colleagues and learn from the whole team.

 Develop and integrate backend and frontend software components.
 Package and deploy interoperable services in distributed environments.

Como tramitador de recobros de riesgos diversos (Hogar y Comercio), la persona seleccionada se responsabilizará la gestión de los siniestros susceptibles de ser recobrados o reclamados por las Compañías contrarias, siguiendo los protocolos establecidos para garantizar que los siniestros se gestionan de la forma más eficaz y eficiente, al mismo tiempo que se presta un servicio de siniestros centrado en el cliente.

 Revisión del siniestro, labores de detección del causante y lanzamiento del recobro.

 Tramitación de recobros a través del convenio SGR.
 Gestión de siniestros recobrables NO CONVENIO.
 Gestionar el recobro de indemnizaciones de Compañías contrarias.
 Trasladar instrucciones al proveedor y velar su cumplimiento.
 Detectar y resolver problemas consultando las políticas, procedimientos y estándares para garantizar la coherencia y calidad de las soluciones.
 Interrelación con distintas áreas del equipo con el fin de garantizar una correcta gestión de los expedientes.
 Contribuir a los esfuerzos del equipo, participando en los proyectos y tareas, para que el proveedor ofrezca a nuestros clientes una gestión de los siniestros óptima y se vea reflejado en los resultados de calidad de la Compañía.
 Estudio de los protocolos y normativas establecidas y plantear, en su caso, mejoras de estos.
 Proponer también ideas para mejorar la simplificación de procesos o de cualquier otro aspecto que aporte valor.
 Tus habilidades y experiencias 
 Esperamos que la persona que se incorpore en el equipo reúna las siguientes habilidades y experiencias:
 Licenciatura / Grado en Administración de empresas, económicas, derecho o similares.
 Experiencia demostrada de al menos 2 años en recobros a través del convenio SGR y en tramitación de recobros NO CONVENIO.
 Experiencia en herramientas de Office 365.
 Proactividad en la toma de decisiones, orientación al cliente y resolución de problemas.
 Habilidades comunicativas, relacionales y de trabajo en equipo.
 Capacidad de planificación, adaptabilidad y flexibilidad, y gestión del estrés.

items.desc:
Job Summary 
 Zurich Insurance Europe AG is looking for a Personal Lines Agent in Wexford to join on a 12 month fixed term contract. 
 The role itself will focus on understanding what matters to Zurich customers; Meeting customer demands is a key part of our roles. 
Zurich offers you the ability to expand your knowledge base and create a career within General Insurance. 
 This role may be available part-time or full time. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need. 
 Your Role 
 As a Personal Lines Agent your main responsibilities will include, but not necessarily be limited to, the following: 
 -Deliver telephone-based support to customers on all aspects of general insurance underwriting 
 -Respond to customer queries relating to our products (home, motor & van) in a timely and efficient manner – striving to exceed quality customer service 
 -Retain current customers in line with challenging business targets 
 -Identify upsell opportunities for additional policy benefits 
 -Contact targeted renewals to drive retention targets 
 -Build rapport & relationship with our potential and existing customers 
 -Identify cross-selling prospects for additional products and arrange follow-up calls with customers for future sales opportunities 
 -Focus on the achievement of challenging service levels with customer centricity crucial to all processes 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 As a Personal Lines Agent your skills and qualifications will include: 
 -Excellent phone manner & communication skills 
 -Good IT Skills (use of MS Office Products) 
 -Minimum of 2 H5's or higher level C3's in the Leaving Certificate (or equivalent) or Third Level Qualification (minimum level 6 standard) or relevant work experience Experience in similar work environment – dealing with customers 
 -Experience within the insurance industry would be an advantage 
 -Completed or be in the process of completing CIP as a minimum and / or ACII qualification 
 -Demonstrate excellent verbal & written communication skills 
 -Have attention to details, ability to interpret data and ability to follow work through 
 -Have the ability to prioritise and manage own work while considering the greater impact on the team 
 -Have an enthusiastic, professional, positive and flexible approach that includes the ability to self-motivate 
 -Build rapport with our customers quickly & put the customer at the centre of everything we do 
 -Be resilient in the nature of our work and adapt to changing conditions 
 -Have good negotiation skills to close renewal offer & be target focused. 
 -Have quick learning capabilities and an aptitude for understanding the variable elements of insurance products 
 -Demonstrate solution focus in approach to work and dealing with stakeholders 
 Additional Information 
 Position is Wexford-based but occasional travel may be required to other Zurich locations. 
 If you value an exciting and varied working environment and meet the above requirements, then our recruiter is looking forward to receiving your application by clicking on the button “Apply online”. 
 Who We Are 
 Zurich is one of Ireland's leading insurance companies providing a wide range of general insurance and life insurance products and services. The company employs over 1,000 people across its locations in Dublin and Wexford. 
 Zurich is a strong brand – with our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, helping our customers in 210 countries and territories to understand and protect themselves from risk. In order to deliver our services, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting opportunities for further training & development. As a Zurich employee you benefit from a multitude of advantages as well as a strong culture, characterized by acceptance, diversity and team spirit. 
 At Zurich, we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our purpose and values are designed to protect, inspire confidence and help our employees reach their full potential. We value and defend what is right and promote opportunities for equity among our professionals, regardless of gender, disability, LGBTQ +, race, ethnicity, generations, belief, etc. Join Zurich and be part of this culture. Together we are committed to delivering on our purpose - Let’s Create a Brighter Future Together!

Ils·Elles
items.desc:
Mission
 Avec plus de 100 apprenti·es en formation dans une douzaine de professions, l’EPFL est une entreprise formatrice à part entière.
Quel que soit l’apprentissage choisi à l’EPFL, les apprenti·es réalisent leur formation professionnelle dans un environnement hors du commun composé de laboratoires de recherche dans des domaines aussi variés que l’ingénierie, les sciences exactes et l’architecture. Ils·Elles bénéficient de tout le dynamisme et la diversité d’un campus universitaire qui leur offre de nombreuses perspectives, d’avantages et possibilités d’épanouissement personnel.
 À l’École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), vous avez la possibilité de vous lancer dans un apprentissage passionnant dans le domaine de l’automatisation, comme automaticienne ou automaticien. 
 🎥 Rencontre avec Maël, apprenti Lab 
 Principales tâches et responsabilités
 À l’EPFL, l’apprentie automaticienne ou l'apprenti automaticien découvrira un métier complet mêlant mécanique, électronique et informatique industrielle. Il ou elle participera à la fabrication de pièces mécaniques, aussi bien par usinage manuel que sur machines-outils. La formation comprendra également le câblage et le montage de platines électriques, ainsi que l’installation, la mise en service et le dépannage de machines automatisées, notamment de robots et de systèmes robotisés.
L’apprenti·e sera amené·e à concevoir des composants mécaniques et à réaliser des prototypes à l’aide d’outils de modélisation 3D (CAO) et d’impression 3D. Il ou elle développera et programmera des automates industriels (PLC) et participera à l’intégration de systèmes automatisés spécialisés, incluant des capteurs intelligents, des entraînements électriques et des robots.
Au fil de sa formation, l’apprenti·e apprendra à analyser le fonctionnement global d’une installation, à diagnostiquer et corriger des pannes, à optimiser les performances et à appliquer les normes de sécurité et de qualité.
L’environnement de travail est innovant et en constante évolution, au cœur de la recherche de pointe. L’automatisation progressant rapidement, l’apprenti·e aura l’opportunité de se familiariser avec les technologies émergentes tout en développant des compétences concrètes, interdisciplinaires et très recherchées dans un secteur passionnant et tourné vers l’avenir.
 Cette année, nous publions une place d'apprentissage dans l’atelier SV-IN (School of Life Sciences – Infrastructure) – L’atelier SV-IN assure la maintenance, la réparation et le suivi technique des équipements scientifiques de la Faculté des sciences de la vie (SV) de l’EPFL - https://www.epfl.ch/schools/sv/sv-in/ 
 Profil
 Afin de compléter la procédure de postulation, merci d'ajouter à votre postulation : 
 lettre de motivation
 curriculum vitae avec indication de références
 copie de vos bulletins scolaires des 3-4 derniers semestres
 copies de vos certificats, diplômes obtenus, attestations de stages
 Nous offrons
 En devenant apprenti·e à l’EPFL, vous bénéficierez de :
 un environnement de travail exceptionnel
 6 semaines de vacances quel que soit votre âge
 un salaire supérieur aux propositions du canton
 une aide une aide au financement des trajets en transports publics 
 l’accès aux modules de formation spécifiques, proposés par l’EPFL aux apprenti·es, pour travailler sur l’autonomie, la responsabilisation et le succès de l’apprentissage
 l’accès au centre sportif et aux différentes activités qui y sont proposées
 Informations
 Date d'entrée en fonction : 16 Aout 2027
 Nous organiserons des stages de sélection au cours du premier trimestre.
 Durée : 4 ans

items.desc:
Voor onze team in regio Mechelen te ondersteunen zijn we vandaag op zoek naar een FLYING AUDICIEN - VLIEGENDE AUDIOLOOG. 
 Voor onze hoorcentra en verkooppunten in de regio van Mechelen zoeken we versterking. Als flying audicien/vliegende audioloog vlieg je uit naar verschillende locaties. Met jouw expertise lever je een toegevoegde waarde aan elk team waar je neerstrijkt. Zo draag jij bij aan onze ambitie om voor onze klanten de meest geschikte hooroplossing te vinden.
 Met je diploma Audiologie (BA of MA), een RIZIV nummer op zak én een stevige portie empathie sta jij te popelen om iedereen die onze hoorcentra binnenkomt, verder te helpen.
 Herken jij je hierin:
 Jij brengt een pak ervaring als audioloog/audicien binnen in ieder team. Je ziet snel waar verbeteringen mogelijk en zinvol zijn, en deelt enthousiast best practices met het team. 
 Dag in dag uit hetzelfde traject? Nee dankje! Werken in wisselende omgevingen is wat jou gelukkig maakt. 
 Je bent je bewust van groepsdynamiek. Ieder team heeft z’n eigenheid maar jij vindt makkelijk je plek binnen elk team. 
 Oog voor detail, dat heb jij. En dat zal van pas komen bij het uitvoeren van verschillende geavanceerde audiometrische testen om de meeste geschikte hooroplossing voor te stellen.
 Nieuwe technieken zoals remote fitting toepassen, daar word jij helemaal warm van vanbinnen. 
 Verantwoordelijkheid nemen is voor jou een evidentie. Wij kunnen op beide oren slapen, jij volgt het gehele proces op van A tot Z.
 Nog steeds enthousiast? 
Weet dat je komt werken bij de marktleider van hooroplossingen in België, met meer dan 270 hoorcentra in België en meer dan 70 jaar expertise, die op zijn beurt behoort tot de Sonova Group, de belangrijkste fabrikant van hooroplossingen ter wereld.
 Bovendien bieden wij je:
 Een contract van onbepaalde duur met start zo snel mogelijk.
 Extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, ADV-dagen, groepsverzekering en hospitalisatieverzekering, een GSM, een flex income plan, een laptop en een bedrijfswagen.
 Verder krijg je ook een gepersonaliseerd ontwikkelingsplan met kwalitatieve coaching en feedbackmomenten om je professionele vaardigheden te ontwikkelen.
 De garantie dat je écht een verschil kan maken voor mensen met gehoorverlies. Hoe geweldig is dat?
 #LI-TW1 
 #Lapperre

items.desc:
Are you passionate about SAP EWM and ready to take the next step in your career? Would you like to go beyond day-to-day system support and help shape the future of warehouse operations?
 At our Sonova Logistics Center in Thuringia, Germany, you will play a key role in maintaining and continuously improving our SAP EWM environment. Working closely with an experienced colleague, you will take ownership of system improvements, collaborate with international teams, and contribute to the evolution of our warehouse processes.
 With exciting developments ahead, including SAP S/4HANA and future warehouse automation initiatives, this is an opportunity to grow your expertise, bring your ideas to life, and make a real impact.
 More about the role: 
 Take ownership of SAP EWM processes and support the smooth operation and continuous improvement of our warehouse management system.
 Manage change requests end-to-end, from gathering and evaluating requirements to coordinating implementation, testing, and go-live.
 Act as a key interface between local warehouse operations, SAP teams, global process owners, and external implementation partners.
 Identify opportunities to optimize warehouse processes, improve efficiency, and enhance system functionality.
 Support the implementation of global SAP standards while ensuring local operational requirements are effectively addressed.
 Contribute to upcoming SAP S/4HANA developments and future initiatives involving warehouse automation and robotics.
 Support system testing, validation, and process documentation in line with internal quality standards.
 More about you: 
 At least 2 years of hands-on experience working with SAP EWM, ideally in a warehouse, logistics, or supply chain environment.
 Good understanding of warehouse processes and an interest in improving systems and operational workflows.
 Experience with SAP change requests, system enhancements, or process improvements.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
 Confidence working with different stakeholders and the ability to translate operational needs into system requirements.
 Very good English communication skills; German language skills are an advantage.
 Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP customizing, or warehouse automation is a plus, but not essential.
 More about what we offer: 
 As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.
 You will benefit from working alongside an experienced SAP EWM colleague who will support your onboarding and knowledge development. You will also have the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility, contribute to the evolution of our SAP landscape, and develop your skills through a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities.
 At Sonova, your ideas matter, your development is encouraged, and your work makes a difference.

 Unsere Aftersales-Teams machen jeden Tag aufs Neue den Unterschied aus – mit ihrer Leidenschaft, ihrem Geschäftssinn, ihrem Kommunikationstalent und ihrem Gespür dafür, was unseren Kund:innen Freude macht.  Außerdem analysieren Sie Fehler im Fahrwerksbereich, an elektrischen Anlagen und Triebwerken aller Art.

 Zusätzlich führen Sie Qualitäts- und Funktionskontrollen durch.

 Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Kfz-Mechaniker:in oder Mechatroniker:in mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung. 
 Weiterbildung als Servicetechniker:in, Kommunikationselektroniker:in oder Hochvolttechniker:in S2/S3 wünschenswert.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions.  Sustainability Assessment: Investigate and assess material sustainability based on available databases, material properties, and applicable sustainability requirements. 
 Simulation & Model-Based Methods: Apply model-based methods and simulation tools to analyse and support improvements in acoustic performance. 
 Experimental Testing: Prepare experimental setups, perform testing activities, and carry out data acquisition to support material and component evaluation.

 Testing & Experimentation: Understanding of testing techniques and methodologies, with experience in preparing experimental setups, performing tests, and defining structured test plans.

 Working Style: Structured, proactive, and detail-oriented, with the ability to take responsibility for your own work and independently propose solutions. 
 Teamwork & Communication: Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team.

items.desc:
Your contribution to something big: 
 You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on the development and optimization of heat pump systems. You will support the evaluation of innovative designs, components, and material applications through laboratory testing, with a strong focus on refrigeration circuits, system performance, efficiency, sound, and control logic. Your main responsibilities will be: 
 Refrigeration System Testing: Plan and perform development tests on refrigeration circuits and components, considering system operating envelopes and focusing on product performance, efficiency, sound, and control logic. 
 Test Planning & Execution: Create structured test plans, prepare laboratory activities, execute development tests, and document results in accordance with applicable standards and internal requirements. 
 Component Validation: Test and validate refrigeration components and technical concepts to support the development of efficient and reliable heat pump solutions. 
 Heat Pump Performance Assessment: Evaluate heat pump requirements and system behaviour to support the development and optimization of new technical concepts and solutions. 
 Technical Specifications: Create, review, and interpret technical specifications for refrigeration components and support their application within heat pump systems. 
 Laboratory Testing : Prepare test setups, handle samples, and use laboratory equipment and data acquisition tools to conduct development testing. 
 Test Data Analysis: Analyse and interpret experimental results, identify relevant findings, and clearly document conclusions to support engineering decisions. 
 Technical Documentation: Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and clear communication within the development team.
What distinguishes you: 
 Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics Engineering, or a comparable technical field. 
 Thermodynamics & Fluid Mechanics: Strong knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and refrigeration systems. 
 Refrigeration Systems: Good understanding of the specification, calculation, design, and testing of refrigeration systems and components. 
 Testing & Experimentation: Experience handling samples, preparing test setups, and conducting tests in a laboratory environment. 
 Data Analysis: Ability to analyse and interpret test results and translate findings into clear technical conclusions and documentation. 
 Standards: Knowledge of European standards applicable to refrigeration systems and heat pumps is considered a plus. 
 Digital Tools: Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Experience with MATLAB and/or Simulink in engineering or laboratory environments. 
 Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-oriented mindset and strong attention to detail. 
 Working Style: Proactive and responsible, with the ability to independently organize your work, take ownership of assigned activities, and propose solutions. 
 Teamwork & Communication: Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative and Agile environment. 
 Languages: Excellent written and spoken English.

items.desc:
¿Quiénes somos? 
 Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales (TSA) es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica creadora de soluciones audiovisuales broadcast desde 1993. 
 Con sede central en España y oficina en Latinoamérica, TSA destaca por su carácter internacional ofreciendo servicios y soluciones broadcast y multimedia en cualquier parte del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones de consultoría, diseño e integración de proyectos audiovisuales broadcast end-to-end, soluciones integrales para la producción de televisión, proyectos de innovación como los basados en IA y servicios de plataformas de video DTH, IPTV, OTT, emisión de canales, etc. Nuestros proyectos y servicios se complementan además con formación, coaching y soporte con diferentes niveles de servicio. 
 También gestionamos el mayor telepuerto totalmente privado de España, mediante el cual se distribuyen más de 700 canales de televisión y radio, además de ofrecer accesos a Internet, Starlink, LAN, Voz IP y datos. 
 Nuestra experiencia se ha forjado a lo largo de los años a través del diseño, ejecución y soporte de numerosos proyectos y servicios, tanto propios como de nuestros clientes. 
 Creemos en la orientación al cliente, la innovación y la flexibilidad, y nuestro compromiso es promover soluciones tecnológicas para nuestros clientes, que se ajusten a las necesidades cambiantes de un mundo audiovisual en constante evolución. 
 Misión 
 La principal misión será dar soporte y acompañamiento a las Unidades de Negocio, asegurando el seguimiento económico de las distintas líneas de actividad y la gestión integral de las licitaciones públicas, aportando información y análisis para facilitar la toma de decisiones de la Dirección, las funciones a realizar serán: 
 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones? 
 Gestión integral de licitaciones públicas: preparación y presentación de la documentación administrativa en las plataformas electrónicas de contratación, control de plazos, atención a requerimientos y subsanaciones, y seguimiento de adjudicaciones. 
 Coordinación con las distintas áreas implicadas para la recopilación de la documentación exigida en las ofertas y en las propuestas de adjudicación. 
 Seguimiento de la cartera e ingresos de arrastre, así como de la contratación y la venta nueva y su devengo en ingresos, por Unidad de Negocio. 
 Consolidación de arrastre y venta nueva para la elaboración de la previsión de cierre del ejercicio (forecast) y de las estimaciones de cierre oficiales. 
 Seguimiento presupuestario y control de costes; elaboración y análisis de los cierres mensuales frente a presupuesto y previsión de cierre, con análisis cualitativo de las desviaciones. 
 Elaboración de reporting de gestión y cuadros de mando para el equipo de Dirección. 
 Interlocución entre las Unidades de Negocio y el área de Control de Gestión para garantizar la integración y coherencia de la información. 
 Impulso de la automatización y digitalización de los procesos de reporting y de las tareas recurrentes del área 
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Idiomas: 
 Valorable inglés nivel intermedio, mínimo B1 (hablado y escrito). Deseable C1. 
 Experiencia: 
 Se valorará experiencia en control de gestión, análisis financiero y gestión de licitaciones públicas realizando las siguientes funciones: 
 Planificación y seguimiento presupuestario, control de costes y análisis de desviaciones. 
 Elaboración de previsiones de cierre (forecast), estimaciones de cierre y reporting de gestión. 
 Preparación y presentación de ofertas en licitaciones públicas. 
 Interlocución con Unidades de Negocio y equipos de Dirección. 
 Conocimientos Técnicos: 
 Valorable conocimiento en herramientas de análisis y gestión empresarial, así como en contratación pública, tales como: 
 Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas avanzadas, Power Query). 
 SAP. 
 Herramientas de visualización y automatización (Power BI, Power Automate, macros/VBA o similares). 
 Plataformas electrónicas de contratación pública y normativa de contratación del sector público (Ley 9/2017, de Contratos del Sector Público). 
 Herramientas de IA generativa aplicadas a la productividad (p. ej., Microsoft Copilot). 
 Fundamentos de control de gestión: presupuestación, cuenta de resultados, costes y rentabilidad. 
 Aptitudes: 
 Alta capacidad analítica y visión de negocio. 
 Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interlocución, con capacidad para trabajar de forma transversal y generar red con las diferentes áreas.

 ¿Qué harás en esta posición? 
Liderarás la adquisición de contenidos de terceros para la plataforma, conciliando las necesidades de programación con los principios de negocio de Movistar Plus+, y definiendo en cada caso la mejor estrategia de negociación. Además, tendrás un papel relevante en el desarrollo de alianzas 360, identificando oportunidades y riesgos asociados a la compra de derechos.

También impulsarás el seguimiento de KPIs de rendimiento y la elaboración de informes ejecutivos que apoyen la toma de decisiones, así como la coordinación y gestión de equipos.
 Qué buscamos 
Profesionales con al menos 8 años de experiencia en la industria audiovisual , gestionando la adquisición de contenidos de distintos géneros, como cine, series o documentales. Es imprescindible aportar experiencia previa en operadores de televisión de pago y/o plataformas o canales de TV , así como un conocimiento sólido del mercado de adquisición de contenidos y de sus principales distribuidores, tanto en el ámbito nacional como internacional.
 Valoraremos formación universitaria en ADE o similar , Ingeniería Superior y/o MBA .
