Je neemt ownership over je engagementen en communiceert tijdig over voortgang, keuzes en mogelijke knelpunten. Je deelt kennis, documenteert oplossingen en helpt het team om elke cyclus beter te worden. Je krijgt ruimte om ook bij te dragen aan UX, DevOps of infrastructuur, afhankelijk van je interesses en talenten. Hoe wij werken We werken in cycli van zes weken. Voor de start worden ideeën samen met stakeholders voorbereid en scherpgesteld. Daarna vertaalt het team de gekozen prioriteiten naar een concreet plan en duidelijke milestones. Na elke cyclus blikken we samen terug en verbeteren we onze aanpak waar nodig. Op elke cyclus volgt een cooldown van twee weken. Die ruimte kun je gebruiken voor onderzoek, een proof of concept, een eigen idee, technische verbetering, bugs of kennisdeling. Zo maken we bewust tijd voor innovatie en voor werk dat anders te gemakkelijk op de achtergrond belandt. Onze kijk op AI AI ondersteunt je om sneller te onderzoeken, bouwen en valideren, maar neemt jouw inzicht en verantwoordelijkheid niet over. Jij blijft in controle over ontwerp en implementatie en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, samenhang en meerwaarde van wat we opleveren. profiel Je bent een full-stack developer met professionele ervaring. Je voelt je comfortabel aan zowel de front-end als de back-end, maar hoeft niet overal even sterk in te zijn. We houden rekening met jouw expertise en voorkeuren en geven je ruimte om verder te groeien en je te specialiseren. Je hebt ervaring met moderne webontwikkeling en begrijpt hoe front-end, back-end en infrastructuur samenkomen. Ervaring met Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, NestJS, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes of AWS is een pluspunt, geen afvinklijst. Je leert graag bij en deelt ook jouw eigen kennis, aanpak en favoriete technologieën met het team. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt actief afstemming wanneer dat het resultaat sterker maakt. Je communiceert eerlijk, respectvol en duidelijk en staat open voor andere inzichten. Je denkt kritisch na over je eigen werk en over hoe het team samenwerkt. aanbod Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Een job met maatschappelijke impact: je bouwt mee aan digitale leermiddelen voor het Vlaamse onderwijs. Veel autonomie en vertrouwen om je werk te organiseren en technische keuzes mee vorm te geven. Een team waarin uitdagingen worden gedeeld, successen samen worden gevierd en kennis vrij wordt uitgewisseld. Ruimte om te groeien via conferenties, opleidingen, cooldowns en eigen initiatieven. Een 38-urenweek binnen een 37-urenstatuut, goed voor 6 extra vakantiedagen. Glijdende werkuren en de mogelijkheid om tot 2 dagen per week thuis te werken. Een laptop, extra monitor en thuiswerkvergoeding. De mogelijkheid tot fiets- of autoleasing. waarden Bij die Keure geloven we dat vakkennis pas echt tot haar recht komt wanneer ze samengaat met de juiste ingesteldheid. Onze medewerkerswaarden zijn dan ook: Hungry, Humble & Smart. Hungry : Je bent nieuwsgierig, neemt initiatief en wilt blijven leren. Je ziet kansen, pakt verantwoordelijkheid en helpt ideeën vooruit. Humble : Je werkt vanuit vertrouwen en respect. Je luistert, deelt kennis, vraagt feedback en zet het resultaat van het team boven je eigen gelijk. Smart : Je combineert gezond verstand met heldere communicatie. Je maakt doordachte keuzes en voelt aan wat een gebruiker, collega of situatie nodig heeft. Zin om mee te bouwen? Stuur je cv en/of portfolio naar jobs@diekeure.be. Vertel ons vooral waar jij energie van krijgt, waarin je sterk bent en wat je nog wilt leren. Twijfel je of je aan elk punt voldoet? Laat dat je niet tegenhouden. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw ervaring, talenten en groeipotentieel. Heb je door een handicap, chronische ziekte, neurodiversiteit of een andere persoonlijke situatie nood aan een aangepaste sollicitatieprocedure, laat het ons weten. Dan bekijken we samen welke aanpassingen mogelijk zijn.

items.desc: Many organisations see the potential of AI but don't know where to start. Möbius is met +145 collega’s actief in België en Nederland en begeleidt al sinds 1997 een grote verscheidenheid aan organisaties. Steeds meer organisaties beseffen dat AI inzetten enorme kansen biedt, maar weten niet altijd waar of hoe te beginnen. Wij helpen hen om gebruik te maken van deze technologieën en vertrekken daarbij altijd vanuit het werk zelf . We kijken eerst waar teams hun tijd aan besteden en waar AI écht waarde toevoegt. Pas daarna kiezen we de technologie die daarbij past. Om onze teams te versterken, zijn we op zoek naar een AI Business Consultant : iemand die een sterke kennis van AI combineert met een scherp oog voor waar die technologie bij onze klanten het grote verschil kan maken . Jouw rol Je begeleidt klanten van analyse tot adoptie , volgens onze aanpak: Inventariseren: je brengt per afdeling en rol in kaart welke taken er gebeuren, hoe vaak en hoeveel tijd ze vragen. Denk aan documenten die manueel verwerkt worden of een klantendienst die verdrinkt in mails. Filteren: je bepaalt welk werk AI kan dragen, op basis van beschikbare data , voldoende volume en herhaling en een beheersbare foutmarge . Waar nodig bouw je menselijke controle in. Beslissen: je stelt een pragmatische AI-roadmap op met een duidelijke business case, en adviseert mee over kopen of bouwen. Samen met onze AI Engineers zet je use cases om in werkende oplossingen. Workshops en trainingen geven: je ontdekt samen met de klant kansen en leert management en medewerkers zelfstandig werken met AI-tools en verbeterde processen. Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden om een expert in jouw vakgebied te worden en om steeds up-to-date te blijven met de nieuwste AI-trends. YOUR ROLE In this role you will play a key role in: Leading and coordinating a draughtsman in the production of detailed design drawings, ensuring that specifications are clearly defined and accurately translated into compliant technical documentation Coordinating closely with support disciplines including finite element analysis (FEA), CFD, and test engineers to ensure seamless integration of simulation and testing activities into the product development process Acting as the technical reference point for project managers on products under development, contributing to planning coordination and providing expert answers to technical questions throughout the project lifecycle Applying solid mechanical engineering knowledge to the design and specification of mechanical components including screws, springs, gears, shafts, and other fundamental mechanical elements, with a good understanding of basic structural mechanics and hydraulics Leveraging numerical calculation tools — in particular Python — to perform optimisations, parametric studies, and other numerical analyses, bringing a structured and rigorous approach to problem-solving Organising and structuring problem-solving approaches in a methodical way, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to identify root causes and deliver robust engineering solutions YOUR PROFILE You hold an engineering degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, and bring 3 to 5 years of experience in mechanical design and product development, ideally in a complex industrial environment You have strong mechanical engineering knowledge, including a good understanding of fundamental mechanical components (screws, springs, gears, shafts, etc.), basic structural mechanics, and basic hydraulics, combined with the ability to specify detailed design requirements clearly and accurately You are proficient in Python and comfortable with numerical calculation techniques including optimisations and parametric studies, enabling you to bring a data-driven and analytical approach to engineering challenges You demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to organise and structure your approach in a methodical and rigorous way, and to collaborate effectively with FEA, CFD, and test engineering teams You are professionally proficient in both French and English (mandatory) What you'll love about working here: Digital Campuses and Academy – Our engineering academy offers more than 60,000 hours of training, alongside our digital campus covering GenAI, data, and sustainability. Whether you're looking to deepen your Python and numerical simulation expertise or explore new engineering methodologies, we support your learning journey at every step. Communities – Our Framework drives career development and elevates Capgemini's capabilities across various domains. These communities form the pillars of our Engineering Career Framework, connecting you with peers and experts worldwide and enabling you to grow your influence and technical expertise in mechanical design. Environmental Sustainability – Our teams around the world pave the way for a sustainable future, from building electric and hydrogen cars to solar airships and advanced mechanical systems. Join us and contribute to products and projects that truly make a difference. Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

items.desc: As our Commissioning Engineer, you‘ll bring our installations to life, ensuring the successful startup of complex and large-scale energy plants across Europe. You’ll coordinate and execute the commissioning activities on site, working closely with both the Project Team and the Customer. By testing, tuning, and monitoring, you make sure the plant performs to the highest standards. In this role, you combine technical knowledge with hands-on skills, and you’ll report to the Project Field Team Manager. about the job As Commissioning Engineer, you will: Coordinate commissioning activities on-site, including progress meetings with all stakeholders. You will be the bridge between our Customer on-site and the Project Team. Conduct tests for I/O, electrical connections, and upload the control software (PLC, visualization) for the energy plant. Oversee and execute the first fire, one of the highlight moments of a VYNCKE project. Fine-tune the installation to achieve the required performance targets (stability, power output and emissions). Monitor boiler performance and share feedback with the Project Team on executed works and activities. Provide training for Customer operators and maintenance teams, and assist in the successful handover of the installation About you We imagine our ideal candidate would: Hold a master’s degree in electronics or electromechanics, specialized in automation or electrical engineering, or equivalent through experience. Be passionate about automation and eager to apply that knowledge hands-on. Bring strong problem-solving skills and enjoy working independently or in a small team. Show autonomy, initiative, and an international mindset to engage with customers. Be willing to travel and work on-site abroad for periods of 2 to 4 weeks, mainly in Western Europe. Be fluent in English. About our offer Join VYNCKE, and we can promise you that you will embark on a learning journey. We offer an environment where your skills are valued, with a direct impact by advising and supporting your fellow Vynckeneers. You’ll be part of a team that trusts and empowers you, where every challenge is an opportunity to shine and there is room for initiative and an openness to communicate your vision and ideas. Your career is more than a job – it’s a path to making a meaningful impact in the world of clean energy, one project at a time. Eager to know more about this specific job opportunity? Don’t be shy: contact us! About VYNCKE In 1912, more than a century ago, VYNCKE was born from the hands of a single blacksmith: Louis VYNCKE. Today, we’ve grown into a leader in the industry of clean energy technology. Our journey from a family-run workshop to a pioneer in clean energy has been driven by an unwavering commitment to our customers and a deep respect for our planet. At VYNCKE, you join a legacy and a community that values tradition while fearlessly stepping into the future. Is this your career match? Great! We can’t wait to hear from you to find out if we see the match too.

items.desc: itsme® has fundamentally changed how people lead their digital lives in Belgium , but we are not stopping there! Do you want to be a driving force to help expand on this success story as part of a talented team that is making a positive impact on society? Then keep on reading, you’ll probably like what you’ll see. We are itsme®, one of Europe’s fastest-growing scale-ups , with 150 team members and growing. Our mission: to provide a state-of-the-art digital identity solution for all people, enabling them to interact securely in the digital space. Now, only nine years after being founded, close to 8 million citizens use the itsme® app to identify themselves and sign documents online. Starting in Belgium, we successfully launched the itsme app in 32 European countries, with the ambition of becoming an internationally leading player . We are currently looking for a Business Controller . You will join a small, hands-on finance team in a scale-up and report to the Finance Manager. Your core is FP&A and business partnering, but you don’t stay in one lane. You work closely with our Business Operations team, the NetSuite and Salesforce experts, to make sure our data is reliable from source to report. What your job looks like FP&A and reporting You prepare the monthly reporting for management, shareholders and team leads, and explain the story behind the numbers. You build and maintain budgets and rolling forecasts, and track how changes in the organisation impact them. You analyse variances and flag what needs attention. You develop and improve our BI reporting (currently Power BI). Business partnering You are a finance partner for the whole organisation. As a small company, that means working with every department, from operations and sales to product and HR. You support business cases: you build the financial model, challenge assumptions and help management make the right decision. You deliver accurate data for cross-departmental projects. Support across finance You step in where the team needs you. Depending on the moment, that means backing up accounting during the close, contributing to tax projects such as the wage withholding tax exemption and the innovation income deduction, or supporting customer billing. Data and AI in finance You help automate and improve finance processes, increasingly using AI tools. You review AI-generated output critically and make sure what leaves finance is correct. You have at least 3 years of experience in audit or controlling. You hold a master’s degree in economics, business, accounting or a similar field You are accurate. You check your own work and spot inconsistencies quickly. You are data driven and comfortable working with large datasets. Experience with BI tools (ideally Power BI), an ERP (ideally NetSuite) and/or a CRM (ideally Salesforce) is a plus. You are flexible and like variety. Switching between a forecast, a business case and a tax file in the same week doesn’t scare you. You take ownership and work independently, but ask for help when you need it. You communicate clearly with non-finance colleagues. You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have a good command of English. What we offer Being welcomed by an informal, enthusiastic, and ambitious team that is revolutionising how we safely manage our digital identity, in Belgium & beyond. Offices within walking distance from Brussels Central Station, with the possibility to work remotely 3 days a week. A contract of indefinite duration, with an attractive compensation package. An environment where we care a lot about our Chris values: C uriosity : Explore, learn, and challenge the status quo. H umble : Respect, listen, and embrace feedback for growth R esourcefulness : Connect, mobilise, and collaborate across ecosystems. I mpact : Lead by example and create positive influence. S cale : Build strong foundations for sustainable growth.

Proactive, organised and focused on continuous improvement. Good written and verbal communication skills. items.desc: Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de schermen én op de werkvloer die zorgt dat het hele hotel op wieltjes loopt. Wanneer er op drie afdelingen tegelijk iets gebeurt, bewaar jij de rust en het overzicht. Als Operations Supervisor ben je de rechterhand van de General Manager en de centrale schakel tussen receptie, housekeeping en F&B. Je combineert een hands-on aanpak met organisatorisch inzicht en sterk leiderschap. Je bent niet alleen zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer om je collega’s te ondersteunen en gasten te woord te staan, maar je neemt ook het voortouw in dagelijkse administratie, roosters en kwaliteitscontrole. Bij afwezigheid van de General Manager neem jij bovendien vol vertrouwen de eindverantwoordelijkheid op je. About The Role Jouw dag in het hotel Geen twee dagen zijn hetzelfde. Je start je dag misschien met een kwaliteitscontrole bij het ontbijt, helpt daarna de receptie door een drukke check-out piek, om vervolgens de personeelsplanning voor volgende week af te werken. Jij zorgt ervoor dat het team als één goed geoliede machine draait. Je coördineert de dagelijkse operaties en stemt receptie, housekeeping en F&B vlot op elkaar af. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer, springt in waar nodig (bijvoorbeeld aan de balie of bij het ontbijt) en bent het centrale aanspreekpunt. Je waarborgt de perfecte gastbeleving, volgt klantentevredenheid actief op en behandelt klachten op een diplomatieke, oplossingsgerichte manier. Je neemt de leiding over het F&B-gedeelte, waaronder het ontbijtconcept, stockbeheer, bestellingen en het bewaken van de hygiënenormen. Je coacht, traint en motiveert het team. Je helpt bij de onboarding van nieuwe collega's en de dagelijkse aansturing. Je volgt administratie, facturatie, kassaverwerking en rapportages nauwgezet op. Je denkt commercieel mee over prijszetting, up-selling en volgt groepsreservaties op. In de afwezigheid van de General Manager bewaak jij de continuïteit en neem je de touwtjes in handen. Je bent dus tegelijk een gastgerichte leider , een probleemoplosser , een administratieve rots in de branding en een echte verbinder. Wie zoeken wij? We zoeken geen manager die het liefst de hele dag in een kantoor zit. We zoeken iemand die het overzicht behoudt door er middenin te staan, zelf meewerkt en collega's inspireert om elke dag voor topkwaliteit te gaan. Je ademt gastvrijheid en houdt rekening met de uiteenlopende verwachtingen en behoeften van onze gasten. Je hebt sterke leidinggevende kwaliteiten en krijgt energie van het begeleiden en motiveren van een divers team. Je behoudt het overzicht en blijft kalm en efficiënt, zelfs in drukke of onverwachte situaties. Je bent een organisatietalent dat vlot schakelt tussen verschillende afdelingen en prioriteiten. Je analyseert situaties snel en onderneemt doeltreffende, zelfstandige acties. Je werkt uiterst nauwkeurig, met name op het vlak van administratie en kassa- en betalingsverwerking. Je navigeert moeiteloos door het PMS-systeem en andere digitale hoteltools. Je bent cultureel bewust, communiceert flexibel en bent een ware ambassadeur voor de kwaliteitsnormen van het hotel. De functie vraagt duidelijk om iemand die leidinggeven combineert met operationele aanwezigheid, probleemoplossend denken en een sterke servicefocus. Wat wij bieden Bij ons stap je niet zomaar in een nieuwe job, je lanceert een carrière. In ons moderne hotel heerst een gedreven teamgeest waar kwaliteit de standaard is en jouw talenten de ruimte krijgen om te bloeien. We investeren volop in jouw toekomst en zorgen voor de juiste omkadering, zodat jij met volle energie het beste van jezelf kunt geven. Dit pakket helpt jou vooruit: Sterke financiële basis: Een competitief loon, aangevuld met de zekerheid van een gratis hospitalisatieverzekering. Klaar voor de toekomst: We bieden interne opleidingen en reële doorgroeimogelijkheden voor wie wil bijleren en initiatief toont. Slimme mobiliteit: Omdat we duurzaamheid belangrijk vinden, vergoeden we je treinabonnement volledig en bieden we een mooie fietsvergoeding. Ruimte voor jezelf: Flexibele werkuren die jou de controle geven over een gezonde werk-privébalans. Mooie extra's: Toegang tot het 'Benefits at Work' platform boordevol kortingen op producten en ervaringen. Als kers op de taart geniet je van exclusieve kortingen voor jou, je vrienden en familie in onze eigen hotels. Over Green Park Hotel Brugge Welkom bij Green Park Hotel Brugge, jouw nieuwe werkplek in het groen. Ons hotel ligt in een rustige, bosrijke omgeving, net buiten het prachtige historische centrum van UNESCO-werelderfgoedstad Brugge. Hier bieden we een perfecte mix van comfort en gastvrijheid voor zowel ontspannende gezinsvakanties als zakelijke verblijven. Als medewerker maak je deel uit van een plek vol dynamiek. Van de zakelijke bijeenkomsten in onze vergaderzalen tot het vakantiegevoel aan ons verwarmd buitenzwembad en de lachende gezichten in de kinderspeelplaats. items.desc: Vil du være med til at optimere og udvikle de Single-Use systemer, der understøtter produktionen af livsvigtige vacciner? .....så er du måske vores nye kollega til et 12 mdrs. barselsvikariat som Single-Use Systems Professional Vi søger en engageret og løsningsorienteret Single-Use Systems Professional, som brænder for forbedringer, tekniske løsninger og samarbejde på tværs af produktionen. I rollen får du ansvaret for vores Single-Use systemer, herunder poser og transfersæt, der sikrer sikker og effektiv transport af produkt gennem produktionsprocessen. Din vigtigste opgave bliver at understøtte driften af produktionen. Du kommer til at samarbejde tæt med produktionsmedarbejdere, specialister, ingeniører, hvilket giver dig en bred kontaktflade og en central rolle i den daglige drift og udvikling. Dine nye kolleger Du bliver en del af Materiel and Sterile Operations, som består af cirka 12 medarbejdere fordelt på to faggrupper. Du vil specifikt indgå i Raw Materials teamet, der består af fire dedikerede kolleger med stor faglighed og stærkt samarbejde. Vi har et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet, hvor faglig sparring, humor og hjælpsomhed er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Hos Bavarian Nordic får du mulighed for at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø med høj grad af frihed, fleksibilitet og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Vi tilbyder desuden fleksible arbejdsforhold med mulighed for hjemmearbejde på ugentlig basis. Dine arbejdsopgaver Som Single-Use Systems Professional vil du blandt andet arbejde med: Dialog og samarbejde med leverandører om udvikling og optimering af Single-Use produkter Procesverificering i produktionen for at sikre, at systemerne fungerer som forventet Daglig teknisk support til operatører og specialister Deltagelse i systematisk problemløsning samt vurdering af konsekvenser ved fejl eller afvigelser Optimering af arbejdsprocesser med fokus på effektiv og sikker anvendelse af Single-Use systemer Som en del af rollen vil du være til stede i produktionen flere gange om måneden for at forstå processerne, identificere forbedringsmuligheder og sikre tæt samarbejde med de medarbejdere, der anvender systemerne i praksis. Kvalifikationer og kompetencer Vi forestiller os, at du har en naturvidenskabelig akademisk uddannelse og erfaring fra GMP-miljøer vil være en fordel. Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har flere af følgende kompetencer: Du har forståelse for, hvordan produktionsanlæg og processer fungerer, og kan omsætte denne viden til praktiske løsninger og kvalificeret sparring Du trives med at arbejde systematisk og har fokus på detaljen. Du formår at skabe overblik og sikre, at opgaver gennemføres korrekt og dokumenteres i overensstemmelse med gældende krav Du motiveres af samarbejde og har let ved at skabe relationer på tværs af faggrupper. Samtidig trives du med at undervise, formidle viden og støtte kolleger i deres daglige arbejde Erfaring med aseptiske processer og kendskab til GxP-regulerede miljøer er en fordel og giver et stærkt fundament for rollen Hvorfor vælge Bavarian Nordic? Hos Bavarian Nordic bliver du en del af en virksomhed med en stærk kultur, høj faglighed og et meningsfuldt formål. Vi udvikler og producerer vacciner, der gør en forskel for mennesker verden over. Vi tilbyder Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling Stor indflydelse på egne opgaver og løsninger Aktiv personaleforening og sociale arrangementer Fleksible arbejdsforhold, pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring, konkurrencedygtig løn og mulighed for bonus Kommer du med offentlig transport, kan du benytte vores buslinje 70E, som kører direkte mellem Humlebæk Station og vores faciliteter i Kvistgård. Derudover tilbyder vi ladestandere til elbiler på arbejdspladsen. Løn Årligt grundlønsinterval (brutto): DKK 585.900–716.100. Hos Bavarian Nordic ønsker vi en fair og transparent fastsættelse af lønnen. Den endelige grundløn fastsættes ud fra relevant erfaring, kvalifikationer og kompetencer samt vores interne lønstruktur. Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os gerne en ansøgning samt CV. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og lære dig bedre at kende. Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America. Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com #LI-LJ1

items.desc: Job Description Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready for your next challenge? Would you like to lead technical architecture, mentor junior talent, and work directly with clients while staying at the forefront of modern data technologies? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools. Contract: Full-time Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station Work Assignments As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for: Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering. Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users. Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement. You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants. What You Bring to the Team Ideally, you have: Solid experience working as a Data Engineer. Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs. Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP. An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data. Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects. A relevant degree. A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English. If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. Why Devoteam Data Driven? You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth: Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies. Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off. Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Lasertag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things. Our Impact Below are a few examples of our work: Migrated Novo's global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration. Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client. Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack. Application Process Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th. We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. items.desc: Nørre Gymnasium søger snarest en årsvikar på deltid i psykologi og dansk frem til sommer. Stillingen omfatter tre-fire hold. Det er en fordel, hvis du kan undervise i begge fag, men det er ikke et krav. Man kan læse mere om kravene til faglig kompetence på Børne- og Undervisningsministeriets hjemmeside her. Pædagogikum er ikke en forudsætning. Om Nørre Gymnasium Nørre Gymnasium er et stort udviklingsorienteret gymnasium beliggende i Brønshøj i København med cirka 1250 elever og 130 ansatte. Vi udbyder stx samt den engelsksprogede IB-uddannelse (IB er ikke relevant i dette stillingsopslag). Vores strategi og vision er, at vi ønsker at uddanne unge mennesker til at møde fremtiden med håb og handling gennem faglig begejstring, kreative tilgange, fællesskaber og handlekompetence. Nørre Gymnasium har en decentraliseret projektorganisation, hvor princippet er, at mange beslutninger træffes så tæt som muligt på dem, beslutningerne vedrører. Den enkelte lærer og teamet/teamlederen omkring en klasse har derfor stort selvstændigt ansvar og råderum. Du kan læse mere på vores hjemmeside: nrgym.dk Ansøgning Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte vicerektor Sebastian Krag Kristiansen på se@nrgym.dk. Ansøgning, CV og eksamenspapirer skal sendes elektronisk via jobopslaget på gymnasiejob.dk. Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at ansætte før fristens udløb. Hvis du har søgt stilling hos os tidligere og fortsat er interesseret, vil vi bede dig gensende din ansøgning her. Du skal være indstillet på at fremvise straffeattest, hvis det efterspørges. Ansættelsesvilkår Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Alle lærere får stillet en bærbar computer til rådighed. Vi tilbyder desuden lærerarbejdspladser og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling. items.desc: Do you want to help shape the digital applications that support digital manufacturing at VELUX? As our new Technical Product Owner, you will connect manufacturing needs with solutions enabled by our top-tier Industrial IoT platform, turning business priorities into a clear roadmap and delivery-ready work—and helping drive our digitization journey. Meet your future team You will join our growing Industrial IoT Platform Team within the IT & Digital Enablement (IT&DE) department. We work closely with the Operations & Supply (O&S) organization to support the entire VELUX Group globally. This role is a new addition to the team, and you will work alongside the Senior Technical Product Owner who is accountable for ensuring a common approach. You will connect IT and Supply and own an assigned area of manufacturing applications and capabilities within that framework. Your scope can evolve as portfolio priorities and the product model develop, contributing to VELUX’s continuous digitization journey. What we offer As Technical Product Owner, you will have the opportunity to shape your part of an evolving digital manufacturing application landscape. You will own the technical product direction, roadmap, backlog and day-to-day decisions, in close collaboration with the business, translating their needs and priorities into a clear, scalable and sustainable product path. You will connect manufacturing needs with delivery-ready work for technical teams, helping establish a consistent product mindset across your scope. To make that work clear and actionable, you will establish and maintain product requirements, processes and guardrails that support development and delivery. More specifically your tasks will be to: Own and continuously develop the technical product roadmap and backlog for your agreed area of digital manufacturing applications and capabilities. Turn incoming business needs into clearly defined problems and desired outcomes, then shape them into features with acceptance criteria. Keep the backlog structured and sufficiently refined for delivery teams to begin work, meeting the agreed Definition of Ready standards. Coordinate refinement and product preparation for sprint planning, make day-to-day prioritisation decisions within the agreed product direction, and escalate decisions outside your scope. Be the primary product contact for your assigned scope and coordinate dependencies across stakeholders and teams. Escalate cross-domain trade-offs, investment or capacity choices, and scope conflicts that need resolution beyond your remit. Keep manufacturing processes, applications, shared technology capabilities, integrations and deployment requirements aligned from end to end. Shape the roadmap around connected manufacturing needs rather than separate technology silos. Manage the technical capability lifecycle from prioritised business need and validation through delivery, operational feedback and continuous improvement, using agreed measures to inform product-quality and lifecycle decisions. You can be based in Skjern, Østbirk, Kolding or Hørsholm. The role requires regular physical presence in Skjern and at manufacturing locations in Denmark, with occasional travel abroad. When tasks and projects allow, you can work from home up to 2 days per week. What you will bring into the organization You bring experience from product ownership, product management or a comparable business-facing role within digital manufacturing, including evolving or multi-product scopes. You can collaborate with both business and technical colleagues to turn priorities into delivery-ready work, and you are ready to bring structure, accountability and product focus to a development organisation. Moreover, we expect that you: Bring a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, including how operational applications, enterprise systems, machine integration and data interact. Broader knowledge of digital manufacturing landscapes is an advantage. Can create product roadmaps, structure complex demand, and translate desired outcomes into delivery-ready features and backlogs. Take a disciplined, outcome-oriented approach to product ownership, establishing and maintaining clear product requirements, processes and decision guardrails. Balance standardization and short-term delivery needs with long-term product integrity. Have experience working in a complex matrix organisation, using stakeholder collaboration, clear communication and sound decision-making to align colleagues across organisational boundaries. Have the technical fluency to collaborate credibly with architects, technical leads and engineering teams. Ready to apply? items.desc: Company Description Apex Logic Lab is a small experimental technology lab focused on understanding sports through reliable data infrastructure and machine learning. The team builds systems that transform real-time information from live events into clearer, more actionable views of games for partners and clients. Working at Apex Logic Lab offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge tools that support analysis, performance insights, and fan experiences. Team members collaborate closely in a fast-paced environment where innovation, accuracy, and curiosity about sports and technology are highly valued. Role Description The Live Sports Data Analyst is a contract, on-site at games role based in the Paris area. In this position, the individual will attend live sporting events or designated venues to capture real-time game data, including plays, statistics, and contextual information, using company tools and applications. Responsibilities include monitoring game flow, entering data with high accuracy and speed, verifying entries against established standards, and reporting any anomalies or technical issues to the operations team. The role also involves collaborating with data engineers and analysts to improve data collection processes, participating in training sessions to refine methods, and following strict quality and timing protocols. This position may require evening and weekend work aligned with live sports schedules. Qualifications Strong Data Collection skills with attention to detail and accuracy in fast-paced, real-time environments. Analytical Skills to interpret game situations, validate data, and recognize patterns or inconsistencies. Clear Communication skills to coordinate with team members, report issues, and follow operational guidelines. Experience with Training and Research to learn new tools quickly, apply standardized methods, and contribute to process improvements. Knowledge of major sports (rules, terminology, game flow) and enthusiasm for live sporting events. Comfort with technology, including mobile apps, data entry interfaces, and basic troubleshooting. Ability to work on-site in the Paris area, including evenings and weekends as available. Previous experience in sports statistics, live event operations, or a related data-focused field is beneficial; relevant education in fields such as sports management, statistics, or computer science is a plus. Pay We pay a base of $100 plus two bonuses based on your speed and accuracy. The first bonus, worth up to $200, is earned by avoiding major mistakes. The second bonus has no cap, and its size depends on how well you handle challenging situations (penalties, red cards, VAR) and how quickly you enter potential goals. items.desc: Every student on Earth deserves what only the lucky few get today: a brilliant tutor who knows them, believes in them and shows up every day. Millions of students across 25+ countries already use Knowie, their learning companion, +5x per week. They don’t come back because a teacher told them to. They come back because it helps and they like it. Most of our growth is word of mouth, students truly love it. Why now? AI has made knowledge a commodity, and school systems can’t keep up. Students need motivation, guidance and someone on their side, and AI can finally deliver that one-to-one, at scale. We’re building a companion that feels like the cool older sibling, not another teacher. It’s personal, motivating and something students love. This is creating a totally new market category. Education will become one of the core assets in a future where a whole generation growing up lives on more uncertainty than ever before. Education systems will keep shifting, and we’re the stable layer that families and students rely on through that change. We raised €40mio+, operate with a lean team of +60 hands on builders & are deeply driven to define this new category to bring personalised education to 1bn students globally. For this role, product experience isn’t one part of what we do. It is the whole thing. A brilliant tutor only works if students want to come back every day, and that comes down to how it looks, moves and feels. We need someone to own that: to lead it, push it and iterate on it with millions of students in real time. You’ll take a product students already love to its next stage. Simplifier: Education is messy. AI is unpredictable. You turn complicated user journeys into experiences that feel obvious. Biased to action : You move fast by default. Prototypes over presentations, experiments over endless debate. Builder : You like getting your hands dirty. Bonus if you’ve shipped a side project end to end, or opened a merge request. Team-first : Direct feedback, no preciousness, no territory. Engineers prototyping features? More builders means better outcomes. Curious : New tools, new patterns, new ways of thinking. Objectifs &
items.desc: Au sein de l'équipe Recherche Avancée d'un grand groupe industriel, vous intervenez sur un projet stratégique axé sur l'écoconception et les matériaux de nouvelle génération. L?objectif de la mission est de concevoir et de déployer des modèles numériques prédictifs afin de simuler l'évolution, le vieillissement et la dégradation de matrices complexes au contact de milieux réactifs et biologiques. Objectifs & LivrablesEn interface directe avec les experts R&D (spécialistes matériaux, chimistes, ingénieurs procédés), vous assurez : Développement de modèles prédictifs multi-échelles : Modélisation couplée associant mécanique des milieux continus, cinétique réactionnelle et phénomènes de transport (diffusion de masse, gradients de concentration). Implémentation via des codes de calcul par éléments finis (FEA) et/ou approches hybrides associant physique et Machine Learning (PINNs, surrogate models). Compréhension des phénomènes d'interface : Modélisation des mécanismes de surface : dégradation, adhésion, sorption/désorption et transferts de matière. Exploitation et intégration des données expérimentales (chimie analytique, spectrométrie, caractérisations de surface) pour le calage et la validation des modèles. Aide à la décision & valorisation scientifique : Restitution des résultats de simulation sous forme de critères de design exploitables par les équipes de formulation. Rédaction de la documentation technique et contribution aux collaborations scientifiques externes. Profil candidat: Formation : Ingénieur ou Docteur (PhD) en Mécanique, Génie des procédés, Physique des matériaux ou Mathématiques appliquées. Compétences clés : Maîtrise éprouvée de la modélisation multiphysique (couplage transport / réaction / mécanique). Pratique solide de la simulation numérique et du scripting scientifique (Python, C++, MATLAB, solveurs éléments finis). Intérêt ou expérience dans les méthodes d'hybridation physique-IA (Machine Learning appliqué à la physique). Sensibilité à l'interaction entre simulation et essais physico-chimiques expérimentaux. Savoir-être : Capacité à travailler en autonomie au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, esprit d'analyse et aisance de communication avec des spécialistes aux horizons variés.

À ce titre, vous prenez notamment en charge les missions suivantes : Architecture de sécurité et gestion des accès Définir et maintenir l’architecture de sécurité de référence et la trajectoire Zero Trust ; Définir les principes de cloisonnement, les standards de durcissement et les exigences de sécurité des environnements Cloud, SaaS, API et solutions intégrant de l’IA ; Contribuer à l’intégration de la sécurité dans les projets numériques et à la conception des solutions IAM, PAM et MFA ; Protection, détection et pilotage du SOC managé Définir les politiques de protection et de détection des outils de cyberdéfense (EDR/XDR, pare-feux, VPN, WAF) et en contrôler l’application ; Piloter le SOC managé, définir les modalités d’escalade et analyser et qualifier les alertes escaladées ; Définir la stratégie de détection, exploiter le renseignement sur la menace (CTI) et conduire ou faire conduire des campagnes de Threat Hunting ; Vulnérabilités et réponse à incident Définir et piloter le processus de gestion des vulnérabilités, surveiller la surface d’attaque externe et suivre les actions de remédiation ; Assurer le rôle d’Incident Manager technique, coordonner les équipes et prestataires et engager les mesures d’endiguement relevant des délégations prédéfinies ; Réaliser ou piloter les investigations numériques, préserver les preuves et organiser les retours d’expérience et exercices techniques ; Ingénierie, audits et conformité Concevoir et développer des outils d’automatisation et des agents d’intelligence artificielle au service de la cyberdéfense ; Proposer au RSSI le programme d’audits techniques et de tests d’intrusion, piloter les prestations et suivre les recommandations ; Définir les mesures techniques requises par NIS2 et Part-IS, produire les indicateurs de sécurité et contribuer aux actions de sensibilisation. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Contribuer directement à la protection des systèmes d’information d’une compagnie aérienne internationale ; Intervenir sur des enjeux de cyberdéfense variés, de la détection des menaces à la réponse aux incidents ; Participer à des projets technologiques innovants dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant et fortement réglementé. Notre contexte Pionnier de la science des matériaux depuis plus de 130 ans, Michelin s’appuie sur une expertise unique pour contribuer significativement au progrès humain et à un monde plus durable. Plus de sécurité, plus de performance, une meilleure expérience de conduite...et plus de prédictivité... Michelin innove en proposant des solutions de pointe pour l'ensemble des marques de pneumatiques, en réponse aux attentes des constructeurs automobiles et des conducteurs. À l’heure où les véhicules deviennent de véritables plateformes numériques, Michelin est convaincu que la connectivité des pneus est un levier essentiel pour atteindre ses ambitions de croissance durable et satisfaire les attentes de ses clients. S’appuyant sur sa capacité à tirer toute la valeur des données d'usage et de la connaissance physique du pneumatique, Michelin est en mesure de proposer un jumeau numérique du pneu aux spécificités uniques. Différent des autres solutions, en effet, car il n'a besoin d'aucun capteur dans le pneumatique et fonctionne quels que soient la marque et le modèle du pneu et du véhicule. L’équipe en charge de la compréhension / prédiction des performances met son savoir et ses compétences au service de la conception des produits , pour proposer une mobilité plus sûre et plus durable. Cette équipe de 25 personnes recrute en CDI un·e ingénieur·e mécanicien·ne / physicien·ne dans le but d’améliorer ses modèles et sa compréhension des performances Comportements Pneus et Véhicules au sein du Centre de R&D Michelin basé à Clermont-Ferrand. Votre mission avec nous Votre mission consiste à comprendre les mécanismes qui pilotent la performance Comportement d’un pneumatique, en lien avec le véhicule , et de la modéliser dans des outils intégrables directement aux nouvelles plateformes S oftware D efined V ehicle (véhicules définis par logiciels). Vous accompagnez les partenaires par votre expertise en perfectionnant les briques physiques de ces modèles . Vous avez un niveau d’ anglais courant ( B2 mini ) Vous avez par ailleurs de bonnes capacités à travailler au sein d'équipes projet multidisciplinaires Qu’est-ce que vous avez à y gagner ? A votre prise de poste, vous bénéficiez d'un plan de formation personnalisé. Votre progression dans le métier se fera grâce à votre entourage (expert performances, experts pneumatiques, expert matériaux) dans un climat de partage de savoirs et savoir-faire mais aussi grâce à une formation continue qui sera définie de manière individuelle. Vos compétences, votre curiosité, votre rigueur d'analyse et votre sens de la physique, vous permettront de gagner en expertise afin de devenir une référence interne sur la performance comportement pneu et véhicule. Vous pourrez ensuite évoluer soit vers un rôle de gestion transverse, soit vers un rôle d'expert dans le développement de nouvelles méthodes. En intégrant Michelin, les perspectives de carrière sont variées, et vous serez acteur·trice de votre développement. N’hésitez plus ! Vous avez envie de participer à une vision ambitieuse de la mobilité durable, rejoignez-nous ! Nos projets : Plateforme Machine Learning : accélérer l’expérimentation et le déploiement des modèles en production. Personnalisation : moderniser les solutions de recommandation et améliorer la pertinence des contenus proposés. Content Intelligence : automatiser l’analyse et l’enrichissement des contenus pour améliorer leur exploitation. Votre rôle et vos missions Identifier et prioriser les besoins métiers pour transformer les enjeux business en cas d’usage IA à fort impact. Piloter le développement des produits IA, de la définition du backlog au suivi des livraisons et de la performance. Formaliser les user stories, critères d’acceptation, métriques de succès et plans d’amélioration des modèles. Maîtrise des méthodes Agile et capacité à animer les rituels : daily, sprint planning, rétrospectives et refinements. Bonne compréhension des environnements techniques AWS , Snowflake, Python et SQL (pratique si le candidat sait rédiger des requêtes sur les données) et Scala, sans nécessité d’être expert. Forte capacité à traduire les enjeux métiers en fonctionnalités et à définir les indicateurs de succès. Excellentes compétences en communication, coordination et leadership transverse. Capacité à fédérer les équipes, aligner les parties prenantes et accompagner l’adoption des solutions IA. Autonomie, esprit d’initiative et capacité à co-construire le produit avec le responsable de l’équipe. Anglais et français niveau C1. Et le process ? items.desc: WholeHelp vient d'être rachetée par Sage. Et ce n'est que le début. Avec Sage Experience, on rend l'IA accessible à tout type d'entreprise, sur de vrais cas d'usage. Pas des démos de laboratoire : interroger ses chiffres en langage naturel, automatiser les tâches qui font perdre des heures, connecter ses outils, créer des écrans sur-mesure. Le tout branché sur les logiciels de gestion Sage que les PME utilisent déjà. Nos produits SaaS sont pensés nativement pour l'IA, et ils tournent déjà chez les clients. Le poste Product Builder : responsable de produit qui conçoit et construit en personne, avec l'IA, le produit qui lui est confié. Tu es responsable d'une ligne produit Sage Experience, et tu la construis. Une ligne, c'est l'expérience web et IA d'un logiciel de gestion Sage. En binôme avec le développeur référent de ta ligne, tu réponds de ce qu'elle devient chez les clients. Tu dis le besoin, l'ordre et le pourquoi ; ton binôme dit le comment, et quand ce n'est pas raisonnable. Concrètement, tu développes toi-même tes écrans, avec l'IA, dans le code du produit, sur le design system commun et les routes API que les développeurs te fournissent. Ton code suit le circuit de tout le code : merge request, tests, CI. Ton binôme le relit, peut le refuser, puis le fusionne et le met en production. Tu as peut-être déjà construit tes propres outils parce qu'on ne te laissait pas toucher au produit. Ici, c'est le poste. Ton travail continue après la mise en production. À la fin, une question compte : est-ce que les clients restent ? Selon la ligne, tu fais grandir une offre en production, tu en lances une neuve ou tu ouvres une ligne de zéro. Sur Sage 100, utilisé par plus de 40 000 PME en France, plus de trente écrans web tournent déjà. Ce que tu vas faire Développer avec l'IA les écrans, les fonctionnalités et les templates de pages, de widgets et de workflows de ta ligne, avec leurs tests, à partir des specs et en collaboration étroite avec les experts métier (partenaires, clients, collaborateurs de Sage) Tenir avec ton binôme le backlog des routes et des données Produire avec l'IA les formations de ta ligne produit, et y former les partenaires intégrateurs, les équipes consulting et le support Poser sur tes pages des indicateurs d'usage et de friction, dans le respect du RGPD, et t'en servir pour que les clients restent Faire émerger les nouveaux besoins, repérer et proposer les outils tiers à intégrer Présenter ta ligne en public (salon, keynote, webinaire) et appuyer l'avant-vente à la demande du commerce de Sage L'équipe Tu rejoins une équipe de 10 à 15 personnes. Product Builders et développeurs travaillent ensemble au quotidien, sur une même stack : TypeScript, Node ou Bun côté serveur, React côté client. Les routes, les connecteurs et la plateforme commune (Ask, moteur de workflows, console) restent aux développeurs. Dès le premier jour, tu as les outils d'IA validés par Sage au niveau de licence le plus élevé, une usine de formation et nos outils maison, faits pour avancer à la vitesse de l'IA sur les usages d'aujourd'hui. Dans un second temps, tu pourras aussi proposer une expérience mobile first ; passer sur une autre ligne reste possible. Toi Tu construis déjà avec l'IA au quotidien, en vibe coding, des outils qui tournent, et tu vérifies ce qu'elle produit au lieu de la croire. Pas besoin d'un parcours de développement, mais tu sais tester ce que tu livres et l'expliquer. Tu as l'œil UX/UI, et tu sais écrire une spec fonctionnelle. Tu parles d'adoption et de clients avant de parler d'outils, et tu sais expliquer un produit à un public. Tu viens peut-être du produit SaaS B2B, du design produit, d'un éditeur de gestion, d'une agence digitale, du conseil fonctionnel ou de la création d'entreprise. Une culture comptable, de gestion ou d'ERP est un vrai plus. Lire une documentation d'API ou connaître Sage aussi. Ce qui compte, ce n'est pas le nombre d'années, c'est ce que tu as réellement construit. Ce poste n'est pas pour toi si tu n'as rien construit toi-même à montrer Comment on se rencontre Un premier échange, puis tu nous montres ce que tu as dans le ventre : tes réalisations de cette année, projets personnels compris. Enfin, une rencontre avec l'équipe et la direction. CDI. Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (92800 Puteaux), trois jours par semaine au bureau, à la tour Hekla Capacité à faire le trajet ou à déménager: 92800 Puteaux: Faire le trajet sans problème ou prévoir un déménagement avant de prendre son poste (Requis) Langue: Anglais (Requis) Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (92800 Puteaux)

Il travaille en interface avec les développeurs prestataires en régie, pilotés par le Tech Lead, ainsi qu'avec les équipes métier, sécurité et l'infogérant. Piloter l'infogérant et assurer l'interface technique avec les développeurs pour tenir délais et qualité. Maintenir un niveau de sécurité et de documentation permettant à toute personne de reprendre un sujet sans dépendre du consultant. Coordination technique (?60 %) Cadrer les besoins techniques avec le produit et les traduire en lots et tickets pour les développeurs. Remonter au Tech Lead les risques et les urgences sur le BUILD et la TMA pour éclairer ses arbitrages. Piloter la TMA des sites Drupal, Drupal headless et WordPress : qualification des tickets, suivi des délais, montées de version et correctifs de sécurité. Piloter l'infogérant : demandes de changement, suivi des déploiements, respect des engagements. Organiser et conduire les mises en production applicatives : plan de MEP, go/no-go, communication, plan de retour arrière. Tenir à jour la documentation : architecture, procédures d'exploitation, runbooks de MEP, décisions techniques. DevOps et sécurité (?40 %) Maintenir et faire évoluer les pipelines CI/CD Gérer la cohérence des environnements (DEV, RECETTE, PREPROD PROD). Intervenir sur les briques AWS serverless : diagnostic, évolutions mineures, revue des changements proposés par l'infogérant. Assurer le suivi sécurité : traitement des alertes GitGuardian, rotation des secrets exposés, revue des droits IAM, points réguliers avec nos équipes cybersécurité. Contribuer au support niveau 2 et à l'analyse des incidents de production.

items.desc: At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work. We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco. Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished. Why Verda Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits. 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team. A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem. Practicalities Work mode: Remote (EU) Employment type: Full-time, permanent Start date: As soon as possible About the role Instead of traditional systems engineering, your focus will be entirely on the silicon and low-level software layers. You will design, build, and maintain the automation frameworks that keep our entire fleet up to date—covering everything from motherboards and Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs) to high-performance InfiniBand fabrics and GPU clusters. In our "move fast" culture, your job is to build the safety nets (health checks, canary deploys, and automated rollbacks) that allow us to update hardware rapidly without taking down the cloud. Your Responsibilities Fleet-Wide Firmware Orchestration: Design and execute automated, zero-touch firmware update pipelines across our global fleet of servers, switches, and accelerators. Heterogeneous Hardware Management: Own the firmware lifecycle for multiple hardware profiles, including Systemboards (BIOS/UEFI), BMCs, InfiniBand HCAs, Network Switches, and high-performance GPUs. Redfish & API Automation: Leverage Redfish and IPMI APIs to programmatically discover, configure, inventory, and update bare-metal assets at scale. Build Blast-Radius Protections: Architect robust telemetry pipelines to assess hardware health post-flash, and build automated rollback mechanisms to instantly recover from faulty vendor payloads. Tooling & Infrastructure as Code: Integrate firmware management pipelines cleanly into our existing configuration management ecosystems (SaltStack/Ansible) and provisioning workflows. Vendor & Engineering Liaison: Deep-dive into hardware errata and bug reports, collaborating closely with hardware vendors and internal platform teams to patch critical CVEs and performance regressions. Your key competencies Automation at Scale: Proven experience managing and updating firmware across thousands of nodes simultaneously. You don't do "one-off" flashes; you write code to update clusters. Deep Redfish Expertise: Mastery of the DMTF Redfish specification for server management, out-of-band communication, and telemetry collection. Hardware Polyglot: Strong understanding of the architectural differences in managing firmware across systemboards, network stacks (InfiniBand/Ethernet), and GPU architectures. Failure Domain Expertise: A paranoid mindset regarding hardware health. You know how to verify if a device is truly healthy post-boot and how to safely execute an unattended rollback if it isn't. Scripting & Infrastructure Code: Proficiency in Python, Go, or advanced shell scripting alongside configuration management tools (Ansible/Salt) to interact with hardware APIs. Nice-to-Haves Experience working within the OpenBMC ecosystem or building custom BMC firmware images. Deep operational familiarity with NVIDIA/Mellanox firmware management tools (mstflint, mlxup). Experience managing firmware lifecycles specifically within large-scale AI/ML training clusters or high-performance computing (HPC) environments. items.desc: Company Description Apex Logic Lab is a small experimental technology lab focused on understanding sports through reliable data infrastructure and machine learning. The team builds systems that transform real-time information from live events into clearer, more actionable views of games for partners and clients. Working at Apex Logic Lab offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge tools that support analysis, performance insights, and fan experiences. Team members collaborate closely in a fast-paced environment where innovation, accuracy, and curiosity about sports and technology are highly valued. Role Description The Live Sports Data Analyst is a contract, on-site at games role based in the Munich area. In this position, the individual will attend live sporting events or designated venues to capture real-time game data, including plays, statistics, and contextual information, using company tools and applications. Responsibilities include monitoring game flow, entering data with high accuracy and speed, verifying entries against established standards, and reporting any anomalies or technical issues to the operations team. The role also involves collaborating with data engineers and analysts to improve data collection processes, participating in training sessions to refine methods, and following strict quality and timing protocols. This position may require evening and weekend work aligned with live sports schedules. Qualifications Strong Data Collection skills with attention to detail and accuracy in fast-paced, real-time environments. Analytical Skills to interpret game situations, validate data, and recognize patterns or inconsistencies. Clear Communication skills to coordinate with team members, report issues, and follow operational guidelines. Experience with Training and Research to learn new tools quickly, apply standardized methods, and contribute to process improvements. Knowledge of major sports (rules, terminology, game flow) and enthusiasm for live sporting events. Comfort with technology, including mobile apps, data entry interfaces, and basic troubleshooting. Ability to work on-site in the Munich area, including evenings and weekends as available. Previous experience in sports statistics, live event operations, or a related data-focused field is beneficial; relevant education in fields such as sports management, statistics, or computer science is a plus. Pay We pay a base of $100 per game plus two bonuses based on your speed and accuracy. The first bonus, worth up to $200, is earned by avoiding major mistakes. The second bonus has no cap, and its size depends on how well you handle challenging situations (penalties, red cards, VAR) and how quickly you enter potential goals. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join our dynamic team and immerse yourself in the exciting world of power systems and controls! You will build transient models for grid-connected converters and plants, including renewable energy systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), HVDC, FACTS, and microgrids. Imagine defining and developing controller concepts that enhance the performance of converter-based assets, from inner controls to plant-level energy management. You will investigate the interactions among various systems, ensuring robust performance during normal operations and faults. Your expertise will drive innovation as you apply data analytics and AI/ML methods for predictive maintenance and load forecasting, all while mentoring the next generation of engineers in this critical field. How You’ll Make an Impact Develop and validate transient models for converter-based grid assets, including renewables, BESS, HVDC, FACTS, industrial loads, data centers, and microgrids Design, tune, and assess control strategies from converter inner controls to plant-level energy management and supervisory functions Implement grid-following and grid-forming controls, including synchronization, voltage/frequency support, and fault ride-through capabilities Analyze interactions between converter controls, plant controllers, and protection systems to optimize system performance and reliability Perform dynamic, transient, and small-signal studies to evaluate system behavior and support controller tuning in weak and low-inertia grids Apply advanced analytics and AI/ML techniques for forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, while providing technical leadership and mentoring What You Bring Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Power Systems, Control Engineering, or a related field with a focus on power systems and controls Extensive professional experience in power-system modeling and studies, including development and validation of RMS and EMT models Strong understanding of power-system dynamics, stability, fault response, and control interactions Practical expertise in converter-based technologies and control architectures, including grid-following and grid-forming controls Proficiency with industry-standard simulation tools (e.g., PowerFactory, PSCAD/EMTDC, MATLAB/Simulink) and programming in Python, MATLAB, or similar environments Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience in data analytics/AI/ML considered an advantage; fluent English required, German a plus About the Team In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. items.desc: Allow us to introduce ourselves Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions. We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally. Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here Your mission as a (Senior) Product Designer We’re looking for a (Senior) Product Designer (m/f/d) to help shape the core experiences of our B2B research platform and B2C panel app. You'll work alongside a team of product designers, product managers and engineers to identify problems, explore solutions and ship great products. What you’ll be doing Find problems worth solving . Proactively identify opportunities through your own exploration and research, user conversations and feedback from research experts and product managers. Turn problems into solutions . Take ideas from early concepts and prototypes to polished UIs and shipped features. Prototype in code . Build and test ideas directly in the existing product using tools like Cursor. Raise the bar for craft . Sweat the details, from typography, color and spacing to composition and interaction, to make our products feel polished and considered. You will thrive in this role if You are autonomous and proactive . You don’t need every problem fully specified before you can get started. You take initiative and own features end to end. You are craft-driven . You have a high bar for quality and know how to make software feel polished down to the smallest details. You are experienced in complex software . You’ve designed dashboards and platforms with complex workflows and information structures, not just websites. Ideally with experience in data visualization and dashboarding. You are strong in information design . You know how to turn complex information into clear, easy-to-understand interfaces. You are a systems thinker . You build reusable patterns rather than isolated screens and have experience working with design systems. You are comfortable with motion . You use motion intentionally to communicate state, time and dynamism. You are a collaborative team player . You work closely with product managers and engineers as well as stakeholders across the organization to find the right solutions and bring them to life. You are curious about new technology . You actively experiment with AI tools in your design workflow and look for new ways to work and build. You are based in one of the countries where we operate : Germany, Spain, the Netherlands, or the UK. What’s in it for you? Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year All the hardware you need and your own MacBook If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces. Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English. This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm. Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Please read our privacy policy here . Learn more about us: appinio.com LinkedIn Xing Kununu Instagram

Wir sind ein starkes Team aus Nachvorneschauern*, Cleverdenkern, Innovationstreibern und Visionenverwirklichern – so gestalten wir gemeinsam die Gegenwart und die Zukunft. Werde Teil des Teams! items.desc: Location Am Campus 1 74177 Bad Friedrichshall Employment Area IT - Cloud Services Level Experienced professional Working Model Full-time Reference ID 5202 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Here, you will shape the face and services of our cloud: You will develop the STACKIT Portal and Marketplace, the central interface for our customers - from robust backend services to the user interface. Your Tasks You build it, you run it! You take responsibility for the design, implementation, and operation of our applications in the STACKIT Marketplace – focusing on Go backend services or acting as a versatile fullstack developer. Go & Backend Specialist: You design and develop scalable backend services and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architectures in Go (Golang), providing high-performance REST and gRPC APIs. UX/UI Realizer: In close collaboration with our UX designers, you transform wireframes and prototypes into pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible user interfaces that delight our customers. Quality First: You don’t just write code; you guarantee the highest software quality through unit tests and end-to-end tests. Teamplayer & Visionary: You work agilely with Product Owners and Backend Engineers to turn technical visions into reality and actively drive the further development of our frontend tech stack. Mentor & Coach: You enjoy sharing your knowledge! You support your colleagues with code reviews and establish best practices in the our domain. Your Profile Backend or Fullstack Engineer: You have several years of experience in professional software engineering, primarily focused on backend development (Go, microservices, API design) or fullstack development. Go & API Enthusiast: You master Go (Golang) or a comparable modern backend language and have deep expertise in REST API design and microservice architecture. Frontend Experience (Optional / Plus): Knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, and modern web architectures is a major plus for fullstack profiles, though optional for pure backend specialists. Tooling Pro: You are familiar with build tools (Webpack, NX), package managers (npm, yarn), and have experience setting up CI/CD pipelines (e.g., with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) for frontend deployments. Cloud Affinity: Basic knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes is a plus, as you work in a "You build it, you run it" environment and can deploy your containers yourself. Problem-Solver: Complex UI logic or asynchronous data streams don’t make you sweat – your analytical skills help you find elegant solutions. Teamplayer: You are a communication pro and enjoy working agilely in a team that pushes each other. Communication: English (spoken and written) is a must, as we are positioned internationally. German is a plus. Your contact Heiko Kiefer Recruiter E-Mail:recruiting@mail.schwarz What happens once you applied? 1 Application We love simplicity. Apply quickly and easily digitally, even without registration. 2 Checkup Together with the department, we take a look at your documents. 3 Interview When you first get to know each other, the focus is on both your personality and your professional suitability. 4 Contract offer Have we convinced each other? Then your employment contract is on its way to you digitally by e-mail. 5 Welcome Your first day of work with is about to begin and your individual onboarding in the team begins. We look forward to seeing you!
