items.desc: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Our Implementation Consultants start the customers journey after signature working with our top customers. They own the customer relationship and are responsible for a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. You understand the value they are trying to achieve and work with them to define and deliver a project plan to achieve this. Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. Will require travel to customer sites for up to 30% of the time, which may include overnight stays. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. In this role, you will: Be the Samsara advisor, managing the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment Lead solution workshops to develop L1 processes for business process Guide customers through change management processes including policy, comms and training Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara's technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers Minimum requirements for the role: 2+ years of experience in an implementation consultant, project manager, or onboarding role. Enterprise SaaS and hardware experience preferred Strong project management skills with ability to follow methodologies 2+ years experience supporting or working with technical products Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving & project management skills Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations Experience managing >20 implementations/projects at a time Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment Fluency in English and German (spoken and written) is a mandatory requirement for this position An ideal candidate also has: Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards Change management delivery experience Experience using AI or automation into CS workflows to drive measurable productivity improvements. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, …

items.desc: Company Description Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 20 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission. Job Description Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind, as well as other non-hydro renewable initiatives like PV/Solar and batteries. We currently develop, construct and operate wind generation assets across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. As (Senior) Project Engineer you deliver engineering work packages for a development or execution project by ensuring technical compliance, coordinating technical interfaces with other work packages, communicating with suppliers and stakeholders, and managing quality, risks and documentation throughout the contract lifecycle. You will lead the cable accessories scope, including HV terminations, fibre optic terminations, hang-offs and installation accessories, as well as their associated installation methodologies and technical interfaces. Key Responsibilities : Ensure delivery of assigned work packages per contractual requirements and standards Perform technical review of reports, design and system studies supplied by contractors and third parties (e.g. Accessories Design and Installation Procedures, technical studies and investigations,.) and verify compliance with Vattenfall’s requirements Support supplier qualification activities, factory visits, inspections, testing and technical workshops as required Review and support development of offshore installation, handling, termination and testing procedures Interface with other packages and plant suppliers, to ensure consistency, technical compatibility and quality of the performed works Manage technical queries and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders Ensure timely documentation of findings, lessons learned and proactively share knowledge within the department and the wider organisation where relevant Monitor and report on safety, quality, progress, and cost in a structured and timely manner Manage risks, opportunities and mitigation plans for own scope Engage with internal stakeholders to handle deviations from the Employer’s Requirements Collaborate with Legal/Contract Management on claims related to IAC Plan and coordinate assigned technical activities within the project schedule Represent technical interests within cross-functional project discussions We welcome applications from candidates at either Intermediate or Senior level. For Intermediate-level candidates, we are particularly interested in individuals who demonstrate strong technical capabilities, a high level of motivation, and a willingness to learn and develop further Location : The role will be based in one of Vattenfall’s office locations in Amsterdam (Netherlands) or Hamburg (Germany). Some travel to other offices/suppliers shall be expected. Qualifications Your profile : B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical engineering or similar Experience working as project engineer on large-scale projects with the inter array cables scope Strong theoretical knowledge and/or practical experience with cable accessories, including terminations, hang-offs, fibre optic connections and their associated installation activities on an offshore wind farm. Technical knowledge of Inter array cable system for wind farms with focus on technical interfaces towards the wind turbine, its foundation as well as the offshore substation. Experience with cable installation, electrical system design or systems engineering will be considered a plus. Understanding of the commercial impact of technical choices Good communication, collaboration and influencing skills High degree of self-motivation and autonomy Continuous learning and improvement mindset Willingness to travel and perform remote work from supplier’s sites/offices Good English language skills and preferably also good German and/or Dutch Additional Information Our offer We offer an international and collaborative working environment, attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work with experienced colleagues across disciplines and …

items.desc: Job Description: Zur Unterstützung von Facility Management Services / KONS13 sucht Airbus Aerostructures am Standort Nordenham einen Koordinator Flächenmanagement & FM Services (d/m/w). Dein Standort Der Standort Nordenham bildet mit rund 4000 Beschäftigten das Zentrum für den Schalen- und Sektionsbau sowie die Großblechfertigung der Airbus Aerostructures GmbH. Im Bereich der integrierten Schalenfertigung zählt Nordenham zu den weltweit modernsten Produktionsstandorten. Automatisierte und hochinnovative Fertigungstechnologien ermöglichen am Standort Nordenham den Bau von Komponenten für modernste Flugzeuge. Rund 5.000 Rumpfschalen und vollständig montierte Rumpfsektionen für fast alle Flugzeuge der Airbus-Familie verlassen jährlich das Werk Nordenham. Technologische Schwerpunkte am Standort Nordenham bilden die Profilfertigung, das Streckziehen von großflächigen Metallstrukturen, das Metallkleben sowie die Herstellung und Montage von Kohlenstofffaserbauteilen. Dein Arbeitsort direkt an der Weser Du arbeitest in Nordenham zwischen Wattenmeer und Unterweser, geprägt durch landschaftliche Idylle und kilometerweiter Sicht bis zum Horizont. Für Großstadtfeeling sind Bremerhaven, Bremen und Oldenburg im pendelbaren Umkreis. items.desc: Join Tylko, Where Design Meets Technology Founded in Warsaw, Poland, in 2015, Tylko is redefining how we design, shop for, and experience furniture. Frustrated by mass-produced, one-size-fits-all solutions, the team created something smarter: bespoke storage that balances cutting-edge technology, premium craftsmanship, and sustainable production. With millimetre-perfect precision, every piece is made-to-order and crafted locally , minimising waste and maximising longevity. The result? A new standard in furniture – one that fits your space, your style, and your life. Why It Matters We’re not just building furniture. We’re changing how people think about living with it. By merging technology and design, we help people create spaces that truly reflect who they are. If you believe that good design can make everyday life better, you’ll feel right at home here. How We Work We believe in small teams, big ideas, and simple processes. No endless paperwork, no silos. Just open communication, shared goals, and a healthy dose of curiosity. We start small, think big, and move fast, because progress always beats perfection . At Tylko, collaboration and trust aren’t buzzwords - they’re how we work. From day one, you’re part of a team that makes real decisions and brings them to life together. You’ll have the freedom to share ideas, turn them into action, and shape the space around you literally. Here, learning isn’t a bonus. It’s part of the job. AI is part of how we work - it's not an add-on here . We treat it like any other tool worth knowing: it helps us think, decide, and move faster. We're not looking for people who "know AI" - we're looking for people curious enough to rethink how they work altogether. You don't need to be an expert on day one - you need the drive to grow. About the Role We’re currently looking for a Design Advisor (minijob position) to join our team in the Berlin flagship store . If you’re passionate about design and love helping people create beautiful, functional spaces, this role is for you. You’ll be the bridge between Tylko’s product innovation and our customers, offering expert advice and a personalized experience rooted in creativity and technology. As a Design Advisor, you’ll be part of a close-knit showroom team, supporting customers through every step of their journey – from exploring personalised furniture options to configuring their ideal piece. Your goal? To make every visit inspiring, informative, and deeply connected to the Tylko brand. Once you join our Team you will be responsible for: Customer greeting and consultation, providing tailored design advice and product recommendations Introduction and explanation of Tylko’s configuration system, materials, sustainability initiatives, and R&D innovations in a clear and engaging manner Guidance through digital configurator and augmented reality tools to help customers visualise and personalise furniture Collaboration with architects, interior designers, and B2B clients visiting the showroom Maintenance of visual merchandising standards to ensure alignment with Tylko’s brand identity Support for in-store events such as talks, workshops, and design activations Collection of customer feedback and sharing insights with HQ and R&D teams Contribution to store performance goals, including customer satisfaction and sales targets What we offer for this particular role: A chance to shape Tylko’s flagship retail presence and influence our physical retail strategy Competitive salary with performance-based bonus Employee discount on Tylko products Inspiring work environment in the heart of Berlin Opportunity to grow within a fast-scaling European design brand Access to training, development, and cross-team collaboration with HQ What we’re looking for: Passion for design, furniture, and architecture – supported by studies or strong personal interest Excellent communication skills in German and English Skilled at explaining technical product details in a simple, engaging, and passionate way Approachable and confident in communication – able to quickly build trust, understand customer needs, and offer thoughtful, personalised design advice Comfortable using digital tools, such as configuration software and CRM systems Team-oriented mindset with a proactive, entrepreneurial approach Motivated by innovation, sustainability, and creating great customer experiences Openess to work in a minijob position; flexibility to work weekends and evenings as required by retail operations It would be an additional plus if you have: Previous experience in a customer-facing role (retail, showroom, hospitality, or service)

items.desc: About the Role As a Quantum Computing Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in mathematical methods for quantum computing, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Physics with a quantum physics focus. You have hands-on experience developing software for quantum systems, or quantum technologies within embedded systems. You excel at modeling quantum threats — side-channel attacks, adversarial pertubations, backdoors, … — and translating into practical security defenses. You will be one of Haste's first quantum security researchers pioneering defenses for quantum compute environments alongside HPC and AI workloads. Key Responsibilities Investigate side channels, adversarial perturbations, backdoors and quantum system vulnerabilities. Develop Python research software and proof-of-concept implementations. Translate findings into defenses and production-grade requirements. Document research through reports, whitepapers and demonstrations. Monitor quantum security research, standards and frameworks. Requirements Minimum MSc in Physics focused on quantum physics. Current residence in Germany or Austria. Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only. Quantum computing mathematics, Python development, quantum threat modeling and security engineering capabilities.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You will be a global subject matter expert for electrical products deployed in data centers. We are looking for engineers with hands-on design, manufacturing, and installation experience. They should be capable of understanding detailed equipment specifications and evaluating the merit and risks of design changes. Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but is not expected to exceed 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be required. Contributions could include leading international projects and developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary. Listen to the voice of the customer to understand if there are improvements that can be made to increase product reliability or availability. Work with global supplier and manufacturers to design product improvements, and to oversee root cause analysis. Contribute to our global body of knowledge and drive a cycle of continuous improvement at a global scale A day in the life In this role, you'll focus on the electrical products that form the backbone of AWS data centers worldwide. You might start your day reviewing equipment submittals and specifications, then transition into a collaborative session with our product development team to understand how new electrical systems are being designed and tested. You'll work across multiple geographic zones simultaneously, sometimes supporting field engineering teams through root cause analysis investigations, other times partnering with global suppliers to explore design improvements. Your work includes translating complex electrical systems into clear documentation and guidance for operations teams, while staying connected to how your decisions impact customer reliability and availability. You'll also contribute to our collective knowledge base, sharing insights that help drive continuous improvement across our global infrastructure. About the team The Electrical Products and Services team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, we are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. We drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to Senior Leadership. We seek new ways to enhance the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, you can design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on. items.desc: What are we building? At Hard Rock Games, we’re not just making games—we’re crafting experiences that connect people, deliver thrills, and celebrate the spirit of Hard Rock. As the social casino gaming arm of Hard Rock Digital, our teams shape every stage of the journey from concept to launch to live operations, giving our teams the ability to innovate, experiment, and make real impact. With the backing of a globally recognized brand, we combine the agility of a startup with the reach of an entertainment powerhouse. Here, creativity thrives, ideas scale, and careers grow. We’re looking for passionate creators, builders, and innovators to join us in shaping the future of free-to- play gaming. Let’s play hard. What’s the position? Hard Rock Games is hiring a Slot Mathematician to design, model, and validate the math behind our slot games across our game portfolio. You will own the mathematical correctness of every game - from design through player-facing release - ensuring models meet target performance metrics and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Design and model slot game math: reel strips, paytables, symbol weights, bonus features, free spins, and jackpots. Tune models to hit target RTP, hit frequency, and volatility, including multiple RTP variants. Analyze simpler games directly using data analysis tools; write and validate simulations in code for more complex games. Playtest game builds and verify that implemented games match the designed model, payouts, and feature behavior. Produce PAR sheets and comprehensive math documentation for internal review and certification labs (GLI, BMM). Support regulatory certification across jurisdictions by answering lab and regulator questions. Partner with game designers early, advising on feature costs in RTP and impact on volatility. Help build a shared Java codebase of simulators, model libraries and math tools, starting from our existing tools. Work closely with developers from specification through release to ensure correct math implementation. Leverage AI tools to prototype ideas, generate code, and explore possibilities - while maintaining full ownership of correctness. What are we looking for? 3+ years designing math models for slot games with shipped titles in iGaming, Social, or Land- Based environments. Experience in a regulated environment is preferred. Ability to build and analyze slot models directly using data analysis tools - comfortable performing direct mathematical analysis. Strong programming and problem-solving skills; Java preferred, but solid Python, C++, or C# is welcome. Comfort with version control systems like Git and working in shared code repositories. Strong grasp of probability, combinatorics, and expected-value analysis. Ability to manually verify, derive, and explain math results. You understand why a model is correct, not just that it runs. Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Clear communication skills - explaining math concepts to designers, producers, and regulators. What’s in it for you? Make a visible impact: you’ll own campaigns and events that shape how millions play. Fast-paced execution + brand heritage: build boldly under the Hard Rock name. Competitive compensation with flexible vacation and hybrid work. Be part of a player-obsessed, inclusive team that trusts your autonomy and skills. Influence product strategies, your post-mortems and insights will steer our roadmaps. Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

items.desc: About COPE Galway COPE Galway has been providing essential social services in Galway for 60 years . We respond to the needs of people experiencing homelessness, women and children subjected to domestic abuse, and we support older people towards healthy, independent ageing. Our vision is for a community where every person is valued, cared for, and supported at every stage of life. COPE Galway is deeply embedded in the Galway community. We are founded on the belief that together we can make a positive difference in the lives of the people we serve and our community. Our People Our People, COPE Galway staff and volunteers, are the driving force behind everything we do. Their passion, commitment, and professionalism enable us to deliver a wide range of services, support more people, and make a real impact in the community. We have a diverse range of roles, from frontline support workers and social care professionals to catering, community engagement and other professional roles. Each role is crucial in ensuring we deliver our services effectively and make a positive impact in the community. Working with COPE Galway Joining our team means you will make a lasting, positive impact on the lives of the families and individuals we support and contribute to driving meaningful social change in the community. Whether you are a frontline worker directly supporting clients or in an administrative role, you are vital to our efforts to address critical issues like homelessness and domestic abuse and to ensure that older people are valued and supported. At COPE Galway, we prioritise the development and wellbeing of our people. We offer a supportive work environment, with opportunities for ongoing training, personal and professional growth, and leadership development. Our Culture We foster an inclusive, supportive and respectful workplace , where diversity is valued. Our team is united by a shared mission and a genuine passion for empowering people and creating meaningful change. We take a trauma-informed approach to the way we work and foster this culture in every aspect of the organisation, including a focus on the health and wellbeing of our staff. Homeless Services COPE Galway Homeless Service supports families and individuals in Galway who are homeless or at risk of becoming homeless. We provide residential and non-residential services, including a day centre, street outreach, supported temporary accommodation and seasonal cold weather responses. Our family services offer family-focused support, emergency accommodation, and specific developmental support for children. Our resettlement service and Housing First programme teams work with individuals moving on from homelessness to secure long-term housing. The Role There is a reliance on private emergency accommodation (PEA) including B&Bs, Hotels, Tourist Hostels, Holiday apartments etc. to meet the emergency accommodation needs of families, individuals and couples who are homeless in Galway. COPE Galway Family Services and the COPE Galway Day Centre organise and facilitate placements on behalf of Galway City Council and Galway County Council in such accommodation with bookings ranging in duration from as little as one night to a number of weeks and months at a time. The overall purpose of this role is to source suitable private emergency accommodation and to co-ordinate and support engagement with accommodation providers in conducting assessment of this accommodation against required standards. The role will involve visiting PEA emergency accommodation on a regular basis including in advance of placements and on foot of complaints and feedback for the purposes of ensuring that required standards are being met and resolving accommodation related issues with families and individuals (in conjunction with another staff member when required). The role was also involve liaising with accommodation providers on behalf of clients, COPE Galway and the local authorities adopting a solutions focused approach. The role will have direct interactions with people in Homeless Services. It is a challenging and also rewarding position focused on finding the best emergency accommodation placements possible for people despite resource challenges/accommodation shortages, working to ensure that the accommodation is maintained at the required standards and striving to support placement sustainment for people experiencing homelessness. The team member will manage relationships with accommodation providers and support the PEA Administrator to deal with the administration tasks associated with these placements. The role includes ensuring that booking forms are accurate and up to date at the point and time of placement and reviewing any changes/adjustments to the bookings. This requires working in close cooperation with the PEA, Family Services and Day Centre teams. items.desc: Since 1994, Microdata Due has been a trusted leader in advanced fire safety technologies for the marine industry. As part of Consilium Safety Group, we develop innovative safety solutions that protect lives, assets, and operations worldwide. Backed by Antin Infrastructure Partners, a leading private equity firm, Consilium Safety Group is on an ambitious growth and transformation journey. With strong financial support and a clear strategic direction, we continue to invest in innovation, operational excellence, and talented people who want to make a difference. This is an exciting opportunity to join an international company where you can grow professionally, take on new challenges, and contribute to cutting-edge technology development. We are now looking for an Electronics Test Technician to join Production and Testing Department. About the role As an Electronics Test Technician, you will play an important role in ensuring the quality, reliability and performance of our electronic products. Working closely with colleagues in production and engineering, you will carry out testing, troubleshooting and verification activities throughout the manufacturing process. Main responsibilities Perform functional testing of electronic boards, including fault finding and diagnosis of failures and anomalies. Verify wiring and cable harnesses against electrical drawings and technical specifications. Integrate equipment and sub-assemblies into finished systems. Conduct final product testing to ensure compliance with quality requirements before delivery to customers. Prepare and maintain test documentation and technical reports. Your profile We are looking for a structured and quality-oriented individual with a genuine interest in electronics and testing. You are methodical, accurate and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. To succeed in this role, you have: A technical diploma in electronics, electrical engineering or an equivalent qualification. The ability to read and interpret electrical and electronic schematics. Good practical knowledge of laboratory instruments, including oscilloscopes, multimeters and function generators. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel. A structured approach to problem-solving and strong attention to detail and quality. The ability to collaborate effectively while taking responsibility for your own tasks. Additional qualifications and experience The following qualifications and experience would be considered an advantage: Knowledge of English, particularly for reading and understanding technical documentation. Previous experience in a similar position. Practical experience in THT and SMD component soldering on printed circuit boards (PCBs). Experience in manufacturing wiring harnesses, including soldering, crimping and wire-wrap connections. Experience in preparing production and quality documentation, such as Test Reports, Process Flow Charts and Certificates of Conformity (CoC). Join us and make a difference At Consilium Safety Group, you will become part of an international organisation committed to innovation, quality and safety. We offer the opportunity to contribute to products and technologies that make a real difference in protecting people and critical infrastructure. Ready to put your technical skills to work in an organisation shaping the future of SafetyTech? Apply today and become part of Consilium Safety Group!

Role Description The Live Sports Data Analyst is a contract, on-site at games role based in the Milan area. In this position, the individual will attend live sporting events or designated venues to capture real-time game data, including plays, statistics, and contextual information, using company tools and applications. Responsibilities include monitoring game flow, entering data with high accuracy and speed, verifying entries against established standards, and reporting any anomalies or technical issues to the operations team. The role also involves collaborating with data engineers and analysts to improve data collection processes, participating in training sessions to refine methods, and following strict quality and timing protocols. Knowledge of major sports (rules, terminology, game flow) and enthusiasm for live sporting events. Comfort with technology, including mobile apps, data entry interfaces, and basic troubleshooting. Ability to work on-site in the Milan area, including evenings and weekends as available. Chi cerchiamo? Per la Direzione Industries Energy Projects – Global Business Unit Local Energy Infrastructures, siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire con il ruolo di Manutentore elettrico all'interno del team Industrial & Facility Energy Services presso la sede del nostro cliente a Milano . ENGIE nell’ambito della linea di business Industries Energy Projects , si impegna a rendere l’impresa un luogo sostenibile ed efficiente offrendo soluzioni su misura dedicate ai servizi, agli spazi e alle persone (Facility Management) e lavori di realizzazione e manutenzione (Construction). ENGIE è infatti in grado di finanziare qualsiasi intervento energetico che migliori le performance del cliente, garantisca innovazione, ottimizzazione dei consumi energetici e riduzione delle emissioni di CO2. items.desc: Job Description Summary Job Description Responsible Investment team and role overview The Aegon Asset Management Responsible Investment team brings together ESG, sustainability and impact expertise at the heart of our investment business. The team plays an important role in investment research and product development, engagement, client discussions and helps both the firm and our clients navigate the evolving sustainability landscape. Based in Amsterdam, the 7-person highly international team works in a hybrid model, combining close in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote working. This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants to build a strong foundation in responsible investment. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive and eager to learn and develop. You will gain hands-on experience across sustainability research, engagement, ESG and impact data, and reporting, working on real investment and sustainability questions from day one. You will support: Sustainability Research : Working closely with the rest of the RI team. Researching material ESG issues facing potential investment opportunities. This includes analyzing, identifying improvements and monitoring company and sector specific ESG issues. Engagement & Voting: Supporting engagement with companies to encourage improvements identified. Working with the wider team to plan, execute and document engagement efforts (letters, calls, meetings); and provide sector and company analysis to support engagement with corporates, policy makers and investor bodies. Contributing towards voting at the company Annual Meetings. ESG and Impact data Reporting: Carrying out a robust monitoring and reporting processes, supporting other team members with ESG and impact research, reporting and data management. Providing data to various teams and external clients. Start your career in responsible investment, learn from an experienced international team, work directly on real investment and sustainability questions, and progressively build your own areas of expertise. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, management, political science, international development, or related fields Genuine interest in responsible investment; familiarity with ESG issues is an advantage Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Dutch is a distinct advantage Able to work independently and establish/maintain working relationships internally Proactive and collaborative attitude, comfortable asking questions and learning from others A strong learning mindset, intellectual curiosity and eagerness to develop professionally Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in a relevant field Strong verbal and written communication in Dutch are an advantage Company Overview: Aegon Asset Management (Aegon AM) is a leading global investor. Our 350+ investment professionals manage and advise on assets of US $446 billion for a global client base of pension plans, public funds, insurance companies, banks, wealth managers, family offices and foundations. We organize our firm around four investment platforms: fixed income, real assets, equities and multi-asset & solutions, which includes a fiduciary and multi-manager business. Each investment platform has dedicated teams with deep asset-class expertise, organized globally and committed to maximizing client benefit from their specialist areas. We are an international business: Our 1,130 employees work from 16 locations across Europe, the Americas and Asia. Bij Prijsvrij Vakanties en D-reizen draait alles om data: van betrouwbare datastromen tot automatiseringen, dashboards en analyses die collega’s helpen betere keuzes te maken. Ons data team groeit, en daarbij geloven we in één ding: de juiste persoon is belangrijker dan de juiste functietitel. Ben jij een echt datatalent? Dan maken we graag een plek voor je. Vertel ons waar jouw krachten liggen, dan kijken we samen hoe jij het beste tot je recht komt in ons team. ✈️ Bij ons data team kun je terecht als: Data Engineer: je bouwt en beheert pipelines, databases en koppelingen, en zorgt dat data klopt en beschikbaar is; AI Engineer: je bouwt toepassingen met LLM’s en AI-agents en zorgt dat AI echt waarde toevoegt in onze processen; Data Scientist: je ontwikkelt voorspellende modellen en zet machine learning en AI in waar het waarde toevoegt; Data Analyst: je vertaalt vragen uit de organisatie naar heldere analyses en bouwt dashboards in Power BI die collega’s dagelijks gebruiken; Business Analyst: je vormt de brug tussen de business en het data team, en zorgt dat de juiste vragen worden beantwoord. Herken je jezelf in een combinatie van deze rollen? Nog beter! Dit krijg jij: De allerbeste deal! De reis van jouw leven met een positie in een informele organisatie, waar harde werkers het verschil maken voor onze klanten. De mogelijkheid om je intern te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij ontvangen je met open armen in een hecht en gezellig team, waar je samen met je collega’s bijdraagt aan onze missie: een zorgeloze reis voor de beste prijs! Een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden; 25 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime) en 8% vakantiegeld; Een goede pensioenregeling via Nationale Nederlanden; Korting op je eigen vakanties én Friends & Family-korting om weg te geven; Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 kilometer enkele reis; Volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden via My Academy; Een moderne werkplek in het bruisende hart van ‘s-Hertogenbosch; Office gym, een handig fietsplan en collectiviteitskorting bij CZ; Gezelligheid gegarandeerd met onze vrijdagmiddagborrels, Bossche bollen als er iets te vieren is én maandelijks een padeltoernooi. Of je al een tijdje werkt en toe bent aan een volgende stap, of net bent afgestudeerd: je bent welkom. Talent zit niet in je leeftijd, maar in wat je kunt en wat je nog wilt leren. Jij (gaat op vakantie en) neemt mee: Een afgeronde hbo of wo-opleiding; Een technische basis, opgedaan tijdens je studie of in een eerdere baan, en de wil om die verder uit te bouwen; Ambitie om het beste uit data te halen, en uit jezelf; Een analytische blik: je ziet patronen in data en weet wat je er wel en niet uit kunt concluderen; Een zelfstandige en gestructureerde houding, waarmee je makkelijk schakelt bij ad-hoc vragen; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Je woont in de regio Den Bosch en haalt energie uit samenwerken met collega’s op kantoor. Ready for take-off? Klaar om samen met ons data om te zetten in een zorgeloze reis voor de beste prijs? We maken graag kennis met je! Nog vragen? We zijn maar één belletje of WhatsAppje van je verwijderd: 06 45 49 13 03.

items.desc: Your mission Will you be our new all-round Front Office employee at the Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - City Hall? We are looking for a new colleague for one of the most vibrant hotels in Amsterdam, a real all-rounder who likes variety and a challenge. Do you have a heart for the reception and do you like variety? Then this role is really something for you. A work day as an all-round Front Office employee: You enter one of the nicest hotels in Amsterdam, we opened in 2018 and everything still looks spick and span. Your colleagues say hello and you walk to our back office. Here we do a handover, look at the arrivals and check-outs of the day and get started. Today again very nice international guests with whom you can have a chat. You tell them about Amsterdam and what they can do here. There is laughter and the guests see you as a real insider. Some guests come in wanting a drink, so you step behind the bar and pour them a nice drink. It's wonderful to see the variety between different departments and the contact with the guests. Two colleagues come by and you have a chat. The end of your shift is approaching and you ensure that the reports are closed, your cash register is correct and you prepare the handover for your colleagues. The next two days you are off, in the middle of the week while the rest of the Netherlands is at work! Who we are and what defines us About Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - City Hall In April 2018 we opened our Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - City Hall and since then we have been delighted to receive many international guests. We have 89 rooms and a cozy bar that is also part of the reception. As a result, we have a lot of personal contact with our guests. We are part of Borealis Hotel Group and managed by Interstate Hotels & Resorts. BHG is a fast growing well known hotel developer with hotels operating in Europe under the brands IHG, Hilton, Accor. So plenty of opportunities to grow. Your profile Do you have the X-press factor? Are you able to follow certain policies and standards, are you precise but at the same time creative to come up with new ideas? Then we would like to welcome you at the Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam – City Hall. What are you bringing? Computer skills, some experience in reception – front office and the desire to work on flexible times and days, just like your colleagues. Benefits Because you become part of a growing hotel group, you get on the personal development train from day one. With us you are immediately on the radar and we take you along in your career, whereby your training and development are our top priority. We pay well and you get a discount at thousands of IHG hotels all over the world! Are you as excited as we are? Then we look forward to receiving your motivation letter & CV About us Borealis Hotel Group Is an expanding European hospitality company which develops, owns, operates and manages select-service, full-service and extended-stay hotels, which are all branded by international hotel chains like InterContinental Hotels Group, Accor, Hilton Hotels & Resorts and Marriott. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Amstelveen & Wiesbaden, our passionate and experienced team started building todays portfolio in 2016. Being active in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Austria, Spain and Denmark and being backed by strong institutional investors, it is our ambition to further grow our portfolio. Our vision and values We consider our values to be self-evident. Nevertheless, they are indispensable to achieve our ultimate goals: To be the most attractive hotel operator for employees, brands & investors, by delivering operational excellence that results in the highest guest satisfaction. What sets us apart The soul of our hotels, which are a result of the behaviour of our employees. That’s where we are proud of. The feeling to be part of one and the same family! Creating joyful people experiences together: for our guests, our colleagues and stakeholders! We love the hotel industry! The combination of high standards of professionalism and quality as well as humanity and closeness. The balance of happy employees, satisfied guests and economic success. A good working atmosphere, opportunities for advancement, appreciation and the chance to make a difference.

items.desc: Bij Scenius bouw je software die je terugziet in het echte leven: betaalplatforms, pin terminals en apps die door miljoenen mensen worden gebruikt. We doen dat voor startups, scale-ups en enterprises in fintech, legaltech, healthtech en daarbuiten, en we zijn erbij van het eerste idee tot na de release. Dat doen we vanuit ons eigen kantoor in Eindhoven, in vaste teams waarin ook de oprichters nog altijd meebouwen. Je werkt bij Scenius en blijft dat ook: naar de klant ga je als het product daarom vraagt, daarna bouw je weer verder met je eigen team. Klanten komen terug met hun volgende product, en daardoor groeien we hard. Die groei investeren we ook in onszelf. Zo staat er op kantoor ons eigen AI-cluster, Codey, met 10 GPU's en ruim 750 GB VRAM, waarop we open source modellen draaien en AI in onze producten bouwen. Projecten waar wij aan werken Voor Pay.nl maken we de telefoon tot kassa, met encryptie, kaartcommunicatie en software voor terminals die dag en nacht moet draaien. Voor in3 bouwen we een modulair betaalplatform met iDEAL- en Rabobank-integraties en een mobiele app op Kubernetes. En voor Appir werken we aan een e-commerceproduct waarin aanbevelingsalgoritmes bepalen welke kleding je ziet. Wat je gaat doen als Software Developer Als Software Developer bouw je mee aan complete digitale producten. Je denkt mee over het product design en de architectuur, schrijft de code en spreekt de klant direct. Je reviewt elkaars code, beslist samen met de mensen die het bouwen en blijft na de oplevering betrokken, zodat je ziet hoe je werk zich in productie houdt. Je werkt aan 2 soorten projecten. Soms bouw je iets vanaf nul, van een eerste MVP tot een volwaardige release. Soms stap je in bij een product dat al draait en moet groeien, met meer gebruikers, betere performance of nieuwe koppelingen. Het eerste vraagt om durven kiezen, het tweede om goed begrijpen wat er al staat. Bij Scenius doe je allebei, of het nu gaat om custom software, een webapplicatie, een mobiele app of een AI-implementatie. Onze stack Backend en architectuur: .NET (C#), Python, Go, microservices, Enterprise Service Bus Frontend en mobile: React, React Native, TypeScript Cloud en DevOps: Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, GCP en Codey Wie jij bent Je bent een productbouwer. Je wilt iets opleveren dat echt gebruikt wordt, en daarna weten hoe het zich houdt bij duizenden mensen tegelijk. We zijn kritisch op wie we aannemen, omdat iedereen hier keihard verantwoordelijk is voor wat de klant krijgt. Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een professionele softwareomgeving Een hbo- of wo-opleiding, of werk dat laat zien wat je kunt Ervaring met een strict typed, goed gedocumenteerde en goed geteste enterprise stack Ervaring met agile werken in teamverband Goed Nederlands in woord en geschrift Wat we bieden Bij Scenius bepaal je zelf hoe je werkt, zolang je levert wat je belooft. Je groeit door steeds meer van het product in handen te nemen, en je mag daarbij helemaal jezelf zijn, met of zonder gebruiksaanwijzing. Serieus werk, met plezier onderweg. Een goed salaris en direct een vast dienstverband Afwisselend werk: enterprise software voor de ene klant, bleeding edge technologie voor de andere, in B2B en B2C Veel verantwoordelijkheid en direct contact met de product en engineering teams bij de klant zonder lagen management ertussen Altijd toegang tot Codey, ons eigen AI-cluster, om nieuwe modellen te testen en AI in je werk te gebruiken Je eigen pc, werkplek en lichtshow, helemaal naar jouw smaak samengesteld Flexibele werktijden: begin ergens tussen 6 en 11 uur, zolang je je uren maakt en laat weten wat je doet. Your Metrics New-customer ROAS (per market) New opportunities per month (per market) Responsibilities Be the in-house owner of paid acquisition. You run the main markets yourself and keep the whole picture together: a bi-weekly sync with our freelance Google Ads specialist (smaller markets) and our Meta Ads specialist, one shared plan across all markets, and the cross-market work (tracking, feeds, structure) done once for everyone. As you gain more experience, you grow into leading paid acquisition as a whole. Run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads for your markets (about 70% of budget): execute the weekly change list (keywords, negatives, targets, budgets), challenge it when the data says otherwise, and keep the accounts clean. Keep every market on pace against its monthly and yearly plan, and act when it drifts. Own tracking and attribution. Our B2B sales process can be long and complicated. Our CRM sends opportunity and deal values to the ad platforms; you make sure that stays accurate across Google, Microsoft and GA4. Our tech team builds and adjusts, you specify and test. You have all the data and tools at your disposal: Claude, GA4, PostHog, CRM and platform data, and you dig in yourself. Write and test ad copy and assets across languages, with native speakers where needed. Pick landing pages that match the search, brief and run landing-page tests with our UI/UX designer and content people, and keep Merchant Center and the Shopping feeds healthy across markets. Run new experiments: new campaign types, new markets, new offers. Think along on the bigger picture with the growth lead: which market offering we improve next, which product categories we advertise on and how we make them profitable. You pull in the people it takes: UI/UX, product, content, sales. Work with our AI tooling (Claude) every day. Pick up growth work beyond ads when it comes up: outbound campaigns, new channels, content, landing pages. Search stays your core, but nobody here stays only in their own lane. You Work hard, are results-driven, and like being measured on real outcomes. Have 2–4 years hands-on in SEA or performance marketing, on accounts of €50k+ per month. Work in a structured way. Are AI-pilled: you get excited about trying new ideas and finding better ways to work with AI. Communicate clearly in English. Dutch and other languages are a plus. Why Monday Merch? Rapid growth opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up, and one founder as your direct counterpart. One account, €2M+ a year, real ownership of execution and growth across 10+ markets, including US. Work from our beautiful office in the city centre of Rotterdam. Work with great tools (including a brand new MacBook) and bright, hard-working people. Yearly workation (2026 was Gran Canaria). Full-time, on-site at our Rotterdam city-centre office, no systematic WFH FD Gazelle 2026 and Deloitte Technology Fast 50 2026: experience working at one of the fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands. items.desc: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release; Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing; Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features. What you bring A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer; Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans; Experience with test automation and test frameworks; You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests; Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira. You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not; You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business. Nice to have Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code; You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support. Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests; You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better; Experience testing mobile apps. We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it , Say it , Make it . What we offer A gross salary between €3,400 and €4,800 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, bi-weekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months and much more;

items.desc: Company Description Milestone One is a Site Enabling Services organization with global headquarters in Zug, Switzerland. We understand what clinical study sites need and our overall mission is to support sites in stronger study delivery. Job Description The Full-Stack Developer will design, build, and maintain the internal platforms, applications, and integrations that run Milestone One’s business. Our applications have a React/TypeScript front end, an API layer, and a database backend, hosted on Azure and integrated with Microsoft 365. We work data-first: we design and document the data structure, build the API from that specification, and then build the front end. You will work in a small team alongside AI coding agents, with security, data protection, and documented testing built into how we deliver. Role responsibilities: Design and document data models and databases (Azure SQL) for our central data platform, internal applications, and reporting Develop secure REST APIs and backend services (.NET / C#, Azure App Service or Functions), with access checks in the API and permissions enforced at both the API and data layers Build React/TypeScript front ends that integrate with our company intranet and follow the Milestone One design system Build integrations between internal systems and third-party services (APIs, webhooks, data imports) Work in GitHub: pull requests, code reviews, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and automated code and secret scanning Define infrastructure as code with OpenTofu, using Managed Identity and Key Vault instead of stored secrets Write automated tests with Playwright and support business users during acceptance testing Use AI coding agents productively and safely, reviewing, testing, and taking ownership of all generated code Follow our change management and system validation procedures, and keep technical documentation current Collaborate with stakeholders to shape requirements and turn them into working solutions Qualifications Professional experience building web applications with React/TypeScript and a backend language such as C# / .NET (we welcome both experienced and early-career developers) SQL — schema design, data modelling, and writing efficient queries REST API design, authentication and authorization (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect) Git branching, pull requests, and code review; CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) Azure fundamentals — App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity Secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP Top 10) and care for personal and sensitive data Willingness to work in a regulated environment: change control, testing evidence, audit trails, and data integrity Fluent in English, written and spoken Nice to Have .NET 8 / C# — REST API development (Entity Framework or Dapper) Infrastructure as code with OpenTofu or Terraform Automated testing with Playwright or similar tools Professional experience working with AI coding agents or assistants Azure Functions, Static Web Apps, API Management, Front Door / WAF v2 Star schema / dimensional modelling (staging dimension fact ETL) Microsoft Graph API and Microsoft 365 integration Clinical trial domain knowledge (sites, studies, patients, financial events) Knowledge of data protection requirements such as GDPR and HIPAA Additional Information If you feel it is time to make your skills and knowledge visible within a developing company with true focus on its people, then Milestone One is the right choice for you.

Przygotuj się na codzienny kontakt z ludźmi wywodzącymi się z różnych kultur i środowisk, który dostarcza licznych wyzwań i daje dużą satysfakcję. Dołącz do nas by zdobyć nowe doświadczenie i realizować swoją ścieżkę kariery. Jako Starszy Specjalista/Starsza Specjalistka w zespole szkoleń dowiesz się jak pomagamy pracownikom budować swoje kompetencje oraz zadbać o swój rozwój. Dodatkowo poznasz sposób w jaki wspieramy pracowników w zdobywaniu przez nich certyfikatów, a także lokalnych jak i międzynarodowych kwalifikacji, dzięki czemu dostarczają usługi na najwyższym poziomie. Będziesz identyfikował/a potrzeby szkoleniowe i rozwojowe a także nadzorował/a dostarczanie usług w tym zakresie. EY.AI – na tym stanowisku będziesz pracować w środowisku, w którym agenci AI są częścią procesów wewnętrznych i codziennych operacji. Wspólnie automatyzujecie zadania, analizujecie dane i rozwijacie rozwiązania wspierające funkcjonowanie organizacji, wykorzystując zarówno narzędzia EY, jak i rozwiązania globalnych partnerów technologicznych. Twój zakres obowiązków: Organizacja szkoleń wewnętrznych i zewnętrznych, eventów szkoleniowych i rozwojowych Badanie potrzeb szkoleniowych i rozwojowych Doradztwo i dobór programów szkoleniowych Dbanie o realizację procesów szkoleniowych Zarządzanie budżetem szkoleniowym Współpraca z zespołem regionalnym w zakresie działań L&D Zarządzanie i koordynacja programów rozwojowych oraz monitorowanie realizacji kluczowych wymagań edukacyjnych Nasze wymagania: Znajomość języka angielskiego na bardzo dobrym poziomie Umiejętności analityczne, doświadczenie w monitorowaniu i zarządzaniu budżetem szkoleń Znajomość rynku usług szkoleniowych i nowych trendów Praktyczna znajomość pakietu Office (Excel, Power Point, Word, Power BI) Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu szkoleń i warsztatów To oferujemy: EY Badges – globalna certyfikacja Twoich kompetencji i możliwość zdobycia tytułu MBA renomowanej uczelni Hult International School of Business School Career Counselor - profesjonalny, indywidualny doradca w zakresie budowania i rozwoju kariery Platforma psychoedukacyjna – pakiet bezpłatnych konsultacji ze specjalistami z szerokiego zakresu zdrowia psychicznego i rozwoju osobistego oraz dostęp do aktywności edukacyjnych Program benefitów oferujący m.in. prywatną opiekę zdrowotną z dodatkowymi badaniami profilaktycznymi, ubezpieczenie na życie, bilety, sporty zespołowe, platformę do nauki języków obcych, karty sportowe i wiele innych (dostępnych online i offline) Etapy rekrutacji: 1. Aplikuj. Jeśli robisz to po raz pierwszy, załóż profil i dodaj CV. 2. Porozmawiajmy. Czekają rekruterzy i osoby z Twojego przyszłego zespołu. O EY Polska Jesteśmy globalną firmą doradczo-technologiczną. Robimy różnicę - transformujemy i zmieniamy usługi, produkty, organizacje, a nawet reguły gry. Biznesowo i technologicznie, wykorzystując sztuczną inteligencję i prawdziwe talenty. Pomagamy organizacjom rozwiązywać złożone problemy, podejmować lepsze decyzje i wdrażać zmiany na lepsze. Dajemy pewność - danych, opinii, standardów, technologii i bezpieczeństwa. Codziennie podejmujemy wyzwania, analizujemy możliwości, promptujemy, badamy, współpracujemy, zadajemy dobre pytania, planujemy, modelujemy, kodujemy, próbujemy nowych rzeczy, wyciągamy wnioski – tworzymy rozwiązania, które są kluczowe dla klientów. Tutaj tworzą się przyjaźnie, relacje i wspomnienia na całe życie. Tutaj robisz trudne i ważne rzeczy, z wspierającymi i najlepszymi ludźmi. Zatrudniamy ponad 400 000 wyjątkowych osób w ponad 150 krajach na świecie. W Polsce jest nas ponad 7000 – pracujemy w Warszawie, Gdańsku, Katowicach, Krakowie, Łodzi, Poznaniu, Szczecinie, Rzeszowie i Wrocławiu oraz w centrum usług Global Delivery Services w Warszawie i Wrocławiu. Dbamy o środowisko – nie tylko biznesowe. W ramach realizacji założonego planu zmniejszyliśmy globalną emisję gazów cieplarnianych o 40% w stosunku do roku bazowego 2019. EY jest pracodawcą równych szans – doceniamy i promujemy różnorodność wiedzy, doświadczeń i perspektyw naszej społeczności. Tworzymy środowisko oparte na szacunku, otwartości i współpracy, w którym każdy może się rozwijać i mieć realny wpływ. Prowadzimy program „Poziom Wyżej bez Barier”, który wspiera pracowników z niepełnosprawnościami w realizacji ich ambicji i marzeń związanych z rozwojem zawodowym. EY zapewnia wszystkim kandydatom jednakowe szanse w procesie rekrutacji, niezależnie od płci, wieku, rasy, wyznania, orientacji seksualnej, pochodzenia, niepełnosprawności lub jakiejkolwiek innej prawnie chronionej podstawy, zgodnie z obowiązującym prawem.

items.desc: Your role Salesforce QA Analyst What you'll be doing What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Salesforce QA Analyst within our Fuel division. This position falls under our Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Poland. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and functionality of software products of company. This involves the development of test cases, execution of manual, and the identification and documentation of defects. The Tester works closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions. You will report directly into the QA Lead in this role. How We Work As a Salesforce QA Analyst, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Company issued equipment Formal, hands-on training Role Responsibilities The responsibilities of the role will include: Analyzing business and technical requirements to develop test plans and test cases. Identifying testing objectives and ensure adequate test coverage. Performing manual testing for functional, regression, and integration scenarios. Analyzing results of automated tests. Identifying, documenting, and reporting defects with detailed steps to reproduce. Working closely with developers to verify fixes and resolve issues. Contributing to the creation and maintenance of automated test scripts. Using testing frameworks and tools to enhance efficiency. Working with the development team to understand system functionality. Participating in Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups and sprint reviews. Maintaining test documentation, including test cases, test plans, and results. Providing detailed testing reports and status updates to stakeholders. Suggesting improvements to testing processes and methodologies Staying updated with the latest tools, trends, and techniques in software testing. Qualifications and Skills : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 4+ years of software quality assurance experience, including hands-on testing of Salesforce or comparable SaaS and CRM platforms. Demonstrated ability to independently analyze business and technical requirements, define test coverage, and create clear test plans, cases, and test data. Strong experience with manual functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing, with the judgment to prioritize risk and release readiness. Experience reviewing automated test results and contributing to automated test scripts using QA tools, frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines. Proficient in defect lifecycle management and Agile delivery practices, with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business team Benefits & Perks Competitive Salary Pension Contributions 25 days of annual leave Pay during Parental leave Eye examinations and a subsidy for the purchase of glasses (if needed) Pay Transparency The salary range for this position is 12,124 - 15,154 PLN gross per month. The final offer will be determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria including relevant skills, professional experience, and qualifications. Corpay maintains structured compensation practices and regularly reviews pay to support compliance with equal pay principles and applicable EU legislation. Additional compensation elements, including benefits and variable pay (if applicable), will be discussed during the recruitment process. About Corpay About Corpay Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law. Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms: Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions. …

items.desc: Job Title: TMF Associate Employment Type: Full time, Permanent Job Reports To : Manager, TMF Operations Department/Unit Name : TMF Operations Job Summary: Responsible for the management of the Trial Master File (TMF) content and associated processes during the study life cycle from study set up to transfer/archiving. Work in partnership with study teams during periodic file reviews and audits to address findings related to the TMF. Manage access and organization of the controlled electronic file repository, in line with the defined file structure and access management framework. Work proactively and successfully within a cross-functional team. Communicate and promote department and company goals and practices. Interact with stakeholders in a way that fosters a positive working atmosphere and encompasses a professional and helpful attitude. Time allocated may be adjusted based on need. Service Delivery Serve as the primary TMF contact for assigned studies. Ensure TMF is complete and “inspection ready” throughout study lifecycle and documents are filed contemporaneously. Work with Team Lead to create study specific TMF management and oversight documents (e.g., File Index, Expected Document Lists and TMF Management Plan) in alignment with study. Develop and maintain study-specific work instructions, as needed. Utilize organization skills to maintain a quality control schedule and perform periodic inventories of study TMF to ensure completeness. Review and communicate out-of-scope and/or incomplete documents to study teams; escalating as needed. Reconcile expected document lists based on study events and milestones. Prioritize and resolve TMF help desk tickets; may include triaging activities. Provide study specific TMF training to internal and/or external stakeholders, as needed. Process and review documents, following applicable scanning and best practices and best practices, and applying ALCOA principles appropriately. File and retrieve TMF documents in a timely manner. Department Support Complete routine administrative tasks in a timely manner (e.g., timesheets, metrics). Participate in discussions, decisions and sharing of knowledge in department meetings, periodic presentations, and smaller working groups. Seek opportunities to assist in the development, implementation and maintenance of internal systems (e.g., databases used to manage records). Provide mentorship and training to junior level staff. Propose suggestions and work on the development and maintenance of department quality system documents to improve efficiencies. Qualifications The successful candidate will possess a college diploma/degree and 3 years of relative related experience or on going training. They will have an understanding of TMF organization, implementation, and archival including relevant regulations and guidance to assure quality and integrity of TMFs. Have the ability to incorporate the principles of ALCOA in relation to TMF oversight. Utilize skills in time management and problem-solving. Identify challenges and problems and take the initiative to identify solutions. Demonstrated computer literacy, proven functional knowledge of Microsoft packages and potential to develop. Working Conditions Home based, with the ability to go into office occasionally if needed. items.desc: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! About Vonage Vonage is a global cloud communications leader in the $100B+ CPaaS market. Customers including Airbnb, Snapchat, and thousands of enterprises depend on our APIs and SDKs to deliver SMS, voice, and messaging at scale. The Technical Routing & Quality team sits at the heart of this — owning the configuration and performance of every message and call that traverses the Vonage network. Why This Role Matters Every OTP SMS, enterprise marketing message, and API-triggered communication travels through routing groups owned and maintained by this team. As a Technical Routing Analyst, you will own the day-to-day quality and cost performance of global SMS and voice routing, ensuring traffic is delivered reliably, efficiently, and at the best possible margin. What You Will Do Monitor and respond to quality alerts (SMSCR, DLR Success Ratio, Rejected/Undelivered, Queue, Bind-down) via Zendesk and Tableau, following established investigation processes Provide 24x5 follow-the-sun routing assurance coverage in rotation with regional peers Perform proactive quality assurance across SMS and voice destinations — identifying degraded suppliers and initiating route changes Manage country-level routing: evaluate supplier performance against cost and quality targets and implement tiered routing decisions Onboard and test new supplier connections (SMPP/MM4/MM7 protocols) in coordination with Connectivity Operations Identify and escalate carrier degradations, encoding errors, and throughput issues, coordinating resolution with CORT and suppliers Contribute to automation initiatives that improve supplier onboarding times, cost management, and quality alerting Participate in regional handover processes and maintain clear handover notes for the next-shift team Support the migration of SMS services from IBM Data Centres to AWS What You Will Bring Solid understanding of SMS routing fundamentals — SMPP protocol, DLR codes, encoding, conversion rates, and delivery ratio metrics Experience working with carrier or telco routing systems and monitoring tools (e.g. Tableau, Zendesk, or equivalent) Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate degradation patterns, cross-reference data sources, and drive root-cause resolution Comfortable working in a fast-paced, 24x5 operational environment with on-call responsibilities Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate clearly across time zones with suppliers and internal stakeholders Experience collaborating cross-functionally with carrier, product, and engineering teams Nice to Have Familiarity with voice routing metrics (ASR, NER, MOS, PDD) and SIP fundamentals Experience with ML-driven or algorithmic routing systems Knowledge of RCS, Network APIs, or US direct carrier connectivity Background in a CPaaS, wholesale telco, or carrier operations environment About the Team The Technical Routing & Quality team is focused on three objectives: reducing tech debt, automating the core business, and investing in growth areas such as Network APIs, RCS, and US direct connectivity. We operate a follow-the-sun model and work closely with Carrier Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to deliver best-in-class routing services. #LI-WW1 There's no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Capture from the market incoming information about corporate actions and income payments affecting Citi Private Bank clients. Create such events in internal booking platforms (product processors) and oversee entire lifecycle of an event until final settlement. Collect clients’ instructions (voluntary events) and pass them to custodians. Collect events’ proceeds (cash, stock) and distribute downstream to Citi’s clients. Identifying inconsistencies in the process and mitigating risks in a timely and efficient manner. Maintaining communication and relations with internal and external key stakeholders from multiple global locations. Respond to incoming inquiries related to corporate actions. Perform control over automated processes. Actively raise/promote improvement initiatives that further automate or simplify our daily job, increasing quality of deliverables. Contributing to business goals as outlined by the organization. Other tasks related to operational support in private banking industry, in line with internal operating manuals and/or superior’s delegation.
