items.desc: VIA University College, Kantinen på Campus Holstebro søger en servicemedarbejder til kassebetjening, levering af mødeforplejning, samt diverse småopgaver i køkkenet med ansættelse pr. 01.01 2027. Stillingen er på 30,00 timer ugentligt, og er en fast stilling. Arbejdstiden ligger hovedsagelig mellem kl. 7.00-13.30 med få eftermiddage, weekend- eller aftenvagter. Kantinens vision er at inspirere og begejstre vores kunder med den mad, vi serverer med udgangspunkt i de officielle klimabaserede kostråd. Vi arbejder målrettet for en mere bæredygtig kantinedrift med bl.a. stort fokus på reducering af vores CO2 aftryk og vi har det økologiske spisemærke i sølv. Vi er med til at skabe et godt studiemiljø på campus, hvor fællesskaber får det bedste frem i alle. Vi understøtter trivslen for de studerende, og vi værner om et godt arbejdsmiljø. Vi har en god tone i køkkenet og altid et smil til vores kunder. Kantinen på Campus Holstebro laver mad til studerende på 8 uddannelser samt gæster og personale; i alt ca. 1600 studerende og 200 medarbejdere. I køkkenet er vi 9 medarbejdere med forskellig baggrund. DIN PROFIL Vi søger en glad og smilende medarbejder, som kan skabe en imødekommende og professionel oplevelse, hvor gæster føler sig velkomne, set og værdsatte. Du skal kunne møder alle med nærvær, service og kvalitet, så kantinen bliver et naturligt samlingspunkt på campus Dine kompetencer: Du har en positiv indstilling og er engageret i at levere god service til vores kunder Du har en god ordenssans, arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og ansvarligt samt prioritere egne arbejdsopgaver. Du er en teamplayer og medvirker aktivt og bevidst til et godt arbejdsmiljø Du har nemt til smil og er god til at kommunikere Du er mødestabil. Du har lyst til at arbejde med fokus på bæredygtig kantinedrift. Kendskab til sociale medier og computer Erfaring fra kantinearbejde eller restauration vil være en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har et positivt sind og en vilje til at lære. Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være at: Varetage kassebetjeningen Printe bestillinger Pakke mødeforplejning, samt levere og afhente mødeforplejning til/fra lokaler på campus Have ansvar for, at kantinen altid fremstår pæn og ren, samt sørge for opfyldning af forplejning og kølemontre Forestå opdækning til arrangementer Gå til hånde i køkkenet Indhente brugt service på campus, og forestå opvask i samarbejde med det øvrige team Lave opslag for kantinen på vores sociale medier VI TILBYDER En spændende kantine og arbejdsplads, hvor der dagligt kommer mange unge studerende og medarbejdere. Et godt samarbejde i et team med ”højt til loftet” og med en travl hverdag. Gode funktionelle rammer i køkkenet og gode kantinefaciliteter. Praktikdage i VIAs øvrige kantiner. Gode arbejdstider, der hovedsagelig ligger mellem kl. 7.00-13.30 med kun få weekend- og aftenvagter. På VIA University College har vi et ønske om at have levende campusmiljøer og at sætte vores studerende i centrum. De studerende skal altid føle sig velkomne i kantinen og have mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid. LØN- OG ANSÆTTELSESFORHOLD Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer samt organisationsaftalen for køkkenmedhjælpere i staten mv. mellem Finansministeriet og FOA. Arbejdsstedet er Gl. Struervej 1, 7500 Holstebro. ER DU INTERESSERET? Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kantineleder Bjørn Frølund Thorstensen på mail bjfr@via.dk eller på tlf. 8755 0829. Ansøg stillingen via vores online rekrutteringssystem. Vi skal have din ansøgning senest onsdag den 25.11.2026. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 48. VI er VIA VIA er en af Danmarks største uddannelsesinstitutioner med lokationer overalt i Region Midtjylland. Vi uddanner og efteruddanner bl.a. lærere, sygeplejersker, ingeniører, designere og mange flere. Vi udvikler uddannelser i tæt samarbejde med praksis. Vi er en arbejdsplads med fleksibilitet, frihed og gode muligheder for udvikling. Hvis du er nysgerrig på, hvordan det er at arbejde i VIA, kan du læse nogle af vores fortællinger her . I VIA værdsætter vi kompetence og talent i alle former. Vi tror på styrken i diversitet og byder alle velkomne, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet eller baggrund. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen og blive en del af et inkluderende fællesskab. items.desc: Business Controller - Magle Biopolymers About Magle Biopolymers Magle Biopolymers is part of the Magle Group - an international life science group with strong roots in dextran technology. We develop and manufacture advanced polymer-based materials used in medical products, contributing to improving patients’ lives. As a CDMO entity within the group, Magle Biopolymers operates in a regulated environment with high quality requirements. Quality, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration are core elements of our daily work, and we continuously strive to improve our processes and solutions. About the Position In the newly established role of Business Controller, you will become part of the Biopolymers business unit, reporting directly to the CEO of Biopolymers with a functional line to the Group Finance Director. You will be the single source of financial truth for the business - building the cost model and controlling framework on top of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, which we implemented in August 2026, and making the financial consequences visible where operational and commercial decisions are taken. Bookkeeping and the monthly close are handled by our outsourced Accounting team, so your focus is on financial steering and business partnering. The position is based in Køge with regular presence at our site in Hårlev. Key Responsibilities - Build, validate and maintain the cost model and cost prices for Køge and Hårlev - meeting the requirements of the Danish Financial Statements Act (ÅRL §44) and usable for day-to-day cost control Deliver cost-per-unit visibility by product and customer and own variance analysis, making the cost of scrap, idle time and unused capacity explicit Own the annual budget, ongoing estimates and the long-term forecast in close dialogue with the CEO and function leads - Hold overall responsibility for the monthly reporting to management, the Board and Group - complete, reconciled to the ledger and delivered on time Partner with operations, commercial, supply chain and quality managers through monthly follow-up, getting to the root causes of deviations together - Establish production metrics and dashboards - scrap, downtime, yield and labour hours - that managers use in their daily steering Calculate and challenge business cases, pricing and improvement claims, and verify that savings show up in the P&L Act as counterpart to the external auditors on cost prices and inventory valuation We Imagine That You Have an HD in accounting (HD-R), cand.merc.aud., cand.merc. or equivalent Have 4+ years of experience in controlling, including at least two as a plant, site or business-unit controller in manufacturing Have built a fully-loaded cost model or standard costing framework, and have a solid accounting foundation including knowledge of the Danish Financial Statements Act on cost prices and inventory valuation Are strong in Excel and can build cost and business-case models independently Can challenge senior leaders on evidence while keeping a good working relationship – you say what the number is, and it does not move under pressure Are as comfortable on the production floor as at the desk, and can explain cost to non-finance colleagues in a way that drives action - Are curious about AI tools - experience with Claude is an advantage, but not a requirement Speak and write Danish and English fluently Ideally have experience from an audit firm, with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, from pharmaceutical, chemical or other process manufacturing (GMP), and with Power BI or similar tools We Offer A newly established role with real influence on how the business is steered A professional and collaborative working environment, close to both management and production Canteen arrangement, an active Staff Club and health insurance. Application We invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. For questions, please contact HR Manager Rikke Tjustrup at rikke.tjustrup@maglegroup.com. About Magle Group Magle Group has a solid history within life science and has grown through strategic acquisitions. Today, the group consists of several specialized entities, including Magle Biopolymers, with a strong focus on dextran technology and CDMO services.

items.desc: Job no: 596842 Contract type: Temporary Appointment Duty Station: Copenhagen Level: P-4 Location: Denmark Categories: Partnerships UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to Deliver UNICEF Supply Division (SD) works to ensure equitable and inclusive access to essential supplies and services for children and their families across development, humanitarian and fragile contexts. SD brings together global supply chain expertise, market engagement, and partnerships with governments, civil society, the private sector, industry, and other stakeholders to support the needs of children worldwide. This provides a strong operational and partnership foundation for the Humanitarian and Transport Logistics Alliance (HTLA) and its focus on strengthening humanitarian transport and logistics through collaboration across sectors. The Humanitarian Transport and Logistics Alliance (HTLA) is a strategic UNICEF-led initiative designed to strengthen the resilience, efficiency, preparedness, and performance of humanitarian supply chains through structured collaboration between humanitarian organizations, commercial transport and logistics providers, governments, donors, academia, and other strategic stakeholders. Building on UNICEF's role as holder of the United Nations Long-Term Arrangement (LTA) for global freight forwarding and transportation services, its established relationships with global carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers, HTLA provides a coordination and operational mechanism to facilitate faster, more predictable and cost-effective movement of humanitarian goods. Through partnership MoUs with carriers, humanitarian shipments can benefit from priority handling and expedited bookings, alongside preferential conditions that help reduce delays and avoid additional logistics costs. These arrangements provide a strong operational and partnership foundation on which HTLA can build. Building on this established foundation and the value already being delivered, HTLA aims to progressively strengthen and broaden the model into a multi-stakeholder alliance. The intention is to protect and expand the operational benefits already achieved while creating a structured mechanism through which humanitarian and commercial actors, and other strategic partners, can strengthen preparedness, address shared supply chain bottlenecks and develop collective solutions that improve humanitarian logistics resilience and system-wide performance. The Partnerships Coordinator will play a central role in taking this work forward, driving implementation of the HTLA roadmap, coordinating stakeholders and supporting the Alliance's continued development. How can you make a difference? The Partnerships Coordinator will lead the day-to-day implementation and coordination of HTLA, translating its agreed strategic direction and roadmap into a functioning alliance. The role will drive delivery across the HTLA workplan, coordinate internal and external stakeholders, establish fit-for-purpose governance and ways of working, monitor progress and results, and ensure that decisions, dependencies and risks are actively managed. Under the supervision of the Chief, GTLC, the position will work closely with logistics and partnership functions colleagues, and relevant other technical and partnership functions. The post holder will serve as the central coordination and focal point for HTLA and ensure coherence across partnership development, industry engagement, governance, communications, resource mobilization and results monitoring. items.desc: Position description Category Optics and Optronics Contract Fixed-term contract Job title Researcher in Optical Instrumentation for Cryogenic Super-Resolution Microscopy (cryo-PALM) H/F Socio-professional category Executive Contract duration (months) 36 Job description Would you like to develop optical instrumentation and methods for microscopy at very low temperatures? Join us as a researcher on a three-year fixed-term contract within the ANR EPIC project. You will investigate and optimise a cryo-PALM microscope and develop reliable cryogenic sample transfers between fluorescence and electron microscopy at IBS/IRIG! As a researcher, your responsibilities will include: Develop and evaluate optical improvements to the cryo-PALM microscope: excitation and emission paths, photon collection efficiency, spatial sampling, optical alignment and quantitative point spread function (PSF) characterisation. Investigate and optimise illumination and acquisition strategies for cryo-FIB lamellae: spatially targeted activation/excitation, control of sample heating and improved single-molecule localisation precision. Develop and validate procedures for transferring vitrified samples between cryo-FIB/SEM, cryo-PALM and cryo-electron microscopy, maintaining cryogenic conditions and limiting contamination and deformation of the lamellae. Establish calibration methods and assess the performance of the correlative cryo-PALM/cryo-ET workflow with cryo-EM and image processing specialists; contribute to the evaluation of fluorescent proteins within the project. Applicant Profile We primarily seek a specialist in experimental optics or photonics with a PhD in optics, photonics, experimental physics, optical instrumentation or a related field. Hands-on experience designing, aligning and optimising optical or microscopy setups is essential. Knowledge of biophysics or biological applications is an asset; you will work closely with specialists in biology and cryo-EM. Prior PALM or cryo-EM experience is welcome but is not required. Technical skills Strong expertise in experimental optics, photonics and optical instrumentation. Hands-on experience designing, aligning, optimising and quantitatively characterising optical or microscopy setups. Knowledge of fluorescence microscopy, super-resolution imaging, cryogenic instrumentation or biological applications would be an asset. Programming and quantitative experimental data analysis skills would be an asset. Interpersonal skills Independence, scientific rigour and good organisational skills. Initiative, scientific curiosity and the ability to propose solutions to experimental challenges. Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment. Good communication skills and the ability to share scientific results. Language skills Good command of spoken and written scientific English to work in an international environment. Knowledge of French is welcome but is not essential. Why join us? …. items.desc: Position description Category Optics and Optronics Contract Fixed-term contract Job title Engineer in Optical Instrumentation for Cryogenic Super-Resolution Microscopy (cryo-PALM) H/F Socio-professional category Executive Contract duration (months) 36 Job description Would you like to design, assemble and optimise optical instruments for microscopy at very low temperatures? Join us as a engineer on a three-year fixed-term contract within the ANR EPIC project. You will develop and improve a cryo-PALM microscope and help establish reliable cryogenic sample transfers between fluorescence and electron microscopy at IBS/IRIG! As a engineer, your responsibilities will include: Design, assemble, align and optimise the optical systems of the cryo-PALM microscope: excitation and emission paths, photon collection efficiency, spatial sampling and point spread function (PSF) characterisation. Implement and test illumination and acquisition strategies for cryo-FIB lamellae: spatially targeted activation/excitation, reduced sample heating and improved localisation precision for fluorescent molecules. Improve, test and document vitrified sample transfers between cryo-FIB/SEM, cryo-PALM and cryo-electron microscopy, maintaining cryogenic conditions and preventing contamination or deformation of the lamellae. Implement calibration procedures and help integrate the correlative cryo-PALM/cryo-ET workflow with cryo-EM and image processing specialists; support the evaluation of fluorescent proteins within the project. Applicant Profile We seek an engineer specialising in experimental optics or photonics. You hold an engineering degree (diplôme d’ingénieur or equivalent) or a PhD with strong practical experience in optical instrumentation. Hands-on experience designing, assembling, aligning and optimising optical or microscopy setups is essential. Knowledge of biophysics or biological applications is an asset; you will work closely with specialists in biology and cryo-EM. Prior PALM or cryo-EM experience is welcome but is not required. Technical skills Strong practical skills in experimental optics, photonics and optical instrumentation. Hands-on experience designing, assembling, aligning and optimising optical setups and integrating scientific instruments. Knowledge of fluorescence microscopy, super-resolution imaging, cryogenic instrumentation or biological applications would be an asset. Skills in instrument control, acquisition automation, programming or experimental data processing would be an asset. Interpersonal skills Independence, scientific rigour and good organisational skills. Initiative, scientific curiosity and the ability to propose solutions to experimental challenges. Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment. Good communication skills and the ability to share scientific results. Language skills Good command of spoken and written scientific English to work in an international environment. Knowledge of French is welcome but is not essential. Why join us? …. By joining the Grenoble Interdisciplinary Institute, you’ll be part of a dynamic and innovative research environment where you’ll have the opportunity to learn, grow and play a key role within a centre of excellence. …AND THAT’S NOT ALL! You may be interested in the benefits that come alongside your main role: A cutting-edge research ecosystem dedicated to topics of significant societal importance. Training to enhance your skills and boost your career. A staff committee offering a wealth of social, cultural and sporting benefits. Practical benefits: staff canteen/meal vouchers, 85% of transport costs covered, and much more. An exceptional living environment in Grenoble, nestled in the mountains, offering a unique balance between city life and nature. Want to be part of the adventure? Apply now and put your energy to work for research and innovation! In line with the CEA’s commitments to the integration of people with disabilities, this role is open to everyone. The CEA offers adjustments and/or organisational arrangements to facilitate the inclusion of disabled workers Position location Site Grenoble Job location France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Isère (38) Location Grenoble Candidate criteria Languages English (Fluent) French (Intermediate) Recommended training Ingénieur Requester Position start date 01/02/2027 General information Organisation The French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission (CEA) is a key player in research, development and innovation in four main areas : defence and security, nuclear energy (fission and fusion), technological research for industry, fundamental research in the physical sciences and life sciences. Au sein de cette entité, le département CLD assiste au plus près les applications dans leur transition et développe les capacités nécessaires à une utilisation sécurisée de l'offre SG Cloud Platform, notamment chez Azure et AWS. Vous aurez le rôle de Tech Lead Azure au sein de la Cloud Team Corporate. Vous serez à l'intersection des sujets techniques, business et au cœur des besoins des utilisateurs finaux. Vos responsabilités principales : Aider au pilotage et animer la résolution des différents challenges techniques rencontrés par l'équipe Accompagner nos utilisateurs dans l'utilisation de nos services, que ce soit en phase d'intégration ou en phase d'évolution Participer à l'évolution des services de landing zone ou des services plus spécifiquement développés par l'équipe S'assurer que l'équipe est à l'état de l'art en matière de compétences sur les technologies Gérer la dette technique (stratégie, réduction des incidents) Et si c'était vous ? Vous disposez des qualités et compétences suivantes : Des connaissances solides en matière de technologies cloud, en particulier sur Azure Un esprit de synthèse et fibre techniques vous permettant d'appréhender et de comprendre les problématiques liées au génie logiciel et à au cloud Un excellent relationnel vous permettant de développer une relation de qualité tant avec les utilisateurs finaux que les fournisseurs Une bonne maitrise des principes d'agile à l'échelle (Safe) Une pratique courante de l'anglais (écrit et parlé) Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Notre vision est de jouer un rôle moteur dans les transformations positives du monde et de contribuer à un avenir plus écologique, respectueux de la planète ! Choisir Société Générale, c'est intégrer un Groupe où la culture d'entreprise est tournée vers l'inclusion, la diversité et l'esprit d'équipe ! C'est construire une carrière dynamique avec la possibilité de changer de poste en moyenne tous les 4 ans, en France et à l'international tout en bénéficiant de formations régulières ! Au regard de vos compétences, une rémunération attractive revue annuellement, composée d'un salaire fixe, d'une part variable individuelle et d'une prime d'intéressement et de participation vous sera proposée. Vous bénéficiez également de tarifs préférentiels sur vos services bancaires, d'un compte épargne temps monétisable et d'un Plan d'Epargne Entreprise abondé . Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez de nombreux avantages complémentaires : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service 26 à 28 jours de congés payés par an et 14 à 18 jours de RTT (suivant les années), des congés liés aux événements de la vie Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Un Comité d'Entreprise (billetterie événements sportifs & culturels, primes et subventions vacances, garde d'enfants, chèque cadeaux à Noël) Une offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Pourquoi nous choisir ? Chez Société Générale, nous sommes convaincus que vous êtes le moteur du changement, et que le monde de demain sera fait de toutes vos initiatives, des plus petites aux plus ambitieuses. Aux 4 coins du monde, que vous nous rejoigniez pour quelques mois, quelques années ou toute votre carrière, ensemble nous avons les moyens d'avoir un impact positif sur l'avenir. Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Rejoindre Société Générale, c'est intégrer une équipe de talents, engagés pour leurs clients et tournés vers l'avenir. Chez Société Générale, faites grandir vos ambitions. Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d'engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: ABGi Technology recrute pour son client, un acteur majeur du secteur du transport, son futur Développeur Full Stack Web Node.js F/H, basé à Lyon. VOS MISSIONS Dans le cadre de l'évolution et de la modernisation de ses applications métiers, notre client souhaite renforcer ses équipes de développement avec un(e) Développeur(se) Full Stack Web expérimenté(e), spécialisé(e) en Node.js et JavaScript / TypeScript. Vous interviendrez au sein d'un environnement technique complexe, dans le cadre de projets de conception, de développement et d'évolution d'applications web métiers. Ces projets s'inscrivent dans une démarche de transformation et d'amélioration continue de l'écosystème digital du client, avec des enjeux importants en matière de qualité logicielle, de performance, de sécurité, de maintenabilité et de continuité de service. Vous participerez à l'ensemble du cycle de vie des applications, depuis l'analyse des besoins fonctionnels et techniques jusqu'à la mise en production des nouvelles fonctionnalités, en collaboration avec les équipes de développement, les responsables techniques et les différents interlocuteurs métiers. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement Agile et DevOps, favorisant la collaboration, l'amélioration continue et le respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Les missions qui vous seront demandées : Participer à l'analyse et à la compréhension des besoins fonctionnels et techniques ; Contribuer à la conception technique et à l'évolution des applications web métiers ; Concevoir, développer et maintenir de nouvelles fonctionnalités Back-End sous Node.js ; Développer et faire évoluer les composants Front-End des applications web ; Utiliser les technologies JavaScript et TypeScript pour garantir la qualité et la maintenabilité des développements ; Concevoir, développer et intégrer des API REST permettant les échanges entre les différentes applications et services ; Participer à l'intégration des applications avec les bases de données SQL et/ou NoSQL ; Contribuer à l'amélioration des performances, de la fiabilité et de la sécurité des applications ; Réaliser les tests unitaires et participer aux campagnes de tests d'intégration ; Identifier, analyser et corriger les anomalies techniques et fonctionnelles ; Assurer le support technique lors des phases de recette et de validation ; Participer aux revues de code et veiller au respect des standards de développement ; Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la qualité du code et à la réduction de la dette technique ; Participer à la documentation technique des fonctionnalités et composants développés ; Collaborer avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles dans le cadre des différentes phases des projets ; Participer aux cérémonies Agile et contribuer à la planification et au suivi des développements ; Contribuer aux processus d'intégration et de déploiement continus ; Participer aux mises en production des nouvelles versions applicatives ; Assurer la maintenance corrective et évolutive des applications existantes ; Contribuer au maintien en conditions opérationnelles (MCO) des applications ; Être force de proposition concernant les évolutions techniques, les optimisations et les bonnes pratiques de développement. NOTRE RECHERCHE Compétences et expériences requises : Minimum 3 années d'expérience professionnelle en développement Full Stack Web ; Bonne maîtrise de Node.js pour le développement Back-End ; Solides compétences en JavaScript et TypeScript ; Expérience avec un framework Back-End tel que Express.js, NestJS ou équivalent ; Expérience en développement Front-End avec au moins l'un des frameworks suivants : React, Angular ou Vue.js ; Bonne maîtrise des technologies web HTML5 et CSS3 ; Expérience dans la conception, le développement et l'intégration d'API REST ; Bonne maîtrise de Git et des pratiques de gestion de versions ; Connaissances solides des bases de données SQL et/ou NoSQL ; Expérience dans la réalisation de tests unitaires avec Jest, Mocha ou un outil équivalent ; Compréhension des bonnes pratiques de développement et des principes de qualité logicielle ; Capacité à analyser, diagnostiquer et résoudre des anomalies applicatives ; Expérience dans la maintenance et l'évolution d'applications web ; Bonne compréhension des problématiques de performance, de sécurité et de maintenabilité ; Capacité à travailler dans un environnement technique complexe et collaboratif ; Autonomie, rigueur et capacité à proposer des solutions techniques adaptées. Les compétences suivantes constituent de réels atouts : Docker pour la conteneurisation des applications ; Kubernetes pour l'orchestration et le déploiement des services ; Outils d'intégration et de déploiement continus : GitLab CI, Jenkins ou Azure DevOps ; Environnements Cloud public : Microsoft Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ; Expérience des pratiques DevOps et de l'automatisation des processus de développement et de déploiement ; Bonne connaissance des méthodes Agile / Scrum ; …

Responsabilités Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes produit et commerciales afin de leur permettre de développer de nouvelles opportunités et d’étendre l’utilisation chez les clients de toutes les offres technologiques et d’IA de Circana Détenir et entretenir une expertise approfondie et à jour sur les dernières offres technologiques et d’IA de Circana, afin d’agir en tant qu’expert référent (SME) dans les pays couverts Concevoir des supports de démo efficaces, les présenter directement aux clients ou supporter les équipes en contact avec les clients pour qu’ils puissent les présenter en autonomie Être l’ambassadeur des produits, en favorisant leur adoption et en suscitant l’enthousiasme entre les départements et les marchés afin de soutenir une forte pénétration client et le succès commercial des produits Adapter la communication et les supports produit globaux et régionaux à la dynamique et aux organisations des marchés locaux, en particulier lors des lancements et des nouvelles releases Recueillir activement les retours des parties prenantes internes et clients, et les partager en interne et à tous les niveaux de l’équipe Product Management Apporter un soutien aux équipes formation et expérience client interne, notamment par du coaching, la fourniture de supports et un appui régulier aux équipes au contact des utilisateurs finaux Assurer un support technique – de manière ad hoc et prioritaire, assurer la résolution et l’escalade des problèmes clients Participer et faciliter les tests d’acceptation utilisateur (UAT) locaux des nouvelles versions Profil recherché Expérience du travail au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires dans un contexte multi-pays. Une connaissance des outils de BI tiers est un atout. De bonnes compétences en communication, notamment pour les présentations et les ateliers. Fort esprit d’équipe, favorisant des relations de travail solides entre équipes et départements. Très motivé(e), responsable et engagé(e). Le français et l’anglais sont requis à un niveau de maîtrise professionnel. Les comportements Circana Au-delà des compétences techniques, de l’expérience et des qualités propres au poste, ces comportements partagés sont fondamentaux pour notre culture et notre réussite. Nous recherchons des personnes qui font preuve de ces comportements et les incarnent au quotidien dans leur travail : Rester curieux : avoir soif d’apprendre et de progresser, toujours poser les grandes questions. Rechercher la clarté : accueillir la complexité pour créer de la clarté et inspirer l’action. Assumer les résultats : être responsable de nos décisions et assumer nos choix. Placer le client au centre : apporter sans relâche de la valeur à nos clients. Être un challenger : ne jamais se satisfaire de l’existant, toujours viser l’amélioration continue. Défendre l’inclusion : favoriser la confiance dans les relations, avec empathie, respect et intégrité. S’engager les uns envers les autres : contribuer à faire de Circana un excellent lieu de travail pour tous. Localisation : Ce poste est basé à Paris, La Défense (télétravail partiel) #LI-AG1

Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint. Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/ What We Offer Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry. items.desc: Qui nous sommes Depuis plus de 170 ans, Lagardère Travel Retail offre une expérience unique au service de nos voyageurs et de nos partenaires. Nous concevons et opérons des offres de commerce et de restauration dans les lieux de mobilité, afin d’enrichir l’expérience des voyageurs, autour de trois activités : Travel Essentials, Duty Free & Fashion et Foodservice. Présents dans plus de 50 pays avec 5 000 points de vente, nous réalisons 8 milliards d’euros de chiffre d’affaires et nous appuyons sur l’engagement de 29 000 collaborateurs dans le monde. Filiale du Louis Hachette Group (via le groupe Lagardère), coté sur Euronext Growth, nous combinons puissance d’un groupe international et expertises locales, au plus près des territoires et des voyageurs. Pourquoi nous rejoindre Vous évoluerez dans un environnement multiculturel et dynamique, au sein d’un siège monde au coeur des décisions stratégiques. Dans un environnement de distribution international, il accompagne le pilotage de la performance des flux, des stocks, des capacités et de la qualité de service. Demonstrated experience designing precision machinery, manufactured devices, complex mechanisms or tooling, with accountability for producing drawings and delivering functional hardware. Deep understanding of precision manufacturing, machining and tooling methods, material behavior, fits, GD&T, surface finishes, tolerance chains and dimensional verification. Strong CAD and drawing capability, including manufacturing-ready documentation, BOMs, tolerance analysis and clear technical communication with machinists, toolmakers, metrology teams and suppliers. Hands-on experience across the complete hardware development cycle, including prototypes, supplier follow-up, inspection, precision assembly, functional testing and commissioning. Practical experience installing cooling circuits and working knowledge of piping systems, fluid components and instrumentation, including flow, pressure and temperature sensors. What sets you apart Previous experience in mold design and manufacturing, injection molds, forming dies, precision toolmaking or comparable tight-tolerance machinery is strongly preferred. Experience with precision positioning mechanisms, custom machines, scientific instrumentation, optomechanical devices or automated precision assemblies. Experience specifying and interpreting CMM reports, geometric tolerances, surface roughness measurements, inspection plans and precision assembly or alignment procedures. Proven ability to work directly with machine shops and toolmakers, resolve manufacturing deviations, optimize parts for production, and lead build-to-test iterations. Strong ownership, practical problem-solving skills and a design-for-manufacture mindset, with the ability to turn complex designs into reliable, accurately manufactured and assembled devices. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du verantwortest das technische Vorgehen und bist erste Ansprechperson für die Fachseite. Du baust Prototypen und Anwendungen rund um Cybersecurity und KI, von der ersten Demo bis zur Lösung im Betrieb. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du entwirfst Architekturen und triffst die technischen Grundsatzentscheidungen. Du bewertest Security-Produkte und Startups und hilfst Kund:innen, begründet zu entscheiden. Wo es gute Lösungen schon gibt, bindest Du sie ein, statt sie nachzubauen. Du arbeitest mit KI-Agenten und Coding-Tools, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verstehst, was sie bauen. Du führst Workshops und Trainings durch, zum Beispiel zur sicheren Nutzung von KI. Du merkst, wo bei Kund:innen das nächste Problem steckt, und baust die Demo, die zeigt, dass wir es lösen können. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du machst daraus Angebote und Folgeaufträge und entwickelst unser Leistungsportfolio im Cyber-Bereich weiter. Du bringst Ideen in interne Themen ein und machst gute Lösungen für das ganze Team wiederverwendbar. Security-Tiefe lernst Du bei uns im Projekt und von unserem Cyber-Team. Eine Pentest-Laufbahn, SOC-Erfahrung oder ein Security-Studium brauchst Du dafür nicht. DEIN PROFIL Unsere Kund:innen haben Sicherheitsfragen, die sich nicht mit Folien lösen lassen. Du gehst direkt zu ihnen, verstehst das Problem und baust eine Lösung, die funktioniert. Wir ersetzen keine Security-Hersteller. Wir prüfen, was sie taugen, und bauen, was fehlt. KI macht Dich dabei schneller. Ob das Ergebnis stimmt, entscheidest Du. Dafür bringst Du mit: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, einer Ingenieur- oder Naturwissenschaft oder einem anderen Fach, das dich technisch geprägt hat, oder vergleichbare Praxis. Du hast schon Software gebaut, die andere nutzen, auch ohne KI: im Job, als Werkstudent:in, in eigenen Projekten oder in einem Startup. Der Einstieg direkt nach dem Studium ist möglich. Für das Senior Level bringst du mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit. Du denkst Dich schnell in komplexe Themen ein, verstehst, was eine KI dir ausgibt, und widersprichst, wenn eine Anforderung oder ein Ergebnis nicht stimmt. Du gehst gerne auf Kund:innen zu und erklärst Komplexes einfach. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1 in beiden Sprachen) und bist für Termine bei Kund:innen reisebereit. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Cloud, Containern oder Identity-Systemen wie Entra ID Erfahrung mit KI-Agenten, MCP oder anderen LLM-Anwendungen Berührungspunkte mit Security, etwa Security Operations, IAM oder Zero Trust Erfahrung in der Beratung oder in einer regulierten Branche Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb Dich gerne trotzdem. DEINE BENEFITS Unterstützende Teamkultur : Teamzusammenhalt ist uns wichtig - wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und pflegen eine gesunde Officekultur. Unser Eventteam plant regelmäßige Afterworks und sorgt für einen Austausch außerhalb des Arbeitsplatzes. Schnelle Verantwortungsübernahme: Du übernimmst ab Tag 1 spannende Aufgaben mit eigener Verantwortung - egal ob auf deinem Projekt oder bei der Einbringung in interne Aufgabe - du gestaltest mit! Klare Karrieremöglichkeiten: Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, das dich fördert, fordert und weiterbringt. Wir haben klar definierte Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein transparentes Anforderungsmanagement and jedes Level. Kreativer Arbeitsplatz: Wir geben dir die Freiheit und Zeit, kreative Lösungen zu entwickeln und bieten dir dafür die beste und modernste Hardware an (Apple oder Windows). Mitarbeiterbenefits: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit-Card, Wellpass und betriebliche Altersvorsorge sorgen für dein Wohlbefinden. Außerdem gibt es bei uns im Office den Besten Kaffee aus unserer neuen Siebträgermaschine und einen immer gefüllten Soft-Getränkekühlschrank. Attraktive Urlaubsregelung: Du genießt 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und kannst flexibel von daheim arbeiten. KI-Tools: Für Deine Arbeit bei TRUSTEQ stehen Dir aktuelle KI-Tools zur Verfügung. Über uns Wir sind eine dynamische und schnellwachsende Unternehmensberatung, die das Beste aus beiden Welten vereint: die Agilität eines Startups kombiniert mit der Expertise und Erfahrung unseres Top-Managements. Wir unterstützen führende Unternehmen in den Bereichen Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Cloud, AI und Technology Transformation & Data. Bei uns erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien, eine herausragende Teamkultur und Raum für Deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. items.desc: Infrastructure / SRE Engineer Inviso is partnering with one of our clients to find an experienced Backend / Platform Engineer to join their team working remotely. Inviso is managing the recruitment and placement process for this opportunity. This is a remote, direct-hire permanent employee position for our client that is a global multi-billion dollar software conglomerate. The Infrastructure / SRE Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating the cloud, infrastructure, deployment, observability, and reliability capabilities that allow platform teams to ship safely and consistently. This role focuses on landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, incident response, cost optimization, and production readiness. The Engineer treats infrastructure and reliability as products, building repeatable systems that reduce toil, improve delivery speed, and support mission-critical customer environments. The ideal candidate is hands-on, automation-minded, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning systems in production. Experience & Skills Required Experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure with reliability ownership. Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, landing zones, networking, identity, security, and environment management. Experience with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices. Experience establishing observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and actionable operational signals. Experience defining or supporting SLOs, reliability practices, incident response, postmortems, and on-call operations. Ability to automate operational tasks and reduce manual toil through scripts, tools, runbooks, and platform services. Experience preparing software for customer-controlled, hybrid, BYOC, on-premises, or edge environments preferred. Strong understanding of cost and capacity optimization, including expensive compute such as GPU workloads. Strong communication and collaboration skills for client-facing consulting environments. Pragmatic mindset with the ability to balance speed, safety, automation, cost, and operational quality. Desired Qualifications Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bicep, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or related infrastructure and delivery tools. Experience with Azure Arc, fleet management, pull-based deployment patterns, or version/configuration drift management. Experience supporting regulated, air-gapped, edge, or mission-critical delivery environments. Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, model-serving infrastructure, GPU workloads, or AI development lifecycle operations. Experience building enterprise-scale infrastructure supporting multiple teams, products, or customers. Experience using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining strong review, testing, and operational discipline. Success Criteria Success in this role is measured by reliable platform operations, repeatable delivery, strong observability, reduced operational toil, and the ability to help client teams ship safely into complex customer environments. Infrastructure / SRE Engineers are expected to improve speed and stability at the same time.

items.desc: Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino is looking for a Front Desk Agent to join our Room Division team, for season 2027. Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional. Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences. Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino is located on the southwest coast of the Peloponnese, one of the most unspoiled and breath-taking landscapes in the Mediterranean, and 45 minutes’ drive from Kalamata International Airport. The beachfront resort comprises of 99 suites and villas, all with outdoor terraces and sea views, along with seven restaurants and bars. About the job Based at Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino within the Room Division Department, the Front Desk Agent will be responsible for providing exceptional guest service from arrival to departure, ensuring a smooth and personalized experience in accordance with Legendary Quality Experiences. This role includes handling check-ins, check-outs, and guest inquiries while maintaining accuracy in billing and communication across departments. The Front Desk Agent reports to the Front Desk Manager. As Front Desk Agent, you will be responsible for the following duties : Provide courteous, efficient service and ensure guest satisfaction from arrival to departure in line with MOHG Legendary Quality Experiences (LQEs) and Forbes standards. Welcome and register guests promptly, ensuring a smooth arrival experience and escorting them to their rooms when necessary. Coordinate also with other departments the delivery of special requests for seamless experience. Address and record guest preferences. Have an accurate overview and organization of daily and next-day arrivals and departures. Handle guest billing, payments and invoicing in compliance with Greek law and hotel policies. Manage phone calls and guest correspondence including mail and messages. Maintain thorough knowledge of hotel facilities, services, and promotions. Support colleagues and demonstrate teamwork to ensure service excellence. Perform other reasonable duties assigned by management. As Front Desk Agent, we expect from you: Valid EU Passport or Hellenic Residence Permit. Minimum 2-year experience in the luxury hospitality industry in the same or similar position. Proficiency in English, with an additional language preferred. Good computer skills. HMS, Alliants or Alice knowledge is preferred. Driving license is required. Our commitment to you Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously. MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones. Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally. Task force opportunities across the Group of Mandarin Oriental. Depending on your role, you may have the opportunities to be selected as a Cultural Exchange Ambassador. CEAs help to spread our unique Oriental heritage and act as role models, demonstrating how Colleagues will work together to deliver on our vision, mission and philosophies. Accommodation and laundry of linen. Three complimentary meals per day at our Colleague restaurant. Uniform and laundry of uniform. Private Medical Insurance. We’re Fans. Are you?

Application of logical thinking. Be able to use equipment schematics, manuals, etc in the course of establishing root cause. Adhere to troubleshooting standards. Correct the problem Log all equipment downtime and generate downtime reports each shift Support TPM (total productive maintenance) process Document and communicate all spare parts consumed. Highlight any spare parts related issues. Work with spare parts technician to optimise spare parts inventory, cost, supplier reduction, etc Ensure the relevant information is shared effectively across all shifts and among all required groups. Ensure an effective shift handover occurs at the start/end of each shift Complete preventative maintenance (PM) tasks to schedule. Update PM records. Ensure spares/consumables required for PM-activity are in stock. Adhere to 5S requirements in both production and technician work areas. Feedback to the relevant engineers issues concerning the performance of equipment. Support initiatives to improve process/equipment performance Support initiatives to reduce setup and changeover times Provide training to other technicians. Education: Certificate/Diploma Electronic Engineering (or equivalent). Additional training will be provided on the job Training : Agilent i5000 ICT platform GPIB, RS232 and PCIO interfaces C++, Windows, UNIX programming Knowledge of automotive protocols (K-Line, CAN and LIN) SMT Deprag auto screw-insertion Knowledge of pneumatic control systems Experience of automotive-electronics manufacturing standards Professional Experience How many years of professional experience in a specific professional area are required for the position? 2-3 Years working in a manufacturing environment. Preferably in Electronics Industry. items.desc: Junior Geophysicist, Kilcullen We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking. Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting‑edge technology to deliver exceptional client value, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, we embrace progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth. As part of Woolpert, Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company contributes deep geospatial expertise across Europe, supporting complex infrastructure, property, manufacturing, utilities, and natural‑environment projects through world‑class data capture, verification, and governance. Position Overview We are currently recruiting a Junior Geophysicist to join our Subsurface Engineering Department . The role will be responsible for the post processing and interpretation of ground penetrating radar and geophysical data collected in the field and is a great opportunity for someone looking to broaden their experience within the utilities sector to work within the expeditious Geospatial industry. The successful applicant will be reporting to the Production Manager and the role will be based in our Head Office in Kilcullen, Co Kildare with the option of Hybrid/ remote working after the initial training period. What You Will Do Processing Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) data. Management of geophysical projects allocated to you by the Project Manager. Post processing of all geophysical survey data collected from site. Report writing on geophysical survey findings and recommendations. Provide schedule and progress reports to the Project Manager. Problem solving solutions to ensure deadlines are maintained. Ensure client work is delivered to the highest quality standards and any deviations are rectified with haste and learnings incorporated through after-action reviews. Ensure accuracy of all information that is reported on the Project Management system. Comply with company health and safety policies and data protection requirements at all times. Support innovation of workflows and technology. Any other duties as required by the business. What You Will Bring Be fully familiar with field survey design and data acquisition using Ground Penetrating Radar. Have excellent data processing, interpretation, report writing and communications skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel. A degree in Geophysics, Geoscience or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. The right to work in Ireland. Benefits You Will Love At Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include: Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package aligned to your experience Access to cutting‑edge geospatial technology and industry‑leading tools Flexible working options designed to support work–life balance Enhanced wellbeing support, including employee assistance initiatives Opportunities within a growing, globally connected organisation through our partnership with Woolpert Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm. Performance‑related bonus scheme that rewards your contribution Fitness and Wellbeing reimbursement programme Equal Employment Opportunity Woolpert is an equal‑opportunity employer committed to full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, and promote without regard to protected characteristics. For more information, see our EEO resources. Applicants requiring accommodation during recruitment may contact MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com Agency Notice Please do not contact any employee of Woolpert or its subsidiaries about this requisition. Agencies not engaged by the Woolpert Talent Acquisition Team will not be eligible for fee payment.

items.desc: Household Operative - UPMC Kildare Hospital Location: UPMC Kildare Hospital (Clane) Job type: Permanent Salary: €30,805.00 - €39,183.96 pro rata (DOE) Hours: Full Time 39 hours per week Overview of role: To provide a high quality service in line with infection control standards and protocols throughout the organisation. Our successful candidate will be be required to work across the Catering and Housekeeping department. Primary Duties and Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities: Cleaning of Clinical & Non-Clinical department. Waste removals and management. Follow all SOPs and policies. To liaise with Waste Removal Operators when onsite to ensure accuracy of collections and removals. To ensure all equipment used is kept clean and in good condition and stored in the allocated areas. Assist with the preparation, presentation and service of meals and refreshments. Support the delivery and collection of patient meals in accordance with departme ntal procedures. Maintain high standards of cleanliness and hygiene across kitchen. Greet and engage with patients. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Shape the future of medicine and vaccine delivery with cutting-edge technology, ensuring seamless launches and a resilient global supply. Transform lives worldwide by delivering life-changing treatments anywhere, anytime. Grow, thrive, and make an impact in a workplace that empowers you to bring your best self every day, with pride. Help deliver 30+ new product launches by 2030, ensuring patients get treatments faster than ever.

Based in Elanco’s Dublin office, you will also manage the quality system for the Elanco Ireland Marketing Authorisation Holder and Importer entity, ensuring compliance with applicable pharmaceutical regulations, European Union Good
items.desc: At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals! As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People. At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights. Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today! Your Role: Qualified Person As Qualified Person, you will oversee the technical review and certification of veterinary medicinal product batches released for the European market. Based in Elanco’s Dublin office, you will also manage the quality system for the Elanco Ireland Marketing Authorisation Holder and Importer entity, ensuring compliance with applicable pharmaceutical regulations, European Union Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice requirements. Your Responsibilities: Conduct technical reviews and certify European finished-product batches in accordance with Regulation 2019/6, Regulation (EU) 2025/2091 and applicable EU Good Manufacturing Practice requirements, including Articles 39 and 40. Manage quality documentation and act as the primary contact for the European Manufacturing and Quality organisation regarding European batch releases, service-quality indicators, deadlines and follow-up actions. Assess critical deviations with relevant stakeholders and support recall decisions, including participation in management notification processes and product-related governance meetings. Maintain and improve the Elanco Ireland quality system by preparing and approving procedures, work instructions, site master file content, Qualified Person declarations and other product-supporting quality documents. Manage change controls, deviations and self-inspections for the Elanco Ireland entity, support audits and inspections, communicate potential market issues to authorities, and share knowledge of European Union pharmaceutical quality expectations across the organisation. What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications): Qualified Person status for veterinary medicinal products in accordance with Regulation 2019/6 and applicable veterinary Good Manufacturing Practice requirements. A minimum Master’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline. At least two years of experience in a Quality department within a pharmaceutical site, or equivalent. Demonstrated knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Veeva and SAP. What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications): Experience with veterinary medicinal products and European batch release activities. Practical experience managing quality systems, including change controls, deviations and self-inspections. Experience supporting regulatory authority inspections, audits or market issue notifications. Experience preparing quality documentation such as procedures, work instructions, site master file content or Qualified Person declarations. Experience working with cross-functional European quality organisations and communicating quality information in English. Additional Information: Location: Dublin, Ireland. Work model: 100% onsite from the Dublin office. Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrecognized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Elanco we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles! #LI-MK1 Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status Elanco may use automated tools, including AI, to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications against job‑related criteria and/or transferrable skills. items.desc: Research & Development Italy, BEINETTE November 3 2026 Full time Permanent Vantaggi professionali Retribuzione competitiva e programma di bonus Formazione continua (e-learning e progetti) Permessi per volontariato I tuoi compiti e le tue responsabilità: Per il nostro team siamo alla ricerca di un/a Dairy Product Technology Specialist che supporti l’avviamento e l’ottimizzazione di macchine e linee destinate alla produzione di mozzarella, pizza cheese e altri formaggi a pasta filata presso i nostri clienti internazionali. È un ruolo fortemente operativo, che combina conoscenza del processo lattiero-caseario, attività sul campo e problem solving tecnico. La persona seguirà le macchine dalla fase di avviamento presso il cliente fino alla messa a punto dei parametri di processo, assicurandosi che la linea raggiunga le performance e le caratteristiche di prodotto attese. Interverrà inoltre su impianti già in esercizio, collaborando con il Service e l’After Sales per analizzare eventuali problematiche di processo e individuare le regolazioni o le soluzioni più appropriate. Le tue principali responsabilità Seguire l’avviamento di nuove linee produttive e singole macchine presso gli stabilimenti dei clienti, prevalentemente all’estero. Impostare e ottimizzare i parametri tecnologici di processo in funzione della materia prima, del prodotto e delle performance richieste. Supportare il cliente nella produzione di mozzarella, pizza cheese e altri formaggi a pasta filata, intervenendo su aspetti quali umidità, pH, temperature, tempi di lavorazione, resa, consistenza e caratteristiche funzionali del prodotto. Analizzare e risolvere problematiche di processo, individuandone le cause e definendo le azioni correttive più appropriate. Formare il personale del cliente sull’utilizzo delle macchine e sui principali parametri di processo. Raccogliere e analizzare dati tecnologici e di processo direttamente sul campo, utilizzando Excel per interpretarli e supportare le decisioni tecniche. Collaborare con il team Service e After Sales negli interventi tecnologici su macchine e linee già installate. Collaborare con Project Management, Engineering e R&D per il miglioramento delle performance degli impianti e delle soluzioni esistenti. Supportare, quando necessario, il team Sales nelle fasi iniziali dei progetti, contribuendo alla definizione delle soluzioni tecniche e dei KPI di performance. Contribuire, sulla base dell’esperienza maturata sul campo, al miglioramento e allo sviluppo futuro delle nostre tecnologie. Il tuo profilo e le tue qualifiche: Cerchiamo una persona con una buona conoscenza pratica dei processi lattiero-caseari e un forte interesse per la tecnologia applicata alla produzione industriale. Il profilo ideale possiede: esperienza nel settore lattiero-caseario, maturata in caseifici, stabilimenti produttivi, reparti tecnologici o aziende produttrici di macchine e impianti per il settore alimentare; conoscenza dei principali processi di produzione del formaggio; preferibilmente, esperienza specifica nella produzione di mozzarella, pizza cheese o altri formaggi a pasta filata; capacità di comprendere l'impatto di parametri quali pH, temperatura, umidità, composizione della materia prima e condizioni di filatura sulla qualità del prodotto finale; capacità di analizzare dati di processo e buona padronanza di Excel; buona conoscenza dell'inglese, necessaria per lavorare quotidianamente con clienti internazionali; disponibilità a frequenti trasferte internazionali, per circa il 60-70% del tempo, minimo 80 giorni all'anno anche per periodi di 2–3 settimane consecutive; autonomia, capacità di adattamento e attitudine al problem solving in contesti produttivi. Una laurea in Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari, Ingegneria Alimentare o di Processo, Scienze e Tecnologie Lattiero-Casearie, Biotecnologie Alimentari o discipline affini rappresenta un plus, ma non è un requisito indispensabile: siamo interessati anche a candidati che abbiano sviluppato queste competenze direttamente sul campo. Potresti essere la persona giusta anche se oggi lavori in un caseificio o in uno stabilimento lattiero-caseario e hai acquisito un'esperienza pratica completa del processo produttivo, ma non hai ancora lavorato per un costruttore di macchine. Cosa offriamo Un ruolo tecnico con una forte componente internazionale e la possibilità di lavorare direttamente presso clienti in diversi Paesi. L'opportunità di sviluppare competenze sia nella tecnologia casearia sia nell'applicazione industriale su macchine e linee produttive. Un contesto in cui collaborare con Engineering, R&D, Project Management, Sales, Service e After Sales. Un percorso adatto sia a professionisti già esperti sia a profili con solida esperienza pratica e potenziale di crescita. Quando l'attività non richiede la presenza presso clienti, possibilità di lavorare in modalità smart working fino a 2 giorni alla settimana. items.desc: Siamo alla ricerca di una persona per il ruolo di IT Operations & Support per la nostra sede di Milano . Cerchiamo una persona che contribuisca alla gestione e all’evoluzione dei sistemi aziendali, rendendo più semplice il lavoro quotidiano dei team di advertising, analytics, consulenza, creatività e sviluppo. Nel team IT ti occuperai di dispositivi, identità digitali, servizi di collaborazione e infrastruttura. Affiancherai all’amministrazione quotidiana alcune attività di base su sistemi Windows, Mac, Linux, cloud, collaborando con i team tecnici e con il responsabile IT per gli interventi più complessi. RUOLO Come IT Operations & Support ti occuperai di: Supporto alle persone e alle sedi . Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite ticket, individuare le cause dei problemi e seguirne la risoluzione; mantenere operative postazioni, periferiche e sale riunioni, anche per chi lavora da remoto. Dispositivi e asset IT. Configurare e mantenere computer Windows e macOS, distribuire software e aggiornamenti tramite strumenti MDM, applicare configurazioni sicure e curare inventario, licenze e ciclo di vita delle dotazioni, coordinandoti con i fornitori. Identità, accessi e collaborazione . Amministrare Google Workspace e i servizi SaaS: account, gruppi, permessi, autenticazione a più fattori e condivisioni. Gestire gli aspetti IT di ingressi, cambi di ruolo e uscite, in coordinamento con HR e referenti dei servizi. Reti e continuità operativa . Diagnosticare problemi di connettività, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS e DHCP; collaborare alla manutenzione degli apparati di rete, al monitoraggio dei servizi e alla verifica di backup e ripristini. Sicurezza operativa . Gestire aggiornamenti e protezione degli endpoint, verificare log e segnalazioni e collaborare alla risposta agli incidenti. Applicare le procedure di sicurezza e i principi di minimo privilegio e condivisione controllata, tutelando informazioni aziendali e dei clienti. Automazione e integrazioni . Realizzare piccoli script e utilizzare API per semplificare attività ripetitive, controlli e gestione degli account; mantenere le modifiche documentate, verificabili e ripristinabili. Documentazione e miglioramento . Aggiornare procedure e knowledge base, aiutare le persone a usare correttamente gli strumenti e proporre miglioramenti che riducano problemi ricorrenti, tempi di attesa e attività manuali. Requirements Sei la persona che stiamo cercando se hai: Esperienza pratica nell’amministrazione di sistemi o nel supporto IT aziendale, con capacità di gestire richieste e priorità in autonomia e coinvolgere gli specialisti quando necessario. Buona conoscenza di Windows e macOS, dell’hardware e della diagnosi dei problemi; familiarità con la gestione centralizzata dei dispositivi e la protezione degli endpoint. Familiarità con l’amministrazione di Google Workspace o di una suite cloud equivalente e con la gestione di utenti, gruppi, autorizzazioni e autenticazione sicura. Conoscenze operative di networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN e ruolo di switch, router e firewall. Capacità di comunicare con interlocutori anche non tecnici, documentare il lavoro e leggere documentazione tecnica in inglese. Capacità di leggere e modificare semplici script in almeno un linguaggio tra Bash, PowerShell e Python, con attenzione alla gestione sicura di credenziali e dati. Nice to Have: Valorizziamo queste competenze e l’interesse a svilupparle nel tempo: Processi di configurazione automatizzata dei dispositivi. Conoscenze di Google Cloud o AWS, in particolare di identità e permessi, macchine virtuali, storage e monitoraggio. Familiarità con Docker, Git, API REST e semplici flussi di integrazione e deployment. Conoscenza di SSO, strumenti di monitoraggio e logging, backup e ripristino, oppure esperienza nel supporto a team di sviluppo. Caratteristiche personali Cerchiamo precisione e curiosità tecnica. Per noi contano la capacità di ascoltare, collaborare, assumersi la responsabilità delle attività e trovare soluzioni concrete. Saper bilanciare rapidità e sicurezza, dando priorità ai problemi che incidono sul lavoro delle persone e sulla continuità dei servizi, sono aspetti fondamentali per questo ruolo. items.desc: Established in Turin in 2008, eGlue Technologies is a leading company in embedded software development, cloud computing, and machine learning. eGlue supports industrial and automotive customers from the very early stages of the project to the final release of the product. Initially concentrating on developing Linux-based embedded software for connected vehicles, our journey has evolved launching a cloud division fulfilling the increasing market demand of big data analytics. Adopting Agile methodology, we ensure adaptability and iterative development in both embedded and cloud projects. Posizione: We are seeking Software Engineers to join our cloud and systems team. The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in computer science engineering—specifically in networking, web application mechanics, client-server architectures, and security principles . In this role, you will contribute to the design, architectural definition, and implementation of secure, high-performance web applications and backend systems. While our core ecosystem relies on C# / .NET and Azure, we value strong architectural vision and core engineering concepts over specific tool knowledge. You will actively participate in projects centred around the following key topics: Design and implementation of scalable client-server architectures and RESTful APIs. Securing web communications, data transport, and application endpoints. System-level architectural choices for cloud-connected applications and big data ingestion. RESPONSIBILITIES Designing and implementing robust software architectures for web and backend platforms. Managing networking communications (HTTP/S, TCP/IP, WebSockets) between client and server components. Applying software security best practices (authentication, authorization, encryption, secure API design). Analyzing application bottlenecks and optimizing architectural performance. Participating in technical design reviews and alignment meetings using Agile methodologies. Interfacing with customers to translate business needs into technical architectural requirements (Middle profiles). Requisiti: BASIC REQUIREMENTS (JUNIOR/INTERNSHIP PROFILES) Solid knowledge of Client-Server architecture and Web application fundamentals . Strong understanding of Networking concepts & protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, REST, TCP/IP, DNS). Understanding of Software Security principles (TLS/SSL, OAuth2/JWT, CORS, OWASP foundation). Knowledge of Software & Architectural Patterns (OOP, MVC, Microservices, Clean Architecture basics). Degrees in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS (SENIOR PROFILES) Hands-on experience or familiarity with C# and .NET ecosystem (.NET Core / .NET 6+). Knowledge of SQL databases and ORMs (e.g., Entity Framework ). Familiarity with cloud providers, specifically Microsoft Azure (App Services, Azure SQL, Functions). Version control systems ( Git ). Altre informazioni: Language: English, Italian (B2+). Work model: Hybrid. Compensation and Benefits Package The final salary offer will be aligned with the candidate's background, skills, and professional experience, within the following reference ranges: Junior: €28,000 – €34,000 Gross Annual Salary Middle: €34,000 – €42,000 Gross Annual Salary Senior: €42,000 – €50,000 Gross Annual Salary In addition to the base salary, the comprehensive package includes the following benefits: €8/day digital meal vouchers (electronic Ticket Restaurant) for each working day Annual welfare budget Performance bonus

items.desc: About the Company G.D is a leading organization headquartered in Bologna, Italy. As a key player in the high-tech machineries production, we specialize in cutting-edge technologies, shaping the future of industrial automation. Our business portfolio encompasses a wide range of innovative making and packing solutions, in particular for Modern Oral and Next Generation products. We strive to continuously expand our offerings and enhance our capabilities to meet the evolving needs of our customers. For more detailed information about G.D and its comprehensive business landscape, please visit www.gidi.it. G.D is part of Coesia, a group of innovation-based industrial and packaging solutions companies operating globally, headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Coesia operates in 34 countries with 21 different companies and employs over 8,000 people as of 2026. About the Role The successful candidate, reporting directly to the FP&A Manager within the Group Controlling Department , will be responsible for the following Group-level activities: Understanding the main items of the balance sheet and income statement; Performing accounting reviews and economic/financial analyses; Managing monthly closings and overseeing the monthly actuals, budgeting, and forecasting processes; Preparing monthly reports and variance analyses, including: Order Intake, Revenue, and Backlog Profit & Loss (P&L) Operating Expenses (Opex) by Cost Center and Nature Capital Expenditures (Capex) Personnel Costs Balance Sheet (BS) & Cash Flow Preparing management reports for Top Management; Managing and developing the reporting software platform. What You Need to Be Successful Degree in Economics, Business Administration, or Management Engineering; At least 2 years of experience in Controlling , with solid expertise in Business Analysis , management reporting, management and industrial accounting, as well as a strong foundation in general accounting; Understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) , accounting procedures, monthly closing processes, and experience with management consolidation activities; Good command of spoken and written English; Proficiency in SAP and advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Experience with reporting and/or business intelligence tools for data analysis, such as IBM Cognos and Tagetik , will be considered a plus. The profile is completed by excellent organizational skills, a proactive attitude, strong problem-solving capabilities, flexibility, and outstanding interpersonal and communication skills. Our Offer Compensation for this role includes a base salary starting from EUR 36.000, in line with experience. The actual offer may exceed this minimum based on the candidate's qualifications and fit for the role. A range of additional benefits (e.g., insurances, etc.) is also available in accordance with Company policy. The applicable collective agreement is the CCNL Metalmeccanico. Join the Team!
