items.desc: Vacature: User-Centered Design Pionier Maak impact op de werkvloer met design en technologie Bij RoboHouse zoeken we een User‑Centered Design Pionier – iemand die user‑centered design research tot leven brengt en met vernieuwende oplossingen de werkvloer van de toekomst mede vormgeeft. Wij geloven dat technologie het werk van mensen in uiteenlopende werkomgevingen kan versterken. Daarom ontwikkelen we robotica die fysiek werk ondersteunt, ontworpen mét de mensen die dat werk dagelijks doen. Dat realiseren we samen met bedrijven, onderzoekers en startups, vanuit ons fieldlab op de campus van de TU Delft. Als User‑Centered Design Pionier ben je onderdeel van het RoboHouse Innovatieteam. Dit team bestaat uit design- en robotica-engineers die met een learning by doing-aanpak oplossingen ontwikkelen voor concrete situaties op de werkvloer. Je onderzoekt, ontwerpt en co-creëert samen met bedrijven en hun medewerkers. Altijd met maatschappelijke impact als drijfveer. Daarmee maken we samen onze missie waar: 'Robotics voor a better society'. Voel je je aangesproken door deze vacature, maar vink je niet elk hokje af? Gewoon reageren. We leren je graag kennen. Wat je gaat doen Je stapt in ons worker-centric innovatieproces waarin co-creatie, joint decision-making en learning-by-doing centraal staan. In de projecten waar je aan zult werken, maken we robotica tastbaar voor het MKB en grote bedrijven. Samen met het team onderzoek je werkprocessen, voer je user research uit en ontwerp je oplossingen die écht werken. · Je werkt nauw samen met mensen op de werkvloer: van zorgmedewerker tot installateur. · Je begeleidt co-creatie sessies en vertaalt inzichten uit het veld naar ontwerpconcepten. · Je werkt iteratief: kennismaken, observeren, ontwerpen, co-creëren, aanpassen. · Je schakelt met bedrijven, van innovatieve MKB’s tot grote corporates. · Je werkt actief samen met het RoboHouse Innovatieteam én bent met enige regelmaat op locatie bij bedrijven. · Je draagt bij aan maatschappelijke impact: robotics for a better society. Wat we van jou vragen Je hebt ervaring met design thinking of vergelijkbare innovatieprocessen. Je weet hoe je user research opzet en uitvoert. Je bent bekend met werken volgens agile-methodieken, zoals kanban of scrum Je bent minimaal medior in ervaring en kunt zelfstandig een project trekken. Je vindt het leuk en toont betrokkenheid om samen te werken met mensen uit de praktijk in uiteenlopende omgevingen zoals op de werkvloer, in een loods of een fabriek. Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en niet bang om te pionieren. Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed , in woord en geschrift. Ervaring met robotica is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen must. Wat je van ons krijgt Een plek in een praktisch, creatief team dat houdt van aanpakken. Werken aan maatschappelijke innovatie met tastbare impact. Veel vrijheid om je werk en aanpak zelf vorm te geven. Hybride werken is deels mogelijk – maar je bent regelmatig op locatie en werkt nauw samen met het innovatieteam op RoboHouse. Een fijne werkcultuur waarin experimenteren, leren en lachen centraal staan. De praktische zaken Locatie : RoboHouse, TU Delft Campus, met regelmatig werk op locatie bij bedrijven. Fulltime (32-40 uur per week, 0.8–1.0 fte). Hybride werken : De mogelijkheid bestaat om deels thuis te werken, maar je bent regelmatig bij bedrijven en werkt samen met het innovatieteam. Dienstverband : bepaalde tijd (1 jaar), met uitzicht op verlenging. Salaris : afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring met een minimum van € 3.706,- en een maximum van € 5.760,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime aanstelling van 40 uur per week. 41 vakantiedagen (328 uur) bij een fulltime aanstelling (40 uur), bovenop nationale feestdagen. Vakantiegeld in mei én een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% in december. Een goede pensioenregeling via ABP. Telefoon en laptop van de zaak. Reiskostenvergoeding. Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap? Stuur dan vóór 1 december je cv of portfolio en een korte motivatie naar y.h.m.entius@tudelft.nl. Wil je eerst even sparren of heb je vragen over de rol? Neem gerust contact op met Yvette Entius, Directeur RoboHouse, via 0634115213 of y.h.m.entius@tudelft.nl. Salaris: €3.706,00 - €5.760,00 per maand Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Flexibele werkuren Pensioen Reiskostenvergoeding Werklocatie: Fysiek

items.desc: Application packaging engineer Maak impact op de digitale werkplek van TU Delft! Bouw mee aan slimme Self-Service Software Delivery en maak software eenvoudig toegankelijk voor onderwijs en onderzoek. Functieomschrijving Hoe zorg je ervoor dat duizenden medewerkers en studenten op het juiste moment over de juiste software beschikken? En hoe maak je dat proces betrouwbaar, veilig en zoveel mogelijk geautomatiseerd? Als Software Delivery & Automation Engineer werk je aan het beschikbaar stellen, distribueren en up-to-date houden van software binnen TU Delft. Van software packaging en deployment tot scripting, automatisering en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.Je maakt deel uit van Software Delivery (SWD), een compact technisch team binnen de directie ICT. Samen verzorgen we softwaredistributie voor een veelzijdige omgeving, van standaardsoftware tot specialistische applicaties voor onderwijs en onderzoek. Je werkzaamheden zijn afwisselend. De ene dag onderzoek je waarom software niet goed installeert op een onderwijswerkplek. De volgende dag automatiseer je een proces met PowerShell of verbeter je de softwaredistributie via Microsoft Intune of Ivanti Neurons. Je neemt vraagstukken rondom softwaredistributie van analyse tot validatie op je. Je onderzoekt wat nodig is, ontwikkelt of configureert een passende oplossing, test het resultaat en legt je bevindingen vast. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het directe probleem en zoek je naar mogelijkheden om onze softwaredistributie betrouwbaarder, eenvoudiger en slimmer te maken. Je houdt je bezig met het voorbereiden, testen en distribueren van applicaties, het analyseren van installatieproblemen en het automatiseren van werkzaamheden met onder andere PowerShell en API's. Ook werk je aan software-updates, standaardisatie en het verbeteren van onze technische processen. Naast deze ontwikkelingen draag je bij aan de dagelijkse dienstverlening, zoals softwareaanvragen, wijzigingen en incidenten. Onze dienstverlening is volop in ontwikkeling. We onderzoeken hoe nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI, ons kunnen helpen bij technische analyse, troubleshooting, scripting en automatisering. Daarbij blijft kritisch denken belangrijk: je controleert aannames en test of oplossingen daadwerkelijk werken. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, beheerders en leveranciers. Binnen het team krijg je ruimte om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe mogelijkheden te onderzoeken en verbeteringen daadwerkelijk door te voeren. We zoeken niet uitsluitend iemand die alle technologieën al beheerst. Ook als je aan het begin van je loopbaan staat of vanuit een andere technische functie wilt doorgroeien, bieden we ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen. Functie-eisen Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en een technische basis in Windows-beheer, applicatiebeheer, softwaredistributie of automatisering. Je hebt basiskennis van Windows, software-installaties en technische probleemoplossing. Je bent technisch nieuwsgierig, denkt analytisch en onderzoekt graag hoe systemen en applicaties werken. Je werkt zorgvuldig en gestructureerd, controleert aannames en vindt het belangrijk om oplossingen goed te testen en te documenteren. Je hebt affiniteit met scripting, bij voorkeur PowerShell, en het automatiseren van werkzaamheden. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, communiceert duidelijk, zoekt de samenwerking op en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat. Ervaring met Microsoft Intune of vergelijkbare distributieplatformen, software packaging (MSI/MSIX, Win32), PowerShell en troubleshooting is welkom. Kennis van Ivanti Neurons, Microsoft Graph API, REST API's, Git, CI/CD, Microsoft Entra ID, software-lifecyclemanagement, AI-toepassingen of affiniteit met Linux en/of macOS is een pré. Ervaring is welkom, maar ontwikkelpotentieel telt ook. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je technisch inzicht hebt, zorgvuldig werkt, graag leert en nieuwe technologie snel eigen maakt. TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Al meer dan 180 jaar leiden we ingenieurs op die wereldwijd impact maken bij bedrijven, overheden of als ondernemer. Onze alumni zetten kennis om in concrete oplossingen voor de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Die uitdagingen veranderen snel. Daarom werken we elke dag aan thema’s zoals energie, klimaat, digitalisering, AI en slimme mobiliteit. Ons onderwijs en onderzoek sluiten direct aan op wat de samenleving nodig heeft, nu en straks. Bij TU Delft maken mensen het verschil. Met hun kennis en nieuwsgierigheid zorgen zij voor sterk onderwijs, vernieuwend onderzoek en innovaties die verder komen dan de campus. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, samen te werken en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wie bij TU Delft werkt, sluit zich aan bij een internationale community van professionals en studenten. Samen bouwen we aan kennis, innovatie en oplossingen die de wereld vooruithelpen. Universiteitsdienst – Directie ICT Bij de directie ICT werken we met circa 200 collega’s verdeeld over een …

items.desc: Techniek begrijpelijk maken én verbeteringen realiseren? In deze rol vertaal je wensen uit de business naar slimme IT-oplossingen die echt het verschil maken. Aalsmeer Product Owner IT Aalsmeer Jouw uitdaging Als IT Product Owner / Portfoliomanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het optimaliseren van het digitale landschap van de afdeling Real Estate & Facility Management (RE&FM). Je bent sparringpartner om de businesswaarde en systeemcontinuïteit te maximaliseren. Samen met de Business Owners vertaal je de visie en doelen van RE&FM naar haalbare digitale oplossingen. Royal FloraHolland werkt veel met SaaS-oplossingen voor bijvoorbeeld een ticket-management systeem en een oplossing voor fysieke toegangsbeveiliging. Een interessant aspect in het digitale landschap van RE&FM is de combinatie tussen Informatie technologie en Operationele technologie. De integratie van deze twee werelden maakt deel uit van je functie. Jouw Functie Samen met de business bepaal je prioriteiten en beheer je het IT portfolio en de roadmap. Je hebt het overzicht over het totale applicatie landschap en bepaalt de richting waarin dit landschap zich ontwikkelt. Verder: Zorg je voor implementeerbare oplossingen die passen binnen het ICT-landschap en stemt deze af met de verschillende stakeholders. Breng je structuur in projecten met focus op security, compliance, standaardisatie en rationalisatie, ondersteund door Enterprise Architecture. Coördineert je leveranciers en outsourcingpartners zoals Conclusion en Heijmans. Je bewaakt het overzicht van het applicatielandschap en stuurt de ontwikkeling daarvan. Wat jij meebrengt WO werk en denkniveau; Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie in een complexe regie organisatie (IT Project Manager, Business/Informatie analyst en/of -Consultant); Het spreken en schrijven van de Nederlandse taal is een vereiste voor de functie; Je weet regie te nemen en structuur aan te brengen bij de verschillende projecten; Je hebt ervaring met het onderhouden van contacten met leveranciers. Ons Aanbod Een salaris volgens de cao (o.b.v. 38 uur per week) van €5.652,- tot €8.061,- en 8,33% vakantiegeld . Een thuiswerkvergoeding én een budget van €750 voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek. Een werkweek van 32, 36 of 38 uur afhankelijk van jouw wens. Hybride werken vanuit onze locaties in Aalsmeer en Naaldwijk, gecombineerd met thuiswerken. 27 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband met de mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen. 5x per jaar een plant cadeau Ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via onze Academy. Toegang tot een uitgebreid online leerplatform voor jouw ontwikkeling. Extra voordelen zoals personeelskorting, een fietsplan en een actieve personeelsvereniging . Meer informatie? Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de vacature of procedure waar de vacaturetekst je geen antwoord op geeft? Voor meer informatie over het sollicitatieproces kun je contact opnemen met Recruiter Jorieke Hogeland, via joriekehogeland@royalfloraholland.com. Een online screening en referentiecheck maken deel uit van het sollicitatieproces, net als de aanvraag van een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG). Werk je bij een bureau en wil je een kandidaat voorstellen voor deze vacature bij Royal FloraHolland? Bedankt, maar hier gaan we niet op in. We werven onze nieuwe collega graag zelf. De afdeling Je staat er misschien niet bij stil, maar de digitale achterkant van Royal FloraHolland is ronduit vernieuwend. Data, machine learning en AI: alles zetten we in voor het perfect servicen van onze klanten en het optimaliseren van (logistieke) processen. Met onze IT-projecten maak je tot ver over de grenzen impact en versterk je onze leidende positie. Zo bouw je mee aan Floriday, het digitale platform dat wereldwijd, 24/7, duizenden kwekers en kopers bij elkaar brengt. Ook beheren we de supply chain waarin dagelijks miljoenen ‘fusten’ – onze beroemde bloemenemmers – verwerkt worden. Naast developers vind je daarom ook architecten, cloud engineers, data scientists, security officers en andere rollen in het team. Onmisbaar bij het ontwikkelen en digitaliseren van processen en systemen. Waar ga jij aan de slag? Royal FloraHolland is de grootste internationale sierteeltmarktplaats van bloemen en planten: een vereniging van kwekers met een bedrijf. Al meer dan 100 jaar streven we samen naar een optimale prijs voor bloemen en planten, met de beste kwaliteit tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten. Een dubbelzijdig Royal FloraHolland platform: een digitaal platform, Floriday, en een logistiek platform, waarmee logistieke, financiële en vastgoeddiensten nauw met elkaar verbonden zijn. We streven naar duurzaam succes voor onze leden en werken samen met alle partijen in de sierteeltsector, zodat de sector blijft groeien. Wij geloven dat we samen meer bereiken dan alleen. We willen waarde toevoegen via ons internationale B2B platform en vanuit een gezonde coöperatie. Via onze diensten zorgen we dat we onze klantbeloftes ook duurzaam waarmaken: …

Het platform wordt gehost en ondersteund door Blue Yonder, inclusief het Snowflake reporting platform en first-line support. In deze rol speel je een sleutelrol in het opbouwen van interne Warehouse Management expertise. Waar we nu nog intensief samenwerken met een implementatiepartner, neem jij stap voor stap meer verantwoordelijkheid over. Je analyseert processen, vertaalt veranderingen naar functionele specificaties, voert configuraties en basic development uit en begeleidt integratietesten en deployments. Bij complexe vraagstukken werk je nauw samen met onze implementatiepartner en het Blue Yonder productteam. Als onderdeel van onze internationale SAFe en Agile organisatie , sluit je aan bij de Logistics ART , waarin je samenwerkt met 8 teams verspreid over Europa. Wat ga je doen? Als Blue Yonder WMS Engineer werk je nauw samen met de Product Owner Logistics en draag je actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze WMS-roadmap. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere uitrol van het platform en in innovatieve projecten rondom robotisering en automatisering. Je vertaalt businessbehoeften naar slimme oplossingen door: Requirements op te halen en uit te werken in user stories en designopties Oplossingen te configureren, bouwen en testen binnen Blue Yonder Intensief samen te werken met interne teams en externe partners om kwaliteit te waarborgen Daarnaast: Ondersteun je go-lives en hypercare fases op locatie Ben je hét aanspreekpunt voor WMS-vraagstukken (functioneel, technisch en database) Coördineer je supportcases en stem je af met Blue Yonder Zorg je voor heldere documentatie en verzorg je trainingen voor key users Bewaak je de performance en continuïteit van het systeem Heb je met Blue Yonder WMS en logistieke processen. Kennis van MOCA voor het ontwikkelen en beheren van maatwerkoplossingen binnen Blue Yonder. Ervaring met Groovy scripting voor automatiseringen, integraties en systeemuitbreidingen. Kortom: een veelzijdige rol waarin je techniek, processen en stakeholders samenbrengt om functionele wensen te vertalen naar technische oplossingen binnen het WMS-landschap van Royal FloraHolland! Ons aanbod Een team met een positieve werksfeer en een echte can-do mentaliteit Een werkweek van 32 tot 38 uur per week Een salaris (o.b.v. 38 uur) van € 4.938 tot € 7.006 volgens de cao Hybride werken vanuit onze locaties in Aalsmeer en Naaldwijk , gecombineerd met thuiswerken 27 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband Een laptop en telefoon 5x per jaar een plantcadeau Ruime ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via onze Academy Werken bij een unieke coöperatie: de grootste marktplaats voor bloemen en planten in Europa De afdeling Je staat er misschien niet bij stil, maar de digitale achterkant van Royal FloraHolland is ronduit vernieuwend. Data, machine learning en AI: alles zetten we in voor het perfect servicen van onze klanten en het optimaliseren van (logistieke) processen. Met onze IT-projecten maak je tot ver over de grenzen impact en versterk je onze leidende positie. Zo bouw je mee aan Floriday, het digitale platform dat wereldwijd, 24/7, duizenden kwekers en kopers bij elkaar brengt. Ook beheren we de supply chain waarin dagelijks miljoenen ‘fusten’ – onze beroemde bloemenemmers – verwerkt worden. Naast developers vind je daarom ook architecten, cloud engineers, data scientists, security officers en andere rollen in het team. Onmisbaar bij het ontwikkelen en digitaliseren van processen en systemen. Waar ga jij aan de slag? Royal FloraHolland is de grootste internationale sierteeltmarktplaats van bloemen en planten: een vereniging van kwekers met een bedrijf. Al meer dan 100 jaar streven we samen naar een optimale prijs voor bloemen en planten, met de beste kwaliteit tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten. Een dubbelzijdig Royal FloraHolland platform: een digitaal platform, Floriday, en een logistiek platform, waarmee logistieke, financiële en vastgoeddiensten nauw met elkaar verbonden zijn. We streven naar duurzaam succes voor onze leden en werken samen met alle partijen in de sierteeltsector, zodat de sector blijft groeien. Wij geloven dat we samen meer bereiken dan alleen. Candidates will be joining some of the brightest inventors and engineers in the world to develop products that make data faster and safer. items.desc: Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About this role In this role, you will join the Customer Data Products & Insights (CDPI) team, the group responsible for building the data foundations that power all customer experiences at Just Eat Takeaway. We work collaboratively across CRM, Product, and Marketing to lead with data, deliver trusted insights, and care about the quality and impact of what we build. As a Data Engineer, you’ll design, build, and optimise the pipelines and models that fuel our Customer Data Platform and downstream activation tools. You’ll work closely with analysts and cross-functional partners to translate business needs into reliable, scalable, and production-ready solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives such as Data Ignite and Looker adoption, helping us build a consistent and customer-centric data ecosystem that supports millions of users. Location: 3 days a week from our Amsterdam office & 2 days working from home Reporting to: Senior Manager - Customer Data Products and Insights These are some of the key components to the position: Design, build, and maintain scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines to ensure the CDP remains the trusted source of customer data. Implement strong data quality checks, lineage, and governance using tools such as DataHub and Morpheus to uphold accuracy and reliability. Collaborate with CRM, Product, and engineering partners to integrate new events, attributes, and identifiers into the customer data ecosystem. Build and optimise ELT pipelines using BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, and Datadog, aiming for excellence in performance, stability, and scalability. Apply best practices in documentation, unit testing, and CI/CD to ensure production-ready, high-quality data assets. Partner with the Data Ignite team to develop datasets for activation through Hightouch, supporting CRM, Product, and Media use cases. Ensure Hightouch-ready tables are efficient, secure, and well-monitored, and contribute to troubleshooting and optimisation when needed. Support the migration to Looker by building semantic layers and standardised customer KPIs aligned with global definitions. Work with analysts and engineers to design scalable data models that enable self-serve dashboards and consistent reporting. Contribute to sprint planning, technical prioritisation, and knowledge-sharing to help the team collaborate effectively and deliver together. What will you bring to the team? Strong SQL and dbt skills, with the ability to design clean, scalable data models that support reliable customer insights. Confident Python abilities for automation, orchestration, and building pipelines that help the team deliver efficiently. Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster, and a desire to optimise workflows for stability and speed. Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT best practices, and governance concepts that ensure trust and accountability. Interest in customer and marketing datasets, with curiosity for how data powers segmentation, activation, and engagement. A sense of ownership and a proactive approach, contributing to the team’s success with a collaborative and positive mindset. Openness to learning Looker semantic modelling and supporting our migration from Tableau to a unified reporting platform. Willingness to explore tools like Hightouch or other activation platforms to understand how data drives real-time experiences. Curiosity for real-time data frameworks such as Pub/Sub, Kafka, or Dataflow, and a desire to build future-ready pipelines. A responsible, growth-oriented working style, eager to learn from others, share knowledge, and help the team aim higher together. At JET, this is how we play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn't just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers' loyalty, again and again. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we're building a …

items.desc: Researcher 32-38 uren € 4050.00 - € 6400.00 per Maand Warmenhuizen Ben jij een nieuwsgierige moleculair plantenwetenschapper die graag de verbinding legt tussen genetica, moleculaire biologie en AI-ondersteunde analyses? Omdat ons onderzoek naar wortelgewassen verder groeit, zoeken we een Researcher Trait Discovery & Genomics die biologische vraagstukken weet te vertalen naar experimenteel gevalideerde genen en concrete mogelijkheden voor de veredeling van wortelen. Jouw baan Binnen de afdeling Trait Discovery & Genomics van Bejo draag je bij aan de verdere verbetering van ons Apiaceae-portfolio, met de nadruk op peen. Je werkt nauw samen met onderzoekers, onderzoeksassistenten, veredelaars en specialisten op het gebied van bio-informatica, fytopathologie, celbiologie en data science. Samen vertalen jullie genetische observaties en biologische hypotheses naar kandidaatgenen, functionele validatie en uiteindelijk toepassing binnen de veredeling. Je volgt wetenschappelijke en technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet, beoordeelt nieuwe methoden en vertaalt kansrijke toepassingen naar robuuste en gebruiksvriendelijke onderzoeksprocessen. Samen met onderzoeksassistenten organiseer je het experimentele werk, leg je methoden en resultaten zorgvuldig vast en weet je complexe onderzoeksresultaten helder over te brengen. Daarbij houd je steeds het uiteindelijke doel voor ogen: onderzoeksresultaten realiseren die praktisch toepasbaar zijn binnen onderzoek en veredeling. Dit krijg je van ons Bij Bejo werk je in een betrokken familiebedrijf met een informele en collegiale sfeer, waar je veel ruimte krijgt om je talent te ontwikkelen en werk en privé goed in balans te houden. We investeren in jouw groei, vitaliteit en duurzame inzetbaarheid, en bieden een arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket dat past bij wat jij nodig hebt om met plezier je werk te doen. Voor de rol van Researcher krijg je onder andere; Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.050,00 en € 6.400,00 bij een fulltime dienstverband, aangevuld met een winstdeling en 8,33% vakantiegeld. Flexibel arbeidsvoorwaardenbudget van €800 netto per jaar, vrij besteedbaar aan o.a. sport & vitaliteit, werk‑privébalans, mobiliteit en duurzaamheid. Studie‑ en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, doorgroeikansen en diverse vitaliteitsvoorzieningen (zoals OpenUp en #BejoFit). Goede pensioenregeling en aanvullende verzekeringen Vakantie- en vitaliteitsdagen volgens de Tuinzaden cao Actieve personeelsvereniging die diverse bedrijfsactiviteiten -borrels en uitjes organiseert Maatschappelijke betrokkenheid, met veel aandacht voor duurzaamheid en de wereldwijde voedselvoorziening. Dit gaat over jou Je bent een inventieve en pragmatische plantenwetenschapper die graag onderzoekt hoe genen van invloed zijn op planteigenschappen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking op met collega’s met aanvullende expertise en voelt je thuis in multidisciplinaire teams. Je combineert wetenschappelijke diepgang met een praktische instelling en weet ideeën te vertalen naar goed opgezette experimenten en oplossingen die breder toepasbaar zijn. Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand met: Minimaal een masteropleiding (MSc) en ervaring op het gebied van moleculaire plantenbiologie, genetica, biotechnologie, bio-informatica, computationele biologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Expertise in gene discovery, functionele of translationele genetica, moleculaire veredeling, plantenbiotechnologie of computationele plantenwetenschappen. Kennis van genetische mappingmethoden, zoals QTL-mapping, bulked-segregant analysis (BSA) en GWAS, en inzicht in wanneer je welke methode toepast. Je kunt vanuit gemapte regio’s de stap maken naar kandidaatgenen met behulp van fine mapping, selectie van recombinanten en de integratie van sequentie-, annotatie-, expressie- en biologische gegevens. Ervaring met het identificeren en prioriteren van kandidaatgenen en praktische ervaring met functionele genvalidatie, bij voorkeur in combinatie met data mining en AI-ondersteunde methoden. Ervaring met het analyseren en interpreteren van grootschalige biologische datasets of multi-omicsdata is een pré. Goede organisatorische vaardigheden voor het plannen van experimenteel onderzoek, het vastleggen van methoden en resultaten en het afstemmen met collega’s. Goede communicatieve en samenwerkingsvaardigheden en een professionele beheersing van de Engelse taal. Bereidheid om zowel binnen Nederland als internationaal te reizen. items.desc: Sportradar AS Ferjemannsveien 10, 7042 Trondheim Om jobben Lagre favoritt Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 2 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor THE CHALLENGE Make security a normal part of how our engineers build software, from secure design and threat modelling to security reviews. Put the right security checks into CI/CD: SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, infrastructure-as-code scanning and supply chain security. Work with Platform Engineering to secure our cloud and Kubernetes environments. Run vulnerability management based on risk, from deciding what matters most to seeing the fix shipped. Help engineering teams build securely without slowing them down, including when they work with AI coding tools. Be the person engineers come to with security questions, and give them answers they can act on. Lead DevSecOps Security Engineer Stay hands-on, and set the technical standard the rest of the team follows. Senior Manager, Information Security Engineering Lead the team: strategy, roadmap, hiring and performance, while staying close to the technical work. Be a trusted voice with engineering and technology leaders. ABOUT YOU You like security best when it helps people ship good software, not when it gets in their way. You are happy working next to engineers, explaining the "why" and then rolling up your sleeves to fix things with them. You keep learning, and you care about getting things done in a global company. Experience in DevSecOps, security engineering, application security or cloud security. Good knowledge of CI/CD and modern development practice. Experience securing cloud-native environments, preferably AWS, and working with Kubernetes and containers. A solid grasp of vulnerability management and the OWASP Top 10. A track record of working with engineering teams as an adviser and enabler. Clear, confident communication in fluent English. For the Senior Manager route: experience leading engineers, setting direction, running hiring and managing performance. Nice to have: CSPM or KSPM tooling, AWS and GCP security, GitLab Ultimate, infrastructure as code, large enterprise experience, security certifications. In your application, add a few lines on which route suits you better and why: Lead DevSecOps Engineer, or Senior Manager (leading a team while staying hands-on). If you are open to either, say so. OUR OFFER A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a hybrid model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. If needed, there is a option for home office days. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Two technical interviews: Meet with the Technical team and Hiring Manager to dive into your solution and your expertise, as well as discuss team fit. Final Steps: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! We keep it simple and aim to wrap up the process within 3 weeks. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) - we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team! items.desc: Job Summary : Interested in a career where contracts, negotiation, and clinical research come together? Medpace is hosting a virtual information session for individuals interested in learning more about our Contract Specialist opportunities across Europe. During this session, you'll learn more about our office-based Clinical Contract Specialist opportunities at Medpace, with openings in London, Munich, Warsaw, Prague, and Leuven . Whether you are an early-career professional or bringing transferable experience from another industry, join us to learn more about a career in clinical research contracts. WHEN: November 30th at 11:00 AM A first pre-screening will be done and if you're selected you will receive a MS Teams invite to follow the online event. Responsibilities : The Contract Specialists are in charge of Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and finalizing agreements, termination letters or other legal documents required for a clinical study; Negotiate within client approved contract and budget templates and negotiation parameters; Identify and assesses legal, financial, and operational risks and escalate to appropriate Contract Lead or Contract Manager; Provide recommendations and alternative resolutions throughout negotiations using established escalation channels; Coordinate with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual process and mutually agreed up timelines; and Keep up to date with applicable local regulations impacting clinical trial contracts. Qualifications : Bachelor's, Master's or PhD graduate in Business, Law or related fields; or an experienced professional with transferable contract, legal, procurement or commercial experience; Strong language proficiency in English and the local language; Willing to work office-based. Medpace Overview : Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries. Why Medpace? : When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration. Purpose-Driven Work Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence Collaborative Culture Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust. Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable Continuous Growth & Development Office based environment with on-site mentors Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly Other Employee Benefits Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training Company-sponsored social events Please note benefits may vary based on country. What to Expect Next A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

items.desc: Posting Description: ATS Integration Consultant Do you enjoy solving complex integration challenges and working directly alongside customers to bring technical solutions to life? Are you experienced in working with RESTful web services and interested in connecting HR technology platforms and systems? Join Aon and help our enterprise clients optimally integrate their technology using the assessment tools available through Aon form! Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As a Consultant for ATS Integration, you will be responsible for client onboarding initiatives from initial requirements through implementation, testing and debut. You will interact directly with customers to understand their ATS environment and workflows and translate their requirements into effective technical integrations. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Crafting and implementing integrations between the Aon Assessment Platform and customer ATS systems using web services described by OpenAPI specifications, RESTful endpoints, webhooks, JSON, XML and SFTP-based data exchange. Working directly with customer HR technology and IT teams to understand ATS configurations, authentication requirements, candidate workflows and data exchange needs. Handling integrations beginning with collecting requirements and continuing through configuration, testing, and launch, including troubleshooting API errors, data mapping issues, and workflow exceptions. Crafting clear integration specifications and data mapping documentation and supporting customers throughout testing and implementation. Prioritising multiple customer integration projects while working closely with Engineering, Solution Architects, Technical Support and QA teams. Maintaining integration documentation and helping identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve customer implementations. How this opportunity is different This role gives you the opportunity to combine technical integration work with direct customer engagement. You will work with different ATS environments and customer workflows, solving technical integration challenges while guiding customers through implementation. You will have ownership of integrations from initial discovery through launch and work closely with both customer teams and Aon's technical specialists. It is a superb opportunity for someone who enjoys working with APIs and data, solving integration problems and building positive relationships with customers throughout the implementation process. Skills and experience that will lead to success proven track record in technical integration, solutions engineering or implementation consulting, ideally within HR technology, SaaS or enterprise software. Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI, JSON/XML and OAuth 2.0 , including troubleshooting integration failures and working with API responses and payloads. Experience delivering customer-facing integration projects end-to-end, from requirements gathering and configuration through testing and launch. Experience with at least one major ATS platform such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle Taleo, Greenhouse, iCIMS or SmartRecruiters , combined with an understanding of data mapping, transformation and validation. Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical requirements clearly and prioritise multiple customer projects at various stages. Experience with Azure, Azure DevOps, SFTP integrations, SQL, OpenAPI specifications, assessment or talent technology platforms, and AI tools used for user documentation and troubleshooting would be an advantage. #LI-KK2 #LI-Hybrid #technologyandsecurity

items.desc: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description As a Maintenance Specialist, you will support manufacturing operations by ensuring equipment reliability, optimizing maintenance processes, and leading technical improvement initiatives. Reporting directly to the Maintenance Manager, you will work in a skilled and collaborative maintenance team. This team partners with production, engineering, suppliers, and external service providers to improve machine performance, reduce downtime, and drive continuous improvement. In this first-shift position, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical expertise while working with modern maintenance tools, CMMS systems, automation technologies, and AI-supported solutions that enhance troubleshooting, analysis, and decision-making. If you enjoy solving technical challenges, implementing improvements, and continuously expanding your skills in a manufacturing environment, this role is for you. You will report to the Maintenance Team Supervisor and work onsite in Katowice, Poland. Your Responsibilities: Support maintenance teams in ensuring the continuous operation and reliability of manufacturing equipment and production lines. Lead root cause analysis activities and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring equipment failures. Develop and execute preventive maintenance strategies, maintenance plans, and equipment improvement initiatives using CMMS systems. Coordinate external contractors, service providers, and suppliers while supporting maintenance and capital investment projects. Drive equipment modernization, cost reduction, and continuous improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and production uptime. The Essentials - You Will Have: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience in maintenance, industrial automation, manufacturing engineering, or equipment reliability engineering. Knowledge of PLC-controlled equipment and industrial automation systems. Experience working with CMMS platforms such as Fiix, SAP PM, Maximo, or similar systems. Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, electrical schematics, and mechanical drawings. Communicative English proficiency. The Preferred - You Might Also Have: Experience in managing equipment implementation, modernization, or capital investment projects. Experience coordinating contractors, suppliers, and external service providers.· Knowledge of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, RCA, preventive or predictive maintenance methodologies. Experience with CAD/CAE systems. Experience with CNC machining, metrology equipment, or additive manufacturing (3D printing). What We Offer: Medical Plan - Includes coverage for partners and children. Paid by Rockwell, subject to tax and social security contributions payable by you. Medicover Sport Program - Includes a sports card with weekly entries to sports, recreation and wellbeing facilities within the Medicover network. Pension Scheme - Participation in Employee Capital Plans (PPK), a voluntary long-term retirement savings program provided in accordance with statutory requirements. Life insurance - Group life insurance, including disability coverage. Paid by Rockwell, subject to tax and social security contributions payable by you. MyBenefit Platform - Access to a flexible benefits platform, with monthly points allocated by the employer. Lunch Card – Monthly meal vouchers through the Edenred card. OnTrack - A wellbeing platform that encourages movement and healthy habits. Employee Assistance Program - Access to personal coaching and resources to support physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing goals. Calm Premium - Tools for relaxation, meditation, focus and sleep. At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. #LI-Hybrid #LI-JS1

items.desc: Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements. With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand. A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts. About Atos Group Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris. Analityk Biznesowy z językiem angielskim Szukamy doświadczonego Analityka Biznesowego z płynną znajomością j. angielskiego , który dołączy do zespołu realizującego długoterminowe projekty IT dla dużej brytyjskiej instytucji z sektora finansowego. To rola dla osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na styku biznesu i IT , potrafi przełożyć potrzeby interesariuszy na konkretne wymagania oraz ceni uporządkowany sposób pracy, wysoką jakość dokumentacji i współpracę w międzynarodowym środowisku. Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z zespołem liczącym kilkanaście osób oraz z klientem i specjalistami reprezentującymi różne obszary biznesowe i technologiczne. Jak będzie wyglądać Twoja praca? W tej roli będziesz: zbierać, analizować i doprecyzowywać wymagania biznesowe oraz funkcjonalne, przekładać potrzeby biznesowe na wymagania i rozwiązania możliwe do realizacji przez zespoły IT, przygotowywać szczegółową, formalną dokumentację analityczną i projektową, analizować procesy biznesowe oraz wpływ planowanych zmian na aplikacje i istniejące rozwiązania, współpracować z wieloma interesariuszami po stronie biznesowej i technologicznej, współpracować z developerami, architektami, Project Managerami oraz innymi specjalistami zaangażowanymi w realizację projektu, wspierać proces wytwarzania oprogramowania od analizy wymagań po wdrożenie rozwiązania, uczestniczyć w projektach obejmujących rozwój aplikacji, integracje systemowe oraz zmiany w istniejących rozwiązaniach. Pracujemy w środowisku, w którym dużą wagę przywiązuje się do dobrze zdefiniowanych procesów, jakości dokumentacji i klarownego podziału odpowiedzialności . Jeżeli dobrze czujesz się w projektach wymagających uporządkowanego i metodycznego podejścia, ta rola może być dla Ciebie szczególnie interesująca. Czego szukamy? Kluczowe będzie dla nas: doświadczenie zawodowe jako Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst lub w zbliżonej roli, doświadczenie w projektach związanych z developmentem aplikacji lub rozwiązaniami software'owymi, praktyczne doświadczenie w analizie i zarządzaniu wymaganiami biznesowymi, dobra znajomość procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania, doświadczenie we współpracy z zespołami developerskimi, doświadczenie w przygotowywaniu szczegółowej dokumentacji analitycznej lub projektowej, umiejętność prowadzenia rozmów z wieloma interesariuszami, zbierania informacji i przekładania ich na konkretne wymagania, doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym, bankowym lub ubezpieczeniowym, bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalająca na swobodną współpracę z międzynarodowym klientem, bardzo dobra znajomość języka polskiego umożliwiająca codzienną współpracę z zespołem. Dodatkowym atutem będzie znajomość procesów bankowych, doświadczenie związane z produktami oszczędnościowymi, np. lokatami terminowymi lub rachunkami oszczędnościowymi, znajomość brytyjskich metod i systemów płatności, takich jak FPS, BACS, CHAPS czy Warrants , doświadczenie w analizie lub migracji danych, doświadczenie w projektowaniu lub analizie integracji pomiędzy aplikacjami, znajomość REST API, asynchronous API lub Apache Kafka , doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku wykorzystującym metodyki takie jak PRINCE2 lub Waterfall. Dlaczego warto? Dołączysz do stabilnego, długoterminowego projektu w sektorze finansowym , dającego możliwość pracy przy złożonych rozwiązaniach IT i rozwijania kompetencji analitycznych w międzynarodowym środowisku. Będziesz mieć okazję współpracować z doświadczonymi specjalistami reprezentującymi zarówno biznes, jak i technologię, a także uczestniczyć w projektach, w których analityk ma realny wpływ na kształt rozwiązania. items.desc: We’re looking for a Mid Data Engineer to take ownership of our data lake — the system of record for millions of financial events every day, including bets , wallet transactions, and live odds, serving 12M+ active users. You’ll be responsible for designing and maintaining reliable data pipelines and defining how data is ingested, stored, retained, reconciled, and governed across AWS S3 and Snowflake/Databricks. Your work will ensure that Analytics, Finance, and Regulatory teams have access to accurate, consistent, and fully traceable data — with zero drift from source systems. Location: Kraków, Poland. Hybrid — 2 days per week from the office . ﻿What you will do: Own the lakehouse architecture: bronze/silver/gold layers, Iceberg/Delta tables, schema evolution. Land operational data via CDC streaming (Kafka, Debezium), handling late and duplicate events. Design data layout for speed and cost: partitioning, compaction, file sizing, query performance on Trino/Athena/Snowflake. Own retention and archival: storage tiering, regulatory retention, immutability, GDPR deletion. Guarantee correctness: freshness SLAs, drift detection, reconciliation against the source wallet and ledger systems. Own governance: catalog and lineage, row/column access control, PII masking, encryption, audit trails. Monitor ingestion health, data anomalies, and cloud storage/compute spend. Requirements: Must-have: 2 years of hands -on in a production lakehouse environment. Lakehouse architecture — bronze/silver/gold layering, an open table format (Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi), schema evolution. Data layout & query optimization at TB+ scale — partitioning, compaction, file sizing, query performance on Trino/Athena/Snowflake. Cloud lakehouse/DWH in production — Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery. CDC & streaming ingestion — Kafka + Debezium or equivalent; late, duplicate, and out-of-order events. Strong SQL and data modeling — enough relational grounding to reason about the OLTP systems you capture from. Critical for financial ledgers. Correctness — freshness SLAs, drift detection, reconciliation against source wallet/ledger systems. Governance — catalogs, lineage, row/column access control, PII masking, retention, GDPR deletion. Cloud object storage — S3 or GCS, plus storage tiering and archival. Python and an orchestrator — Airflow or Dagster, as tools.

items.desc: Established in 1997, Softeq was built from the ground up to specialize in new product development and R&D, tackling the most difficult problems in the tech sphere. Now we've expanded to offer early-stage innovation and ideation plus digital transformation business consulting. Our superpower is to deliver all of this under one roof on a global scale. So let's get started and build a better future together! We're looking for a Automation QA Engineer to join our team and contribute to its continued growth. We are building a new customer portal for a large logistics company. Business users at the company's customers will use it to track shipments, see delays and ETAs, manage invoices and documents, get alerts and reports, and ask an AI assistant about their own data. The portal runs on Azure: React/TypeScript front end (installable PWA), Python/FastAPI services, and an Azure Databricks lakehouse that feeds the application with certified data. Customers from many companies use the same application, so strict data isolation between them is a core requirement. You will build an automation-first test system for the application and its data, and own quality evidence for each release. What you will do Define the test strategy and test plan for each release together with the team and the client. Build and maintain UI end-to-end automation with Playwright, and API and contract tests with pytest against an OpenAPI 3.1 contract. Write cross-tenant negative tests : prove that a user of one customer company can never see or change another company's data, through the UI, the API or exports. Test role-based access and entitlements: admins, internal staff, customer users, delegated access. Run performance and load tests (Azure Load Testing or k6) against agreed targets. Run security tests in the pipeline (DAST with OWASP ZAP) and support remediation and retest after penetration tests. Test accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) with automated checks (axe) and manual review; test the PWA across the agreed browser and device matrix, including web push on iOS. Test data: reconcile application data against source systems, verify data quality rules, run KPI regression against certified baselines, and prepare evidence packs for data sign-off. Help test AI features: evaluation sets for the assistant, checks that answers stay within the user's data. Integrate all tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions), keep them fast and stable, and report quality at release gates. Manage defects and give clear, reproducible bug reports. What we expect 4+ years of test automation for web applications and APIs , with code in TypeScript or Python that you maintain like production code. Strong Playwright (or Cypress / Selenium with a clear reason to move to Playwright): page objects or fixtures, test data management, parallel runs, flaky-test control. API testing with pytest or similar: authentication flows (OAuth2 / OIDC, JWT), contract testing against OpenAPI, negative and boundary cases. Experience testing role-based access and multi-tenant isolation . Good SQL : you can write reconciliation queries between a source and a target and explain each variance. CI integration of tests (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar): test reports, quality gates, running tests per pull request. Clear written and spoken English; you can explain a defect and its business impact to developers and to the client. Nice to have Data testing frameworks: Great Expectations, chispa, dbt tests; Databricks or another lakehouse. Performance testing with k6, JMeter or Azure Load Testing. Security testing: OWASP ZAP, OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. Accessibility testing (axe, screen readers) and PWA / mobile browser testing. Testing LLM features: evaluation sets, groundedness checks, prompt-injection test cases. ISTQB or similar certification. Logistics, transportation or supply-chain domain. Our tech stack Playwright · pytest · k6 / Azure Load Testing · OWASP ZAP · axe · GitHub Actions · React / TypeScript · Python / FastAPI · Azure Databricks · PostgreSQL · Azure Softeq communicates only from @ softeq.com email addresses. We never request payments or fees for any reason during hiring — including trainings or courses to be completed, equipment, onboarding, or background checks — and we will not ask for banking information, cryptocurrency or gift cards. If you receive a message from any other domain or requesting payment, do not respond and report it to abuse@softeq.com

items.desc: Andersen is hiring a Streamlit Data App Engineer in the EU f or a project developing interactive data applications on Databricks to enhance analytics and support drug development. The customer is a global biopharmaceutical organization focused on developing innovative therapies to address evolving healthcare needs. Through advanced research and development capabilities, the company works on specialized treatment solutions aimed at improving patient outcomes and expanding access to modern healthcare. Its activities span multiple therapeutic areas, with ongoing development programs and a commitment to scientific innovation, quality, and long-term growth across international markets. The project is focused on developing and enhancing data-driven applications for the drug development domain, built on top of an existing Databricks data platform. It aims to deliver intuitive user interfaces, interactive data applications, and seamless access to analytical insights, improving data accessibility and user experience for scientific and business stakeholders. Responsibilities: Building, maintaining, and productionizing Python/Streamlit-based data applications hosted on Databricks Apps. Enriching and preparing the existing Lineage Explorer application to full production readiness. Designing and building a new data-entry and data-exposure application for the Competitive Intelligence use case, supporting up to approximately 600 users. Proactively proposing UX and application architecture solutions for new data applications. Collaborating with Databricks and Data Engineering teams responsible for the underlying data foundation. Owning application-level deployment, maintenance, operations, and change management. Requirements: Strong hands-on Python experience for 4+ years. Hands-on experience with Streamlit or similar frameworks for building Python-based data applications. Experience building interactive data applications with business logic, data input, and data visualization/exposure, beyond traditional BI dashboards. Strong UX/product mindset, with the ability to proactively propose intuitive application flows, layouts, and user interactions. Good understanding of backend concepts and data flows, with the ability to work beyond purely frontend/UI concerns. Understanding of application maintenance, operations, deployment, and change management processes. Ability to work independently, proactively, and with strong ownership of solution design and delivery. Level of English – from Intermediate+ and above. Nice to haves: Familiarity with Azure Databricks and data engineering environments. Understanding of dbt / data engineering fundamentals. Experience with React as an alternative or complementary frontend technology. Experience in regulated/compliance-sensitive reporting contexts. Pharma/biotech industry experience. Reasons why this job would be interesting to you: Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc.. The opportunity to change the project and/or develop expertise in an interesting business domain. Job conditions – you can work both fully remotely and from the office or can choose a hybrid variant. Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee. The opportunity to earn up to an additional 1,000 EUR per month, depending on the level of expertise, which will be included in the annual bonus, by participating in the company's activities. Access to the corporate training portal, where the entire knowledge base of the company is collected and which is constantly updated. Bright corporate life (parties / pizza days / PlayStation / fruits / coffee / snacks / movies). Certification compensation (AWS, PMP, etc). Referral program. Private health insurance and sports compensation, depending on the type of employment. Your personal data is protected in accordance with GDPR regulations. items.desc: Company Description At lastminute.com, we live for the holidays. We are the European Travel-Tech leader in Dynamic Holiday Packages. With technology, we turn spontaneous thoughts into meaningful experiences, helping people travel the world. Job Description We are looking for a CRM Application Engineer to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are passionate about technology and product development, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, international environment, keep reading, you might be the perfect fit for this role The job in brief: Job Title - CRM Application Engineer Working model - Remote Team - you will join the CRM and Channels team within the Technology department Level - Professional Location - Remote European Union (or On-Site in Chiasso, Switzerland) Contract - Permanent – Full time (36h/week) Travel time required - available to make short and sporadic trips abroad What your impact will be: As a CRM Application Engineer, you will oversee the strategic growth and optimization of our CRM landscape. You will ensure that internal and external customer service teams utilize data and automated workflows to deliver a superior experience for our travellers. Serve as the primary link between business units and technical delivery teams for CRM initiatives. Translate high-level business goals into functional technical specifications and process enhancements. Manage the configuration, maintenance, and integration of core CRM tools and automated sequences. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Uphold rigorous standards for data integrity and system reliability across every customer touchpoint. Evaluate platform performance to identify and execute on continuous improvement opportunities. Partner with cross-departmental teams to implement new functionalities and complex system integrations. Direct incident management efforts, including root-cause investigations and the resolution of technical hurdles. Qualifications Your expertise: A minimum of 3 years in a CRM-centric technical role, such as Analyst or Administrator. Experience in managing data structures, user access, and API-driven integrations. Ability to align business requirements with technical feasibility and scalable solutions. Competence in SQL and scripting. Software development background: MySQL, Javascript, CSS, HTML, PHP, React. Good analytical capacity with a focused, data-driven approach to solving problems. Communication skills, particularly in explaining complex technicalities to non-experts. Fluent English, written and spoken. Desirable: Background supporting Customer Care or Customer Success departments. Experience within agile development frameworks. Experience in configuring/managing platforms like VTENext, Salesforce or Zendesk is a plus. Knowledge of AWS infrastructure/services and GITLAB pipelines. Familiarity with AI-driven service tech and advanced automation solutions. Additional Information Perks of working with us : How we work together: An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together: Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time. Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content Other perks: 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws. Wish you were here? We do, too! items.desc: Location: Bucharest, Romania This role is part of a large-scale SAP ECC6 to S/4HANA migration program for a major international organization. As a core member of a dedicated Data Migration Squad, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the transformation and loading pipelines that sit at the heart of the migration delivery. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and your fellow data engineers to ensure that data flows reliably, accurately, and on time from the source ECC6 environment to the target S/4HANA platform. WHO ARE YOU? You have solid hands-on experience designing and building ETL pipelines in complex data environments? You are comfortable working with large volumes of heterogeneous data, and you know how to handle edge cases, rejections, and transformation complexity? You are rigorous and detail-oriented — you care about the quality of what you deliver, not just whether it runs? You enjoy working in a team, sharing knowledge, and improving practices collectively? You are curious about SAP data landscapes, or already have some exposure to them? Then this role is made for you. WHAT WE CAN ACHIEVE TOGETHER You will join a dedicated squad of 4 data professionals, embedded within a broader SAP program team. You will work in close collaboration with the Technical Lead and contribute to the delivery of migration pipelines across all in-scope data objects, in an agile delivery mode with iterative development and regular validation cycles. By joining us, you will play a hands-on role in one of the most technically challenging phases of a major international transformation program. Your mission will include : Designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines for data extraction, transformation, and loading Implementing transformation rules based on mapping specifications defined with the Technical Lead Participating in data quality checks, reconciliation processes, and error handling Documenting pipeline logic, transformation rules, and technical decisions Contributing to the continuous improvement of delivery practices within the squad WHAT YOU BRING Senior Data Engineer 2–4 years of experience in data engineering or ETL-focused roles Comfortable implementing pipelines based on defined specifications Eager to grow in a structured migration context ETL & Data Engineering Solid hands-on experience with at least one ETL platform (Talend, Informatica, SSIS, or equivalent) Strong understanding of data transformation patterns and pipeline design Experience working with large and complex datasets Familiarity with data quality concepts — validation rules, rejection handling, reconciliation Soft Skills Rigorous and detail-oriented approach to delivery Ability to work collaboratively in a small, fast-moving team Good communication skills — able to discuss technical topics with both engineers and functional stakeholders NICE TO HAV E Exposure to SAP data structures or SAP migration projects Familiarity with SAP migration tools (BODS, Syniti/SNP, or equivalent) Experience working in an agile delivery environment Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS) YOUR CAREER AT THALES Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competencies in different areas: Room and attention to personal development Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Ability to streamline kitchen operations and improve efficiency in a high-pressure environment. Ensuring consistency and quality in every dish, from ingredient sourcing to plating. items.desc: About Seqera Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity's biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence. We're a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we're strengthening our internal foundations - and that's where you come in. Note: This role is open to candidates located in Spain or the UK. About the role Seqera is hiring a Business Operations Analyst to join our Business Operations team. The team owns the commercial engine behind our go-to-market: sales process, deal desk, quoting, Salesforce, sales reporting, GTM tooling, and revenue analytics. As our deal volume and complexity grow, we need someone to take over the day-to-day operations so that deals keep moving, the data stays reliable, and the team has room to build. You will report to the Director of Revenue Operations and work every day with Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, and Marketing. Within the team, you'll partner closely with our Analytics, GTM Systems, and Marketing Operations colleagues. This is a hands-on role that covers sales operations, commercial operations, analytics, and business systems. You'll support our sales leaders and reps day to day, contribute to the delivery of GTM projects from scoping through rollout, and improve how things work as you go. You’ll enjoy this role if you like understanding how things work end to end, and you get satisfaction from fixing the cause of a problem rather than the symptom. What you'll do Pipeline, forecasting, and reporting Support the operating cadences that keep GTM aligned, including forecast calls, pipeline and renewal reviews, and leadership QBRs, by preparing materials, tracking actions, and keeping the data accurate. Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards, and handle ad-hoc reporting requests from across the business. Audit open pipeline for past-due close dates, stalled stages, and missing next steps, and follow up with owners. Sales process and CRM data Keep account assignments, territories, quotas, price books, and SKUs accurate, and account and contact data clean and de-duplicated. Monitor lead routing, stage criteria, and handoffs from SDR to AE to Customer Experience, and flag where they break down. Reconcile bookings with Finance, including the data behind commission calculations. Deal desk and contracts Review submitted quotes, and work live with AEs to structure complex deals, including multi-year commitments, step-ups, and non-standard terms. Keep approvals moving, and check every closed-won deal against the signed contract before it's booked. Track renewals, opt-out windows, and step-ups, and flag at-risk accounts and coverage gaps early. Analytics Answer ad-hoc questions about customers, products, and usage, analyse win/loss, conversion, sales cycle, and renewal performance, and turn the findings into clear recommendations for the commercial teams. Contribute to the data models and dashboards behind our revenue analytics (Snowflake, dbt, Superset), act on data quality alerts, and provide cover when the analytics lead is away. Review analytics pull requests to build shared context. You don't need to be a data architecture expert. Systems and automation Make Salesforce admin changes, including fields, page layouts, validation rules, and flows, and test new changes and integrations before rollout. Spot recurring friction in GTM workflows, fix the root cause, and build automations, integrations, and AI workflows, including Claude skills and plugins, to remove manual work. Help deliver GTM projects, such as new product launches and process changes, from scoping through rollout and adoption. Keep commercial runbooks, process maps, system documentation, and our GTM tool inventory up to date. Tool support and onboarding Triage questions in our GTM tool support channels, and support GTM office hours. Handle system setup and onboarding for new hires, including access, licenses, and approver coverage. About you Experience and background 2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, Deal Desk, Business Operations, or a similar analytical role at a B2B SaaS company. Strong Salesforce experience: you've built reports and dashboards and you're comfortable with admin work on objects, fields, and flows. Admin certification is a plus. You’ve redesigned at least one commercial process end to end, such as quote approvals, renewal tracking, or lead routing. You mapped how it actually worked, documented it so others could follow, fixed where it broke, and can point to what improved (faster turnaround, fewer errors, less manual work). An understanding of how B2B deals work, including quotes, contracts, renewals, and ARR/TCV. …

Analyze test results, deliver technical test reports, define Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and actively support failure investigations. Experience: Hands-on experience in RF and electrical testing, integration processes (AIT), and working within cleanroom environments. Technical knowledge: Solid understanding of RF chains/parameters (S-params, Gain, NF, P1dB, G/T, IM) and RF components (amplifiers, phase shifters, combiners/dividers, switches, mixers).Familiarity with antenna parameters (directivity, gain, VSWR, XPD) and basic electronic circuitry.Proficiency with standard RF and lab equipment (Spectrum/Network Analyzers, Power Meters, Signal Generators, Multimeters).Experience with test languages/environments to execute and automate test sequences. Soft skills: High degree of autonomy, organized and proactive mindset, capability to manage workload across concurrent projects, and strong teamwork in multidisciplinary setups. Languages: Advanced / fluent level in English. Valuable / Nice to have: Prior experience in satellite applications, space systems, or space-grade communication protocols and interfaces. Working Conditions: Flexibility for occasional shift work (morning/late/night), potential weekend interventions during critical test campaigns, and willingness to travel abroad for specific AIT phases.
