items.desc: Vill du bidra till energiomställningen och vara med och säkerställa att produkter inom energi och inomhusklimat uppfyller krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och prestanda? Vi söker dig som har en ingenjörsutbildning inom energiteknik eller annat närliggande teknikområde och som vill utvecklas inom produktcertifiering. Om oss RISE Certifiering är en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom produkt-, ledningssystem- och personcertifiering. Vi består av cirka 100 kollegor med bred teknisk kompetens och ett tydligt uppdrag, att skapa förtroende och bidra till ett tryggt och hållbart samhälle. Om rollen Som ingenjör inom produktcertifiering blir du en del av ett engagerat och stöttande team med cirka 30 ingenjörer och administratörer i en utvecklande och prestigelös arbetsmiljö. Genom våra produktcertifieringar hjälper vi företag att visa kravuppfyllnad och få tillträde till nationella och internationella marknader. Du arbetar med hela certifieringsprocessen och är uppdragsledare, från kunddialog och planering till teknisk granskning, certifikat och slutleverans. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera teknisk analys med kunddialog och relationsskapande. Du arbetar med många olika uppdrag, produkter, tillverkare och tekniska lösningar samtidigt och du möter en stor variation i dessa. Du får en bredare teknisk överblick, bygger spetskompetens inom regelverk och standarder samt får arbeta nära innovativa företag och framtidens tekniska lösningar. Du får successivt med stöd av introduktion och mentorer bygga en bred kompetens inom hur tekniska krav, provningsresultat, standarder och tillverkningsprocesser hänger ihop. På några års sikt har du möjlighet att utvecklas till specialist inom energiprodukters regelverk, standarder och certifiering. För den som vill finns även möjligheter att bidra till utveckling av nya certifieringsområden, regelverk och internationella samarbeten. Här arbetar du med både etablerade produkter och morgondagens innovationer. Du får tidig insyn i ny teknik och framtida krav, samtidigt som du bidrar till kvalitetssäkring och certifiering av produkter som redan spelar en viktig roll i samhället. Genom nära samarbete med ledande tillverkare och branschaktörer bygger du ett unikt nätverk och en bred teknisk överblick. Rollen omfattar bland annat att: Driva och planera uppdrag självständigt. Kundmöten och offertarbete. Utvärdera och granska teknisk dokumentation och provningsresultat. Verifiera överensstämmelse mot relevanta standarder och regelverk. Följa upp tekniska frågor tillsammans med kunder och interna specialister. Framtagande av nya kravspecifikationer och certifieringsregler. Du kan exempelvis komma att arbeta med värmepumpar, ventilationssystem och fjärrvärmecentraler. Bedömningarna kan omfatta egenskaper som energieffektivitet, brandsäkerhet, täthet, hållfasthet och andra krav som regleras genom standarder, byggregler och certifieringsregler. Placeringsort: Borås Vem är du? Vi söker dig som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera självständigt arbete med nära samarbete. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och bidrar aktivt till ett öppet och konstruktivt arbetsklimat. Med din kommunikativa och relationsskapande förmåga bygger du förtroende både internt och i dialogen med kunder och samarbetspartners. Du arbetar strukturerat och har ett starkt kvalitetsfokus, vilket gör att du kan hantera flera parallella uppdrag och leverera med hög precision. Samtidigt har du en god analytisk och problemlösande förmåga. Du kan tolka krav, identifiera avvikelser och fatta välgrundade beslut i komplexa tekniska frågeställningar. Krav Teknisk högskoleutbildning med inriktning mot energiteknik eller värme- och kylteknik. Några års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, inom produktutveckling, konstruktion, tillverkningsindustri, provning och certifiering eller teknisk konsultverksamhet inom energi, installation eller ventilation. Förmåga att förstå, analysera och bedöma tekniska krav. God IT-vana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärssystem och digitala verktyg. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Meriterande Kunskap inom provning, standarder, regelverk. Kunskap om ekodesign och energimärkning. Välkommen med din ansökan! Låter det intressant? Kontakta gärna gruppchef Stefan Coric, 010-516 60 73 eller gruppchef Anton Falk 010-516 61 36. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-11-25. Urval & intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden. Våra fackliga representanter är; Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-516 51 61, och Ingemar Petermann, SACO, +46 10 228 41 22.

As a leading home delivery provider in Sweden, we've grown by 50%+ annually and are approaching SEK 1 billion in revenue. And we're just getting started. With a proven platform, growing market share and significant opportunities ahead, we're entering our next phase of growth. We're large enough to operate at real scale, yet small enough for one leader to fundamentally change how the company works. We believe technology should remove complexity, not create it. The Role We're looking for a CTO to lead the next chapter of our technology platform and turn engineering into a lasting competitive advantage. This is a builder-operator role. You'll modernize a business-critical platform while keeping a fast-growing, high-volume operation running every day. Our technology combines a PostgreSQL core, serverless services on AWS, web dashboards and native courier and customer apps. It powers route optimization, live tracking and dynamic ETAs across millions of deliveries. Your challenge is to evolve this architecture into a reliable, scalable and increasingly automated platform, while driving engineering performance through clear priorities, ownership and disciplined execution. Reporting directly to the CEO and serving on the Management Team, you'll have the mandate to shape our technology strategy, make critical architectural decisions and ensure technology delivers measurable business impact. Your mission: enable Airmee to scale faster, without scaling complexity or compromising today's operations. What success looks like Within this role you will: Modernise the platform without disrupting it — lead the decomposition of our central architecture into isolated, resilient building blocks, sequenced around peak season. Make reliability the default — a platform designed for 2x peak volume, with mature observability and real-time systems that hold up under load. Build a data platform the business trusts — clear ingestion, transformation and governance layers, and one version of the truth from operational dashboards to Board reporting. Make reliability and security the default — establish strong observability, engineering standards and security practices and certifications that scale with the business. Build an engineering organisation that absorbs change without losing speed — clear ownership, documentation, modular work and disciplined ways of pausing and restarting. Scale our advantage in AI and automation — build on years of AI-driven optimization to accelerate engineering productivity, automate operations and unlock new capabilities. What you'll own You'll own: Technology strategy and architecture — set the technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and lead platform modernization while balancing long-term investments with business priorities. Engineering, Product and Data leadership — ensure teams deliver results with clear ownership, accountability, high standards and speed of execution. Platform reliability and performance — ensure our systems are scalable, secure, cost-efficient and reliable across business-critical operations. Product and technology delivery — turn business needs into scalable products and capabilities, with predictable delivery, high quality and speed. Security and compliance — establish security by design, robust engineering practices and accountability for regulatory requirements. Who we're looking for We're looking for a technically exceptional leader who loves building, scaling and operating technology. Someone who sees technology as the operating system of the business, not a separate function. Who combines long-term architectural thinking with the urgency to deliver results today. You probably recognize yourself in several of these: You've built and scaled business-critical platforms, ideally through significant architectural transitions while maintaining live operations. You have deep technical expertise and the judgment to challenge architectural decisions, without needing to make every decision yourself. You know how to drive performance and accountability across engineering teams, ensuring priorities translate into measurable results. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution — comfortable discussing technology strategy with the Management team and diving into technical problems with engineers. You know how to prioritize ruthlessly, protect engineering focus and deliver at speed without compromising reliability. You believe great systems and strong teams outperform heroic individuals. You have a continuous improvement mindset, always looking for ways to develop yourself and your team, and see AI and automation as tools to accelerate progress. You understand that great engineering is measured by the business outcomes it enables, not technical sophistication alone. Experience we're looking for Proven experience as …

items.desc: Att bygga en säker digital framtid handlar om mer än teknik. Det handlar om att hitta rätt balans mellan innovation, risk och affärsvärde. Vardagen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt Du tillhör området Tech Security, som ansvarar för IT-säkerhetsövervakning, incidenthantering, hot- och omvärldsbevakning samt de tekniska verktyg och plattformar som skyddar SBAB. I rollen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt samarbetar du nära andra arkitekter, utvecklings- och driftteam och arbetar tätt ihop med IT-säkerhetschefen. Utveckla SBAB:s säkerhetsförmåga : Du ansvarar för att vidareutveckla och förvalta SBAB:s tekniska säkerhetsstyrning samt säkerhetsarkitektur. I en miljö präglad av molntjänster, AI och automation säkerställer du att säkerhet integreras tidigt i utvecklings- och förändringsinitiativ och att säkerhetskrav omsätts till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken. Rollen innebär ett stort mandat att påverka hur säkerhet byggs in i framtida lösningar och arbetssätt. Omsätta säkerhetskrav i praktiken : Du kravställer mot övriga IT-verksamheten inom IT-säkerhet. Du kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med ett operativt arbetssätt. Genom att definiera riktlinjer, delta i projekt, genomföra riskanalyser kopplade till tekniska initiativ samt föreslå och driva igenom säkra lösningar säkerställer du att säkerhetskrav integreras i arkitektur, plattformar och tekniska initiativ på ett sätt som skapar affärsvärde. Vara ett rådgivande stöd : Du fungerar som ett viktigt stöd till våra utvecklingsteam, arkitekter och andra intressenter internt. Genom att förankra och förklara säkerhetsrisker och säkerhetskrav på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt bidrar du till välgrundade beslut och hållbara lösningar. Utveckla och stärka bankens leverantörsuppföljning: Ur ett IT-säkerhetsperspektiv arbetar du i ett nära samarbete med exempelvis inköp och juridik för att vidareutveckla vår leverantörsuppföljning. Rollen säkerställer att säkerhetskrav efterlevs i både interna och outsourcade lösningar. Rollen kombinerar strategiskt arbete med praktiskt deltagande i lösningar. Du kommer inte bara att definiera krav och riktlinjer, utan också vara en aktiv part i projekt, riskanalyser och tekniska initiativ. Kollegan vi söker Vi söker dig som har en teknisk förståelse och trivs i en roll som länk mellan säkerhet, arkitektur och verksamhetsstyrning. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du: Har erfarenhet av teknisk IT-arkitektur och molnarkitektur, gärna AWS. Förstår moderna plattformar, integrationer, IAM, Zero Trust och CI/CD. Har erfarenhet av att ta fram styrning, arkitekturprinciper och tekniska krav. Har kunskap inom säker användning av AI, agentisk AI och ny teknik. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från bank-, finans- eller försäkringssektorn, eller om du tidigare varit med och byggt säkerhets- eller AI-plattformar. För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du har ett gott omdöme och förmåga att fatta välgrundade beslut även i komplexa situationer där olika perspektiv, risker och behov behöver vägas mot varandra. Du har ett helhetsperspektiv och kan se hur tekniska vägval påverkar såväl arkitekturen som verksamheten i stort. Samtidigt är du pragmatisk och lösningsorienterad, med fokus på att hitta vägar framåt som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du är även skicklig på att kommunicera och förankra dina budskap hos olika intressenter samt kan på ett pedagogiskt och övertygande sätt presentera risker, rekommendationer och beslut.

items.desc: Vill du använda din meteorologiska expertis för att göra skillnad på riktigt? Missa inte möjligheten att bli en del av vårt team och att få bidra till att stärka hela samhällets hållbarhet. SMHI är en svensk expertmyndighet med globalt perspektiv och en livsviktig uppgift i att förutse förändringar i väder, vatten och klimat. På vetenskaplig grund och genom kunskap, forskning och tjänster bidrar vi till att öka hela samhällets hållbarhet. Till enheten Prognos väder söker vi nu en prognosmeteorolog. Enheten Prognos väder är uppdelad i tre grupper, placerade på kontoren i Norrköping, Göteborg och Uppsala och som tillsammans består av ca 75 kunniga och engagerade prognosmeteorologer. Varje kontor har sin specifika nisch, därmed skiljer sig arbetsuppgifterna lite åt beroende på vilket kontor man arbetar vid. Nu söker vi en medarbetare till kontoret i Norrköping där du kommer bli en del av ett härligt team bestående av 25 prognosmeteorologer. Din arbetsplats finns på ett modernt kontor med närhet till restaurang och gym. Hos oss möts du av en trivsam arbetsmiljö och hög professionalism. Om tjänsten I arbetet ingår att ta fram och leverera väder- och varningsinformation till allmänheten och professionella kunder. Vi bistår bland annat kommuner, myndigheter och privata kunder med prognoser och varningsinformation samt levererar innehåll till vår hemsida och sociala medier. Det innebär mycket kontakt och samarbeten bland annat med Sveriges Radio för skriftliga och muntliga väderprognoser, samt med kunder inom sjöfart, bygg- och anläggning, energimarknaden och inom väg- och spårtrafik. Som meteorolog på SMHI har man daglig kontakt med kunder och det ställs därför stora krav på servicekänsla och professionalitet. Utöver kontakt med externa parter kan du även ingå i olika projekt och utvecklingsarbeten med andra delar av SMHI där din kunskap inom meteorologi kommer till användning. Du förväntas också delta i olika typer av verksamhetsutveckling och projekt utanför vakttjänst, där din meteorologiska expertis kan komma till nytta. Arbetet kan även ske utanför den egna gruppen. Arbetsuppgifterna i vakttjänst innebär till stor del skiftarbete med tjänstgöring både vardagar och helgdagar, året om och under dygnets alla timmar. Vilken typ av arbetsuppgifter du kommer att ha beror på verksamhetens behov och vi ser då till alla kontorens produktionsområden, men även personliga intressen och särskilda kompetenser beaktas. SMHI ansvarar även för den civila flygväderproduktionen i Sverige och levererar väderprognoser och varningar för luftfarten i samarbete med danska DMI. Om dig Vi söker dig som har meteorologisk utbildning eller motsvarande, som uppfyller WMO:s kompetenskrav, samt genomgången PMU (Praktisk Meteorologisk Utbildning). Du har god datorvana och mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och goda kunskaper i engelska är ett krav. Andra språkkunskaper är meriterande. Radioframträdanden och briefingar för olika kunder utgör en viktig del i arbetet därför ställs extra krav på presentations- /kommunikationsförmåga. Det är vidare meriterande med: Erfarenhet av meteorologiskt prognosarbete, samt kännedom om hydrologi och oceanografi Erfarenhet av att medverka i radio eller TV- sändningar med väderinnehåll Erfarenhet av energibranschen Erfarenhet av projektarbete och av att ha jobbat som utbildare eller lärare Erfarenhet av att arbeta med sociala medier/rörlig bild/kommunikation/webbsidor Programmeringskunskaper samt kunskap eller erfarenhet av AI/ML Som person behöver du vara kommunikativ, utåtriktad och ha lätt för att samarbeta då mycket av arbetet utförs med dina kollegor eller i kontakt med kunder. Du måste ha ett genuint intresse för meteorologi och väder och en god analytisk förmåga. Eftersom intensitet och arbetsuppgifter varierar är flexibilitet och förmåga att handla rationellt i stressiga situationer av stor vikt. Du ska kunna planera och strukturera effektivt samt uppvisa ett resultatorienterat driv i dina arbetsuppgifter. Vi ser även ett stort värde i förmågan att aktivt driva verksamhetens utveckling och bidra till en trivsam stämning. Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning Arbetstid: Prognosarbete sker enligt fastställda passtider, skifttjänstgöring året runt. Placeringsort: Placering är på vårt kontor i Norrköping. En majoritet av din arbetstid är på kontoret och du har möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån när det passar verksamheten. items.desc: Job Description Hej Software Engineer, Do you want to help shape the digital future of IKEA? With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to ask questions, share your ideas, learn from mistakes and grow together with others. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have opportunities to try things you haven’t done before, while contributing to digital solutions that support how IKEA brings products to life and creates a better everyday life for the many people. We are on a journey to modernize our landscape, and we are looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems together with others to join the Digital Product Area ‘Range Core - Requirements and Compliance’ within Technology at Inter IKEA, Range Operations. Here you will help develop digital solutions that support product development, manufacturing, suppliers and the movement of IKEA products through our global value chain. We believe good software is created by teams where people bring different perspectives, share knowledge, ask questions and learn together. You don’t need to know everything from day one. Curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to keep learning matter to us. We are growing our team in Malmö and looking for someone who enjoys working with people across different roles, teams, cultures and locations. Qualifications Your new job We’re looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems and learning together with others. Your strengths might be in frontend or backend development, or somewhere in between. What matters to us is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in growing and contributing across the stack. You’ll join a cross-functional team building and maintaining digital products across the stack, from backend services, APIs, integrations and databases to web applications and user experiences. You’ll have opportunities to build on your strengths while developing your skills in other areas. Together, we experiment, share knowledge and continuously improve how we design, build, test and deliver software. Your work will have a global impact, helping co-workers, suppliers, and partners collaborate effectively and ensuring trusted IKEA products reach our customers. What we’d like you to bring to the table Experience building software solutions, with strengths in frontend, backend, or across the full stack. Experience with backend development using C#/.NET and REST APIs and/or frontend development using React, TypeScript or similar technologies. A good understanding of software design, data modelling, relational databases and building reliable, maintainable solutions. An ability to understand complex problems, break them down into manageable parts and work with others to find practical solutions. Experience with software testing and modern development practices, such as version control, continuous integration and automated delivery. Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure, GCP or AWS is valuable, but not essential. A collaborative mindset, curiosity and an interest in learning, sharing knowledge and improving together with your team. An interest in understanding the wider product and contributing beyond your main area of expertise. Additional Information Be yourself, a Software Engineer, and more! Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career. We welcome your application Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 19th of November. Apply by submitting your CV. As part of the application process, you will be asked to answer a few screening questions. When answering the questions, please avoid relying on AI-generated responses. This position is based in Malmö, Sweden. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Recruiter Monaka Perumal; monaka.perumal@inter.ikea.com. We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. …

items.desc: About Proxify Proxify is a global network of vetted remote software, data and AI professionals. We help companies scale their tech teams with world-class talent, typically delivering the right match within two days. Only about 1% of the 20,000+ people who apply each month make it into the network. Clients get speed, quality and flexibility, with real technical experts guiding every step, and none of the admin burden or risk of traditional hiring. About the role Do you speak fluent data, from pipelines and warehouses to dashboards and models, and love the idea of turning that knowledge into the perfect team for a client? This is your chance to be the technical expert behind every data match we make. As a Client Engineer (Data) , you'll be part of our client teams. You'll be the technical voice in front of clients and the person who decides which data professionals are right for them. Technical discovery : Run discovery calls with clients to understand their data landscape: stack, architecture, data maturity, team setup and business goals. Turn what you learn into a sharp role profile with the right skills, seniority and scope. Matching : Search and shortlist Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists and ML Engineers from the Proxify network. Interview them to assess technical depth and fit with the client's context. Candidate presentation : Write clear, convincing pitches that explain why each candidate fits, and support the client through interviews and decisions. Client advisory : Act as a trusted technical advisor. Challenge requirements when needed, and help clients shape roles that will actually solve their data problems. Collaboration : Work closely with Client Managers and Account Managers to meet client needs, keep timelines tight and grow long-term partnerships. Client focus : Startups, scaleups and enterprise companies building or scaling their data, analytics and AI capabilities. Why you'll love this opportunity at Proxify Help companies close their data skill gaps and create job opportunities for data professionals worldwide. Stay close to the tech: see dozens of modern data stacks and talk shop with top engineers every week. ️ Be part of a humble, supportive and tech-savvy team. Great opportunities for professional development and personal growth. ️ Work in a truly international team across 39 countries, with occasional in-person meetups. What you bring to be successful in this role 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Scientist or in a similar data role. Solid understanding of the modern data stack: SQL, Python, Spark, dbt, Airflow, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or Redshift. Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP). Ability to quickly read a client's data challenge and translate it into the right skills, seniority and profile. Confidence to run technical interviews and judge candidates across data engineering, analytics and ML. Strong ownership mindset with a bias for action and high quality. Naturally curious, sociable and comfortable in client-facing conversations. A humble team player who thrives in a performance-oriented environment. Native-level English. Bonus points : experience in consulting, solutions engineering, technical recruiting or pre-sales; exposure to MLOps, data governance or GenAI/LLM projects; additional languages (e.g. German, Swedish, French or Spanish). Why it may not be your match You prefer to stay heads-down in code. This role is about people and judgment as much as technology, and you'll be talking to clients and candidates every day. You like every day to look the same. We build as we go and keep things agile. You haven't worked hands-on with data yourself. You'll be assessing experienced data professionals, so you need to have been in their shoes. Department : Business · Location : Remote / Stockholm (HQ)

items.desc: Job Description: Are you our next Product Application Engineer – Emergency Lighting? Are you passionate about emergency lighting, technology, and turning technical expertise into real customer value? We’re looking for a Product Application Engineer to help drive the adoption and growth of our Emergency Lighting portfolio across Sweden. In this role, you’ll combine technical expertise with a strong commercial mindset. You’ll work closely with our sales teams, consultants, customers, partners, and offer management to shape solutions, influence specifications, develop opportunities, and build a strong pipeline for Emergency Lighting. What you’ll do Act as the technical expert for Emergency Lighting , supporting the sales organisation throughout the sales process. Provide hands-on support in customer opportunities , from early discussions and specification through product selection, system design and final solution. Work closely with sales teams, consultants/specifiers and customers to develop the right technical solutions. Provide continuous technical engagement throughout specification and sales cycles, helping us strengthen our position in the Emergency Lighting market. Develop Emergency Lighting competence within the sales organisation through training, coaching and day-to-day technical support . Help build strong Emergency Lighting expertise internally and reduce dependency on external technical support. What we’re looking for Strong technical knowledge of Emergency Lighting systems and solutions . Previous experience within Emergency Lighting is highly desirable. Experience supporting sales and customer projects , rather than only working with products internally. Understanding of the consultant/specification process and how technical solutions are specified in projects. Ability to translate technical knowledge into practical solutions for customers and sales teams . Proactive, customer-oriented and commercially minded, with an interest in developing and growing the business. This is not only a product expert role. We’re looking for someone who enjoys working closely with sales and customers and can provide continuous, hands-on technical support throughout the specification and sales process. Our Emergency Lighting portfolio You’ll work across our Emergency Lighting offer, including: Emergency luminaires, including anti-panic lighting and exit signs Self-contained Emergency Lighting systems DiCub Central Battery Systems, including AC/AC and AC/DC solutions Essential for the role Excellent knowledge of Emergency Lighting principles, products, systems, and applications. Strong ability to translate technical knowledge into clear customer and business value. Ability to influence and engage different stakeholders with empathy and credibility. items.card: in this role is measured by reliable platform operations, repeatable delivery, strong observability, reduced operational toil, and the ability to help client teams ship safely into complex customer environments. Infrastructure / SRE Engineers are expected to improve speed and stability at the same time.
items.desc: Infrastructure / SRE Engineer Inviso is partnering with one of our clients to find an experienced Backend / Platform Engineer to join their team working remotely. Inviso is managing the recruitment and placement process for this opportunity. This is a remote, direct-hire permanent employee position for our client that is a global multi-billion dollar software conglomerate. The Infrastructure / SRE Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating the cloud, infrastructure, deployment, observability, and reliability capabilities that allow platform teams to ship safely and consistently. This role focuses on landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, incident response, cost optimization, and production readiness. The Engineer treats infrastructure and reliability as products, building repeatable systems that reduce toil, improve delivery speed, and support mission-critical customer environments. The ideal candidate is hands-on, automation-minded, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning systems in production. Experience & Skills Required Experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure with reliability ownership. Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, landing zones, networking, identity, security, and environment management. Experience with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices. Experience establishing observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and actionable operational signals. Experience defining or supporting SLOs, reliability practices, incident response, postmortems, and on-call operations. Ability to automate operational tasks and reduce manual toil through scripts, tools, runbooks, and platform services. Experience preparing software for customer-controlled, hybrid, BYOC, on-premises, or edge environments preferred. Strong understanding of cost and capacity optimization, including expensive compute such as GPU workloads. Strong communication and collaboration skills for client-facing consulting environments. Pragmatic mindset with the ability to balance speed, safety, automation, cost, and operational quality. Desired Qualifications Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bicep, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or related infrastructure and delivery tools. Experience with Azure Arc, fleet management, pull-based deployment patterns, or version/configuration drift management. Experience supporting regulated, air-gapped, edge, or mission-critical delivery environments. Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, model-serving infrastructure, GPU workloads, or AI development lifecycle operations. Experience building enterprise-scale infrastructure supporting multiple teams, products, or customers. Experience using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining strong review, testing, and operational discipline. Success Criteria Success in this role is measured by reliable platform operations, repeatable delivery, strong observability, reduced operational toil, and the ability to help client teams ship safely into complex customer environments. Infrastructure / SRE Engineers are expected to improve speed and stability at the same time.

items.desc: As a joint venture of the University of Basel and the University Hospitals Basel, the Department of Biomedicine (DBM) brings together basic and clinical scientists to advance the understanding of health and disease. We are home to more than 67 research groups and over 800 employees across six locations in the heart of Basel. Our collaborative and international environment fosters innovation, excellence, and impactful research. The Ocular Pharmacology and Physiology group, led by PD Dr. Albert Neutzner, is looking for a Lab Technician. Join our community and help shape the future of biomedicine. Your position Perform cisterna magna and stereotactic intracranial injections in support of preclinical research projects Collect and process biological samples, including brain tissue, blood, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) Monitor animal health and welfare in accordance with established protocols and regulatory standards Maintain accurate experimental records and ensure thorough documentation of research activities and results Optionally, conduct brain tissue processing, histological and immunohistochemical staining, as well as microscopy and imaging analyses Your profile Bachelor's or master's degree in Veterinary Science, Life Sciences, Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field LTK1 certification or an equivalent qualification Previous experience in neurobiology is preferred Practical experience in handling mice, including anaesthesia and animal welfare procedures Experience with injection techniques in mice, preferably including intracranial and intrathecal injections We offer you We offer a collaborative and international research environment within the Department of Biomedicine, with the opportunity to contribute to preclinical research in ocular pharmacology, physiology and neurobiology. The position provides hands-on experience with advanced experimental techniques, including stereotactic and cisterna magna injections, biological sample processing, histology, immunohistochemistry and microscopy. You will work in a stimulating academic environment with close interaction between basic and clinical research. Application / Contact Please apply on the following link: Jetzt bewerben Apply

items.desc: We are looking for a talented and experienced scientist to join our Technology Development team and help deliver innovative crop biotechnology projects through high-quality experimental science. Our Technology Development team works across molecular biology, gene editing, plant transformation and assay development to support Tropic’s crop improvement programmes and accelerate research into real-world impact. Job Purpose In this role, you will contribute to the delivery of key R&D programmes through technology optimisation, in particular the development of protoplast cell assays, including gene editing, RNAi implementation and plant regeneration. You will drive and lead experimental design and execution, generate high-quality data, communicate results effectively and help shape project direction through scientific insight, innovation and effective collaboration. Responsibilities Design and deliver laboratory experiments independently with scientific rigour and creativity. Plan experiments, manage risk, troubleshoot effectively and interpret results to inform project decisions. Identify and apply new methods and technologies that support innovation and business goals. Maintain accurate, traceable records and contribute high-quality data and documentation. Communicate progress, risks and recommendations clearly to colleagues and stakeholders. Collaborate across teams and support a culture of shared learning and continuous improvement. Champion safe laboratory practice, quality standards and scientific excellence. Show initiative to contribute to wider team performance and the training of others. Requirements You will bring proven scientific expertise, hands-on laboratory excellence and the drive to apply your skills in crop biotechnology and deliver real-world impact from your work. Technical PhD in Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Plant Biotechnology or a related discipline. Strong technical expertise in experimental design, in particular in protoplast-based gene editing and regeneration. Troubleshooting, data analysis and delivery of high-quality scientific outputs. Ability to design, interpret and optimise complex laboratory experiments and workflows. Expertise in areas relevant to plant biotechnology including advanced molecular biology, gene editing, tissue culture, assay development and bioinformatics. Experience with rice transformation is desirable, but not essential Transferable Proven ability to take ownership of complex research activities and deliver against objectives. Able to manage competing priorities, solve problems effectively and adapt in a fast-paced environment. Scientifically curious, proactive and innovative, with strong critical thinking skills. Clear and confident communicator, able to share progress and recommendations with different audiences. Highly organised, with strong attention to detail in record-keeping, data handling and reporting. Collaborative and supportive, with a positive approach to team-working and continuous improvement. About Us Tropic is a pioneering tropical seeds company dedicated to the development of healthier, more robust, high-performing varieties of tropical crops. The company’s current core crop portfolio focuses on banana and rice, which together provide a source of livelihood to billions of people worldwide. Tropic utilises its proprietary GEiGS® platform and other cutting-edge gene editing technologies to develop improved crops with increased disease resistance, higher yields, and environmentally sustainable traits. By harnessing the power of advanced genetic engineering, Tropic is committed to addressing global agricultural challenges and providing innovative solutions that benefit farmers, consumers, and the environment. items.desc: This is a Band 6 Specialist Biomedical Scientist role in Blood Sciences at Guy’s and St Thomas’ laboratories specialising in Core Chemistry This is a 24/7 shift working opportunity within the Synnovis Essential Services Laboratories in the heart of London The Blood Sciences department is an innovative and progressive department that delivers analytical services to two prominent London teaching hospitals, Guy’s and St Thomas Hospital, as well as supporting the Synnovis Hub. It offers an extensive repertoire of tests in Chemistry and also supports clinical services such as first trimester screening and intraoperative PTH testing in theatres. This department is actively engaged in training activities, ranging from IBMS registration and specialist portfolios to presentations and lectures. The in-house training is well-structured, featuring monthly CPD sessions, clear training plans supported by UKAS, Synnovis training opportunities, and the option to attend external conferences. They will be required to undertake their responsibilities within any of the core sub-units of Core Chemistry. You will be HCPC registered having completed the IBMS Specialist Portfolio in Clinical Chemistry or be able to demonstrate equivalent knowledge and experience. The laboratories are UKAS accredited to ISO 15189 standards and are accredited with IBMS as training laboratories for both Registration and Specialist Portfolios. There is a wide breadth of clinical specialties associated with a prestigious teaching hospital including a distinct children’s hospital on site, The Evelina. For you, this makes for varied and interesting, and sometimes challenging work; no two days are ever the same! Due to the variety and complexity of some of our patients the work can be very challenging but rewarding as you will gain invaluable scientific experience. The laboratories are equipped with Abbott Alinity analysers which are integrated to the EPIC electronic patient record system used throughout the Trust. Your development will be actively supported and tailored in collaboration with your line manager, ensuring alignment with your personal ambitions and career aspirations. items.desc: COMPANY & ROLE OVERVIEW Kodiform Therapeutics is a discovery-stage spin-out from the Institute of Cancer Research and the University of Oxford, based on the pioneering research of our Founders, Professors Terry Rabbitts and Angela Russell. We develop small-molecule inhibitors of hard-to-drug proteins, including intrinsically disordered proteins, using our intracellular domain antibody (iDAb) platform. Our technology finds new functional binding sites on these proteins and opens new routes to target them with small molecules. We are based at the Scale Space science Innovation Hub in White City, London. The role. We are looking for an experienced cell biologist with substantial hands-on experience in medium- to high-throughput screening of small molecules to join our small, multidisciplinary laboratory team. Working hand in hand with colleagues in pharmacology and on the iDAb platform, you will develop, optimise and run robust, automation-ready assays, mostly cell-based but also biochemical (e.g. HTRF). These assays underpin both the functional validation of our intracellular antibodies and the screening and characterisation of small-molecule binders/libraries. You will apply your expertise in cell and molecular biology to design, execute and interpret experiments, and you will play a key role in building our screening and R&D capabilities. You will ideally already have a broad understanding of the drug discovery process, acquired preferably in a biotech or pharma setting, with strong hands-on experience in assay development, optimisation and QC preferably for medium/high throughput screens lab automation and small-molecule screening, as well as target validation and target engagement/mechanism-of-action studies. You are organised, keep meticulous records and are an effective team player, keen to share your expertise with colleagues and to contribute to our inclusive company culture. We offer a competitive salary and pension. PURPOSE & MISSION This role will deliver robust, screening-ready assays and high-quality screening data to support Kodiform's intracellular antibody (iDAb) platform and small-molecule discovery programmes. The postholder will independently, or under guidance develop, optimise, miniaturise and run assays, mostly cell-based (e.g. reporter gene, BRET/NanoBRET, high-content imaging) as well as biochemical formats such as HTRF/TR-FRET. These assays will be used to functionally validate newly identified iDAbs in cells and to screen, triage and profile small molecules. The data generated will drive hit identification, hit validation and progression decisions across our programmes. DIMENSIONS & STAKEHOLDERS Line manager - TBD. Scientists team: cell biology/pharmacology and protein sciences colleagues Interact with suppliers of reagents, cell lines, assay kits and consumables, as well as lab-automation collaborators, managers of shared facilities and service engineers. Kodiform Laboratory Manager and Biological Safety Officer: laboratory operations, equipment, genetic modification (GM), biosafety and COSHH compliance. No direct reports and no budget responsibility; you may help train colleagues on screening workflows and equipment. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Small molecules / iDAbs screening Plan and run medium- to high-throughput small-molecule screening campaigns end to end (primary screen, hit confirmation, dose-response and counter-screens) in 96- to 1536-well formats. Set up, programme and run lab automation: prepare compounds for acoustic compound dispensing (e.g. Echo), liquid and cell dispensers/handlers, plate washers and multimode plate readers. Prepare and manage assay-ready compound plates, dilution series, plate maps and associated metadata. Monitor screen performance using plate QC metrics and apply agreed acceptance criteria. Analyse and interpret screening data (curve fitting, IC50/EC50). Develop and run iDAb-guided screening assays, e.g. cellular BRET or biochemical HTRF competition/displacement formats. Assay development Independently or with guidance design, develop and optimise cell-based assays to functionally validate newly identified iDAbs, including intracellular expression, target binding, functional readouts, and mechanism-of-action studies (e.g. downstream signalling,): reporter assay, BRET/NanoBRET protein-protein interaction, RT-qPCR gene expression, immunofluorescence and flow cytometry, proliferation assays. Generate and characterise engineered cell models: transient and stable (including inducible) expression of iDAbs and tagged targets by lentiviral transduction, CRISPR knock-out/knock-in and shRNA knock-down, clonal selection and validation (e.g. Western blot, RT-qPCR, imaging). Develop biochemical assays as primary or orthogonal formats, e.g. HTRF/TR-FRET, AlphaLISA or fluorescence polarisation, using recombinant proteins and iDAbs from the protein science team. Miniaturise assays and transfer them from the bench to automated 384/1536-well formats. Manage cell lines …

Deliver secure configuration and designs, investigation findings, vulnerability remediation plans, monitoring improvements, documented standards and playbooks, risk assessments, audit evidence and management summaries. Play a key role in protecting our AWS and Azure cloud environments, ensuring security controls, configurations and services remain aligned to best industry practise, internal standards and PCI DSS, CE+ requirements. Our platform guides them through each trial and produces automated analysis and instant impact reports. We now plan to extend the model beyond education, starting with health within the next 12 months. About the role You will be our first in-house engineer, leading the move of platform development from our current development partner. AI makes it realistic for a compact team to do work that once needed a larger team, and we want that engineer close to our users, trials and funders. You will set up an AI-assisted way of working, design the platform to support trials across domains such as health, and explore new uses of AI. The engineering strategy is not fixed: we want you to help shape it. Our current stack includes PHP/ Symfony, React, PostgreSQL and AWS. Key responsibilities Lead the handover from our development partner, including an audit of code, AWS hosting, database and third-party APIs. Keep the platform secure and reliable, and own the quality of everything released, including AI-generated code. Set up an AI-assisted development pipeline with automated testing and human review. Design the platform to support trials in new domains, starting with health. Act as part-time product manager, working with colleagues and practitioners to turn their needs into improvements. Protect personal data, including children's data and, in future, health data. Person specification Essential Extensive full-stack experience building non-trivial products, with strong architectural judgement. Actively uses AI tools in development and can critically evaluate AI-generated code. Works well with non-technical colleagues and explains technical ideas clearly. An entrepreneurial, enabling mindset suited to a small, early-stage organisation. Genuine interest in evidence, education or health, and randomised controlled trials. Understands data protection and the handling of sensitive data. Able to work from our Durham office at least three days a week. Desirable Experience of AI-first workflows or building AI integrations (for example MCP servers). Experience with PHP (Symfony), React, PostgreSQL, AWS and third-party APIs. Experience of taking over a codebase from an external supplier. What success looks like in your first year By the end of your first year, the platform will be running reliably under our ownership, your AI-assisted pipeline will be delivering improvements, and first steps towards health trials will be underway. What we offer The opportunity to become a key senior leader in the company, shaping its direction as well as its technology. The chance to build our technology and engineering approach from the ground up. Work with real-world impact, helping practitioners find out what works for the people they serve. items.desc: About Us At Travel Counsellors, our customers, communities and colleagues are at the heart of what we do. For more than 30 years, we’ve supported independent travel professionals to build successful businesses and create personal connections with their customers. Today, more than 2,200 Travel Counsellors around the world are supported by a team of over 400 colleagues in our Support Offices. We’re continuing to grow and invest in technology that helps our people deliver exceptional service. Travel Counsellors was named Best Place to Work in Travel in 2022 and featured in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work in 2023, 2024 and 2025. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our technology team. About the Role As a Software Engineer, you’ll build and improve the digital services that help Travel Counsellors serve their customers and run their businesses. You’ll join a strategic engineering team and work in the domain where your skills can make the greatest difference. You’ll develop dependable C# and .NET software, working with engineers, product colleagues and domain specialists to understand customer and operational needs. You’ll contribute throughout the delivery lifecycle, from exploring requirements and shaping solutions to testing, release and production support. We use modern engineering practices and AI development tools to help teams work effectively. You’ll use your judgement to choose where AI can help, provide clear context, and review and test its output. You’ll remain responsible for the quality, security and maintainability of the software you deliver. What You’ll Do Build, test and support software that meets customer, product and operational needs. Develop and maintain C# and .NET services, APIs and integrations. Work with colleagues to understand requirements, explore options and deliver changes incrementally. Contribute throughout the delivery lifecycle, including production support. Write automated tests, take part in peer reviews, follow secure coding practices and help monitor services. Use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot where they’re useful. Provide context, review and test their output, and take responsibility for what you ship. Learn about the team’s domain, architecture and operational needs, and share useful knowledge with colleagues. Communicate progress and raise questions, risks and dependencies early. Our teams work with AWS, SQL Server and CI/CD processes, and may use document databases such as MongoDB. You’ll be comfortable using modern development tools, including AI tools, with care and sound judgement. A degree or formal qualification is welcome, but equivalent practical experience is equally valued. Travel industry experience isn’t required. Bristol NHS Foundation Trust values all people as individuals. In support of our journey towards becoming a recognised global leader in offshore wind, Arup has an opportunity for a Geotechnical Engineer to join our established and growing offshore wind ground engineering team in London. Our team delivers geoscience and ground engineering projects for clients across the offshore wind sector, with a focus on marine site characterisation and the design of offshore wind foundations. As a centre of excellence within Arup for offshore wind engineering, our highly skilled UK team supports projects across the globe, working with major developers, collaborating with technical specialists across disciplines, and partnering closely with research institutions. You will contribute to the interpretation of ground investigation data, support geotechnical design for fixed and floating offshore wind foundations, and help deliver innovative, sustainable and technically robust solutions for our clients. You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams, collaborating with colleagues across geotechnics, structural engineering, offshore engineering, numerical modelling and sustainability to deliver high-quality outcomes. At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. Is this role right for you? items.desc: This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced General Surgeon to join the cohesive and forward-thinking General Surgery team at Northampton General Hospital (NGH) in a substantive Specialist appointment. The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery and development of high-quality inpatient and outpatient surgical services, supporting routine, cancer and elective activity. This role offers the opportunity to develop a specialist interest within General Surgery, contribute to service improvement and take an active role in the leadership and development of the department. We are seeking an experienced General Surgeon with a minimum of five years’ experience at Registrar level within the UK NHS, who is committed to delivering excellent, patient-centred care and working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. Key Duties include : Deliver high-quality inpatient and outpatient General Surgical services, contributing to elective, cancer and waiting-list activity targets. Support the continued development of elective surgical services and, where required, contribute to the management of surgical emergencies. Develop areas of sub-specialisation and specialist interest in line with departmental needs. Contribute to clinical leadership, service development, clinical audit, patient safety and quality improvement initiatives. Support the teaching, supervision and professional development of junior and middle-grade medical staff. Work collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to improve patient pathways, service efficiency and the quality of care. Please submit your application as soon as possible as we reserve the right to close adverts once we have received sufficient applications Northampton General Hospital NHS Trust is on an exciting journey with all of our divisions committed to doing things better, with more efficiency as we update, modernise, and advance. We have also entered a Group Model with neighbouring Kettering General Hospital NHS Foundation Trust and become University Hospitals of Northamptonshire (UHN). As part of this collaborative approach, there may be a requirement for you to work across both the Kettering and Northampton hospital sites, depending on the needs of the service. Our Excellence Values Compassion Accountability Respect Integrity Courage We want to recruit the best people to deliver our services across UHN and help to unleash everyone's full potential. UHN encourages applications from people who identify from all protected groups. We understand that we need to work with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and make sure the environment they work in is inclusive and collaborative. We recognise the valuable contribution that the Armed Forces community make to our organisation. We have signed the Armed Forces Covenant and achieved Silver Award under the Armed Forces Employer Recognition Scheme. We have active Networks that promote and support colleagues from all backgrounds. This ensures everyone feels supported and has a sense of belonging working for UHN. Job Plan: This is a 10-programmed activity (PA) post, comprising 6.5 PAs for Direct Clinical Care (DCC), 2 PAs for DCC administration and 1.5 PAs for Supporting Professional Activities (SPA). The provisional job plan includes elective theatre sessions, outpatient clinics, multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings, clinical administration and supporting professional activities, including teaching. Theatre and outpatient activity will remain flexible in line with service requirements, with clinic sessions confirmed on commencement. The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery of routine, cancer and elective General Surgical services, support waiting-list and theatre activity targets, and have opportunities to develop specialist interests, contribute to clinical audit and quality improvement, and support undergraduate and postgraduate medical education. On-Call Commitments: The post may include participation in the General Surgical Emergency Service, depending on service requirements and the successful candidate’s experience. This may involve providing senior clinical supervision in the emergency theatre and on the surgical wards, as required. The specific on-call rota arrangements and frequency will be confirmed by the department.

We require motivated individuals, with good initiative and organisational skills. You will work as part of a multi-disciplinary team providing interventions for working age adults. This is an exciting time to be a part of the service due to the ongoing community transformation programme, a national programme of change to improve community mental health care & support for those with severe and enduring mental illness (SMI). The unique opportunity to work alongside experts by experience, third sector partners, primary care and adult social care to truly develop and improve services to tackling health inequalities and meet the needs of the communities with serve is truly refreshing and will be extremely rewarding. Workload will be continually negotiated through supervision and case load management with the appropriate clinical team managers. We also provide specialist inpatient services in York and some highly specialised services across the country. As a teaching trust with strong links to local universities, we are a centre of excellence for teaching, research and development. items.title: Theatre Scrub Practitioner General Theatres, Band 5
items.card: The role supports a diverse range of elective and emergency surgical activity, including robotic surgery, urology, breast surgery, gynaecology, gynaecological oncology, colorectal surgery and upper gastrointestinal surgery. Main responsibilities include maintaining aseptic technique; preparing, checking and managing surgical instruments, implants, medical devices and specialist equipment; providing scrub assistance
items.desc: The Band 5 Scrub Practitioner delivers safe, high-quality, evidence-based perioperative care across the Trust’s General operating theatres, assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating care while managing an allocated caseload. The role supports a diverse range of elective and emergency surgical activity, including robotic surgery, urology, breast surgery, gynaecology, gynaecological oncology, colorectal surgery and upper gastrointestinal surgery. Main responsibilities include maintaining aseptic technique; preparing, checking and managing surgical instruments, implants, medical devices and specialist equipment; providing scrub assistance for procedures across these specialties; completing instrument, needle and swab counts and the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist; supporting safe patient positioning, transfer and theatre preparation; anticipating and responding to intraoperative needs; communicating effectively with patients, carers and the multidisciplinary team; safeguarding dignity and safety; maintaining accurate records; complying with professional, Trust, infection prevention, information governance and risk-management standards; reporting and supporting the investigation of incidents; contributing to audit, service improvement and research-based practice; undertaking mandatory training and continuing professional development; and supervising, teaching and supporting learners, new staff and less experienced colleagues while acting as a professional role model. Clinical Responsibilities / Key Responsibilities Maintain aseptic technique and provide safe, effective scrub assistance for elective and emergency procedures across robotic surgery, urology, breast surgery, gynaecology, gynaecological oncology, colorectal surgery and upper gastrointestinal surgery, working within assessed competence. Prepare, check, manage and account for surgical instrumentation, implants, prostheses, medical devices and equipment appropriate to the procedure and specialty. Accurately perform and document instrument, needle and swab counts, and actively participate in all relevant stages of the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist and associated perioperative safety checks. Anticipate the needs of the surgical team, respond appropriately to intraoperative changes and escalate concerns promptly to maintain patient safety. Support safe patient positioning and transfer, and prepare, check and restore the theatre environment before and after surgery in accordance with local procedures and assessed competence. items.desc: Why might this job interest you? We have an exciting opportunity for a Pharmacy Technician Higher Level at East Kent Hospitals University NHS Foundation Trust to join the Pharmacy Department at William Harvey Hospital in Ashford or Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother Hospital in Margate. You will be responsible for working closely with Pharmacists and other healthcare professionals within the multi-disciplinary team in the Emergency Department to deliver high-quality, patient-focused medicines management services. You will manage the compilation and verification of patient drug histories by communicating with patients, carers, GPs, and other health professionals, ensuring any discrepancies are resolved or appropriately referred. You will also support the team by checking and documenting specified blood results, interpreting medical and nursing notes for medicines reconciliation, and identifying patient-drug or drug-disease interactions, referring as necessary to ensure safe and effective patient care. As a Pharmacy Technician Higher Level, you will be responsible for documenting patients’ allergies and reactions to medicines, ensuring accurate records are maintained. You will be managing reviews of patients’ own drugs to assess suitability during their hospital stay and supporting discharge planning in collaboration with ward staff and other healthcare professionals across secondary and primary care. You will be responsible for giving out medication to patients, providing counselling on correct usage, dosages, side effects, and device administration, while addressing any questions or concerns. You will also administer medicines within your competence, considering prescriptions, patient conditions, observations, and blood results, document consultations appropriately, and help minimise delays in discharge by ensuring timely availability of medications. Responsibilities of this job role To dispense prescriptions when required, ensuring all medications are prepared accurately and in accordance with trust guidelines. You will also check for completeness and appropriateness of prescriptions prior to dispensing. To assist with the management and movement of medicines between wards, including controlled drugs, to maintain efficient supply chains. You will also identify medicines needing safe return or disposal and coordinate with the pharmacy team. To provide medicines-related information and guidance to external healthcare organisations, such as GP surgeries and community pharmacies, to support admission and discharge processes. You will also suggest improvements to communication pathways to enhance patient care. To support the training, mentoring, and competency assessment of pre-registration trainee pharmacy technicians, junior pharmacy technicians, and pre-registration pharmacists. You will act as a role model and contribute to the development of staff through guidance, education, and feedback. To contribute to quality management and service improvement by reviewing procedures, suggesting enhancements, and participating in audits. You will also assist in the writing and maintenance of standard operating procedures for the pharmacy team. To maintain professional registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council and actively engage in continuous professional development (CPD). This includes completing mandatory training, local accreditations, and participating in meetings or learning sessions to ensure up-to-date knowledge and compliance with best practices. To be successful in applying for this role you will need: NVQ Level 3 in Pharmacy Services or BTEC in Pharmaceutical Science (or equivalent). Registered with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC). Accredited in medicines management and accuracy checking pharmacy technician (ACPT). Experience with NHS systems (e.g., PAS, RIS) and Microsoft packages. Desirable: hospital pharmacy experience or Medicines Optimisation Programme competence. The benefits we can offer you in return: · Putting People in Places to Care – be part of the NHSP community, by joining the bank and caring for patients with a team of people from all walks of life. · Weekly pay to give you access to your wages more quickly. · Blue Light Card – NHS Discount Provider · First choice of shifts/placements at the Trust of your choice over agencies. · Our team is always happy to help - access our support line any time. · Working options to suit your lifestyle – being on the bank gives you the flexibility to work the shifts you want or choose fixed term placements. · Training and development opportunities via the Trust and NHSP’s own academy. · Explore different wards , keep your skills up to date whilst gaining vital experience. · Being part of the NHSP Community means you’ll get access to member activities such as member of the month, member appreciation week, key date giveaways, webinar series and much more. items.card: Job Description Ramboll is looking for an Electrical Design Engineer to join our growing Life Science & Pharma team. You will work as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team delivering technically demanding projects across the life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, laboratory and research sectors . Projects may range from new-build laboratories and research facilities through to refurbishment, retrofit
items.desc: Job Description Ramboll is looking for an Electrical Design Engineer to join our growing Life Science & Pharma team. You will work as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team delivering technically demanding projects across the life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, laboratory and research sectors . Projects may range from new-build laboratories and research facilities through to refurbishment, retrofit and complex modifications within existing operational environments. The role offers the opportunity to develop strong technical expertise while working closely with electrical, mechanical, public health, sustainability and other specialist disciplines. You will contribute throughout the design process, from early feasibility and concept design through detailed design, procurement, construction and commissioning. Your key responsibilities As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will: Develop electrical building-services designs for laboratories, research facilities, pharmaceutical and other technically complex buildings . Undertake design and specification of: HV and LV electrical distribution systems Transformers and main switchgear Standby generation and UPS systems Small power and specialist power supplies General and emergency lighting Earthing and lightning protection Fire alarm and life-safety interfaces ICT, security and other ELV systems Prepare electrical calculations, technical specifications, drawings, schedules and reports. Undertake electrical load assessments and contribute to resilient and maintainable electrical infrastructure strategies. Carry out lighting calculations, cable sizing, voltage-drop, fault-level and protection studies using appropriate engineering software. Work with project BIM/Revit models and coordinate electrical services with the wider building design. Coordinate with mechanical engineers and specialist designers on equipment power requirements, controls and interfaces. Support the development of design solutions for laboratories and controlled environments where resilience, business continuity and reliability of electrical supplies are important design considerations. Undertake surveys and assessments of existing buildings and electrical infrastructure, including projects involving refurbishment and retrofit. Participate in design workshops, coordination meetings and technical reviews. Review contractor proposals, technical submissions and shop drawings against the design intent. Attend construction sites, undertake inspections and support testing, commissioning and witnessing activities. Assist with resolving technical issues during construction. Contribute to project documentation and quality-assurance processes. Work collaboratively with clients, architects, contractors, equipment suppliers and other engineering disciplines. About you We are looking for someone who is fundamentally a technically strong electrical engineer , with an interest in developing expertise within the Life Science & Pharma sector. You will ideally have: A degree, HNC/HND or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related discipline . Experience in electrical building-services design within a consultancy, contractor or similar engineering environment. A sound understanding of LV electrical distribution and building electrical systems. Familiarity with relevant UK electrical and building-services standards, particularly BS 7671 / IET Wiring Regulations . Experience producing electrical calculations and technical design information. An understanding of engineering design through RIBA design stages. Experience using engineering design software such as Amtech/Trimble ProDesign, EOM, Dialux or equivalent . Experience working with Revit and BIM environments , or a willingness to develop these skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. An organised and methodical approach to engineering design. The ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary project team. Life Science & Pharma experience Previous experience of laboratories or pharmaceutical projects would be advantageous, but it is not essential . Experience in any of the following would be particularly relevant: Research and development laboratories Containment laboratories CL2/CL3 environments Pharmaceutical manufacturing GMP facilities Cleanrooms and controlled environments Universities and research institutions Healthcare or other critical environments Mission-critical or high-resilience electrical infrastructure We are particularly interested in engineers who are curious about how these environments operate and want to understand the relationship between scientific processes, specialist equipment, building services and electrical infrastructure . You will be someone who enjoys getting into the detail of an electrical design while retaining an understanding of the wider project. In Life Science & Pharma projects, that means thinking beyond simply providing …

items.title: Locum Consultant in Palliative Medicine
items.card: you will join one of England’s best ‑ performing and most highly rated NHS organisations, providing high ‑ quality specialist care across two main hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—as well as a network of community ‑ based services. You will be part of a multidisciplinary environment that serves a diverse population and delivers award ‑ winning services, including
items.desc: As a Locum Consultant in Palliative Medicine at Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust, you will join one of England’s best ‑ performing and most highly rated NHS organisations, providing high ‑ quality specialist care across two main hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—as well as a network of community ‑ based services. You will be part of a multidisciplinary environment that serves a diverse population and delivers award ‑ winning services, including complex medical, cancer, and supportive care pathways. In this role, you will provide expert palliative and end ‑ of ‑ life care, collaborating closely with acute teams, community partners, and specialist services to support patients with complex symptom management and holistic needs. You will contribute to high ‑ quality clinical care, leadership, teaching, and service development within a Trust that continually invests in its facilities—including major expansions in critical care and diagnostic services—to enhance patient experience and clinical outcomes. You will join a motivated, well ‑ supported workforce of more than 6,000 staff who are PROUD to Care and who consistently recommend the Trust as an excellent place to work and receive treatment. Please note: Some roles may require weekend shifts at multiple sites. Please refer to the attached job description document for a detailed list of the main duties of the job. Our Trust is one of England's top-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—along with award-winning clinics across North West London. Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use. We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid. We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future. We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring. Provide an efficient and responsive clinical service for patients requiring supportive and palliative care. Deliver high ‑ quality specialist palliative care within the hospital and community settings. Work as part of a multidisciplinary team to support patients and relatives across the palliative care pathway. Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key colleagues across community and hospital services. Participate in cross ‑ clinical cover within other areas of the specialist palliative care service, including liaison with hospital teams. Contribute to strategic development and service improvement initiatives across the palliative care service. Participate in rota arrangements for the palliative care service as required. Provide clinical leadership and guidance within the palliative care team. Support education, training, and development opportunities for colleagues within the service. Contribute to the coordination and delivery of a 7 ‑ day visiting and on ‑ call service, if the department has such arrangement in place. Engage in service ‑ wide quality improvement, innovation, and integrated models of care. Provide specialist advice and support to other healthcare professionals managing palliative care needs. Participate in multidisciplinary meetings to review patient needs and optimise care planning. Ensure continuity and safety of patient care through effective documentation and communication. Promote a compassionate, person ‑ centred approach to end ‑ of ‑ life care across all clinical interactions.
