items.desc: Job Description Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique. Vous contribuerez à développer des solutions de pointe pour résoudre les problèmes énergétiques auxquels notre monde est confronté. Technip Energies est une entreprise de technologies et d’ingénierie de premier plan. Leader dans le GNL, l’hydrogène, l’éthylène, la chimie durable et la gestion du CO2, nous contribuons au développement de marchés stratégiques tels que l'énergie, les dérivés énergétiques, la décarbonation et la circularité. Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle. Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer. Missions proposées : L'objectif de ce stage est d'identifier, développer et déployer des solutions pragmatiques permettant d'assister les ingénieurs dans leurs nombreuses revues de planning d’exécution de projets, et à fortiori durant les phases de montage d’appels d’offres. Les plannings sont développés une première fois lors des phases d’appels d’offres puis plus en détails au démarrage des projets. Des revues sont conduites suivant différents niveaux de priorités et différents angles (métiers, thématiques) et gagneraient à être automatisées. Dans ce cadre, vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Découvrir les métiers et activités des différentes disciplines de la division Engineering ; Comprendre les enchainements d’activités et de livrables standards ; Rencontrer les ingénieurs et experts métier afin de comprendre leurs besoins et d'identifier les tâches répétitives, chronophages ou susceptibles d'être assistées par l'IA ; Identifier et prioriser des cas d'usage concrets à forte valeur ajoutée pour les équipes d'ingénierie ; Évaluer et exploiter les possibilités offertes par Microsoft Copilot, Dataiku, Power Automate, Python, les outils internes d'IA ainsi que d'autres solutions pertinentes ; Développer des assistants, agents IA, bibliothèques de prompts et méthodes de travail adaptés aux besoins des utilisateurs ; Tester, documenter et améliorer les solutions développées en collaboration avec les équipes métier ; Rédiger des guides utilisateurs, bonnes pratiques et supports de formation destinés à faciliter le déploiement et l'adoption des outils ; Participer à l'accompagnement des équipes dans l'utilisation des solutions mises en place. Le développement itératif permettra de confirmer en situation réelle les fonctionnalités et méthodologies considérées Les livrables attendus à l'issue du stage comprendront notamment des cas d'usage documentés, des agents ou assistants IA opérationnels, des bibliothèques de prompts ainsi que les guides et supports nécessaires à leur déploiement et à leur maintenance par les équipes. Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous l'occasion de développer à la fois vos compétences en ingénierie, en innovation digitale et en intelligence artificielle appliquée à l'industrie. Profil recherché: Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d'échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes : Vous êtes en dernière année d'École d'Ingénieur ou en Master avec une spécialisation généraliste, mécanique, industrielle ou équivalente ; Vous possédez un fort intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et l'Intelligence Artificielle générative ; Vous souhaitez appliquer l'IA à des problématiques concrètes d'ingénierie et de gestion des connaissances Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome et force de proposition ; Vous faites preuve d'excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et de communication ; Vous êtes à l'aise pour échanger avec des experts techniques et comprendre leurs enjeux métier ; Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques et présentez un intérêt pour Microsoft Copilot, les assistants conversationnels et les agents IA ; Des connaissances en automatisation, en développement léger (Python, Power Platform ou outils équivalents) constituent un plus ; Vous disposez d'un niveau d'anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, nécessaire dans un environnement de travail international. Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement innovant et multiculturel, à participer à la transformation des métiers de l'ingénierie et à développer des solutions qui seront utilisées concrètement par les équipes ? Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement international et dynamique, à prendre part à des projets d'envergure et à relever des défis techniques et organisationnels ? Envoyez-nous votre candidature! Votre carrière chez nous : Travailler chez Technip Energies est une aventure passionnante, remplie de …

items.desc: Description De L'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au coeur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Engagés à vos côtés, au service de vos enjeux critiques. Business Unit Défense & Sécurité Protéger les territoires, anticiper les menaces. Notre Business Unit Défense & Sécurité est au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Forte de plus de 840 collaborateurs répartis sur l’ensemble du territoire, elle conçoit des systèmes critiques pour l’armée et l’aviation civile. Nos équipes interviennent sur des projets à haute valeur ajoutée : liaisons de données tactiques, lutte antidrones, surveillance maritime, simulation et entraînement, sûreté aérienne. Grâce à notre expertise et à notre engagement dans des programmes internationaux, nous contribuons activement à la sécurité des territoires. Rejoindre cette Business Unit, c’est contribuer à la protection des citoyens au sein d’un collectif engagé. Description Du Poste Nous recrutons un/une Stagiaire - IVQ avec un spécialisation IA pour rejoindre notre BU Défense & Sécurité au sein de l'agence Lutte Anti-Drone et Surveillance de Zone. La branche LAD (Lutte Anti-Drones) de CS GROUP développe des solutions d’intelligence artificielle pour l’analyse de flux vidéo, notamment pour la détection et l’identification de drones en temps réel afin de sécuriser des grands évènements (Jeux Olympiques 2024, Coupe du Monde de Rugby 2023). Dans le cadre de ce stage, vous travaillerez sur la partie montante du cycle en V. Vous servez le garant de la conformité des systèmes que l’on produit. Intégrer les composants physiques et logiciels, vérifier l’intégrité et valider les systèmes complets avant la livraison au client. Vos missions : La mission principale sera d'optimiser et robustifier les processus de validation par rapport aux activités IVQ suivantes : Rédaction et passage de fiches de tests Rédaction et analyse de fait technique Évaluation de performances en plateforme et sur le terrain Mise en place de démonstrateurs Environnement technique : Validation de systèmes multicapteurs et effecteurs : Poste opérateur RADAR Caméra avec modules IA Capteurs radiofréquences Brouilleurs de fréquences Pont de liaison radio Utilisation des outils Tuleap, Testlink et Rectify Utilisation de Copilot et IAKA Plateformes : Linux, Windows Documentation, rédaction, transmission d'informations Il faudra maintenir un niveau de sécurité et de confidentialité en adéquation avec les données traitées. Qualifications De formation Bac+5 d'ingénieur ou équivalent, vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études. Vous disposez de connaissances sûres (Linux, Réseaux, analyse des logs, et surtout en IA) ? Vous êtes polyvalent et autonome ? Vous avez un bon esprit d'équipe et d'analyse? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons ! Informations supplémentaires Rejoignez une entreprise où l’humain, l’innovation et l’impact se rencontrent. Chez CS, nous offrons : Une expérience collaborateur enrichissante, portée par un environnement de travail conçu pour favoriser la flexibilité, l’autonomie et le bien-être au quotidien. Un parcours d’intégration complet pensé pour embarquer chaque talent dès le premier jour et une Academy pour développer vos compétences, enrichir votre expertise et construire les parcours professionnels qui vous ressemblent. Un engagement sociétal fort : plus de 3 000 associations soutenues, une politique handicap active, une culture inclusive, une démarche de numérique responsable, et des partenariats comme Elles bougent pour inspirer les talents féminins de demain. …et bien d’autres avantages à découvrir en nous rejoignant ! Notre singularité ? L’alliance unique entre expertise technologique, projets critiques et engagement humain. Entreprise innovante et responsable, nous construisons un environnement éthique, inclusif et tourné vers l’avenir. Ouverts à tous les talents, nous croyons que la diversité est une richesse. #C2SO #LAD Employeur inclusif et engagé, …

Un support est possible à la Data analyse + Data visualisation
items.desc: Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d’une centaine de disciplines, de l’optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l’intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c’est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C’est donc être au cœur d’une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C’est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d’accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C’est aussi la possibilité d’évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d’activité, voire de pays. Lieu : Cannes, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique. Sur le site de Thales Alenia Space Cannes , au sein du Département AIT CUO (Assemblage, Intégration et Test de Charge Utile Optique), vous intégrerez l’équipe du pôle DATA & IA composé de 3 ingénieurs développeurs. Le Département AIT CUO est constitué d’équipes multidisciplinaires de 80 personnes . Ce Secteur Industriel Qui Réalise Des Instruments Spatiaux Dans Le Domaine De L’observation Et De La Science a Pour Missions Principales La conduite des activités d’AIT des Charges Utiles Optiques tout au long du cycle de développement dans le respect des coûts, délais, conformité technique, qualité, sécurité du personnel et du matériel. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien En rejoignant le site de Toulouse, vous intégrez un site regroupant nos solutions de cyberdéfense souveraines pour faire face aux menaces informatiques croissantes et nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée. Les images issues de l’observation spatiale peuvent présenter différents défauts liés à l’acquisition et aux capteurs : déformations géométriques (routes, bâtiments), flou, bruit… Pour garantir des images exploitables, une chaîne de corrections est nécessaire après acquisition afin d’améliorer la qualité des données, au plus près des contraintes de quasi-temps réel. Au sein de l’équipe Qualité Image , basée à Labège , une chaîne de simulation et correction des images satellitaires a déjà été mise en place. Dans le cadre de ce stage, vous contribuerez à son enrichissement en développant et en testant des traitements portant notamment sur la radiométrie et la géométrie des images. Vous serez encadré par des experts en traitement d’images spatiales et travaillerez sur des solutions en Rust , privilégiant un code sécurisé et performant. Votre profil Vous souhaitez effectuer un stage d'une durée de 6 mois . Vous effectuez une formation de niveau dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou Master 2 en école d’ingénieur ou en formation universitaire, à dominante traitement d’image ou informatique . Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Mot de l'équipe Expérimenté en développement informatique, vous portez un intérêt à l’analyse des images satellitaires et à la mise en place d’applications concrètes et opérationnelles ? Alors ce stage est fait pour vous ! Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Aujourd’hui, le réseau InPost est le système automatisé de retrait et de livraison de colis le plus vaste et le plus pratique d’Europe, avec 100 000 points de retrait hors domicile, dont plus de 70 000 Lockers (ou APM) et 30 000 points de retrait (ou PUDO), répartis dans 9 pays (Royaume-Uni, France, Pologne, Italie, Espagne, Portugal, Belgique, Luxembourg et Pays-Bas). items.desc: À propos de nous setec est un groupe d'ingénierie français, indépendant et pluridisciplinaire, reconnu pour la réalisation de projets complexes et innovants à travers le monde. Animés par l’esprit "Ingénieurs et Citoyens", passionnés par la technique, nos 4 200 collaboratrices et collaborateurs mobilisent chaque jour leurs compétences qu’ils mettent au service des clients et des projets. En tant qu’ingénierie créée en 1972, setec international conçoit et suit les réalisations de projets de grande envergure dans le domaine des infrastructures de transport, au service des populations et des territoires. Notre culture, marquée par le collectif et la diversité nous permet d’accueillir aujourd’hui plus de 20 nationalités différentes et des profils mixtes. Nous comptons aujourd’hui près de 400 collaborateurs basés principalement sur sept sites en France (Vitrolles, Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Nantes, Mayotte et La Réunion). Animés par la passion de nos métiers, nous avons à cœur la transmission de nos savoirs non seulement avec une politique de formation interne mais aussi en participant aux parcours académiques proposés par nos écoles partenaires. Libres d’oser, nous pouvons créer nos trajectoires de carrière adaptées. Engagés à la fois pour le bien-être de nos collaborateurs et pour le respect de l’environnement, nous veillons à proposer un cadre de travail stimulant, bienveillant, équitable et éco-responsable. Nous choisissons de redistribuer la valeur produite au bénéfice de nos collaborateurs. Notre ouverture nous amène au-delà des frontières avec plus de la moitié de notre chiffre d’affaires réalisée à l’international. Pour apporter des réponses aux transitions écologiques, sociétales et numériques en cours, nous avons élaboré, ensemble, notre plan stratégique en 2022 pour définir nos enjeux et notre plan d’actions à l'horizon 2026. La première brique de ce projet d'entreprise a été l'écriture de notre raison d'être, rédigée à l'issue d'une démarche collective et collaborative impliquant l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Nous recrutons et reconnaissons tous les talents. Trabajarás codo a codo con ingenieros senior para llevar casos de uso de IA y agentes conversacionales desde el prototipo hasta producción, con un plan claro de mentoría y crecimiento. Tasks Participar en el ciclo completo de una solución de IA: comprensión del problema, preparación de datos, experimentación, evaluación, documentación y soporte en el despliegue. Colaborar con Producto, Data e Ingeniería para convertir requisitos en historias de trabajo y definir métricas de éxito. Preparar y asegurar la calidad de datos (limpieza, validaciones, muestreos) y apoyar procesos de etiquetado. Contribuir a la evaluación de modelos y agentes (tests offline/online, A/B, conjuntos de validación) y a la definición de guardrails básicos. Ayudar a instrumentar observabilidad : métricas, logs y alertas para detectar degradaciones y drift. Ejecutar playbooks de retraining y versionado , registrar experimentos y elaborar resúmenes claros de resultados. Escribir documentación simple y útil ; participar en code reviews y pedir feedback con frecuencia. Mantenerse al día de buenas prácticas de IA/ML y proponer pequeñas mejoras en procesos o calidad del código. Requirements 🧠 Requisitos: Buenas bases de programación en Python (estructuras de datos, testing básico, manejo de paquetes). Conocimientos de control de versiones con Git/GitHub y exposición a pipelines de CI/CD (por ejemplo, GitHub Actions). Fundamentos de diseño e integración de APIs REST . Interés demostrado en agentes de IA y su ciclo de vida (experimentación, evaluación, despliegue y monitorización). Capacidad para trabajar con datos : consultas, transformaciones y validaciones (pensamiento analítico). Inglés avanzado (documentación, lectura técnica y comunicación básica con clientes/equipo). Excelencia académica demostrable. ✨ Valoraremos: Nociones de desarrollo de APIs con FastAPI. Familiaridad con frameworks de agentes ( LangChain y LangGraph ). Interés/experiencia en orquestación de ETLs (p. ej., con workflows). SQL y bases de datos relacionales ( PostgreSQL / Supabase ). Conocimientos básicos de cloud (preferiblemente GCP ) o Kubernetes (k8s) . TypeScript para tooling o servicios auxiliares. Benefits 📊 Beneficios: Sueldo competitivo acorde a tu experiencia. Bonus ligado a objetivos. Posibilidad de teletrabajo: modalidad híbrida Flexibilidad horaria : nos importa que concilies tu vida laboral y personal. Formación continua y presupuesto anual para desarrollo profesional (cursos, certificaciones, conferencias). Seguro de salud . Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos punteros con impacto en banking, logistics y healthcare . Entorno dinámico, joven y colaborativo, donde la innovación es el día a día.

 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a global leader in driving transformation through digital enterprise engineering, manufacturing, and electronics design. Our EDA (Electronic Design Automation) division provides software and hardware verification solutions that help companies around the world deliver high-performance electronic products to market faster and more efficiently. 
 Position Overview 
 We are looking for a Digital Design Engineer to join our team in Cairo, Egypt. 
 Main Responsibilities: 
 Design and develop synthesizable models for FPGA vendor library cells to be used in static and formal functional verification flows. 
 Periodically integrate new versions from supported FPGA vendors. 
 Develop DSP decomposition models for arithmetic blocks across different FPGA vendors. 
 Participate in developing and maintaining build and regression pipelines and test harnesses for FPGA modeling. 
 Perform integration testing with upstream tools. 
 Participate in developing and testing AI agents to accelerate cell modeling, version integration, and migration. 
 Generate documentation and reference materials as needed. 
 Understand customers' use cases and assist with integrating customer designs into the test harness. 
 Fix, validate, and triage defects related to FPGA modeling. 
 Job Requirements: 
 B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 Excellent knowledge of digital design and RTL design fundamentals. 
 Strong knowledge of hardware description languages (HDLs), such as Verilog, VHDL, or SystemVerilog. 
 Experience with FPGA design flows and place-and-route (P&R) tools, such as Vivado or Quartus, is preferred. 
 Strong command of scripting languages, such as Shell, Perl, and Python. 
 Experience with Siemens EDA tools, such as simulation, emulation, or formal verification tools, is highly advantageous. 
 Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present ideas effectively and share knowledge with others. 
 Why Join Us? 
 We are Siemens: 
 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. 
 You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! 
 Compensation & Benefits

items.desc: At Stackgini we are building the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. IT landscapes of large enterprises have never been under more pressure. Thousands of applications to govern. Major transformations to manage. Growing regulatory complexity on one side, business units shipping AI prototypes in days on the other. And in the middle: enterprise IT teams still managing and collecting tech demands manually, managing the complexity of highly integrated processes and systems. Stackgini changes this fundamentally. Stackgini's system understands its customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up, from technical configuration to application documentation, from individual IT demands to dependencies across the entire tech portfolio, with the depth of knowledge of a senior IT expert and the speed of a machine. If you had unlimited budget, you would hire a dedicated IT expert for every IT demand. With Stackgini, this is now possible. Some of the largest organizations in this world trust Stackgini including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers or REWE. We're a small, talent-dense team of >10, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career. Tasks The role A Product Engineer at Stackgini owns features end to end. You take a customer problem, scope it with Product & CSM, design the solution, build it across the stack, ship it, and stay close to it after release. Recent examples: Product Engineers shipped Decisions and Approvals (a feature for routing IT requests through multi-step approval workflows), built evaluation infrastructure to benchmark agent recommendations against expert baselines, and agentic IT solutions research with our inhouse developed agent tool-use. You are close to users. You join customer calls, run user tests, read support context, and you use that input to decide what should exist and how it should behave. The person building the feature is expected to shape the feature. We have more good ideas than hands. For most reasonable feature ideas the question is not whether we build them, but when. Product Engineers are the people who turn that prioritization into shipped product quickly, without lowering the bar. The AI work AI is core to our product, but we don't run agents for everything. We use them where they create real value. For that we built our own LLM harness from hard-earned production experience: maximum freedom for the model, without compromising on enterprise control, governance or EU data residency. What this means for you: you work hands-on with these new technologies, you run evals instead of trusting demos, and you know how to put this stuff into production reliably. Agent output gets benchmarked against expert-curated baselines, and failure modes get named, measured and fixed. If you are obsessed with how AI systems behave, fail and improve, this is the place for you. How we ship Small teams of 2 to 3 engineers around a topic. We deploy continuously to production. We use AI tools heavily, and you have freedom in which ones (e.g. Cursor, Claude, Codex). Around that we run a strong operating system: clear ticket context, focused branches, AI review before human review, screenshots or videos for product changes, manual product testing before release, production verification after. The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix. Requirements What we need from you Nobody at 11 people knows everything. We hire people who dive in and own outcomes. 3 to 6 years of full-stack experience shipping production software people actually use. You can get productive in our stack fast: Kotlin/Spring Boot and Python on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend. You don't need to know all of it on day one, but you should get into it quickly. You have shipped agentic systems, side projects absolutely count. You think in tools, context and evals, not just prompts. Fluent English. German is a real plus because many customer calls run in German. We pair you with a German-speaking teammate when needed, but German gets you closer to users faster. You'll stand out if You build with AI natively, not as an afterthought. You can take a vague problem to a shipped feature. You scope, decide, implement, test and iterate. You want to understand why people behave the way they do, and you use that understanding to make product decisions. You have high standards for yourself and move fast without needing to be pushed. B2B SaaS or startup experience is a plus. items.desc: WHY SPEKTR At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale. Compliance, built like product. Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again. We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow. It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands. $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures. Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference. Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries. THE OPPORTUNITY We’re hiring a Product Owner to build products that compliance teams at banks and payment companies rely on every day, in more than 15 countries. You’ll work across the core of the spektr platform, from onboarding and monitoring to investigations, where our AI agents are taking on work that used to take analysts hours. You will shape what compliance looks like when AI agents do most of the work. You’ll prototype, put ideas in front of compliance teams early, and work with engineering and design to ship what holds up in a regulated environment. You’ll do it at a Series A startup that moves fast, with the autonomy to take an idea from a blank page to a product running at banks and payment companies. This is a chance to help define how compliance gets done, not to digitise the way it’s always been done. What You Will Be Doing Prototype fast and test with real users. Build working prototypes, often with AI tools, and put them in front of compliance and operations teams at banks and payment companies in days rather than months. Keep what works and drop what doesn’t. Explore several ways to solve a problem before committing to one, and come back with a clear view on which gives users the best experience, and why. Shape the product experience with our designers. Make complex compliance workflows simple to use, so analysts spend their time on decisions, not on the tool. Push how far AI can go in compliance. Our customers are regulated institutions, so every automated decision has to be explainable and defensible. You’ll work out what our AI agents can take on, what a human still needs to review, and what it takes for a compliance team to trust the result, then move that line further with each release. Turn customer requests into platform capabilities. When a customer asks for something specific, find the version that solves their problem and fits into the existing platform, so it stays configurable and works for the next customer too. Work hand in hand with engineering in Copenhagen and Iași. Align on what we’re building and why, agree how it fits the platform’s direction, and make the calls that keep work moving. Learn from the field. Work with our implementation team, who sit on site with customers and see every rough edge first, and use what they and our production data show you to decide what to improve. What We Are Looking For You’ve owned product on a B2B platform and can show us what you built, how you tested it with users and what changed as a result. Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry is a plus. You build with AI. AI tools are part of how you prototype, research and explore ideas every day, and you have a view on how AI is changing the way products get made. Hands-on and fast. You’d rather show a working prototype than describe one, and you’re comfortable putting early work in front of users to learn quickly. Strong product and UX instincts. You can take a complex workflow and make it feel simple, and explain why one design works better than another. A platform thinker. When a customer asks for something, you look for the solution that fits the existing platform and scales beyond that one customer. Technical enough to go deep with engineers. You understand how systems, data and APIs fit together, and engineers want you in the room when decisions get made. Opinionated and open. You have a clear view on how things should work, argue for it, and change your mind when users or evidence show you otherwise. Close to customers by …

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our Verification and Release Test Team

Wayve’s Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and machine learning models. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company.

As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system, including sensing and model-behaviour testing, as Wayve and your experience evolve.



🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration and system levels, working across software and hardware boundaries.

 - Lead root-cause investigations for failures identified during test campaigns, collaborating with hardware, software, infrastructure and DevOps teams to resolve issues.

 - Analyse test results, uncover software and hardware bugs, and report findings through Jira with clear evidence to support debugging.

 - Review, create and follow risk assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

 - Automating HIL test setups and improving test infrastructure to expand coverage, make failures easier to trace and strengthen compliance reporting.

 - Integrating requirements, coverage and compliance workflows, including Jama, MC/DC coverage analysis and MISRA checks, and managing test artefacts through Artifactory and Azure.

 - Developing traceability dashboards and defining KPIs and quality metrics that support data-driven validation and release decisions.



🙌 You should apply if:

 - You have hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software or mechatronic systems, with a track record of independently delivering test automation.

 - You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest.

 - You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers.

 - You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators.

 - You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray.

 - You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel.

 - You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems.

 - You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155.

 - You’ve worked with test automation dashboards, logging and reporting infrastructure, using tools such as Grafana, Looker, Datadog and Jira.

 - You’re a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement who communicates clearly and works effectively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps and product teams.

 - Ideally, you’ve contributed to improvements in test methods, safety procedures or operational efficiency, and are familiar with data management and version control tools such as Git.

 - Experience using agentic AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate and improve test development, debugging and automation workflows would also be valuable.

IT Security Architecture

Our mission is to ensure that the right technologies are identified, selected, and deployed in the most efficient and effective way to support Telefónica’s strategic vision and business objectives. This includes the security of our networks and Systems defining the right architecture and technologies to assure having a secure infrastructure.
 In this role based in Madrid (Spain), you will work for defining the security IT architecture across the Telefónica Group within the GCTIO organization. Your primary responsibility will be to drive the IT architecture security requirements in close coordination with Telefónica’s operating businesses and key stakeholders. It will also include participation in security standardization fora.

 You will play a key role in shaping the future IT security and ensuring a consistent security strategy across the Group, fostering innovation and operational efficiency.

 ? 💼 
 Extensive knowledge of communications and security architectures for LAN, WAN, WLAN and SD-WAN networks, including routing, switching, segmentation, VLANs, security zones and access control
 Design and evolution of security architectures for data centres, offices, cloud environments, hybrid platforms and corporate services.

 Definition of architectures based on Zero Trust, defence in depth, least privilege, segmentation and security by design principles.

 Knowledge and application of security standards and best practices such as ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK.
 Use and management of digital certificates, PKI, certification authorities, HSMs, key management, electronic signatures and cryptographic protocols.
 Administration and securing of Linux and Windows systems, including hardening, identity and privilege management, updates, monitoring, event logging and vulnerability management.
 Extensive knowledge of network, server and service virtualisation technologies, as well as architectures based on virtual machines, containers and cloud platforms.
 Evaluation, selection and integration of security tools for threat prevention, detection, investigation and response.
 Conducting risk assessments, threat modelling and architecture reviews to identify vulnerabilities, exposure surfaces, critical dependencies and potential attack vectors.
 Definition of security patterns, standards and requirements for infrastructure projects, applications, cloud services and technology procurement processes.
 Technical evaluation of vendors and suppliers, delivery of proofs of concept and validation of the integration, scalability, performance and effectiveness of security solutions.
 Collaboration with infrastructure, network, cloud, development, operations, SOC, business continuity and data protection teams to integrate security throughout the service lifecycle.
 Knowledge of the fundamentals of quantum computing and its impact on the public-key cryptographic algorithms currently in use.

 Support for operating companies in defining roadmaps and implementing post-quantum migration, prioritising critical assets, exposed services, long-lived data and vendor dependencies.

items.card: responsibilities will include: providing expert technical support and consultancy to ESA projects, programmes and general studies in the field of AOCS and pointing systems (AOCS architecture design and verification, including AOCS applicative software and FDIR, as well as AOCS equipment procurement) throughout all project phases; participating in feasibility studies, project reviews and the evaluation of procurement
items.desc:
Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands 
 This vacancy is published to recruit for either: an appointment of 4 years, extendable to an indefinite duration; or a fixed-term appointment with an initial duration of 4 years that depending on performance and organisational needs, may be extended up to a maximum total duration of 8 years.
 Description 
 AOCS and Pointing Systems Engineer in the AOCS and Pointing Architecture Section, GNC, AOCS and Pointing Division, Electrical Department, Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality.
 The AOCS and Pointing Architecture Section provides functional support for space missions in the domains of Earth observation, science, and resilience, navigation and connectivity.
 The Section carries out technological research and development, harmonisation and standardisation in the field of AOCS and pointing, with a focus on subsystem competitiveness, improvement and innovation for performance, robustness, autonomy and process.
 Duties 
 Reporting to the Head of Section, within the technical fields described above, your main tasks and responsibilities will include:
 providing expert technical support and consultancy to ESA projects, programmes and general studies in the field of AOCS and pointing systems (AOCS architecture design and verification, including AOCS applicative software and FDIR, as well as AOCS equipment procurement) throughout all project phases;
 participating in feasibility studies, project reviews and the evaluation of procurement proposals;
 identifying critical development problems and assisting in their resolution;
 contributing to the definition of technology development requirements and work plans for the Agency’s technology programmes;
 defining, initiating and managing R&D activities covering both long- and short- term needs and addressing AOCS-enabling and -enhancing concepts and advanced control techniques;
 fostering new application areas for multidisciplinary activities, placing emphasis on innovative concepts, cutting-edge technologies and system architectures;
 laboratory activities for the testing of AOCS products and the evaluation and prototyping of new AOCS solutions;
 monitoring applicable scientific and technological trends and maintaining state-of-the-art expertise;
 contributing to the dissemination of the results of the activities performed and the transfer of knowledge across the Agency.
Your duties may also include supporting other activities within your field of competence.
 Technical competencies 
 General background and specific experience in the technical domains covered by the position
 Hands-on experience
 Understanding of related technologies, R&D trends and the industrial landscape
 Project support experience in a relevant domain
 Experience in the management and monitoring of industrial activities, including participation in reviews
 Behavioural competencies 
 Result Orientation
Operational Efficiency
Fostering Cooperation
Relationship Management
Continuous Improvement
Forward Thinking
For more information, please refer to the ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook. 
 Education and professional experience 
 A master's degree in control engineering and/or aerospace engineering is required for this post together with a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience. 
 Additional requirements 
 You should have at least five years' experience in the development of satellite AOCS subsystems and in the procurement engineering of a range of AOCS hardware units. Preference will be given to those with expertise in two or more of the following areas relating to the position:
 AOCS subsystem architecture, design, testing and verification, including control algorithm design and tuning, analysis and simulation
 AOCS modelling and software, including automatic code generation, hardware and spacecraft avionics
 Pointing error engineering
 Advanced control, optimisation and estimation techniques
 Smallsat and nanosat AOCS
 Laboratory facility or hands-on hardware (including integration) experience
 Artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques for AOCS applications and engineering
 Your motivation for supporting engineering laboratory activities and for proposing new R&D activities will be considered in the selection process.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness 
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics. 
 At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please …

Continuous learning as the platform scales. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

items.card: ABOUT THE ROLE The Transparency International Secretariat (TI-S) is seeking a Research Coordinator / Data Analyst to support the implementation of the Building Regional Integrity and Democratic Governance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye (BRIDGe-WBT) project, a regional action aimed at strengthening political integrity, the rule of law and democratic governance in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo,
items.desc: ABOUT THE ROLE The Transparency International Secretariat (TI-S) is seeking a Research Coordinator / Data Analyst to support the implementation of the Building Regional Integrity and Democratic Governance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye (BRIDGe-WBT) project, a regional action aimed at strengthening political integrity, the rule of law and democratic governance in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, and Türkiye. The objective of the action is to strengthen the fight against corruption in the Western Balkans and Türkiye. It aims to contribute to credible progress in the EU enlargement process by strengthening political integrity and judicial independence in the Western Balkans and Türkiye. It does so by monitoring reforms, identifying weaknesses, and providing evidence-based recommendations. It brings together national civil society expertise and regional coordination to generate reliable evidence on corruption risks, political integrity and judicial independence and accountability reforms. Building on existing Transparency International tools and methodologies, including Integrity Watch platforms and the regional National Integrity System (NIS) recommendation tracker, the research coordinator will generate reliable policy relevant evidence to support the project objectives. This includes strengthening the data and indicators available through Integrity Watch, quality control and support to tracking the implementation of priority NIS recommendations, and analysing gaps between formal regulations, and institutional practice through systematic, transparent and comparable monitoring. More specifically, the researcher will contribute to maintaining and upgrading five existing Integrity Watch platforms and launching two new platforms in Albania and Montenegro, using datasets to develop corruption-risk indicators and red flags. The researcher will support the compilation of country analyses and produce at least two regional comparative analytical products on agreed themes such as political finance and electoral integrity, procurement integrity, and judicial independence, integrity and accountability. The researcher will also support TI chapters and partners in applying SMART criteria to the tracked NIS recommendations, including setting a baseline, clear milestones and evidence requirements for assessing their implementation. The researcher will quality assure each tracker update, which monitors progress on priority reforms across the target countries. The researcher will use the findings to develop evidence-based recommendations for policy makers and support the dissemination of findings and policy recommendations in relevant fora as required. The Research coordinator will work closely with TI national chapters and partner organisations in the region as well as the Projects, Policy & Advocacy, Global Movement, and Communications teams to ensure that research outputs are rigorous, accessible to wide audiences, comparable across countries, and policy relevant for advocacy. The role requires a highly motivated researcher with expertise in anti-corruption, rule of law, political integrity as well as data management and analysis to (1) conduct and coordinate research activities on political integrity and judicial independence; (2) provide technical advice (3) overseeing the implantation of digital tools for political integrity and democratic governance and (4) support the development of policy recommendations and the dissemination of findings in relevant fora to meet the objectives of the project. The position is currently estimated to start in January 2027 for 27 months. OVERVIEW OF KEY DIMENSIONS Role Purpose: to conduct and coordinate research and data activities on political integrity, judicial independence and democratic governance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye, including quality assuring the tracking of progress on anti-corruption reforms and their implementation. Team: Research and Knowledge. Reporting Line: Head of Research and Knowledge. Salary Band: According to TI‑S internal salary structure; this position is aligned with band PF2, with a salary range of EUR 42.000–59.000 gross per year. Final salary placement will be determined based on the number of years of relevant professional experience. Starting Date: 1January 2027, or as soon as possible there after subject to funding. Contract Duration: Currently we can offer an employment contract limited to a duration of 27 months. Working Hours: full time [100%; 40 hours per week] Location: Transparency International Secretariat (TI-S), Berlin - with some international travel. Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen. In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Define component rules, accessibility requirements, and interaction principles to support consistent, high-quality implementation by AI agents. items.desc: THE POSITION As Data & AI Engineer, you join the Value Assurance team within Tendering & Engineering. Your main responsibility is turning complex engineering and tendering challenges into practical, production-ready data and AI solutions. As the most technical person in T&E, you are the bridge to our central Data & Analytics (D&A) team building on our existing Databricks platform and guidelines, you design and build the AI applications and integrations that our estimators and engineers rely on. Working at the intersection of engineering, software development and AI, you understand both the technology and the engineering problem behind it. You take solutions from first idea to production-ready, working with IT and D&A to bring them live and keep them running reliably. Together with estimators, engineers and D&A, you decide where data and AI add the most value to how we make decisions and deliver projects. YOUR IMPACT Tenders and engineering designs at Van Oord draw on large amounts of data, documents and expert judgement. Your work helps teams find the right information faster, automate repetitive analysis and base decisions on reliable data. That directly improves the quality and speed of our tenders and the solutions we deliver to clients. Because engineers rely on your solutions, they need to hold up to engineering scrutiny, not just pass technical tests. To make this happen, you will Work with estimators, engineers and D&A to translate tendering and engineering processes into clear technical scopes, automation and decision support Design and build production-ready AI solutions and the data flows behind them within our existing platform guidelines, such as extracting structured data from tender documents. Develop applications using large language models, including RAG solutions built on embeddings, hybrid search and reranking. Build integrations between AI applications, engineering systems and business data sources, including MCP servers that give AI agents safe access to production data. Evaluate and monitor the quality, reliability and performance of AI solutions, and help shape our AI and data tooling landscape. You work with Python, SQL, Databricks (including MLflow) and Azure, alongside large language models. You report to the portfolio manager of information systems within Tendering & Engineering, and you act as backup for the technical lead, providing continuity and technical support when needed. Your work environment You are based at our head office in Rotterdam. The team works closely with estimators, engineers and project specialists, so you see your solutions used in real tenders and projects rather than in isolation. You get the room to work independently and to propose new ideas, with short lines to the people who use what you build. Colleagues are open, practical and quick to share knowledge, and engineering expertise is valued at every level. Van Oord is a leading international marine contractor and a family-owned company since 1868. We work on dredging, offshore wind, offshore infrastructure and coastal protection projects around the world, with our own fleet and a strong focus on sustainable solutions. Innovation in engineering, data and technology is central to how we work. About You You are curious, analytical and pragmatic, and you enjoy turning vague engineering and business questions into clear technical scopes. You prefer the simplest solution that works, take ownership of it and document it in a structured, maintainable way. You explain technical choices clearly to estimators, engineers and senior non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable with deeply technical subjects when an engineer talks about pump capacities, flow rates or installation sequences, you can follow the reasoning and check whether a number makes sense. You also bring A BSc or MSc in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical or Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline, or a technical degree combined with proven experience in engineering, construction or energy projects. At least 4 years of professional experience in data, AI or software engineering, including strong Python and SQL skills and solutions running in production. Experience with Databricks and Azure is a plus. Professional hands-on experience developing RAG applications, with a good understanding of how chunking, embeddings, hybrid search and reranking affect answer quality. Experience with agents, tool calling and MCP is a plus. Experience evaluating AI quality, reliability and performance, ideally with knowledge of deep learning. Fluency in English. Dutch is a plus. WE OFFER This is your opportunity to make a visible contribution to projects that support the energy transition while developing your career in an international environment. What do we offer you A salary that matches your responsibilities and experience. Attractive travel allowance (€0.31 per km) and home working allowance (€2.45 per day). 32 holidays, of which a maximum of 7 are …

items.desc: Enzo is a B2B PropTech and WaterTech startup revolutionizing the real estate and insurance industry with its cutting-edge IoT and AI solution, one.drop. Our proprietary sensor technology helps monitor water systems in buildings in real-time, enabling early detection of leaks and preventing costly water damage. Backed by significant funding and a rapidly growing customer base, Enzo is on a mission to protect properties while conserving one of our most vital resources - water. As an AI Engineer Intern , you'll join our AI team and get hands-on with the systems that make our agents smarter and our predictions sharper. It's real work with real ownership, plenty of room to experiment, and a direct line from what you build to the impact it has. Tasks Tasks that you will work on: Work closely with our product and engineering teams to build, test, and improve AI-powered features. Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to improve agent performance and accuracy. Automate data collection, data labelling and data pipeline engineering. Requirements You cover the following requirements: Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or a related engineering field. A strong interest in agentic AI systems and workflows, ideally with some hands-on experience. Familiarity with agentic build platforms such as RAGFlow (through coursework, projects, or self-study). A sense for choosing the right model for the task, knowing when a frontier model is warranted vs. when a smaller, faster, or cheaper one gets the job done. Comfortable with some ambiguity, with support from senior team members as you take on more. B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams. Technical depth Hands-on experience building or contributing to RAG systems, ideally in a production or near-production setting. Solid engineering fundamentals; Python and/or TypeScript proficiency. Productive in an unfamiliar codebase with some ramp-up support. Practical AWS experience (Lambda, S3, ECS, or similar); ready to grow into Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore . Some experience with containers and CI/CD in real projects. Exposure to evaluating non-deterministic systems — you've contributed to or run test/eval cycles, even if you haven't owned a full eval suite end-to-end. Basic working knowledge of model/agent monitoring concepts. Awareness of cost and latency trade-offs when working with LLMs. Some hands-on exposure to the Claude ecosystem (Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files) is a plus, or strong ability to ramp up quickly. Practical experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) in real projects. 2+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including some exposure to production systems. Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about common failure modes. Nice to Have: Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare. Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery. AWS and Claude Code Certifications (or actively pursuing them). A2A: Interest in agent-to-agent interoperability concepts. CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Practical experience with one or more use cases from the following: NLP, LLMs, and Recommendation engines. Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust). Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа. Experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build. MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration, having authored a server is an additional plus. Write production code across the stack (AI, backend services, data pipelines) with code review support. Help integrate AI components into backend services and RESTful APIs. Support model evaluation efforts and help investigate and improve failure modes. Take on increasing ownership of components and technical decisions as you grow in the role. items.desc: Contexte Selon profil Au sein de la DSI d'un grand groupe de protection sociale et patrimoniale, l'équipe renforce ses capacités pour intégrer l'intelligence artificielle générative dans ses applications métier. Les consultants rejoindront l'équipe pour concevoir et développer des services back-end en Java et en Python, et y intégrer des briques d'IA générative et des agents IA capables d'automatiser des tâches métier. Missions principales ? Concevoir, développer et maintenir des services back-end et des API REST en Java et/ou Python ? Intégrer des modèles de langage (LLM) dans les applications métier via leurs API ? Mettre en place des solutions RAG pour que l'IA réponde à partir des documents et données internes ? Concevoir et développer des agents IA capables d'enchaîner des tâches et d'appeler des outils ou des systèmes internes ? Optimiser les instructions données aux modèles (prompt engineering) et contrôler la qualité des réponses ? Garantir la sécurité et la confidentialité des données manipulées par l'IA ? Rédiger les tests et la documentation technique ? Travailler en méthode agile avec les équipes métier, data et architectureProfil candidat:Développeur back-end Java et/ou Python ayant déjà intégré de l'IA générative dans une application, idéalement en production. Une première expérience sur des agents IA est un vrai plus.

items.title: AI Engineer
items.card: Your mission Design and deploy production-ready AI systems — LLM-powered and agent-based — that automate medical coding and reduce administrative workload in hospitals, owning each feature from prototype to monitoring. Outcomes Production LLM systems: design and deploy LLM-powered systems that automate medical coding in real clinical environments. Agentic workflows: build and iterate on agent-based workflows
items.desc: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! Context Up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work — and the AI systems that can fix it only matter if they actually run in production, inside real hospitals, on sensitive health data. Building that is the heart of this role. This is an AI Engineer role : you won't just write models, you'll shape Parallel's core AI architecture, define our machine learning strategy, and embed intelligent systems directly into hospital workflows. You'll work hand in hand with the CTO and the founding team, with very high ownership over everything from agentic LLM workflows to the way AI outputs land in the tools doctors actually use. Your mission Design and deploy production-ready AI systems — LLM-powered and agent-based — that automate medical coding and reduce administrative workload in hospitals, owning each feature from prototype to monitoring. Outcomes Production LLM systems: design and deploy LLM-powered systems that automate medical coding in real clinical environments. Agentic workflows: build and iterate on agent-based workflows tailored to complex clinical operations. Secure data pipelines: work with hospital IT to build secure, scalable data ingestion pipelines that adhere to health-data security standards. Product integration: integrate AI outputs into the apps used by doctors and hospital staff. AI roadmap & full ownership: partner with the CTO to define the AI roadmap, and own the full lifecycle of each AI feature — research, prototyping, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Who you are : This job is for you if: You have 3+ years working on applied ML/AI problems in production environments — real systems that run, not just POCs. You have strong experience with LLMs and NLP, including prompt engineering and/or fine-tuning. You're proficient in Python or Node.js and have worked with ML libraries (Hugging Face, LangChain, PyTorch, etc.). You have a deep sense of ownership and can move from prototype to product quickly. You're action-oriented and autonomous, and you thrive in a fast-paced startup where you shape the core, not execute tickets. You care about solving user problems over shipping features, and you're comfortable getting close to the product and its users. Bonus: familiarity with backend services (Node.js/TypeScript) and data infrastructure. Bonus: experience working with sensitive or regulated data (healthcare, finance, etc.). Hiring process Quick chat with Wallerand, our recruiter (30 min) Chat with our CTO, Chris (30 min) AI / technical case study, in person at our Paris office (60 min) Meeting with our CEO, Paul (30 min) Why should you join us? A rare opportunity: you shape Parallel's core AI architecture and ML strategy from day one, with very high ownership alongside the founders. Real-world impact: your systems directly reduce hospital burnout and free up medical staff to focus on patients, not paperwork. Cutting-edge work that ships: state-of-the-art LLM and agentic systems deployed into real clinical environments — with the engineering rigor (type safety end to end, automated best practices, rapid iteration with tools like Cursor) to make them reliable. Package & perks: competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus our standard benefits (Alan health insurance, Swile meal vouchers, Apple equipment, 50% public-transport coverage). Flexibility: on average one day of remote work per week, and one remote week per year. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

Running a bank means thousands of back-office operations every day; our goal is to make them faster, more reliable and more scalable. As an AI Engineer, you will join the AI Team and report directly to Thomas Linck, VP Platform. You will build and own Skaleet's AI products: a
items.desc: [SKALEET] Skaleet builds the core banking engine behind banks and neobanks: accounts, payments, cards. Our platform runs in production for 30+ regulated financial institutions in 15 countries, including Crédit Agricole, Caisse d'Epargne and Nirio (FDJ United), and manages over 10 million accounts. In 2026, Euromoney named Skaleet the best banking solution in Europe. Our revenue grew by 40% in 2025. We are about 100 people, based in Boulogne-Billancourt. Our ambition: become the platform of choice for European banks and fintechs that want to replace their legacy core banking systems. [Job Description] Context Skaleet recently created its AI Team, with one clear ambition: improve our clients' banking operations through AI. Running a bank means thousands of back-office operations every day; our goal is to make them faster, more reliable and more scalable. As an AI Engineer, you will join the AI Team and report directly to Thomas Linck, VP Platform. You will build and own Skaleet's AI products: a suite of specialized banking agents that let back-office operators understand, analyze and act on the platform in natural language, plus AI-powered automations that take over recurring operational processes end to end. You will ship AI into production banking environments, where "mostly right" is not an acceptable bar. Your future missions Architecture & delivery Build and ship Skaleet's AI products end to end, from early prototypes to production deployment Own the technical architecture of our agentic platform and continuously improve it by integrating the latest advances in foundation models, agent frameworks and AI engineering Agents & reliability Design reliable agentic workflows combining LLMs, tools, banking data and human oversight Define how agents reason, retrieve context, call tools, handle failures and collaborate to complete complex banking operations Own AI quality, observability and evaluation, using traces, user feedback, annotated datasets, LLM-as-judge, calibration against human labels and regression gates Integration & data Build the integration layer between agents and Skaleet's platform: MCP servers and APIs, production-grade authentication, permission management, error handling, retries, idempotency and structured outputs Develop the context and retrieval systems powering our agents: embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking and knowledge ingestion over Skaleet's product documentation and clients' business processes Work closely with data engineers to make banking data usable by AI systems: data models, pipelines, interfaces, tenant isolation Security & compliance Implement the safeguards required for banking use cases: human validation gates, permission scoping, tenant isolation, audit trails, explainability, safe failure modes Product & iteration Prototype quickly, iterate with banking operators, identify high-value use cases and improve the product based on real operational feedback Evaluate and integrate the best available AI models and technologies based on quality, latency, cost, security and regulatory constraints This role is about building systems on top of existing foundation models, not training models from scratch. [Desired Profile] You Are a Great Match If Must-have Minimum 5 years of software engineering experience, including significant hands‑on experience building LLM-based agent systems in production Strong Python backend skills: REST APIs, async, automated testing Concrete experience with tool calling, RAG, agent context/memory management, and LLM quality evaluation Comfortable designing and integrating complex, data‑intensive production systems Experience monitoring and optimizing LLM systems in production: observability, tracing, cost and latency control at scale Working knowledge of guardrails and defenses against prompt injection Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, Engineering, or equivalent hands‑on experience Bonus points Strong team player with product sensitivity: you can push back on a spec that is technically unrealistic, without waiting to be asked Proactive, autonomous, entrepreneurial mindset, at ease in a scale‑up Experience in a regulated environment (banking, insurance, healthcare) where audit trail and human control are hard constraints (a plus, not a prerequisite) The benefits of joining Skaleet Hybrid work: up to 2 days of remote work per week 25 days of paid vacation and 12 additional days off (RTT) per year Health insurance: Alan Blue A Swile card to cover your meals on workdays Brand-new offices in Boulogne-Billancourt, right next to Metro Line 10 [Recruitment Process] A video call with Maxime, HR Manager, to get to know each other and tell you more about Skaleet, our culture and values (30'). A video call with Louis to present Skaleet's AI product vision, the project's ambitions and the role you could play (30'). A live coding session to assess your technical skills …

items.desc: Nous sommes le premier industriel de la donnée en Europe . Notre métier est de créer, manager et exploiter le patrimoine data de nos clients. Nous avons la conviction que chaque entreprise peut adopter une démarche innovante de gestion de la donnée et créer des cas d’usage disruptifs en réduisant l'impact écologique et en diminuant la dette technique. Nous comptons plus de 900 collaborateurs en mission chez nos clients grands comptes dans tout secteur d’activité Nous recrutons un Data Engineer Python / GenAI H/F en CDI sur Paris pour une entreprise de renommée . Dans le cadre d'un projet innovant autour de l'IA générative, notre client souhaite développer un Agentic Data Pipeline Generator basé sur OpenCode, afin d'automatiser et d'industrialiser la création de Data Pipelines. Vos principales missions Développer des pipelines d'ingestion et de traitement de données en Python , en s'appuyant sur des agents IA (Agentic AI) pour automatiser et accélérer les développements. Concevoir et développer un Agentic Data Pipeline Generator avec OpenCode, en configurant les agents via AGENTS.md et SKILLS.md. Assurer l'orchestration et l'industrialisation des workflows Data avec Apache Airflow . Intégrer des serveurs MCP pour connecter les agents à JIRA, Confluence et GitLab, tester la solution sur des cas d'usage réels et mesurer les gains en productivité et en qualité. Compétences techniques recherchées Python : excellente maîtrise du développement et de l'ingestion de données. Apache Airflow : maîtrise de l'orchestration et de l'automatisation des workflows Data. GenAI / Agentic AI : expérience concrète dans le développement ou l'utilisation d'agents IA. OpenCode, MCP, AGENTS.md et SKILLS.md : connaissance des environnements et mécanismes agentiques. JIRA, Confluence et GitLab. Atouts complémentaires : connaissance des architectures Data Lakehouse, des Data Pipelines et de Starburst. Profil recherché 10 ans d'expérience minimum en développement Python, ou 5 ans avec une pratique quotidienne et significative de l'Agentic Coding. Profil technique, opérationnel et hands-on, avec une réelle expérience en Data Engineering. Autonomie, esprit d'initiative et force de proposition. Capacité à concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions concrètes. Nous recherchons un développeur qui aime coder, expérimenter et construire des solutions, avec une forte appétence pour l'IA agentique et l'automatisation.
