items.desc: Job Description About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About The Role As an Applied AI Engineer on our Enterprise team, your role is to guide some of Germany's largest businesses to the frontier of AI and help them deploy Claude into their operations, their products, and their ways of working. You will become the go-to Claude Platform specialist and trusted technical advisor for your customers, advising their engineering teams on architecture, agent design, and evaluation, and working with the C-level and senior executives who sponsor these programmes to show the business value Claude can create and help them reach a confident decision to build on Claude. Enterprise deals are different. Procurement cycles are longer, more stakeholders are involved, and success depends on being able to connect the technical work to the outcomes the boardroom cares about. You will be as comfortable advising an engineering team on evaluation and architecture as you are presenting a value case to a CIO or CTO, and you will carry the technical thread across every stage of a multi-quarter engagement. Much of this work happens in German, with German executives and engineering teams, so native or fluent German is essential for the role. You will partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives and Applied AI Architects to take each customer from first conversation, through technical evaluation, proof of value and procurement, to the decision to build on Claude. Once they have decided, you set their systems integration partner up to deliver, agreeing the target architecture and what good looks like, and you stay close as the customer's technical advisor on Claude throughout deployment, while the partner does the build. Working alongside Anthropic's Product and Engineering teams, you will use your knowledge of the Claude Platform to advise on evaluation, recommend architectures that meet enterprise security and scale requirements, and create the technical and business resources that help large organisations succeed with Claude. Responsibilities Partner with Enterprise Account Executives and Applied AI Architects to take enterprise customers in Germany from first conversation, through technical evaluation, proof of value and procurement, to the decision to build on Claude Lead the technical side of each opportunity through to that decision, and remain the customer's technical advisor on Claude as they deploy Set customers and their systems integration partners up to deliver: agree the target architecture, define what good looks like, and stay on hand to advise the delivery team as the build progresses Guide enterprise customers to the frontier of AI, advising them on how to deploy Claude into their operations, their products, and their ways of working Help customer engineering teams see how they would build on Claude, covering architecture, agent design and evaluation, so they can make a confident decision Build and present the business value case for Claude with C-level and senior executives, in German and English, linking technical capabilities to measurable outcomes such as cost, revenue, risk, and time to market Guide customers through long, multi-stakeholder procurement and adoption cycles, including technical evaluations, proofs of concept, security and architecture reviews, and a clear path to production Work with Account Executives on account strategy, deal qualification, and executive engagement plans, and with Applied AI Architects to keep context and continuity across every engagement Run executive briefings, technical workshops, and enablement sessions for both leadership and engineering audiences Navigate enterprise requirements around security, compliance, data residency, and governance, working with Anthropic's internal teams where needed Identify patterns across enterprise engagements and feed insights back to Product, Engineering, and the wider Applied AI team Travel to customer sites across Germany for executive meetings, workshops, and relationship building You may be a good fit if you have Native or fluent German, written and spoken, as you will work day to day with German enterprise customers at both executive and engineering level 6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder Experience in a pre-sales or technical advisory role selling into large enterprises, ideally in the German market, including scoping and designing complex solutions Experience with value-based selling, meaning you can build a business case, quantify impact, and present it to senior decision makers Comfort presenting to, and building relationships with, C-level and VP-level …

You'll work on real features inside a B2B SaaS platform, learn to write executable specifications that drive code generation, and build the judgment to evaluate what agentic tools produce before it ships. items.desc:
About the Team

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products.

Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group.



About the Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Guardian team in London. You will design and build production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users.

This is a hands-on engineering role with substantial technical depth and ownership. You will work across architecture, implementation, evaluation, and operations, taking projects from early exploration through production deployment. The work requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound product judgment, and comfort solving problems where both the requirements and the underlying technology are evolving.

You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product and engineering teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI.

This role is based in our London office.



In this role, you will:

 - Design, build, and operate core components of Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability.

 - Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths.

 - Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction.

 - Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities.

 - Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI.

 - Develop evaluations, adversarial tests, and monitoring to understand safety performance, false positives, latency, and user impact.

 - Own projects end to end, contribute to technical direction and design reviews, and investigate failures to improve system behavior and reliability.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have experience building and shipping complex production software, with ownership across design, implementation, deployment, and operation.

 - Have built with AI agents or large language models in a core product, startup, or technically serious independent project, and understand the unique challenges of agentic systems.

 - Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can design reliable backend services, APIs, and infrastructure.

 - Exercise sound product-engineering judgment and can navigate tradeoffs across safety, usability, speed, and reliability.

 - Enjoy working closely with researchers, translating open-ended ideas into practical systems, and using experiments and evaluations to guide decisions.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity, take initiative, and communicate clearly across technical disciplines.

 - Care deeply about building AI systems that are useful, trustworthy, and safe.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Introduction 
 The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing.
As a mechanical engineer in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment on the design, construction and installation of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer System.
 Functions 
 Design of precision tooling for the integration, testing and installation of the ITk Pixel Outer System Detector, comprising the Outer Barrel, Endcaps and Inner System Support Tube.
 Design and develop service installation procedures and tooling, including temporary service management solutions for testing of the ITk Pixel Detector.
 Verify the design of components and tooling according to the relevant standards and best engineering practices, performing both, analytical and numerical calculations.
 Develop, document and implement tools and procedures for integration and installation of detector components and services.
 Participate hands-on in the detector integration work in the ATLAS SR1 cleanroom as well as the preparation on surface and in the cavern for the installation.
 Prepare technical specifications for components and tools, following up their production, acceptance and installation.
 Support preparation of and participate in the ATLAS ID detector extraction.

 Proven experience in the design of precision mechanical components and assembly tools for complex systems.
 Demonstrated experience in the use of CAD software for 3D modelling and management of large assemblies. Proficiency in Catia V5 would be a plus.

 Proven hands-on experience in the construction and testing of mechanical systems.
 Demonstrated experience drafting technical specifications, assembly procedures and engineering reports.
 The following experience would be an advantage:
 Assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment.
 Structural joining techniques, particularly orbital welding.
 Technical competencies: 
 Design and analysis of mechanical structures.
 Production of 2D drawings and 3D models (ISO dimensioning, tolerancing).
 Integration of mechanical systems.
 Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.
 Knowledge and application of joining techniques, welding.

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.

Biologist, clinician or scientist? Let’s talk, even if no role matches yet.

We’re always glad to meet scientists who want to join us, whether or not a position is open today. We welcome spontaneous applications from biomedical profiles such as:

 - Biologists and translational scientists  working with AI in oncology, immunology, immuno-oncology and more

 - Computational biologists and bioinformaticians who leverage agentic systems in their workflows and analysis 

 - Data scientists and AI scientists working on biomedical questions



You might be a good fit if you:

 - Hold an advanced degree in biomedical sciences, medicine, bioinformatics or a related field

 - Have hands-on experience with biomedical, clinical or omics data

 - Are excited about and have started applying AI to biology, 

 - Love working in a multidisciplinary team



What happens next:

If your profile aligns with a current or future need, we will contact you to arrange a conversation. Otherwise, with your consent, we will keep your details on file and reach out when a suitable opportunity arises.



You're also welcome to keep an eye on our careers and LinkedIn Jobs pages and apply for specific roles that match your skills and motivations.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Flexible work organization

 - Friendly and informal working environment

 - Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds


RECRUITMENT PROCESS & SECURITY

 - Please complete the form and submit your CV.

 - Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

 - Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

 - Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com http://owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

 - The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com http://Owkin.com.

 - The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

 - Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

 - Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.



If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

 - Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

 - Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

 - Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

 - Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address hiring@owkin.com

 - contact the following authorities:
   
   - [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/
   
   - [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

ABOUT US

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Not an engineer or a scientist? There’s still a place for you at Owkin.

We’re always glad to meet people who want to join us, whether or not a position is open today. We welcome spontaneous applications from profiles such as:

 - Business and partnerships: sales, business development, data and strategic partnerships, customer success

 - Product and project management: product managers, program and project managers, business operations

 - Marketing, communications and public affairs

 - Corporate functions: finance, legal, HR and talent, people operations, procurement and office management

You might be a good fit if you:

 - Believe AI can change how we discover and deliver treatments, and want to be part of it

 - Have a background in, or real curiosity about, pharma, biotech, healthcare or AI

 - Like working in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where collaboration across teams is the norm

 - Are ready to learn quickly and bring your own ideas



What happens next:
If your profile aligns with a current or future need, we will contact you to arrange a conversation. Otherwise, with your consent, we will keep your details on file and reach out when a suitable opportunity arises.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Flexible work organization

 - Friendly and informal working environment

 - Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds


RECRUITMENT PROCESS & SECURITY

 - Please complete the form and submit your CV.

 - Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

 - Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

 - Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

 - Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com http://owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

 - The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com http://Owkin.com.

 - The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

 - Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

NetBird | Berlin, Germany (or remote, CET overlap) | Full-time
 https://netbird.io/careers NetBird is open source networking and access control WireGuard-based overlay networks with zero-config peer-to-peer connectivity. Now working with new use cases in access for AI agents. Open source, built in Europe, used by thousands of teams worldwide. We're a small and growing team going up against (and working with) the incumbents in network security. Post Series A with 10xd revenue since the raise.
- Senior/Staff Backend Engineer (Go!!) : the control plane: peer coordination, policy and access control, multi-tenancy, and keeping it all fast as customer networks grow into the hundreds of thousands of peers.

items.desc: Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant. Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows. Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid. Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen. Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen. Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning. Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we …

items.desc: Et si votre prochain défi professionnel servait directement la planète ? Chez Idex , nous ne nous contentons pas de produire, distribuer et optimiser l'énergie : nous sommes des héros de la décarbonation . Premier groupe français indépendant du secteur (CA de 2,1 milliards en 2025), nous transformons les territoires grâce à des solutions locales et bas-carbone (biomasse, géothermie, solaire…). Rejoindre la #TeamIdex , c'est intégrer une entreprise à mission où vos compétences servent une ambition claire : accélérer la transition énergétique. Ici, nous ne cherchons pas seulement des experts, mais des personnalités qui partagent nos valeurs : L'Engagement collectif pour agir face à l’urgence climatique L'Esprit de conquête pour relever les défis de nos 12 000 clients et explorer de nouveaux territoires La Rigueur dans l'action pour transformer nos idées en résultats concrets L’Exemplarité et la Transparence pour construire ensemble une relation de confiance Dans le cadre d'une transformation globale axée sur l'Intelligence Artificielle, la Direction des Usages Numériques (DUN) d'Idex fait évoluer son organisation pour accélérer l'intégration de solutions IA à forte valeur ajoutée. Afin de répondre aux enjeux d'efficacité et d'agilité, nous recherchons un(e) Analyste IA et Déploiement Agentique. En immersion au plus près des équipes opérationnelles (approche Forward Deployed Engineering ), vous jouerez un rôle central d'interface et d'accélérateur entre les besoins métiers du Groupe et la réalisation technique. Vous serez rattaché(e) directement au Responsable du HUB IA. Vos missions Vos responsabilités s'articulent autour de trois axes majeurs : 1. Recueil du besoin & Déploiement de verticaux agentiques Co-concevoir et décliner la roadmap IA en lien avec les directions métiers. items.desc: Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) marwa.hamdi@mines-albi.fr en collaboration avec Safa Layeb Safa.layeb@mines-albi.fr et Franck Fontanili Franck.fontanili@mines-albi.fr Partenaires IMT impliqués : Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures, Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama nel.samama@telecom-sudparis.eu Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet marius.huguet@emse.fr Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février): Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM) Description du projet : L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences. Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens. Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète. Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux. Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain. Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ? Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026. Objectif du stage L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources : Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ; Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir. La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact). Profil recherché Formation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel ; Compétences techniques : Python indispensable ; une expérience des LLM (fine-tuning, prompting, API) et/ou du process mining (pm4py) est un atout fort ; Qualités : rigueur scientifique, autonomie, goût pour le travail avec des données réelles imparfaites, intérêt pour le domaine hospitalier. Références Huguet M, Pehlivan C, Ballereau F, Dodane-Loyenet A, Fontanili F, Garaix T, Yordanov Y, Augusto V, Tazarourte K, Redjaline A. items.desc: Vlissingen Universitair oude stijl, Hbo oude stijl 36 uur Schaal 11 / €4.132 - €6.275 (bruto) ICT Solliciteer voor 23 november 2026 Dit ga je doen Wat ga je doen? Als Cloud-AI Engineer ontwikkel, implementeer en beheer je innovatieve AI-oplossingen die onderzoekers en analisten van het SKC-OC ondersteunen bij hun werkzaamheden. Je vertaalt de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie naar betrouwbare, veilige en direct toepasbare oplossingen die aansluiten bij de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie en bijdragen aan de aanpak van ondermijnende criminaliteit. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen, implementeren en doorontwikkelen van AI-toepassingen op basis van machine learning, large language models (LLM's), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) en agentische AI. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat deze oplossingen niet alleen technisch sterk presteren, maar ook voldoen aan de eisen op het gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid, privacy en wet- en regelgeving. In deze rol werk je nauw samen met data scientists, data engineers, informatiespecialisten en inhoudelijke experts. Samen realiseer je AI-oplossingen die hoogwaardige informatievoorziening, onderzoek, analyse en besluitvorming ondersteunen. Betrouwbaarheid, samenwerking en verantwoord gebruik van AI staan daarbij centraal. Daarnaast: Ontwikkel en optimaliseer je AI-workflows, prompts en modelconfiguraties; Richt je MLOps-processen in voor deployment, monitoring en doorontwikkeling; Toets je AI-oplossingen op kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, bias en naleving van wet- en regelgeving; Bewaak je de prestaties, beschikbaarheid en beheersbaarheid van AI-toepassingen gedurende de gehele levenscyclus; Volg je ontwikkelingen binnen AI en vertaal je deze naar concrete kansen voor de organisatie; Draag je bij aan kennisdeling en de verdere professionalisering van AI binnen de organisatie. Met jouw expertise help je het SKC-OC om AI op een innovatieve, verantwoorde en toekomstbestendige manier in te zetten voor maatschappelijke opgaven. Dit krijg je Schaal 11 €4.132 - €6.275 (bruto) Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd 1 jaar 36 uur Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur. Dit bieden we nog meer Naast het salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,50% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaal vriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je OV-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof. Dit vragen wij Functie-eisen: Wo- of hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting Artificial Intelligence, Informatica, Data Science of een vergelijkbare opleiding. Ervaring met machine learning, AI-toepassingen en large language models. Kennis van AI-engineering, MLOps en het ontwikkelen en beheren van AI-oplossingen. Ervaring met retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering en agentische AI is een pre. Kennis van privacy-, informatiebeveiligings- en AI-gerelateerde wet- en regelgeving en inzicht in verantwoord AI-gebruik. Wat breng je mee? Je bent een analytische en resultaatgerichte professional die complexe vraagstukken weet te vertalen naar praktische AI-oplossingen. Je werkt gestructureerd, communiceert helder en schakelt moeiteloos tussen technische en niet-technische collega's. Daarnaast werk je graag samen in multidisciplinaire teams en volg je ontwikkelingen binnen het AI-vakgebied actief, zodat je nieuwe mogelijkheden kunt vertalen naar concrete toepassingen voor de organisatie. Het SKC-OC maakt onafhankelijke analyses over ondermijning door georganiseerde criminaliteit. Deze analyses worden uitgevoerd vanuit een maatschappelijke invalshoek en resulteren in verschillende producten, namelijk het periodieke Dreigingsbeeld Ondermijning Nederland (DON) en thema- en internationale studies. Met het project Trendanalyse ontwikkelt het SKC-OC een nieuwe werkwijze waarmee we trends en ontwikkelingen eerder signaleren en duiden. items.desc: Who we are ADC is a boutique data and AI consultancy with offices in the Netherlands, Sweden and Denmark, and an award-winning data design studio (CLEVER°FRANKE) embedded in the group. We help organisations turn data and AI into real impact, leading a mission to accelerate the responsible use of data and AI. We bring the full data value chain under one roof: from strategy and engineering to analytics, data science and design. This way, we turn complex data into clear roadmaps, scalable foundations, AI-powered tools, and experiences people actually enjoy using. Freelance Data & AI Engineering opportunities Are you a freelancer interested in applying your data, engineering, cloud or AI expertise to real business challenges? We are always looking for talented freelance professionals to join the project teams driving this work forward. How this connects to our current work Our teams are actively working across the following areas: Data engineering: designing, building and maintaining scalable data pipelines that turn complex, high-volume datasets into reliable, production-ready foundations for analytics, models and AI. Data and AI in regulated environments: building solutions where data quality, traceability and reproducibility are essential, helping clients upgrade their data infrastructure and stay audit-ready. Credit risk analytics: supporting model development and validation for frameworks such as IRB and IFRS 9, and connecting regulatory risk models to strategic business outcomes. Generative AI and agentic systems: developing custom AI systems such as agentic workflows, RAG-based systems and domain-specific AI assistants. MLOps and model monitoring: building end-to-end AI pipelines and monitoring frameworks that keep models performing at their best, managing drift and retraining needs. We build these solutions with technologies such as Python and Docker, on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. What you bring We’re not just consultants: we’re leading experts in Data & AI, using our expertise in AI, Data, Cloud Engineering and Financial Risk Management. What unites us is a shared way of working: breaking down complex challenges to change how organisations operate. We don’t expect you to have everything on this list. What matters is where you can add value now and where you want to grow. 3+ years of experience in data engineering, AI engineering or data science, ideally gained in consulting or project-based work A quantitative academic background , such as AI, Econometrics, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related field Hands-on experience with Python and at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) A strong grasp of the modern GenAI landscape (LLMs, RAG, embeddings and vector search, tool/function calling, agentic patterns, and protocols like MCP) and the judgement to know when to apply each Experience with, or interest in, financial services and its regulatory context The ability to communicate with anyone in the room , explaining complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences A collaborative spirit: you believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives and supporting each other to raise the bar Fluency in English; Dutch is a plus. What’s in it for you At ADC, we value our freelance partners as true extensions of our collective. We bring you on board for your expertise, giving you the space to deliver exceptional work on projects that matter. That means: Impact you can point to: you’ll see your work in action, directly shaping how our clients build, run and rely on their data and AI solutions. The freedom to innovate: we bring you in for your expertise. You’ll have the autonomy to recommend better ways to build pipelines, models and AI systems, propose smarter approaches, and challenge the status quo. True partnership: you won’t be working in a silo. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Coder est pour vous une passion, et pas seulement une compétence ? Infrastructure, Python, Continuous Delivery, DevOps, Open Source ne sont pas que des buzzwords pour vous ? Bref, un vrai passionné de tech ! Rejoignez-nous ! Au sein de l'une de nos Feature Teams, adepte de l'approche " You build it, You Run it " et qui a pour projet de développer le Cloud privé mondial du Groupe ! En tant que développeur Devops Cloud, vous contribuerez aux services d'infrastructure Cloud (IaaS) consommés par l'ensemble de nos DSI. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Développer des services Cloud à base d'outils OpenSource et d'autres standards du marché (Jira, GitHub, Jenkins, Sonar, Ansible...) le tout dans une approche Agile (Scrum ou Kanban). Contribuer à l'établissement des standards et aux bonnes pratiques de développement, à l'engineering de développement et/ou à l'architecture logicielle de votre service. Participer au maintien des services en conditions opérationnelles, dans un processus de " Continuous Deployment ", avec création d'environnements " On Demand ". Administrer les services compute du cloud privé de la Société Générale, sur OpenStack/Openshift Contribuer aux différentes communautés open source, en particulier OpenStack. Mettre en place des solutions d'automatisation des opérations (Bot, Machine Learning, AgenticAI). Et si c'était vous ? Vous êtes diplômé d'un Bac+5 en école de Commerce, d'Ingénieur ou Université avec une spécialisation en informatique et vous avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience Vous êtes intéressé et maîtrisez peut-être l'utilisateur des services cloud des hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Plateform, OVH), ce serait un plus ! Vous êtes à l'aise sur plusieurs stacks technos open source, administration système, Linux, Kubernetes, Openstack, Openshift, Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery, Ansible, Terraform, Git, Monitoring, Prometheus, Python, etc. Vous êtes vrai pédagogue et à l'écoute, vous aimez travailler en équipe, dans un environnement dynamique et international. You're fluent in english ! Vous êtes notre candidat idéal ! Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Notre vision est de jouer un rôle moteur dans les transformations positives du monde et de contribuer à un avenir plus écologique, respectueux de la planète ! Choisir Société Générale, c'est intégrer un Groupe où la culture d'entreprise est tournée vers l'inclusion, la diversité et l'esprit d'équipe ! C'est construire une carrière dynamique avec la possibilité de changer de poste en moyenne tous les 4 ans, en France et à l'international tout en bénéficiant de formations régulières ! Au regard de vos compétences, une rémunération attractive revue annuellement, composée d'un salaire fixe, d'une part variable individuelle et d'une prime d'intéressement et de participation vous sera proposée. Vous bénéficiez également de tarifs préférentiels sur vos services bancaires, d'un compte épargne temps monétisable et d'un Plan d'Epargne Entreprise abondé . Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez de nombreux avantages complémentaires : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service 26 à 28 jours de congés payés par an et 14 à 18 jours de RTT (suivant les années), des congés liés aux événements de la vie Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Un Comité d'Entreprise (billetterie événements sportifs & culturels, primes et subventions vacances, garde d'enfants, chèque cadeaux à Noël) Une offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Pourquoi nous choisir ? Chez Société Générale, nous sommes convaincus que vous êtes le moteur du changement, et que le monde de demain sera fait de toutes vos initiatives, des plus petites aux plus ambitieuses. Aux 4 coins du monde, que vous nous rejoigniez pour quelques mois, quelques années ou toute votre carrière, ensemble nous avons les moyens d'avoir un impact positif sur l'avenir. Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d'engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer Type: Full-time Location: Paris What about us? Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation The Role We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to drive our product development cycle. This role is built on the philosophy that the best engineers don't just write code, they build solutions. Your primary responsibility is to bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, rapidly translating high-level goals into polished, shipped features. You will be expected to challenge requirements , bring a product-first mindset to the engineering team, and ensure every line of code adds tangible value. This role demands strong software engineering proficiency and acute product judgment to prioritize and ship high-impact features in a fast-paced environment. What do you need to be successful in this role? Exceptional software engineering and system design capability , with proven experience designing, building, and shipping production-grade, scalable systems across the full stack (including C#, Python, and Typescript proficiency), always prioritizing technical clarity and maintainable architecture. A "Product-First" Engineering Mindset , demonstrating the ability to analyze business needs and challenge assumptions. You don't just build what is asked; you build what is needed to move the needle for the product and the user. End-to-end feature ownership , driving the entire development lifecycle from defining requirements to robust implementation, QA, deployment and monitoring, maintaining high accountability for the final user and business outcome. Strategic communication skills , capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for business stakeholders and, conversely, translating complex business objectives into prioritized, elegant engineering solutions. High-velocity development , leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve accelerated delivery while rigorously upholding code quality and architectural integrity. What will you find working at INFINIT? Competitive Salary and Equity : We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together. Diverse and Inclusive Team : Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment. Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities. Flexible Benefits: Access Flexible Retribution benefits with Swile through a convenient mobile app Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance and corporate gym discounts. Quality Time Together : We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time. Personal Time Off : Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off as well as your birthday off. Flexibility and Ownership : We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Paris office and 2 days at home. Diversity and Inclusion INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

items.desc: Deine Rolle Als AI Strategy Consultant bei Turbine Kreuzberg verbindest du geschäftliche Ziele, technologische Möglichkeiten und erfolgreiche Umsetzung. Du strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen, führst Projekte eigenständig und entwickelst Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen stiften. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf AI-basierter Delivery von Projekten und Pitches, der Beratung unserer Auftraggebe zur Nutzung von AI im Unternehmen und der Implementierung von AI in digitale Produkte. Du nutzt AI, um schneller zu recherchieren, Hypothesen zu entwickeln, Analysen zu verdichten, Angebote zu bauen und Projekte effizient zum Ergebnis zu führen – mit menschlicher Verantwortung für Bewertung, Qualität und Entscheidungen. Du erkennst, wo LLMs, generative AI, Automatisierung, Datenplattformen und Agentic Engineering einen Unterschied machen – und genauso klar, wo eine klassische Lösung die bessere ist. Ganz nach unserem Leitmotiv: »From Intent to Code«. Deine Aufgaben AI-basierte Delivery: Du nutzt AI-native Tools und Workflows für Research, Analyse, Dokumentation, Projektplanung, Pitches und Qualitätssicherung. AI-Beratung: Du identifizierst Use Cases, bewertest Nutzen, Daten- und Prozessreife, Governance, Datenschutz und Risiken und entwickelst priorisierte Roadmaps für den Einsatz von AI im Unternehmen. AI in Produkten: Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele in AI-Funktionen wie bspw. semantische Suche, Content-Automatisierung, Personalisierung, Copilots, Agents oder AI-Funktionen in Commerce-, PIM- und CMS-Systemen. Umsetzung bis in den Betrieb: Gemeinsam mit Engineers arbeitest du an Lösungsdesign, Datenflüssen, APIs, Modell- und Toolauswahl. Projekt- und Stakeholder Management: Du steuerst Kundenprojekte oder Workstreams, moderierst Workshops, hältst Fortschritt und Risiken im Blick und schaffst Alignment von Fachbereich bis C-Level. New Business: Du erkennst AI-Potenziale bei bestehenden Auftraggeber und unterstützt bei Angeboten, Pitches und der Gewinnung neuer Projekte. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung: Du bringst etwa drei bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung aus Beratung, Digital Transformation, Technology Delivery, Produktarbeit, Projektmanagement oder AI-bezogenen Projekten mit. Für die Manager-Ebene erwarten wir Erfahrung in der Führung größerer Engagements, Workstreams oder Teams. Ownership: Du setzt Projekte selbstständig auf, strukturierst und steuerst sie – auch wenn sich Scope, Stakeholder oder Timelines verändern. Du arbeitest autonom, machst Risiken sichtbar und führst Teams ohne Mikromanagement zum Ergebnis. AI-Praxis: Du nutzt AI bereits in deiner eigenen Arbeit und interessierst dich für LLMs, generative AI, Agents und AI-gestützte Automatisierung. Business-Tech-Brücke: Du sprichst mit dem C-Level über Geschäftswert, Risiken und Entscheidungen und arbeitest mit Engineers an Machbarkeit, Daten, APIs und technischen Grenzen. Du musst nicht selbst programmieren. AI-Qualität: Du kennst Herausforderungen wie Datenqualität, Halluzinationen, Evaluation, Kosten, Datenschutz, Sicherheit und Governance und denkst AI-Produkte bis zum Betrieb. Beratung und Kommunikation: Du denkst schnell und analytisch, arbeitest dich in neue Domänen ein, moderierst souverän, schreibst klar und übersetzt Komplexes in umsetzbare Entscheidungen. Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch. Check, check, check… Halt! Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien – oder einfach andere? Lass dich davon nicht abhalten. Entscheidend sind deine Neugier, dein Urteilsvermögen und deine Fähigkeit, AI in echte Ergebnisse zu übersetzen. Wir freuen uns auf die Möglichkeit, neue Skills zu lernen und beizubringen. Das erwartet dich bei uns AI mit Wirkung: Du verbindest Beratung, Pitches und implementierte AI-Lösungen mit messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen. Consulting und Engineering als Einheit: Du arbeitest mit Consultants, Engineers, Architekt:innen, Designer:innen und den Teams unserer Auftraggeber an Lösungen, die funktionieren. Zwei plus drei: Hybrides Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen im Office in Berlin und drei Tagen flexibel. Frischer Wind für deine Ideen: In unseren Breakout- und Hackout-Sessions entwickelst du neue Ideen und testest neue Wege. Meerblick statt Bürowand: Pack deinen Laptop ein und arbeite eine Zeit lang aus unserer Agentur-Wohnung in Faro, Portugal. Wachse über dich hinaus: Wir geben dir Zeit und Budget für deine persönliche Weiterbildung. Fit bleiben, wie du willst : Wir bezuschussen deine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club. Exclusive Vorteile : Über unser Corporate-Benefits-Programm bekommst du Rabatte bei vielen bekannten Marken. Unser Einstellungsprozess Schritt 1 – Bewerbung: Du sendest uns deinen CV mit Anschreiben. Schritt 2 – Erstes Kennenlernen: 30 Minuten für ein gegenseitiges Kennenlernen und deine Fragen. Schritt 3 – Case und reguläres Interview: Case ohne Vorbereitung (1 Stunde) plus reguläres Interview. items.desc: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team , you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide. This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe. What You Will Do Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts. Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers. Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration. Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events. Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support. Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem. Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant. Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling. What You Bring Clinical experience in healthcare (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice). Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments. A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care. Strong communication skills - equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians. Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset. Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments. Fluency in Dutch and English Bonus Points Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs). Background in healthtech or SaaS. Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations. Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts. Location We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Leiden with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition First interview with our NL Country Director Follow up interview with of our NL Medical Operations team lead Working Day - Join us in the Leiden office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. Culture at Tandem At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started. Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together. Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection. We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds. We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for our next colleague to join as a Backend Engineer to help us protect our content and strengthen the technology behind a secure, reliable streaming experience. The role is in our Stockholm office . Are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? The Role As a Backend Engineer on playback security, you will develop the services and APIs that apply playback security decisions, revoke access and support effective action against unauthorized streaming. Working closely with other streaming engineers, backend engineers and other specialists across Viaplay, you will focus on connecting protection controls across the playback journey. Our backend services are built primarily in Node.js, Rust and Java, using serverless and event-driven architecture on AWS. We value shared ownership, learning from each other, and taking responsibility for services in production. You’re drawn to problems without an obvious answer and willing to challenge how things are done. You think in systems, connecting the details to the bigger picture. You’re curious about working alongside AI agents where setting direction, delegating tasks and challenging the results is a natural part of your work. You bring the confidence to experiment and the judgement to own what you deliver. Solid experience developing backend services with Node.js. Experience building secure, reliable and scalable services, including REST APIs and distributed or event-driven systems. Experience deploying services and infrastructure on AWS, using CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code. Experience with unit and integration testing, monitoring and troubleshooting production services. An understanding of authentication, authorization and access control, and a collaborative approach to engineering. items.desc: Quartr is a software company serving the world of finance. Every day, leading companies and financial institutions worldwide use our products to research faster and understand deeper. For too long, markets have been obsessed with numbers. Everyone has access to the same quantitative data, while qualitative insights – the words, the signals, the nuance – have remained mostly in the shadows. We make those insights accessible, searchable, and actionable. Our products are used daily by some of the most sophisticated teams in finance and tech, including major hedge funds and Magnificent 7 companies, and over a million investors have downloaded our mobile app. We're backed by some of the smartest minds in our industry and growing fast at a global scale, and we're still at the very beginning of what we expect to be a multi-decade journey. We're now looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Public API team. The team owns how customers get Quartr's data into their own systems: our REST API, webhooks, and Snowflake data shares. We're also building search and an MCP server so customers and their AI agents can query transcripts, reports, and slides directly. You'll design, build, and run these products, with a high bar for reliability, performance, and developer experience. Our customers build on top of what we ship, so getting the details right matters. What you’ll do Design, build, and maintain the APIs and services that deliver Quartr's data to customers. Evolve the API with care: versioning, backwards compatibility, and clear documentation. Build data delivery beyond REST, including webhooks, Snowflake data shares, search, and tools for AI agents. Own the reliability, performance, and security of your services in production. Work with product, data, and customer-facing teams to turn customer needs into features. Who you are You are a strong problem-solver with keen attention to detail. You take ownership of what you build, from design to production and capable of delivering high-quality solutions. You communicate clearly and work well in a collaborative team. Tech Required Backend development experience, ideally with NestJS and TypeScript. Experience designing and maintaining APIs used by customers or other teams. A solid track record of working with databases in production environments. A plus, but not required Hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes. Experience with webhooks, data pipelines, and event-driven systems, such as CDC and Kafka. Experience with search engines such as OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. Experience with Snowflake or other data warehouses. Familiarity with MCP or building tools for AI agents. What we offer Do your life's work: The world's leading finance professionals use Quartr daily. We do fewer things better and hold a very high bar for quality. Join the foundational team: We're still at the very beginning of a multi-decade journey. You'll have a big influence on product, culture, and how we win. Real ownership: We believe in shared success. Every team member gets equity exposure, so we all benefit from the value we create. Meritocracy over hierarchy: You'll join a culture where the best idea wins. We value clear thinking, leave ego at the door, and obsess over the details. Office culture with flexibility: Join us in one of our offices. We value being together, while also offering flexibility to work from home when needed. Compensation & well-being: We offer competitive salaries, benefits, and a generous wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health. We include occupational pension for all employees in Sweden.

items.desc: About Cerrion At Cerrion, we're building the future of AI-enabled manufacturing. Headquartered in Zurich with more than $25M in funding from Creandum, Y Combinator, and top Silicon Valley investors, we're building the industrial AI platform to deploy AI Agents that can see what's happening on the production floor, automatically spot problems, and instantly intervene to keep lines running smoothly, at scale. Our technology is live in factories across 18+ countries, helping leading manufacturers in glass, beverage, food, CPG, building materials, and wood cut downtime by up to 50%. Role Summary As a Customer Integration Engineer, you are the technical bridge between Cerrion and our customers' IT and security teams. Your mission is to make it easy and secure for enterprise customers to connect to and run Cerrion in their environment. You lead the technical onboarding and expansion workstreams with customer IT: guiding networking, connectivity, authentication, and data-flow setup, troubleshooting issues, and working closely with our internal infrastructure team. You also join sales conversations as the technical voice on integration, architecture, and security, helping our team remove technical blockers on the way to a signed deal. This is a customer-facing, high-ownership role at the front lines of scaling a real-world AI platform into complex enterprise and industrial environments. It suits someone highly structured, who tracks every open item and fights to get customers live. Your Responsibilities Own customer IT onboarding and expansions: act as the primary technical contact for customer IT and security during deployment and scaling, driving all required connectivity and configuration to completion. Guide integrations end-to-end: lead customers through setup and validation of networking and access requirements (firewalls, allowlists, VPNs and tunnels, ports, DNS, certificates, proxies, reverse proxies), working in lockstep with Cerrion's infrastructure team. Lead the customer security review process: own the timeline and delivery of customer security questionnaires and due diligence requests. Coordinate with internal security engineering to curate responses, manage escalations, and maintain our standard compliance answer library. Support technical resale and sales engineering: join customer and prospect calls to explain our architecture and security setup, answer technical objections, and help move deals forward. Document customer installations: produce clear, structured as-builts and integration notes that support long-term reliability and internal handoff. Build scalable enablement assets: create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, diagrams, and FAQs for customer IT and security stakeholders and internal teams. Your Qualifications Must-have Strong networking fundamentals with hands-on experience in TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, IPsec, DNS, firewalls and allowlists, certificates, and proxy and reverse-proxy environments. Solid grounding in IT security and the questions enterprise security teams ask. Customer-facing enterprise experience: you have worked directly with IT and security teams in support, solutions, implementation, forward-deployed, sales engineering, or similar roles. Ability to lead technical calls independently, explain tradeoffs clearly, and drive alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders. Highly structured way of working: you keep meticulous track of open items and don't let details slip. A get-it-done mindset: pragmatic, biased toward action, and persistent in getting customers live securely and quickly, without losing rigor. Strong documentation habits: you produce clean, reusable artifacts and keep records current. Fluent English, spoken and written. German is a big plus, and other languages are welcome. Nice-to-have Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar frameworks. Exposure to industrial and OT environments, hybrid and on-prem deployments, or edge and IoT systems. Familiarity with manufacturing frameworks like ISA-95 and protocols like OPC-UA. Fundamentals of Linux, Docker, and GitHub. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform. Performance Expectations Time to go live for customer integration workstreams. Customer IT satisfaction and low friction during onboarding and expansions. Clear, complete installation and integration documentation for every customer. Contribution to deals unblocked through technical support. Why Join Cerrion? Your work directly determines how fast, and how safely, customers can deploy Cerrion at scale, influencing revenue, retention, and product direction. items.desc: Job Description This role offers a great balance of home and office working, with flexibility around location and the expectation of attending one of our offices at least two days a week. As the UK’s largest independent full fibre network and wholesale platform of choice, we’re busy setting new standards for what digital infrastructure can and should be. Our network is greener, more reliable and designed for the future. The products we run over it lead the way on speed, value and service - helping businesses to innovate, communities to thrive, and people to live more connected digital lives. At CityFibre, you’ll be part of something bigger, helping to build a better-connected Britain, together. Joining us as a Data Solution Architect You'll play a key role in shaping and delivering CityFibre's enterprise data architecture, designing scalable data, analytics and AI-enabled solutions that support our wider business transformation. Working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams and delivery partners, you'll take ownership of end-to-end solution architecture, translating complex business requirements into practical, secure and future-ready technology solutions. You'll receive a salary of up to £87,000, depending on experience, alongside a performance-related bonus and a range of flexible benefits. This is some of what you can expect to be doing: Lead the end-to-end solution architecture and design of enterprise data platforms, data products, analytics and AI-enabled solutions, from initial requirements through to implementation Partner with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, challenge assumptions and ensure architectural decisions align with business objectives Evaluate technology options, architectural trade-offs, risks and dependencies, balancing business value, scalability, cost and delivery considerations Design modern cloud-based data architectures, including data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, integration frameworks and enterprise analytics platforms Establish and maintain architecture principles, reference architectures, governance standards and technology roadmaps across data and AI solutions Provide architectural leadership to engineering and delivery teams, influencing technical decisions and ensuring solutions are delivered in line with agreed designs Support the adoption of emerging technologies, including Generative AI, Agentic BI and intelligent automation, identifying opportunities to deliver measurable business value What you'll bring to the role You'll be an experienced Data Solution Architect with a strong background in enterprise data architecture, cloud technologies and end-to-end solution design, combined with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, scalable solutions. items.desc: What Awaits You Every Day At Quobly Implantée au cœur des Alpes françaises, Quobly est issue de plus de 15 ans de recherche dans le domaine de l’informatique quantique. Nous développons un ordinateur quantique à qubits de spin sur silicium, avec l’ambition de rendre cette technologie pratique, évolutive et capable de répondre à des enjeux concrets. Quobly vous offre l’opportunité de participer à l’avenir de l’informatique quantique : rejoignez notre équipe Software et explorez le potentiel de l’IA générative appliquée à des données scientifiques réelles. Le stage Au sein de l’équipe Software, vous travaillerez pendant 6 mois avec nos physiciens et ingénieurs sur un sujet à la croisée de l’IA générative, de la vision par ordinateur et de la physique quantique. Votre objectif sera de développer des méthodes capables de générer des données scientifiques synthétiques réalistes et physiquement pertinentes, afin de rapprocher les données simulées des résultats obtenus lors de nos expérimentations. Technical Challenges Étudier les simulateurs physiques et analyser les différences entre les données simulées et expérimentales. Explorer les approches de génération d’images, de données synthétiques et d’adaptation de domaine les plus pertinentes. Développer en Python des pipelines de préparation des données, d’entraînement et d’évaluation. Entraîner et comparer différents modèles sur GPU, notamment avec PyTorch ou un framework équivalent. Collaborer avec les physiciens et ingénieurs pour vérifier le réalisme et la cohérence scientifique des résultats. You Are Special Because Vous êtes en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en Master 2 en IA, data science, informatique, vision par ordinateur, physique ou dans un domaine proche. Vous interviendrez sur des projets à forte dimension technique, autour des LLM, des architectures RAG et des systèmes agentiques, avec une approche orientée développement logiciel, automatisation et mise en production. Vous serez amené à exploiter les outils d'intelligence artificielle pour accélérer vos développements, tout en garantissant la qualité, la fiabilité, la maintenabilité et la structuration du code produit. VOS MISSIONS Concevoir et développer des applications intelligentes reposant sur des LLM, des architectures RAG et des workflows agentiques. Utiliser les nouvelles solutions d'intelligence artificielle pour accompagner et accélérer les différentes étapes du développement logiciel : génération de code, débogage, automatisation et amélioration des applications.
