items.desc: DESCRIPTION DE POSTE En tant que AI Product Specialist, vous êtes responsable de la qualité et de la performance de nos agents IA en production . Votre mission : faire en sorte que ce que nos agents répondent à nos clients soit juste, utile et fiable, et étendre ces agents à de nouvelles lignes d’assurance, dans un contexte exigeant : données sensibles et marché réglementé. Vous évoluez au sein de l’équipe Produit, en binôme étroit avec le senior software engineer de l’équipe IA, qui construit le socle technique et l’architecture de nos agents. Il construit et intègre, vous améliorez et garantissez la qualité de ce qui est livré. Vous faites aussi de l’IA une compétence partagée dans l’équipe. 💻 Missions Améliorer la qualité et la performance de nos agents IA Itération sur les prompts : concevoir, tester et améliorer les prompts, le contexte fourni et les garde-fous de nos agents, avec une démarche d’expérimentation rigoureuse et mesurée. Optimisation du RAG : analyser et améliorer la pertinence des informations récupérées et du contexte fourni aux agents, afin de garantir des réponses fiables, précises et fondées sur les bonnes sources. Analyse des conversations : exploiter les traces de nos agents (via LangSmith) pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne, ce qui échoue et pourquoi, du point de vue du client. Jeux de tests et critères de qualité : construire et faire évoluer les jeux de tests et les évaluateurs automatisés (notamment LLM-as-a-Judge) pour mesurer objectivement la qualité des réponses, identifier les axes d’amélioration et détecter les régressions. Suivi de la qualité : définir et suivre les indicateurs de qualité de nos agents (exactitude, pertinence, satisfaction etc), et animer des revues régulières. Gestion de l’incertitude : définir avec les équipes concernées les cas où l’agent doit s’abstenir ou passer la main à un humain, et les cas critiques à ne jamais manquer. Étendre nos agents à de nouveaux périmètres Nouvelles lignes d’assurance : préparer l’extension de nos agents à de nouveaux produits. Exemple concret : passer de l’agent qui répond aux questions de nos clients en assurance auto à l’assurance santé, puis à d’autres lignes (moto, emprunteur, MRH). Connaissance métier : travailler avec les experts métier pour fournir les contenus, les cas d’usage et les cas limites propres à chaque périmètre. Critères de mise en production : définir les critères de qualité à atteindre avant chaque ouverture, et s’assurer qu’ils sont respectés. Ouverture progressive : accompagner les phases pilotes (mode shadow, ouverture progressive) et analyser les résultats pour décider de la suite. Diffuser la compétence IA dans l’équipe Transmission : former l’équipe Produit à lire les conversations, comprendre les évaluations et itérer sur les prompts, pour que cette compétence ne repose pas sur une seule personne. Documentation : documenter les bonnes pratiques, les jeux de tests et les décisions, pour qu’elles soient réutilisables. Travailler au cœur d’une équipe Binôme avec la Tech : travailler au quotidien avec le senior software engineer de l’équipe IA. Partenaire du Produit et des métiers : collaborer avec les PM et les équipes commerciales et marketing. Conformité : respecter notre gouvernance IA et la réglementation applicable (RGPD, AI Act, devoir de conseil). 🎯 PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Expérience : Expérience concrète sur des produits basés sur des LLM avec une pratique avérée de l’itération sur les prompts et de l’évaluation de la qualité des réponses. Une expérience dans un contexte régulé ou sensible (assurance, finance, santé) est un plus. Hardskills Prompting et optimisation : maîtrise des techniques d’amélioration d’un agent (rédaction et structuration de prompts, contexte, garde-fous), avec une démarche de test comparatif. Évaluation de la qualité : expérience concrète de conception de jeux de tests et de critères d’évaluation d’un assistant IA. Lecture des traces : capacité à analyser des conversations et des traces (LangSmith) pour diagnostiquer les problèmes et les prioriser. Compréhension des LLM : bonne compréhension de leur fonctionnement et de leurs limites (hallucinations, RAG, variabilité des réponses). Analyse de données : capacité à tirer des conclusions fiables de données d’usage et à relier la qualité d’une réponse à un résultat business. Conformité : sensibilité aux enjeux de données personnelles et de réglementation IA Softskills Rigueur et honnêteté intellectuelle : capacité à dire qu’un agent n’est pas prêt, preuves à l’appui, même sous pression de calendrier. Culture produit et orientation business : comprendre ce qu’est une bonne réponse pour un client et pour le business, et pas seulement pour un modèle. Communication : rendre des résultats techniques lisibles pour des équipes non techniques et pour des décideurs. Pédagogie : goût pour la transmission, capacité à rendre l’IA accessible à des équipes non expertes. Collaboration : étroite collaboration avec la Tech et les métiers …

Job Description: 
 Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale, tra le principali realtà mondiali nell’Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Elicotteri, Velivoli, Aerostrutture, Elettronica, Cyber Security e Spazio. Con oltre 60.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una solida presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici a livello globale, è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese.
 All’interno dell’ Area Cyber & Security Solutions , stiamo ricercando un/a Software Engineer per le nostre sedi di Genova / Roma Laurentina/ Torino / Chieti / Firenze.
 Di seguito l’elenco delle principali attività previste per il ruolo:
 Sviluppare agent per endpoint (EDR) e componenti di sistema in C++ moderno, su Linux e Windows
 Sviluppare servizi di supporto e tooling in Java
 Implementare raccolta di telemetria e logica di detection (signature-based, euristica e comportamentale) con relativi meccanismi di response
 Integrare motori e regole di malware detection nell’agent
 Sviluppare la comunicazione sicura tra agent e backend (TCP/IP, socket, IPC)
 Eseguire debugging e troubleshooting di problemi complessi a livello di sistema
 Garantire affidabilità, sicurezza e resilienza degli agent, applicando pratiche di secure coding e standard di codifica
 Contribuire alle decisioni di architettura e progettazione, producendo documentazione (SysML / UML)
 Implementare testing automation e pipeline di CI/CD, mantenendo elevati standard di qualità del codice attraverso testing e code review
 Collaborare con il team di sviluppo e gli altri team coinvolti per l’integrazione end-to-end
 Supportare e fare mentoring ai colleghi con minore esperienza
 Titolo di studio
 Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o equivalente.
 Seniority
 Senior (da 5 a 10 anni di esperienza nel ruolo, o più di 5 anni di esperienza in ruoli analoghi)
 Conoscenze e competenze tecniche
 Solide competenze di programmazione in C++ (C++ moderno, OOP, design pattern), con esperienza nello sviluppo a livello di sistema
 Solida esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni Java
 Sviluppo di applicazioni Linux e Windows
 Fondamenti di networking: TCP/IP, UDP, programmazione con socket
 Multi-threading e comunicazione tra processi (IPC)
 Ottime capacità di debugging e risoluzione dei problemi
 Conoscenza di base dei concetti di sicurezza degli endpoint (processi, comportamento dei malware, tecniche di attacco)
 Esperienza con Git, CMake, Microsoft Visual Studio e sviluppo in ambiente Linux (Ubuntu)
 Esperienza con cicli di vita iterativi e relativi strumenti (Jira / Polarion / DevOps)
 Conoscenza degli standard di progettazione e di codifica
 Competenze comportamentali
 Autonomia nella gestione di task complessi e multi-componente
 Ottime capacità di problem solving, analisi e attenzione al dettaglio
 Security mindset e orientamento alla qualità del codice
 Propensione al lavoro in team e capacità di relazionarsi in modo efficace con interlocutori interni ed esterni
 Attitudine al mentoring e alla condivisione delle conoscenze con i colleghi meno esperti
 Capacità di assumersi responsabilità e motivazione al raggiungimento degli obiettivi
 Proattività nel miglioramento continuo e nella formazione continua
 Conoscenze linguistiche
 Italiano madrelingua, Inglese professionale (B2)
 Sono un plus una o più di di queste competenze
 Esperienza nello sviluppo di prodotti EDR/XDR, antivirus o altri prodotti per la sicurezza degli endpoint
 Windows internals: processi, thread, gestione della memoria, registro, servizi; ETW; driver minifilter e kernel callback
 Strumentazione di sicurezza su Linux: eBPF, auditd, syscall tracing
 Tecniche di malware detection: basate su firme (es. YARA), euristiche e comportamentali
 Analisi dei malware e reverse engineering (statico/dinamico; IDA, Ghidra); conoscenza dei formati PE/ELF
 Conoscenza di MITRE ATT&CK e di detection engineering (es. regole Sigma)
 Pratiche e standard di secure coding (es. CERT C++, MISRA C/C++)
 Processi formali del ciclo di vita del software: gestione dei requisiti, progettazione, implementazione, test, integrazione
 Progettazione software con SysML / UML
 Strumenti di Continuous Integration; Docker e macchine virtuali
 Sviluppo software ad alta integrità (es. RTCA DO-178C)
 Esperienza con piattaforme embedded o ARM, RTOS o middleware DDS
 Coinvolgimento, valorizzazione delle competenze , cura del benessere e della sicurezza delle persone sono i cardini della nostra cultura aziendale.
 Ci impegniamo ogni giorno a favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e stimolante, promuovendo attivamente i principi di inclusione, equità e valorizzazione delle diversità .

Dans un contexte d’accélération des usages autour de la Data, de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle, nous recherchons un consultant capable d’accompagner rapidement nos clients sur des missions concrètes, tout en contribuant au développement de nos offres de demain. Offres & avant-vente Contribuer aux offres Data, IA et Transformation, participer aux cadrages, aux propositions commerciales et aux soutenances. Appui SI / RSI Travailler aux côtés des consultants DSI et RSI sur des sujets de gouvernance, cartographie, pilotage ou transformation SI. VOTRE PROFIL Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée autour de la Data, du décisionnel, de la Business Intelligence ou de la valorisation de la donnée. Vous êtes capable d’intervenir de manière autonome auprès de clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux métiers et de transformer leurs besoins en solutions pragmatiques. COMPÉTENCES RECHERCHÉES Pour éviter une liste trop fermée, nous cherchons surtout un profil équilibré : solide sur la Data, à l’aise avec les clients, curieux des nouveaux usages et capable d’apprendre vite. items.desc: CLO Virtual Fashion is redefining the future of apparel through cutting-edge 3D clothing simulation technology—powering the entire fashion lifecycle from concept and design to production, marketing, fitting, and styling. Since 2009, CLO has been building a dynamic digital fashion ecosystem, driven by its industry-leading simulation algorithms that blend the physical and virtual worlds of clothing. Our suite of tools—including CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny—streamlines every stage of the garment creation process, while platforms like CLO-SET and CONNECT enable seamless collaboration, content management, and digital asset workflows. Through smart tagging technology, CLO also links physical and digital garments, creating an integrated and intelligent fashion infrastructure built for the future of design and sustainability. CLO Virtual Fashion, a global leader in digital fashion innovation, operates across 16 offices in 13 countries—including key hubs in Asia, North America, Europe, and South America. As the demand for immersive, tech-driven fashion solutions grows, CLO continues to expand its global footprint, powered by a rapidly growing international user base and a future-focused vision. Position Overview We are seeking an IT Support & Tech Support based in Europe to oversee local IT infrastructure operations and lead technical consultations for enterprise clients. In this dual-impact role, you will manage end-to-end device provisioning, identity lifecycles (Google Workspace and Slack), and rapid-response offboarding procedures across the European time zone. Externally, you will drive technical consultations with client IT teams—troubleshooting SSO/identity integrations (SAML, Microsoft Entra ID) and resolving firewall/proxy whitelisting hurdles—acting as a trusted technical bridge between our enterprise customers and internal engineering teams. This includes but is not limited to: Client IT Consultation & Technical Diagnostics Lead diagnostic and troubleshooting sessions with enterprise client IT administrators regarding network access, proxy/firewall whitelisting, and software connectivity. Assist clients with SSO and identity federation implementations (SAML, Microsoft Entra ID). Act as the technical translator and liaison between client IT personnel and internal engineering teams, distilling technical bugs, diagnostic logs, and requirements clearly for both audiences Internal IT Operations & Equipment Lifecycle (Europe) Onboarding & Hardware Provisioning: Configure laptops based on IT guidelines for new hires across Europe. Identity & Account Management: Administer user accounts and permissions across core platforms, including Google Workspace and Slack Offboarding & Urgent Incident Handling: Execute prompt offboarding protocols, including immediate account revocation, access lockouts, and secure remote laptop wiping/formatting upon employee departures Qualifications Hardware & Systems Knowledge: Strong practical understanding of PC/Mac hardware architecture, operating systems (Windows/macOS), and local hardware troubleshooting. Networking & Identity Fundamentals: Demonstrated literacy in SSO/identity federation (SAML 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD), enterprise networking, and perimeter controls (firewall rules, proxy whitelisting, DNS). Client Technical Consulting: Experience interacting directly with external B2B clients and IT teams in a technical support, solutions, or consultation capacity. Technical Communication & Coordination: Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues collaboratively, synthesize root causes, and communicate fluently with both client IT administrators and internal software engineers. Account & Device Administration: Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace and Slack, as well as executing remote disk formatting and account offboarding procedures. Scripting & AI tool skills: Basic scripting experience (e.g., Google Apps Script) and hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini). Ability to build tools locally and deploy and configure them in company-approved environments, following guidance from the global IT/Security team. Cross-Regional Support: Self-driven and adaptable, able to coordinate and handle time-sensitive tasks across overlapping European and North American time zones. Language: Fluent professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal). Preferred Qualifications Prior experience with or exposure to CLO 3D software or digital product creation tools Experience working within distributed, cross-border teams across Europe and Asia/US Additional European language proficiency (e.g., German, French, Spanish, Italian) Benefits Refresh month after every 5 years of employment in the company 1 week extra holidays between Christmas and new years Company Pension Scheme Deutschland Ticket Partial Gym Membership Support (Urban Sports Club) International + modern working environment Young and fast growing team Start Up mentality Room for growth …

items.desc: Overview Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. We are looking for a Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to join our industry-leading data and IP management product team to build the knowledge and intelligence layers of SOS AI, our AI platform serving the intersection between Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and AI/ML workflows. Responsibilities Design and build low-latency hybrid retrieval (lexical, vector, graph, faceted) over large, heterogeneous data for on-premises, IP-sensitive deployments. Develop the semantic insight layer: automated tagging, domain-aware metadata, and embeddings as first-class managed assets with version provenance. Build the EDA-aware knowledge graph as organizational memory: entity and relationship inference, ontology evolution, versioning, and temporal queries. Implement agentic memory and outbound MCP servers exposing retrieval, graph traversal, and lineage to external agents with access controls gatekeeping and full audit. Engineer governance so access control propagates from source data through embeddings, graph nodes, retrievals, and agent responses. Benchmark retrieval quality, embedding models, and LLMs against EDA use cases, selecting models per task under cost and latency constraints. Collaborate with product, EDA tool teams and customers to translate semiconductor and RF workflows into requirements. Qualifications MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field 5+ years building production ML or data-intensive systems. Demonstrated experience building RAG and knowledge graph systems in production (a must): ingestion, indexing, and retrieval pipelines. Hands-on expertise with LLMs: embeddings, fine-tuning, prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and open-weights models for on-prem inference. Strong command of vector databases, graph databases, and low-latency retrieval infrastructure at scale. Experience with agentic memory management and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent-grounding interfaces. Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face, etc..), with solid software engineering and API design practices. ML applied to semiconductor applications, especially the RF and microwave industry, is highly valued. Familiarity with data governance, access control, and provenance in IP-sensitive or regulated environments is a plus. Careers Privacy Statement***Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

items.desc: Overview Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. We are looking for an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Platform Engineer to join our industry-leading data and IP management product team to build the Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) infrastructure that powers SOS AI, our AI lifecycle management platform that brings together Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and AI/ML workflows. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate the SOS AI platform: the orchestration, tracking, messaging, and application services that run the AI/ML lifecycle on-premises. Integrate the platform with engineering and EDA workflows so that data flows cleanly between tools and the experiment substrate. Own platform reliability and performance: observability, scaling, upgrade paths, and operational tooling for the backend services. Establish access control, audit trails, and reproducibility guarantees appropriate for IP-sensitive engineering data. Collaborate with ML engineers, product, and customers to turn AI/ML workflow needs into durable platform capabilities. Qualifications BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field 5+ years building and operating AI or data platforms in production. Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration, particularly Prefect (or comparable orchestrators such as Airflow or Dagster). Strong containerization and orchestration skills (Docker and Kubernetes) for building and deploying distributed backend services. Solid backend engineering in Python, including API design, relational databases (PostgreSQL), and service architecture. Experience with MLOps tooling such as experiment tracking and model registries (for example MLflow), and with messaging or eventing systems (for example NATS or Kafka). Experience delivering on-premises or air-gapped systems, with a focus on reliability and operability. Experience with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and job schedulers is valued. Experience in semiconductor, EDA, or other engineering domains is a plus. Careers Privacy Statement***Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

items.desc: VINCI Energies , accélérateur de la transformation énergétique et digitale, réalise 21,6 Milliards d'euros de CA, avec 109 003 collaborateurs présents dans 60 pays. VINCI Energies Systèmes d'Information (VESI) , est le chef d'orchestre des outils informatiques, de communication et de gestion de VINCI Energies. Au service des métiers, VESI est porteur d’innovation dans la transformation de nos métiers et de nos modes de travail. Nous accompagnons nos utilisateurs dans l’adoption de nouvelles solutions créatives, innovantes et ambitieuses pour répondre aux enjeux stratégiques de demain : ERP, Business Intelligence, Digitalisation, Mobilité, IA, RPA, Plateformes technologiques, Conduite du changement, Numérique Responsable … Consultez notre page entreprise sur Job teaser ! DESCRIPTIF DE L'OFFRE : Au sein de l’équipe VESI AI (direction Data & AI), vous êtes le trait d’union entre les métiers de VINCI Energies et nos data scientists. Votre défi : transformer des besoins opérationnels en solutions d’IA concrètes, utiles et livrées à temps. Aux côtés de 1 à 2 experts techniques, vous pilotez chaque projet de bout en bout, de la première idée jusqu’à son utilisation sur le terrain. Votre rôle consiste à : Recueillir les besoins des métiers VINCI Energies, les clarifier et les formaliser (expression de besoin, périmètre, critères de succès) Évaluer avec les data scientists la faisabilité et la valeur métier des cas d’usage (ROI) et contribuer à leur priorisation Construire la roadmap technique du projet avec l’équipe data science : jalons, livrables, ressources et risques Suivre l’avancement au quotidien, anticiper les points de blocage et sécuriser les délais et la qualité des livrables Organiser la recette avec les utilisateurs métier, puis accompagner la mise en service et l’adoption des solutions Animer les comités projet et rendre compte de l’avancement à la direction Data & AI Assurer une veille sur l’IA et contribuer à l’acculturation des métiers (démonstrations, supports de sensibilisation) Qui êtes-vous ? Vous préparez un diplôme d’École d’Ingénieur ou d’École de Commerce (Bac+5) avec une spécialisation IA ou IT, et recherchez un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois (date de début flexible). Vous avez une première expérience en gestion de projet (stage, alternance, projet académique ou associatif). Chez VESI, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre motivation, votre curiosité et votre capacité à apprendre qu’à votre niveau d’expérience. Dans ce contexte, vous êtes organisé(e), curieux(se) et aimez travailler en équipe. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Saft est le spécialiste des batteries de haute technologie pour l’industrie, de la conception et du développement à la production, de la personnalisation à la fourniture de services. Depuis près de 100 ans, Saft fournit à ses clients des batteries avec une durée de vie toujours plus longue, pour l’alimentation de secours et la propulsion de leurs applications critiques. Notre technologie innovante, sure et fiable assure une haute performance dans l’espace, en mer, dans les airs et sur terre. Saft fournit l’énergie de l’industrie et des villes intelligentes, tout en assurant des fonctions de secours dans des environnements extrêmes, du cercle polaire jusqu’au désert du Sahara. Saft est une filiale à 100 % de TotalEnergies, une compagnie multi-énergies mondiale de production et de fourniture d’énergies : pétrole et biocarburants, gaz naturel et gaz verts, renouvelables et électricité. Activités Missions principales En tant que Responsable Programme MES/SCADA , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation digitale des opérations industrielles en définissant les standards, en accompagnant les déploiements à l’échelle du groupe et en assurant une gouvernance efficace des solutions MES et SCADA. Définir et piloter la feuille de route pluriannuelle MES/SCADA, en cohérence avec les priorités industrielles et le programme Smart Plant. Mettre en place et animer la gouvernance du programme : instances de décision, gestion budgétaire, suivi des indicateurs de performance, reporting, planification, gestion des risques et suivi des plans d’action. Définir, formaliser et faire appliquer les standards fonctionnels, techniques, d’architecture, d’intégration et de cybersécurité afin de garantir la cohérence, la pérennité et la sécurité des solutions et des données industrielles. Accompagner les équipes métiers dans l’expression de leurs besoins ainsi que dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de solutions MES/SCADA adaptées. Contribuer aux choix d’architecture des solutions et collaborer étroitement avec les intégrateurs et éditeurs afin de sécuriser les engagements contractuels, la qualité des livrables ainsi que les conditions de support et de maintenance. Accompagner les sites industriels dans le déploiement d’outils de collecte et d’analyse des données industrielles afin de favoriser la prise de décision basée sur la donnée et l’excellence opérationnelle. Capitaliser sur les retours d’expérience et les bonnes pratiques des déploiements locaux MES/SCADA afin de contribuer à l’amélioration continue et à la standardisation des solutions à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Expérience et compétences techniques Au moins 10 ans d’expérience dans le pilotage de programmes ou de projets MES et/ou SCADA au sein d’environnements industriels complexes et internationaux. Expérience avérée dans la gestion de programmes de transformation de grande envergure : gouvernance, gestion budgétaire, planification, gestion des risques, conduite du changement, coordination d’équipes transverses et pilotage de partenaires externes. Bonne compréhension des processus industriels, des architectures IT/OT, des systèmes d’automatisation et des enjeux d’intégration avec les ERP. Solide connaissance des exigences et des bonnes pratiques en matière de cybersécurité industrielle. Compétences comportementales Forte vision stratégique et compréhension des enjeux business. Capacité à innover et à accompagner le changement. Excellentes compétences relationnelles et aptitude à fédérer des parties prenantes multiples. Forte orientation client et résultats. Capacités reconnues en leadership, management et accompagnement des équipes. Forte autonomie, maturité professionnelle et capacité de prise de décision. Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et influence. Grande capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement international en constante évolution. items.desc: Haddad Brands Europe , fondée en 2017, est spécialisée dans la distribution de textile pour enfants sous licences exclusives (Nike, Levi’s, Converse, Jordan, Lacoste…) à travers toute l’Europe. Opérationnelle depuis 9 ans , la société connaît une croissance fulgurante et compte déjà plus de 500 collaborateurs répartis dans toute l'Europe. Nous distribuons nos produits aussi bien en wholesale, auprès de grands faiseurs spécialisés ou multimarques, qu’en Retail, via nos corners dans les grands magasins. Concrètement, cela signifie que si tu achètes du textile enfant (0-7 ans pour Nike, 0-16 ans pour Levi’s, Converse et Jordan), que ce soit dans une boutique physique, en ligne, aux Pays-Bas, au Royaume-Uni, en Italie ou ailleurs en Europe, le produit que tu tiens entre les mains est forcément passé par chez nous, y compris si tu l’achètes dans une boutique officielle Nike ou Levi’s ! Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un.e Merchandising Data Analyst au sein du siège social basé à La Plaine Saint Denis (stade de France). LES MISSIONS : Devenir le garant de la fiabilité de la donnée produit et des pratiques merchandising : nettoyer l'existant, sécuriser les données saisies au quotidien et challenger les habitudes historiques qui ne servent plus la performance. Ce poste libère du temps de management en prenant en charge un sujet que la direction traite aujourd'hui elle-même, faute de temps. Garantir le respect des règles de saisie : définir avec les équipes merchandising les exigences attendues, vérifier leur bonne application et alerter en cas de problème. Analyser les pratiques historiques : comprendre pourquoi certaines habitudes existent, évaluer si elles sont encore utiles et proposer des solutions basées sur les données. Bon relationnel : capable de travailler avec les équipes supply chain et merchandising. Bonne maîtrise d’Excel et des outils BI (Power BI de préférence) , avec une utilisation quotidienne de l’IA. Nous recherchons avant tout un esprit vif , plutôt qu’une expérience significative : une personne qui apprend vite, et non quelqu’un qui a déjà tout vu. Le poste n’est pas réservé aux profils merchandising : un profil en data, business, supply chain ou finance, qui aime les chiffres et le terrain, peut tout à fait convenir. Esprit vif et curieux, qui pose des questions et ose remettre en cause les habitudes avec tact Rigoureux(se) , à l’aise même lorsque les données ne sont pas parfaites, et capable d’avancer sans attendre que tout soit parfait. items.desc: Job Description Integrated Business Planning (IBP) brings together forecasting and planning across marketing, sales, finance, procurement, manufacturing, and customer service into a unified process. This integration ensures alignment across the enterprise, leading to superior customer outcomes. As one of the CMR/HDX Demand Planners , you will collaborate closely with an IBP data scientist to generate reliable forecasts and coordinate demand reviews. This particular role will be focused on the Cellular Mollecular Research and Health Care Diagnostics sales channels (CMR/HDX). Your role will be crucial in ensuring effective demand schedules, streamlining internal processes, and ultimately enhancing the customer experience. Responsible for analyzing overall product demand, forecasting future demand and product needs, and providing input into component demand schedules. Assists in the improvement of demand forecasting accuracy for internal and external customers, working with demand data scientist(s) to determine the appropriate algorithm for statistical forecasts. The work of the demand planner will enable Agilent to maximize account sales and inventory turns by accurately forecasting demand, managing product history and promotional demand, and identifying historical sales trends and demand patterns. Works with the demand data scientist(s) to maintain integrity of data for demand model inputs and analyzes internal demand stream information. Collaborates on Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) processes to enhance demand sensing and adjustment of long-term view of the Integrated Business Planning (IBP). Develops reports and leads demand review forums, reporting on attainment of business objectives, adherence to demand forecast schedules and driving consensus on unconstrained demand. Principle Duties/Responsibilities: Develop Demand Forecasts : Utilize IBP data scientist modeling, market intelligence, and field sales input to create accurate demand forecasts. Coordinate Demand Reviews : Collaborate with sales and marketing stakeholders to conduct thorough demand reviews. Execute Demand Planning : Provide reliable forecasts to ensure effective demand planning. Analyze Historical Sales Trends : Review past sales trends, research demand drivers, and evaluate forecast results to inform future planning. Perform Root Cause Analysis : Investigate key metrics such as forecast accuracy, bias, and value add to identify underlying issues. Derive Consolidated Forecasts : Generate a comprehensive forecast of unconstrained demand. Evaluate IBP Deviations : Discuss and understand the impact of last month's IBP deviations on the current month's plan. Facilitate Best Practices : Proactively facilitate and re-engineer best practices, fostering consensus among functional experts. Drive Improvement Actions : Implement actions for improvement and develop a stakeholder communication plan. Monitor Forecast Consumption : Track forecast consumption and plan attainment to ensure alignment with goals. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent. 8+ years relevant experience for entry to this level. Extensive knowledge and specialized expertise in sales, marketing, or finance; experience in forecasting or planning is a plus. Strong executive presence and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to assess complex business problems and deliver impactful results. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with different levels of management. Self-motivated and capable of operating independently. Additional Details This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws. items.desc: Patent Analytics Expert (IP & Portfolio Analysis Products) Do you want your patent analytics expertise to shape the products and AI that others rely on? Do you revel in testing a polished AI answer and finding exactly where its reasoning breaks down? Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent analytics and AI for IP and business decision-makers! About the team: LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy. Many of our customers use patents to make business decisions: comparing their portfolio with competitors', spotting acquisition or licensing targets, deciding what to keep or drop, or tracking where a technology is heading. Increasingly, they ask an AI assistant to help. We're looking for someone who knows what good answers to these questions look like, to help make sure our products, and the AI inside them, give them. About the role: "How does our portfolio compare with our three closest competitors?" "Which companies would strengthen our position in power electronics?" "What does this patent actually claim?" Answering questions like these well takes judgment: which companies to group together, how to count, which time window to use, how to read a claim, and what the numbers can and cannot support. AI can now produce a polished answer in seconds, which makes that judgment more important, because a convincing answer can still be a wrong one. In this role, you will represent the people who ask these questions, and you will be forward deployed: working closely with the product and engineering teams building specific end-user experiences, rather than advising from a distance. You will define what a genuinely useful answer looks like across different use cases, contexts, and data scenarios, and encode that judgment in artefacts and other mechanisms, including AI agents, so it can scale. You will test our analytics and AI against it and help shape what we build next. Key Responsibilities: Be the voice, alongside the product and engineering teams building our end-user experiences, of the various types of end users who use patent analytics for business decisions: IP and portfolio managers, competitive-intelligence analysts, corporate development and M&A teams, R&D strategists and investors, by deeply understanding their needs, aspirations and the jobs they need to get done. Define what good looks like across a broad range of AI-assisted uses, such as portfolio exploration and comparison, competitor benchmarking, technology and sector trends, acquisition and licensing target identification, portfolio optimisation, and patent summaries and claim interpretation. Capture that definition in governed, versioned question sets, graded example answers, scoring rubrics, and acceptance criteria that teams build closed-loop evaluations on, and work closely with engineering teams to guide them as they build evaluation frameworks on these. Perform structured human-in-the-loop evaluations and drive the eyes-on evaluation layer for our AI assistant and analytics features: design and carry out expert reviews, judge whether results meet the bar, and feed what you learn back into the standards. Collaborate closely with other patent experts in the team to develop methods that scale eyes-on human evaluation. Help engineering teams troubleshoot issues by working backwards from AI outputs to the underlying data sources, to identify root causes. Help shape new AI use cases and features: spot questions customers cannot easily answer today, and test ideas with customers and our user research colleagues. Scope and lead your own projects independently, from defining the problem to sharing recommendations with senior stakeholders. Track how competitors and new AI tools serve these users, and flag opportunities and risks. Help capture your judgment in tools and AI assistants that let others apply it at scale and evaluate those tools over time to detect drift and develop ways to recalibrate them. Requirements: Experience using patent data to answer business questions, for example in patent analytics, IP or innovation consulting, competitive intelligence, portfolio management, IP due diligence, or technology scouting. A strong technical background, enough to read patents critically and interpret what their claims cover. A solid understanding of patent data and its pitfalls for analysis, such as family counting, ownership roll-ups, legal status, citations, classification, and time effects The ability to explain clearly why an analysis is or is not trustworthy, and what would make it better. items.desc:
Role highlights: 
 Role: Forward Deployed Backend/DevOps Engineer
 Location: Portugal (Lisbon)
 Reports to : VP, Forward Deployed Engineering
 Working type: Hybrid (On-site at customer locations approx. 50% of time)
 Must be eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances. 
 Must be based in-country and native level speaker of the country you're deploying to. 
 Why this role matters 
 In this role, you are the backend and infrastructure backbone defence and intelligence customers rely on. You deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and design the high-performance backend systems that move satellite data at scale — fast APIs, resilient services, tuned databases, automated infrastructure. Our stack: Python and Go services on Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, Terraform and Ansible, CI/CD pipelines that also run offline, cloud (AWS) and on-premises air-gapped clusters, with AI-assisted development as the default.
 This is a ship-daily role: systems you build run mission-critical workloads analysts use to protect nations.
 What you'll own 
 Platform deployment & operations 
 Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centres).
 Install, upgrade and operate Kubernetes clusters and containerised applications (Docker) in customer environments — cloud and on-premises.
 Build infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines that work without external internet access, including offline registries and artifact mirroring.
 Troubleshoot deployment and production issues in disconnected environments, from the application layer down to storage and networking.
 High-performance backend systems 
 Design and build APIs, services and data pipelines that handle large volumes of SAR imagery and intelligence data with low latency.
 Connect ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools through robust, well-designed integrations.
 Own database design and performance at production scale (PostgreSQL, MongoDB): schemas, indexing, tuning, replication and backup.
 Apply caching, queueing and horizontal scaling patterns deliberately — and capacity-plan for fixed on-premises hardware where you cannot simply scale out.
 Reliability, security & observability 
 Build monitoring, logging and alerting that work in restricted environments, so problems are found before the customer finds them.
 Harden deployments to meet customer security constraints; own backup, recovery and upgrade paths for systems that cannot go down.
 Run the infrastructure behind AI workloads shipped by the team — model serving, vector databases, GPU nodes — reliably and repeatably.
 Customer engagement & rapid delivery 
 Work embedded with intelligence analysts, operators and customer IT teams to understand operational and infrastructure requirements.
 Rapidly prototype and iterate (working systems first, polish later) to address immediate operational needs.
 Conduct hands-on training for customer administrators on platform operations.
 Feed deployment experience back to ICEYE's product and engineering teams as concrete technical requirements.
 What we're looking for 
 Must-haves 
 5+ years hands-on backend engineering building and operating production systems at scale.
 Strong programming skills in Python. You write typed, tested services and you are comfortable with async APIs. TypeScript is a plus.
 Proven experience designing high-performance backend systems: APIs, distributed services, messaging, caching and databases under real load. Experience with spatial, search, or vector workloads in Postgres is a plus.
 Production experience in both cloud (e.g., AWS) and on-premises environments — this role lives in both.
 Deep Docker and Kubernetes: deploy, debug, and upgrade clusters — not only consume them. GitOps and infrastructure-as-code experience. Pipelines that can run offline or on an isolated network are a plus.
 Observability as a habit: metrics, logs, and alerts are part of done.
 Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD experience, ideally including pipelines that run offline or in isolated networks.
 PostgreSQL and/or MongoDB at production scale: schema design, tuning, replication, backup and recovery.
 Observability as a habit: metrics, logging and alerting are part of done, not an afterthought.
 Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritise working solutions over perfect architecture.
 Strong communication and customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators.
 Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
 Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region.
 Nice to have 
 Experience in defence, intelligence, or government operational environments.

items.desc: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. Stage de fin d’études en ingénierie logicielle et IA appliquée aux tests automobiles Chez Lucid Motors, la qualité logicielle est essentielle pour offrir une expérience exceptionnelle à bord de véhicules de plus en plus sophistiqués et largement définis par le logiciel. En rejoignant notre équipe Software Engineering basée à Toulouse, vous intégrerez nos activités dédiées à la qualité et à l’automatisation des logiciels d’infodivertissement. Vous travaillerez sur un projet concret situé à la croisée de plusieurs domaines particulièrement recherchés : développement logiciel ; automatisation des tests ; analyse de données techniques ; débogage de systèmes complexes ; Machine Learning et intelligence artificielle générative ; systèmes embarqués et logiciels automobiles. Les Plateformes Modernes D’infodivertissement Exécutent Des Milliers De Tests Automatisés Sur Différentes Versions, Configurations Et Couches Logicielles. Lorsque Ces Tests Échouent, Les Équipes D’ingénierie Doivent Rapidement Comprendre Ce Qui S’est Passé Quelle fonction a échoué ? Quelle est la cause probable de l’échec ? S’agit-il d’un défaut du produit, d’un problème d’infrastructure ou d’une anomalie déjà connue ? Un problème similaire a-t-il déjà été identifié ? Quelle équipe ou quel composant logiciel doit être analysé ? Votre objectif sera de concevoir une solution capable d’automatiser une partie de cette analyse et de fournir aux ingénieurs des informations fiables pour accélérer l’identification des causes racines. Votre mission Vous concevrez et développerez un prototype permettant d’analyser, regrouper et catégoriser automatiquement les défaillances issues de campagnes de tests d’infodivertissement automobile . La solution exploitera les résultats de tests, les journaux d’exécution, les traces système et différentes données de diagnostic. Elle pourra également intégrer des techniques de Machine Learning et d’intelligence artificielle générative afin de suggérer des causes potentielles ou de retrouver des incidents similaires. Analyser automatiquement les résultats de tests Vous Serez Notamment Amené à analyser les résultats produits par des campagnes de tests automatisés ; développer des composants logiciels permettant de collecter et de traiter les résultats, journaux d’exécution, traces, rapports de crash et données de diagnostic ; détecter des schémas de défaillance récurrents ; associer les anomalies aux cas de test, composants logiciels, configurations et contextes d’exécution concernés ; distinguer les défauts potentiels du produit des problèmes liés aux tests, à l’infrastructure ou à l’environnement d’exécution. Classer et regrouper les défaillances Vous Contribuerez à développer des algorithmes capables de regrouper et de classer des défaillances similaires ; identifier les anomalies récurrentes ou dupliquées entre plusieurs campagnes de tests ; extraire des signatures pertinentes à partir des logs, messages d’erreur, événements système et stack traces ; associer une défaillance à un domaine ou à un composant logiciel potentiel ; générer un résumé clair de chaque anomalie avec les éléments de diagnostic utiles ; proposer un niveau de confiance permettant de différencier les classifications fiables des cas nécessitant une analyse humaine. items.desc: Dans le cadre du développement de ses solutions d’intelligence artificielle, Dassault Systèmes recherche un·e stagiaire Ingénieur·e R&D en IA agentique au sein de l’équipe DELMIA Generative Augmented Experiences, basée à Vélizy. DELMIA Generative Experiences développe des solutions innovantes pour l’Industrie 4.0, en combinant notamment intelligence artificielle, réalité augmentée et vision par ordinateur afin d’accompagner la transformation numérique des environnements industriels. Missions Au sein d’une équipe dynamique composée de développeur·euses et de chercheur·euses, vous contribuerez à la conception et au développement d’un agent d’IA capable de générer automatiquement des données synthétiques réalistes, diversifiées et adaptées à différents objectifs métier. Vous concevrez un agent capable d’interpréter les besoins exprimés en entrée et de sélectionner les stratégies de génération appropriées, notamment pour créer des trajectoires réalistes et enrichir les jeux de données. Vous étudierez et intégrerez des méthodes récentes d’auto-texturation de maillages 3D, en tenant compte de différentes conditions d’éclairage, et développerez un module d’analyse critique des rendus à l’aide d’un modèle vision-langage (VLM). Vous participerez également à la mise en place d’une boucle itérative entre génération, évaluation et correction, afin d’améliorer progressivement la qualité et la fiabilité des données produites. Enfin, vous documenterez les choix techniques et les approches retenues. Qualifications Vous préparez un diplôme d’ingénieur·e ou un Master (Bac+5) et maîtrisez le langage Python. Vous disposez de connaissances en frameworks d’agents IA, tels que LangChain ou LangGraph, ainsi qu’en modèles vision-langage (VLM). Une première expérience en vision par ordinateur ou en génération de données synthétiques serait un atout. Vous portez un intérêt particulier aux grands modèles de langage (LLM), aux agents IA et aux innovations dans ces domaines. Votre autonomie, votre rigueur, votre curiosité technique et votre capacité à explorer de nouvelles approches vous permettent d’aborder des problématiques complexes et de contribuer à la réalisation de solutions concrètes. Votre environnement de travail Vous rejoindrez une équipe à taille humaine, dans un environnement convivial, créatif et stimulant, au siège de Dassault Systèmes à Vélizy. Vous bénéficierez d’un cadre propice à l’apprentissage, à l’expérimentation de technologies de pointe, au partage des connaissances et au développement de vos compétences, avec une attention particulière portée aux aspirations et aux motivations de chaque membre de l’équipe. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

Vous avez une première expérience en gestion de projet (stage, alternance, projet académique ou associatif). Chez VESI, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre motivation, votre curiosité et votre capacité à apprendre qu’à votre niveau d’expérience. Dans ce contexte, vous êtes organisé(e), curieux(se) et aimez travailler en équipe. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Votre Profil Rigueur et organisation Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse Aisance à l’écrit comme à l’oral Capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques et à animer une réunion Vrai sens du service Curiosité et force de proposition Compétences Techniques Compréhension des grands principes de l’IA (Machine Learning, IA générative, LLM, RAG, agents) Capacité à dialoguer avec des profils techniques, sans être nécessairement développeur Capacité à évaluer la pertinence et la fiabilité des résultats générés par l'IA Anglais B2/C1 Pourquoi vous serez bien chez nous ? Un parcours d’intégration dès votre premier jour et un suivi de carrière individualisé Des projets innovants, collaboratifs et participatifs avec un fort esprit d’équipe Des possibilités d’évolution, de formations et de mobilités dans un groupe international en fort développement Un management et accompagnement de proximité Accord de télétravail flexible dès le début du contrat, extension après 6 mois de présence Une reconnaissance de la performance du collaborateur via de la participation, de l’intéressement et un plan d’épargne entreprise Le partage et la fierté de nos réussites Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Notre ADN : Confiance, Esprit d’entreprendre, Solidarité, Autonomie, Responsabilité Venez vivre et partager avec nous ces valeurs !

items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. This role is both business-focused and consultative — perfect for someone who can combine deep domain expertise, AI fluency, and leadership of client engagements. We’re looking for professionals who think like architects and act like builders. You will shape the business architecture behind intelligent systems: the problems worth solving, the processes and decisions that should change, the use cases to prioritise and the outcomes that define success. You bring deep expertise and enough understanding of modern AI to spot opportunities, challenge assumptions, and work effectively with technical teams. Once a use case moves into technical execution, Forward Deployed Engineers and specialist engineering teams own how it is designed and deployed; you remain accountable for the business intent and agreed outcomes. Analyse and redesign processes and decision flows, identifying where human judgement, data, automation and intelligent capabilities should interact differently. Build and prioritise a portfolio of AI opportunities, assessing business relevance, expected value, feasibility, adoption, risk, data readiness and operating-model impact. Translate selected opportunities into actionable business definitions: problem statements, process requirements, decision logic, user needs, acceptance criteria and intended outcomes. Create adoption and operating-model roadmaps, covering the changes in roles, processes, decision rights, ways of working and human oversight that intelligent capabilities require. Guide multidisciplinary delivery teams on business context and priorities, working with Forward Deployed Engineers, architects, AI, Software and Data Engineers and AI Governance specialists without taking over their decision rights. Review business outcomes through delivery and adoption, using agreed KPIs and operational evidence to decide whether an initiative should continue, change direction, expand or stop. 👤 Who You Are You are a senior business consultant or industry specialist who knows the key question is not what AI can do, but where it should operate and why. You understand how processes actually work, where decisions break down and what people need to change. You discuss AI confidently with technical teams without pretending to be the architect or engineer. You bring structure to ambiguity, make assumptions visible and challenge an initiative when the value does not justify the complexity. 🛠️ What You Bring Qualifications & Experience Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. items.desc: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. À propos de WPP Media WPP est le leader mondial des services de communication et de transformation créative pour les plus grandes marques. WPP Media est l'unité opérationnelle média de WPP, réunissant médias, data, technologies et partenariats pour délivrer une personnalisation créative à grande échelle. Connectés via notre plateforme d'IA marketing pionnière WPP Open et alimentés par Open Intelligence , nos collaborateurs permettent aux annonceurs de maximiser l'efficacité et l'impact de leurs investissements publicitaires. Pour des raisons de clarté et d'accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l'écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances, en considérant l'ensemble des candidatures sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique, de religion ou de handicap. Nos Valeurs Fondamentales Be Extraordinary : Cultiver un leadership collectif qui inspire des idées transformatrices. Create an Open environment : Créer un équilibre fondé sur la confiance mutuelle, l'écoute et l'épanouissement des équipes. Lead with Optimism : Stimuler activement l'apprentissage et le développement pour faire grandir l'organisation. Le Rôle Au sein du pôle Data, Tech & Analytics (DTA) de WPP Media France, vous intégrez une équipe produit agile et innovante, historiquement connectée aux expertises programmatiques et d'activation média. Nous recherchons un profil avant tout technique, pragmatique et orienté "hands-on" ( Data Engineer & Product Builder ). Votre mission principale est de concevoir, consolider et faire évoluer des solutions technologiques et algorithmiques propriétaires concrètes (outils d'optimisation des campagnes, mesure de performance, scripts d'automatisation). En binôme étroit avec les Product Leads de l'équipe, vous jouez un rôle central à la frontière de la data engineering et de la construction de produit adtech, en tirant pleinement parti des dernières innovations du cloud Google et de l'intelligence artificielle générative. Vos Missions Principales Data Engineering & Fondations Techniques : Reprendre, auditer et rationaliser l'architecture de données existante (harmonisation des conventions de nommage, des taxonomies et des modèles de données). Développer, automatiser et maintenir les pipelines de données en SQL et Python sur l'environnement Google Cloud (BigQuery, Dataform, Cloud Functions / Cloud Run). Construire et fiabiliser les flux d'ingestion de données 1st, 2nd et 3rd party via les APIs des grandes plateformes publicitaires (Google Ads, DV360, Meta, TikTok, etc.). items.card: Your mission Looking to start your IT career in the Netherlands as a refugee? The Motopp IT Traineeship offers a 6-month program with training and mentorship, preparing you for full-time roles at top companies like PwC, Rabobank, Alliander, Achmea and many others. Start your IT-career with Motopp Over the course of 29 weeks, you will prepare, together with eleven other trainees, for a career in the Dutch IT sector.
items.desc: Your mission Looking to start your IT career in the Netherlands as a refugee? The Motopp IT Traineeship offers a 6-month program with training and mentorship, preparing you for full-time roles at top companies like PwC, Rabobank, Alliander, Achmea and many others. Start your IT-career with Motopp Over the course of 29 weeks, you will prepare, together with eleven other trainees, for a career in the Dutch IT sector. How? Through a combination of technical IT skills training, insights into Dutch work culture, and workshops to develop essential soft skills. You will learn software development, gain an understanding of how the workplace operates in the Netherlands, and participate in sessions on topics such as presenting, assertiveness, and teamwork. The traineeship is fulltime and conducted in English. After completing the training, we will start mediation towards a paid job at one of our partner companies across the country. If we find a match, for the next 18 months we will continue to support you with personal coaching sessions, evaluations, and additional workshops. Step-by-Step Program IT Bootcamp (16 weeks): Trainees develop technical skills and explore their ideal IT role. Topics covered are: Project Management, Requirements Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Back-end Development (Python, FastAPI), Testing, Cloud Computing, Software Testing, Information Security, Data analysis . Internal Internship (13 weeks): Apply your knowledge in a simulated Dutch Agile work environment at Motopp, work on applications in Sprints, and receive feedback from trainers and mentors. Professional skills: Learn about Dutch work culture, communication, presentation techniques, CV building, and get introduced to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Career: We do not offer a 100% job guarantee, but we do offer 100% job intention. Once you're ready to start working, you'll be matched with a position that aligns with your experience and skills, such as a software developer, system administrator, or business analyst. During the first 18 months, you’ll get ongoing support with personal coaching, regular feedback, and workshops to help you keep growing in your role. Starting date The traineeship starts on the 4th of January 2027. Applicants are informed about the final selection no later than 1,5 week before the start of the traineeship. Is this traineeship not the right timing for you? In 2027, we'll have a new traineeship starting almost every month. Keep an eye on our website and LinkedIn for new openings or reach out to us via recruitment@motopp.nl Practical information Full-time: Monday to Friday from 09:00-17:30. Hybrid: An average of two days a week at our office in Amsterdam, the other days from home. Cost-free: Training costs are covered, as well as travel expenses and a laptop if needed. Your profile A refugee background with a Dutch residence permit. English language proficiency at level B2 minimum. Experience with or strong and proven affinity with IT. Completed education at HBO or WO level (equivalent to a bachelor's degree). During the selection process we may ask for a diploma verification via IDW / Nuffic. Strong communication skills, analytical thinking, and eagerness to learn. Fulltime available, 5 days per week for 29 weeks. 5+ years of experience in IT or (data) analyst roles within large organizations or corporates (>500 employees) is a strong plus. Dutch language proficiency at B2 level is a strong plus. A Dutch driver’s license is a strong plus for candidates living outside a metropolitan area or the Randstad. Selection process The Selection Process Is As Follows First interview (online via Teams) Cognitive assessment (online) Second interview (online via Teams) We recommend that candidates take the time to prepare for the interviews by reflecting on their motivation and passion for IT. It’s also helpful to explore our webinar and read through the stories of our trainees on the website to get a better sense of what to expect. If you have any questions about the traineeship or the process, feel free to reach out to us at recruitment@motopp.nl – we're happy to help! About Us Motopp strives for equal opportunities for everyone.

Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.
 Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss—from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.

You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.

 Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
 Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features
 Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors
 Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
 Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
 Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum Requirements 
 7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety

Job Description: 
 Airbus Helicopters, a division of Airbus, is a global leader in the civil and military rotorcraft market. 
 Its mission is to provide civil and military helicopter solutions to its customers who serve and protect citizens, save lives and safely carry passengers in highly demanding environments. 
 Airbus Helicopters masters the complete helicopter value chain, from design and development, to industrialisation, production and support and services. It aims to ensure safety, quality, competitiveness and mission availability. 
 Airbus Helicopters España S.A. (AHE) integrates the Rotorcraft activities in Spain being a tractor company of other Spanish entities that participate in the Rotatory wing Aircraft Industry.
 EBSTIF perform Design and Stress activities participating in all the phases of the product, from specification to customer in-service support: conceptual and detail design, support to production (non-conformity assessment, generation of documentation needed for manufacturing, etc.), support to testing activities, generation of evidences for certification/qualification purposes and costumer support.
 In this context, EBSTIF is looking for candidates with:
 - Ability to design Helicopter structure components and assemblies that are optimized in terms of weight, cost, performance,production/assembly requirements while highest safety of the Product is assured using appropriate design tools.
 - Ability to verify the compliance of a detailed design solution toward baseline of validated requirements for a single sub-system / equipment / component / module.
 - Ability to develop modifications and retrofits within timescales as part of an integrated, multidisciplinary team.
 - Ability to adapt design solutions to real Helicopter configuration in a brief period of time
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and requirements. 
 - An innovative mindset and a natural curiosity about new technology. 
 Technical skills 
 - Mandatory: 5 years of experience in Composite and Metallic Helicopter Structure Design, CATIA V5, Microsoft Office user, Configuration management (VPM), Change management (ECR/ECP management), Knowledge of AH Manufacturing processes
 - Desirable: CATIA V4, Composite repair design
 - Ability to communicate technical subjects effectively and accurately to non-specialists.
 - Technical team lead experience would be a plus
 Soft skills 
 - Team spirit
 - English: advanced level. French: valuable
 - Proactive person with continuous improvement spirit
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 - Open and curious mindset as well as a practical and agile approach

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Wind tunnel model designer and stress calculation specialist (f/m) to join our Flight Physics / Aerodynamics department based in Toulouse , France. 
 You will be part of a team developing sophisticated wind tunnel models for research and development programmes. As part of the Wind Tunnel Technology team, you will be involved in designing and manufacturing aerodynamic test models aiming at delivering accurate aerodynamic data and airflow pattern evaluations for tests at Airbus and external wind tunnels. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 Design wind tunnel models using Catia V5 while ensuring efficient manufacturing, assembly & instrumentation integration. 
 Perform structural analyses of wind tunnel models primarily using the Catia FEM module and hand calculations. 
 Liaise closely with suppliers to secure on-time, on-cost delivery and manufacturability of components. 
 Lead and coordinate tasks for other designers within the internal team and the external supply chain. 
 Define and optimize aerodynamic testing facilities and techniques in collaboration with programme stakeholders. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Master degree in aeronautics, specialised in mechanical engineering. 
 This position requires at least 5 years of experience in an industrial environment. 
 Hands-on mechanical CAD design skills, ideally in Catia V5. 
 Structural analysis expertise via Finite Element Analysis (Catia FEM module) and hand calculations. 
 Knowledge of design for manufacture (DFM) of metallic structures (composites know-how is a plus). 
 Familiarity with aerodynamic testing and wind tunnel terminology would be an advantage. 
 Advanced level both in French and in English.

Job Description: 
 Envolez-vous avec Airbus Helicopters ! 
 Airbus Helicopters recherche un Ingénieur Systèmes pour l’architecture des données de Maintenance (f/h) pour rejoindre le Maintenance et Operations sol basé à Marignane, France . 
 Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères. 
 Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement. 
 Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères. 
 Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g 
 Vos futures missions : 
 En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers la définition des activités de Maintenance sur hélicoptères chez nos clients. 
 Les opérations de maintenance sur les hélicoptères sont des activités clés pour les clients d'Airbus. Par conséquent, la charge de travail de maintenance doit être optimisée afin de maximiser la disponibilité de la flotte d'hélicoptères et de répondre aux attentes des clients. 
 Pour concrétiser cette ambition, et dans un environnement où des solutions basées sur les données sont nécessaires, un poste d'Ingénieur en architecture des données de maintenance vient de s'ouvrir au sein d'Airbus Helicopters à Marignane. 
 Vous intégrerez le département « Maintenance & Ground Operations » (Maintenance et Opérations au sol) du bureau d'études d'Airbus Helicopters, et ferez partie de l'équipe transverse « Maintenance Data Management ». 
 L'objectif de cette équipe est de définir et de mettre en œuvre des solutions au sol optimisées et basées sur les données d'hélicoptères pour nos utilisateurs finaux de maintenance, ainsi de soutenir les offres de services connectés d'Airbus Helicopters. L'équipe « Maintenance & Ground Operations » est basée à Marignane (France) et à Donauwörth (Allemagne) ; les deux équipes travaillent en étroite collaboration pour harmoniser les méthodes et partager les expériences. 
 Missions et responsabilités 
 Vos principales missions seront : 
 Contribuer à la définition de la politique de produit des solutions de maintenance d'hélicoptères basées sur les données avioniques. 
 Piloter le concept d'utilisation de l'avionique en maintenance pour les hélicoptères civils et militaires en développement, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec : Les responsables du support produit (Product Support Officers) et l'architecte de maintenance de chaque hélicoptère concerné. 
 Les équipes d'essais en vol d'Airbus Helicopters et les équipes CAMO en tant que « voix » internes des clients. 
 Les responsables « Santé et Utilisation » (Health and Usage). 
 Les responsables de la gestion des pannes (Failure management). 
 Les architectes avioniques embarqués. 
 Soutenir la construction d'offres futures basées sur les données de maintenance des hélicoptères. 
 Soutenir le développement de produits au sol impliqués dans la maintenance et basés sur les données des hélicoptères. 
 Vous ferez le lien entre les besoins des clients et les équipes techniques, en traduisant la stratégie et les processus métier en une architecture logique pour le système d'information : 
 Modéliser la circulation des informations et des flux de travail au sein de l'organisation. 
 Définir ce que le système doit faire (règles métier, cas d'utilisation, dépendances) et garantir la cohérence globale de la solution. 
 Transformer des exigences complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires pour les équipes de développement. 
 Garantir que les développements servent activement la vision stratégique globale. 
 Compétences et qualifications requises 
 Vous êtes ingénieur systèmes ou avionique avec 5 à 10 ans d'expérience. 
 Vous avez de l'expérience en maintenance aéronautique. 
 Vous avez des connaissances sur les opérations et missions d'hélicoptères. 
 Vous êtes capable de naviguer dans des environnements complexes avec de multiples parties prenantes tout en gardant un état d'esprit centré sur le client. 
 Vous possédez des compétences d'écoute active associées à une communication persuasive. 
 Vous êtes autonome, organisé et résilient pour mener à bien des projets de bout en bout, et vous possédez de solides compétences en gestion de projet. 
 Un anglais courant est indispensable pour évoluer dans cet environnement international.
