items.desc: Role Summary The Senior AI Engineer leads technical design and delivery of AI automation across multiple Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows and services. You will remain hands-on while shaping technical approach, resolving ambiguous requirements, and building capabilities other engineers can reuse. You will partner across teams to improve investigation quality and response time and establish engineering standards. What You Will Do Lead complex initiatives spanning diverse security services teams; resolve design tradeoffs and implement critical components using large language models (LLMs), agents, and retrieval pipelines. Define reusable architecture for agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and tool integrations; choose deterministic or model-driven approaches based on evidence, risk, and cost. Establish evaluation methods and release criteria across workflows, covering factual accuracy, reliability, false positives, and regressions against validated evidence. Design consistent controls for least-privilege access, sensitive data, prompt injection, output validation, and analyst approval of high-impact response actions. Lead SIEM, SOAR, XDR/EDR, threat intelligence, and case management integration design; address scale, API failures, and dependencies across services. Improve shared Python components, testing, CI/CD, observability, and rollback practices; lead design reviews and coach engineers on difficult implementation decisions. Own reliability and measurable outcomes across related workflows, using investigation quality, analyst time saved, success rates, latency, and cost to guide improvements. Shape priorities with Security Operations, Threat Research, Data Science, and DevOps; coordinate technical dependencies, resolve production issues, and document architecture and operating standards. What You Will Bring 7+ years building production software, including 2+ years with LLMs, agents, or applied ML; 1+ year in or alongside a SOC or security team. Deep Python and API engineering skills; experience evaluating providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic and open-source models for production use. A record of leading architecture and delivery across multiple workflows or services, with reusable designs adopted by other engineers. Experience setting AI evaluation and release criteria, diagnosing systemic failure modes, and balancing quality, security, latency, and cost. Strong security operations knowledge and experience designing secure integrations, evidence handling, and appropriate analyst oversight for automated response. Experience designing and operating distributed or event-driven cloud services, including testing, CI/CD, observability, resilience, and production of incident resolution. Ability to turn ambiguous needs into technical plans, influence decisions across teams, and coach senior engineers while remaining hands-on. Experience with SQL, Taegis, Sigma detection rules, or mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK. Experience with vector databases, hybrid retrieval, model fine-tuning, or agent orchestration frameworks. items.card: you will own detection models end to end, from the first look at an emerging pattern through feature design, training, shadow evaluation, production launch and the weekly performance review. items.desc:
Own the detection models and the measurement science that find fraudulent and compromised AWS accounts in real time. Join a team of scientists and engineers whose analysis decides how fraud is detected and stopped, and how fast.
The AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention organization keeps AWS a safe place to build for millions of customers. Our team owns the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS. Account compromise is the case where a legitimate customer's credentials are stolen or exposed and an attacker uses the account to run unauthorized workloads. Fraud is the case where an account exists to consume resources with no intent to pay. Most accounts our models score belong to legitimate customers, so every decision has to stop fraud while leaving their work undisturbed. As a Data Scientist you will own detection models end to end, from the first look at an emerging pattern through feature design, training, shadow evaluation, production launch and the weekly performance review. You will define how we measure ourselves: precision by outcome, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, and the cost a model prevented.
- Own models that detect and block fraudulent activity in real time, protecting customers and AWS.
- Turn a pattern spotted in a handful of accounts into a model that screens millions.
- Define the metrics your models and systems are measured by and discuss them in weekly and monthly business reviews.
- End-to-end ownership, from the first signal to the enforcement action and the cleanup after it.
Key job responsibilities
- Own detection models and rules end to end: frame the problem with partners, source and engineer features from large-scale activity, sign-in and usage data, train and validate, run shadow evaluations, launch, and monitor performance after launch.
- Investigate new fraud and compromise patterns as they emerge, quantify their scale and design the detection response, from a fast rule to a trained model, with the trade-off between speed and precision stated.
- Define and audit the metrics that measure our systems: outcome-based precision and recall, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, prevented cost. Own the analysis behind weekly and monthly business reviews.
- Evaluate agentic and LLM-based systems: build labeled evaluation sets, measure error rates in both directions, and set the thresholds under which automation is allowed to act.
- Extend detection to new AWS services as they launch, including AI services where spend accrues in minutes.
- Write clear technical documents for scientists and for non-technical partners in operations, engineering and leadership, and present them in science reviews.
- Mentor junior scientists and analysts on method, and help interview for the team.
A day in the life
You begin with the performance review of the models you own: what they caught, what was later overturned, and what slipped past every layer. You pull the misses, find that three share a pattern you have not seen before, size it in the data, write a shadow-mode rule, and put a one-page analysis in front of the team with the precision you expect and the cost of waiting for a full model. In the team's planning session for the next quarter, that analysis becomes a proposal for a new model and you make the case for its place on the roadmap against the other layers of the detection stack. You also audit the cases your agentic system resolved on its own and adjust its evaluation set and thresholds. You use AI coding assistants daily, for SQL, Python and documentation, and you check their work. Your stakeholders are the fraud engineering teams that power your models, the teams that act on their decisions, the AWS service teams whose customers we protect, and the leadership that reads your numbers every week.
About the team
We are a team of scientists, analysts, software and data engineers and a program manager, with close partners across AWS Fraud Prevention worldwide. We own the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS, from signal and detection through decision, enforcement, cleanup and reinstatement. We follow a layered detection strategy with online and offline machine learning models and agentic investigation systems. Our models also run in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, where they must work under EU data-residency constraints.
We invest in the growth of every team member through mentorship, careful code and document reviews, and projects sized to stretch you. We celebrate promotions, and new members ship their first project within their first quarter.

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a CAMO Services Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). 
 The department is in charge of ensuring the continuing airworthiness, maintenance status, technical records and configuration of customer aircraft in accordance with applicable regulations, approved procedures and contractual requirements. 
 The role covers three main areas: Airworthiness, Review Certificate (ARC) support, second-hand aircraft transitions and Entry Into Service (EIS) projects.
 RESPONSABILITIES 
 Support the control of continuing airworthiness, aircraft maintenance status, configuration and technical records.
 Perform technical and documentary reviews and identify, report and follow up discrepancies.
 Support ARC, aircraft transition and EIS activities while ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and contractual requirements.
 Provide technical support to customers and internal stakeholders and contribute to safe, efficient and cost-effective fleet management.
 MAIN ACTIVITIES 
 1. AIRCRAFT TRANSITIONS
 Support aircraft acquisition, delivery, acceptance, lease transition and redelivery projects through detailed documentary reviews.
 Assess aircraft historical records, maintenance status, AD/SB/modification/repair compliance and configuration.
 Verify the status and recording of ADs, SBs, modifications, repairs and applicable engineering documentation.
 Review records for aircraft, engines, APU, landing gear and relevant components.
 Manage discrepancy reports, support records handover and identify technical or contractual risks affecting acceptance or redelivery.
 Support maintenance planning, technical queries and the resolution of documentary discrepancies.
 2. AIRWORTHINESS REVIEW ACTIVITIES
 Review aircraft and component records for airworthiness compliance.
 Verify maintenance status, mandatory requirements, aircraft configuration and life-limited components.
 Identify and manage findings and discrepancies, coordinating their resolution with customers and relevant stakeholders.
 Support ARC procedures and associated documentary activities within the individuals assigned authority and organizational approvals.
 3. CAMO ENTRY INTO SERVICE (EIS)
 Support service preparation, customer coordination and analysis of requirements and documentation.
 Support the development or tailoring of key CAMO processes: CAMO organisation, Operator Maintenance Programme, Maintenance Control and Fleet Management, Configuration Control and Maintenance Planning.
 Support the development of procedures for Reliability Monitoring, Mandatory Engineering DocumentControl, Non-mandatory SB Policy, Structural Damage Chart Management and ARC.
 Prepare high-quality technical deliverables and presentations and support knowledge transfer to customers.
 Candidates must meet all legal and professional requirements for the role. 
 SKILLS 
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification.
 Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in CAMO, continuing airworthiness management, or aircraft maintenance engineering.

Location: Amsterdam, Hullenbergweg 81-135 (Office), Netherlands 
 Job Title: AI Platform Engineer 
 Locatie: Amsterdam - Hybride (met een team bijeenkomst in Hengelo kantoor per week)
 Talen: Nederlands & Engels
 Dienstverband: Fulltime
 Role Overview 
 Ben jij een DevOps of Platform Engineer die de sprong wil maken naar de wereld van Generative AI, binnen een van de meest hoogbeveiligde software-omgevingen van Nederland?
 Bij Thales Nederland bouwen we in Hengelo aan onze eigen geavanceerde AI-ecosystemen die draaien in volledig air-gapped infrastructuren . Als AI Platform Engineer word jij de spin in het web die ervoor zorgt dat onze software engineers en systemen veilig gebruik kunnen maken van lokale taalmodellen, geavanceerde multi-agent netwerken en systemen voor contextgebaseerde informatie-ophaling. Omdat we geen gebruik kunnen maken van publieke cloud-API's, bouwen, hosten en beheren we alles zélf on-premise op onze eigen high-performance GPU-clusters.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Beheer van AI-Containerapplicaties: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het deployen, updaten en onderhouden van cruciale AI-hulpprogramma's en developer-tools binnen de on-premise container-orkestratieplatforms. Je zorgt voor optimale performance, resource-allocatie en hoge beschikbaarheid voor de development teams.
 Air-Gapped RAG & Codebase Infrastructure: Je bouwt en onderhoudt de on-premise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) infrastructuur. Je zorgt dat applicaties via lokale data-pijplijnen, tekst-segmentatie (chunking) en vector-indexering veilig en razendsnel context kunnen ophalen uit onze interne codebases.
 On-Premise Model Routing & Lifecycle: Je richt de tooling in voor lokale model-serving en helpt bij het bouwen van een flexibele routing-laag. Hierdoor kunnen applicaties binnen het afgesloten netwerk dynamisch schakelen tussen verschillende lokale modellen op basis van de complexiteit van de specifieke taak.
 Agent Orchestration & Tooling: Je ondersteunt het opzetten van lokale raamwerken voor multi-agent systemen (zoals gespecialiseerde code-, architectuur- en debugging-agents). Je helpt bij het integreren van lokale geheugensystemen en interfaces waarmee agents externe tools kunnen aanroepen.
 Air-Gapped Observability: Je implementeert monitoring- en tracing-dashboards die volledig lokaal binnen het netwerk draaien. Je meet hiermee het token-verbruik, de verwerkingstijd (latency) en infrastructuurkosten per team of gebruiker, zonder dat er data naar buiten lekt.
 Strikte AI Safety & Security Rails: Samen met onze security-experts implementeer je harde vangrails en beveiligingsinfrastructuren om kwaadwillige invoer (prompt-injecties) te voorkomen en te garanderen dat agents zich strikt houden aan datacompartimentering en autorisatieniveaus.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Ervaring met On-Premise & DevOps: Goede ervaring met Linux-omgevingen, containerisatie en container-orkestratie in een on-premise datacenter-setting.
 Software Engineering: Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python (ervaring met andere systeemtalen of scripting is een pre) en ervaring met het bouwen en integreren van lokale API's.
 GenAI Interesse & Conceptuele Kennis: Je begrijpt de theorie achter vector-indexering, embeddings en de werking van grote taalmodellen (LLM's). Je hebt hier bij voorkeur al op hobbymatige of projectmatige basis mee geëxperimenteerd met open-source middelen.
 Talen: Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
 Veiligheidsonderzoek: Aangezien je werkt aan defensie-gerelateerde projecten, is het succesvol doorlopen van een nationale veiligheidsscreening (Verklaring van Geen Bezwaar) een vereiste.
 Wat Thales biedt 
 Een unieke kans om te pionieren met state-of-the-art GenAI-technologie in een high-security enterprise-omgeving.
 Een flexibele hybride werkomgeving met een gezonde balans tussen thuiswerken en samenwerken op het High Tech Systems Park in Hengelo.
 Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO Metalelektro, waaronder een zeer competitief salaris en 40 vakantiedagen per jaar (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen).
 Ruimte en budget om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen tot een expert in AI-infrastructuur.
 #LI-NB1

Job Description: 
 Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Aerospazio, Difesa & Sicurezza. Con oltre 60.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una significativa presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, e Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici internazionali è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese. Innovazione, ricerca continua, digitalizzazione e sostenibilità sono i pilastri del suo business nel mondo.
 Leonardo è uno dei partner industriali strategici del programma GCAP (Global Combat Air Programme), insieme alla britannica BAE Systems e alla giapponese Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, finalizzato allo sviluppo e alla realizzazione di un sistema aereo di nuova generazione, definito come “sistema di sistemi”. Impiegato per operazioni multidominio in ambito difesa, il sistema sarà caratterizzato da una “core platform” connessa con altri sistemi periferici “adjuncts”, pilotati e non pilotati.
 Il programma, tra i più sfidanti e avveniristici per l’industria dell’aerospazio e della difesa, guiderà la rivoluzione tecnologica che caratterizzerà il settore nei prossimi cinquant’anni. Una sfida finalizzata a rafforzare la sovranità tecnologica e industriale dei paesi coinvolti, perché punta a identificare e a rendere disponibili quelle tecnologie innovative, dette abilitanti, che assicureranno il salto generazionale, generando ritorni positivi e progresso economico e sociale per l’intero sistema Paese, a beneficio delle nuove generazioni.
 Le risorse che lavoreranno all’interno di questo programma avranno l’opportunità di accedere ad un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto internazionale e tecnologicamente avanzato.
 Nell'ambito dell'ingegneria della Div Aeronautica, B.U. Velivoli, nella U.O. Gcap Chief Engoneering, stiamo ricercando un/a system modeller/system engineer presso la sede di Torino.
 La risorsa contribuirà allo sviluppo del design del sistema GCAP attraverso le seguenti attività:
 - Design del sistema GCAP, i.e. design a livello velivolo e Through Life Support dello stesso

items.desc:
How do you turn engineering changes into well-managed projects and continuously better manufacturing processes?
 As our Product and Process Engineer based in Tullamore, Ireland , you will take ownership of post-launch engineering and Product Lifecycle Management activities, coordinating changes across products, materials and manufacturing processes.
 With around 90% of the role focused on project and process management, you will bring structure to complex engineering initiatives, align cross-functional stakeholders and keep projects moving toward their goals. In return for your engineering expertise, strong organization and project leadership skills, you will have the opportunity to drive meaningful improvements across products and manufacturing processes while working in an international environment.
 More about the role 
 Lead and coordinate post-launch and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) activities, ensuring engineering projects and changes are delivered effectively and on time.
 Manage cross-functional engineering projects involving changes to products, raw materials and manufacturing processes, bringing together stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, R&D, Procurement and other functions.
 Own and coordinate Engineering Change activities, including Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), supplier Product Change Notices and the associated documentation and ERP processes.
 Drive continuous improvement across products and manufacturing processes using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to improve quality, efficiency, cost and delivery.
 Identify and lead cost-saving and Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives across products and production processes.
 Maintain accurate product master data and ensure engineering changes are properly documented, implemented and communicated.
 Manage multiple priorities simultaneously, bringing structure to change, keeping stakeholders aligned and ensuring teams remain focused on the most important project deliverables.
 More about you 
 Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering or a related engineering discipline – an engineering degree is essential for this position.
 At least 3–5 years of relevant experience within Manufacturing, Process, Industrial or Product Engineering, ideally in a production environment.
 Strong background in project management , with demonstrated experience independently coordinating complex, cross-functional engineering projects and leading change.
 Practical experience with Lean and/or Six Sigma methodologies and a track record of applying continuous improvement principles in an engineering or manufacturing environment.
 Experience with Engineering Change Management and working with ERP systems; experience with SAP, JD Edwards or similar platforms is an advantage.
 Highly organized, autonomous and solution-oriented, with strong communication skills and the ability to prioritize, adapt to change and keep teams and stakeholders focused.
 Fluent English and confidence working across functions and cultures; AutoCAD, automation experience, project management certification, Lean/Six Sigma certification and German are considered advantages.

items.desc:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 At NVIDIA, we are helping public-sector organizations use accelerated computing and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve government services, research and national capabilities. The Global Public Sector team is seeking a Solutions Architect based in France to turn sovereign AI priorities into scalable technical solutions. This hands-on role collaborates with solutions partners, government entities, research organizations, integrators and NVIDIA engineering and product teams to develop architectures, build proofs of concept and move validated workflows toward production. The work spans generative and agentic AI, model adaptation, GPU-accelerated inference, containerized platforms and machine learning operations. Travel within France and occasionally across Europe may be required for customer engagements.
 What you’ll be doing: 
 Translate public-sector mission goals, data constraints and operational requirements into technical architectures for generative and agentic AI solutions.
 Collaborate with partners to build and demonstrate working prototypes using Python and PyTorch. Then define practical paths from proof of concept to production deployment on NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms.
 Build containerized deployment patterns using Kubernetes, including model serving, scaling, integration and lifecycle considerations for customer environments.
 We lead hands-on discovery sessions, technical workshops and field trials with customer engineers and ecosystem partners, with clear success criteria and measurable technical outcomes.
 Guide model adaptation and inference workflows for large language models, then solve performance, compatibility and deployment issues with partner and technical teams.
 We create reusable notebooks, code samples, architecture guidance and technical presentations that connect customer requirements with implementable solutions.
 Bring structured customer and partner feedback to NVIDIA product and engineering teams to inform product requirements and remove adoption barriers.
 What we need to see: 
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Statistics, Physics, Mathematics or another relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.
 5 or more years of meaningful experience in solutions architecture, technical consulting, software development or a closely related technical role.
 Strong hands-on programming skills in Python and practical experience using PyTorch to build, test and debug machine learning workflows.
 Proven work with generative or agentic AI, including domain adaptation or deployment of agent-based solutions.
 Practical experience packaging and deploying AI applications with containers and Kubernetes.
 Ability to turn sophisticated customer requirements into clear solution architectures, working prototypes, and ready-to-implement technical plans.
 Clear written, verbal and technical presentation skills, including the ability to communicate through code, notebooks, architecture documents and workshops.
 Proven teamwork across customer, engineering, research, product, sales and partner teams in an international environment.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Development experience with NVIDIA GPUs, software libraries or high-performance computing systems.
 Applied knowledge of continuous integration and delivery, AI model lifecycle management, and repeatable deployment pipelines for AI systems.
 Technical depth in one or more areas such as multimodal AI, computer vision, edge deployment, digital twins or data analytics.
 Consulting or delivery experience with government customers, sovereign technology programs or AI startups.
 Professional communication skills in French and English; additional Western European languages are a plus.
 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

69,000 EUR – 119,600 EUR for Level 3; and 87,750 EUR – 152,100 EUR for Level 4.

items.desc: IRB Barcelona is seeking a proactive and motivated AI Software Engineer to join the Biomedical Genomics Lab (BBGLab) led by Dr. Núria López-Bigas at IRB Barcelona (bbglab.irbbarcelona.org). The lab studies the mutations and mechanisms that drive cancer development, and translates this knowledge into computational tools for research and precision cancer medicine. AI is becoming a central part of this work, both to accelerate scientific discovery and to make the lab's tools more useful to researchers and clinicians. The successful candidate will join a team of bioinformaticians and software engineers to build AI-powered systems, with a strong focus on LLMs and agentic systems. Current projects include an agentic AI system for human-AI scientific collaboration, co-developed with the lab's researchers to uncover the molecular mechanisms of tumorigenesis across genes and tissues, and a chatbot embedded in the Cancer Genome Interpreter to support the interpretation of mutations. The role is mainly focused on engineering, with some support to research projects. Prior experience in cancer genomics or bioinformatics is not essential, but it is considered an asset; we are looking for someone curious about the biology behind our work and willing to learn it. This position is financed by the project “Data-driven cancer genome interpretation for personalised cancer treatment” from the European Union (Acronim: CGI-Clinics. Grant Agreement: 101057509). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, deploy and maintain LLM-based and agentic applications for the lab's projects, such as the agentic system for scientific collaboration and the Cancer Genome Interpreter chatbot. Integrate AI components with the lab's tools, databases and knowledge sources. Evaluate and improve the quality and reliability of LLM-based systems (prompting, context management, tool use, evaluation). Apply software engineering best practices: version control, testing, code review and documentation. Keep up to date with advances in AI and propose how to apply them to the lab's projects. Provide technical support to research projects, participate in project meetings, and contribute to technical reports. YOU HAVE Highly proactive profile, with a strong willingness to learn and to stay constantly up to date with a rapidly changing AI landscape (models, frameworks, tools and AI coding assistants). Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Sciences, Physics, Mathematics or similar. At least 1 year of experience in software development. Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems (e.g. LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, RAG, tool use, agents). Strong Python programming skills and familiarity with software development best practices. Experience with collaborative software development using Git and platforms such as GitHub. Excellent English (written and spoken). Excellent communication skills and ability to work within a collaborative team. Strong analytical skills, ability to work independently, and adaptability to new challenges. YOU MIGHT ALSO HAVE Extensive, proven experience building LLM-based applications and agentic systems (RAG, MCP, multi-agent frameworks, evaluation). Experience with AI coding assistants and modern AI development workflows. Experience with machine learning or deep learning. Experience in bioinformatics or cancer genomics, particularly in NGS data analysis. Experience with pipelines (Nextflow), high-performance computing, containers (Docker, Singularity), cloud environments (e.g. AWS), and databases. Experience with full-stack development. A Master’s degree or a PhD in a related field. Experience working in international teams. Our mission is to carry out research of excellence to cure cancer and other diseases linked to ageing. items.desc: Votre mission Intégré(e) à nos équipes Cyber, vous travaillerez au contact des experts techniques et des métiers pour identifier des besoins concrets et les transformer en solutions. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : comprendre et formaliser les besoins des équipes internes et de nos clients ; analyser les usages et identifier les tâches pouvant être automatisées ou augmentées par l'IA ; réaliser un benchmark des solutions IA du marché et sélectionner les technologies les plus pertinentes en fonction des cas d'usage ; traduire un besoin utilisateur en spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques ; concevoir et développer des outils, assistants ou agents combinant Cyber, IA et automatisation ; exploiter des API et développer des automatisations en Python, PowerShell ou Bash ; tester les solutions auprès des utilisateurs et mesurer leur valeur ajoutée ; étudier leur sécurité, leur robustesse, leur maintenabilité et leur capacité à passer à l'échelle ; pour les solutions les plus prometteuses, réfléchir à leur industrialisation et à leur transformation en offre commercialisable auprès de nos clients. Quelques terrains d'expérimentation Selon les besoins identifiés, vous pourriez par exemple imaginer : un assistant Cyber intelligent facilitant l'accès à la connaissance et aux procédures ; un outil d'analyse et de priorisation des vulnérabilités ; des agents permettant d'automatiser certaines tâches ou contrôles Cyber ; un dispositif permettant de collecter, analyser et restituer automatiquement des données de sécurité ; un outil générant des rapports et recommandations personnalisés à partir de données techniques ; ou encore un nouveau service IA répondant à un besoin Cyber identifié auprès de nos clients. Nous ne vous imposons pas la solution : nous attendons aussi de vous que vous nous aidiez à l'imaginer. Le profil que nous recherchons Vous préparez un Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou Master, avec une dominante Cybersécurité, Informatique, IA/Data, Cloud ou Infrastructure. Au-delà de votre formation, nous recherchons un profil disposant déjà d'une bonne culture de l'écosystème IA et de ses usages. Vous connaissez ou avez déjà expérimenté plusieurs technologies du marché : LLM, IA générative, agents IA, RAG, API, automatisation, outils no-code/low-code… Vous êtes capable de comprendre les possibilités mais également les limites d'une technologie, et surtout d'identifier le bon outil pour répondre au bon besoin. Vous avez également : de solides bases en Cyber, systèmes et réseaux ; une pratique du développement, idéalement Python ; une bonne capacité d'écoute, d'analyse et de reformulation du besoin ; une sensibilité aux problématiques utilisateurs et clients ; suffisamment de curiosité pour explorer de nouvelles technologies et challenger l'existant. Mais surtout, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui ne se contente pas de développer ce qu'on lui demande. Vous aimez comprendre le besoin, challenger la demande, proposer une solution puis la concrétiser. Et si votre PFE permettait de transformer une idée IA en une nouvelle solution Cyber pour nos clients ? L’intelligence artificielle transforme les pratiques de la cybersécurité : automatisation des tâches, analyse de données, qualification des vulnérabilités, assistants intelligents, génération de rapports, exploitation de la connaissance… Chez Axians, nous souhaitons aller plus loin : identifier les usages réellement créateurs de valeur, développer les outils associés et imaginer comment certains d’entre eux pourraient devenir demain de véritables solutions commercialisables auprès de nos clients. Votre challenge sera donc autant technologique que métier et business. Dans un monde en évolution permanente, VINCI Energies accélère la transition environnementale en concrétisant deux mutations majeures, numérique et énergétique. Ses équipes déploient des technologies et des solutions multitechniques sur mesure, de la conception à la réalisation, l'exploitation et la maintenance. Ancrées dans leurs territoires, agiles et innovantes, ses plus 2 100 entreprises sont au cœur des choix énergétiques de leurs clients, de leurs infrastructures et de leurs process pour les rendre chaque jour plus fiables, plus efficients et plus durables. VINCI Energies vise une performance globale, attentive à la planète, utile aux hommes et solidaire des populations.

items.desc: Stage BAC+5 - Data Science - Solutions logicielles et data pour la spectrométrie de masse - F/H/D Localisation: Marcy l'Etoile, France Type de Contrat: Stage Fonction: Bioscience R&D Acteur mondial dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro depuis plus de 60 ans, bioMérieux offre des solutions de diagnostic qui déterminent l’origine d’une maladie ou d’une contamination pour améliorer la santé des patients et assurer la sécurité des consommateurs. Rejoindre bioMérieux, c’est choisir une société familiale et humaniste, portée par une vision long terme, au service de la santé publique dans le monde. Chaque stagiaire ou alternant est accompagné par un tuteur expérimenté et formé. Il ou elle bénéficie d’un suivi et d’une évaluation l’aidant à progresser et à se préparer à la vie professionnelle. Chez bioMérieux, les ingénieurs du département Data Science, rattachés à l’Unité R&D, contribuent à la conception, au développement et au support de systèmes de diagnostic in vitro innovants et d’une façon plus générale, des outils et des environnements informatiques de travail nécessaires à ces développements. Quelle est votre mission chez bioMérieux ? Sujet : Développement et déploiement d'applications d'IA générative au sein du département Data Science Le stage portera sur différentes thématiques autour de l’IA générative et de leurs applications possibles aux solutions bioMérieux, et au domaine du diagnostic in-vitro en général. Un intérêt particulier sera porté sur les modèles de fondations et les outils qui permettent d’extraire de manière automatique des informations à partir de documents contenant des connaissances métiers et de les structurer. Vos missions principales seront : de mener une veille scientifique et technologique sur les outils IA générative ; de contribuer au développement d’outils permettant d’extraire de l’information à partir de données internes à bioMérieux ; de déployer ce type de modèles sur notre infrastructure de calcul interne ou sur AWS ; de partager les connaissances au sein des équipes projets multidisciplinaires et dans le département Data Science, en particulier avec les groupes d’Excellence Fonctionnelle concernés. Qui êtes-vous ? Vous préparez une formation de niveau BAC+5, vous êtes actuellement en Master ou en Ecole d’Ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en Data Science/ Informatique. Vous disposez d’une expérience solide en Analyse de Données. Vous êtes à l’aise avec le langage de programmation Python, et programmez efficacement en suivant les bonnes pratiques DevOps. Vous avez idéalement une première expérience avec les modèles d’IA générative et les frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, HuggingFace, LlamaIndex). Vous connaissez les bases de la création d’images Docker et de leur déploiement sur un cluster Kubernetes. Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux(se), et faites preuve d’une curiosité technique et scientifique. Vous avez le sens de la communication écrite et orale dans un environnement multidisciplinaire. Vous êtes intéressé(e) par le domaine des biotechnologies et des sciences du vivant. Vous possédez un bon niveau d’anglais vous permettant d’échanger et de travailler efficacement au quotidien. Stage basé à Marcy l’Etoile accessible en transports en commun via la ligne 98 ou 98E de Gorge de Loup. Dates : Février 2026 pour une durée de 6 mois. At NVIDIA, we are helping public-sector organizations use accelerated computing and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve government services, research and national capabilities. The Global Public Sector team is seeking a Solutions Architect based in France to turn sovereign AI priorities into scalable technical solutions. This hands-on role collaborates with solutions partners, government entities, research organizations, integrators and NVIDIA engineering and product teams to develop architectures, build proofs of concept and move validated workflows toward production. The work spans generative and agentic AI, model adaptation, GPU-accelerated inference, containerized platforms and machine learning operations. Collaborate with partners to build and demonstrate working prototypes using Python and PyTorch. Then define practical paths from proof of concept to production deployment on NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms. Build containerized deployment patterns using Kubernetes, including model serving, scaling, integration and lifecycle considerations for customer environments. We lead hands-on discovery sessions, technical workshops and field trials with customer engineers and ecosystem partners, with clear success criteria and measurable technical outcomes. Guide model adaptation and inference workflows for large language models, then solve performance, compatibility and deployment issues with partner and technical teams. We create reusable notebooks, code samples, architecture guidance and technical presentations that connect customer requirements with implementable solutions. Bring structured customer and partner feedback to NVIDIA product and engineering teams to inform product requirements and remove adoption barriers. What we need to see: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Statistics, Physics, Mathematics or another relevant engineering field or equivalent experience. 5 or more years of meaningful experience in solutions architecture, technical consulting, software development or a closely related technical role. Strong hands-on programming skills in Python and practical experience using PyTorch to build, test and debug machine learning workflows. Technical depth in one or more areas such as multimodal AI, computer vision, edge deployment, digital twins or data analytics. Consulting or delivery experience with government customers, sovereign technology programs or AI startups. Professional communication skills in French and English; additional Western European languages are a plus. Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. items.desc: Poste : Dans le cadre du développement d?une plateforme d?intelligence artificielle générative et agentique, nous recherchons un développeur Fullstack senior Java / React pour concevoir et industrialiser les interfaces et les services associés. La plateforme permettra aux utilisateurs d?interagir en langage naturel avec des agents IA, d?automatiser certaines tâches et de bénéficier d?une aide à la décision. Elle devra également s?intégrer au système d?information de l?entreprise : applications métiers, authentification et sources de données. Le projet présente des enjeux importants de sécurité, de fiabilité et de passage à l?échelle, avec une population cible pouvant atteindre 80 000 utilisateurs. Le c?ur du besoin porte sur le backend Java et son industrialisation dans un environnement on-premise contraint en ressources RAM et CPU. La capacité à intervenir sur le frontend est également attendue, mais reste secondaire par rapport à l?expertise backend. Vos Mission : Concevoir et développer les services backend Java, les API REST/GraphQL et les intégrations avec les LLM, les agents IA et les applications du système d?information. Contribuer aux interfaces React/TypeScript : interfaces conversationnelles, tableaux de bord, notifications et gestion des permissions. Assurer la performance et la fiabilité de la solution : profilage, optimisation RAM/CPU, dimensionnement, tests automatisés et tests de charge. Participer à l?industrialisation et à la sécurisation : Docker, CI/CD, supervision, authentification, contrôle des accès et préparation des déploiements on-premise. Produire la documentation technique et d?exploitation, et contribuer aux audits de sécurité ainsi qu?à la recette avant mise en production. Profil candidat: Vous disposez d?au moins 5 ans d?expérience en ingénierie logicielle, avec une expérience confirmée de Java en production et du développement d?applications complexes. Les compétences prioritaires sont les suivantes : Maîtrise de Java et d?un framework backend tel que Spring Boot, Quarkus ou Micronaut. Expérience des systèmes distribués et des déploiements on-premise. Compétences solides en profilage, optimisation des performances et maîtrise de la consommation RAM/CPU. Bonne pratique des API REST et/ou GraphQL, de la persistance des données et des tests automatisés. Capacité à intervenir sur React et TypeScript. Maîtrise des principes SOLID, du Clean Code et du typage strict. Expérience de Docker, des chaînes CI/CD et des mécanismes de sécurité applicative. Une expérience uniquement centrée sur le développement fonctionnel Java / React ne suffira pas : la capacité à industrialiser un backend performant, à le dimensionner et à le faire fonctionner sous contraintes de ressources constitue un critère déterminant. Les compétences complémentaires appréciées sont : Expérience des LLM, de l?IA générative ou des architectures agentiques. Connaissance de Kubernetes et des outils Prometheus, Grafana ou ELK. Pratique du Domain Driven Design ? DDD. Expérience des architectures événementielles ? Event Driven Architecture.

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale. Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées. Description du poste NEXTON recrute un Architecte Data / IA H/F , en CDI , à Paris ! Ton futur environnement de travail : Dans le cadre de la transformation en profondeur de l'écosystème SI, Data & IA d'un acteur majeur de l'énergie, nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Data & IA F/H . Ton défi : concevoir des solutions technologiques de pointe répondant aux cas d'usage métiers et IA, tout en assurant la transition harmonieuse avec le socle existant. Tes missions : Design d'Architecture End-to-End : Concevoir les architectures de données de bout en bout, couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée : ingestion, pipelines de transformation, stockage, modélisation et exposition. Architecture « Ready for Delivery » : Traduire les cas d'usage métiers, analytiques et IA en blueprints d'architecture, dossiers techniques et patterns d'implémentation directement activables par les équipes de réalisation. Intégration & Exposition : Structurer les patterns d'intégration entre les systèmes sources opérationnels, les plateformes de données et les consommateurs finaux (applications métiers, dashboards décisionnels, services d'IA). Infrastructure & Socle Technologique : Définir le design technologique en synergie avec les équipes Cloud, Infrastructure, Sécurité et Engineering, en sélectionnant et challengeant les composants les plus adaptés. Gouvernance, Sécurité & Résilience : Intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de confidentialité et de Data Governance by design , tout en garantissant des niveaux élevés de performance, d'interopérabilité et d'exploitabilité. Stratégie de Transition : Modéliser les trajectoires de migration, les phases de coexistence technique et les plans de décommissionnement des plateformes historiques. Accompagnement du Delivery : Co-construire les solutions avec les Data Engineers, Tech Leads et Product Owners, assurer les revues d'architecture et formaliser les décisions techniques (ADR, cartographies). Qualifications Expérience : De formation supérieure (Bac+5 en informatique, école d’ingénieurs ou équivalent), vous disposez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience probante en architecture de données, Data Engineering senior ou leadership technique data. Expertise Technique : Maîtrise des architectures Data modernes (Lakehouse, Modern Data Stack, architectures distribuées, Data Mesh / Data Fabric). Connaissance approfondie des environnements Cloud majeurs (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et de leurs services managés de données et d'IA. Solide maîtrise des patterns d'ingestion (batch et streaming), du processing de données, ainsi que des technologies de catalogage et de gouvernance. Expérience pratique des enjeux de migration et de transition de plateformes complexes. Qualités relationnelles : Capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques pointus auprès d'interlocuteurs variés (métiers, sécurité, delivery). Esprit critique, rigueur méthodologique et sens affirmé de la collaboration d'équipe. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ? Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année : Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours. Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences. Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser. Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir. Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce. Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté. Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous ! NEXTON

items.desc: What Do We Do? The shift to electric mobility is happening. Electra is accelerating it. Transportation is one of Europe's biggest sources of carbon emissions. Since 2021, Electra exists to make charging so simple that electric vehicles become the obvious choice for everyone. In 5 years, we've built a team of 300+ talents from 21 nationalities in 10 countries. We’ve grown into one of Europe's leading fast-charging operators by deploying fast, reliable infrastructure and user experiences across our own network, and we’re now expanding to thousands more charging points in Europe with our own eMSP. Backed by over €1 billion in funding, we’re looking for bold, passionate, collaborative talents to drive Europe’s energy transition. If that sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you! Your Missions Electra opens fast-charging stations across 10 European countries . The Rollout Department is where Electrons work from Site signature to Station opening , bringing our stations to life. Rollout operations rely on a core tool, Sitetracker (built on Salesforce) , used daily by 100+ internal users and external partners across Europe. Alongside the Rollout teams, the RolloutOps team supports and drives their operational performance across Europe. You will join this team, led by Lancelot DANNE, with a mission to build and improve processes, optimize AI, workflows, automations and integrations, and ensure high-quality, consistent data for reliable forecasting and strategic decision-making. You will lead projects that transform the way teams work : listening to users across countries, turning their challenges into solutions, delivering improvements, and ensuring their adoption. You will also develop and maintain Rollout tools and workflows (Sitetracker, Payflows, n8n, Notion, …), keeping them clean, standardized and trusted . The team is small and sees tools and AI (Anthropic solutions) as key performance levers. You will have real ownership from day one and continuously explore new solutions to help Electra become Europe's leading fast-charging network. ‍️‍️Your responsibilities Lead projects with the business Drive projects end to end , with your Team Lead: gather requirements, design solutions, build or coordinate delivery, roll them out across countries, and measure adoption. Identify operational bottlenecks in our tools and processes, and turn them into improvement projects. Ops Performance is a focus. Work closely with teams : Country Ops, Construction, Finance, Procurement, Expansion. Organize workshops, gather feedback, align priorities and provide clear updates. Contribute to partner-facing tools : the ST Connect portal and mobile app used by our external partners. Projects you could work on AI Workflows : build agents, workflows, artifacts, directly into the tools Project Managers use every day (Slack, Sitetracker, …). Salesforce (Sitetracker) ERP integrations : align items, receipts and stock across Sitetracker, SAP and Payflows. Data Consistency Contract : country-level data quality scores, automated updates and reliable forecast history. CRM for Rollout: centralize PM and partner exchanges in Sitetracker, linked to sites and projects, to open up data access and future AI use cases. Forecast conditionality: Improve Forecast models via a contextualized, site-specific forecast that accounts for every site characteristic likely to shift it, such as the DNO, the voltage level or the permit type. Enablement, Training & Knowledge Management: AI and Sitetracker. Keep tools & workflows reliable Automate wherever possible : leverage AI, Flows, validation rules, Apex and LWC to streamline operations. Administer Salesforce (Sitetracker) : automate support operations and manage users, permissions, licenses, sandboxes, releases and vendor support cases. Maintain standards : data models, naming conventions, documentation and security. Review teammates' changes through pull requests. Build & maintain integrations between Salesforce and other tools: Sitetracker, HubSpot, Payflows, Snowflake/Omni, Slack and SAP, with automated checks that catch issues before they impact country teams. Maintain country forecast templates : milestones, lead times and critical paths. Your Profile Must have 2+ years of experience as a Project Manager, Engineer, Business Analyst or in a similar role. Knowledge of AI and automation and a strong interest in applying them to business operations. GitHub & Salesforce basics : branches, pull requests. Apex, LWC, REST integrations and Salesforce CLI. Understanding of data architecture and how systems interact. Hands-on configuration experience : AI, Flows, validation rules, data models, SOQL and data loading tools. Business-facing experience : gathering requirements, running workshops, presenting solutions and driving adoption. Proactive mindset : you identify problems, propose solutions and ask for help when needed. You don't wait for a ticket. Fluent English : you'll work with teams across 10 countries. …

items.card: Your mission Shape scalable, AI-enabled enterprise software and modern architectures across SAP and non-SAP environments. You combine enterprise architecture with cloud-native technologies and modern AI architecture, establishing clear standards and reusable patterns that help our engineering teams build
items.desc: Your mission Shape scalable, AI-enabled enterprise software and modern architectures across SAP and non-SAP environments. We are looking for an experienced Enterprise & Cloud Architect to evolve our software and technology landscape. You combine enterprise architecture with cloud-native technologies and modern AI architecture, establishing clear standards and reusable patterns that help our engineering teams build better software in practice. You define and evolve our enterprise, cloud and product architecture and design modern cloud-native and SaaS architectures. You establish pragmatic engineering standards and reusable patterns for microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, Domain-Driven Design, automated testing, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, security and observability. You develop architecture patterns and guardrails for Generative AI, AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and foundation model integration, including security, data privacy, governance, monitoring and cost control. You design integration and target architectures across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP and non-SAP platforms and drive the modernization of existing applications toward modular and cloud-native architectures. You make technology decisions across Azure or AWS, SAP BTP, Kubernetes, data and AI platforms and work closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps and Security in architecture reviews. What Matters to Us You do more than create target architectures and architecture diagrams. You understand how modern, AI-enabled software is actually built and operated. You translate sound architecture and engineering principles into pragmatic solutions and provide hands-on technical guidance to help teams put them into practice. Your profile You have several years of experience as an Enterprise, Cloud, Solution or Software Architect and a strong practical understanding of modern software architecture and cloud-native development. You have solid expertise in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS as well as experience with microservices, APIs, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing and DevSecOps. You have experience with AI-enabled applications and modern AI architectures, including Generative AI, AI Agents and Retrieval-Augmented Generation, ideally using Azure AI, AWS AI Services, SAP Business AI or comparable platforms. You are familiar with SAP architectures and integrations, ideally SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP. Hands-on experience with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) and SAP BTP, Kyma runtime is a strong plus. You have successfully put engineering standards and architecture guardrails into practice and can communicate complex technical topics clearly, both with engineering teams and at a strategic level. Why us? We support mobile and flexible working, including the option to work temporarily from abroad by agreement. Our working time account gives you the flexibility to balance work and personal commitments in a way that suits your life. Our Works Council is available to provide support and advice whenever needed. 30 days of annual leave are standard for us. We support your personal and professional development through a transparent career framework as well as individual learning and development opportunities. Continuous learning is part of our company culture, which is why we actively support ongoing professional development. Through our JobRad program, you can lease a bicycle or e-bike of your choice, including more than one bike. With WellPass, you get access to a broad Germany-wide network of fitness, sports, wellness and health services. Regular team and company events strengthen our open culture and create opportunities for personal exchange. You can expect an international working environment with colleagues and customers from different countries and cultures. Our global team continues to grow. Join us and actively shape the next chapter of Implico's success story. We look forward to receiving your application, preferably online via our application portal so we can ensure a faster process. Alternatively, you are also welcome to send us your application documents by post. About us Welcome to the Implico Group! Implico is an SAP-centric software and consulting partner specializing in bulk logistics automation within SAP-led supply chain environments. The Group provides SAP-branded Solution Extensions built to extend SAP Cloud ERP and SAP supply chain processes with industry-specific automation, delivered in line with SAP‘s clean core principles. SAP S/4HANA SDM and SAP S/4HANA RFNO are an SAP-branded Solution Extensions for secondary distribution and automation management, used by distributors and fuel networks to run order to cash as one standardized chain.

items.desc: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it's Daniel Ricciardo's Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth's Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt's running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day. We're a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world's most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we'd love to explore how you can join us. Taking ownership and driving impact Being open to change and feedback Being passionate about our mission and our customers. Your Mission Join Catawiki as a UX Designer shaping the experience of buying and selling special objects, from discovery through to the experience after a sale. This role is not tied to a single product vertical: its scope can sit within Demand (buyer-side features), Supply (seller-side features) or Fulfilment (post-sale experiences, including payments, shipping and customer service). You'll bring a connected view of the marketplace to your product area, understanding how buyer, seller and post-sale experiences influence one another. You'll identify where people need support and where design can make the greatest difference, balancing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints. You'll lead through your work and influence, rather than people management. What You'll Do Lead design for parts of the seller and expert experience, from research and early concepts through prototyping, delivery and learning after launch. Use customer research, behavioural data and business insight to frame problems, identify needs and prioritise design opportunities. Turn complex problems into clear journeys, interaction and interface designs, prototypes and service flows. Test ideas with customers and colleagues, and use what you learn to improve them. Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Writers, supply stakeholders and other designers to shape and deliver solutions. Balance user empathy with business goals and technical constraints, connecting your design decisions to measurable customer and commercial impact. Contribute to design systems and shared patterns that create coherent experiences across Catawiki. Use Figma and practical AI-assisted workflows to explore ideas and build prototypes, applying judgment to the outputs. Communicate your thinking clearly, tell the story behind your decisions and iterate in response to feedback. Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities, getting up to speed quickly with the aim of contributing productively within your first month. What You'll Bring 5+ years of experience owning UX or product design work end to end , with a portfolio showing how you approached complex problems, the decisions you made and the outcomes you contributed to. Strong interaction design, prototyping and visual communication skills , with an understanding of how to use and improve design systems and shared patterns. Experience conducting or contributing to customer research and translating research , data and direct feedback into design decisions. Strong Figma skills and practical experience using AI for design ideation or prototyping , alongside a willingness to keep experimenting. Clear, structured communication in English and the ability to explain your approach to design and non-design partners. Structured problem solving, independent decision-making and systems thinking : understanding how decisions within one product area affect connected journeys and the wider marketplace. The ability to manage stakeholders , collaborate across disciplines and influence decisions without formal authority. Adaptability and openness to feedback as priorities , processes and design tools evolve. Helpful experience Working in a smaller product company, e-commerce platform or marketplace. Designing seller journeys or working on marketplace experiences. Delivering in less structured environments with several competing priorities. How We Work Across disciplines: You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Writers, supply stakeholders and other designers, bringing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into shared decisions. From evidence to iteration: Customer research, behavioural data and direct feedback help shape the work. You'll explore and test ideas, iterate with customers and colleagues, and keep learning after launch. With ownership and openness: You'll own design decisions, explain your rationale and bring feedback into the process. Clear communication and influence matter more than formal authority. items.desc: Shape our offensive security services Ready to immerse yourself in the world of securing critical IT by thinking and acting like a real adversary? Join our security team at Schuberg Philis! We are an engineering company with a people-centric approach and a focus on customer satisfaction, dedicated to delivering mission critical IT solutions to our customers. As an offensive security specialist, you will collaborate with about 30 customer-oriented teams managing critical system environments. Your role is pivotal in ensuring the security of Schuberg Philis and its customers by identifying and exploiting realistic paths in our complex, one-of-a-kind environments. You will scope, execute, and report on penetration tests, purple and red teaming engagements, and threat modeling assessments tailored to our unique and complex mission-critical environments. We focus on what real-world adversaries search for and abuse, not compliance-driven checks that look good on paper but don't raise resilience. You will engage closely with engineers, customer teams, external experts, vendors, and stakeholders to define and drive work that measurably strengthens these environments. The engagements are hands-on and technical, and we want someone who can own an engagement end-to-end: from a customer saying "we want to test something, can you help us figure out what?" all the way to presenting the results of a bespoke engagement to their board. At Schuberg Philis, we thrive on growth and innovation, offering an exciting environment for security enthusiasts. We are actively seeking security professionals at various seniority levels to join our security team. We provide a challenging and rewarding atmosphere where autonomy in your day-to-day operations is valued. We are a small team and we are part of the team that works on our value propositions for security. This means we have a lot of mandate to define and shape offensive security services within Schuberg Philis. In this role, you will work with cutting-edge technologies, spanning private and public clouds and VMs to serverless - all highly automated. As an offensive security specialist your skills will be put to the test in a diverse technological landscape. Success in this role requires a unique blend of skills and traits 7+ years of experience (the more the better) in an offensive security role. A security mindset aimed at identifying realistic attack paths from a real-world adversaries' perspective. Giving security advice that fits the unique and challenging mission-critical environments we manage to help our teams set up strong defense-in-depth. Recommendations should fit the environment in front of you, not a textbook fix that can't be applied there. You will have the experience and judgment to run engagements on your own, and the collaborative instinct to tackle the hardest problems together. Our teams will love you if you can take them by the hand through the entire process. Experience and understanding at least one of the major clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP). Strong risk management thinking, sense of ownership, and a solid BS radar. Eagerness to learn, coupled with a stubborn determination to make things happen. Experience with building solid tools that support our activities. Experience in IT engineering and IT engineering heavy environments preferred. What will be your focus? Help scope, lead, execute, and report on various types of complex offensive security engagements. Every environment is unique, and we expect our engagements to treat them as such as well. Build and maintain tools to help scale our offensive security services well beyond a small team. As an example: by building and maintaining a secure AI penetration testing methodology and toolkit that can be used by our customer teams. Collaborating with all customer teams, offering guidance on security-related topics. Evaluating and improving the security resilience of Schuberg Philis itself through red and purple teaming engagements. Using your technical and soft skills to guide the organization in adopting security measures along with the broader security team. We show impact, and can help limit it. Where we would love to grow as a team We care more about mindset, experience, and being calm under pressure than a checklist of specific technologies. Our best work comes from people who can rely on experience and the right mindset to tackle the unfamiliar. However, if you bring depth in advanced malware development, Kubernetes, or OT security, you'll find eager sparring partners and plenty of room to make those areas your own. Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across …

Investigator & Designated Local Officer About the Role CBRE's Global Trust & Investigations team conducts independent, objective, and high-quality investigations into allegations of serious misconduct and supports one of the world's leading ethics and compliance programs. The team helps protect CBRE's people, reputation, and culture by ensuring concerns are addressed fairly, consistently, and professionally. The Investigator & Designated Local Officer (DLO), Poland serves as a key member of the EMEA Trust & Investigations team and supports CBRE's whistleblower and investigations framework across the Poland regional hub. The role combines responsibility for conducting complex investigations with designated local officer responsibilities supporting whistleblower administration and governance. The position supports Poland, Czechia, Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, Croatia, Slovenia, and Bulgaria and partners closely with Legal, Compliance, People, Internal Audit, Corporate Security, and business leadership to ensure concerns are handled fairly, consistently, and professionally. What You’ll Do Lead Complex Investigations Conduct investigations involving fraud, corruption, financial misconduct, ethics concerns, retaliation, workplace misconduct, discrimination, harassment, conflicts of interest, and other significant concerns. Manage investigations from intake through closure, including planning, interviews, evidence review, analysis, findings, and reporting. Assess credibility, analyze information from multiple sources, and develop objective, evidence-based conclusions. Prepare high-quality investigative reports and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Support regional and cross-border investigations throughout EMEA. Serve as Designated Local Officer Serve as Designated Local Officer for assigned entities within the Poland regional hub. Receive, assess, and manage whistleblower reports submitted through internal reporting channels. Perform risk assessments and determine appropriate investigative approaches. Maintain professional and confidential communications with reporting persons and other stakeholders. Support governance, recordkeeping, and whistleblower program oversight activities. Escalate significant legal, regulatory, financial, employee-relations, or reputational risks as appropriate. Partner Across the Enterprise Build strong working relationships with Legal, Compliance, People, Internal Audit, Corporate Security, and business leaders. Provide guidance regarding investigations, confidentiality, retaliation risk, and appropriate case handling. Coordinate effectively with regional and local stakeholders while maintaining investigative independence. Support training and awareness initiatives related to investigations and whistleblower reporting. Generate Risk Insights Identify trends, root causes, control weaknesses, and emerging risks arising from investigative activity. Support remediation discussions and broader risk-mitigation initiatives. Maintain complete and accurate documentation within approved case-management systems. Contribute to the continued evolution, consistency, and effectiveness of CBRE's EMEA investigations program. What You’ll Need Bachelor's degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. Approximately 5-8+ years of experience in investigations, compliance, legal, audit, employee relations, corporate security, law enforcement, or a comparable field. Experience conducting complex workplace, ethics, compliance, fraud, financial, or misconduct investigations. Strong interviewing, analytical, critical-thinking, and report-writing skills. Ability to exercise sound judgment when handling highly sensitive and confidential matters. Strong stakeholder-management, collaboration, and communication capabilities. Fluency in Polish and English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting whistleblower programs or investigations frameworks. Experience in a multinational or matrixed organization. Familiarity with European whistleblower and compliance frameworks. Professional …

At Aristocrat, we are committed to your growth and success, equipping you with the tools and assistance required to excel in a fast-paced environment. Build Seamless Integrations: Design and support reliable data flows between SAP, external financial tools (e.g., Kyriba) and internal Allegro ecosystems. S/4HANA Readiness: A solid understanding of modern SAP standards and the technical curiosity required to refactor legacy setups for a smooth transition to S/4HANA. Strong Integration Skills: Proven experience in designing secure, reliable integrations connecting SAP with diverse third-party and internal systems. The Mentor DNA: Exceptional communication skills with a natural ability to share knowledge, discuss technical challenges collaboratively, and guide junior/mid-level developers. Pragmatism & Agility: Excellent self-organization skills to manage concurrent priorities, and the ability to use modern engineering tools (including AI assistants) to optimize your workflow and deliver on time. What's in it for you: Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms). A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories. English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job. A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. items.desc: Are you a Software Engineer/ Data Engineer, passionate about modern Java development, data-driven solutions, and building personalized customer experiences? Join us in shaping the future of financial tech at Avanza! Driven by changing customer behavior, digital transformation, and smart technology, the financial industry is constantly evolving. At Avanza, we are continuously improving our offerings to make savings cheaper, better, and simpler for millions of people. We are now building a brand-new Martech team within our Product & Tech organization, and we are looking for a Software Engineer/ Data Engineer to join us on this journey! We are on an exciting journey. As Avanza expands into Denmark, we are undergoing a major cloud transformation toward Google Cloud Platform (GCP). By 2030, our goal is to be fully cloud-based and "AI-first”. About the Role In this role, you will be a key player in building up a new team consisting of developers, data engineers, a product manager and an engineering manager. Together, you will design, implement, further develop, and maintain high-performing products and systems within the Marketing Technology (Martech) domain. As a Software/Data Engineer in the Martech team, you will work closely with the business and get to tackle domain-specific engineering challenges—focusing on personalized experiences, data-driven development, and scaled performance. Your key responsibilities will include: Designing, implementing, and managing products and microservices architecture within the Martech domain. Conducting technical investigations and feasibility studies to support well-founded architecture decisions. Taking active part in design processes—both technically and in shaping the product roadmap alongside the business. Participating in agile ceremonies (standups, retros, planning) with rotating responsibility, as well as shared weekly responsibility for unmapped work, bug handling, and support ("KA"). Challenging existing solutions with innovative, efficient ways to solve complex domain problems. Who We Are Looking For To thrive in this role, you are a curious, solution-oriented developer who enjoys taking technical ownership while maintaining a collaborative, team-first mindset. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable backing up your ideas with data and logic, and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and evolve. You appreciate an environment with low prestige, high trust, and a strong focus on delivering real value to our customers. Avanza is currently transitioning to English as our primary language. We welcome English-speaking candidates who are comfortable working in an environment where Swedish is still used in day-to-day communication, meetings, and documentation. We expect this to evolve as we continue our transformation. We would love to see that you have: At least 4–5 years of relevant professional experience in system development. Solid, hands-on experience with Java and it´s surrounding ecosystem. Have hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and a curiosity to explore how AI can enhance our work. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent self-taught knowledge. It is a great bonus if you have experience or interest in: Marketing Technology (Martech), personalization, or streaming data. Technologies such as Spring, MongoDB, BigQuery, dbt, Spanner and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP). Modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular, React) and microservices architecture. Event-driven architecture, CI/CD, and test automation. Domain knowledge from Fintech, insurance, or pensions. What We Offer At Avanza, you get to work with modern technologies in an open, helpful, and innovative atmosphere. We believe in flexibility and balance, offering a hybrid work environment where we spend 3–4 days at our office in Stockholm and 1–2 days remotely. You will be part of a culture that encourages growth, personal commitment, and having fun along the way! Application Process Please submit your application by clicking the "Apply Now" button below. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible as applications are reviewed continuously, but no later than 21/12 . Please note that due to GDPR compliance, we do not accept applications via email. If you have any questions about the role or team, feel free to contact Ulrika.Nord@avanza.se (Talent Acquisition Partner). We look forward to receiving your application!
