items.desc: We’re looking for an (Senior) Analytics Engineer to join Knowit’s Services team. In this role, you’ll combine business understanding with practical data platform development, working with our clients and helping shape Knowit’s own internal data platform. You might already be a senior professional or ready to take the next step towards that level. What matters most is your ability to understand business needs, translate them into technical solutions and take those solutions into practice. What the role is about You’ll join a close team of seven professionals whose expertise spans data engineering, data modelling and BI. We work together across client accounts, sharing knowledge and helping each other solve problems. Our way of working brings continuity to client relationships and gives you colleagues who understand the context of your work. Our clients typically need broad support: from clarifying a business problem to integrating source data, building data models and making the results usable. You’ll work across several accounts, with your responsibilities shaped by your strengths and the clients’ needs. We develop data platforms in close cooperation with our maintenance colleagues. Your focus will be on developing and improving solutions, with an understanding of how they can be maintained over time. Alongside client work, roughly half of your role will focus on developing Knowit’s internal data platform. Here, you’ll work closely with technical colleagues and business stakeholders, helping identify development needs and turn them into working solutions. Your work could include: Discussing business needs with stakeholders and identifying the problems worth solving. Building and improving data pipelines , source integrations and maintaining cloud data platforms . Designing data models and semantic and context layers that give data a clear, shared business meaning. Developing data applications with Streamlit and making data accessible through suitable analytics tools. Developing our internal platform , particularly with Snowflake and dbt, alongside Tableau. Exploring and implementing capabilities for AI applications and agents , including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and capabilities within Snowflake. Building data platforms for analytics and AI Our development direction is towards platforms that serve a wider range of uses, including AI applications and agents alongside reporting and dashboards. For you, this means thinking about how data should be structured, described and made accessible so it can support both today’s business questions and emerging use cases. Semantic modelling is an important part of this work: helping people and applications interpret data consistently. You don’t need to arrive with all the answers. We’re looking for curiosity, sound technical judgement and a willingness to develop these approaches together with the team. What do we expect from you? You have several years of relevant experience in analytics engineering, data engineering or a similar role combining business needs with technical delivery. You’re comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions and involving colleagues when their expertise will help. We’re particularly interested in: Business understanding and stakeholder collaboration . You can explore the need behind a request, clarify requirements and explain technical choices to different audiences. Strong practical data modelling skills . You can turn source data and business concepts into clear, maintainable models. Experience with semantic and context modelling is especially valuable. Experience with modern cloud data platforms , such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Fabric. Experience with data transformation and modelling tools . We use dbt extensively, so hands-on experience is valuable. A strong modelling background and readiness to learn dbt also give you a good foundation. Familiarity with Git and CI/CD practices , and a basic understanding of AWS and/or Azure . An interest in developing data applications, including working with Streamlit. Good communication skills in English. Finnish is welcome, but it is not required. You’ll likely enjoy this role if you like variety, working closely with business stakeholders and following a solution from the initial question through to implementation. We also value experience with integration tools such as Fivetran, Frends or native AWS and Azure components, as well as established BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI or YAML-based ones such as Lightdash or dbt charts. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Coder est pour vous une passion, et pas seulement une compétence ? Infrastructure, Python, Continuous Delivery, DevOps, Open Source ne sont pas que des buzzwords pour vous ? Bref, un vrai passionné de tech ! Rejoignez-nous ! Au sein de l'une de nos Feature Teams, adepte de l'approche " You build it, You Run it " et qui a pour projet de développer le Cloud privé mondial du Groupe ! En tant que développeur Devops Cloud, vous contribuerez aux services d'infrastructure Cloud (IaaS) consommés par l'ensemble de nos DSI. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Développer des services Cloud à base d'outils OpenSource et d'autres standards du marché (Jira, GitHub, Jenkins, Sonar, Ansible, etc.) le tout dans une approche Agile (Scrum ou Kanban) Contribuer à l'établissement des standards et aux bonnes pratiques de développement, à l'engineering de développement et/ou à l'architecture logicielle de votre service Participer au maintien des services en conditions opérationnelles, dans un processus de " Continuous Deployment ", avec création d'environnements " On Demand " Administrer les services compute du cloud privé de la Société Générale, sur OpenStack/Openshift Contribuer aux différentes communautés open source, en particulier OpenStack Mettre en place des solutions d'automatisation des opérations (Bot, Machine Learning, AgenticAI) Et si c'était vous ? Vous êtes diplômés d'un Bac +4/+5 en école de Commerce, d'Ingénieur ou Université avec une spécialisation en informatique et vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience sur des technos infra Vous êtes intéressé et maîtrisez peut-être l'utilisateur des services cloud des hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Plateform, OVH), ce serait un plus ! Vous êtes à l'aise sur plusieurs stacks technos open source, administration système, Linux, Kubernetes, Openstack, Openshift, Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery, Ansible, Terraform, Git, Monitoring, Prometheus, Python, etc. Vous êtes vrai pédagogue et à l'écoute, vous aimez travailler en équipe, dans un environnement dynamique et international You're fluent in english ! Vous êtes notre candidat idéal ! Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Notre vision est de jouer un rôle moteur dans les transformations positives du monde et de contribuer à un avenir plus écologique, respectueux de la planète ! Choisir Société Générale, c'est intégrer un Groupe où la culture d'entreprise est tournée vers l'inclusion, la diversité et l'esprit d'équipe ! C'est construire une carrière dynamique avec la possibilité de changer de poste en moyenne tous les 4 ans, en France et à l'international tout en bénéficiant de formations régulières ! Au regard de vos compétences, une rémunération attractive revue annuellement, composée d'un salaire fixe, d'une part variable individuelle et d'une prime d'intéressement et de participation vous sera proposée. Vous bénéficiez également de tarifs préférentiels sur vos services bancaires, d'un compte épargne temps monétisable et d'un Plan d'Epargne Entreprise abondé . Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez de nombreux avantages complémentaires : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service 26 à 28 jours de congés payés par an et 14 à 18 jours de RTT (suivant les années), des congés liés aux événements de la vie Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Un Comité d'Entreprise (billetterie événements sportifs & culturels, primes et subventions vacances, garde d'enfants, chèque cadeaux à Noël) Une offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Pourquoi nous choisir ? Chez Société Générale, nous sommes convaincus que vous êtes le moteur du changement, et que le monde de demain sera fait de toutes vos initiatives, des plus petites aux plus ambitieuses. Aux 4 coins du monde, que vous nous rejoigniez pour quelques mois, quelques années ou toute votre carrière, ensemble nous avons les moyens d'avoir un impact positif sur l'avenir. Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d'engagement sont multiples.

items.card: Deine Aufgaben Design-Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Experience in Kundenprojekten oder Workstreams und führst sie eigenständig vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Go-live. User Research: Du gehst zu den Menschen, die die Software später nutzen: in Interviews, Usability-Tests und vor Ort. Was du dort lernst, verdichtest du zu Insights, mit denen ein Team arbeiten kann. Discovery & Workshops: Du holst
items.desc: Deine Rolle Gutes Design bemerkt man meistens erst, wenn es fehlt: beim Bestellprozess, der sich zieht, oder im Portal, in dem niemand findet, was er sucht. Als Experience Designer bei Turbine Kreuzberg sorgst du dafür, dass es gar nicht so weit kommt. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit Software arbeiten, in B2B-Commerce-Plattformen, Kundenportalen, PIM- und Content-Systemen oder internen Tools. Unser Leitmotiv heißt »From Intent to Code«. Mit AI und Agentic Engineering setzen wir neue Capabilities auf bestehende Systeme und machen aus einer Absicht früh lauffähige Software. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen diese Capabilities erleben und nutzen, und siehst deine Ideen schnell im Code und vor echten Nutzer:innen. Dabei arbeitest du im Team mit Consultants, Engineers und Architekt:innen. Deine Arbeit vertrittst du vor dem Dev-Team genauso überzeugend wie vor dem Vorstand. Deine Aufgaben Design-Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Experience in Kundenprojekten oder Workstreams und führst sie eigenständig vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Go-live. User Research: Du gehst zu den Menschen, die die Software später nutzen: in Interviews, Usability-Tests und vor Ort. Was du dort lernst, verdichtest du zu Insights, mit denen ein Team arbeiten kann. Discovery & Workshops: Du holst Fachbereiche, Management und Engineering an einen Tisch und machst aus einer unklaren Lage eine klare Fragestellung. Experience-Konzeption: Du übersetzt komplexe B2B-Prozesse in Journeys, Informationsarchitekturen und User Flows, die einfach wirken, obwohl sie es nicht sind. UI Design & Prototyping: Du gestaltest Interfaces, arbeitest mit Design Systems und baust Prototypen, gern auch code-nah mit AI-Tools. AI-Experiences: Du gestaltest AI-gestützte Funktionen so, dass Menschen ihnen vertrauen und sie gern nutzen. Umsetzungsbegleitung: Du bleibst bis zum Schluss dran, im Handover, bei Akzeptanzkriterien und in der Design-QA mit unseren Engineers. New Business: Du erkennst, wo bei Auftraggeber mehr möglich ist, und hilfst, daraus neue Projekte zu machen. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre als Experience, UX, Product oder Service Designer gearbeitet, am besten in einer Beratung oder einem Produktteam. Erfahrung mit Commerce-, PIM- oder Content-Plattformen ist ein Plus. Portfolio: Dein Portfolio zeigt den Weg vom Problem zur umgesetzten Lösung und was diese Lösung bewirkt hat. Konzeptionsstärke: Verschachtelte Abläufe und Datenmodelle reizen dich, weil am Ende etwas Einfaches daraus werden soll. Gestaltungsqualität: Typografie, visuelle Hierarchie und Barrierefreiheit (WCAG) beherrschst du, Figma sowieso. Technologieverständnis: Du verstehst genug von Frontend, APIs und Design Tokens, um mit Engineers über Machbarkeit zu sprechen. AI Fluency: Du nutzt AI täglich in Research, Synthese und Prototyping und weißt, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Präsentation & Storytelling: Deine Decks bringen komplexe Inhalte auf eine Story, die im Workshop überzeugt und im Pitch gewinnt. Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf das perfekte Briefing. Du fragst nach, machst Risiken sichtbar und bringst die Arbeit voran. Check, check, check… Halt! Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien – oder einfach andere? Lass dich davon nicht abhalten. Entscheidend sind deine Neugier, dein Urteilsvermögen und deine Fähigkeit, AI in echte Ergebnisse zu übersetzen. Wir freuen uns auf die Möglichkeit, neue Skills zu lernen und beizubringen. Das erwartet dich bei uns AI mit Wirkung: Du verbindest Beratung, Pitches und implementierte AI-Lösungen mit messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen. Consulting und Engineering als Einheit: Du arbeitest mit Consultants, Engineers, Architekt:innen und den Teams unserer Auftraggeber an Lösungen, die funktionieren. Zwei plus drei: Hybrides Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen im Office in Berlin und drei Tagen flexibel. Frischer Wind für deine Ideen: In unseren Breakout- und Hackout-Sessions entwickelst du neue Ideen und testest neue Wege. Meerblick statt Bürowand: Pack deinen Laptop ein und arbeite eine Zeit lang aus unserer Agentur-Wohnung in Faro, Portugal. Wachse über dich hinaus: Wir geben dir Zeit und Budget für deine persönliche Weiterbildung. Fit bleiben, wie du willst: Wir bezuschussen deine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club Exklusive Vorteile: Über unser Corporate-Benefits-Programm bekommst du Rabatte bei vielen bekannten Marken. Unser Einstellungsprozess Schritt 1 – Bewerbung: Du sendest uns dein Portfolio mit Anschreiben. Schritt 2 – Erstes Kennenlernen: 30 Minuten für ein gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, deine Fragen und ein Blick in dein Portfolio. Schritt 3 – Case und reguläres Interview: Case mit Vorbereitung (2 Tage vor Interview erhältst du eine Aufgabe) plus reguläres Interview Schritt 4 – Finales Interview / Lunch: Je nach Standort treffen wir uns in Berlin oder Hamburg zu einem finalen Gespräch und gemeinsamen Lunch. Kontakt Matthias Specht matthias.specht@turbinekreuzberg.com Über uns Turbine Kreuzberg vereint Business Consulting mit Software Engineering. …

items.desc: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it. About the role You will own how customers experience Agent F, from landing pages and product demonstrations through onboarding and migration to the work they do every day. A founder looking at their finances for the first time and a controller investigating a discrepancy need different levels of detail. Both should understand where they are, what a number means and what to do next. This combines product design with hands-on front-end engineering. You will talk to customers, shape the journey, design the interactions and ship them in the product. You will use AI coding agents to help implement changes, and take responsibility for reviewing the code and checking the finished experience. Your work will connect the product into a coherent whole: consistent navigation, familiar controls and clear explanations across features. You will also own the steps that turn an interested visitor into an active, paying customer. What you will build and improve An engaging path from first interest to a useful result. Connect landing pages and product demonstrations to sign-up, account setup and the first session so a customer understands what to provide and what they will get back. Measure where people abandon the process and address the causes. A migration experience people can follow. Help customers bring in their history from accounting software or spreadsheets. Make upload progress, missing information, validation errors and next steps understandable. A consistent product experience. Develop the design language, navigation and reusable components used across the product. Make tables, forms and reports behave predictably, including loading, empty and error states. Useful decision screens. Design views that help customers compare recommendations, understand costs and choose what happens next. Our planned evidence board brings this information together as customers describe their needs. Interfaces that earn trust. Help users see where a figure came from, understand a proposed change and review it before approval. Include accessibility, keyboard use and clear language in the implementation. Improvements grounded in actual use. Keep up with the customer pipeline, from interested prospects to customers onboarding or migrating. Observe customer sessions and work with the customer-facing team. Turn recurring questions into product changes, then check whether those changes helped. For example, a customer uploads a file and sees a different total from the one they expected. You would design the journey that explains what was imported, what needs checking and how to resolve the difference, working with the data engineer on the underlying evidence. What you bring You have five or more years of experience designing and shipping software, including business-to-business software sold as a service (B2B SaaS). You may come from product design with strong engineering skills, or from front-end engineering with substantial design ownership. You can show a product journey you improved, explain the choices you made and describe the effect on customers. You have owned an onboarding, activation or conversion measure: whether people got started, reached a useful result or became paying customers. Core experience Product design across information architecture, interaction design and visual design. Production front-end work with React, TypeScript, CSS and reusable components, including reviewing and debugging code generated by agents. Building or maintaining a design system that other people use. Customer research, usability testing and product analytics that inform what you ship. Daily use of AI coding agents, with a clear approach to specifications, review and verification. Clear written explanations of design decisions and their trade-offs. Useful additional experience Financial software, complex tables and dashboards, or products where people need to inspect the source of a result. Experience with configuration-driven interfaces, where shared rules and data determine how a screen is assembled, would also be useful. items.desc: Meet the Team Cisco Collaboration Design is defining the next generation of product experiences across hardware and software. We are a global, cross-disciplinary team of designers, researchers and technologists who care deeply about how people work together and how our products can make collaboration better. Our work spans collaboration devices, software and intelligent workplace experiences, with particular attention to the administrators who enable, manage and support them and the people who use them every day. We’re committed to a creative, supportive design culture where you can experiment, learn and do meaningful, impactful work. Designers contribute across products and experience areas as priorities evolve, bringing different strengths to a shared design practice. Your Impact We are looking for a Product Designer who can bring clarity to complex systems and work closely with product and engineering to turn user needs, technical constraints and product strategy into intuitive, reliable, scalable and accessible experiences. You will help shape the future of the intelligent workplace, making it easier for administrators to enable effective collaboration while delivering useful, coherent experiences for end users. In this role, you will: Design end-to-end experiences across collaboration devices, software and intelligent workplace services, including the workflows administrators use to enable, manage and support collaboration. Understand how multiple data sources connect to create meaningful experiences. Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, researchers and other designers to define user journeys, interaction models and implementation-ready designs for administrators and end users. Explore how AI-assisted and agentic workflows can improve collaboration and workplace experiences while reducing friction and preserving user trust and control. Showcase how you use emerging technologies and AI tools for design exploration, prototyping and research synthesis, applying human judgment in close collaboration with engineering. Create prototypes at the right level of fidelity, from quick explorations to detailed concepts for team alignment, usability testing and engineering handoff. Use Cisco’s design system to create consistent experiences, identifying gaps and contributing patterns across device, workplace and administrator workflows. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related experience or a master’s degree with 3+ years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience. A portfolio or work samples demonstrating product design projects, including user insights, interaction flows, individual contribution and evaluation of proposed solutions. Experience working end-to-end within the design process from exploration to launch and iteration using Figma and any additional design tools. Experience working with product management and engineering on product design projects. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing for collaboration devices, workplace technology or experiences spanning desktop, web, mobile and connected hardware. Experience with enterprise administrator workflows, such as deployment, configuration, management, monitoring or support. Experience designing AI-assisted workflows, automation or intelligent recommendations, with attention to user understanding, trust and control. Ability to frame user problems, explain design decisions and build agreement through feedback and collaboration. Strong interaction design skills, with experience translating complex information and system behavior into clear workflows, interfaces and visualizations Collab Hiring Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets, TechInsights’ content informs decision makers and professionals whose success depends on accurate knowledge of the semiconductor industry—past, present, or future. Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market analysis in the semiconductor industry. TechInsights’ customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence. Own your software in production. That includes monitoring, fixing defects, investigating incidents and learning from how the system behaves in production. Use CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code so deployments and recoveries are repeatable and safe. Prefer small batches and short feedback loops. Coach and mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming and design discussions. Encourage open, constructive technical debate. Use AI tools across design, coding, testing, debugging and refactoring. Review AI-generated work critically before accepting it. Why this role exists Product Designer owns the end-to-end experience of Valis: from the first time a CEO sees it, through the admin setting it up, to the moment an employee uses it every day. What you will do Customer journey Map the journey for each type of user: CEO and founder, client admin, end user, and our own deployment team. Keep it current as the product changes. Sit in on client rollouts and install sessions. Watch real people use the product, and turn what you see into clear, prioritised problems for engineering. Define and track experience metrics with the product and deployment teams: activation, adoption, time to first value. Product design Design the core surfaces end to end: the desktop app (daily brief, meetings library, calendar, chat), the mobile app and the admin panel. Design the onboarding: first install, connecting data sources, first useful answer. Write specs and prototypes that engineers and AI agents can build from directly. Tailor them to the reader: a CEO needs to see which of their problems a release solves, and an employee needs to know what changed in their app. Requirements Must have 7+ years in product design, including 3+ years owning the experience of a B2B SaaS product end to end, not a single feature inside a large team. Prototyping in code (React / TypeScript), working in GitHub alongside engineers. Experience with enterprise users: admins, IT, security and access settings. Good working knowledge of RU language Benefits We offer competitive base, performance-based bonus, and the opportunity to join the team during fast growth.

items.desc: At Cerrion, we’re building the future of AI-enabled manufacturing. Headquartered in Zurich with more than $25M in funding from Creandum, Y Combinator, and top Silicon Valley investors, we’re building the industrial AI platform to deploy AI Agents that can see what’s happening on the production floor, automatically spot problems, and instantly intervene to keep lines running smoothly, at scale. Our technology is live in factories across 18+ countries, helping leading manufacturers in glass, beverage, food, CPG, building materials, and wood cut downtime by up to 50%. We are looking for an independent Installation Engineer to work with us on a long-term B2B contract. The Opportunity You are the person who gets our AI camera systems installed right. Working from Poland, you travel to customer sites (glass plants, food factories, packaging facilities), lead the installation, and make sure every deployment meets our technical standard. You also help build the playbook: site documentation, floor plans, cable routing standards, and installation checklists that can be reused across future deployments. Most of the work happens hands-on in the field, with frequent international travel, mainly across Europe and occasionally to the US. You have seen most of what can go wrong on an industrial site. When a cable goes missing at a factory in the US, you drive to the nearest electrical shop and solve it. This is a contract engagement for an established professional running your own business (JDG or equivalent). You own your installations from the first site visit to the final debrief, organize your own work, and invoice Cerrion monthly for your services. Travel and accommodation costs for deployments are included in your invoice. Scope of Work Lead on-site installations: install cameras and hardware at industrial facilities, mainly across Europe with occasional projects in the US. Deliver to standard: complete each installation to Cerrion’s technical specification and share learnings that improve future deployments. Build the playbook: produce installation documentation, including floor plans, cable schematics, and configuration notes, plus reusable checklists. Optimize the process: spot inefficiencies in how installations are done today and propose better hardware solutions. Coordinate on site: work with local contractors and facility engineers, and solve logistical and technical problems independently, from sourcing materials locally to adapting mounting solutions. Report back: debrief after each deployment on what worked, what didn’t, and what to improve. We’d love to hear from you if You run your own registered business in Poland (JDG or equivalent) and can invoice on a B2B basis. You are a licensed electrician, certified to work in electrical cabinets operating above 24V (e.g. SEP G1 E). This is mandatory. It is a legal and safety requirement for our deployments. You bring 5+ years of hands-on electrical or field installation experience. You can read and produce floor plans and wiring diagrams. You are resourceful and independent, and solve problems on the ground without needing every next step spelled out. You are comfortable with everyday collaboration tools: shared spreadsheets, project trackers, and Slack. You are available for frequent international travel. You speak and write fluent English. Nice-to-Have Experience in manufacturing, automation, or building systems. German, Spanish, or French. Why work with Cerrion Impact: Every camera you mount and cable you route powers AI Agents running on real production lines in factories across 18+ countries. Steady, long-term work: A growing deployment pipeline across Europe and the US, with your scope growing as our footprint grows. Compensation: Competitive B2B rate, invoiced monthly, with travel costs covered through your invoice. Autonomy: You plan your own work around agreed project timelines, with minimal bureaucracy. Team: Collaborate with AI PhDs, ex-Googlers, and serial entrepreneurs from around the world.

items.desc: About Us Innovamat is an educational organization specializing in mathematics education . Founded in Barcelona in 2017, Innovamat provides schools with a complete, research-based math program covering Early Childhood through Secondary Education, grounded in research across mathematics education, cognition, and neuroscience. Our program integrates curriculum, teacher training, assessment, and intervention into a single coherent system. Today, Innovamat is present in 9 countries, partnering with 31,000+ teachers across 3,300+ schools and reaching more than 720,000 students. We are one of the few organizations in the sector with independently validated efficacy data from external research institutions, and the first non-American organization to pass the California State Board of Education adoption process for a core math curriculum. Your Mission You will join our Operations team as its software engineering backbone . Our business systems (CRM, marketing automation, data warehouse, classroom platform, billing and logistics) are a large distributed ecosystem. Until now we have run them with hybrid profiles that combine business understanding with hands-on building. As we scale across markets, we need someone who brings real software engineering discipline to Operations: clean architecture, testing, observability, reliability and maintainability. Your Day To Day Building and owning integrations between our core systems (Salesforce, Iterable, the Classroom Manager platform, Jira, the data warehouse, billing and others), with proper error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring. Developing on the CRM platform (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows) and replacing no-code spaghetti with maintainable, tested code where it makes sense. Designing data pipelines and syncs that keep our systems consistent at scale, and diagnosing why they drift (data quality, API limits, payload edge cases). Creating internal tools and services that automate manual processes for Revenue and Operations teams, from small scripts to full applications. Work with engineering standards: version control, code review, CI/CD, environments, documentation and incident post-mortems. Taking part in incident resolution across the Operations ecosystem. You will find the root cause and then fix the structural problem so it doesn't come back. Evaluating build vs. buy vs. configure with sound technical judgment, and being honest about trade-offs and cost. Working closely with Engineering and Data so Operations systems and the product platform evolve coherently. Using AI agents and automation to speed up your own development and to design AI-assisted workflows for the business. Mentoring colleagues with hybrid or less technical profiles, raising the technical bar of the team. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional experience as a software developer (backend or full-stack), with solid fundamentals: data structures, APIs, testing, version control and debugging complex systems. Strong command of at least one general-purpose language ( Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Apex or PHP ) and willingness to learn others quickly. Experience designing and consuming REST/GraphQL APIs , webhooks and asynchronous processes, and handling their failure modes. Good SQL skills and comfort working with data models and analytical data (warehouse, ETL/ELT). Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms (CRM, marketing automation, billing, ERP) is a big plus. Technical judgment: you understand trade-offs, write code that others can maintain, and know when not to build something. Interest in the business side of what you build. You want to understand how Sales, Marketing and Customer Success work, so you solve their real problem and not just the ticket. Early-adopter mindset with AI coding agents and automation tools. High autonomy and ownership. You can take a vague operational pain point and turn it into a reliable solution. Fluent English and conversational Spanish. You'll stand out if you have: Experience with Salesforce development (Apex, LWC, SOQL, deployments) or another enterprise CRM. Experience with iPaaS/automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n) and knowing their limits. Experience with Databricks, dbt, Metabase or a similar data stack. Background in marketing automation (Iterable, HubSpot, Braze…) and email/data deliverability. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and infrastructure as code. Previous experience in a B2B or edtech company. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is welcome, but we value demonstrated ability above all. items.desc: Привіт! Ми OBRIO — команда, яка завжди хоче більшого: від себе, від життя, від роботи. Якщо тобі теж замало «достатньо добре» — ти вже розумієш, про що ми. Тут сильні люди притягують сильних — і разом ми розвиваємо компанію, що будує продукт № 1 у ніші spiritual wellness — Nebula. Зараз ми шукаємо AI Engineer до Tech команди. Ти будуватимеш внутрішні AI-рішення з нуля — від архітектури до продакшену. Твої системи напряму впливатимуть на ефективність команд, що працюють з 70M+ користувачами по всьому світу. Це не підтримка і не супровід — це реальна розробка, яка формує фундамент AI в компанії. У команді ти працюватимеш разом з Антоном Водолазьким (СТО OBRIO). Працюючи напряму з ним, ти матимеш реальний вплив на технічну стратегію продукту, швидкі рішення та можливість будувати AI-рішення на рівні бізнесу. Які виклики тебе чекають? Побудувати внутрішні AI-рішення з нуля . Перетворювати бізнес-запити команд у ефективні LLM-архітектури (RAG, embeddings, vector search). Закласти фундамент AI-інфраструктури, яка зростатиме разом із бізнесом. Твій вплив ми бачимо в: Скороченні часу команд на рутинні задачі завдяки AI-автоматизації процесів. Формуванні AI як реального бізнес-інструменту, а не експерименту. Створенні довгострокової цінності — AI-систем, які напряму впливають на ефективність компанії. Підвищенні швидкості прийняття рішень через кращий доступ до даних і знань. Що сприяє твоєму успіху у цій ролі? Ти маєш 1+ рік досвіду у розробці та інтеграції AI/LLM-рішень Ти реалізовував RAG, embedding-процеси або налаштовував векторні БД Ти розбираєшся в LLM, prompt engineering і контекстному менеджменті Володієш Python та/або JavaScript Маєш досвід із LangChain, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex або схожими фреймворками Працював з N8N, Diffy чи іншими automation/оркестраційними платформами Володієш знаннями класичних ML-алгоритмів (Regression, Tree-based, Clustering) Розумієш основи MLOps, CI/CD, контейнеризації Впевнено читаєш технічну документацію, API, працюєш із логами та observability. Що ти отримаєш в OBRIO? Свободу у форматі роботи — можливість працювати з офісу в Києві, Львові, Варшаві або remote, з підтримкою надкомфортних умов у трьох містах. Сильне середовище для зростання — 75% команди формують Middle та Senior спеціалісти, тож ти швидко зростаєш через складні задачі та сильних колег. Підтримку фізичного та ментального ресурсу — участь в OBRIO Wellness Club або покриття індивідуальних занять спортом та Spiritual Allowance для твого балансу (дивись, як це працює в нас). AI Workation — до 5 робочих днів на квартал, які ти можеш повністю присвятити створенню масштабованих AI-інструментів. Час на відновлення — 20 оплачуваних днів відпустки, необмежені лікарняні та можливість sabbatical leave. Щоб досягати якнайкращих результатів потрібно якнайкраще почуватись. Причетність до соціально важливих ініціатив — участь у благодійних проєктах, волонтерстві та підтримці мобілізованих колег і їхніх сімей. Один з наших проєктів OBRIO Innovation Space x КПІ нещодавно номінований на DOU Awards. Ти будуватимеш внутрішні AI-рішення з нуля — від архітектури до продакшену. Твої системи напряму впливатимуть на ефективність команд, що працюють з 70M+ користувачами по всьому світу. Це не підтримка і не супровід — це реальна розробка, яка формує фундамент AI в компанії. У команді ти працюватимеш разом з Антоном Водолазьким (СТО OBRIO). Працюючи напряму з ним, ти матимеш реальний вплив на технічну стратегію продукту, швидкі рішення та можливість будувати AI-рішення на рівні бізнесу. Які виклики тебе чекають? Побудувати внутрішні AI-рішення з нуля . Перетворювати бізнес-запити команд у ефективні LLM-архітектури (RAG, embeddings, vector search). Закласти фундамент AI-інфраструктури, яка зростатиме разом із бізнесом. Твій вплив ми бачимо в: Скороченні часу команд на рутинні задачі завдяки AI-автоматизації процесів. Формуванні AI як реального бізнес-інструменту, а не експерименту. Створенні довгострокової цінності — AI-систем, які напряму впливають на ефективність компанії. Підвищенні швидкості прийняття рішень через кращий доступ до даних і знань. Що сприяє твоєму успіху у цій ролі? Ти маєш 1+ рік досвіду у розробці та інтеграції AI/LLM-рішень Ти реалізовував RAG, embedding-процеси або налаштовував векторні БД Ти розбираєшся в LLM, prompt engineering і контекстному менеджменті Володієш Python та/або JavaScript Маєш досвід із LangChain, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex або схожими фреймворками Працював з N8N, Diffy чи іншими automation/оркестраційними платформами Володієш знаннями класичних ML-алгоритмів (Regression, Tree-based, Clustering) Розумієш основи MLOps, CI/CD, контейнеризації Впевнено читаєш технічну документацію, API, працюєш із логами та observability. Що ти отримаєш в OBRIO? Свободу у форматі роботи — можливість працювати з офісу в Києві, Львові, Варшаві або remote, з підтримкою надкомфортних умов у трьох містах. Сильне середовище для зростання — 75% команди формують Middle та Senior спеціалісти, тож ти швидко зростаєш через складні задачі та сильних колег. Підтримку фізичного та ментального ресурсу — участь в OBRIO Wellness Club або покриття індивідуальних занять спортом та Spiritual Allowance для твого балансу (дивись, як це працює в нас). AI Workation — до 5 робочих днів на квартал, які ти можеш повністю присвятити створенню масштабованих AI-інструментів. Час на відновлення — 20 оплачуваних днів відпустки, необмежені лікарняні та можливість sabbatical leave. Щоб досягати якнайкращих результатів потрібно якнайкраще почуватись. Причетність до соціально важливих ініціатив — участь у благодійних проєктах, волонтерстві та підтримці мобілізованих колег і їхніх сімей. items.desc: A propos d’Atos Atos est la marque d’Atos Group dédiée aux services numériques de bout en bout, sécurisés et accélérés par l’IA. Atos conçoit, développe et opère des environnements numériques essentiels à la performance, à la résilience et à la souveraineté. L’entreprise aide les organisations publiques et privées du monde entier à garder la maîtrise de leurs données et de leurs infrastructures, tout en répondant à leurs exigences de conformité. Avec plus de 52 000 collaborateurs au service de plus de 4 500 clients dans 54 pays, Atos accompagne la modernisation des systèmes IT, accélère la transformation cloud et data, renforce la cybersécurité et déploie des environnements de travail numériques sécurisés, au bénéfice de ses clients, de leurs collaborateurs et de la société. Atos propose également des services de conseil et d’accompagnement à travers sa marque Atos Amplify. Partenaire de confiance dans la gestion d’environnements complexes et critiques, Atos accompagne les organisations dans des contextes hautement réglementés et souverains. A propos d’Atos Group Atos Group est un leader international de la transformation digitale avec près de 54 000 collaborateurs et un chiffre d’affaires annuel de près de 7,2 milliards d’euros. Présent commercialement dans 54 pays, il exerce ses activités sous deux marques Atos pour les services et Eviden pour les produits et systèmes. Numéro un européen de la cybersécurité et leader dans le domaine du cloud, Atos Group s’engage pour un avenir sécurisé et décarboné. Il propose des solutions sur mesure et intégrées, accélérées par l’IA, pour tous les secteurs d’activité. Atos Group est coté sur Euronext Paris. Au sein des équipes Atos impliquées dans plusieurs programmes européens majeurs du secteur spatial, vous contribuerez à la conception de nouvelles générations de services exploitant l'intelligence artificielle agentique pour transformer des données spatiales complexes en informations directement exploitables par les utilisateurs. Ces solutions combinent données d'observation de la Terre, modèles géospatiaux, modèles de fondation spécialisés et systèmes multi-agents afin d'assister les experts dans la compréhension et l'analyse de problématiques liées à l'agriculture, à l'environnement, à la gestion des risques, à l'aménagement du territoire et à l'adaptation au changement climatique. Vous intégrerez une équipe mêlant expertise spatiale, intelligence artificielle, data science et cloud computing dans un environnement d'innovation à forte visibilité européenne. Vos missions Votre mission consistera à concevoir et développer des chaînes de traitement agentiques capables d'exploiter de multiples sources de données et de connaissances pour répondre à des besoins métiers complexes. Analyser des cas d'usage métiers et les traduire en workflows agentiques ; Identifier et intégrer les sources de données pertinentes (observation de la Terre, données géospatiales, documents techniques, bases de connaissances, services externes) ; Concevoir des architectures reposant sur des Small Language Models (SLM) et Large Language Models (LLM) ; Développer des mécanismes d'orchestration d'agents spécialisés ; Mettre en œuvre des modèles de fondation géospatiaux (Geospatial Foundation Models) et des modèles physiques ou scientifiques ; Évaluer et améliorer la qualité des raisonnements, des inférences et des résultats générés ; Concevoir des mécanismes de validation, de traçabilité et d'explicabilité des résultats ; Participer au déploiement de démonstrateurs et de prototypes innovants. Au cours du stage, vous pourrez intervenir sur différentes composantes des projets conception système, IA générative, orchestration multi-agents, développement logiciel, data science ou encore interaction homme-machine. Profil Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en école d'ingénieurs ou en cursus universitaire équivalent et recherchez un stage de fin d'études d'une durée minimale de 4 mois. Vous possédez idéalement des connaissances dans plusieurs des domaines suivants Développement Python ; Conception logicielle et architectures distribuées ; Données géospatiales et observation de la Terre ; Intelligence artificielle générative ; LLM, SLM et systèmes RAG ; Architectures agentiques et multi-agents ; Frameworks d'orchestration tels que LangChain, LangGraph ou équivalents ; Protocoles et mécanismes d'interopérabilité d'agents (MCP, A2A ou technologies similaires) ; Méthodes de développement logiciel en contexte projet. Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais écrit est nécessaire pour l'exploitation de documentations scientifiques et techniques dans un contexte international. As part of a global technology organization, NTT DATA combines international expertise with strong local capabilities to deliver secure, scalable, and business-focused solutions to enterprise customers. The team will work closely with NTT Hungary's Data Center, Customer Experience, and Networking business areas, developing AI solutions that can be integrated into existing enterprise environments and services — from contact centers and text-to-speech solutions to broader AI-powered business applications. Our vision is to design, scale, demonstrate, and deliver enterprise AI platforms that provide the foundation for a growing portfolio of AI services and solutions. As an AI Solution Engineer , you will play a hands-on role across the entire solution lifecycle — from customer discovery, pre-sales and proof-of-concepts through technical validation, deployment, and early production implementation. Given that the position is part of the Hungarian subsidiary/organizational unit, and that the role supports medium and large corporations, as well as Hungarian state-owned enterprises, fluent knowledge of both Hungarian and English, as well as a location in Hungary—preferably Pest County/Budapest—is essential What You Will Do Build and deploy AI solutions — configure, integrate, validate, and troubleshoot enterprise AI platforms across on-premises, private cloud, hybrid, and public cloud environments. Develop hands-on AI prototypes and PoCs using LLMs, open-weight models, model APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and agentic AI workflows. Translate customer requirements into technical solutions by contributing to solution concepts, architecture, sizing, technical designs, and implementation approaches. Integrate AI platforms with enterprise environments , including APIs, data sources, identity and authentication services, security controls, and existing business applications. Lead the technical delivery of successful PoCs and sales engagements , transitioning validated solutions toward secure, scalable, and operable implementations. Create and deliver technical demonstrations and workshops , explaining complex AI technologies and demonstrating their practical business value to customers and internal stakeholders. Troubleshoot and optimize solutions across applications, AI platforms, containers, infrastructure, integrations, and model-serving environments. Develop reusable technical assets , including reference architectures, deployment patterns, configurations, documentation, runbooks, and demo environments. Collaborate across disciplines , working with AI architects, cloud and infrastructure teams, networking, security, delivery, sales, and technology partners. Stay current with enterprise AI technologies and evaluate emerging platforms, frameworks, model-serving technologies, and cloud-native capabilities. What You Bring 3–5 years of hands-on IT experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, solution engineering, systems integration, or a comparable technical role. Strong practical experience with Linux, Python, REST APIs, Git, scripting, and technical troubleshooting , with the ability to develop and integrate working solutions rather than focusing solely on operations. Hands-on experience with containers and deployment technologies , particularly Docker, with working knowledge of Kubernetes or comparable orchestration platforms; OpenShift experience is a strong advantage. Practical understanding of modern Generative AI , including LLM APIs or model inference, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and agentic AI concepts. Professional AI/ML experience is a plus, but not mandatory. Experience integrating and deploying software across enterprise environments , including on-premises, private cloud, hybrid cloud, or public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Understanding of enterprise AI infrastructure and operations , including model serving, inference, GPU-based workloads, security, identity, networking, monitoring, and production-readiness considerations. Customer-facing and solution-oriented mindset , with an ability to participate in pre-sales, technical workshops, proof-of-concepts, solution validation, and early-stage implementations. Strong communication, problem-solving, ownership, and continuous-learning skills , with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with architects, engineers, sales teams, and customers. Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion, dedication, and a no-excuse mindset to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.
Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic cellular transceivers. We are looking for an experienced RF engineer to lead the validation of complex PLL and frequency synthesis subsystems. In this role, you will work cross functionally with Design, Firmware, and System teams to ensure our silicon meets rigorous specifications. As an RF TX Silicon Validation Engineer, you will own the bring-up and characterization of frequency generation subsystems in market-leading transceivers. Your work style is collaborative and proactive, driving technical solutions across interdisciplinary teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills; ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to Chip Design, Firmware, System Engineering and System Validation teams.
Expertise in Python for test automation and data analysis (NumPy/Pandas), and demonstrated experience working with AI coding agents beyond script generation: delegating multi-step tasks, defining acceptance criteria, and validating agent output against specifications.
Proven track record in systematically debugging complex silicon issues and isolating root causes across hardware, firmware, or test setups.
Deep understanding of RF transceiver architecture with specific expertise in cellular transmitter architecture and key metrics like ACRL, SEM, EVM and Cross-Talk Isolation.
Mastering requirements for cellular standards (e.g. 5G NR, LTE) and mixed-signal building blocks (ADCs/DACs) is highly desirable.
Experience with 3GPP spectrum emission and network signalling requirements is definitely a plus.
Hands-on mastery of RF lab equipment including Spectrum/Phase Noise Analyzers, VNAs, and high-speed Oscilloscopes.
Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience in RF/Mixed-Signal validation, system engineering or design.

items.level: Silicon Validation Engineering ICT4 – Silicon Validation Engineering ICT5
items.desc:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion, dedication, and a no-excuse mindset to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.
Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic cellular transceivers. We are looking for an experienced RF engineer to lead the validation of complex PLL and frequency synthesis subsystems. In this role, you will work cross functionally with Design, Firmware, and System teams to ensure our silicon meets rigorous specifications. You will drive our shift to agentic engineering, scaling validation throughput with AI agents without compromising the quality bar, to enable uncompromised connectivity in future Apple products.
As an RF PLL Silicon Validation Engineer, you will own the bring-up and characterization of frequency generation subsystems in market-leading transceivers. Your work style is collaborative and proactive, driving technical solutions across interdisciplinary teams. You will work in an agentic work flow, you scope the problem and define pass/fail criteria, delegate implementation and execution to AI agents, and verify every result against the specification.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills; ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to Chip Design, Firmware, and System Verification teams.
Expertise in Python for test automation and data analysis (NumPy/Pandas), and demonstrated experience working with AI coding agents beyond script generation, delegating multi-step tasks, defining acceptance criteria, and validating agent output against specifications.
Proven track record in systematically debugging complex silicon issues and isolating root causes across hardware, firmware, or test setups.
Hands-on mastery of RF lab equipment including Spectrum/Phase Noise Analyzers, VNAs, and high-speed Oscilloscopes.
Deep understanding of RF transceiver architecture with specific expertise in frequency synthesis (PLLs, DCOs) and key metrics like Phase Noise, Lock Time, and Cross-Talk Isolation.
Experience with cellular standards (5G NR, LTE) and mixed-signal building blocks (ADCs/DACs) is highly desirable.
Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience in RF/Mixed-Signal validation or design.
Experience building agentic workflows or tooling (e.g., custom agents, tool integrations, LLM-driven test automation) in an engineering environment.

items.desc:
About the job
 Keep Graphcore’s Bristol laboratories safe, reliable and ready for engineers to test AI hardware.
 As a Lab Technician in DC Engineering, you’ll support the facilities behind hardware bring-up, validation and characterisation. You’ll help engineering teams use electronic systems and test equipment safely and effectively.
 Your preventative maintenance and troubleshooting will help keep laboratory equipment available for engineers’ work. By checking electrostatic discharge controls, you’ll help protect the hardware being developed and tested.
 You’ll set up and calibrate test equipment, manage laboratory assets, and support board, cable and wire modifications. You’ll also oversee goods coming into and leaving the laboratories.
 Beyond equipment support, you’ll shape standard operating procedures for multidisciplinary laboratory teams. Your technical guidance will help colleagues meet safety, quality and regulatory requirements in their everyday work.
 The team and culture
 The Laboratory team supports engineering groups with installations, repairs and equipment modifications. You’ll work with engineers to understand their technical requirements and get test benches ready within project timescales.
 The team maintains accurate technical documentation and works to defined laboratory practices. You’ll contribute practical guidance and help junior colleagues develop their skills.
 What we’re looking for
 Experience working in an electronics laboratory and a practical, resourceful approach to technical problems.
 Ability to set up, calibrate and troubleshoot electronic test equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analysers and power supplies.
 Understanding of electrostatic discharge (ESD) controls and laboratory health and safety requirements, with experience applying safe working practices.
 Experience repairing and modifying PCB assemblies to IPC-7711/21 and J-STD-001 standards, and inspecting assemblies to IPC-A-610.
 Experience assembling cables and wire harnesses from drawings to IPC-620 standards.
 Clear communication across engineering disciplines, with the ability to meet project timescales and mentor junior colleagues.
 While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.
 Benefits
 Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
 Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
 Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
 Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
 Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
 Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
 Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
 Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Sponsorship
 Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.
 Access to controlled technology 
 Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.
 Join the Team at Graphcore
 Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
 As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings …

items.desc:
The role translates business, technology and market developments into clear marketing choices: where Nokia should play, which audiences and opportunities matter most, how Nokia should position itself and where GMC should focus its investment and resources.
 Operating across Nokia's businesses and GMC, the strategist connects market intelligence, customer needs, technology developments, competitive dynamics and Nokia's portfolio into a compelling and differentiated strategic narrative.
 This is a senior strategic role. It is not primarily responsible for campaign or programme execution. Instead, it sets the direction that enables Marketing Planners, Campaign teams, Communications, Brand, Field Marketing and specialist teams to build integrated plans and execute effectively.
Lead the development and execution of Nokia’s global Cloud & AI marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with business and technology priorities.
 Identify strategic growth opportunities, investment priorities, and competitive positioning to strengthen market leadership.
 Analyze customer, market, competitor, and technology trends to inform strategic decision-making and future direction.
 Develop a differentiated Cloud & AI point of view that establishes Nokia as a trusted industry leader.
 Translate complex technology innovations into compelling customer-focused insights, value propositions, and market narratives.
 Create and govern a unified Cloud & AI positioning, messaging architecture, and thought leadership framework.
 Define priority audiences, market segments, ecosystem partners, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
 Collaborate with Brand, Communications, and portfolio teams to deliver consistent and impactful external storytelling.
 Provide strategic guidance to marketing planning and execution teams while driving alignment across functions and business units.
 Establish success metrics, evaluate market impact and performance, and continuously optimize strategy based on data-driven insights.
You have:
 Extensive experience in B2B technology marketing, marketing strategy, portfolio strategy, or similar strategic leadership roles.
 Strong knowledge of cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and their impact on enterprise and telecommunications markets.
 Proven strategic thinking, business acumen, and ability to align marketing initiatives with business objectives.
 Ability to translate complex technologies into compelling customer value propositions and market narratives.
 Expertise in market research, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and strategic analysis.
 Demonstrated success in developing differentiated positioning, messaging frameworks, and go-to-market strategies.
 Strong capability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable strategic priorities.
 Exceptional executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
 Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across matrixed organizations without direct authority.
 Experience working within large, global organizations, leveraging data-driven insights to refine strategy and measure business impact.
 It would be nice if you also had:
 Experience within telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise technology sectors.
 Familiarity with hyperscalers, cloud ecosystems, and strategic technology partnerships.
 Understanding of AI infrastructure, platforms, and the evolving AI ecosystem.
 Proven track record of advising senior executives and contributing to leadership decision-making forums.
 Exposure to major technology launches, ecosystem initiatives, and industry-shaping market events.
 P.S: The role does not support relocation.

items.title: Applied AI Course Author
items.card: you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call. Project details are shared after signing an NDA. Requirements: 5+ years of recent professional experience in applied AI/ML, data, AI automation, or a related field, including hands-on experience with LLMs. A master’s degree or PhD in a relevant field, or 10+ years of senior professional experience in AI or a related industry.
items.desc: TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners (people with no prior tech background) through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions. We’re looking for an experienced Course Author in Applied AI to help design and develop a graduate-level online program in Applied Artificial Intelligence, delivered in partnership with a US university. The program is built for working professionals in fields such as marketing, operations, finance and HR. They learn to evaluate, build, integrate, deploy and govern AI solutions using modern no-code and low-code tools. You’ll turn approved course syllabi into engaging, rigorous learning materials and help shape how a new generation of AI practitioners learns to make sound, defensible decisions. This is a part-time, project-based opportunity for subject matter experts who are passionate about teaching, curriculum design and helping learners succeed. Please submit all resumes or CVs in English. After applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call. Project details are shared after signing an NDA. Requirements: 5+ years of recent professional experience in applied AI/ML, data, AI automation, or a related field, including hands-on experience with LLMs. A master’s degree or PhD in a relevant field, or 10+ years of senior professional experience in AI or a related industry. Practical knowledge of AI tools and workflows, including prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, automation, APIs, and LLM evaluation. Experience applying AI to real business problems, considering business value, cost, risk, and reliability. Experience teaching, mentoring, or creating educational content, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences. Strong English communication skills (C1+), including clear professional and educational writing. Strong organizational and collaboration skills, with the ability to work proactively, incorporate feedback, and meet agreed deadlines. Nice-to-have Experience designing courses or learning materials for higher education or online programs. Familiarity with AI strategy, business cases, or responsible AI practices or governance. Experience with EdTech or learning platforms, or contributions to the AI community through publications, talks, or open-source projects. Brand: TripleTen What you will do: Develop graduate-level course content in Applied AI based on approved syllabi: guided lessons, hands-on labs, case studies, weekly assignments and final projects, mostly in text and video format. Write clear assignment briefs and analytic rubrics for all graded work, including explicit rules on when and how students may use AI tools. Design practical labs on current AI platforms (LLM assistants, RAG applications, workflow automation, AI agents, APIs and monitoring tools), and make sure every graded task can be completed with free or open-source tools. Curate reading lists of research papers, standards and vendor documentation, and explain why each source matters. Create supporting materials: preparatory (non-credit) modules for learners without a technical background, a program glossary, templates and worked examples. Collaborate with the LX designer and the student experience team on learning objectives, course structure and assessment design (if you don’t have experience with this, that’s ok). Consult on Applied AI-related questions, and keep content up to date as tools and regulations change. Revise content based on academic review by the partner university’s faculty, and make sure it meets graduate-level academic standards. What we can offer you: Fully remote, part-time collaboration (at least 25h/week). Compensation: fixed fee per course package, paid in milestones. A diverse team across Europe, the US, Latin America and more. Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.

The customer is an established international organization offering a diverse range of products and services across multiple markets. Its activities focus on supporting business needs, improving operational processes, and delivering effective solutions. The company continues to develop its capabilities, adapt to changing market requirements, and pursue long-term growth. The project is focused on developing and maintaining a B2B e-commerce platform based on a headless commerce architecture. It includes extending platform functionality, integrating external business systems, and implementing process automation and AI-based capabilities to support business operations. Responsibilities Evolving the Medusa-based commerce backend: custom modules, data models, module links, API routes, workflows. Extending Medusa Admin with widgets and custom routes. Implementing B2B features: company accounts, customer groups, customer-specific price lists, quotes, approval flows, bulk ordering. Integrating ERP, CRM, PIM and back-office systems via workflows, event subscribers and scheduled jobs. Designing, building and deploying AI agents and tools working through Medusa APIs and workflows. Owning cloud infrastructure for Medusa: PostgreSQL, Redis, containerized server and worker instances, CI/CD. Finding manual bottlenecks and automate them. Writing clean, tested, secure code. Requirements Experience in backend development with Node.js and TypeScript for 5+ years. Hands-on production experience with Medusa (v2 preferred): custom modules, workflows SDK incl. compensation logic, subscribers, Admin customizations for 1+ years. This has allowed us to scale our coverage more effectively and deliver more meaningful impact throughout Dunelm's service teams. Contribute to shared libraries, observability components, and internal platforms. 2. Observability Instrumentation Help evolve our observability strategy across systems and services. Drive how we collect, process, sample, and surface logs, distributed traces and metrics using OpenTelemetry. Focus on high-quality telemetry that enables fast diagnosis, cost efficiency, and meaningful visibility across the stack. 3. Service Levels & Ownership Help teams truly own their services by helping to define and adopt meaningful SLIs and SLOs. Guide product teams in using observability data to make reliability measurable. 4. Incident Response Participate in on-call investigations when issues arise. Drive blameless post-incident reviews and help to identify observability gaps, recommend mitigating actions that stem losses, but also permanent fixes that prevent recurrence. 5. Infrastructure & Pipelines Model infrastructure using tools such as Pulumi, CDK, and Terraform in AWS and other PaaS and SaaS providers. Improve pipelines and support safe deployment strategies (e.g. canary, blue / green). 6. Mentoring & Team Growth Help support and coach other engineers. items.desc: The Maternity Matron post is a senior clinical leader responsible for providing visible, professional and operational leadership across maternity services. Working closely with the Head of Midwifery, obstetric, neonatal and wider multidisciplinary teams, the post holder will lead on the delivery of safe, effective and compassionate care, ensuring that women, babies and families receive high-quality services that meet national standards and local priorities. The Matron will be accountable for maintaining clinical quality, patient safety, governance, workforce management and patient experience across designated maternity areas. They will support staff development, promote a positive culture of continuous improvement, and lead initiatives that enhance service performance, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and recommendations from national maternity reviews. The role requires strong leadership, experience in change management, and a commitment to improving outcomes and reducing inequalities for women and babies. Please note we reserve the right to close this vacancy prior to the closing date once the required number of suitable applications have been received. The Modern Matron provides senior, visible, and compassionate clinical leadership across maternity services, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective, high ‑ quality and personalised care for women, birthing people, babies, and families. The post holder will lead and support community and rural midwifery-led unit teams to maintain excellence in clinical standards, operational performance, and patient experience. Working collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team, the Midwifery Matron ensures that services are responsive to women’s needs and aligned with national maternity priorities and local service objectives. The role promotes a culture of learning, continuous improvement, professional accountability, and staff wellbeing, acting as a positive role model and clinical expert who drives innovation and delivers equitable, evidence ‑ based maternity care. We manage three major locality hospitals at North Tyneside, Wansbeck and Hexham, plus a number of smaller community hospitals and clinics from Tynemouth to Berwick on Tweed, covering one of the largest geographical areas of any NHS trust in the country. Leading in innovation and quality – opening a state of the art Northumbria Specialist Emergency Care Hospital, the first of its kind in England. Do you want to work in one of the best performing NHS organisations in England? Work in an organisation that supports its staff and focuses on staff experience as much as it does the experience of its patients? You can live and breathe in an area that has the cleanest air, cost effective living, great nightlife, some of the best schools with a wealth of history available on your doorstep. Sound too good to be true? Well it isn’t, this is what you get when you work for Northumbria Healthcare, this is the Northumbria Way! Please read ‘applicant guidance notes’ before submitting your application. Provide visible clinical and operational leadership across maternity services, promoting a culture of safety, compassion, accountability and continuous improvement. Lead and support maternity teams to deliver high-quality, evidence-based care that improves outcomes and experiences for women, babies and families. Maintain oversight of clinical quality, patient safety, risk management, infection prevention and patient experience within designated areas. Ensure effective implementation of national maternity strategies, regulatory standards and local policies. Lead on workforce management, including recruitment, retention, absence management, rostering and workforce planning. Support staff wellbeing, professional development, clinical supervision and leadership development. Monitor service performance, quality indicators and key performance metrics, taking action to address areas of concern. Champion equity, inclusion and personalised care, working to reduce health inequalities and improve maternity outcomes for all women and families. About The Role The Media Data Platform (MDP) team is looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join a growing squad building MDLZ's in-house media ecosystem. You will design and deliver data pipelines, integrations, and AI-driven solutions that ingest, transform, and activate data from external media platforms — enabling smarter media investment decisions at global scale. The role sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams across Marketing & I&A Products. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and optimise data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve media data from external platforms (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social media, measurement partners) using Python, Databricks, GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow), and AWS. Develop and deploy AI/ML models and LLM-based workflows — including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration — to generate media performance insights and activation intelligence. Build and maintain APIs and backend services that surface media data and AI-generated insights to business users and downstream applications. Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for pipelines and models to ensure reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency in production. Collaborate with Product Owners, Engineering, and Architects across Marketing & I&A Products to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable technical solutions. Contribute to platform architecture decisions including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerisation (Docker), and CI/CD practices. Write clean, tested, well-documented code; participate in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and knowledge-sharing across the team. How You Will Contribute We Are Looking For Candidates With Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade data pipelines or applications. Hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery, DBT, Cloud Storage) and AWS, plus Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog). Solid understanding of data engineering — ETL/ELT, SQL, data modelling, and working with structured and unstructured data at scale. Exposure to AI/ML engineering — LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agent-based architectures. Experience with data integration patterns: REST APIs, streaming, orchestration (Airflow/Cloud Composer), and DBT. Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, CI/CD, testing, Docker, and Terraform. Strong communication skills; able to work cross-functionally and translate technical topics to business stakeholders. Intellectual curiosity and a bias for learning in a fast-moving data and AI environment. Nice to Have Experience in media data engineering and adtech integrations (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social platforms, Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI). Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem (MLflow, Feature Store, Genie). Exposure to NLP or multimodal AI. Experience with monitoring/observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch). Prior experience in a CPG/FMCG environment. The responsibilities of this position are performed within the framework of a regional business model that is defined and managed by Mondelēz Europe GmbH, Switzerland .
